abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Minimal symptom expression (MSE; Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living [MG- ADL] score: 0 or 1) achievement is increasingly recognized as a treatment goal in myasthenia gravis (MG). OBJECTIVE: To assess (post hoc) baseline MG-ADL scores and subsequent MSE achievement in patients participating in RAISE-XT (NCT04225871, Phase 3), an open-label extension study of the complement component 5 inhibitor zilucoplan. METHODS: Adults with anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive generalized MG completing a qualifying double-blind, placebo-controlled study (NCT03315130/NCT04115293 [RAISE]) could enter RAISE-XT and self-administer once-daily subcutaneous zilucoplan 0.3mg/kg. Double-blind baseline MG-ADL scores in patients stratified by MSE achievement (defined in the protocol, without rescue therapy) while on zilucoplan up to Week 120 and time to MSE after initiating zilucoplan were assessed (cutoff: November 11, 2023). RESULTS: Of 200 patients enrolled in RAISE-XT, 183 received only zilucoplan 0.3mg/kg or placebo in the double-blind studies. The cumulative proportion of patients achieving MSE at any time from zilucoplan initiation to Week 120 was 63% (Kaplan–Meier analysis). Patients who achieved MSE had MG-ADL scores of 2–18 at double-blind baseline (mean [standard deviation]: 9.7 [3.0], n=102); patients not achieving MSE had scores of 6–19 (11.0 [2.9], n=81). MSE was first achieved as early as Week 1 after initiating zilucoplan. Within 12 weeks of initiating treatment, 58.8% (n/N=60/102) of patients had achieved MSE. Treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 97.0% (n/N=194/200) of patients; most were mild or moderate. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Patients with a broad range of baseline MG-ADL scores achieved MSE during zilucoplan treatment, with some achieving MSE as early as one week after initiation. Funding: UCB. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：达到最小症状表达（MSE；重症肌无力日常生活活动量表[MG-ADL]评分：0或1）日益被视为重症肌无力（MG）的治疗目标。目的：在参加RAISE-XT（NCT04225871，3期）的患者中（事后）评估基线MG-ADL评分及随后达到MSE的情况，RAISE-XT是补体成分5抑制剂zilucoplan的开放标签扩展研究。方法：完成合格的双盲、安慰剂对照研究（NCT03315130/NCT04115293 [RAISE]）的抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性全身型MG成人可进入RAISE-XT，并自行每日一次皮下注射zilucoplan 0.3mg/kg。评估接受zilucoplan治疗至第120周期间按是否达到MSE（方案定义，无挽救治疗）分层的患者的双盲基线MG-ADL评分，以及开始zilucoplan后达到MSE的时间（数据截止：2023年11月11日）。结果：在RAISE-XT入组的200名患者中，183名在双盲研究中仅接受zilucoplan 0.3mg/kg或安慰剂。从开始zilucoplan至第120周任意时间达到MSE的累积比例为63%（Kaplan–Meier分析）。达到MSE的患者双盲基线MG-ADL评分为2–18（均值[标准差]：9.7 [3.0]，n=102）；未达到MSE的患者评分为6–19（11.0 [2.9]，n=81）。最早在开始zilucoplan后第1周即首次达到MSE。在开始治疗后12周内，58.8%（n/N=60/102）的患者已达到MSE。治疗中出现的不良事件发生于97.0%（n/N=194/200）的患者；大多数为轻度或中度。总结/结论：基线MG-ADL评分范围广泛的患者在zilucoplan治疗期间达到MSE，部分患者在开始治疗后最早一周即达到MSE。资助：UCB。

abstracts.title: Assessing the Relationship between IgG-levels and Infection Rate in Nipocalimab-treated Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis (VIVACITY-MG3)
abstracts.authors: Ghazala Hayat; Ricardo Rojo Cella; Robert Edwards; Marie Fitzgibbon; Robert Gordon; Wim Noel; Zia Choudhry; Kavita Gandhi; Sindhu Ramchandren; Kevin Winthrop; Carlo Antozzi
abstracts.affiliations: Saint Louis, MO; Spring House, PA; Raritan, NJ; Beerse, Belgium; Horsham, PA; Titusville, NJ; Portland, OR
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In the Phase 3 Vivacity-MG3 study, nipocalimab+standard-of-care (SOC) resulted in median IgG reduction of –69% at Week 24, with rapid and sustained disease control over 24 weeks in a broad population of antibody-positive patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), and was well-tolerated with an acceptable safety profile. Overall incidence of infection was similar between nipocalimab and placebo groups (43% each). OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether there is a relationship between reduced IgG levels and infection rates in patients with gMG treated with nipocalimab+SOC across the double-blind phase of Vivacity-MG3. METHODS: Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) analysis was conducted to assess whether IgG levels (evaluated as a continuous variable) were associated with infection rates in patients from Vivacity-MG3. Area-Under- the-Curve (AUC) values were calculated using logistic regression ROC analysis with treatment group, maximum change from baseline in IgG, and baseline IgG as covariates. AUC values range from 0–1, with 0.5–≤0.7 indicating no/poor discrimination (equivalent to chance/poor discrimination) and higher values reflecting predictive association (≥0.8–≤0.9, excellent). RESULTS: ROC analysis showed AUC (standard error) for patients with lowest post-baseline level of IgG ≤5 g/L (N=94, 105.5 patient-years-of-exposure): 0.51 (0.062); ≤4 g/L (N=87, 97.9 patient-years-of-exposure): 0.52 (0.064); ≤3 g/L (N=74, 72.4 patient-years-of-exposure): 0.53 (0.070); ≤2 g/L (N=44, 30.0 patient-years-of-exposure): 0.69 (0.082). These values indicate no real predictive association between reduced IgG levels (as low as ≤2 g/L) and infection rates. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: These results show no association of infection occurrence with lowering IgG levels in nipocalimab-treated patients with gMG in Vivacity-MG3. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在3期Vivacity-MG3研究中，nipocalimab+标准治疗（SOC）使第24周IgG中位降低–69%，并在广泛抗抗体阳性全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者人群中实现24周内快速且持续的疾病控制，且耐受性良好，安全性可接受。nipocalimab组与安慰剂组感染总体发生率相似（各43%）。目的：评估在Vivacity-MG3双盲阶段接受nipocalimab+SOC治疗的gMG患者中，IgG水平降低与感染率之间是否存在关系。方法：采用受试者工作特征（ROC）分析评估Vivacity-MG3患者的IgG水平（作为连续变量评估）是否与感染率相关。曲线下面积（AUC）值通过logistic回归ROC分析计算，协变量包括治疗组、IgG自基线最大变化和基线IgG。AUC值范围为0–1，0.5–≤0.7表示无/差区分度（等同于随机/差区分度），更高值反映预测性关联（≥0.8–≤0.9，优秀）。结果：ROC分析显示，基线后IgG最低水平≤5 g/L患者（N=94，105.5患者年暴露）的AUC（标准误）为0.51（0.062）；≤4 g/L（N=87，97.9患者年暴露）为0.52（0.064）；≤3 g/L（N=74，72.4患者年暴露）为0.53（0.070）；≤2 g/L（N=44，30.0患者年暴露）为0.69（0.082）。这些值表明IgG水平降低（低至≤2 g/L）与感染率之间无真实预测性关联。总结/结论：这些结果显示，在Vivacity-MG3中接受nipocalimab治疗的gMG患者中，感染发生与IgG水平降低无关联。海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: Assessing the Relationship between Immunoglobulin g Level and Efficacy of Nipocalimab Measured Using the Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living Scale
abstracts.authors: Zabeen Mahuwala; Ruben Faelens; Belén Valenzuela; Martine Neyens; Yaowei Zhu; Jocelyn Leu; Marie Fitzgibbon; Sindhu Ramchandren; Juan-José Pérez-Ruixo

abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab, a neonatal fragment crystallizable receptor (FcRn) blocker, prevents immunoglobulin G (IgG) recycling, lowers levels of circulating IgG antibodies, including pathogenic autoantibodies, and improves generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) symptoms. OBJECTIVE: To explore the longitudinal relationship between IgG level and Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) score using semi-mechanistic pharmacometrics modeling with data from clinical studies of nipocalimab in gMG and healthy volunteers. METHODS: Data from Phase 1 (n=5), Phase 2 (n=1), and Phase 3 (n=1; Vivacity-MG3) clinical studies were analyzed to characterize pharmacokinetics ([PK]; 3,429 serum nipocalimab concentrations [n=277]) and pharmacodynamics ([PD]; 4,441 serum IgG concentrations [n=421]; 1,247 FcRn receptor occupancy data [n=78]). To establish the longitudinal relationship between IgG and MG-ADL, 2,317 absolute change from baseline (CFB) MG- ADL scores were analyzed in seropositive (anti- acetylcholine receptor, anti-muscle-specific receptor tyrosine kinase, anti-lipoprotein receptor-related protein-4) gMG participants (n=220) using a previously developed nonlinear mixed-effects model. RESULTS: The previous model captured serum nipocalimab and total serum IgG concentrations of Vivacity-MG3 well. MG-ADL CFB drug effect was linearly related to IgG %CFB at 0.28 points per 10% IgG %CFB. In gMG, this resulted in approximately a 2-point MG-ADL reduction for nipocalimab-induced 70% IgG reduction when adjusted for placebo effect. The slope of the regression line was dependent on baseline MG-ADL score. Age, body weight, race, ethnicity, sex, autoantibody status, gMG background therapy, and gMG duration did not have a clinically relevant impact. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: The model confirmed IgG %CFB drives nipocalimab effect on MG-ADL. Total serum IgG reduction is a good predictor for efficacy in gMG, allowing for comparison of clinical effect across FcRn- blockers. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Nipocalimab是一种新生儿Fc受体（FcRn）阻断剂，可阻止免疫球蛋白G（IgG）再循环，降低循环IgG抗体（包括致病性自身抗体）水平，并改善全身型重症肌无力（gMG）症状。目的：利用nipocalimab在gMG和健康志愿者中临床研究的半机制群体药理学模型，探讨IgG水平与重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）评分之间的纵向关系。方法：分析1期（n=5）、2期（n=1）和3期（n=1；Vivacity-MG3）临床研究数据，以表征药代动力学（[PK]；3,429份血清nipocalimab浓度[n=277]）和药效动力学（[PD]；4,441份血清IgG浓度[n=421]；1,247份FcRn受体占有率数据[n=78]）。为建立IgG与MG-ADL之间的纵向关系，使用先前开发的非线性混合效应模型分析血清阳性（抗乙酰胆碱受体、抗肌肉特异性受体酪氨酸激酶、抗脂蛋白受体相关蛋白-4）gMG参与者（n=220）的2,317份MG-ADL自基线绝对变化（CFB）评分。结果：先前模型良好拟合Vivacity-MG3的血清nipocalimab和总血清IgG浓度。MG-ADL CFB药物效应与IgG %CFB呈线性相关，每10% IgG %CFB对应0.28分。在gMG中，经安慰剂效应校正后，nipocalimab诱导70% IgG降低约导致MG-ADL降低2分。回归线斜率取决于基线MG-ADL评分。年龄、体重、种族、民族、性别、自身抗体状态、gMG背景治疗和gMG病程无临床相关影响。总结/结论：该模型证实IgG %CFB驱动nipocalimab对MG-ADL的效应。总血清IgG降低是gMG疗效的良好预测指标，可用于比较不同FcRn阻断剂的临床效应。海报会议I和II

abstracts.title: Assessment of Sustained Health-related Quality of Life in Phase 3 VIVACITY-MG3 Trial of Nipocalimab versus Placebo in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: John Vissing; Kavita Gandhi; Sheryl Pease; Ibrahim Turkoz; Marie Fitzgibbon; Geoffroy Coteur; Wisam Karmous; Nolan Campbell; Sindhu Ramchandren; Elena Cortés- Vicente
abstracts.affiliations: Copenhagen, Denmark; Horsham, PA; Raritan, NJ; Titusville, NJ; Wemmel, Belgium; Barcelona, Spain
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), an autoantibody-mediated disease, causes fluctuating muscle symptoms and substantially impairs health-related quality-of-life (HRQoL). In Vivacity-MG3 (NCT04951622), nipocalimab+standard-of-care (SOC) demonstrated improved and sustained disease control versus placebo +SOC. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the changes in HRQoL during the 24-week (W) double-blind phase using patient- reported measures, MGQoL-15r and EQ-5D visual analogue scale (EQ-5D-VAS). METHODS: Mean change-from-baseline (CFB) between groups in MGQoL-15r and EQ-5D-VAS over 24W were compared using ANCOVA models. Meaningful-within- person-improvement (MWPI) response was a change of one-half a standard deviation on MGQoL-15r (≥4-point) and EQ-5D-VAS (≥10-point). Proportion of patients achieving MWPI and time-to-MWPI over 24W were examined using chi-square test and Kaplan-Meier analyses. Logistic regression evaluated likelihood of achieving MWPI over 24W and sustaining MWPI for ≥8,12,16, and 20W between groups. RESULTS: LS-mean (95% CI) difference in CFB on MGQoL-15r and EQ-5D-VAS was greater with nipocalimab+SOC versus placebo+SOC (−1.38 [−3.14,0.37], not significant [NS] and 6.86[2.07,11.66], p<0.05, respectively) at 4W and sustained (−1.61[−3.55,0.33], NS; 6.47[1.05,11.88], p<0.05) at 24W. At 24W, 67.2% (45/67) versus 56.5% (35/62) achieved MWPI on MGQoL-15r (absolute difference=10.7%[NS]) and 55.2% (37/67) versus 37.1% (23/62) patients achieved MWPI on EQ-5D-VAS (absolute difference=18.1% [p<0.05]) in nipocalimab+SOC versus placebo+SOC. For both measures, nipocalimab+SOC patients were twice as likely to achieve MWPI over 24W with median time-to-response approximately 4W versus 8W with placebo+SOC (p<0.05). Similarly, nipocalimab +SOC patients were approximately twice as likely to sustain MWPI for ≥8,12,16, and 20W (p<0.05) in both measures. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Nipocalimab+SOC-treated patients achieved meaningful HRQoL improvements as early as 4W and were significantly more likely to achieve and sustain these improvements over 24W versus placebo +SOC. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种自身抗体介导的疾病，导致波动性肌肉症状并显著损害健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）。在Vivacity-MG3（NCT04951622）中，nipocalimab+标准治疗（SOC）较安慰剂+SOC显示出改善且持续的疾病控制。目的：使用患者报告结局指标MGQoL-15r和EQ-5D视觉模拟量表（EQ-5D-VAS）评估24周（W）双盲阶段HRQoL的变化。方法：使用ANCOVA模型比较两组24周内MGQoL-15r和EQ-5D-VAS自基线平均变化（CFB）。有意义个体内改善（MWPI）应答定义为MGQoL-15r（≥4分）和EQ-5D-VAS（≥10分）变化达半个标准差。使用卡方检验和Kaplan-Meier分析检查24周内达到MWPI的患者比例及至MWPI时间。Logistic回归评估两组24周内达到MWPI及维持MWPI≥8、12、16和20周的可能性。结果：第4周时，nipocalimab+SOC较安慰剂+SOC在MGQoL-15r和EQ-5D-VAS的CFB LS均值（95% CI）差异更大（分别为−1.38[−3.14,0.37]，无统计学意义[NS]和6.86[2.07,11.66]，p<0.05），并在第24周持续（−1.61[−3.55,0.33]，NS；6.47[1.05,11.88]，p<0.05）。第24周时，nipocalimab+SOC与安慰剂+SOC分别有67.2%（45/67）与56.5%（35/62）达到MGQoL-15r的MWPI（绝对差异=10.7%[NS]），55.2%（37/67）与37.1%（23/62）达到EQ-5D-VAS的MWPI（绝对差异=18.1%[p<0.05]）。对于两项指标，nipocalimab+SOC患者在24周内达到MWPI的可能性为两倍，中位至应答时间约4周，而安慰剂+SOC约8周（p<0.05）。同样，nipocalimab+SOC患者在两项指标中维持MWPI≥8、12、16和20周的可能性约为两倍（p<0.05）。总结/结论：nipocalimab+SOC治疗患者早在4周即达到有意义的HRQoL改善，且较安慰剂+SOC在24周内显著更可能达到并维持这些改善。海报会议I和II

abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is a chronic autoimmune disease. MycarinG (Phase 3/NCT03971422) and its open-label extension studies (MG0004/NCT04124965 and MG0007/NCT04650854) demonstrated the efficacy of repeated cyclic rozanolixizumab treatment in patients with gMG. Managed Access Programs (MAPs) enable pre-authorization treatment for patients with severe/debilitating/life- threatening conditions, where available treatments are deemed inadequate. OBJECTIVE: To describe rozanolixizumab utilization patterns and patient characteristics in MAPs initiated under compassionate use in France, Italy, and Spain. METHODS: This observational, retrospective, longitudinal cohort study included adults with gMG who initiated rozanolixizumab treatment in MAPs in France, Italy and Spain (November 2022–May 2025). Baseline demographics and disease characteristics at treatment initiation were described. Change from baseline in myasthenia gravis (MG)-specific outcomes was assessed when available. All analyses were descriptive. RESULTS: Overall, twelve patients from France, 16 from Italy, and <5 from Spain were included; most were female (58.3%, 87.5% and 50.0%, respectively). Mean (standard deviation [SD]) age was 73.7 (14.6), 53.8 (14.0) and 61.5 (16.5) years, respectively. Additional data were available for Italy: mean (SD) disease duration was 10.8 (10.6) years; 43.8% of patients had an MG diagnosis <5 years, and baseline (mean [SD]) MG-Activities of Daily Living score was 7.4 (2.6). In the two years pre-enrollment, MG crises and MG-related hospitalizations occurred in 6.3% and 43.8% of patients, respectively. Pre-enrollment, 56.3% of patients received pyridostigmine; all received corticosteroids. Treatment outcomes data will be presented in the poster. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Patient baseline characteristics in the rozanolixizumab MAPs were indicative of a population with moderate to severe gMG. Funding: UCB. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种慢性自身免疫性疾病。MycarinG（3期/NCT03971422）及其开放标签扩展研究（MG0004/NCT04124965和MG0007/NCT04650854）证明rozanolixizumab重复周期治疗对gMG患者的疗效。管理可及项目（MAP）允许对现有治疗被认为不充分的严重/致残/危及生命状况患者提供授权前治疗。目的：描述在法国、意大利和西班牙因同情用药启动的MAP中rozanolixizumab的使用模式和患者特征。方法：这项观察性、回顾性、纵向队列研究纳入在法国、意大利和西班牙MAP中启动rozanolixizumab治疗的成人gMG患者（2022年11月至2025年5月）。描述治疗启动时的基线人口学和疾病特征。在可获得时评估重症肌无力（MG）特异性结局的自基线变化。所有分析均为描述性。结果：总体纳入法国12例、意大利16例、西班牙<5例患者；大多数为女性（分别为58.3%、87.5%和50.0%）。平均（标准差[SD]）年龄分别为73.7（14.6）、53.8（14.0）和61.5（16.5）岁。意大利有额外数据：平均（SD）病程为10.8（10.6）年；43.8%患者MG诊断<5年，基线（平均[SD]）MG-日常生活活动评分为7.4（2.6）。入组前两年内，MG危象和MG相关住院分别发生于6.3%和43.8%患者。入组前，56.3%患者接受吡啶斯的明；所有患者均接受皮质类固醇。治疗结局数据将在海报中展示。总结/结论：rozanolixizumab MAP中患者基线特征表明该人群为中重度gMG。资助：UCB。海报会议I和II

abstracts.title: Characterization of Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis on Zilucoplan Treatment in European Managed Access Programs
abstracts.authors: Thais Tarancon; Paolo Emilio Alboini; Pascal Cintas; Sophie Demeret; Vincenzo Di Stefano; Carmen Erra; Laura Fionda; Raffaele Iorio; Raul Juntas-Morales; Emmeline Lagrange; Michelangelo Maestri; Sabrina Sacconi; Fiammetta Vanoli; Claudia Vinciguerra; Karin Annoni; Michelle Mackechnie

abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In RAISE (Phase 3/NCT04115293) and its open-label extension (RAISE-XT/NCT04225871), zilucoplan demonstrated myasthenia gravis (MG)-specific outcome improvement in patients with generalized MG (gMG). Managed Access Programs (MAPs) enable pre- authorization treatment for patients with a severe/debilitating/life-threatening condition, where available treatments are deemed inadequate and no clinical trials are available. OBJECTIVE: To describe zilucoplan utilization patterns and patient characteristics in MAPs initiated under compassionate use/early access authorization in France, and compassionate use in Italy/Spain. METHODS: This cohort study included adults with gMG initiating zilucoplan in MAPs in France, Italy and Spain (December 2021–November 2024). Patient demographics and disease characteristics were described. RESULTS: A total of 57 patients from France, 32 from Italy, and <5 from Spain were included; most were female (50.9%, 65.6% and 75.0%, respectively). Mean (standard deviation [SD]) age was 56.5 (19.8), 57.8 (14.9) and 48.8 (13.6) years, respectively. Additional data were available for France and Italy. Mean (SD) disease duration was 8.7 (9.2) and 11.6 (10.2) years; 42.1% and 28.1% of patients, respectively, had an MG diagnosis <5 years. Baseline mean (SD) MG-Activities of Daily Living scores were 7.3 (4.7) and 9.2 (3.6), respectively. In the two years prior to enrollment, MG crises and MG-related hospitalizations occurred in 57.9% and 9.4%, and 80.7% and 43.8% of patients, respectively. Pre-enrollment, 73.7% and 96.9% of patients received pyridostigmine, and 75.4% and 100% received corticosteroids, respectively. Treatment outcomes will be presented in the poster. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Patients with gMG who entered zilucoplan MAPs had a long disease duration and high prior hospitalization and crisis, reflecting a large unmet need. Funding: UCB. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在RAISE（III期/NCT04115293）及其开放标签扩展研究（RAISE-XT/NCT04225871）中，zilucoplan在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者中显示出重症肌无力（MG）特异性结局的改善。管理准入项目（MAPs）允许对患有严重/致残/危及生命疾病的患者进行预先授权治疗，这些患者可用的治疗被认为不充分且无临床试验可参加。目的：描述在法国因同情用药/早期准入授权而启动的MAPs中，以及在意大利/西班牙因同情用药而启动的MAPs中，zilucoplan的使用模式和患者特征。方法：本队列研究纳入在法国、意大利和西班牙的MAPs中启动zilucoplan治疗的成人gMG患者（2021年12月至2024年11月）。描述患者人口学特征和疾病特征。结果：共纳入法国57例、意大利32例、西班牙<5例患者；大多数为女性（分别为50.9%、65.6%和75.0%）。平均（标准差[SD]）年龄分别为56.5（19.8）、57.8（14.9）和48.8（13.6）岁。法国和意大利有额外数据。平均（SD）病程分别为8.7（9.2）和11.6（10.2）年；分别有42.1%和28.1%的患者MG诊断<5年。基线平均（SD）MG-日常生活活动量表评分为7.3（4.7）和9.2（3.6）。在入组前两年内，MG危象和MG相关住院分别发生于57.9%和9.4%，以及80.7%和43.8%的患者中。入组前，分别有73.7%和96.9%的患者接受吡啶斯的明治疗，75.4%和100%接受皮质类固醇治疗。治疗结局将在海报中展示。总结/结论：进入zilucoplan MAPs的gMG患者病程长，既往住院和危象发生率高，反映出巨大的未满足需求。资助：UCB。海报专场I和III

abstracts.title: Corticosteroid Usage in Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Receiving Nipocalimab: Phase 3 VIVACITY-MG3 Open-label Extension
abstracts.authors: Yuebing Li; Kavita Gandhi; Wisam Karmous; Marie Fitzgibbon; Ibrahim Turkoz; I-Ching Tsai; Zia Choudhry; Wim Noel; Louis Jackson; Sindhu Ramchandren; Hiroyuki Murai
abstracts.affiliations: Cleveland, OH; Horsham, PA; Raritan, NJ; Titusville, NJ; Singapore, Singapore; Beerse, Belgium
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab demonstrated sustained disease control in patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) during the 24-week double-blind phase (versus placebo) and through week 60 of the open-label extension (OLE) phase of Vivacity-MG3 (NCT04951622). OBJECTIVE: To characterize corticosteroid usage, patterns of corticosteroid dose reduction/discontinuation, and symptom improvements among nipocalimab-treated patients with gMG during the Vivacity-MG3 OLE. METHODS: Corticosteroid dose reductions to ≤20, ≤15, ≤7.5, ≤10, and ≤5 mg/day prednisone-equivalent were evaluated through OLE data cutoff. Among patients on a low corticosteroid dose (≤10 or ≤5 mg/day), proportions achieving meaningful clinical improvement (MCI; ≥2 point improvement of Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living [MG-ADL]), minimum symptoms expression (MSE; MG-ADL score 0 or 1), and sustaining these for ≥8 weeks were evaluated. RESULTS: Of 89 patients receiving corticosteroids at OLE baseline (placebo/nipocalimab: 44 [49%], nipocalimab/nipocalimab: 45 [51%]), 45% reduced/discontinued corticosteroids by data cutoff; mean steroid dose reduced from 23 to 10 mg/day prednisone- equivalent. By OLE data cutoff, 85.4%, 71.9%, 60.7%, 41.6%, and 33.7% of patients were on ≤20, ≤15, ≤10, ≤7.5, and ≤5 mg/day prednisone-equivalents, respectively. Among those on ≤10 mg/day (n=54), MCI and MSE were achieved by 98.1% (n=53) and 44.4% (n=24) respectively, and sustained for ≥8 weeks by 94.4% (n=51) and 24.1% (n=13), respectively. For those on ≤5 mg/day (n=30), MCI and MSE were achieved by 100.0% (n=30) and 60.0% (n=18) respectively, and sustained for ≥8 weeks by 93.3% (n=28) and 33.3% (n=10), respectively. CONCLUSION: By OLE data cutoff, nearly half of patients receiving corticosteroids at baseline, reduced/discontinued corticosteroids. A substantial proportion of patients who were on low-dose corticosteroid (≤10 or ≤5 mg/day) during the OLE sustained MCI and/or MSE for ≥8 weeks. Results support the corticosteroid-sparing effect of nipocalimab and concurrent meaningful clinical improvement and sustained disease control in nipocalimab-treated patients with gMG. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在Vivacity-MG3（NCT04951622）的24周双盲期（对照安慰剂）及开放标签扩展（OLE）期至第60周，nipocalimab在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者中显示出持续疾病控制。目的：描述Vivacity-MG3 OLE期间接受nipocalimab治疗的gMG患者中皮质类固醇使用情况、皮质类固醇减量/停用模式及症状改善。方法：截至OLE数据截止日期，评估皮质类固醇减量至≤20、≤15、≤7.5、≤10和≤5 mg/天泼尼松等效剂量的情况。在低剂量皮质类固醇（≤10或≤5 mg/天）患者中，评估达到有意义临床改善（MCI；重症肌无力日常生活活动量表[MG-ADL]改善≥2分）、最低症状表达（MSE；MG-ADL评分0或1）并维持≥8周的比例。结果：在OLE基线时接受皮质类固醇的89例患者中（安慰剂/nipocalimab：44例[49%]，nipocalimab/nipocalimab：45例[51%]），截至数据截止日期45%减量/停用皮质类固醇；平均类固醇剂量从23 mg/天降至10 mg/天泼尼松等效剂量。截至OLE数据截止日期，分别有85.4%、71.9%、60.7%、41.6%和33.7%的患者使用≤20、≤15、≤10、≤7.5和≤5 mg/天泼尼松等效剂量。在≤10 mg/天者中（n=54），分别有98.1%（n=53）和44.4%（n=24）达到MCI和MSE，并分别有94.4%（n=51）和24.1%（n=13）维持≥8周。在≤5 mg/天者中（n=30），分别有100.0%（n=30）和60.0%（n=18）达到MCI和MSE，并分别有93.3%（n=28）和33.3%（n=10）维持≥8周。结论：截至OLE数据截止日期，基线时接受皮质类固醇的患者中近半数减量/停用皮质类固醇。在OLE期间使用低剂量皮质类固醇（≤10或≤5 mg/天）的患者中，相当比例维持MCI和/或MSE≥8周。结果支持nipocalimab的皮质类固醇节约效应，以及接受nipocalimab治疗的gMG患者同时获得有意义的临床改善和持续疾病控制。海报专场I和III

abstracts.title: Corticosteroid Use in Nipocalimab-treated Japanese Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Phase 3 VIVACITY-MG3 Open-label Extension Study
abstracts.authors: Carlo Antozzi; Kavita Gandhi; Ibrahim Turkoz; Michael Kutch; Marie Fitzgibbon; Sindhu Ramchandren; Hiroyuki Murai
abstracts.affiliations: Milan, Italy; Horsham, PA; Titusville, NJ; Chesterbrook, PA; Raritan, NJ
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In seropositive adults with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), nipocalimab treatment (nipocalimab+standard-of-care [SOC]) vs placebo+SOC achieved sustained disease control during the 24-week Vivacity-MG3 study (NCT04951622) double-blind phase that was maintained through open-label extension (OLE) Week 60. In Japan, achieving minimal gMG symptoms with low corticosteroid doses (target: ≤5 mg/day) is an important treatment goal. OBJECTIVE: To characterize the impact of nipocalimab on corticosteroid use in Japanese patients in the Vivacity- MG3 OLE phase. METHODS: Corticosteroid doses (mg/day prednisone- equivalent) were evaluated through OLE data cutoff (August 2024) in 89 patients (Japanese, 11; non- Japanese, 78) receiving steroids at OLE baseline. Among patients who reduced corticosteroid dose (≤5 mg/day), the proportion achieving minimum symptom expression (MSE) was determined. RESULTS: Of 11 Japanese patients receiving corticosteroids at OLE baseline, 7/11 (64%) receiving nipocalimab in OLE reduced/discontinued corticosteroids at data cutoff; of these, 5/7 (71%) reached ≤5 mg/day. Among steroid reducers in Japan, mean (SD) steroid dose reduced from 10.4 (2.32) to 5.6 (2.82) mg/day prednisone- equivalent, and 4/7 (57%) achieved MSE within 48 weeks. In non-Japanese patients, steroid reduction was achieved by 33/78 (42%) patients, including 12/33 (36%) reaching ≤5 mg/day, and the dose was reduced from 25.1 (20.53) to 11.2 (10.50) mg/day prednisone-equivalent; MSE within 48 weeks was achieved by 14/33 (42%). CONCLUSION: In OLE, over half of Japanese patients reduced/discontinued corticosteroids with substantial proportions tapering to low-dose corticosteroid (≤5 mg/day) and achieving MSE within 48 weeks. These results are consistent with the overall population where almost half of patients receiving corticosteroids at baseline, reduced/discontinued steroids and showed sustained disease control with nipocalimab. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在血清阳性成人全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者中，nipocalimab治疗（nipocalimab+标准治疗[SOC]）对比安慰剂+SOC在24周Vivacity-MG3研究（NCT04951622）双盲期实现持续疾病控制，并维持至开放标签扩展（OLE）第60周。在日本，以低皮质类固醇剂量（目标：≤5 mg/天）实现gMG最低症状是重要治疗目标。目的：描述Vivacity-MG3 OLE期日本患者中nipocalimab对皮质类固醇使用的影响。方法：截至OLE数据截止日期（2024年8月），评估OLE基线时接受类固醇的89例患者（日本11例；非日本78例）的皮质类固醇剂量（mg/天泼尼松等效剂量）。在减量至皮质类固醇≤5 mg/天的患者中，确定达到最低症状表达（MSE）的比例。结果：在OLE基线时接受皮质类固醇的11例日本患者中，7/11（64%）在OLE中接受nipocalimab并在数据截止时减量/停用皮质类固醇；其中5/7（71%）达到≤5 mg/天。在日本减量者中，平均（SD）类固醇剂量从10.4（2.32）降至5.6（2.82）mg/天泼尼松等效剂量，4/7（57%）在48周内达到MSE。在非日本患者中，33/78（42%）实现类固醇减量，其中12/33（36%）达到≤5 mg/天，剂量从25.1（20.53）降至11.2（10.50）mg/天泼尼松等效剂量；14/33（42%）在48周内达到MSE。结论：在OLE中，超过半数日本患者减量/停用皮质类固醇，相当比例减至低剂量皮质类固醇（≤5 mg/天）并在48周内达到MSE。这些结果与总体人群一致，总体人群中基线接受皮质类固醇的患者近半数减量/停用类固醇，并在nipocalimab治疗下显示持续疾病控制。海报专场I和III

abstracts.title: Effect of Nipocalimab on Pathogenic IgG and Circulating Immune Complex Levels: A Role in Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living Improvement in Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Ruben Faelens; Matthias Bruckner; Jingyue Xi; Yanfei Zhang; Silke Miller; Sindhu Ramchandren; Marie Fitzgibbon; Sarah Hoffmann
abstracts.affiliations: Beerse, Belgium; Ann Arbor, MI; Spring House, PA; San Diego, CA; Titusville, NJ; Raritan, NJ; Berlin, Germany
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab, a fully human neonatal Fc receptor-blocker, is approved in seropositive adult and adolescent patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). Nipocalimab substantially reduced circulating immunoglobulin-G (IgG), including pathogenic autoantibodies, and complement components in the Phase 3 Vivacity-MG3 study. OBJECTIVE: To quantify the effect of nipocalimab- induced total and pathogenic anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) IgG reduction on complement C3d immune complex levels and Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) improvement in patients with gMG. METHODS: A nonlinear mixed-effects (NLME) model was used to model reductions in total IgG/anti-AChR levels and MG-ADL scores from Phase 2 Vivacity-MG and Vivacity- MG3 through 12 and 24 weeks of nipocalimab treatment, respectively. Linear models were used to describe the sequential reduction of total IgG, anti-AChR, and C3d levels, and to explore the association with MG-ADL improvement at Week 24 of Vivacity-MG3. RESULTS: NLME simulations predicted nipocalimab 15 mg/kg every 2 weeks results in mean %change-from- baseline (CFB) −65.9% pre-dose IgG and mean %CFB −1.84 points MG-ADL (placebo-corrected) at steady-state. In the NLME model, %CFB total IgG fully explains the overall average effect on MG-ADL CFB (105%). Total IgG %CFB was linearly correlated with anti-AChR %CFB (slope of 1.03). At Week 24 of the Phase 3 study, anti- AChR reduction explains C3d reduction (p=0.042, 108%). There is a trend showing that C3d reduction explains MG- ADL reduction (p=0.232, 28.6%), but analysis of more timepoints is needed to establish this fully. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Substantial IgG reduction is an accurate predictor of overall average clinical efficacy in gMG. The symptom improvement observed in patients treated with nipocalimab is driven, at least in part, through reduced activation of the classical complement pathway. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Nipocalimab是一种全人源新生儿Fc受体阻断剂，已在血清阳性成人及青少年全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者中获批。在III期Vivacity-MG3研究中，nipocalimab大幅降低循环免疫球蛋白G（IgG），包括致病性自身抗体，以及补体成分。目的：量化nipocalimab诱导的总IgG和致病性抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）IgG降低对补体C3d免疫复合物水平及gMG患者重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）改善的影响。方法：采用非线性混合效应（NLME）模型，分别基于II期Vivacity-MG和Vivacity-MG3中nipocalimab治疗至12周和24周的数据，建模总IgG/抗AChR水平及MG-ADL评分的降低。采用线性模型描述总IgG、抗AChR和C3d水平的序贯降低，并探讨其与Vivacity-MG3第24周MG-ADL改善的关联。结果：NLME模拟预测nipocalimab 15 mg/kg每2周给药在稳态时使IgG较基线平均变化（CFB）为−65.9%（给药前），MG-ADL平均%CFB为−1.84分（安慰剂校正）。在NLME模型中，总IgG %CFB完全解释了对MG-ADL CFB的总体平均效应（105%）。总IgG %CFB与抗AChR %CFB呈线性相关（斜率1.03）。在III期研究第24周，抗AChR降低解释了C3d降低（p=0.042，108%）。有趋势显示C3d降低解释MG-ADL降低（p=0.232，28.6%），但需更多时间点分析以完全确立。总结/结论：大幅IgG降低是gMG总体平均临床疗效的准确预测因素。接受nipocalimab治疗的患者所观察到的症状改善至少部分通过减少经典补体通路激活驱动。海报专场I和III

abstracts.authors: Suraj Muley; Elena Cortés-Vicente; Artur Druzdz; Laura Fionda; Ali Habib; Zabeen Mahuwala; Renato Mantegazza; Robert Pascuzzi; Sabrina Sacconi; Kimiaki Utsugisawa; John Vissing; Tuan Vu; Jos Bloemers; Paul Mahoney; Thais Tarancon

abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In MycarinG (NCT03971422), one 6- week cycle of rozanolixizumab significantly improved Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) total scores versus placebo in patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). Patients could subsequently enroll in open-label extensions MG0004 (NCT04124965), then MG0007 (NCT04650854), or MG0007 directly. OBJECTIVE: To investigate the effect of repeated rozanolixizumab cycles on MG-ADL and QMG item scores. METHODS: In MG0004 (NCT04124965), patients received once-weekly rozanolixizumab infusions for ≤52 weeks. In MG0007 (NCT04650854), after one initial 6- week cycle (rozanolixizumab 7 mg/kg or 10 mg/kg), subsequent cycles were administered upon symptom worsening. Final efficacy data were pooled across MycarinG, MG0004 (first 6 weeks) and MG0007 for patients with ≥2 symptom-driven cycles. Change from baseline (CFB) to Day 43 in MG-ADL and QMG items across 13 cycles was assessed using weighted means. RESULTS: A total of 129 patients had ≥2 symptom-driven cycles. Across 13 cycles, reductions were observed at Day 43 for MG-ADL and QMG items. For MG-ADL, weighted- mean (SD) CFB to Day 43 scores were: −0.5 (0.8) for double vision, −0.6 (0.9) for eyelid droop, −0.5 (0.7) for talking and chewing, and −0.4 (0.6) for swallowing. For QMG, weighted-mean (SD) CFB scores were: −0.5 (1.0) for double vision, −0.7 (1.1) for ptosis, −0.4 (0.7) for facial muscles, right arm outstretched and left arm outstretched, −0.3 (0.6) for right leg outstretched, −0.4 (0.6) for left leg outstretched, and −0.5 (0.9) for speech after counting aloud from 1 to 50. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Long-term rozanolixizumab demonstrated efficacy across diverse signs and symptoms in gMG. Funding: UCB. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在MycarinG（NCT03971422）研究中，一个6周周期的rozanolixizumab与安慰剂相比，显著改善了全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者的重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）和定量重症肌无力（QMG）总分。患者随后可进入开放标签扩展研究MG0004（NCT04124965），再进入MG0007（NCT04650854），或直接进入MG0007。目的：探讨重复rozanolixizumab周期对MG-ADL和QMG条目评分的影响。方法：在MG0004（NCT04124965）中，患者接受每周一次rozanolixizumab输注，持续≤52周。在MG0007（NCT04650854）中，在初始一个6周周期（rozanolixizumab 7 mg/kg或10 mg/kg）后，后续周期在症状加重时给药。最终疗效数据汇总自MycarinG、MG0004（前6周）和MG0007中具有≥2个症状驱动周期的患者。采用加权均值评估13个周期中MG-ADL和QMG条目从基线至第43天的变化（CFB）。结果：共有129例患者具有≥2个症状驱动周期。在13个周期中，第43天观察到MG-ADL和QMG条目的下降。对于MG-ADL，至第43天的加权均值（SD）CFB评分为：复视−0.5（0.8），眼睑下垂−0.6（0.9），说话和咀嚼−0.5（0.7），吞咽−0.4（0.6）。对于QMG，加权均值（SD）CFB评分为：复视−0.5（1.0），上睑下垂−0.7（1.1），面部肌肉、右臂前伸和左臂前伸−0.4（0.7），右腿前伸−0.3（0.6），左腿前伸−0.4（0.6），从1数到50后言语−0.5（0.9）。总结/结论：长期rozanolixizumab在gMG的多种体征和症状中显示出疗效。资助：UCB。海报会议I和II

abstracts.title: Effect of Rozanolixizumab on Ocular Symptoms in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Analysis of Phase 3 Studies
abstracts.authors: Zabeen Mahuwala; Elena Cortés-Vicente; Ali Habib; Robert Pascuzzi; John Vissing; Tuan Vu; Jos Bloemers; Paul Mahoney; Thais Tarancon; Vera Bril
abstracts.affiliations: Lexington, KY; Barcelona, Spain; Orange, CA; Indianapolis, IN; Copenhagen, Denmark; Tampa, FL; Brussels, Belgium; Slough, United Kingdom; Toronto, Canada
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) may cause disabling ocular symptoms (e.g., diplopia, ptosis). The Phase 3 MycarinG study (NCT03971422) demonstrated greater improvements in ocular symptoms after one 6-week cycle of rozanolixizumab versus placebo in patients with gMG. OBJECTIVE: To investigate (post hoc) the effect of repeated rozanolixizumab cycles on ocular symptoms, using data from MycarinG and its open-label extensions (MG0004, MG0007). METHODS: In MG0004 (NCT04124965), patients received once-weekly rozanolixizumab 7 or 10 mg/kg for ≤52 weeks. In MG0007 (NCT04650854), patients received an initial 6-week cycle of rozanolixizumab 7 or 10 mg/kg, with further cycles upon symptom worsening. Final efficacy data were pooled (MycarinG, MG0004 [first 6 weeks] and MG0007) for patients with ≥2 symptom-driven cycles. Mean scores (weighted by sample size, per cycle) were evaluated at baseline and Day 43 across Cycles 1–13 for ocular items within the MG-Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL), Quantitative MG (QMG), MG Symptoms Patient-Reported Outcome (MGSPRO) Ocular Muscle Weakness, and MG-Quality of Life 15-item revised (MG- QoL15r) scales. RESULTS: Overall, 129 patients received ≥2 symptom- driven cycles. Weighted-mean scores across 13 cycles at baseline and Day 43, respectively, were: MG-ADL diplopia 1.4 and 0.9 (n=939) and ptosis 1.5 and 0.8 (n=939); QMG diplopia 1.6 and 1.1 (n=924) and ptosis 1.4 and 0.8 (n=922); MGSPRO diplopia 1.3 and 0.9 (n=926) and ptosis 1.3 and 0.8 (n=927); and MG-QoL15r “trouble using my eyes” 1.2 and 0.9 (n=890). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Long-term rozanolixizumab treatment improved ocular item scores in MG-specific outcome measures, suggesting benefits for gMG patients experiencing ocular signs and symptoms. Funding: UCB. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）可引起致残性眼部症状（如复视、上睑下垂）。3期MycarinG研究（NCT03971422）显示，gMG患者接受一个6周周期rozanolixizumab治疗后，眼部症状改善优于安慰剂。目的：利用MycarinG及其开放标签扩展研究（MG0004、MG0007）的数据，事后探讨重复rozanolixizumab周期对眼部症状的影响。方法：在MG0004（NCT04124965）中，患者接受每周一次rozanolixizumab 7或10 mg/kg，持续≤52周。在MG0007（NCT04650854）中，患者接受初始6周周期rozanolixizumab 7或10 mg/kg，症状加重时给予进一步周期。最终疗效数据汇总自MycarinG、MG0004（前6周）和MG0007中具有≥2个症状驱动周期的患者。在第1–13个周期中，于基线和第43天评估MG-日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）、定量MG（QMG）、MG症状患者报告结局（MGSPRO）眼肌无力以及MG-生活质量15项修订版（MG-QoL15r）量表中眼部条目的平均评分（按样本量加权，每周期）。结果：总体共有129例患者接受≥2个症状驱动周期。13个周期中基线和第43天的加权均值评分分别为：MG-ADL复视1.4和0.9（n=939），上睑下垂1.5和0.8（n=939）；QMG复视1.6和1.1（n=924），上睑下垂1.4和0.8（n=922）；MGSPRO复视1.3和0.9（n=926），上睑下垂1.3和0.8（n=927）；MG-QoL15r“使用眼睛有困难”1.2和0.9（n=890）。总结/结论：长期rozanolixizumab治疗改善了MG特异性结局指标中的眼部条目评分，提示对存在眼部体征和症状的gMG患者有益。资助：UCB。海报会议I和II

abstracts.title: Effect of Zilucoplan Stratified by Age of Myasthenia Gravis Onset: RAISE-XT 120-week Post Hoc Analysis
abstracts.authors: Michael Weiss; Saskia Bresch; Miriam Freimer; Channa Hewamadduma; Raul Juntas- Morales; Maria Isabel Leite; Angelina Maniaol; Masayuki Masuda; Babak Boroojerdi; Paul Mahoney; Natasa Savic; James F. Howard; Jr.

abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: RAISE-XT (NCT04225871), an ongoing, Phase 3, open-label extension study, demonstrated sustained improvements in myasthenia gravis (MG)-specific outcomes in patients with generalized MG (gMG) during zilucoplan treatment up to Week 120. OBJECTIVE: We evaluated the efficacy of zilucoplan by age of gMG onset. METHODS: In RAISE-XT, adults with gMG who completed RAISE (double-blind; NCT04115293) self- administered daily subcutaneous zilucoplan 0.3 mg/kg. Change from double-blind baseline (CFB) in efficacy outcomes to Week 120 and safety were evaluated post hoc (cutoff: November 11, 2023) in early (≤50 years) and late (>50 years) age-of-onset subgroups. RESULTS: Mean (standard deviation) age (early onset [N=106] and late onset [N=77]) was: 43.9 (12.4) and 66.2 (5.6) years. At Week 120, mean (standard error) CFB (early versus late) was: MG Activities of Daily Living, −7.47 (0.53) versus −6.66 (0.75); Quantitative MG, −10.14 (0.77) versus −9.39 (1.15); MG Quality of Life 15-item revised, −12.55 (1.18) versus −7.68 (1.73); Quality of Life in Neurological Disorders Short Form Fatigue, −11.34 (1.61) versus −9.65 (2.22). Serious and treatment-related treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 34.0% (n/N=36/106) and 38.7% (n/N=41/106) of patients (early subgroup) and 49.4% (n/N=38/77) and 33.8% (n/N=26/77) of patients (late subgroup), respectively. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Zilucoplan demonstrated long-term efficacy, irrespective of age at gMG onset. Funding: UCB. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：RAISE-XT（NCT04225871）是一项正在进行的3期开放标签扩展研究，显示全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者在zilucoplan治疗至第120周期间，MG特异性结局持续改善。目的：我们按gMG发病年龄评估zilucoplan的疗效。方法：在RAISE-XT中，完成RAISE（双盲；NCT04115293）的gMG成人患者自行皮下注射zilucoplan 0.3 mg/kg每日一次。事后评估早期（≤50岁）和晚期（>50岁）发病亚组至第120周疗效结局较双盲基线的变化（CFB）及安全性（数据截止：2023年11月11日）。结果：早期发病（N=106）和晚期发病（N=77）的平均（标准差）年龄分别为43.9（12.4）岁和66.2（5.6）岁。第120周时，平均（标准误）CFB（早期 vs 晚期）为：MG日常生活活动量表−7.47（0.53）vs −6.66（0.75）；定量MG−10.14（0.77）vs −9.39（1.15）；MG生活质量15项修订版−12.55（1.18）vs −7.68（1.73）；神经疾病生活质量短表疲劳−11.34（1.61）vs −9.65（2.22）。严重治疗中出现不良事件和治疗相关治疗中出现不良事件分别发生于早期亚组34.0%（n/N=36/106）和38.7%（n/N=41/106）的患者，以及晚期亚组49.4%（n/N=38/77）和33.8%（n/N=26/77）的患者。总结/结论：无论gMG发病年龄如何，zilucoplan均显示出长期疗效。资助：UCB。海报会议I和II

abstracts.authors: Tuan Vu; Giovanni Antonini; Elena Cortés-Vicente; Artur Druzdz; Ali Habib; Zabeen Mahuwala; Renato Mantegazza; Robert Pascuzzi; Sabrina Sacconi; Kimiaki Utsugisawa; John Vissing; Paul Mahoney; Thais Tarancon; Vera Bril

abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In MycarinG (Phase 3; NCT03971422), one 6-week cycle of rozanolixizumab (7 mg/kg or 10 mg/kg) improved myasthenia gravis (MG)-specific outcomes versus placebo. OBJECTIVE: Here, we evaluate the long-term efficacy of repeated rozanolixizumab treatment cycles across MycarinG and its open-label extension studies in subgroups of patients with generalized MG (gMG). METHODS: Following MycarinG, patients could enroll in MG0004 (NCT04124965) to receive once-weekly rozanolixizumab for ≤52 weeks, or MG0007 (NCT04650854), which comprised an initial 6-week rozanolixizumab cycle, with further cycles administered upon symptom worsening. Final efficacy data were pooled across MycarinG, MG0004 (first 6 weeks) and MG0007 for patients with ≥2 symptom-driven rozanolixizumab cycles. Mean change from baseline (CFB) in MG Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) score to Day 43 in Cycles 1–13 was assessed. Subgroups were prespecified according to baseline characteristics. RESULTS: Overall, 129 patients received ≥2 symptom- driven cycles. Mean (standard deviation) CFB in MG-ADL score at Day 43 across Cycles 1–13 for the overall population ranged from −3.2 (3.3) in Cycle 3 (n=113) to −6.0 (3.9) in Cycle 12 (n=24). Improvements from baseline in MG-ADL scores at Day 43 were consistent in subgroups of autoantibody status (anti-muscle-specific tyrosine kinase and anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody positive), disease duration (<5.4 and ≥5.4 years), age (<65 and ≥65 years), MG-ADL score (<5 and ≥5) and thymectomy status. Treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 93.1% (n=175/188) of patients with ≥1 treatment cycle across MycarinG and MG0007; most were mild/moderate. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Repeated rozanolixizumab treatment cycles demonstrated long-term efficacy in a broad range of patients with gMG. Funding: UCB. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在MycarinG（3期；NCT03971422）中，一个6周周期rozanolixizumab（7 mg/kg或10 mg/kg）较安慰剂改善了重症肌无力（MG）特异性结局。目的：在此，我们在全身型MG（gMG）患者亚组中评估MycarinG及其开放标签扩展研究中重复rozanolixizumab治疗周期的长期疗效。方法：在MycarinG之后，患者可进入MG0004（NCT04124965）接受每周一次rozanolixizumab治疗≤52周，或进入MG0007（NCT04650854），后者包括初始6周rozanolixizumab周期，症状加重时给予进一步周期。最终疗效数据汇总自MycarinG、MG0004（前6周）和MG0007中具有≥2个症状驱动rozanolixizumab周期的患者。评估第1–13个周期中至第43天MG日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）评分较基线的平均变化（CFB）。亚组根据基线特征预先设定。结果：总体共有129例患者接受≥2个症状驱动周期。总体人群中第1–13个周期第43天MG-ADL评分平均（标准差）CFB范围为第3周期−3.2（3.3）（n=113）至第12周期−6.0（3.9）（n=24）。在自身抗体状态（抗肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶抗体和抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性）、病程（<5.4年和≥5.4年）、年龄（<65岁和≥65岁）、MG-ADL评分（<5和≥5）及胸腺切除状态亚组中，第43天MG-ADL评分较基线的改善一致。在MycarinG和MG0007中具有≥1个治疗周期的患者中，治疗中出现不良事件发生率为93.1%（n=175/188）；大多数为轻/中度。总结/结论：重复rozanolixizumab治疗周期在广泛的gMG患者中显示出长期疗效。资助：UCB。海报会议I和II

abstracts.title: Efficacy of Nipocalimab in Adult Patients with None-to-mild Ocular Manifestations of Generalized Myasthenia Gravis in the Phase 3 VIVACITY-MG3 Study
abstracts.authors: Kristl Claeys; Kavita Gandhi; Ibrahim Turkoz; Michael Kutch; Marie Fitzgibbon; Sindhu Ramchandren
abstracts.affiliations: Leuven, Belgium; Raritan, NJ; Titusville, NJ; Chesterbrook, PA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Ocular manifestations are the most common presenting symptom in patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG); however, 15–50% of patients do not experience ocular symptoms. In the phase 3 VIVACITY-MG3 study (NCT04951622), nipocalimab added to standard of care (SOC) treatment (nipocalimab +SOC) demonstrated sustained disease control vs placebo+SOC through improvements in Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) total scores in the overall gMG population and in a subgroup of patients with moderate-to-severe ocular manifestations. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the efficacy of nipocalimab on MG-ADL in a subgroup of patients with none-to-mild ocular manifestations. METHODS: None-to-mild ocular manifestations were defined as ≤1 score on diplopia and ptosis items of the MG-ADL scale; data were analyzed in these patients at double-blind baseline. Symptom improvement was assessed by change from baseline in MG-ADL scores (meaningful clinical improvement [MCI]: ≥2-point improvement; substantial clinical improvement [SCI]: ≥3- point improvement) at Week 24 (W24). RESULTS: Baseline characteristics were generally balanced between nipocalimab+SOC vs placebo+SOC — median (range) age: 50.0 (20–79) vs 50.5 (20–77) years; female: 70.6% vs 50.0%; median (range) baseline MG- ADL: 7.5 (6–10) (n=17) vs 7.3 (6–12) (n=14). At W24, nipocalimab+SOC (n=17) showed median (range) MG- ADL reductions from baseline of −6.00 (−8.0, 1.0) vs −2.75 (−6.0, 0.0) in placebo+SOC (n=12) (difference: −2.32 [SE:0.922]; 95%CI: −4.21; −0.42; p=0.018). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In patients with gMG and none-to-mild ocular manifestations, nipocalimab treatment showed meaningful and substantial clinical improvements on MG-ADL total score versus placebo (as in the overall population). Thus, nipocalimab provides sustained disease control in these patients. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：眼部表现是全身型肌无力（gMG）患者最常见的首发症状；然而，15–50%的患者不出现眼部症状。在3期VIVACITY-MG3研究（NCT04951622）中，在标准治疗（SOC）基础上加用nipocalimab（nipocalimab+SOC）相较于安慰剂+SOC，通过在总体gMG人群及中重度眼部表现亚组中改善肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）总分，显示出持续疾病控制。目的：评估nipocalimab在无至轻度眼部表现亚组患者中对MG-ADL的疗效。方法：无至轻度眼部表现定义为MG-ADL量表中复视和上睑下垂条目评分≤1分；在双盲基线时对这些患者的数据进行分析。通过第24周（W24）时MG-ADL评分较基线的变化评估症状改善（有意义的临床改善[MCI]：改善≥2分；实质性临床改善[SCI]：改善≥3分）。结果：nipocalimab+SOC与安慰剂+SOC的基线特征总体均衡——中位（范围）年龄：50.0（20–79）岁 vs 50.5（20–77）岁；女性：70.6% vs 50.0%；中位（范围）基线MG-ADL：7.5（6–10）（n=17） vs 7.3（6–12）（n=14）。在W24，nipocalimab+SOC（n=17）显示MG-ADL较基线中位（范围）降低−6.00（−8.0, 1.0），而安慰剂+SOC（n=12）为−2.75（−6.0, 0.0）（差值：−2.32 [SE:0.922]；95%CI：−4.21; −0.42；p=0.018）。总结/结论：在伴无至轻度眼部表现的gMG患者中，nipocalimab治疗相较于安慰剂在MG-ADL总分上显示出有意义且实质性的临床改善（与总体人群一致）。因此，nipocalimab在这些患者中提供持续疾病控制。海报专场I和III

abstracts.title: Efgartigimod Followed by Telitacicept in Adult Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: A Dual Cohort Study on Efficacy and Safety
abstracts.authors: Yuan Zhang; Yaping Liu; Xu Zhang; Jia Li
abstracts.affiliations: Wenzhou, China; Lianyungang, China
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an antibody- mediated autoimmune disorder of the neuromuscular junction, and the optimal treatment strategy for adult generalized MG (gMG) remains uncertain. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of sequential therapy with efgartigimod followed by telitacicept in adult gMG. METHODS: A two-stage design was used, including a retrospective real-world cohort and a prospective randomized open-label controlled study. In the retrospective cohort, primary endpoints were changes from baseline in Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) and Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) scores at Weeks 4, 12, and 28; in the prospective study, the primary endpoint was QMG change at Week 30. Secondary endpoints included MG-ADL change, deep response rate, minimal symptom expression (MSE) attainment, background therapy reduction, exacerbation or crisis rate, and safety. RESULTS: The retrospective cohort included 51 patients (29 sequential; 22 monotherapy). Sequential therapy produced greater QMG and MG-ADL improvements at Week 4 (p<0.05), with no differences thereafter. The prospective study enrolled 41 patients (E+1W+T n=14; E +2W+T n=13; T-only n=14). At Week 30, QMG reductions were numerically greater in the sequential groups (−8.57 and −8.69 vs −5.79 points; p=0.059), with similar trends for MG-ADL. Sequential therapy showed higher early deep response rates, while MSE attainment, background therapy reduction, and safety were comparable. Flow cytometry revealed marked reductions in short-lived plasma cells with relative preservation of memory B cells. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Sequential efgartigimod followed by telitacicept is safe and feasible in adult gMG. The 1-week interval regimen may offer advantages in early symptom control and disease stabilization. Yuan Zhang, MS Best Abstract Runner Up Award Recipient Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：肌无力（MG）是一种抗体介导的神经肌肉接头自身免疫性疾病，成人全身型MG（gMG）的最佳治疗策略仍不确定。目的：评估efgartigimod序贯telitacicept治疗成人gMG的疗效和安全性。方法：采用两阶段设计，包括回顾性真实世界队列和前瞻性随机开放标签对照研究。在回顾性队列中，主要终点为第4、12和28周时定量肌无力（QMG）和肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）评分较基线的变化；在前瞻性研究中，主要终点为第30周时QMG变化。次要终点包括MG-ADL变化、深度缓解率、达到微小症状表达（MSE）、背景治疗减少、加重或危象发生率以及安全性。结果：回顾性队列纳入51例患者（29例序贯治疗；22例单药治疗）。序贯治疗在第4周产生更大的QMG和MG-ADL改善（p<0.05），此后无差异。前瞻性研究纳入41例患者（E+1W+T n=14；E+2W+T n=13；仅T n=14）。在第30周，序贯组的QMG降低在数值上更大（−8.57和−8.69 vs −5.79分；p=0.059），MG-ADL呈相似趋势。序贯治疗显示更高的早期深度缓解率，而MSE达成、背景治疗减少和安全性相当。流式细胞术显示短寿命浆细胞显著减少，而记忆B细胞相对保留。总结/结论：efgartigimod序贯telitacicept在成人gMG中安全可行。1周间隔方案可能在早期症状控制和疾病稳定方面具有优势。Yuan Zhang，MS 最佳摘要亚军奖获得者 海报专场I和II

abstracts.title: Frequency of Sustained Response to Nipocalimab versus Placebo Based on Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living and Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis Scales in the Phase 3 VIVACITY-MG3 Study
abstracts.authors: Shahar Shelly; Marie Fitzgibbon; Ibrahim Turkoz; Kavita Gandhi; Sindhu Ramchandren; Constantine Farmakidis
abstracts.affiliations: Haifa, Israel; Raritan, NJ; Titusville, NJ; Horsham , PA; Kansas City, KS
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Sustained disease control is a critical treatment goal in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). The sustained clinical response frequency helps assess generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) disease control, distinguishing true therapeutic effects from intermittent/placebo-related improvements. OBJECTIVE: To assess the frequency of sustained clinical response with nipocalimab, using Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Quantitative MG (QMG) scores during the 24-week double-blind Phase 3 Vivacity-MG3 (NCT04951622) study based on the seropositive patient population. METHODS: Sustained clinical response was defined as high number of visits-in-response (MG-ADL:≥10- responses through 12-visits, QMG:≥7-responses through 8-visits). Meaningful clinical improvement (MCI) was ≥2- point/≥3-point improvement in MG-ADL/QMG total score, respectively; ≥3-point improvement in MG-ADL (MG- ADL≥3), ≥4-point improvement in QMG (QMG≥4) and composite MCI response (MCI in both MG-ADL and QMG) were also assessed. Frequency of sustained clinical response in MG-ADL, QMG total and composite MCI response scores, from baseline through Week 24 were analyzed. RESULTS: For MG-ADL-MCI, nipocalimab+standard-of- care-treated patients (44/77[57.1%]) had higher odds of achieving sustained clinical response (OR:4.0[95%CI:2.01–7.96], p<0.001) versus placebo +standard-of-care (19/76[25.0%]) in ≥10-visits. Similar results were observed for MG-ADL≥3, with nipocalimab- treated patients (37[48.1%]) having higher odds of achieving sustained clinical response (OR:4.9[95%CI:2.30–10.57], p<0.001) versus placebo (12[15.8%]) in ≥10-visits. For QMG-MCI, nipocalimab-treated patients (31[40.3%]) had higher odds of achieving sustained clinical response (OR:4.5[95%CI:1.99–9.96], p<0.001) versus placebo (10[13.2%]) in ≥7-visits. Similar results were observed for QMG≥4, with nipocalimab-treated patients (27[35.1%]) having higher odds of achieving sustained clinical response (OR:4.0[95%CI:1.74–9.30], p<0.001) versus placebo (9[11.8%]) in ≥7-visits. For composite MCI response, nipocalimab-treated patients (25[32.5%]) had higher odds of achieving sustained clinical response (OR:5.6[95%CI:2.15–14.66], p<0.001) versus placebo (6[7.9%]) in ≥10-visits for MG-ADL-MCI and ≥7-visits for QMG-MCI. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: A significantly greater proportion of nipocalimab-treated versus placebo-treated patients achieved sustained responses, reflecting more consistent disease control over 24 weeks in Vivacity-MG3. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：持续疾病控制是全身型肌无力（gMG）的关键治疗目标。持续临床缓解频率有助于评估gMG疾病控制，区分真实治疗效应与间歇性/安慰剂相关改善。目的：基于血清阳性患者人群，在24周双盲3期Vivacity-MG3（NCT04951622）研究中，使用肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）和定量MG（QMG）评分评估nipocalimab持续临床缓解的频率。方法：持续临床缓解定义为高访视缓解次数（MG-ADL：12次访视中≥10次缓解，QMG：8次访视中≥7次缓解）。有意义的临床改善（MCI）分别为MG-ADL/QMG总分改善≥2分/≥3分；还评估了MG-ADL改善≥3分（MG-ADL≥3）、QMG改善≥4分（QMG≥4）以及复合MCI缓解（MG-ADL和QMG均达MCI）。分析从基线至第24周MG-ADL、QMG总分及复合MCI缓解评分的持续临床缓解频率。结果：对于MG-ADL-MCI，nipocalimab+标准治疗患者（44/77[57.1%]）在≥10次访视中达到持续临床缓解的几率高于安慰剂+标准治疗（19/76[25.0%]）（OR：4.0[95%CI：2.01–7.96]，p<0.001）。MG-ADL≥3观察到相似结果，nipocalimab治疗患者（37[48.1%]）在≥10次访视中达到持续临床缓解的几率高于安慰剂（12[15.8%]）（OR：4.9[95%CI：2.30–10.57]，p<0.001）。对于QMG-MCI，nipocalimab治疗患者（31[40.3%]）在≥7次访视中达到持续临床缓解的几率高于安慰剂（10[13.2%]）（OR：4.5[95%CI：1.99–9.96]，p<0.001）。QMG≥4观察到相似结果，nipocalimab治疗患者（27[35.1%]）在≥7次访视中达到持续临床缓解的几率高于安慰剂（9[11.8%]）（OR：4.0[95%CI：1.74–9.30]，p<0.001）。对于复合MCI缓解，nipocalimab治疗患者（25[32.5%]）在MG-ADL-MCI≥10次访视且QMG-MCI≥7次访视中达到持续临床缓解的几率高于安慰剂（6[7.9%]）（OR：5.6[95%CI：2.15–14.66]，p<0.001）。总结/结论：在Vivacity-MG3中，nipocalimab治疗患者相较于安慰剂治疗患者有显著更高比例达到持续缓解，反映24周内更一致的疾病控制。海报专场I和II

abstracts.title: Immunogenicity Assessment with Nipocalimab Treatment in Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Yaowei Zhu; Eleni Caratzas; Jocelyn Leu; Korin Cofsky; Sindhu Ramchandren; Navin Goyal
abstracts.affiliations: Spring House, PA; Titusville, NJ
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In the Phase 3 Vivacity-MG3 study (NCT04951622), nipocalimab, a novel FcRn blocker, demonstrated sustained disease control in seropositive (AChR+, MuSK+, and/or LRP4+) patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the occurrence of anti-drug antibodies (ADA) and neutralizing antibodies (NAb) to nipocalimab, and their impact on pharmacokinetics (PK), pharmacodynamics (PD), efficacy, and safety in all patients in Vivacity-MG3. METHODS: Patients were randomized to intravenous nipocalimab+standard-of-care (SOC) or placebo+SOC for 24 weeks in the double-blind phase, followed by the option to enter the open-label extension phase of the study. Serum samples were collected at selected timepoints up to Week 96 after nipocalimab initiation. RESULTS: One hundred ninety-four nipocalimab-treated patients had post-treatment serum samples evaluated for ADA. The overall incidence of treatment-emergent ADA up to Week 96 was 42.8% (n=83) with low titers (vast majority [92.8%] had peak titers ≤1:80); 22.7% (n=44) developed NAb to nipocalimab. Incidence of sample-level ADA decreased over time. Development of ADA was not associated with study discontinuation. Among 36 patients who discontinued, 36.1% were ADA+ and 63.9% were ADA−. Median serum nipocalimab concentrations, median % change from baseline (CFB) in total IgG and anti-AChR binding autoantibody, and median CFB in MG-ADL total scores over time were comparable between ADA+ and ADA− patients. Infusion-related reactions (all mild) were similar between ADA+ and ADA− patients. Similar findings were observed between NAb+ and NAb− patients. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In nipocalimab-treated patients, development of ADA was transient. Presence of ADA and NAb did not alter PK, PD, efficacy, and safety profiles of nipocalimab. The immunogenicity of nipocalimab is not clinically relevant in patients with gMG. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在3期Vivacity-MG3研究（NCT04951622）中，新型FcRn阻断剂nipocalimab在血清阳性（AChR+、MuSK+和/或LRP4+）全身型肌无力（gMG）患者中显示出持续疾病控制。目的：评估Vivacity-MG3中所有患者中针对nipocalimab的抗药抗体（ADA）和中和抗体（NAb）的发生情况及其对药代动力学（PK）、药效动力学（PD）、疗效和安全性的影响。方法：患者在双盲阶段随机接受静脉nipocalimab+标准治疗（SOC）或安慰剂+SOC治疗24周，随后可选择进入研究的开放标签扩展阶段。在nipocalimab起始后至第96周选定的时间点采集血清样本。结果：194例nipocalimab治疗患者有治疗后血清样本进行ADA评估。至第96周治疗中出现ADA的总体发生率为42.8%（n=83），滴度低（绝大多数[92.8%]峰值滴度≤1:80）；22.7%（n=44）产生针对nipocalimab的NAb。样本水平ADA发生率随时间下降。ADA产生与研究终止无关。在36例终止患者中，36.1%为ADA+，63.9%为ADA−。ADA+与ADA−患者之间，nipocalimab血清浓度中位数、总IgG和抗AChR结合自身抗体较基线变化百分比（CFB）中位数以及MG-ADL总分CFB中位数随时间相当。输注相关反应（均为轻度）在ADA+与ADA−患者之间相似。NAb+与NAb−患者之间观察到相似结果。总结/结论：在nipocalimab治疗患者中，ADA产生为一过性。ADA和NAb的存在未改变nipocalimab的PK、PD、疗效和安全性特征。nipocalimab的免疫原性在gMG患者中无临床相关性。海报专场I和II

abstracts.title: Impact of Time Since Diagnosis on Efficacy of Inebilizumab: Post Hoc Analysis of Phase 3 Myasthenia Gravis Inebilizumab Trial Data
abstracts.authors: Ali Habib; James F. Howard; Jr.; Michael Benatar; Emma Ciafaloni; Maria Isabel Leite; Kimiaki Utsugisawa; John Vissing; Sarah Bray; Michaela Schlader-Ratzinger; Catherine Najem; Sue Cheng; Richard Nowak
abstracts.affiliations: Orange, CA; Chapel Hill, NC; Miami, FL; Rochester, NY; Oxford, United Kingdom; Hanamaki, Japan; Copenhagen, Denmark; Cambridge, United Kingdom; Thousand Oaks, CA; Bradenton, FL; New Haven, CT
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is characterized by autoreactive B cells producing anti–acetylcholine receptor antibodies (AChR+) and anti–muscle-specific kinase antibodies (MuSK+). The MINT primary endpoint (change in Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living [MG-ADL] score) was achieved, supporting inebilizumab’s efficacy in gMG. OBJECTIVE: To determine if inebilizumab response differs by time since diagnosis of gMG. METHODS: MINT (NCT04524273) enrolled participants with AChR+ (190) or MuSK+ (48) gMG that underwent a protocol-specified glucocorticoid taper and were randomized 1:1 to inebilizumab or placebo for 26 (MuSK+) or 52 (AChR+) weeks. Changes from baseline (CFBs) in MG-ADL and Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) scores by time since diagnosis (date of first dose in the randomized period minus gMG diagnosis date) were examined. RESULTS: The least squares mean (LSM) CFB in MG- ADL score was numerically greater for inebilizumab vs placebo at week (W) 26 for participants with diagnosis of <1 year (–5.4 vs –3.0), ≥1y–<4y (–4.3 vs –1.8), and ≥4y (–3.7 vs –2.5); the LSM CFB in QMG score was also numerically greater for inebilizumab vs placebo at W26 (<1y, –5.2 vs –4.0; ≥1y–<4y, –6.4 vs –2.2; ≥4y, –4.0 vs –1.9). Greater improvements from baseline with inebilizumab vs placebo were observed at W52 for MG- ADL (AChR+: <1y, –5.7 vs –2.3; ≥1y–<4y, –5.0 vs –2.7; ≥4y, –4.0 vs –1.5) and QMG (AChR+: <1y, –7.4 vs –1.8; ≥1y–<4y, –8.3 vs –2.9, ≥4y, –3.9 vs –0.5) scores. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Inebilizumab’s efficacy appears independent of time since diagnosis, although the small size of subgroups limits firm conclusions. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的特征是自身反应性B细胞产生抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体（AChR+）和抗肌肉特异性激酶抗体（MuSK+）。MINT主要终点（重症肌无力日常生活活动量表[MG-ADL]评分变化）已达成，支持inebilizumab在gMG中的疗效。目的：确定inebilizumab的应答是否因gMG诊断后时间不同而存在差异。方法：MINT（NCT04524273）入组AChR+（190例）或MuSK+（48例）gMG受试者，按方案规定进行糖皮质激素逐渐减量，并按1:1随机分配至inebilizumab或安慰剂，治疗26周（MuSK+）或52周（AChR+）。按诊断后时间（随机期首次给药日期减去gMG诊断日期）评估MG-ADL和定量重症肌无力（QMG）评分较基线的变化（CFB）。结果：第26周时，inebilizumab组与安慰剂组相比，MG-ADL评分的LSM CFB在诊断<1年（–5.4 vs –3.0）、≥1年–<4年（–4.3 vs –1.8）和≥4年（–3.7 vs –2.5）的受试者中数值上更大；第26周时QMG评分的LSM CFB在inebilizumab组与安慰剂组相比也数值上更大（<1年，–5.2 vs –4.0；≥1年–<4年，–6.4 vs –2.2；≥4年，–4.0 vs –1.9）。第52周时，inebilizumab组与安慰剂组相比观察到MG-ADL（AChR+：<1年，–5.7 vs –2.3；≥1年–<4年，–5.0 vs –2.7；≥4年，–4.0 vs –1.5）和QMG（AChR+：<1年，–7.4 vs –1.8；≥1年–<4年，–8.3 vs –2.9；≥4年，–3.9 vs –0.5）评分较基线有更大改善。总结/结论：Inebilizumab的疗效似乎与诊断后时间无关，但亚组样本量较小限制了确定性结论。海报会议I & II

abstracts.title: Improvements in Myasthenia Gravis Symptoms Patient-reported Outcomes Scores during Long-term Cyclic Rozanolixizumab Treatment
abstracts.authors: Mohita Kumar; Carlo Antozzi; Ali Habib; Henry Kaminski; Robert Pascuzzi; Sabrina Sacconi; Kimiaki Utsugisawa; John Vissing; Jos Bloemers; Paul Mahoney; Thais Tarancon; Vera Bril
abstracts.affiliations: Atlanta, GA; Milan, Italy; Orange, CA; Washington, DC; Indianapolis, IN; Nice, France; Hanamaki, Japan; Copenhagen, Denmark; Brussels, Belgium; Slough, United Kingdom; Madrid, Spain; Toronto, Canada
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia Gravis Symptoms Patient- Reported Outcomes (MGSPRO) scales provide granular assessment of patients’ experiences of specific myasthenia gravis (MG) symptoms, including physical fatigue. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the effect of cyclic rozanolixizumab on MGSPRO scores across MycarinG (Phase 3; NCT03971422) and open-label extension studies MG0004 (NCT04124965) and MG0007 (NCT04650854). METHODS: In MycarinG, patients were randomized 1:1:1 to once-weekly rozanolixizumab 7 mg/kg, 10 mg/kg, or placebo for 6 weeks. In MG0004, patients received once- weekly rozanolixizumab (7 mg/kg or 10 mg/kg) for ≤52 weeks. MG0007 comprised an initial 6-week cycle (7 mg/kg or 10 mg/kg), with further cycles administered upon symptom worsening. Final efficacy data were pooled up to Cycle 13 across MycarinG, MG0004 (first 6 weeks) and MG0007 for patients with ≥2 symptom-driven cycles. Improvements from baseline in MGSPRO scale scores were assessed. RESULTS: One hundred twenty-nine patients received ≥2 symptom-driven cycles. Improvements from baseline to Day 43 were observed throughout 13 cycles in MGSPRO Muscle Weakness Fatigability (mean [SD] min: −15.7 [17.3], Cycle 4; max: −31.8 [29.5], cycle 12), MGSPRO Physical Fatigue (min: −15.4 [18.4], Cycle 3; max: −27.2 [28.6], Cycle 12) and Bulbar Muscle Weakness (min: −13.2 [16.2], Cycle 3; max: −25.4 [23.3], cycle 12) scores. Improvements were consistent between dose groups. Cyclic treatment had an acceptable safety profile; treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 93.1% (n/N=175/188) of patients; most were mild or moderate. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Repeated cyclic rozanolixizumab treatment led to consistent improvements in MG symptoms measured by MGSPRO scales, including physical fatigue, which is a particularly important symptom for patients. Funding: UCB. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In RAISE (Phase 3, NCT04115293), zilucoplan led to clinically meaningful improvements in myasthenia gravis (MG)-specific outcomes in patients with generalized MG (gMG). Improvements were sustained in the ongoing open-label extension, RAISE-XT (NCT04225871). OBJECTIVE: Assess change in item scores for MG- Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL), Quantitative MG (QMG) and MG-Quality of Life 15-item revised (MG- QoL15r). METHODS: In RAISE, adults with gMG were randomized to self-administer once-daily placebo or zilucoplan 0.3 mg/kg; on completion, they received zilucoplan 0.3 mg/kg in RAISE-XT. Post hoc analyses of MG-ADL, QMG, and MG-QoL15r (cutoff: November 11, 2023) included the proportion of patients with no symptoms, improvements, or no change to Week 12 (RAISE), and to Week 120 (RAISE-XT). Change from double-blind baseline (CFB) to Week 120 and safety (RAISE-XT) were also assessed. RESULTS: In RAISE, a greater proportion of patients improved from baseline to Week 12 or had no symptoms at Week 12 across MG-ADL items with zilucoplan (≥52.4%) than placebo (≥38.8%). Improvements further increased (zilucoplan group) and were sustained to Week 120 in RAISE-XT (≥72.6% of patients). At Week 120 (n=73), mean (standard error) CFB for MG-ADL items was: chewing, −0.85 (0.09); swallowing, −0.75 (0.10); talking, −0.86 (0.10); breathing, −0.71 (0.09); double vision, −1.04 (0.14); eyelid droop, −1.44 (0.13); brush hair/teeth, −0.96 (0.11); and rise from chair, −0.79 (0.11). Similar results were observed for QMG and MG-QoL15r. Treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 97.0% (n=194/200) of patients. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Zilucoplan treatment led to sustained improvements across items in MG-specific outcomes to Week 120, suggesting benefit across a range of MG symptoms. Funding: UCB. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在RAISE（3期，NCT04115293）中，zilucoplan使全身型MG（gMG）患者的MG特异性结局获得有临床意义的改善。正在进行的开放标签扩展研究RAISE-XT（NCT04225871）中改善得以维持。目的：评估MG-日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）、定量MG（QMG）和MG-生活质量15项修订版（MG-QoL15r）条目评分的变化。方法：在RAISE中，成人gMG患者随机分配至每日一次自行注射安慰剂或zilucoplan 0.3 mg/kg；完成后在RAISE-XT中接受zilucoplan 0.3 mg/kg。MG-ADL、QMG和MG-QoL15r的事后分析（截止日期：2023年11月11日）包括至第12周（RAISE）和第120周（RAISE-XT）无症状、改善或无变化的患者比例。还评估了从双盲基线至第120周的变化（CFB）和安全性（RAISE-XT）。结果：在RAISE中，zilucoplan组在MG-ADL各条目上从基线至第12周改善或第12周无症状的患者比例（≥52.4%）高于安慰剂组（≥38.8%）。在RAISE-XT中改善进一步增加（zilucoplan组）并维持至第120周（≥72.6%的患者）。第120周时（n=73），MG-ADL各条目的平均（标准误）CFB为：咀嚼，–0.85（0.09）；吞咽，–0.75（0.10）；说话，–0.86（0.10）；呼吸，–0.71（0.09）；复视，–1.04（0.14）；眼睑下垂，–1.44（0.13）；梳头/刷牙，–0.96（0.11）；从椅子站起，–0.79（0.11）。QMG和MG-QoL15r观察到类似结果。治疗中出现的不良事件发生于97.0%（n=194/200）的患者。总结/结论：Zilucoplan治疗使MG特异性结局各条目改善持续至第120周，提示对一系列MG症状的获益。资助：UCB。海报会议I & III

abstracts.authors: Robert Pascuzzi; Ali Habib; Zabeen Mahuwala; Renato Mantegazza; Sabrina Sacconi; John Vissing; Tuan Vu; Jana Zschüntzsch; Joel Baldwin; Thais Tarancon; Vera Bril

abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In the Phase 3 MycarinG study (NCT03971422) and its open-label extensions, Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) responder rates (≥2 point improvement in score) of ≥63.7% were observed in cycles 1–13 of rozanolixizumab treatment in patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). OBJECTIVE: To assess achievement of minimal symptom expression (MSE; MG-ADL score 0 or 1) across rozanolixizumab treatment cycles. METHODS: In MycarinG, patients were randomized to once-weekly placebo, rozanolixizumab 7 mg/kg or rozanolixizumab 10 mg/kg for 6 weeks. In MG0004 (NCT04124965), patients received once-weekly rozanolixizumab 7 or 10 mg/kg for ≤52 weeks. In MG0007 (NCT04650854), after an initial 6-week cycle of rozanolixizumab 7 or 10 mg/kg, further cycles were administered based on symptom worsening (investigator’s discretion). Final efficacy data were pooled across MycarinG, MG0004 (first 6 weeks) and MG0007 for patients with ≥2 symptom-driven rozanolixizumab cycles. The proportion of patients with MSE at any time during treatment or observation in each symptom-driven cycle up to Cycle 13 was analyzed post hoc based on Cycle 1 MSE achievement. RESULTS: Overall, 129 patients were assessed. In Cycle 1, 27.9% (36/129) of patients achieved MSE. Among these, subsequent MSE rates were ≥60.0% in Cycles 2–13. Among cycle 1 MSE non-responders, 19.4% achieved MSE in a subsequent cycle (up to cycle 13; median number of additional cycles received: 6). In every cycle, almost all patients achieving MSE did so within the 6-week treatment period. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: For patients with gMG achieving MSE in Cycle 1, within each subsequent cycle the majority achieved MSE, suggesting consistent efficacy with long-term rozanolixizumab treatment. Funding: UCB. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.title: Myasthenia Gravis Inebilizumab Trial: Adverse Events of Special Interest during the Randomized Controlled Period
abstracts.authors: Richard Nowak; Kimiaki Utsugisawa; Michael Benatar; Emma Ciafaloni; Maria Isabel Leite; John Vissing; Fengming Tang; Blanca I. Canales; Qing Li; Sue Cheng; James F. Howard; Jr.
abstracts.affiliations: New Haven, CT; Hanamaki, Japan; Miami, FL; Rochester, NY; Oxford, United Kingdom; Copenhagen, Denmark; Thousand Oaks, CA; Bradenton, FL; Chapel Hill, NC
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: B cells play a key upstream mechanistic role in autoimmune generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) pathogenesis through the production of antibodies targeting the acetylcholine receptor (AChR+), muscle- specific kinase (MuSK+), or other related proteins. Inebilizumab is a monoclonal antibody targeting CD19+ B cells. B-cell-depleting therapies may impair humoral responses, increase the risk of infections, and reduce response to vaccinations. OBJECTIVE: To examine whether inebilizumab is associated with an increased risk of adverse events of special interest (AESIs) in gMG participants. METHODS: MINT (NCT04524273) was a Phase 3 trial in adults with gMG. During the randomized controlled period (RCP) [52-weeks for AChR+; 26-weeks for MuSK+], participants were randomized (1:1) to receive 300 mg of inebilizumab or placebo on Day 1, Day 15, and Day 183 (AChR+ only). Subsets of adverse events were identified as AESIs due to their relevance to inebilizumab’s mechanism of action. RESULTS: A total of 238 patients were randomized: inebilizumab 119 (95 AChR+, 24 MuSK+), placebo 119 (95 AChR+, 24 MuSK+). Baseline demographics and disease characteristics were generally balanced between treatment groups. AESIs were infrequent, occurring in 10.1% (n=12) of the inebilizumab- and 16% (n=19) of the placebo-treated groups. Cytopenias occurred in 2.5% (n=3) of inebilizumab-treated and 9.2% (n=11) of placebo- treated participants. Serious and/or opportunistic infections were infrequent (inebilizumab: 3.4% [n=4]; placebo: 5.0% [n=6]), with COVID-19 being the most common (inebilizumab: 2/4; placebo: 3/6) and no instances of progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy. Infusion- related reactions occurred in 5.0% (n=6) of inebilizumab- and 2.5% (n=3) of placebo-treated participants. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: These results support a favorable safety profile of inebilizumab over a 26–52-week period. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：B细胞通过产生针对乙酰胆碱受体（AChR+）、肌肉特异性激酶（MuSK+）或其他相关蛋白的抗体，在自身免疫性全身型重症肌无力（gMG）发病机制中发挥关键的上游机制作用。Inebilizumab是一种靶向CD19+ B细胞的单克隆抗体。B细胞清除疗法可能损害体液免疫应答、增加感染风险并降低对疫苗接种的反应。目的：考察inebilizumab是否与gMG参与者中特殊关注不良事件（AESI）风险增加相关。方法：MINT（NCT04524273）是一项在成人gMG患者中开展的3期试验。在随机对照期（RCP）[AChR+为52周；MuSK+为26周]内，参与者按1:1随机接受300 mg inebilizumab或安慰剂，于第1天、第15天和第183天给药（仅AChR+）。由于与inebilizumab作用机制的相关性，部分不良事件被确定为AESI。结果：共238例患者被随机分组：inebilizumab组119例（95例AChR+，24例MuSK+），安慰剂组119例（95例AChR+，24例MuSK+）。两治疗组间基线人口学特征和疾病特征总体均衡。AESI不常见，inebilizumab组发生率为10.1%（n=12），安慰剂组为16%（n=19）。血细胞减少在inebilizumab治疗组中发生率为2.5%（n=3），在安慰剂治疗组中为9.2%（n=11）。严重和/或机会性感染不常见（inebilizumab：3.4%[n=4]；安慰剂：5.0%[n=6]），其中COVID-19最常见（inebilizumab：2/4；安慰剂：3/6），且无进行性多灶性白质脑病病例。输注相关反应在inebilizumab组发生率为5.0%（n=6），安慰剂组为2.5%（n=3）。总结/结论：这些结果支持inebilizumab在26–52周期间具有良好的安全性特征。海报专场I和III

abstracts.title: Phase 3 Myasthenia Gravis Inebilizumab Trial: Minimal Symptom Expression Achievement with Inebilizumab
abstracts.authors: Richard Nowak; Michael Benatar; Emma Ciafaloni; Maria Isabel Leite; Kimiaki Utsugisawa; John Vissing; Sarah Bray; Kristina R. Patterson; Catherine Najem; Sue Cheng; James F. Howard; Jr.

abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is characterized by autoreactive B cells producing anti–acetylcholine receptor antibodies (AChR+), and anti–muscle-specific kinase antibodies (MuSK+). The myasthenia gravis inebilizumab trial (MINT) primary endpoint (change from baseline in Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living [MG-ADL] score) was achieved, supporting inebilizumab’s efficacy in gMG. OBJECTIVE: To determine the proportion of MINT participants who achieved minimal symptom expression (MSE) with inebilizumab. METHODS: MINT (NCT04524273) enrolled participants with AChR+ (190) or MuSK+ (48) gMG that underwent a protocol-specified steroid taper and were randomized 1:1 to inebilizumab or placebo for 26 (MuSK+) or 52 (AChR+) weeks (Ws). The proportion of participants who achieved MSE (MG-ADL score 0 or 1) without rescue therapy (RT) and those who achieved ≥3-point improvements in MG- ADL or Quantitative MG (QMG) scores were examined. RESULTS: A greater proportion of participants who received inebilizumab vs placebo achieved MSE without RT at W26 (combined, 29% vs 20%; AChR+, 27% vs 20%; MuSK+, 38% vs 17%) and W52 (AChR+, 46% vs 25%). The proportion of participants who achieved ≥3- point improvements in MG-ADL scores without RT was greater with inebilizumab vs placebo at W26 (combined, 69% vs 48%; AChR+, 68% vs 49%; MuSK+, 71% vs 46%) and W52 (AChR+, 72% vs 45%). The proportion of participants who achieved ≥3-point improvements in QMG scores without RT was greater with inebilizumab vs placebo at W26 (combined, 60% vs 41%; AChR+, 61% vs 40%; MuSK+, 57% vs 46%) and W52 (AChR+, 69% vs 42%). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Inebilizumab is associated with notable improvements in disease severity and function in patients with gMG. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的特征是自身反应性B细胞产生抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体（AChR+）和抗肌肉特异性激酶抗体（MuSK+）。重症肌无力inebilizumab试验（MINT）的主要终点（重症肌无力日常生活活动量表[MG-ADL]评分较基线的变化）已达成，支持inebilizumab在gMG中的疗效。目的：确定MINT研究中接受inebilizumab治疗达到最低症状表达（MSE）的参与者比例。方法：MINT（NCT04524273）纳入AChR+（190例）或MuSK+（48例）gMG参与者，按方案规定进行激素减量，并按1:1随机接受inebilizumab或安慰剂治疗26周（MuSK+）或52周（AChR+）。考察在未接受挽救治疗（RT）的情况下达到MSE（MG-ADL评分0或1）的参与者比例，以及MG-ADL或定量重症肌无力（QMG）评分改善≥3分的参与者比例。结果：与安慰剂相比，接受inebilizumab治疗的参与者中更大比例在未接受RT的情况下达到MSE：第26周（合并，29% vs 20%；AChR+，27% vs 20%；MuSK+，38% vs 17%）和第52周（AChR+，46% vs 25%）。在未接受RT的情况下MG-ADL评分改善≥3分的参与者比例，inebilizumab组高于安慰剂组：第26周（合并，69% vs 48%；AChR+，68% vs 49%；MuSK+，71% vs 46%）和第52周（AChR+，72% vs 45%）。在未接受RT的情况下QMG评分改善≥3分的参与者比例，inebilizumab组高于安慰剂组：第26周（合并，60% vs 41%；AChR+，61% vs 40%；MuSK+，57% vs 46%）和第52周（AChR+，69% vs 42%）。总结/结论：Inebilizumab与gMG患者疾病严重程度和功能的显著改善相关。海报专场I和II

abstracts.title: Quality of Life in Myasthenia Gravis: Post Hoc Pooled Analysis of Phase 3 Rozanolixizumab Studies
abstracts.authors: Ali Habib; Zabeen Mahuwala; Renato Mantegazza; Robert Pascuzzi; Sabrina Sacconi; John Vissing; Jana Zschüntzsch; Jos Bloemers; Paul Mahoney; Thais Tarancon; Vera Bril
abstracts.affiliations: Orange, CA; Lexington, KY; Milan, Italy; Indianapolis, IN; Nice, France; Copenhagen, Denmark; Göttingen, Germany; Brussels, Belgium; Slough, United Kingdom; Madrid, Spain; Toronto, Canada
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) can significantly affect quality of life (QoL). In MycarinG (NCT03971422), one 6-week cycle of rozanolixizumab (7mg/kg or 10mg/kg) improved MG-QoL 15-item revised (MG-QoL15r) total scores compared with placebo in patients with gMG. OBJECTIVE: Evaluate the effect of long-term rozanolixizumab treatment on QoL in MycarinG and its open-label extensions MG0004 (NCT04124965) and MG0007 (NCT04650854). METHODS: In MG0004, patients received once-weekly rozanolixizumab for ≤52 weeks. In MG0007, one 6-week rozanolixizumab cycle was followed with further cycles upon symptom worsening. Final efficacy data were pooled across MycarinG, MG0004 (first 6 weeks) and MG0007 for patients with ≥2 symptom-driven cycles. Change from baseline (CFB) to Day 43 in MG-QoL15r item-level scores across Cycles 1–13 was assessed post hoc using means weighted by sample size. RESULTS: Overall, 129 patients received ≥2 symptom- driven cycles. Across 13 cycles (N=890 patient-cycles), weighted-mean scores improved for all MG-QoL15r items. Weighted-mean (standard deviation) CFB in item-level scores was: −0.4 (0.7) for “trouble using my eyes”, “trouble eating”, “bothered by limitations in performing work”, “difficulty speaking” (N=889 patient-cycles); −0.3 (0.7) for “limited social activity” and “limited ability to enjoy hobbies/fun activities”; −0.3 (0.6) for “frustrated by my MG”, “trouble meeting the needs of family”, “have to make plans around my MG”, “lost some personal independence”, “trouble walking”, “trouble getting around public places” and “overwhelmed by my MG”; −0.2 (0.5) for “depressed about my MG” and “trouble performing personal grooming”. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Long-term rozanolixizumab treatment demonstrated consistent efficacy across the range of impacts that MG symptoms have on health- related QoL. Funding: UCB. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）可显著影响生活质量（QoL）。在MycarinG（NCT03971422）中，一个6周周期的rozanolixizumab（7mg/kg或10mg/kg）较安慰剂改善了gMG患者的MG-QoL 15项修订版（MG-QoL15r）总分。目的：评估MycarinG及其开放标签扩展研究MG0004（NCT04124965）和MG0007（NCT04650854）中长期rozanolixizumab治疗对QoL的影响。方法：在MG0004中，患者每周一次接受rozanolixizumab治疗≤52周。在MG0007中，一个6周rozanolixizumab周期后，在症状加重时给予进一步周期。对MycarinG、MG0004（前6周）和MG0007中接受≥2个症状驱动周期的患者进行最终疗效数据汇总。采用按样本量加权的均值，事后评估第1–13周期MG-QoL15r条目水平评分从基线至第43天的变化（CFB）。结果：总体而言，129例患者接受了≥2个症状驱动周期。在13个周期中（N=890患者-周期），所有MG-QoL15r条目的加权平均评分均改善。条目水平评分的加权平均（标准差）CFB为：“使用眼睛有困难”、“进食有困难”、“因工作能力受限而困扰”、“说话困难”为−0.4（0.7）（N=889患者-周期）；“社交活动受限”和“享受爱好/娱乐活动的能力受限”为−0.3（0.7）；“因我的MG感到沮丧”、“难以满足家庭需求”、“必须围绕我的MG做计划”、“失去部分个人独立性”、“行走困难”、“在公共场所活动困难”和“被我的MG压垮”为−0.3（0.6）；“因我的MG感到抑郁”和“个人修饰有困难”为−0.2（0.5）。总结/结论：长期rozanolixizumab治疗在MG症状对健康相关QoL的各方面影响中显示出持续一致的疗效。资助：UCB。海报专场I和III

abstracts.title: Quality of Life in Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Achieving Sustained versus Transient Clinical Outcomes in the Phase 3 VIVACITY-MG3 Trial
abstracts.authors: John Vissing; Carlo Antozzi; Kelly G Gwathmey; Kavita Gandhi; Ibrahim Turkoz; Sheryl Pease; Nolan Campbell
abstracts.affiliations: Copenhagen, Denmark; Milan, Italy; Richmond, VA; Horsham, PA; Titusville, NJ; Raritan, NJ
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Minimal clinically important improvement (MCI) in the Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) score (MCI; ≥2-point improvement) or a composite response (CR) of ≥2-point improvement in MG-ADL and ≥3-point improvement in Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis scores are plausible treatment goals in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). OBJECTIVE: This Vivacity-MG3 post hoc analysis was conducted to evaluate health-related quality of life (HRQoL) in patients achieving sustained versus transient MCI or CR. METHODS: Nipocalimab- and placebo-treated patients were stratified by MCI or CR status over the 24-week double-blind phase: never achieved MCI/CR (no-MCI/CR), achieved MCI/CR sustained ≥8 weeks (sustained- MCI/CR), or achieved MCI/CR ≥1 time but not sustained for ≥8 weeks (transient-MCI/CR). Mean changes from baseline (CFB) to Week 24 (W24) in MG-QoL-15 revised (15r) and Neuro-QoL Fatigue scores were compared across groups using ANCOVA models. RESULTS: The MCI analysis included 129 patients (91 sustained-MCI, 29 transient-MCI, 9 no-MCI); the CR analysis included 125 patients (50 sustained-CR, 37 transient-CR, 38 no-CR). Sustained- versus transient-MCI patients demonstrated greater improvements in MG- QoL-15r (least square mean CFB, −6.2 versus −2.0, p<0.001). Additionally, the sustained-MCI group had greater improvements in Neuro-QoL Fatigue (−19.5) versus transient-MCI (−7.5, p<0.001) and no-MCI (−8.5, p=0.04). Similarly, sustained-CR patients demonstrated greater improvements in MG-QoL-15r (−9.6) versus transient-CR (−5.4, p<0.001) and no-CR (−3.6, p<0.001) and in Neuro-QoL Fatigue (−29.2) versus transient-CR (−16.4, p<0.001) and no-CR (−12.2, p<0.001). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Patients achieving sustained versus transient MCI or CR demonstrated greater improvements in HRQoL and fatigue, suggesting 8-week sustained outcomes may be more impactful treatment goals than short-term transient response for patients with gMG receiving advanced treatments. abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）评分的最小临床重要改善（MCI；改善≥2分）或复合应答（CR，即MG-ADL改善≥2分且定量重症肌无力评分改善≥3分）是全身型重症肌无力（gMG）合理的治疗目标。目的：本Vivacity-MG3事后分析旨在评估达到持续性与一过性MCI或CR患者的健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）。方法：在24周双盲期内，按MCI或CR状态对nipocalimab和安慰剂治疗患者进行分层：从未达到MCI/CR（no-MCI/CR）、达到MCI/CR并持续≥8周（sustained-MCI/CR）、或达到MCI/CR≥1次但未持续≥8周（transient-MCI/CR）。采用ANCOVA模型比较各组MG-QoL-15修订版（15r）和Neuro-QoL疲劳评分从基线至第24周（W24）的平均变化（CFB）。结果：MCI分析纳入129例患者（91例持续-MCI，29例一过性-MCI，9例无-MCI）；CR分析纳入125例患者（50例持续-CR，37例一过性-CR，38例无-CR）。持续-MCI与一过性-MCI患者相比，MG-QoL-15r改善更大（最小二乘均值CFB，−6.2 vs −2.0，p<0.001）。此外，持续-MCI组Neuro-QoL疲劳改善（−19.5）大于一过性-MCI（−7.5，p<0.001）和无-MCI（−8.5，p=0.04）。同样，持续-CR患者MG-QoL-15r改善（−9.6）大于一过性-CR（−5.4，p<0.001）和无-CR（−3.6，p<0.001），Neuro-QoL疲劳改善（−29.2）大于一过性-CR（−16.4，p<0.001）和无-CR（−12.2，p<0.001）。总结/结论：达到持续性而非一过性MCI或CR的患者在HRQoL和疲劳方面改善更大，提示对于接受先进治疗的gMG患者，8周持续结局可能是比短期一过性应答更有影响的治疗目标。海报专场I和III

abstracts.title: Quality of Life in Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Achieving Sustained versus Transient Minimal Symptom Expression in the Phase 3 VIVACITY-MG3 Trial
abstracts.authors: Elena Cortés-Vicente; Nolan Campbell; Kavita Gandhi; Marie Fitzgibbon; Ibrahim Turkoz
abstracts.affiliations: Barcelona, Spain; Horsham, PA; Raritan, NJ; Titusville, NJ
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: The Phase 3 Vivacity-MG3 study (NCT04951622) demonstrated sustained disease control in patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) receiving nipocalimab+standard-of-care (SOC) vs those receiving placebo+SOC. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate minimal symptom expression (MSE, Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living score: ≤1) and quality of life (QoL) in patients achieving sustained vs transient MSE in Vivacity-MG3. METHODS: Seropositive patients from the study were stratified into groups based on MSE status over the 24- week double-blind phase: never achieved MSE (no MSE), achieved MSE and sustained for ≥8 weeks (sustained- MSE), or achieved MSE at least once but not sustained for ≥8 weeks (transient-MSE). Logistic regression models compared likelihood (odds ratio [OR]) of achieving sustained- or transient-MSE for nipocalimab+SOC vs placebo+SOC. Myasthenia Gravis-Quality of Life (Revised) Instrument (MG-QoL-15r) total score least- squares mean (LSM) change from baseline (CFB) to Week 24 (W24) were compared across MSE groups. RESULTS: Of 153 patients overall, 35 achieved MSE by W24 (nipocalimab+SOC, n=24/77; placebo+SOC, n=11/76); 19 had sustained MSE (nipocalimab+SOC, n=15/77; placebo+SOC, n=4/76). Nipocalimab-treated patients were significantly more likely to achieve sustained MSE (OR [95% CI]: 4.35 [1.37, 13.81], p=0.013) vs placebo. At W24, sustained MSE patients demonstrated significantly greater improvements in MG-QoL-15r (CFB LSM [95% CI]: −12.7 [−16.3, −9.2]) vs transient-MSE (−8.7 [−12.5, −5.0], p=0.016) and vs no MSE (−4.1 [−7.0, −1.3], p<0.001). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Nipocalimab-treated patients were four times more likely to achieve and sustain MSE for ≥8-weeks than placebo when added to SOC. Those achieving sustained-MSE demonstrated greater improvements on MG-QoL-15r scores than those with transient-MSE. Sustained-MSE is an important and impactful treatment goal for gMG patients receiving advanced treatments. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：3期Vivacity-MG3研究（NCT04951622）显示，接受nipocalimab+标准治疗（SOC）的全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者与接受安慰剂+SOC的患者相比，实现了持续疾病控制。目的：评估Vivacity-MG3中实现持续与短暂最小症状表达（MSE，重症肌无力日常生活活动量表评分≤1）患者的最小症状表达（MSE）和生活质量（QoL）。方法：研究中的血清阳性患者根据24周双盲阶段的MSE状态分层：从未达到MSE（无MSE）、达到MSE并持续≥8周（持续MSE）、或至少达到一次MSE但未持续≥8周（短暂MSE）。采用逻辑回归模型比较nipocalimab+SOC与安慰剂+SOC实现持续或短暂MSE的可能性（比值比[OR]）。比较各MSE组从基线至第24周（W24）的重症肌无力生活质量（修订版）量表（MG-QoL-15r）总分最小二乘均值（LSM）变化。结果：总共153例患者中，35例至W24达到MSE（nipocalimab+SOC，n=24/77；安慰剂+SOC，n=11/76）；19例为持续MSE（nipocalimab+SOC，n=15/77；安慰剂+SOC，n=4/76）。与安慰剂相比，nipocalimab治疗患者实现持续MSE的可能性显著更高（OR[95%CI]：4.35[1.37, 13.81]，p=0.013）。在W24，持续MSE患者的MG-QoL-15r改善显著大于短暂MSE患者（CFB LSM[95%CI]：−12.7[−16.3, −9.2] vs −8.7[−12.5, −5.0]，p=0.016）和无MSE患者（−4.1[−7.0, −1.3]，p<0.001）。总结/结论：在SOC基础上加用nipocalimab治疗的患者实现并持续MSE≥8周的可能性是安慰剂的四倍。实现持续MSE的患者在MG-QoL-15r评分上的改善大于短暂MSE患者。持续MSE是接受先进治疗的gMG患者重要且有影响的治疗目标。海报会议I和III
