abstracts.title: Results from the ADAPT JR Study Investigating Intravenous Efgartigimod in Juvenile Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Kelli Musick; Nancy L. Kuntz; Abigail N. Schwaede; Sithara Ramdas; Diane Beysen; Marek Smilowski; Anna Jesus; Anna Bogatyreva; Juliette Giacobbe; Flavia Menezes; Lan Lan; Jan Noukens; Tonke Van Bragt; Erik Harmen Niks; Anna Kostera-Pruszczyk
abstracts.affiliations: Ghent, Belgium; Chicago, IL; Oxford, United Kingdom; Edegem, Belgium; Katowice, Poland; Charlottesville, VA; Liempde, Netherlands; Leiden, Netherlands; Warsaw, Poland
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Efgartigimod, a human immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) antibody Fc fragment, blocks the neonatal Fc receptor. Phase 3 ADAPT/ADAPT+ trials demonstrated that efgartigimod intravenous (IV) is efficacious and well tolerated in adults with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). There is an unmet need for safe and effective treatments in juvenile gMG, which is rarer than adult-onset gMG (incidence: 1-5 cases vs 30 cases per 1,000,000 people per year). OBJECTIVE: To present interim results of ADAPT JR (NCT04833894), a Phase 2/3 trial assessing efgartigimod IV in participants with acetylcholine receptor antibody–positive (AChR-Ab+) juvenile gMG. METHODS: Staggered enrollment in ADAPT JR began with an adolescent cohort (aged 12-17 years) and is continuing with a child cohort (aged 2-11 years). During Part A, participants received 1 efgartigimod infusion. During Part B, participants received 1 or 2 cycles of 4 once-weekly efgartigimod infusions. RESULTS: In the adolescent cohort, 6 participants enrolled in Part A and continued to Part B, and 5 participants enrolled directly in Part B (N=11; median [range] age, 15.0 [12-17] years). Efgartigimod treatment resulted in IgG and AChR-Ab decreases similar to those observed in previous studies of adults with gMG. Safety profile and Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) improvements were also similar to previous observations. Additional analyses evaluating the long-term safety of efgartigimod from the ADAPT JR+ open-label extension will be presented at the annual meeting. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Pharmacodynamics, safety, and efficacy of efgartigimod in adolescent participants were similar to previous studies in adults. The ADAPT JR child cohort enrollment is ongoing. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Efgartigimod是一种人免疫球蛋白G1（IgG1）抗体Fc片段，可阻断新生儿Fc受体。3期ADAPT/ADAPT+试验表明，静脉（IV）efgartigimod对成人全身型重症肌无力（gMG）有效且耐受性良好。青少年gMG较成人起病gMG更罕见（发病率：每年每1,000,000人中1-5例 vs 30例），存在安全有效治疗的需求。目的：呈现ADAPT JR（NCT04833894）的中期结果，该2/3期试验评估IV efgartigimod用于乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）青少年gMG参与者。方法：ADAPT JR采用序贯入组，先入组青少年队列（12-17岁），目前正在继续入组儿童队列（2-11岁）。在A部分，参与者接受1次efgartigimod输注。在B部分，参与者接受1或2个周期、每周期4次每周1次的efgartigimod输注。结果：在青少年队列中，6名参与者在A部分入组并继续进入B部分，5名参与者直接入组B部分（N=11；中位[范围]年龄，15.0[12-17]岁）。Efgartigimod治疗导致IgG和AChR-Ab下降，与既往成人gMG研究观察到的相似。安全性和重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）改善也与既往观察相似。来自ADAPT JR+开放标签扩展的评估efgartigimod长期安全性的额外分析将在年会上呈现。总结/结论：Efgartigimod在青少年参与者中的药效学、安全性和疗效与既往成人研究相似。ADAPT JR儿童队列入组正在进行中。海报专场I和II

abstracts.title: Sustained Clinical Efficacy and Long-term Safety of Intravenous Efgartigimod for Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Final Analysis of ADAPT NXT
abstracts.authors: Arjun Seth; Kristl G. Claeys; Ali A. Habib; Yessar Hussain; Gregory Sahagian; Elena Cortés-Vicente; Jeffrey Guptill; Li Liu; Rosa H. Jimenez; Sirine Bougamra; Delphine Masschaele; Renato Mantegazza; Andreas Meisel; Fang Sun; Shahram Attarian
abstracts.affiliations: Chicago, IL; Leuven, Belgium; Orange, CA; Austin, TX; Carlsbad, CA; Barcelona, Spain; Ghent, Belgium; Milan, Italy; Berlin, Germany; Pittsburgh, PA; Marseille, France
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Efgartigimod, a human immunoglobulin G1 Fc fragment that blocks the neonatal Fc receptor, was well tolerated and efficacious when administered as fixed- cycles or every-other-week (Q2W) dosing to participants with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) during Part A of the Phase 3b ADAPT NXT study (NCT04980495). OBJECTIVE: Part B of ADAPT NXT investigated the long- term efficacy, safety, and tolerability of efgartigimod in participants with gMG receiving Q2W or every-third-week (Q3W) dosing. METHODS: Participants were randomized 3:1 to Q2W or fixed-cycles dosing of 10 mg/kg efgartigimod for 21 weeks in Part A. Fixed-cycles dosing involved 4 once-weekly infusions followed by a 4-week intertreatment period. All Part B participants received Q2W dosing during a 105- week extension and could switch to Q3W dosing depending on clinical assessment. RESULTS: Sixty-five of sixty-nine participants in Part A (94.2%) continued treatment in Part B; 57.8% (37/64) transitioned, and 48.6% (18/37) remained on Q3W dosing. The average Q3W treatment duration was 434 days. Mean Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG- ADL) total score improvements were sustained through Week 126. Overall, 82.6% (57/69) of participants experienced an MG-ADL improvement of ≥5 points, and 58.0% (40/69) achieved minimal symptom expression (MSE; MG-ADL score, 0-1) at any time during the study. In Part B, 53.1% (34/64) of participants achieved MSE. Efgartigimod was well tolerated, and no new safety signals were observed. Data from the final analysis of ADAPT NXT will be presented at the meeting. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Efgartigimod demonstrated sustained clinical benefits in participants with gMG during long-term treatment while remaining well tolerated across different dosing schedules. abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), an autoantibody-mediated disease causes fluctuating muscle symptoms and substantially impairs health-related quality-of-life (HRQoL). In Vivacity-MG3 (NCT04951622), nipocalimab+standard-of-care (SOC) demonstrated improved and sustained disease control versus placebo+SOC. HRQoL changes during the 24-week (W) double blind phase were evalu- ated using patient reported MGQoL-15r and EQ-5D visual ana- logue scale (EQ-5D-VAS). Methods: Mean change-from-baseline (CFB) between groups in MGQoL-15r and EQ-5D-VAS over 24W were compared using ANCOVA models. Meaningful-within-person-improvement (MWPI) response was a change of one-half a standard deviation on MGQoL-15r (> = 4-points) and EQ-5D-VAS (> = 10-points). Proportion of patients achieving MWPI and time-to-MWPI over 24W were examined using Chi-square test and Kaplan-Meier analyses. Logistic regression evaluated likelihood of achieving MWPI over 24W and sustaining MWPI for > = 8, 12, 16, and 20W between groups. Results: LS-mean (95% CI) difference in CFB on MGQoL-15r and EQ-5D-VAS was greater with nipocalimab+SOC versus pla- cebo+SOC (−1.38 [−3.14, 0.37], not significant [ns] versus 6.86 FIGURE 2 MUNIX and CMAP differences between patients with SMA and healthy volunteers (HC). Upper row shows MUNIX differences and lower row CMAP differences; for MUNIX Sum Scores, CMAP Sum Scores, and MUNIX and CMAP individual muscle scores. FIGURE 3 ROC curves of MUNIX, CMAP, and MUSIX Sum Scores discriminative performances between ambulant and non-ambulant pa- tients with SMA. [2.07, 11.66], p < 0.05, respectively) at 4W and sustained (−1.61 [−3.55, 0.33], ns; 6.47 [1.05, 11.88], p < 0.05) at 24W. At 24W, 67.2% (45/67) versus 56.5% (35/62) achieved MWPI on MGQoL- 15r (absolute difference = 10.7%[ns]) and 55.2% (37/67) versus 37.1% (23/62) patients achieved MWPI on EQ-5D-VAS (abso- lute difference = 18.1%, [p < 0.05]) in nipocalimab+SOC versus placebo+SOC. For both measures, nipocalimab+SOC patients were twice more likely to achieve MWPI over 24W with me- dian time-to-response approximately 4W versus 8W with place- bo+SOC (p < 0.05). Similarly, nipocalimab+SOC patients were approximately twice more likely to sustain MWPI for > = 8, 12, 16, 20W (p < 0.05). Conclusion: Nipocalimab+SOC-treated patients achieved meaningful HRQoL improvements as early as 4W and were significantly more likely to achieve and sustain these improve- ments over 24W versus placebo+SOC.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景和目的：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种自身抗体介导的疾病，会导致波动的肌肉症状并严重损害健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）。在Vivacity-MG3（NCT04951622）研究中，nipocalimab+标准治疗（SOC）与安慰剂+SOC相比，显示出改善且持续的疾病控制。使用患者报告的MGQoL-15r和EQ-5D视觉模拟量表（EQ-5D-VAS）评估了24周（W）双盲期内的HRQoL变化。方法：使用ANCOVA模型比较两组在24周内MGQoL-15r和EQ-5D-VAS较基线的平均变化（CFB）。有意义个体内改善（MWPI）反应定义为MGQoL-15r变化≥半个标准差（≥4分）和EQ-5D-VAS变化≥10分。使用卡方检验和Kaplan-Meier分析评估24周内达到MWPI的患者比例和达到MWPI的时间。使用逻辑回归评估两组在24周内达到MWPI以及在≥8、12、16和20周内维持MWPI的可能性。结果：在第4周，nipocalimab+SOC组与安慰剂+SOC组相比，MGQoL-15r和EQ-5D-VAS的LS-均值（95% CI）CFB差异更大（分别为-1.38 [-3.14, 0.37]，无显著性[ns]；6.86 [2.07, 11.66]，p < 0.05），并在第24周持续（分别为-1.61 [-3.55, 0.33]，ns；6.47 [1.05, 11.88]，p < 0.05）。在第24周，nipocalimab+SOC组与安慰剂+SOC组相比，67.2%（45/67）对56.5%（35/62）的患者在MGQoL-15r上达到MWPI（绝对差异=10.7%[ns]），55.2%（37/67）对37.1%（23/62）的患者在EQ-5D-VAS上达到MWPI（绝对差异=18.1%，[p < 0.05]）。对于两项指标，nipocalimab+SOC组患者在24周内达到MWPI的可能性是安慰剂+SOC组的两倍，中位反应时间约为4周，而安慰剂+SOC组约为8周（p < 0.05）。同样，nipocalimab+SOC组患者在≥8、12、16、20周内维持MWPI的可能性大约是安慰剂+SOC组的两倍（p < 0.05）。结论：与安慰剂+SOC相比，nipocalimab+SOC治疗的患者早在第4周就实现了有意义的HRQoL改善，并且在24周内达到并维持这些改善的可能性显著更高。

abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is a B-cell and antibody-mediated neuromuscular autoimmune disease that can result in substantial disability. Novel therapies are needed to improve disease symptoms. Miv-cel (mivocabta- gene autoleucel; KYV-101) is a fully-human, autologous CD19 CAR T-cell therapy with CD28 costimulation, designed for po- tency and tolerability. Updated data for miv-cel in gMG from KYSA-6 phase 2 (NCT06193889) are presented. Methods: Adults (18–75 y) with gMG (class IIb–IV), his- tory of autoantibodies (AChR, MuSK, LRP4), MG activities of daily living (MG-ADL) score ≥6, and ≥2 immunosuppressant/ immunomodulator failures, received lymphodepletion followed by 1×108 CAR T cells. Results: As of October 3, 2025, 6 patients were dosed (Table). Follow-up was 28 days-9 months (≥24 weeks, n = 3). Miv-cel rapidly expanded with CAR T-cell activation evidenced by deep B-cell depletion and transient immunomodulatory cytokine ele- vation. Of 3 patients with ≥24-weeks follow-up, mean reductions from baseline were 8.0 and 7.7 points for MG-ADL and QMG, respectively, at 24 weeks and 67% achieved minimal symptom expression (Figures 1 and 2). All 6 patients remained immuno- suppressant therapy-free up to 24 weeks. No ICANS or high- grade CRS occurred. After miv-cel, alterations in T-cell subsets were observed in the 3 patients with ≥24-weeks follow-up and reconstituted B cells in 2 patients 3–4 months post-infusion were predominantly naïve, supporting immune reset. Conclusion: With a single dose, miv-cel induced deep B-cell depletion with evidence of immune reset. Patients experienced rapid, robust, and sustained improvements in disease severity with acceptable safety. Miv-cel demonstrates the potential to de- liver durable, drug-free, disease-free remission in patients with gMG. Phase 3 is ongoing.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景和目的：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种B细胞和抗体介导的神经肌肉自身免疫性疾病，可导致严重残疾。需要新型疗法来改善疾病症状。Miv-cel（mivocabtagene autoleucel；KYV-101）是一种全人源、自体CD19 CAR T细胞疗法，具有CD28共刺激结构域，旨在实现效力和耐受性。本文展示了KYSA-6 2期研究（NCT06193889）中miv-cel治疗gMG的更新数据。方法：成人（18-75岁）gMG患者（IIb-IV级），有自身抗体史（AChR、MuSK、LRP4），MG日常生活活动（MG-ADL）评分≥6，且≥2种免疫抑制剂/免疫调节剂治疗失败，接受淋巴细胞耗竭后输注1×10^8个CAR T细胞。结果：截至2025年10月3日，6例患者接受了给药（见表）。随访时间为28天至9个月（≥24周，n=3）。Miv-cel快速扩增，CAR T细胞活化表现为深度B细胞耗竭和短暂的免疫调节性细胞因子升高。在3例随访≥24周的患者中，第24周时MG-ADL和QMG评分较基线平均分别降低8.0分和7.7分，67%达到最小症状表达（图1和图2）。所有6例患者在长达24周内均未使用免疫抑制剂治疗。未发生ICANS或高级别CRS。在miv-cel治疗后，3例随访≥24周的患者观察到T细胞亚群改变，2例患者在输注后3-4个月重建的B细胞主要为幼稚型，支持免疫重置。结论：单次给药后，miv-cel诱导了深度B细胞耗竭，并伴有免疫重置的证据。患者疾病严重程度出现快速、强劲且持续的改善，安全性可接受。Miv-cel展示了在gMG患者中实现持久、无药物、无疾病缓解的潜力。3期研究正在进行中。

abstracts.title: Corticosteroid use in nipocalimab-treated Japanese patients with generalized myasthenia gravis: Phase 3 vivacity-MG3 open-label extension study
abstracts.authors: C. Antozzi1; K. Gandhi2; I. Turkoz3; M. Kutch4; M. Fitzgibbon5; S. Ramchandren3; H. Murai6
abstracts.affiliations: 1Immunotherapy and Apheresis Departmental Unit, Fondazione IRCCS Istituto Neurologico C. Besta, Milan, Italy; 2Medical Affairs, Johnson & Johnson, Horsham, USA; 3Medical Affairs, Johnson & Johnson, Titusville, USA; 4Cytel, Inc, USA; 5Medical Affairs, Johnson & Johnson, Raritan, USA; 6Department of Neurology, International University of Health and Welfare, Narita, Japan
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: In seropositive adults with gen- eralized myasthenia gravis (gMG), nipocalimab treatment (nipocalimab+standard-of-care [SOC]) vs placebo+SOC achieved sustained disease control during the 24-week VIVACITY-MG3 study (NCT04951622) double-blind phase. Sustained disease control was maintained through open-label extension (OLE) week 60. During OLE, 45% of patients receiv- ing nipocalimab (N = 89) reduced/discontinued corticosteroids; a substantial proportion demonstrated minimum symptom expression (MSE; MG-Activities of Daily Living [MG-ADL] score = 0/1) and sustained for ≥8 weeks. In Japan, achieving minimal gMG symptoms with low corticosteroid doses (target: ≤5 mg/day) is an important treatment goal. We characterized the impact of nipocalimab on corticosteroid use in Japanese patients in the VIVACITY-MG3 OLE phase. Methods: Corticosteroid doses (mg/day prednisone-equivalent) were evaluated through OLE data cut-off (August 2024). Among patients who reduced corticosteroid dose (≤5 mg/day), the pro- portion achieving MSE was evaluated. Results: Of 11 Japanese patients receiving corticosteroids at OLE baseline, 7 (64%) receiving nipocalimab in OLE reduced/ discontinued corticosteroids at data cutoff; of these, 5 (71%) reached ≤5 mg/day. Among steroid reducers, mean (SD) steroid dose reduced from 10.4 (2.32) to 5.6 (2.82) mg/day prednisone- equivalent in Japanese patients, while in remaining popu- lation dose reduced from 25.1 (20.53) to 11.2 (10.50) mg/day prednisone-equivalent. Among those reducing corticosteroids, 4/7 (57%) patients achieved MSE within 48 weeks (Table 1). Conclusion: In OLE, over half of Japanese patients reduced/ discontinued corticosteroids with substantial proportions taper- ing to low-dose corticosteroid (≤5 mg/day) and achieving MSE within 48 weeks. These results are consistent with the overall population where almost half of patients receiving corticoste- roids at baseline, reduced/discontinued steroids and showed sustained disease control with nipocalimab.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景和目的：在血清阳性的成人全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者中，nipocalimab治疗（nipocalimab+标准治疗[SOC]）与安慰剂+SOC相比，在为期24周的VIVACITY-MG3研究（NCT04951622）双盲期实现了持续的疾病控制。持续的疾病控制维持至开放标签扩展期（OLE）第60周。在OLE期间，接受nipocalimab治疗的患者（N=89）中，45%减少/停用了皮质类固醇；相当一部分患者达到了最小症状表达（MSE；MG-日常生活活动[MG-ADL]评分=0/1）并持续≥8周。在日本，以低皮质类固醇剂量（目标：≤5 mg/天）实现最小gMG症状是一个重要的治疗目标。我们描述了VIVACITY-MG3 OLE期中nipocalimab对日本患者皮质类固醇使用的影响。方法：评估截至OLE数据截止日期（2024年8月）的皮质类固醇剂量（mg/天泼尼松当量）。在减少皮质类固醇剂量（≤5 mg/天）的患者中，评估达到MSE的比例。结果：在OLE基线时接受皮质类固醇治疗的11例日本患者中，7例（64%）在数据截止时减少/停用了皮质类固醇；其中，5例（71%）达到了≤5 mg/天。在类固醇减量者中，日本患者的平均（SD）类固醇剂量从10.4（2.32）mg/天泼尼松当量降至5.6（2.82）mg/天，而其余人群的剂量从25.1（20.53）mg/天降至11.2（10.50）mg/天。在减少皮质类固醇的患者中，4/7（57%）在48周内达到了MSE（表1）。结论：在OLE中，超过一半的日本患者减少/停用了皮质类固醇，相当比例的患者逐渐减量至低剂量皮质类固醇（≤5 mg/天）并在48周内达到MSE。这些结果与总体人群一致，总体人群中近一半基线接受皮质类固醇治疗的患者在使用nipocalimab后减少/停用了类固醇并显示出持续的疾病控制。

abstracts.title: Effect of subcutaneous self-administered Gefurulimab on ocular muscle function in myasthenia gravis in the PREVAIL Trial
abstracts.authors: F. Saccà1; D. Annane2; M. Mäurer3; M. Takahashi4; S. Rakhade5; J. Scholz5; S. Shang5; T. Vu6
abstracts.affiliations: 1NSRO Department, University of Naples Federico II, Napoli, Italy; 2General ICU, Hôpital Raymond Poincaré, Garches, France; 3Clinic for Neurology and Neurological Early Rehabilitation, Würzburg-Mitte Hospital, Würzburg, Germany; 4Department of Clinical Laboratory and Biomedical, The University of Osaka Graduate School of Medicine Sciences, Osaka, Japan; 5Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease, Boston, USA; 6Department of Neurology and Neuromuscular Medicine, University of South Florida Morsani College of Medicine, Tampa, FL
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Gefurulimab, a novel dual-binding nanobody, blocks complement component 5 activation. The phase 3 PREVAIL trial, assessing the efficacy and safety of ge- furulimab in adults with anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody- positive (AChR-Ab+) generalised myasthenia gravis (gMG) (NCT05556096), met all primary and secondary endpoints and demonstrated clinically meaningful improvement from baseline in Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) total score at week 26 compared with placebo. Here, we present the effect of gefurulimab on ocular symptoms. Methods: Adults with AChR-Ab+ gMG were randomised 1:1 to weekly subcutaneous self-administration of gefurulimab or placebo. The primary endpoint was change from baseline in MG-ADL total score at wk26. MG-ADL and Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) subdomain scores were also assessed. Results: 260 patients were randomized (gefurulimab: n = 131; placebo: n = 129). Mean±SD baseline MG-ADL and QMG total scores were 9.0±2.16 and 14.8±4.37, respectively. Improvements in ocular subdomain scores were observed at first assessment after treatment initiation (MG-ADL, wk1; QMG, wk4) and sus- tained through wk26. Least squares mean±SEM change from baseline at wk26 in MG-ADL and QMG ocular subdomain scores for gefurulimab versus placebo were −1.2 ± 0.14 versus −0.6±0.13 (treatment difference, −0.6±0.19; 95% CI: −1.0, −0.2; p = 0.0016) and −1.7±0.14 versus −0.9±0.14 (treatment differ- ence, −0.7±0.19; 95% CI: −1.1, −0.4, p = 0.0002), respectively. Improvements were also observed in other MG-ADL and QMG subdomains. Adverse events were similar between groups; no meningococcal infections were reported. Conclusion: Gefurulimab, self-administered once weekly via subcutaneous injection, showed early and sustained improve- ments in MG-ADL and QMG ocular subdomain scores, demon- strating benefits for patients with gMG experiencing ocular symptoms.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：Gefurulimab是一种新型双结合纳米抗体，可阻断补体成分5的激活。评估gefurulimab在抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）全身型重症肌无力（gMG）成人患者中疗效和安全性的3期PREVAIL试验（NCT05556096）达到了所有主要和次要终点，并在第26周时与安慰剂相比，在重症肌无力日常生活活动能力（MG-ADL）总分较基线的变化方面显示出具有临床意义的改善。在此，我们介绍gefurulimab对眼部症状的影响。方法：AChR-Ab+ gMG成人患者按1:1随机分配至每周皮下自我注射gefurulimab或安慰剂。主要终点是第26周时MG-ADL总分较基线的变化。还评估了MG-ADL和定量重症肌无力（QMG）子域评分。结果：260例患者被随机分组（gefurulimab组：n=131；安慰剂组：n=129）。基线MG-ADL和QMG总分的平均值±标准差分别为9.0±2.16和14.8±4.37。在治疗开始后的首次评估（MG-ADL，第1周；QMG，第4周）即观察到眼部子域评分的改善，并持续至第26周。第26周时，gefurulimab组与安慰剂组MG-ADL和QMG眼部子域评分较基线的最小二乘均值±标准误变化分别为-1.2±0.14对比-0.6±0.13（治疗差异，-0.6±0.19；95% CI：-1.0，-0.2；p=0.0016）和-1.7±0.14对比-0.9±0.14（治疗差异，-0.7±0.19；95% CI：-1.1，-0.4；p=0.0002）。在其他MG-ADL和QMG子域也观察到改善。两组不良事件相似；未报告脑膜炎球菌感染。结论：每周一次皮下自我注射的Gefurulimab在MG-ADL和QMG眼部子域评分方面显示出早期且持续的改善，证明对伴有眼部症状的gMG患者有益。

abstracts.title: Efficacy and cumulative safety of cemdisiran in adults with generalised myasthenia gravis (gMG): Results from the phase 3 NIMBLE trial
abstracts.authors: S. Jacob1; T. Vu2; A. Habib3; R. Mantegazza4; H. Murai5; J. Vissing6; A. Shaibani7; T. Levine8; Y. Hussain9; A. Meisel10; R. Pavani11; U. Chaudhari11; N. Jalali11; M. DeVeaux11; K. Meagher11; S. Sherman11; D. Pawaskar11; A. Souttou11; L. Perlee11; J. Howard Jr12

abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Autoantibody-mediated complement activation damages neuromuscular junctions in gMG, resulting in variable muscle weakness. The phase 3 NIMBLE trial eval- uated subcutaneous cemdisiran (siRNA inhibiting hepatic C5 production) and subcutaneous pozelimab (monoclonal antibody targeting C5) as monotherapies or in combination in patients with gMG. Methods: NIMBLE is a double-blind, placebo-controlled trial. A total of 288 patients with gMG were randomised to cemdi- siran (600 mg Q12W), pozelimab (200 mg Q4W), combination (both 200 mg Q4W), or placebo. We present key results for the primary efficacy endpoint, change from baseline in MG-ADL at Week 24, based on August 2025 database lock (n = 239), and the cumulative rate of TEAEs based on December 2025 database lock (n = 281). Results: NIMBLE met its primary endpoint. In the cemdisiran (n = 64) and combination (n = 67) arms, the least squares mean (SE) of change from baseline at Week 24 in MG-ADL total score was −4.5 (0.4) and −4.0 (0.4), with placebo-adjusted differences of −2.3 (p = 0.0005) and −1.7 (p = 0.0086); achieving 76.6% (n = 75) and 99.6% (n = 75) terminal complement inhibition, respectively. TEAEs occurred in 74.7% (59/79), 81.6% (40/49), 81.5% (66/81), and 81.9% (59/72) in the cemdisiran, pozelimab, combination, and placebo arms, respectively. No meningococ- cal, serious infections or deaths occurred in the cemdisiran arm during the double-blind treatment period (DBTP); SAEs of infections in other arms were low. There were 2 deaths (pneu- monia [cemdisiran], septic shock [combination]) in patients on concomitant immuno-suppressive therapies and comorbidities after the DBTP. Conclusion: Quarterly, subcutaneous cemdisiran was gener- ally well-tolerated and achieved significant improvement in symptoms with partial complement inhibition among patients with gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：自身抗体介导的补体激活会损害gMG的神经肌肉接头，导致可变的肌肉无力。3期NIMBLE试验评估了皮下cemdisiran（抑制肝脏C5生成的siRNA）和皮下pozelimab（靶向C5的单克隆抗体）作为单药或联合用药在gMG患者中的疗效。方法：NIMBLE是一项双盲、安慰剂对照试验。共288例gMG患者被随机分配至cemdisiran组（600 mg Q12W）、pozelimab组（200 mg Q4W）、联合治疗组（均为200 mg Q4W）或安慰剂组。我们基于2025年8月数据库锁定（n=239）呈现主要疗效终点（第24周MG-ADL较基线的变化）的关键结果，以及基于2025年12月数据库锁定（n=281）的治疗期间不良事件（TEAE）累积发生率。结果：NIMBLE达到了其主要终点。在cemdisiran组（n=64）和联合治疗组（n=67），第24周MG-ADL总分较基线的最小二乘均值（标准误）变化分别为-4.5（0.4）和-4.0（0.4），安慰剂校正后的差异分别为-2.3（p=0.0005）和-1.7（p=0.0086）；分别实现了76.6%（n=75）和99.6%（n=75）的末端补体抑制。在cemdisiran组、pozelimab组、联合治疗组和安慰剂组中，TEAE发生率分别为74.7%（59/79）、81.6%（40/49）、81.5%（66/81）和81.9%（59/72）。在双盲治疗期间，cemdisiran组未发生脑膜炎球菌感染、严重感染或死亡；其他组感染相关的严重不良事件发生率较低。在双盲治疗期后，有2例接受伴随免疫抑制治疗且有合并症的患者死亡（肺炎[cemdisiran组]，感染性休克[联合治疗组]）。结论：每季度一次皮下注射的cemdisiran总体耐受性良好，并在部分补体抑制的gMG患者中实现了症状的显著改善。

abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: In MycarinG (Phase 3; NCT03971422), one 6-week cycle of rozanolixizumab (7 mg/kg or 10 mg/kg) improved myasthenia gravis (MG)-specific outcomes versus placebo. Here, we evaluate the long-term efficacy of repeated rozanolixizumab treatment cycles across MycarinG and its open-label extension studies in subgroups of patients with gen- eralised MG (gMG). Methods: Following MycarinG, patients could enrol in MG0004 (NCT04124965) to receive once-weekly rozanolixizumab for < = 52 weeks, or MG0007 (NCT04650854), which comprised an initial 6-week rozanolixizumab cycle, with further cycles ad- ministered upon symptom worsening. Final efficacy data were pooled across MycarinG, MG0004 (first 6 weeks) and MG0007 for patients with > = 2 symptom-driven rozanolixizumab cy- cles. Mean change from baseline (CFB) in MG Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) score to Day 43 in Cycles 1–13 was assessed. Subgroups were prespecified according to baseline characteristics. Results: Overall, 129 patients received > = 2 symptom-driven cycles. Mean (standard deviation) CFB in MG-ADL score at Day 43 across Cycles 1–13 for the overall population ranged from −3.2 (3.3) in Cycle 3 (n = 113) to −6.0 (3.9) in Cycle 12 (n = 24). Improvements from baseline in MG-ADL scores at Day 43 were consistent in subgroups of autoantibody status (anti-muscle- specific tyrosine kinase and anti-acetylcholine receptor anti- body positive), disease duration (< 5.4 and > = 5.4 years), age (< 65 and > = 65 years), MG-ADL score (< 5 and > = 5) and thymectomy status. Treatment-emergent adverse events oc- curred in 93.1% (n = 175/188) of patients with > = 1 treatment cycle across MycarinG and MG0007; most were mild/moderate. Conclusion: Repeated rozanolixizumab treatment cycles demonstrated long-term efficacy in a broad range of patients with gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：在MycarinG（3期；NCT03971422）中，一个为期6周的rozanolixizumab（7 mg/kg或10 mg/kg）治疗周期相较于安慰剂改善了重症肌无力（MG）特异性结局。在此，我们评估了在MycarinG及其开放标签扩展研究中，对全身型MG（gMG）患者亚组重复使用rozanolixizumab治疗周期的长期疗效。方法：完成MycarinG的患者可入组MG0004（NCT04124965）接受每周一次rozanolixizumab治疗≤52周，或入组MG0007（NCT04650854），该研究包括一个初始的6周rozanolixizumab周期，之后在症状加重时给予后续周期。最终疗效数据汇总自MycarinG、MG0004（前6周）和MG0007中接受≥2个症状驱动rozanolixizumab周期的患者。评估了第1至13周期中第43天MG日常生活活动能力（MG-ADL）评分较基线的平均变化。亚组根据基线特征预先指定。结果：总体而言，129例患者接受了≥2个症状驱动周期。在总体人群中，第1至13周期第43天MG-ADL评分较基线的平均（标准差）变化范围为第3周期（n=113）的-3.2（3.3）至第12周期（n=24）的-6.0（3.9）。在自身抗体状态（抗肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶和抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性）、病程（<5.4年和≥5.4年）、年龄（<65岁和≥65岁）、MG-ADL评分（<5分和≥5分）和胸腺切除状态的亚组中，第43天MG-ADL评分较基线的改善是一致的。在MycarinG和MG0007中接受≥1个治疗周期的患者中，93.1%（n=175/188）发生治疗期间不良事件；大多数为轻度/中度。结论：重复的rozanolixizumab治疗周期在广泛的gMG患者中显示出长期疗效。

abstracts.authors: N. Savic1; M. Freimer2; C. Hewamadduma3; M. Leite4; A. Maniaol5; K. Utsugisawa6; M. Weiss7; B. Boroojerdi8; P. Mahoney9; J. Howard10

abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Clinically meaningful improvements in myasthenia gravis (MG)-specific outcomes were observed with zilucoplan treatment up to Week 120 in patients with generalised MG (gMG) in the Phase 3, ongoing, open-label ex- tension study, RAISE-XT (NCT04225871). Here, we evaluate the efficacy of long-term zilucoplan treatment in patients with gMG, stratified by specific disease characteristics. Methods: Adults with anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody- positive gMG who completed a qualifying double-blind, placebo- controlled study (NCT03315130 or NCT04115293 [RAISE]) could enter RAISE-XT and self-administer once-daily subcu- taneous zilucoplan 0.3 mg/kg injections. Change from baseline (CFB) to Week 120 in MG-specific outcome measure scores was assessed (data cut-off: 11 November 2023). Subgroups were pre- specified according to the following baseline characteristics: age < 65 or ≥65 years, MG Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) score ≤9 or ≥10, and disease duration < 5.2 or ≥5.2 years. Results: Overall, 200 patients enrolled. At Week 120, mean (standard error) CFB in MG-ADL scores across all subgroups were: age: < 65 years, n = 64: −7.3 (0.5) and ≥65 years, n = 22: −6.7 (0.8); MG-ADL: ≤9, n = 68: −7.0 (0.4) and ≥10, n = 18: −7.6 (1.4); and disease duration: < 5.2 years, n = 42: −6.7 (0.7) and ≥5.2 years, n = 44: −7.5 (0.6). Improvements were also observed at Week 120 for Quantitative MG, MG Quality of Life 15-item re- vised, and Quality of Life in Neurological Disorders Short Form Fatigue scores. Treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 97.0% (n/N = 194/200) of patients; most were mild or moderate and unrelated to the study drug. Conclusion: Long-term zilucoplan treatment demonstrated consistent improvements in MG-specific outcomes up to Week 120, irrespective of disease severity, duration or patient age.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：在3期、正在进行的开放标签扩展研究RAISE-XT（NCT04225871）中，zilucoplan治疗至第120周在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者中观察到具有临床意义的重症肌无力（MG）特异性结局改善。在此，我们评估了长期zilucoplan治疗在按特定疾病特征分层的gMG患者中的疗效。方法：完成合格的双盲、安慰剂对照研究（NCT03315130或NCT04115293 [RAISE]）的抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性gMG成人患者可进入RAISE-XT，并每日一次皮下自我注射zilucoplan 0.3 mg/kg。评估了至第120周MG特异性结局评分较基线的变化（数据截止日期：2023年11月11日）。亚组根据以下基线特征预先指定：年龄<65岁或≥65岁，MG日常生活活动能力（MG-ADL）评分≤9或≥10，以及病程<5.2年或≥5.2年。结果：共200例患者入组。在第120周，所有亚组MG-ADL评分较基线的平均（标准误）变化为：年龄：<65岁，n=64：-7.3（0.5）和≥65岁，n=22：-6.7（0.8）；MG-ADL：≤9，n=68：-7.0（0.4）和≥10，n=18：-7.6（1.4）；病程：<5.2年，n=42：-6.7（0.7）和≥5.2年，n=44：-7.5（0.6）。在第120周，定量MG、MG生活质量15项修订版和神经疾病生活质量简表疲劳评分也观察到改善。97.0%（n/N=194/200）的患者发生治疗期间不良事件；大多数为轻度或中度且与研究药物无关。结论：长期zilucoplan治疗至第120周，无论疾病严重程度、病程或患者年龄如何，均显示出MG特异性结局的一致改善。

abstracts.affiliations: 1Department of Neurology, Beijing Hospital, National Center of Gerontology, Institute of Geriatric Medicine, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences, China; 2Department of Neurology, First Hospital of Shanxi Medical University, China; 3Department of Neurology, Affiliated Hospital of Zunyi Medical University, China; 4Department of Neurology, Xi'an Gaoxin Hospital, China; 5Department of Neurology, First Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University, China; 6Department of Neurology, Tangdu Hospital, Air Force Medical University of PLA (formerly known as the Fourth Military Medical University), Shaanxi, China
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: This post hoc analysis aimed to eval- uate the domain-specific clinical efficacy of telitacicept and to explore its differential effect in the clinically relevant subgroup of patients with a history of thymoma. TABLE 1 Demographics and clinical characteristics of the patients at baseline. Methods: Eligible patients from a phase 2 trial (NCT04302103) were randomized to receive weekly subcutaneous telitacicept at 160 mg (n = 14) or 240 mg (n = 15). Key changes from baseline to Week 24 in the total Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) score and its bulbar, ocular, limb, and respiratory subdomain scores were analyzed. Outcomes were also assessed based on thymoma history. Results: Both doses induced early (from Week 4) and sustained improvements across all QMG domains. The 240-mg dose re- sulted in a significantly greater improvement in ocular scores at Weeks 8 and 12 compared to the 160-mg dose (p = 0.037). Patients with a history of thymoma (n = 14) showed a numeri- cally greater reduction in the total QMG score than those with- out (n = 15). The 240-mg dose demonstrated superior efficacy regardless of thymoma status. Conclusion: Telitacicept provides rapid and sustained im- provement in muscle strength across all domains in generalized myasthenia gravis. The 240-mg dose appears particularly ben- eficial for ocular involvement and in patients with a history of thymoma. These promising subgroup findings warrant further investigation in larger confirmatory studies.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：本项事后分析旨在评估泰它西普在特定领域的临床疗效，并探讨其在有胸腺瘤病史的临床相关亚组中的差异化效果。表1 患者基线时的人口统计学和临床特征。方法：来自一项2期试验（NCT04302103）的合格患者被随机分配，每周接受皮下注射泰它西普160 mg（n=14）或240 mg（n=15）。分析了从基线到第24周，定量重症肌无力（QMG）总分及其延髓、眼部、肢体和呼吸亚域评分的关键变化。还根据胸腺瘤病史评估了结局。结果：两种剂量均诱导了所有QMG领域的早期（从第4周开始）和持续改善。与160 mg剂量相比，240 mg剂量在第8周和第12周时眼部评分改善显著更大（p=0.037）。有胸腺瘤病史的患者（n=14）的总QMG评分降低数值上大于无胸腺瘤病史的患者（n=15）。无论胸腺瘤状态如何，240 mg剂量均显示出优越的疗效。结论：泰它西普在全身型重症肌无力中可快速且持续地改善所有领域的肌力。240 mg剂量似乎对眼部受累和有胸腺瘤病史的患者特别有益。这些有希望的亚组发现需要在更大规模的验证性研究中进一步调查。

abstracts.title: Health-related quality of life in patients with generalised myasthenia gravis receiving gefurulimab in the PREVAIL trial
abstracts.authors: T. Ruck1; F. Saccà2; T. Vu3; S. Rakhade4; A. Racine4; S. Pandeya4; A. Lizarraga5
abstracts.affiliations: 1Department of Neurology, Ruhr University Bochum, BG University Hospital Bergmannsheil, Bochum, Germany; 2NSRO Department, University of Naples Federico II, Napoli, Italy; 3Department of Neurology and Neuromuscular Medicine, University of South Florida Morsani College of Medicine, Tampa, USA; 4Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease, Boston, MA, USA; 5Department of Neurology, University of Rochester, Rochester, USA
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Gefurulimab is a novel dual-binding nanobody complement component 5 inhibitor. Efficacy and safety of gefurulimab in adults with anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive (AChR-Ab+) generalised myasthenia gravis (gMG) were demonstrated in PREVAIL, a phase 3, randomised, placebo-controlled trial (NCT05556096). To provide a holistic view of the treatment effect, we present health-related (HR) quality of life (QoL) outcomes. Methods: Patients with AChR-Ab+ gMG were randomised to receive weekly subcutaneous self-injection of gefurulimab or placebo. Exploratory endpoints assessed HRQoL changes from baseline through wk26 (randomised period completion) using: MG-QOL 15-Item Questionnaire-Revised (MG-QOL15r); QoL in Neurological Disorders (Neuro-QoL) Fatigue Scale; EuroQol-5 Dimensions-5-Level (EQ-5D-5L) Visual Analogue Scale (VAS) and Health State Index (HSI). Results: Overall, 260 patients (female, 60.4%; mean ± SD age, 52.8 ± 15.7 yrs; mean ± SD baseline MG-ADL total score, 9.0 ± 2.2) were randomised to gefurulimab (n = 131) or placebo (n = 129). Significantly greater improvements were observed with gefurulimab compared with placebo, starting at wk4 in MG-QOL15r and Neuro-QoL Fatigue and wk8 in EQ-5D-5L. These improvements were sustained throughout the randomised period. At wk26, the least squares mean (95% CI) changes from baseline among patients with available data receiving gefu- rulimab (n = 123) vs placebo (n = 117) were −4.9 (−6.0, −3.8) vs −2.3 (−3.2, −1.4) (p = 0.0005) in MG-QOL15r; −4.8 (−6.2, −3.4) vs −2.5 (−3.8, −1.1) (p = 0.0164) in Neuro-QoL Fatigue; 9.2 (6.2, 12.1) vs 4.6 (1.6, 7.6) (p = 0.0349) in EQ-5D-5L VAS; 0.12 (0.076, 0.155) vs 0.04 (−0.004, 0.079) (p = 0.0088) in EQ-5D-5L HSI. Conclusion: In PREVAIL, patients with AChR-Ab+ gMG re- ceiving gefurulimab had significant improvements in HRQoL compared with those receiving placebo, demonstrated by MG- specific and general HRQoL measures.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：Gefurulimab是一种新型双结合纳米抗体补体成分5抑制剂。PREVAIL试验（NCT05556096）是一项3期、随机、安慰剂对照试验，证明了gefurulimab在抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）全身型重症肌无力（gMG）成人患者中的疗效和安全性。为了提供治疗效果的全面视角，我们展示了健康相关（HR）生活质量（QoL）结局。方法：AChR-Ab+ gMG患者被随机分配接受每周皮下自我注射gefurulimab或安慰剂。探索性终点评估了从基线到第26周（随机期结束）的HRQoL变化，使用：MG-QOL 15项问卷修订版（MG-QOL15r）；神经疾病QoL（Neuro-QoL）疲劳量表；EuroQol-5维度-5水平（EQ-5D-5L）视觉模拟量表（VAS）和健康状态指数（HSI）。结果：总体而言，260名患者（女性，60.4%；平均±SD年龄，52.8±15.7岁；平均±SD基线MG-ADL总分，9.0±2.2）被随机分配至gefurulimab组（n=131）或安慰剂组（n=129）。与安慰剂相比，gefurulimab组观察到显著更大的改善，从第4周开始体现在MG-QOL15r和Neuro-QoL疲劳量表，第8周开始体现在EQ-5D-5L。这些改善在整个随机期持续存在。在第26周，有可用数据的患者中，gefurulimab组（n=123）与安慰剂组（n=117）相比，从基线的最小二乘均值（95% CI）变化在MG-QOL15r中为-4.9（-6.0，-3.8）对比-2.3（-3.2，-1.4）（p=0.0005）；在Neuro-QoL疲劳量表中为-4.8（-6.2，-3.4）对比-2.5（-3.8，-1.1）（p=0.0164）；在EQ-5D-5L VAS中为9.2（6.2，12.1）对比4.6（1.6，7.6）（p=0.0349）；在EQ-5D-5L HSI中为0.12（0.076，0.155）对比0.04（-0.004，0.079）（p=0.0088）。结论：在PREVAIL试验中，接受gefurulimab治疗的AChR-Ab+ gMG患者与接受安慰剂的患者相比，在HRQoL方面有显著改善，这由MG特异性和一般HRQoL指标所证明。

abstracts.title: Myasthenia Gravis Inebilizumab Trial (MINT): Adverse events of special interest during the randomized controlled period (RCP)
abstracts.authors: R. Nowak1; K. Utsugisawa2; M. Benatar3; E. Ciafaloni4; M. Leite5; J. Vissing6; F. Tang7; B. Canales7; Q. Li7; S. Cheng7; J. Howard Jr.8

abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: B cells play a key upstream mechanis- tic role in autoimmune generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) pathogenesis through the production of antibodies targeting the acetylcholine receptor (AChR+), muscle-specific kinase (MuSK+), or other related proteins. Inebilizumab is a monoclo- nal antibody targeting CD19+ B cells. B-cell-depleting therapies may impair humoral responses, increase the risk of infec- tions and reduced response to vaccinations. Here we examine whether inebilizumab is associated with an increased risk of adverse events of special interest (AESIs) in gMG participants. Methods: MINT (NCT04524273) was a phase 3 trial in adults with gMG. During the RCP (52-weeks for AChR+; 26-weeks for MuSK+), participants were randomized (1:1) to receive 300mg of inebilizumab or placebo on Day-1, Day-15, and Day-183 (AChR+ only). Subsets of adverse events were identified as AESIs due to their relevance to inebilizumab's mechanism of action. Results: 238 patients were randomized: inebilizumab 119 (95 AChR+, 24 MuSK+), placebo 119 (95 AChR+, 24 MuSK+). Baseline demographics and disease characteristics were gen- erally balanced between treatment groups. AESIs were infre- quent, occurring in 10.1% (n = 12) of the inebilizumab- and 16% (n = 19) of the placebo-treated groups. Cytopenias occurred in 2.5% (n = 3) of inebilzumab-treated and 9.2% (n = 11) of placebo- treated participants. Serious and/or opportunistic infections were infrequent (inebilizumab: 3.4% [n = 4]; placebo: 5.0% [n = 6]), with COVID-19 being the most common (inebilizumab: 2/4; placebo: 3/6) and no instances of progressive multifocal leu- koencephalopathy. Infusion related reactions occurred in 5.0% (n = 6) of inebilizumab- and 2.5% (n = 3) of placebo-treated par- ticipants (Table 1). Conclusion: These results support a favorable safety profile of inebilizumab over a 26–52-week period.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：B细胞通过产生靶向乙酰胆碱受体（AChR+）、肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶（MuSK+）或其他相关蛋白的抗体，在自身免疫性全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的发病机制中发挥关键的上游机制作用。Inebilizumab是一种靶向CD19+ B细胞的单克隆抗体。B细胞耗竭疗法可能损害体液免疫反应，增加感染风险并降低对疫苗接种的反应。在此，我们检查inebilizumab是否与gMG参与者中特定不良事件（AESIs）风险增加相关。方法：MINT（NCT04524273）是一项在成人gMG中进行的3期试验。在随机对照期（RCP）（AChR+为52周；MuSK+为26周），参与者被随机分配（1:1）在第1天、第15天和第183天（仅AChR+）接受300mg inebilizumab或安慰剂。由于与inebilizumab作用机制的相关性，不良事件的子集被确定为AESIs。结果：238名患者被随机分配：inebilizumab组119人（95名AChR+，24名MuSK+），安慰剂组119人（95名AChR+，24名MuSK+）。治疗组之间的基线人口统计学和疾病特征总体平衡。AESIs不常见，发生在inebilizumab治疗组的10.1%（n=12）和安慰剂治疗组的16%（n=19）。血细胞减少发生在inebilizumab治疗组的2.5%（n=3）和安慰剂治疗组的9.2%（n=11）。严重和/或机会性感染不常见（inebilizumab：3.4% [n=4]；安慰剂：5.0% [n=6]），COVID-19最常见（inebilizumab：2/4；安慰剂：3/6），且无进行性多灶性白质脑病病例。输液相关反应发生在inebilizumab治疗组的5.0%（n=6）和安慰剂治疗组的2.5%（n=3）（表1）。结论：这些结果支持inebilizumab在26-52周期间具有良好的安全性特征。

abstracts.title: Quality of gravis patients achieving sustained versus transient clinical outcomes in the phase 3 vivacity-MG3 trial
abstracts.authors: J. Vissing1; C. Antozzi2; K. Gwathmey3; K. Gandhi4; I. Turkoz5; S. Pease6; N. Campbell4
abstracts.affiliations: 1University of Copenhagen, Copenhagen, Denmark; 2IRCCS Carlo Besta Neurological Institute Foundation, Milan, Italy; 3Virginia Commonwealth University, Richmond, USA; 4Johnson & Johnson, Horsham, USA; 5Johnson & Johnson, Titusville, USA; 6Johnson & Johnson, Raritan, USA
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Minimal clinically important im- provement in the Myasthenia-Gravis-Activities-of-Daily-Living (MG-ADL) score (MCI; ≥ 2-point improvement) or a composite response (CR) of ≥ 2-point improvement in MG-ADL and ≥ 3- point improvement in Quantitative-Myasthenia-Gravis scores are plausible treatment goals in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). This Vivacity-MG3 posthoc analysis evaluated health- related quality of life (HRQoL) in patients achieving sustained versus transient MCI or CR. Methods: Nipocalimab- and placebo-treated participants were stratified by MCI or CR status over the 24-week double-blind phase: never achieved MCI/CR (No-MCI/CR), achieved MCI/ CR sustained ≥8 weeks (sustained-MCI/CR), or achieved MCI/ CR ≥ 1 time but not sustained for ≥8 weeks (transient-MCI/CR). Mean changes from baseline (CFB) to week 24 (W24) in MGQoL- 15r and Neuro-QoL Fatigue scores were compared across groups using ANCOVA models. Results: The MCI analysis included 129 patients (91 sustained- MCI, 29 transient-MCI, 9 no-MCI) and the CR analysis included 125 patients (50 sustained-CR, 37 transient-CR, 38 no-CR). Sustained- versus transient-MCI patients demonstrated greater improvements in MGQoL-15r (least-square-mean CFB, −6.2 versus −2.0, p < 0.001). Additionally, the sustained-MCI group had greater improvements in Neuro-QoL Fatigue (−19.5) ver- sus transient-MCI (−7.5, p < 0.001) and No-MCI (−8.5, p = 0.04). Similarly, sustained-CR patients demonstrated greater improve- ments in MGQoL-15r (−9.6) versus transient-CR (−5.4, p < 0.001) and No-CR (−3.6, p < 0.001) and those with sustained-CR had greater improvements in Neuro-QoL Fatigue (−29.2) versus transient-CR (−16.4, p < 0.001) and No-CR (−12.2, p < 0.001). Conclusion: Patients achieving sustained versus transient MCI or CR demonstrated greater improvements in HRQoL and fatigue, suggesting 8-week sustained outcomes may be more impactful treatment goals than short-term transient response for gMG patients receiving advanced treatments.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：重症肌无力日常生活活动（MG-ADL）评分的最小临床重要改善（MCI；≥2分改善）或复合应答（CR；MG-ADL改善≥2分且定量重症肌无力评分改善≥3分）是全身型重症肌无力（gMG）合理的治疗目标。这项Vivacity-MG3事后分析评估了达到持续性与短暂性MCI或CR患者的健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）。方法：接受Nipocalimab和安慰剂治疗的参与者根据24周双盲期内的MCI或CR状态进行分层：从未达到MCI/CR（无MCI/CR），达到MCI/CR并持续≥8周（持续性MCI/CR），或达到MCI/CR≥1次但未持续≥8周（短暂性MCI/CR）。使用ANCOVA模型比较各组从基线到第24周（W24）的MGQoL-15r和Neuro-QoL疲劳评分的平均变化（CFB）。结果：MCI分析包括129名患者（91名持续性MCI，29名短暂性MCI，9名无MCI），CR分析包括125名患者（50名持续性CR，37名短暂性CR，38名无CR）。持续性MCI与短暂性MCI患者相比，在MGQoL-15r方面表现出更大的改善（最小二乘均值CFB，-6.2对比-2.0，p<0.001）。此外，持续性MCI组在Neuro-QoL疲劳方面有更大的改善（-19.5），对比短暂性MCI（-7.5，p<0.001）和无MCI（-8.5，p=0.04）。类似地，持续性CR患者在MGQoL-15r方面表现出更大的改善（-9.6），对比短暂性CR（-5.4，p<0.001）和无CR（-3.6，p<0.001），并且持续性CR患者在Neuro-QoL疲劳方面有更大的改善（-29.2），对比短暂性CR（-16.4，p<0.001）和无CR（-12.2，p<0.001）。结论：达到持续性而非短暂性MCI或CR的患者在HRQoL和疲劳方面表现出更大的改善，提示对于接受先进治疗的gMG患者，8周持续结局可能是比短期短暂应答更有影响力的治疗目标。

abstracts.title: Achievement of Minimal Symptom Expression in Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Receiving Zilucoplan: A 120-week Post Hoc Analysis of RAISE-XT
abstracts.authors: James F. Howard; Jr.; Saskia Bresch; Miriam Freimer; Maria Isabel Leite; Angelina Maniaol; Kimiaki Utsugisawa; Tuan Vu; Michael Weiss; Joel Baldwin; Babak Boroojerdi; Natasa Savic; Channa Hewamadduma
abstracts.affiliations: Chapel Hill, NC; Nice, France; Columbus, OH; Oxford, United Kingdom; Oslo, Norway; Hanamaki, Japan; Tampa, FL; Seattle, WA; Slough, United Kingdom; Monheim, Germany; Bulle, Switzerland; Sheffield, United Kingdom
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Minimal symptom expression (MSE; Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living [MG-ADL] score: 0 or 1) achievement is increasingly recognized as a treatment goal in myasthenia gravis (MG). OBJECTIVE: To assess (post hoc) baseline MG-ADL scores and subsequent MSE achievement in patients participating in RAISE-XT (NCT04225871, Phase 3), an open-label extension study of the complement component 5 inhibitor zilucoplan. METHODS: Adults with anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive generalized MG completing a qualifying double-blind, placebo-controlled study (NCT03315130/NCT04115293 [RAISE]) could enter RAISE-XT and self-administer once-daily subcutaneous zilucoplan 0.3mg/kg. Double-blind baseline MG-ADL scores in patients stratified by MSE achievement (defined in the protocol, without rescue therapy) while on zilucoplan up to Week 120 and time to MSE after initiating zilucoplan were assessed (cutoff: November 11, 2023). RESULTS: Of 200 patients enrolled in RAISE-XT, 183 received only zilucoplan 0.3mg/kg or placebo in the double-blind studies. The cumulative proportion of patients achieving MSE at any time from zilucoplan initiation to Week 120 was 63% (Kaplan–Meier analysis). Patients who achieved MSE had MG-ADL scores of 2–18 at double-blind baseline (mean [standard deviation]: 9.7 [3.0], n=102); patients not achieving MSE had scores of 6–19 (11.0 [2.9], n=81). MSE was first achieved as early as Week 1 after initiating zilucoplan. Within 12 weeks of initiating treatment, 58.8% (n/N=60/102) of patients had achieved MSE. Treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 97.0% (n/N=194/200) of patients; most mild/moderate. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Patients with a broad range of baseline MG-ADL scores achieved MSE during zilucoplan treatment, with some achieving MSE as early as one week after initiation. Funding: UCB.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：最小症状表达（MSE；重症肌无力日常生活活动量表[MG-ADL]评分：0或1）的实现日益被认为是重症肌无力（MG）的治疗目标。目的：事后评估参与RAISE-XT（NCT04225871，3期）患者的基线MG-ADL评分及随后MSE实现情况，该研究为补体成分5抑制剂zilucoplan的开放标签扩展研究。方法：完成合格的双盲、安慰剂对照研究（NCT03315130/NCT04115293[RAISE]）的抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性全身型MG成人患者可进入RAISE-XT，自行每日一次皮下注射zilucoplan 0.3mg/kg。评估双盲基线MG-ADL评分（按使用zilucoplan至第120周期间MSE实现情况分层，MSE按方案定义、无挽救治疗）及开始zilucoplan后至MSE的时间（截止日期：2023年11月11日）。结果：RAISE-XT入组200例患者中，183例在双盲研究中仅接受zilucoplan 0.3mg/kg或安慰剂。从开始zilucoplan至第120周任何时间达到MSE的累积比例为63%（Kaplan–Meier分析）。达到MSE的患者双盲基线MG-ADL评分为2–18（均值[标准差]：9.7[3.0]，n=102）；未达到MSE的患者评分为6–19（11.0[2.9]，n=81）。MSE最早在开始zilucoplan后第1周即实现。开始治疗后12周内，58.8%（n/N=60/102）的患者达到MSE。治疗中出现的不良事件发生于97.0%（n/N=194/200）的患者；大多为轻/中度。总结/结论：基线MG-ADL评分范围广泛的患者在zilucoplan治疗期间达到MSE，部分患者在开始治疗后最早一周即达到MSE。资助：UCB。

abstracts.title: Assessing Relationship between Immunoglobulin G-levels and Infection Rate in Nipocalimab-treated Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis (VIVACITY-MG3)
abstracts.authors: Ghazala Hayat; Ricardo Rojo Cella; Robert Edwards; Marie Fitzgibbon; Robert Gordon; Wim Noel; Zia Choudhry; Kavita Gandhi; Sindhu Ramchandren; Kevin Winthrop; Carlo Antozzi
abstracts.affiliations: Saint Louis, MO; Spring House, PA; Raritan, NJ; Beerse, Belgium; Horsham, PA; Titusville, NJ; Portland, OR; Milan, Italy
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In the phase 3 Vivacity-MG3 study, nipocalimab+standard-of-care (SOC) resulted in median IgG reduction of –69% at week 24, with rapid and sustained disease control over 24 weeks in a broad population of antibody-positive patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), and was well-tolerated with an acceptable safety profile. Overall incidence of infection was similar between nipocalimab and placebo groups (43% each). OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether there is a relationship between reduced IgG levels and infection rates in patients with gMG treated with nipocalimab+SOC across the double-blind phase of Vivacity-MG3. METHODS: Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) analysis was conducted to assess whether IgG levels (evaluated as a continuous variable) were associated with infection rates in patients from Vivacity-MG3. Area-Under- the-Curve (AUC) values were calculated using logistic regression ROC analysis with treatment group, maximum change from baseline in IgG, and baseline IgG as covariates. AUC values range from 0–1, with 0.5–≤0.7 indicating no/poor discrimination (equivalent to chance/poor discrimination) and higher values reflecting predictive association (≥0.8–≤0.9, excellent). RESULTS: ROC analysis showed AUC (standard error) for patients with lowest post-baseline level of IgG ≤5 g/L (N=94, 105.5 patient-years-of-exposure): 0.51 (0.062); ≤4 g/L (N=87, 97.9 patient-years-of-exposure): 0.52 (0.064); ≤3 g/L (N=74, 72.4 patient-years-of-exposure): 0.53 (0.070); ≤2 g/L (N=44, 30.0 patient-years-of-exposure): 0.69 (0.082). These values indicate no real predictive association between reduced IgG levels (as low as ≤2 g/L) and infection rates. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: These results show no association of infection occurrence with lowering IgG levels in nipocalimab-treated patients with gMG in Vivacity-MG3.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在3期Vivacity-MG3研究中，nipocalimab+标准治疗（SOC）使第24周IgG中位降低–69%，在广泛的抗体阳性全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者人群中实现24周内快速且持续的疾病控制，且耐受良好、安全性可接受。nipocalimab组与安慰剂组总体感染发生率相似（各43%）。目的：评估Vivacity-MG3双盲阶段接受nipocalimab+SOC治疗的gMG患者中IgG水平降低与感染率之间是否存在关系。方法：采用受试者工作特征（ROC）分析评估Vivacity-MG3患者中IgG水平（作为连续变量评估）是否与感染率相关。曲线下面积（AUC）值通过逻辑回归ROC分析计算，协变量包括治疗组、IgG自基线最大变化和基线IgG。AUC值范围为0–1，0.5–≤0.7表示无/差判别（相当于随机/差判别），更高值反映预测关联（≥0.8–≤0.9，优秀）。结果：ROC分析显示，基线后最低IgG水平≤5 g/L患者（N=94，105.5患者年暴露）的AUC（标准误）为0.51（0.062）；≤4 g/L（N=87，97.9患者年暴露）为0.52（0.064）；≤3 g/L（N=74，72.4患者年暴露）为0.53（0.070）；≤2 g/L（N=44，30.0患者年暴露）为0.69（0.082）。这些值表明IgG水平降低（低至≤2 g/L）与感染率之间无实际预测关联。总结/结论：这些结果表明，在Vivacity-MG3中接受nipocalimab治疗的gMG患者中，感染发生与IgG水平降低无关联。

abstracts.title: Assessment of Sustained Health-related Quality of Life in Phase 3 VIVACITY-MG3 Trial of Nipocalimab versus Placebo in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: John Vissing; Kavita Gandhi; Sheryl Pease; Ibrahim Turkoz; Marie Fitzgibbon; Geoffroy Coteur; Wisam Karmous; Nolan Campbell; Sindhu Ramchandren; Elena Cortés- Vicente
abstracts.affiliations: Copenhagen, Denmark; Horsham, PA; Raritan, NJ; Titusville, NJ; Wemmel, Belgium; Issy-les-Moulineaux, France; Barcelona, Spain
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), an autoantibody-mediated disease, causes fluctuating muscle symptoms and substantially impairs health-related quality-of-life (HRQoL). In Vivacity-MG3 (NCT04951622), nipocalimab+standard-of-care (SOC) demonstrated improved and sustained disease control versus placebo +SOC. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the changes in HRQoL during the 24 week (W) double-blind phase using patient-reported measures, MGQoL-15r and EQ-5D visual analogue scale (EQ-5D-VAS). METHODS: Mean change-from-baseline (CFB) between groups in MGQoL-15r and EQ-5D-VAS over 24W were compared using ANCOVA models. Meaningful-within- person-improvement (MWPI) response was a change of one-half a standard deviation on MGQoL-15r (≥4-points) and EQ-5D-VAS (≥10-points). Proportion of patients achieving MWPI and time-to-MWPI over 24W were examined using Chi-square test and Kaplan-Meier analyses. Logistic regression evaluated likelihood of achieving MWPI over 24W and sustaining MWPI for ≥8,12,16, and 20W between groups. RESULTS: LS-mean (95% CI) difference in CFB on MGQoL-15r and EQ-5D-VAS was greater with nipocalimab+SOC versus placebo+SOC (−1.38 [−3.14,0.37], not significant [ns] and 6.86[2.07,11.66],p<0.05, respectively) at 4W and sustained (−1.61[−3.55,0.33], ns; 6.47[1.05,11.88],p<0.05) at 24W. At 24W, 67.2% (45/67) versus 56.5% (35/62) achieved MWPI on MGQoL-15r (absolute difference=10.7%[ns]) and 55.2% (37/67) versus 37.1% (23/62) patients achieved MWPI on EQ-5D-VAS (absolute difference=18.1%[p<0.05]) in nipocalimab+SOC versus placebo+SOC. For both measures, nipocalimab+SOC patients were twice as likely to achieve MWPI over 24W with median time-to-response approximately 4W versus 8W with placebo+SOC (p<0.05). Similarly, nipocalimab +SOC patients were approximately twice as likely to sustain MWPI for ≥8,12,16,20W (p<0.05) in both measures. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Nipocalimab+SOC-treated patients achieved meaningful HRQoL improvements as early as 4W and were significantly more likely to achieve and sustain these improvements over 24W versus placebo +SOC.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种自身抗体介导的疾病，导致波动的肌肉症状并显著损害健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）。在Vivacity-MG3（NCT04951622）中，nipocalimab+标准治疗（SOC）与安慰剂+SOC相比显示出改善且持续的疾病控制。目的：使用患者报告的量表MGQoL-15r和EQ-5D视觉模拟量表（EQ-5D-VAS）评估24周（W）双盲期内HRQoL的变化。方法：使用ANCOVA模型比较两组间MGQoL-15r和EQ-5D-VAS在24周内的平均基线变化（CFB）。个体内有意义改善（MWPI）应答定义为MGQoL-15r变化达半个标准差（≥4分）和EQ-5D-VAS（≥10分）。使用卡方检验和Kaplan-Meier分析检查24周内达到MWPI的患者比例和达到MWPI的时间。Logistic回归评估两组间在24周内达到MWPI及维持MWPI≥8、12、16和20周的可能性。结果：在4周时，nipocalimab+SOC与安慰剂+SOC相比，MGQoL-15r和EQ-5D-VAS的CFB的LS均值（95% CI）差异更大（分别为−1.38[−3.14,0.37]，无统计学显著性[ns]和6.86[2.07,11.66]，p<0.05），并在24周时持续（−1.61[−3.55,0.33]，ns；6.47[1.05,11.88]，p<0.05）。在24周时，nipocalimab+SOC与安慰剂+SOC相比，分别有67.2%（45/67）对56.5%（35/62）的患者在MGQoL-15r上达到MWPI（绝对差异=10.7%[ns]），以及55.2%（37/67）对37.1%（23/62）的患者在EQ-5D-VAS上达到MWPI（绝对差异=18.1%[p<0.05]）。对于两项量表，nipocalimab+SOC患者在24周内达到MWPI的可能性是安慰剂+SOC的两倍，中位应答时间约为4周对8周（p<0.05）。同样，nipocalimab+SOC患者在两项量表上维持MWPI≥8、12、16、20周的可能性约为两倍（p<0.05）。总结/结论：接受nipocalimab+SOC治疗的患者早在4周即获得有意义的HRQoL改善，并且与安慰剂+SOC相比，在24周内达到和维持这些改善的可能性显著更高。

abstracts.authors: Chioma Ezenduka; Paolo Emilio Alboini; Silvia Falso; Rita Frangiamore; Matteo Gastaldi; Melania Guida; Solange Kapetanovic Garcia; Nicasio Rini; Carmelo Rodolico; Elena Rossini; Sabrina Sacconi; Guilhem Solé; Karin Annoni; Kerina Bonar; Grégory Chollet

abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is a chronic autoimmune disease. MycarinG (Phase 3/NCT03971422) and its open-label extension studies (MG0004/NCT04124965 and MG0007/NCT04650854) demonstrated the efficacy of repeated cyclic rozanolixizumab treatment in patients with gMG. Managed Access Programs (MAPs) enable pre-authorization treatment for patients with severe/debilitating/life- threatening conditions, where available treatments are deemed inadequate. OBJECTIVE: To describe rozanolixizumab utilization patterns and patient characteristics in MAPs initiated under compassionate use in France, Italy and Spain. METHODS: This observational, retrospective, longitudinal cohort study included adults with gMG who initiated rozanolixizumab treatment in MAPs in France, Italy and Spain (November 2022–May 2025). Baseline demographics and disease characteristics at treatment initiation were described. Change from baseline in myasthenia gravis (MG)-specific outcomes were assessed when available. All analyses were descriptive. RESULTS: Overall, twelve patients from France, 16 from Italy and <5 from Spain were included; most were female (58.3%, 87.5% and 50.0%, respectively). Mean (standard deviation [SD]) age was 73.7 (14.6), 53.8 (14.0) and 61.5 (16.5) years, respectively. Additional data were available for Italy: mean (SD) disease duration was 10.8 (10.6) years; 43.8% of patients had an MG diagnosis <5 years and baseline (mean [SD]) MG-Activities of Daily Living score was 7.4 (2.6). In the two years pre-enrollment, MG crises and MG-related hospitalizations occurred in 6.3% and 43.8% of patients respectively. Pre-enrollment, 56.3% of patients received pyridostigmine; all received corticosteroids. Treatment outcomes data will be presented in the poster. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Patient baseline characteristics in the rozanolixizumab MAPs were indicative of a population with moderate-to-severe gMG. Funding: UCB.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种慢性自身免疫性疾病。MycarinG（3期/NCT03971422）及其开放标签扩展研究（MG0004/NCT04124965和MG0007/NCT04650854）证明了rozanolixizumab重复周期治疗在gMG患者中的疗效。管理获取项目（MAPs）允许在现有治疗被认为不充分的严重/致残/危及生命状况的患者中获得授权前治疗。目的：描述在法国、意大利和西班牙因同情用药启动的MAPs中rozanolixizumab的使用模式和患者特征。方法：这项观察性、回顾性、纵向队列研究纳入在法国、意大利和西班牙MAPs中启动rozanolixizumab治疗的成人gMG患者（2022年11月至2025年5月）。描述治疗启动时的基线人口学和疾病特征。在可获得时评估重症肌无力（MG）特异性结局的基线变化。所有分析均为描述性。结果：总体纳入法国12例、意大利16例和西班牙<5例患者；大多数为女性（分别为58.3%、87.5%和50.0%）。平均（标准差[SD]）年龄分别为73.7（14.6）、53.8（14.0）和61.5（16.5）岁。意大利有额外数据：平均（SD）病程为10.8（10.6）年；43.8%的患者MG诊断<5年，基线（平均[SD]）MG-日常生活活动评分为7.4（2.6）。在入组前两年内，分别有6.3%和43.8%的患者发生MG危象和MG相关住院。入组前，56.3%的患者接受吡啶斯的明；所有患者均接受皮质类固醇。治疗结局数据将在海报中展示。总结/结论：rozanolixizumab MAPs中的患者基线特征表明该人群为中重度gMG。资助：UCB。

abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In RAISE (Phase 3/NCT04115293) and its open-label extension (RAISE-XT/NCT04225871), zilucoplan demonstrated myasthenia gravis (MG)-specific outcome improvement in patients with generalized MG (gMG). Managed Access Programs (MAPs) enable pre- authorization treatment for patients with a severe/debilitating/life-threatening condition, where available treatments are deemed inadequate and no clinical trials are available. OBJECTIVE: Describe zilucoplan utilization patterns and patient characteristics in MAPs initiated under compassionate use/early access authorization in France, and compassionate use in Italy/Spain. METHODS: This cohort study included adults with gMG initiating zilucoplan in MAPs in France, Italy and Spain (December 2021–November 2024). Patient demographics and disease characteristics were described. RESULTS: 57 patients from France, 32 from Italy and <5 from Spain were included; most were female (50.9%, 65.6% and 75.0%, respectively). Mean (standard deviation [SD]) age was 56.5 (19.8), 57.8 (14.9) and 48.8 (13.6) years, respectively. Additional data were available for France and Italy. Mean (SD) disease duration was 8.7 (9.2) and 11.6 (10.2) years; 42.1% and 28.1% of patients, respectively, had an MG diagnosis <5 years. Baseline mean (SD) MG-Activities of Daily Living scores were 7.3 (4.7) and 9.2 (3.6), respectively. In the two years prior to enrollment, MG crises and MG-related hospitalizations occurred in 57.9% and 9.4%, and 80.7% and 43.8% of patients, respectively. Pre-enrollment, 73.7% and 96.9% of patients received pyridostigmine, and 75.4% and 100% received corticosteroids, respectively. Treatment outcomes will be presented in the poster. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Patients with gMG who entered zilucoplan MAPs had a long disease duration and high prior hospitalization and crisis, reflecting a large unmet need. Funding: UCB.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在RAISE（3期/NCT04115293）及其开放标签扩展（RAISE-XT/NCT04225871）中，zilucoplan在全身型MG（gMG）患者中显示出MG特异性结局改善。管理获取项目（MAPs）允许在现有治疗被认为不充分且无临床试验可用的严重/致残/危及生命状况患者中获得授权前治疗。目的：描述在法国因同情用药/早期获取授权、在意大利/西班牙因同情用药启动的MAPs中zilucoplan的使用模式和患者特征。方法：这项队列研究纳入在法国、意大利和西班牙MAPs中启动zilucoplan治疗的成人gMG患者（2021年12月至2024年11月）。描述患者人口学和疾病特征。结果：纳入法国57例、意大利32例和西班牙<5例患者；大多数为女性（分别为50.9%、65.6%和75.0%）。平均（标准差[SD]）年龄分别为56.5（19.8）、57.8（14.9）和48.8（13.6）岁。法国和意大利有额外数据。平均（SD）病程分别为8.7（9.2）和11.6（10.2）年；分别有42.1%和28.1%的患者MG诊断<5年。基线平均（SD）MG-日常生活活动评分分别为7.3（4.7）和9.2（3.6）。在入组前两年内，MG危象和MG相关住院分别发生于57.9%和9.4%、以及80.7%和43.8%的患者。入组前，分别有73.7%和96.9%的患者接受吡啶斯的明，75.4%和100%接受皮质类固醇。治疗结局将在海报中展示。总结/结论：进入zilucoplan MAPs的gMG患者病程长且既往住院和危象发生率高，反映存在大量未满足需求。资助：UCB。

abstracts.title: Clinical Deterioration, Rescue Therapy, and Hospitalization among Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis (gMG): Results from the Prevail Trial of Gefurulimab
abstracts.authors: James Winkley; Raghav Govindarajan; Nicholas Streicher; Gino Gialdini; Shulian Shang; Sanjay Rakhade; Djillali Annane
abstracts.affiliations: Lexington, KY; Washington, DC; Boston, MA; Garches, France
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In PREVAIL, gefurulimab, a novel dual- binding nanobody that blocks complement component 5 activation, showed early and sustained efficacy in adults with anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive (AChR- Ab+) gMG. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the incidence of clinical deteriorations, rescue therapies, and gMG-related hospitalizations during the randomized controlled treatment (RCT) period of PREVAIL. METHODS: PREVAIL is a 26-week, global, phase 3, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial evaluating the efficacy and safety of gefurulimab in adults with AChR-Ab+ gMG. Patients were randomized 1:1 to weekly subcutaneous self-administration of gefurulimab or placebo. Rescue therapies, including plasma exchange/plasmapheresis, intravenous immunoglobulins, or high-dose corticosteroids, were allowed. Incidence of protocol-defined clinical deteriorations, gMG-related hospitalizations, and rescue therapy use during the RCT period were assessed. RESULTS: 260 patients (female, 60.4%; mean [SD] age at first dose, 52.8 [15.7] years) were randomized (gefurulimab, n=131; placebo, n=129). Demographics and baseline characteristics were balanced between groups. Protocol-defined clinical deteriorations were reported in 9 (6.9%) and 18 (14.0%) patients receiving gefurulimab and placebo (odds ratio [OR] [95% CI]=0.45 [0.19-1.04]; P=0.061), with 0 and 2 (1.6%) patients experiencing gMG- related respiratory failure, respectively. Rescue therapy was administered to 7 (5.3%) patients in the gefurulimab group and 16 (12.4%) in the placebo group (OR [95% CI]=0.39 [0.17-1.00]; P=0.049). gMG-related hospitalization occurred in 3 (2.3%) patients receiving gefurulimab and 12 (9.3%) receiving placebo (OR [95% CI]=0.22 [0.06-0.81]; P=0.023). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: During the PREVAIL RCT period, gefurulimab reduced the risks of gMG-related hospitalizations and needing rescue therapy, with a trend towards reduction in clinical deterioration.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在PREVAIL中，gefurulimab——一种阻断补体成分5激活的新型双结合纳米抗体——在抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）gMG成人中显示出早期且持续的疗效。目的：评估PREVAIL随机对照治疗（RCT）期内临床恶化、挽救治疗和gMG相关住院的发生率。方法：PREVAIL是一项26周、全球、3期、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验，评估gefurulimab在AChR-Ab+ gMG成人中的疗效和安全性。患者按1:1随机分配至每周皮下自我注射gefurulimab或安慰剂。允许挽救治疗，包括血浆置换/血浆分离、静脉注射免疫球蛋白或大剂量皮质类固醇。评估RCT期内方案定义的临床恶化、gMG相关住院和挽救治疗使用的发生率。结果：260例患者（女性60.4%；首次给药时平均[SD]年龄52.8[15.7]岁）被随机分配（gefurulimab，n=131；安慰剂，n=129）。两组人口学和基线特征均衡。接受gefurulimab和安慰剂的患者中分别报告9例（6.9%）和18例（14.0%）方案定义的临床恶化（比值比[OR][95% CI]=0.45[0.19-1.04]；P=0.061），分别有0例和2例（1.6%）患者发生gMG相关呼吸衰竭。gefurulimab组7例（5.3%）和安慰剂组16例（12.4%）接受挽救治疗（OR[95% CI]=0.39[0.17-1.00]；P=0.049）。接受gefurulimab的3例（2.3%）和接受安慰剂的12例（9.3%）患者发生gMG相关住院（OR[95% CI]=0.22[0.06-0.81]；P=0.023）。总结/结论：在PREVAIL RCT期内，gefurulimab降低了gMG相关住院和需要挽救治疗的风险，并呈临床恶化减少的趋势。

abstracts.title: Clinical Determinants of new Rozanolixizumab Cycles in Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: A Post Hoc Analysis of the Phase 3 Mycaring and Open-label Extension Studies
abstracts.authors: Zabeen Mahuwala; Ali Habib; Robert Pascuzzi; Sabrina Sacconi; John Vissing; Tuan Vu; Bethany George; Thais Tarancon
abstracts.affiliations: Lexington, KY; Orange, CA; Indianapolis, IN; Nice, France; Copenhagen, Denmark; Tampa, FL; Slough, United Kingdom; Madrid, Spain
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (MG) is a chronic and debilitating autoimmune disease. In the Phase 3 MycarinG study (NCT03971422), one 6-week cycle of rozanolixizumab, a neonatal Fc receptor blocker, significantly improved MG Activities of Daily Living (MG- ADL) and Quantitative MG (QMG) scores versus placebo. OBJECTIVE: To understand factors leading to initiation of a new rozanolixizumab cycle during long-term rozanolixizumab treatment. METHODS: After MycarinG, patients could enroll in open- label extension studies MG0004 (NCT04124965) then MG0007 (NCT04650854), or MG0007 directly. In MG0007, new rozanolixizumab cycles were initiated at the investigators’ discretion, with advisory protocol guidance to consider a new cycle upon ≥2-point MG-ADL or ≥3-point QMG score increase. MG-ADL and QMG score changes from Day 43 in the previous cycle to baseline of the new cycle (up to Cycle 13) were analyzed post hoc in patients receiving or awaiting a new cycle after initial rozanolixizumab treatment. RESULTS: Overall, 908 cycles from 147 patients were analyzed. New rozanolixizumab cycles were initiated following a mean (standard deviation) score worsening of 3.8 (3.3) for MG-ADL and 4.9 (4.6) for QMG. In total, 619/908 (68.2%) and 557/908 (61.3%) cycles were initiated having met the definition of MG-ADL and QMG score worsening, respectively. Initiation of new cycles followed worsening on either or both scales in 694/908 (76.4%) cycles, and on neither scale in 140/908 (15.4%) cycles. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: New cycles of rozanolixizumab were generally initiated following deterioration in MG-ADL and/or QMG scores. However, some patients received additional cycles without meeting suggested initiation thresholds, suggesting physician-led treatment individualization based on patient needs. Funding: UCB.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型肌无力（MG）是一种慢性且致残的自身免疫性疾病。在3期MycarinG研究（NCT03971422）中，一个6周周期的rozanolixizumab（一种新生儿Fc受体阻断剂）与安慰剂相比显著改善了MG日常生活活动（MG-ADL）和定量MG（QMG）评分。目的：了解在长期rozanolixizumab治疗期间启动新的rozanolixizumab周期的因素。方法：在MycarinG之后，患者可入组开放标签扩展研究MG0004（NCT04124965）继而MG0007（NCT04650854），或直接入组MG0007。在MG0007中，新的rozanolixizumab周期由研究者酌情启动，方案建议性指导为当MG-ADL评分增加≥2分或QMG评分增加≥3分时考虑启动新周期。对接受或等待新周期的患者在初始rozanolixizumab治疗后，从上一周期第43天至新周期基线（至第13周期）的MG-ADL和QMG评分变化进行事后分析。结果：总体分析了来自147例患者的908个周期。新的rozanolixizumab周期启动前MG-ADL平均（标准差）评分恶化3.8（3.3），QMG平均（标准差）评分恶化4.9（4.6）。总计619/908（68.2%）和557/908（61.3%）个周期分别在符合MG-ADL和QMG评分恶化定义的情况下启动。在694/908（76.4%）个周期中，新周期的启动伴随任一或两个量表恶化，而在140/908（15.4%）个周期中两个量表均未恶化。总结/结论：新的rozanolixizumab周期通常在MG-ADL和/或QMG评分恶化后启动。然而，部分患者未达到建议的启动阈值仍接受了额外周期，提示医生根据患者需求进行个体化治疗。资助：UCB。

abstracts.title: Corticosteroid Usage in Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Receiving Nipocalimab: Phase 3 VIVACITY-MG3 Open-label Extension
abstracts.authors: Yuebing Li; Kavita Gandhi; Wisam Karmous; Marie Fitzgibbon; Ibrahim Turkoz; I-Ching Tsai; Zia Choudhry; Wim Noel; Louis Jackson; Sindhu Ramchandren; Hiroyuki Murai
abstracts.affiliations: Cleveland, OH; Horsham, PA; Issy-les-Moulineaux, France; Raritan, NJ; Titusville, NJ; Singapore, Singapore; Beerse, Belgium; Narita, Japan
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab demonstrated sustained disease control in patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) during the 24-week double-blind phase (versus placebo) and through Week-60 of the open-label extension (OLE) phase of Vivacity-MG3 (NCT04951622). OBJECTIVE: To characterize corticosteroid usage, patterns of corticosteroid dose reduction/discontinuation, and symptom improvements among nipocalimab-treated patients with gMG during the Vivacity-MG3 OLE. METHODS: Corticosteroid dose reductions to ≤20,≤15,≤10,≤7.5, and ≤5mg/day prednisone-equivalent were evaluated through OLE data cut-off. Among patients on a low corticosteroid dose (≤10 or ≤5mg/day), proportions achieving meaningful clinical improvement (MCI; ≥2-point improvement of MG-Activities of Daily Living [MG-ADL]), minimum symptoms expression (MSE; MG-ADL score=0/1), and sustaining these for ≥8-weeks were evaluated. RESULTS: Of 89 patients receiving corticosteroids at OLE baseline (placebo/nipocalimab:44[49%], nipocalimab/nipocalimab:45[51%]), 45% reduced/discontinued corticosteroids by data cut-off; mean steroid dose reduced from 23 to 10mg/day prednisone- equivalent. By OLE data cut-off, 85.4%,71.9%,60.7%,41.6%, and 33.7%, of patients were on ≤20,≤15,≤10,≤7.5, and ≤5mg/day prednisone- equivalents, respectively. Among those on ≤10mg/day (n=54), MCI and MSE were achieved by 98.1%(n=53) and 44.4%(n=24) respectively, and sustained for ≥8-weeks by 94.4%(n=51) and 24.1%(n=13), respectively. For those on ≤5mg/day(n=30), MCI and MSE were achieved by 100.0%(n=30) and 60.0%(n=18), respectively, and sustained for ≥8-weeks by 93.3%(n=28) and 33.3%(n=10), respectively. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: By OLE data cut-off, nearly half of patients receiving corticosteroids at baseline reduced/discontinued corticosteroids. A substantial proportion of patients who were on low dose corticosteroid (≤10 or ≤5mg/day) during the OLE sustained MCI and/or MSE for ≥8-weeks. Results support the corticosteroid- sparing effect of nipocalimab and concurrent meaningful clinical improvement and sustained disease control in nipocalimab-treated patients with gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在Vivacity-MG3（NCT04951622）的24周双盲期（对照安慰剂）及开放标签扩展（OLE）期至第60周，nipocalimab在全身型肌无力（gMG）患者中显示出持续疾病控制。目的：描述Vivacity-MG3 OLE期间接受nipocalimab治疗的gMG患者中糖皮质激素使用情况、糖皮质激素减量/停药模式及症状改善。方法：截至OLE数据截止日期，评估糖皮质激素减量至≤20、≤15、≤10、≤7.5和≤5 mg/天泼尼松等效剂量的情况。在低糖皮质激素剂量（≤10或≤5 mg/天）患者中，评估达到有意义临床改善（MCI；MG-日常生活活动[MG-ADL]改善≥2分）、最低症状表达（MSE；MG-ADL评分=0/1）并维持≥8周的比例。结果：在OLE基线时接受糖皮质激素的89例患者中（安慰剂/nipocalimab：44例[49%]，nipocalimab/nipocalimab：45例[51%]），截至数据截止日期45%减量/停用糖皮质激素；平均激素剂量从23 mg/天降至10 mg/天泼尼松等效剂量。截至OLE数据截止日期，分别有85.4%、71.9%、60.7%、41.6%和33.7%的患者使用≤20、≤15、≤10、≤7.5和≤5 mg/天泼尼松等效剂量。在≤10 mg/天者（n=54）中，分别有98.1%（n=53）和44.4%（n=24）达到MCI和MSE，并分别有94.4%（n=51）和24.1%（n=13）维持≥8周。在≤5 mg/天者（n=30）中，分别有100.0%（n=30）和60.0%（n=18）达到MCI和MSE，并分别有93.3%（n=28）和33.3%（n=10）维持≥8周。总结/结论：截至OLE数据截止日期，基线时接受糖皮质激素的患者中近半数减量/停用糖皮质激素。在OLE期间使用低剂量糖皮质激素（≤10或≤5 mg/天）的患者中，相当比例维持MCI和/或MSE≥8周。结果支持nipocalimab的糖皮质激素节约效应，以及接受nipocalimab治疗的gMG患者同时获得有意义的临床改善和持续疾病控制。

abstracts.title: Corticosteroid Use in Nipocalimab-treated Japanese Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Phase 3 VIVACITY-MG3 Open-label Extension Study
abstracts.authors: Carlo Antozzi; Kavita Gandhi; Ibrahim Turkoz; Michael Kutch; Marie Fitzgibbon; Sindhu Ramchandren; Hiroyuki Murai
abstracts.affiliations: Milan, Italy; Horsham, PA; Titusville, NJ; Chesterbrook, PA; Raritan, NJ; Narita, Japan
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In seropositive adults with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), nipocalimab treatment (nipocalimab+standard-of-care [SOC]) vs placebo+SOC achieved sustained disease control during the 24-week Vivacity-MG3 study (NCT04951622) double-blind phase that was maintained through open-label extension (OLE) week 60. In Japan, achieving minimal gMG symptoms with low corticosteroid doses (target: ≤5mg/day) is an important treatment goal. OBJECTIVE: To characterize the impact of nipocalimab on corticosteroid use in Japanese patients in the Vivacity- MG3 OLE phase. METHODS: Corticosteroid doses (mg/day prednisone- equivalent) were evaluated through OLE data cutoff (Aug 2024) in 89 patients (Japanese, 11; non-Japanese, 78) receiving steroids at OLE baseline. Among patients who reduced corticosteroid dose (≤5mg/day), the proportion achieving minimum symptom expression (MSE) was determined. RESULTS: Of 11 Japanese patients receiving corticosteroids at OLE baseline, 7/11 (64%) receiving nipocalimab in OLE reduced/discontinued corticosteroids at data cutoff; of these, 5/7 (71%) reached ≤5mg/day. Among steroid reducers in Japan, mean (SD) steroid dose reduced from 10.4 (2.32) to 5.6 (2.82) mg/day prednisone- equivalent and 4/7 (57%) achieved MSE within 48 weeks. In non-Japanese patients, steroid reduction was achieved by 33/78 (42%) patients including 12/33 (36%) reaching ≤5mg/day and the dose was reduced from 25.1 (20.53) to 11.2 (10.50) mg/day prednisone equivalent; MSE within 48 weeks was achieved by 14/33 (42%). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In OLE, over half of Japanese patients reduced/discontinued corticosteroids with substantial proportions tapering to low-dose corticosteroid (≤5mg/day) and achieving MSE within 48 weeks. These results are consistent with the overall population where almost half of patients receiving corticosteroids at baseline reduced/discontinued steroids and showed sustained disease control with nipocalimab.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在血清阳性的全身型肌无力（gMG）成人患者中，nipocalimab治疗（nipocalimab+标准治疗[SOC]）与安慰剂+SOC相比，在24周Vivacity-MG3研究（NCT04951622）双盲期达到持续疾病控制，并在开放标签扩展（OLE）第60周维持。在日本，以低糖皮质激素剂量（目标：≤5 mg/天）实现gMG最低症状是重要治疗目标。目的：描述Vivacity-MG3 OLE期日本患者中nipocalimab对糖皮质激素使用的影响。方法：截至OLE数据截止日期（2024年8月），评估OLE基线时接受激素治疗的89例患者（日本11例；非日本78例）的糖皮质激素剂量（mg/天泼尼松等效）。在减量至≤5 mg/天糖皮质激素的患者中，确定达到最低症状表达（MSE）的比例。结果：在OLE基线时接受糖皮质激素的11例日本患者中，7/11（64%）在OLE中接受nipocalimab并在数据截止时减量/停用糖皮质激素；其中5/7（71%）达到≤5 mg/天。在日本减量者中，平均（标准差）激素剂量从10.4（2.32）降至5.6（2.82）mg/天泼尼松等效，4/7（57%）在48周内达到MSE。在非日本患者中，33/78（42%）实现激素减量，其中12/33（36%）达到≤5 mg/天，剂量从25.1（20.53）降至11.2（10.50）mg/天泼尼松等效；14/33（42%）在48周内达到MSE。总结/结论：在OLE中，超过半数日本患者减量/停用糖皮质激素，相当比例减至低剂量糖皮质激素（≤5 mg/天）并在48周内达到MSE。这些结果与总体人群一致，总体人群中基线接受糖皮质激素者近半数减量/停药，并在nipocalimab治疗下显示持续疾病控制。

abstracts.title: Effect of Rozanolixizumab on Ocular Symptoms in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Analysis of Phase 3 Studies
abstracts.authors: Zabeen Mahuwala; Elena Cortés-Vicente; Ali Habib; Robert Pascuzzi; John Vissing; Tuan Vu; Jos Bloemers; Paul Mahoney; Thais Tarancon; Vera Bril
abstracts.affiliations: Lexington, KY; Barcelona, Spain; Orange, CA; Indianapolis, IN; Copenhagen, Denmark; Tampa, FL; Breda, Netherlands; Slough, United Kingdom; Madrid, Spain; Toronto, Canada
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (MG) may cause disabling ocular symptoms (e.g., diplopia, ptosis). The Phase 3 MycarinG study (NCT03971422) demonstrated greater improvements in ocular symptoms after one 6-week cycle of rozanolixizumab versus placebo in patients with generalized MG. OBJECTIVE: Investigate (post hoc) the effect of repeated rozanolixizumab cycles on ocular symptoms, using data from MycarinG and its open-label extensions (MG0004, MG0007). METHODS: In MG0004 (NCT04124965), patients received once-weekly rozanolixizumab 7 or 10mg/kg for ≤52 weeks. In MG0007 (NCT04650854), patients received an initial 6-week cycle of rozanolixizumab 7 or 10mg/kg, with further cycles upon symptom worsening. Final efficacy data were pooled (MycarinG, MG0004 [first 6 weeks] and MG0007) for patients with ≥2 symptom-driven cycles. Mean scores (weighted by sample size, per cycle) were evaluated at baseline and Day 43 across Cycles 1–13 for ocular items within the MG-Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL), Quantitative MG (QMG), MG Symptoms Patient-Reported Outcome (MGSPRO) Ocular Muscle Weakness, and MG-Quality of Life 15-item revised (MG- QoL15r) scales. RESULTS: Overall, 129 patients received ≥2 symptom- driven cycles. Weighted-mean scores across 13 cycles at baseline and Day 43, respectively, were: MG-ADL diplopia 1.4 and 0.9 (n=939) and ptosis 1.5 and 0.8 (n=939); QMG diplopia 1.6 and 1.1 (n=924) and ptosis 1.4 and 0.8 (n=922); MGSPRO diplopia 1.3 and 0.9 (n=926) and ptosis 1.3 and 0.8 (n=927); and MG-QoL15r “trouble using my eyes” 1.2 and 0.9 (n=890). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Long-term rozanolixizumab treatment improved ocular item scores in MG-specific outcome measures, suggesting benefits for gMG patients experiencing ocular signs and symptoms. Funding: UCB.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型肌无力（MG）可引起致残性眼部症状（如复视、上睑下垂）。3期MycarinG研究（NCT03971422）显示，在全身型MG患者中，一个6周周期的rozanolixizumab与安慰剂相比眼部症状改善更大。目的：利用MycarinG及其开放标签扩展（MG0004、MG0007）数据，事后探讨重复rozanolixizumab周期对眼部症状的影响。方法：在MG0004（NCT04124965）中，患者接受每周一次rozanolixizumab 7或10 mg/kg，最长52周。在MG0007（NCT04650854）中，患者接受初始6周周期rozanolixizumab 7或10 mg/kg，症状恶化时接受进一步周期。对接受≥2个症状驱动周期的患者汇总最终疗效数据（MycarinG、MG0004[前6周]和MG0007）。在第1–13周期，于基线和第43天评估MG-日常生活活动（MG-ADL）、定量MG（QMG）、MG症状患者报告结局（MGSPRO）眼肌无力及MG-生活质量15项修订版（MG-QoL15r）量表中眼部条目的平均评分（按样本量、每周期加权）。结果：总体129例患者接受≥2个症状驱动周期。13个周期基线和第43天的加权平均评分分别为：MG-ADL复视1.4和0.9（n=939）、上睑下垂1.5和0.8（n=939）；QMG复视1.6和1.1（n=924）、上睑下垂1.4和0.8（n=922）；MGSPRO复视1.3和0.9（n=926）、上睑下垂1.3和0.8（n=927）；MG-QoL15r“用眼困难”1.2和0.9（n=890）。总结/结论：长期rozanolixizumab治疗改善了MG特异性结局指标中的眼部条目评分，提示对存在眼部体征和症状的gMG患者有益。资助：UCB。

abstracts.title: Effect of Subcutaneous Self-administered Gefurulimab on Ocular Muscle Function in Myasthenia Gravis in the Prevail Trial
abstracts.authors: Francesco Sacca; Djillali Annane; Mathias Maurer; Masanori Takahashi; Sanjay Rakhade; Joachim Scholz; Shulian Shang; Tuan Vu
abstracts.affiliations: Napoli, Italy; Garches, France; Würzburg, Germany; Osaka, Japan; Boston, MA; Tampa, FL
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Gefurulimab, a novel dual-binding nanobody, blocks complement component 5 activation. The phase 3 PREVAIL trial, assessing the efficacy and safety of gefurulimab in adults with anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive (AChR-Ab+) generalised myasthenia gravis (gMG) (NCT05556096), met all primary and secondary endpoints and demonstrated clinically meaningful improvement from baseline in MG Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) total score at wk 26 compared with placebo. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the effect of gefurulimab on ocular symptoms from PREVAIL. METHODS: Adults with AChR-Ab+ gMG were randomised 1:1 to weekly subcutaneous self-administration of gefurulimab or placebo. The primary endpoint was change from baseline in MG-ADL total score at wk26. MG-ADL and Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) subdomain scores were also assessed. RESULTS: 260 patients were randomized (gefurulimab: n=131; placebo: n=129). Mean±SD baseline MG-ADL and QMG total scores were 9.0±2.16 and 14.8±4.37, respectively. Improvements in ocular subdomain scores were observed at first assessment after treatment initiation (MG-ADL, wk1; QMG, wk4) and sustained through wk26. Least squares mean±SEM change from baseline at wk26 in MG-ADL and QMG ocular subdomain scores for gefurulimab versus placebo were −1.2±0.14 vs. −0.6±0.13 (treatment difference, −0.6±0.19; 95% CI: −1.0, −0.2; P=0.0016) and −1.7±0.14 vs. −0.9±0.14 (treatment difference, −0.7±0.19; 95% CI: −1.1, −0.4, P=0.0002), respectively. Improvements were also observed in other MG-ADL and QMG subdomains. Adverse events were similar between groups; no meningococcal infections were reported. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Gefurulimab, self- administered once weekly via subcutaneous injection, showed early and sustained improvements in MG-ADL and QMG ocular subdomain scores, demonstrating benefits for patients with gMG experiencing ocular symptoms.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Gefurulimab是一种新型双结合纳米抗体，可阻断补体成分5的激活。3期PREVAIL试验评估了gefurulimab在抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）全身型重症肌无力（gMG）成人患者中的疗效和安全性（NCT05556096），该试验达到所有主要和次要终点，并显示与安慰剂相比，第26周时重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）总分较基线有临床意义的改善。目的：评估PREVAIL试验中gefurulimab对眼部症状的影响。方法：AChR-Ab+ gMG成人患者按1:1随机分配至每周皮下自行注射gefurulimab或安慰剂。主要终点为第26周时MG-ADL总分较基线的变化。同时评估MG-ADL和定量重症肌无力（QMG）子域评分。结果：共随机260例患者（gefurulimab：n=131；安慰剂：n=129）。基线MG-ADL和QMG总分的均值±标准差分别为9.0±2.16和14.8±4.37。在治疗开始后的首次评估（MG-ADL为第1周；QMG为第4周）即观察到眼部子域评分的改善，并持续至第26周。第26周时，gefurulimab与安慰剂相比，MG-ADL和QMG眼部子域评分较基线变化的最小二乘均值±标准误分别为−1.2±0.14 vs. −0.6±0.13（治疗差异，−0.6±0.19；95% CI：−1.0，−0.2；P=0.0016）和−1.7±0.14 vs. −0.9±0.14（治疗差异，−0.7±0.19；95% CI：−1.1，−0.4，P=0.0002）。其他MG-ADL和QMG子域也观察到改善。两组不良事件相似；未报告脑膜炎球菌感染。总结/结论：Gefurulimab每周一次皮下自行注射，在MG-ADL和QMG眼部子域评分方面显示出早期且持续的改善，证明其对伴有眼部症状的gMG患者具有获益。

abstracts.title: Effect of Zilucoplan Stratified by Age of Myasthenia Gravis Onset: RAISE-XT 120-week Post Hoc Analysis
abstracts.authors: Michael Weiss; Saskia Bresch; Miriam Freimer; Channa Hewamadduma; Raul Juntas- Morales; M. Isabel Leite; Angelina Maniaol; Masayuki Masuda; Babak Boroojerdi; Paul Mahoney; Natasa Savic; James F. Howard; Jr.
abstracts.affiliations: Seattle, WA; Nice, France; Columbus, OH; Sheffield, United Kingdom; Barcelona, Spain; Oxford, United Kingdom; Oslo, Norway; Tokyo, Japan; Monheim, Germany; Slough, United Kingdom; Bulle, Switzerland; Chapel Hill, NC
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: RAISE-XT (NCT04225871), an ongoing, Phase 3, open-label extension study, demonstrated sustained improvements in myasthenia gravis (MG)-specific outcomes in patients with generalized MG (gMG) during zilucoplan treatment up to Week 120. OBJECTIVE: We evaluated the efficacy of zilucoplan by age of gMG onset. METHODS: In RAISE-XT, adults with gMG who completed RAISE (double-blind; NCT04115293) self- administered daily subcutaneous zilucoplan 0.3mg/kg. Change from double-blind baseline (CFB) in efficacy outcomes to Week 120 and safety were evaluated post hoc (cutoff: November 11, 2023) in early (≤50 years) and late (>50 years) age-of-onset subgroups. RESULTS: Mean (standard deviation) age (early onset [N=106] and late onset [N=77]) was: 43.9 (12.4) and 66.2 (5.6) years. At Week 120, mean (standard error) CFB (early versus late) was: MG Activities of Daily Living, −7.47 (0.53) versus −6.66 (0.75); Quantitative MG, −10.14 (0.77) versus −9.39 (1.15); MG Quality of Life 15-item revised, −12.55 (1.18) versus −7.68 (1.73); Quality of Life in Neurological Disorders Short Form Fatigue, −11.34 (1.61) versus −9.65 (2.22). Serious and treatment-related treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 34.0% (n/N=36/106) and 38.7% (n/N=41/106) of patients (early subgroup) and 49.4% (n/N=38/77) and 33.8% (n/N=26/77) of patients (late subgroup), respectively. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Zilucoplan demonstrated long-term efficacy, irrespective of age at gMG onset. Funding: UCB.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：RAISE-XT（NCT04225871）是一项正在进行的3期开放标签扩展研究，显示zilucoplan治疗全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者至第120周时，重症肌无力（MG）特异性结局持续改善。目的：我们按gMG发病年龄评估zilucoplan的疗效。方法：在RAISE-XT中，完成RAISE研究（双盲；NCT04115293）的gMG成人患者每日自行皮下注射zilucoplan 0.3mg/kg。事后评估早期（≤50岁）和晚期（>50岁）发病亚组至第120周疗效结局较双盲基线变化（CFB）及安全性（数据截止：2023年11月11日）。结果：早期发病组（N=106）和晚期发病组（N=77）的年龄均值（标准差）分别为43.9（12.4）岁和66.2（5.6）岁。第120周时，均值（标准误）CFB（早期 vs 晚期）为：MG日常生活活动量表，−7.47（0.53）vs −6.66（0.75）；定量MG，−10.14（0.77）vs −9.39（1.15）；MG生活质量15项修订版，−12.55（1.18）vs −7.68（1.73）；神经疾病生活质量短表疲劳，−11.34（1.61）vs −9.65（2.22）。严重治疗中出现的不良事件和治疗相关治疗中出现的不良事件分别发生于早期亚组34.0%（n/N=36/106）和38.7%（n/N=41/106）的患者，以及晚期亚组49.4%（n/N=38/77）和33.8%（n/N=26/77）的患者。总结/结论：无论gMG发病年龄如何，zilucoplan均显示出长期疗效。资助：UCB。

abstracts.title: Efficacy of Nipocalimab in Adult Patients with None-to-mild Ocular Manifestations of Generalized Myasthenia Gravis in Phase 3 VIVACITY-MG3
abstracts.authors: Kristl Claeys; Kavita Gandhi; Ibrahim Turkoz; Michael Kutch; Marie Fitzgibbon; Sindhu Ramchandren
abstracts.affiliations: Leuven, Belgium; Horsham, PA; Titusville, NJ; Chesterbrook, PA; Raritan, NJ
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Ocular manifestations are the most common presenting symptom in patients with generalized- myasthenia gravis (gMG); however, 15–50% patients do not experience ocular symptoms. In phase 3 Vivacity-MG3 study (NCT04951622), nipocalimab added to standard of care (SOC) treatment (nipocalimab+SOC) demonstrated sustained disease control vs placebo+SOC through improvements in Myasthenia Gravis-Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) total scores in the overall gMG population and in a subgroup of patients with moderate-to- severe ocular manifestations. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate efficacy of nipocalimab on MG- ADL in a subgroup of patients with none-to-mild ocular manifestations. METHODS: None-to-mild ocular manifestations was defined as ≤1 score on diplopia and ptosis items of the MG-ADL scale; data were analyzed in these patients at double-blind baseline. Symptom improvement was assessed by change from baseline in MG-ADL scores (meaningful clinical improvement [MCI]: ≥2-point improvement; substantial clinical improvement [SCI]: ≥3- point improvement) at Week (W)24. RESULTS: Baseline characteristics were generally balanced between nipocalimab+SOC vs placebo+SOC — median (range) age: 50.0 (20–79) vs 50.5 (20–77) years; female: 70.6% vs 50.0%; median (range) baseline MG- ADL: 7.5 (6–10) (n=17) vs 7.3 (6–12) (n=14). At W24, nipocalimab+SOC (n=17) showed median (range) MG- ADL reductions from baseline of −6.00 (−8.0, 1.0) vs −2.75 (−6.0, 0.0) in placebo+SOC (n=12) (difference: −2.32 [SE: 0.922]; 95% CI: −4.21; −0.42; p=0.018). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In patients with gMG and none-to-mild ocular manifestations, nipocalimab treatment showed meaningful and substantial clinical improvements on MG-ADL total score versus placebo (as in overall population). Thus, nipocalimab provides sustained disease control in these patients.
