abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：眼部表现是全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者最常见的首发症状；然而，15–50%的患者不出现眼部症状。在3期Vivacity-MG3研究（NCT04951622）中，nipocalimab联合标准治疗（SOC）（nipocalimab+SOC）通过改善重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）总分，在总体gMG人群及中度至重度眼部表现亚组中显示出与安慰剂+SOC相比的持续疾病控制。目的：评估nipocalimab在无至轻度眼部表现亚组患者中对MG-ADL的疗效。方法：无至轻度眼部表现定义为MG-ADL量表中复视和上睑下垂条目评分≤1分；在双盲基线时对这些患者的数据进行分析。通过第24周（W24）MG-ADL评分较基线的变化评估症状改善（有意义的临床改善[MCI]：≥2分改善；实质性临床改善[SCI]：≥3分改善）。结果：nipocalimab+SOC与安慰剂+SOC的基线特征总体均衡——年龄中位数（范围）：50.0（20–79）vs 50.5（20–77）岁；女性：70.6% vs 50.0%；基线MG-ADL中位数（范围）：7.5（6–10）（n=17）vs 7.3（6–12）（n=14）。第24周时，nipocalimab+SOC（n=17）MG-ADL较基线降低的中位数（范围）为−6.00（−8.0，1.0），安慰剂+SOC（n=12）为−2.75（−6.0，0.0）（差异：−2.32[SE：0.922]；95% CI：−4.21；−0.42；p=0.018）。总结/结论：在伴无至轻度眼部表现的gMG患者中，与安慰剂相比，nipocalimab治疗在MG-ADL总分上显示出有意义且实质性的临床改善（与总体人群一致）。因此，nipocalimab在这些患者中提供持续疾病控制。

abstracts.title: Frequency of Sustained Response to Nipocalimab versus Placebo Based on MG-ADL and QMG Scales in the Phase 3 VIVACITY-MG3 Study
abstracts.authors: Shahar Shelly; Marie Fitzgibbon; Ibrahim Turkoz; Kavita Gandhi; Sindhu Ramchandren; Constantine Farmakidis
abstracts.affiliations: Haifa, Israel; Raritan, NJ; Titusville, NJ; Horsham, PA; Kansas City, KS
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Sustained-disease-control is a critical treatment goal in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). Sustained-Clinical-Response frequency helps assess gMG disease control, distinguishing true therapeutic effects from intermittent/placebo-related improvements. OBJECTIVE: Assess the frequency of Sustained-Clinical- Response with nipocalimab, using Myasthenia Gravis (MG)-Activities of Daily Living(MG-ADL) and Quantitative MG(QMG) score during 24-week double-blind phase-3 Vivacity-MG3(NCT04951622) study based on seropositive patient-population. METHODS: Sustained-Clinical-Response was defined as high number of visits-in-response (MG-ADL:≥10- responses through 12-visits, QMG:≥7-responses through 8-visits). Meaningful-clinical-improvement (MCI) was ≥2- point/≥3-point improvement in MG-ADL/QMG total score, respectively; ≥3-point improvement in MG-ADL (MG- ADL≥3), ≥4-point improvement in QMG (QMG≥4) and composite MCI response (MCI in both MG-ADL and QMG) were also assessed. Frequency of Sustained-Clinical- Response in MG-ADL, QMG total and composite MCI response scores, from baseline through week-24 were analyzed. RESULTS: For MG-ADL-MCI, nipocalimab+standard-of- care-treated patients (44/77[57.1%]) had higher odds of achieving Sustained-Clinical-Response (OR:4.0[95%CI:2.01–7.96], p<0.001) versus placebo +standard-of-care (19/76[25.0%]) in ≥10-visits. abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：持续疾病控制是全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的关键治疗目标。持续临床缓解频率有助于评估gMG疾病控制，区分真实治疗效应与间歇性/安慰剂相关改善。目的：基于血清阳性患者人群，在24周双盲3期Vivacity-MG3（NCT04951622）研究中，使用重症肌无力（MG）日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）和定量MG（QMG）评分评估nipocalimab的持续临床缓解频率。方法：持续临床缓解定义为高访视缓解次数（MG-ADL：12次访视中≥10次缓解，QMG：8次访视中≥7次缓解）。有意义的临床改善（MCI）分别为MG-ADL/QMG总分改善≥2分/≥3分；同时评估MG-ADL改善≥3分（MG-ADL≥3）、QMG改善≥4分（QMG≥4）及复合MCI缓解（MG-ADL和QMG均达MCI）。分析从基线至第24周MG-ADL、QMG总分及复合MCI缓解评分的持续临床缓解频率。结果：对于MG-ADL-MCI，nipocalimab+标准治疗患者（44/77[57.1%]）在≥10次访视中达到持续临床缓解的比值高于安慰剂+标准治疗（19/76[25.0%]）（OR：4.0[95%CI：2.01–7.96]，p<0.001）。MG-ADL≥3结果相似，nipocalimab治疗患者（37[48.1%]）在≥10次访视中达到持续临床缓解的比值高于安慰剂（12[15.8%]）（OR：4.9[95%CI：2.30–10.57]，p<0.001）。对于QMG-MCI，nipocalimab治疗患者（31[40.3%]）在≥7次访视中达到持续临床缓解的比值高于安慰剂（10[13.2%]）（OR：4.5[95%CI：1.99–9.96]，p<0.001）。QMG≥4结果相似，nipocalimab治疗患者（27[35.1%]）在≥7次访视中达到持续临床缓解的比值高于安慰剂（9[11.8%]）（OR：4.0[95%CI：1.74–9.30]，p<0.001）。对于复合MCI缓解，nipocalimab治疗患者（25[32.5%]）在MG-ADL-MCI≥10次访视且QMG-MCI≥7次访视中达到持续临床缓解的比值高于安慰剂（6[7.9%]）（OR：5.6[95%CI：2.15–14.66]，p<0.001）。总结/结论：在Vivacity-MG3中，与安慰剂治疗患者相比，nipocalimab治疗患者达到持续缓解的比例显著更高，反映24周内更一致的疾病控制。

abstracts.title: Health-related Quality of Life in Patients with Generalised Myasthenia Gravis Receiving Gefurulimab in the Prevail Trial
abstracts.authors: Tobias Ruck; Francesco Sacca; Tuan Vu; Sanjay Rakhade; Annie Racine; Sarbesh Pandeya; Alexis Lizarraga
abstracts.affiliations: Düsseldorf, Germany; Napoli, Italy; Tampa, FL; Boston, MA; Rochester, NY
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Gefurulimab is a novel dual-binding nanobody that blocks complement component 5 activation. Efficacy and safety of gefurulimab in adults with anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive (AChR-Ab+) generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) were demonstrated in PREVAIL, a phase 3, randomized, placebo-controlled trial in adult patients with AChR-Ab+ gMG (NCT05556096). OBJECTIVE: To assess the health-related quality of life (HRQoL) outcomes from PREVAIL. METHODS: Patients were randomized to receive weekly subcutaneous self-injection of gefurulimab or placebo. Exploratory endpoints assessed HRQoL changes from baseline through wk26 (randomized period completion) using: MG-QOL 15-Item Questionnaire-Revised (MG- QOL15r); QoL in Neurological Disorders (Neuro-QoL) Fatigue Scale; and EuroQol-5 Dimensions-5-Level (EQ-5D-5L) Visual Analogue Scale (VAS) and Health State Index (HSI). RESULTS: Overall, 260 patients (female, 60.4%; mean ±SD age, 52.8±15.7 years; mean±SD baseline MG-ADL total score, 9.0±2.2) were randomized to gefurulimab (n=131) or placebo (n=129). Significantly greater improvements were observed with gefurulimab compared with placebo, starting at wk4 in MG-QOL15r and Neuro- QoL Fatigue and wk8 in EQ-5D-5L. These improvements sustained throughout the randomized period. At wk26, the least squares mean (95% CI) changes from baseline among patients with available data receiving gefurulimab (n=123) vs. placebo (n=117) were −4.9 (−6.0, −3.8) vs. −2.3 (−3.2, −1.4) (P=0.0005) in MG-QOL15r; −4.8 (−6.2, −3.4) vs. −2.5 (−3.8, −1.1) (P=0.0164) in Neuro-QoL Fatigue; 9.2 (6.2, 12.1) vs. 4.6 (1.6, 7.6) (P=0.0349) in EQ-5D-5L VAS; 0.12 (0.076, 0.155) vs. 0.04 (−0.004, 0.079) (P=0.0088) in EQ-5D-5L HSI. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Patients with AChR-Ab+ gMG receiving gefurulimab had significant improvements in HRQoL compared with those receiving placebo, demonstrated by MG-specific and general HRQoL measures.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Gefurulimab是一种新型双结合纳米抗体，可阻断补体成分5的激活。Gefurulimab在抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）全身型肌无力（gMG）成人患者中的疗效和安全性已在PREVAIL中得到证实，这是一项在AChR-Ab+ gMG成人患者中开展的3期、随机、安慰剂对照试验（NCT05556096）。目的：评估PREVAIL中的健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）结局。方法：患者被随机分配接受每周皮下自我注射gefurulimab或安慰剂。探索性终点评估从基线至第26周（随机期完成）的HRQoL变化，使用：MG-QOL 15项问卷修订版（MG-QOL15r）；神经系统疾病生活质量（Neuro-QoL）疲劳量表；以及EuroQol-5维度-5水平（EQ-5D-5L）视觉模拟量表（VAS）和健康状态指数（HSI）。结果：总体而言，260例患者（女性，60.4%；平均±SD年龄，52.8±15.7岁；平均±SD基线MG-ADL总分，9.0±2.2）被随机分配至gefurulimab（n=131）或安慰剂（n=129）。与安慰剂相比，gefurulimab观察到显著更大的改善，MG-QOL15r和Neuro-QoL疲劳自第4周开始，EQ-5D-5L自第8周开始。这些改善在整个随机期内持续存在。在第26周，有可用数据的接受gefurulimab（n=123）与安慰剂（n=117）患者中，从基线变化的最小二乘均值（95% CI）分别为：MG-QOL15r为−4.9（−6.0，−3.8）vs −2.3（−3.2，−1.4）（P=0.0005）；Neuro-QoL疲劳为−4.8（−6.2，−3.4）vs −2.5（−3.8，−1.1）（P=0.0164）；EQ-5D-5L VAS为9.2（6.2，12.1）vs 4.6（1.6，7.6）（P=0.0349）；EQ-5D-5L HSI为0.12（0.076，0.155）vs 0.04（−0.004，0.079）（P=0.0088）。总结/结论：接受gefurulimab的AChR-Ab+ gMG患者与接受安慰剂者相比，HRQoL有显著改善，这由MG特异性及通用HRQoL测量工具所证实。

abstracts.title: Individual Item-level Analyses of Myasthenia Gravis-specific Outcomes during Zilucoplan Treatment in RAISE and RAISE-XT
abstracts.authors: Joe Post; Miriam Freimer; Channa Hewamadduma; Maria Isabel Leite; Angelina Maniaol; Kimiaki Utsugisawa; Michael Weiss; Jos Bloemers; Babak Boroojerdi; Paul Mahoney; Natasa Savic; James F. Howard; Jr.
abstracts.affiliations: Charlotte, NC; Columbus, OH; Sheffield, United Kingdom; Oxford, United Kingdom; Oslo, Norway; Hanamaki, Japan; Seattle, WA; Breda, Netherlands; Monheim, Germany; Slough, United Kingdom; Bulle, Switzerland; Chapel Hill, NC
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In RAISE (Phase 3, NCT04115293), zilucoplan led to clinically meaningful improvements in myasthenia gravis (MG)-specific outcomes in patients with generalized MG (gMG). Improvements were sustained in the ongoing open-label extension, RAISE-XT (NCT04225871). OBJECTIVE: Assess change in item scores for MG- Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL), Quantitative MG (QMG) and MG-Quality of Life 15-item revised (MG- QoL15r). METHODS: In RAISE, adults with gMG were randomized to self-administer once-daily placebo or zilucoplan 0.3mg/kg; on completion, they received zilucoplan 0.3mg/kg in RAISE-XT. Post hoc analyses of MG-ADL, QMG and MG-QoL15r (cutoff: November 11, 2023) included the proportion of patients with no symptoms, improvements or no change to Week 12 (RAISE), and to Week 120 (RAISE-XT). Change from double-blind baseline (CFB) to Week 120 and safety (RAISE-XT) were also assessed. RESULTS: In RAISE, a greater proportion of patients improved from baseline to Week 12 or had no symptoms at Week 12 across MG-ADL items with zilucoplan (≥52.4%) than placebo (≥38.8%). Improvements further increased (zilucoplan group) and were sustained to Week 120 in RAISE-XT (≥72.6% of patients). At Week 120 (n=73), mean (standard error) CFB for MG-ADL items was: chewing, −0.85 (0.09); swallowing, −0.75 (0.10); talking, −0.86 (0.10); breathing, −0.71 (0.09); double vision, −1.04 (0.14); eyelid droop, −1.44 (0.13); brush hair/teeth, −0.96 (0.11); and rise from chair, −0.79 (0.11). Similar results were observed for QMG and MG-QoL15r. Treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 97.0% (n=194/200) of patients. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Zilucoplan treatment led to sustained improvements across items in MG-specific outcomes to Week 120, suggesting benefit across a range of MG symptoms. Funding: UCB.

abstracts.title: Interpreting Clinically Meaningful Improvement on the Myasthenia Gravis Impairment Index (MGII) Patient Reported Outcome (PRO) Ocular Score: Responder Analyses from a Phase 3 Clinical Trial in Ocular
abstracts.authors: Martina Orlovic; Rosa Jimenez; Wan-Yi Huang; Michael Mendes; Fien M. Verhamme; Fien Gistelinck; Cécile Blein; Jeffrey Guptill; Rebecca Cheng; Jennifer Beaumont; Heli Kapadia; Gabriella Szatmary; Carolina Barnett-Tapia
abstracts.affiliations: Gent, Belgium; Boston, MA; Ghent, Belgium; San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA; Flower Mound, TX; Chapel Hill, NC; Toronto, Canada
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: The Myasthenia Gravis Impairment Index (MGII) is an MG-specific measure of disease severity that includes patient-reported outcome (PRO) and physical examination (PE) items. In ADAPT OCULUS, the first pivotal Phase 3 trial of a targeted therapy in ocular myasthenia gravis (oMG), the MGII (PRO) ocular score was the primary endpoint. We evaluated responder rates for MGII (PRO) and MGII (PRO+PE) ocular scores using prespecified thresholds for meaningful within-patient improvement. METHODS: Responder analyses were conducted using data from ADAPT OCULUS, Meaningful individual improvement thresholds for MGII (PRO) and (PRO+PE) ocular scores were derived under blinded conditions using anchor-based and distribution-based methods. Participants were classified as improved, stable, or worsened at Week 4. Treatment effects were summarized using responder proportions and cumulative distribution function (CDF) curves. RESULTS: At Week 4, more participants receiving efgartigimod PH20 SC achieved meaningful improvement on MGII (PRO) ocular score versus placebo (58.0% vs 37.3% ; threshold=3). Consistent findings were observed for MGII (PRO+PE) ocular score (52.2% vs 38.8% ; threshold-=4). CDF curves favored efgartigimod PH20 SC across the range of responses. ADAPT OCULUS met its primary endpoint, MGII (PRO) ocular score at Week 4 versus placebo (p=0.012). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Responder analyses using prespecified thresholds for meaningful individual improvement showed that efgartigimod PH20 SC was associated with clinically meaningful improvement in MGII (PRO) and (PRO+PE) ocular scores versus placebo. Together with the statistically significant primary endpoint, responder analyses demonstrate that MGII ocular endpoints can meaningfully capture patient relevant treatment benefit and show clinically meaningful improvements with efgartigimod PH20 SC in oMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：肌无力损害指数（MGII）是一种MG特异性疾病严重程度测量工具，包括患者报告结局（PRO）和体格检查（PE）条目。在ADAPT OCULUS中——首个针对眼肌型肌无力（oMG）靶向治疗的 pivotal 3期试验——MGII（PRO）眼部评分为主要终点。我们使用预设的个体内有意义改善阈值评估了MGII（PRO）和MGII（PRO+PE）眼部评分的应答者率。方法：应答者分析使用ADAPT OCULUS的数据进行。MGII（PRO）和（PRO+PE）眼部评分的个体有意义改善阈值在盲态条件下使用基于锚点和基于分布的方法推导。参与者在第4周被分类为改善、稳定或恶化。治疗效应使用应答者比例和累积分布函数（CDF）曲线总结。结果：在第4周，接受efgartigimod PH20 SC的参与者中达到MGII（PRO）眼部评分有意义改善的比例高于安慰剂（58.0% vs 37.3%；阈值=3）。MGII（PRO+PE）眼部评分观察到一致结果（52.2% vs 38.8%；阈值=4）。CDF曲线在整个应答范围内均有利于efgartigimod PH20 SC。ADAPT OCULUS达到其主要终点，即第4周MGII（PRO）眼部评分 vs 安慰剂（p=0.012）。总结/结论：使用预设的个体有意义改善阈值进行的应答者分析显示，efgartigimod PH20 SC与安慰剂相比，在MGII（PRO）和（PRO+PE）眼部评分方面与具有临床意义的改善相关。结合统计学显著的主要终点，应答者分析表明MGII眼部终点能够有意义地捕捉患者相关的治疗获益，并显示efgartigimod PH20 SC在oMG中具有临床意义的改善。

abstracts.title: Long-term Efficacy and Safety of Gefurulimab in Adults with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis (gMG): Results from the Open-label Extension (Ole) of the Prevail Trial
abstracts.authors: Stojan Peric; Kelly Gwathmey; Tobias Ruck; Francesco Sacca; Masanori Takahashi; Joachim Scholz; Shulian Shang; Min Yee; Sanjay Rakhade; Tuan Vu
abstracts.affiliations: Belgrade, Serbia; Richmond, VA; Bochum, Germany; Napoli, Italy; Osaka, Japan; Boston, MA; Tampa, FL
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Gefurulimab demonstrated early and sustained efficacy and was well tolerated in adults with anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive (AChR-Ab+) gMG during randomized controlled treatment (RCT) period in the phase 3 PREVAIL trial (NCT05556096). OBJECTIVE: Evaluate long-term efficacy and safety of gefurulimab in the ongoing PREVAIL OLE. METHODS: Patients who completed the 26-week RCT were eligible for the OLE. Patients receiving gefurulimab during RCT continued weekly subcutaneous gefurulimab self-injections (gefurulimab-gefurulimab); patients receiving placebo switched to gefurulimab (placebo- gefurulimab). Efficacy outcomes included changes from RCT baseline in Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL), Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG), and Myasthenia Gravis Composite (MGC) total scores through week 52 (RCT+OLE). RESULTS: Of 260 patients initially randomized, 249 entered the OLE (female, 60.2%; mean±SD age, 52.9±15.6 years; mean±SD baseline MG-ADL total score, 9.0±2.2). Median (range) gefurulimab exposure duration was 504 (1.0-1064.0) days. In the gefurulimab-gefurulimab group (n=127), improvements observed during RCT were sustained through 52 weeks, with least squares mean (95%CI) change from baseline at week 52 of −5.3 (−5.8, −4.8) in MG-ADL, −5.3 (−6.0, −4.6) in QMG, and −9.4 (−10.3, −8.5) in MGC. In the placebo-gefurulimab group (n=122), improvements were seen at the first assessments after gefurulimab initiation and sustained through week 52. Least squares mean (95%CI) changes from baseline at week 52 were: MG-ADL, −4.9 (−5.4, −4.4); QMG, −4.6 (−5.4, −3.9); and MGC, −8.3 (−9.2, −7.3). Gefurulimab was well tolerated. No meningococcal infections were reported. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Gefurulimab, self- administered via weekly subcutaneous injections, demonstrated sustained disease control up to 52 weeks in adults with AChR-Ab+ gMG from the PREVAIL OLE.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在3期PREVAIL试验（NCT05556096）的随机对照治疗（RCT）期，gefurulimab在抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）gMG成人患者中显示出早期且持续的疗效，且耐受性良好。目的：评估gefurulimab在正在进行的PREVAIL开放标签扩展（OLE）中的长期疗效和安全性。方法：完成26周RCT的患者符合OLE入组条件。RCT期间接受gefurulimab的患者继续每周皮下自我注射gefurulimab（gefurulimab-gefurulimab）；接受安慰剂的患者转换为gefurulimab（安慰剂-gefurulimab）。疗效结局包括从RCT基线至第52周（RCT+OLE）的肌无力日常生活活动能力（MG-ADL）、定量肌无力（QMG）和肌无力综合（MGC）总分变化。结果：最初随机化的260例患者中，249例进入OLE（女性，60.2%；平均±SD年龄，52.9±15.6岁；平均±SD基线MG-ADL总分，9.0±2.2）。Gefurulimab暴露持续时间中位数（范围）为504（1.0-1064.0）天。在gefurulimab-gefurulimab组（n=127）中，RCT期间观察到的改善维持至52周，第52周从基线变化的最小二乘均值（95%CI）为：MG-ADL −5.3（−5.8，−4.8），QMG −5.3（−6.0，−4.6），MGC −9.4（−10.3，−8.5）。在安慰剂-gefurulimab组（n=122）中，gefurulimab启动后首次评估即见改善，并维持至第52周。第52周从基线变化的最小二乘均值（95%CI）为：MG-ADL，−4.9（−5.4，−4.4）；QMG，−4.6（−5.4，−3.9）；MGC，−8.3（−9.2，−7.3）。Gefurulimab耐受性良好。未报告脑膜炎球菌感染。总结/结论：每周皮下自我注射的gefurulimab在PREVAIL OLE的AChR-Ab+ gMG成人患者中显示出至52周的持续疾病控制。

abstracts.title: Minimal Symptom Expression in Myasthenia Gravis: A Post Hoc Analysis of Phase 3 Rozanolixizumab Studies
abstracts.authors: Robert Pascuzzi; Ali Habib; Zabeen Mahuwala; Renato Mantegazza; Sabrina Sacconi; John Vissing; Tuan Vu; Jana Zschüntzsch; Joel Baldwin; Thais Tarancon; Vera Bril
abstracts.affiliations: Indianapolis, IN; Orange, CA; Lexington, KY; Milan, Italy; Nice, France; Copenhagen, Denmark; Tampa, FL; Göttingen, Germany; Slough, United Kingdom; Madrid, Spain; Toronto, Canada
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In the Phase 3 MycarinG study (NCT03971422) and its open-label extensions, Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) responder rates (≥2-point improvement in score) of ≥63.7% were observed in Cycles 1–13 of rozanolixizumab treatment in patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). OBJECTIVE: Assess achievement of minimal symptom expression (MSE; MG-ADL score 0 or 1) across rozanolixizumab treatment cycles. METHODS: In MycarinG, patients were randomized to once-weekly placebo, rozanolixizumab 7mg/kg or rozanolixizumab 10mg/kg for 6 weeks. In MG0004 (NCT04124965), patients received once-weekly rozanolixizumab 7 or 10mg/kg for ≤52 weeks. In MG0007 (NCT04650854), after an initial 6-week cycle of rozanolixizumab 7 or 10mg/kg, further cycles were administered based on symptom worsening (investigator’s discretion). Final efficacy data were pooled across MycarinG, MG0004 (first 6 weeks) and MG0007 for patients with ≥2 symptom-driven rozanolixizumab cycles. The proportion of patients with MSE at any time during treatment or observation in each symptom-driven cycle up to Cycle 13 was analyzed post hoc based on Cycle 1 MSE achievement. RESULTS: Overall, 129 patients were assessed. In Cycle 1, 27.9% (36/129) of patients achieved MSE. Among these, subsequent MSE rates were ≥60.0% in Cycles 2–13. Among Cycle 1 MSE non-responders, 19.4% achieved MSE in a subsequent cycle (up to Cycle 13; median number of additional cycles received: 6). In every cycle, almost all patients achieving MSE did so within the 6-week treatment period. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: For patients with gMG achieving MSE in Cycle 1, within each subsequent cycle the majority achieved MSE, suggesting consistent efficacy with long-term rozanolixizumab treatment. Funding: UCB.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在3期MycarinG研究（NCT03971422）及其开放标签扩展研究中，接受rozanolixizumab治疗的全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者在Cycles 1–13中观察到重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）应答率（评分改善≥2分）≥63.7%。目的：评估rozanolixizumab各治疗周期中达到最小症状表达（MSE；MG-ADL评分0或1）的情况。方法：在MycarinG中，患者被随机分配至每周一次安慰剂、rozanolixizumab 7mg/kg或rozanolixizumab 10mg/kg，治疗6周。在MG0004（NCT04124965）中，患者接受每周一次rozanolixizumab 7或10mg/kg，治疗≤52周。在MG0007（NCT04650854）中，在初始6周rozanolixizumab 7或10mg/kg周期后，根据症状加重情况（研究者判断）给予进一步周期。最终疗效数据在MycarinG、MG0004（前6周）和MG0007中接受≥2个症状驱动rozanolixizumab周期的患者中汇总。基于Cycle 1 MSE达成情况，事后分析截至Cycle 13每个症状驱动周期中治疗或观察期间任意时间达到MSE的患者比例。结果：总体共评估129例患者。在Cycle 1中，27.9%（36/129）的患者达到MSE。在这些患者中，Cycles 2–13的后续MSE率≥60.0%。在Cycle 1 MSE无应答者中，19.4%在后续周期（截至Cycle 13；接受额外周期的中位数为6）达到MSE。在每个周期中，几乎所有达到MSE的患者均在6周治疗期内达到。总结/结论：对于在Cycle 1达到MSE的gMG患者，在后续每个周期内大多数达到MSE，提示长期rozanolixizumab治疗具有一致的疗效。资助：UCB。

abstracts.title: Myasthenia Gravis Inebilizumab Trial (MINT): Adverse Events of Special Interest during the Randomized Controlled Period
abstracts.authors: Richard Nowak; Kimiaki Utsugisawa; Michael Benatar; Emma Ciafaloni; Maria Isabel Leite; John Vissing; Fengming Tang; Blanca I. Canales; Qing Li; Sue Cheng; James F. Howard; Jr.
abstracts.affiliations: New Haven, CT; Hanamaki, Japan; Miami, FL; Rochester, NY; Oxford, United Kingdom; Copenhagen, Denmark; Thousand Oaks, CA; Bradenton, FL; Chapel Hill, NC
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: B cells play a key upstream mechanistic role in autoimmune generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) pathogenesis through the production of antibodies targeting the acetylcholine receptor (AChR+), muscle- specific kinase (MuSK+), or other related proteins. Inebilizumab is a monoclonal antibody targeting CD19+ B cells. B-cell-depleting therapies may impair humoral responses, increase the risk of infections and reduced response to vaccinations. OBJECTIVE: To examine whether inebilizumab is associated with an increased risk of adverse events of special interest (AESIs) in gMG participants. METHODS: MINT (NCT04524273) was a phase 3 trial in adults with gMG. During the randomized controlled period (RCP) [52-weeks for AChR+; 26-weeks for MuSK+], participants were randomized (1:1) to receive 300mg of inebilizumab or placebo on Day-1, Day-15, and Day-183 (AChR+ only). Subsets of adverse events were identified as AESIs due to their relevance to inebilizumab’s mechanism of action. RESULTS: 238 patients were randomized: inebilizumab 119 (95 AChR+, 24 MuSK+), placebo 119 (95 AChR+, 24 MuSK+). Baseline demographics and disease characteristics were generally balanced between treatment groups. AESIs were infrequent, occurring in 10.1% (n=12) of the inebilizumab- and 16% (n=19) of the placebo-treated groups. Cytopenias occurred in 2.5% (n=3) of inebilzumab-treated and 9.2% (n=11) of placebo- treated participants. Serious and/or opportunistic infections were infrequent (inebilizumab: 3.4% [n=4]; placebo: 5.0% [n=6]), with COVID-19 being the most common (inebilizumab: 2/4; placebo: 3/6) and no instances of progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy. Infusion related reactions occurred in 5.0% (n=6) of inebilizumab- and 2.5% (n=3) of placebo-treated participants. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: These results support a favorable safety profile of inebilizumab over a 26–52-week period.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：B细胞通过产生针对乙酰胆碱受体（AChR+）、肌肉特异性激酶（MuSK+）或其他相关蛋白的抗体，在自身免疫性全身型重症肌无力（gMG）发病机制中发挥关键上游机制作用。Inebilizumab是一种靶向CD19+ B细胞的单克隆抗体。B细胞耗竭疗法可能损害体液免疫应答、增加感染风险并降低对疫苗接种的应答。目的：考察inebilizumab是否与gMG参与者中特别关注不良事件（AESIs）风险增加相关。方法：MINT（NCT04524273）是一项在成人gMG中开展的3期试验。在随机对照期（RCP）[AChR+为52周；MuSK+为26周]内，参与者按1:1随机分配，在第1天、第15天和第183天（仅AChR+）接受300mg inebilizumab或安慰剂。由于与inebilizumab作用机制的相关性，部分不良事件被确定为AESIs。结果：238例患者被随机分配：inebilizumab 119例（95例AChR+，24例MuSK+），安慰剂119例（95例AChR+，24例MuSK+）。治疗组间基线人口学和疾病特征总体均衡。AESIs不常见，inebilizumab组发生率为10.1%（n=12），安慰剂组为16%（n=19）。血细胞减少在inebilizumab治疗组发生率为2.5%（n=3），安慰剂治疗组为9.2%（n=11）。严重和/或机会性感染不常见（inebilizumab：3.4%[n=4]；安慰剂：5.0%[n=6]），其中COVID-19最常见（inebilizumab：2/4；安慰剂：3/6），未发生进行性多灶性白质脑病病例。输注相关反应在inebilizumab组发生率为5.0%（n=6），安慰剂组为2.5%（n=3）。总结/结论：这些结果支持inebilizumab在26–52周期间具有良好的安全性特征。

abstracts.title: Myasthenia Gravis Inebilizumab Trial: Interim 1-year Open-label Results from Participants with Anti–acetylcholine Receptor OR Anti–muscle-specific Kinase Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: James F. Howard; Jr.; Michael Benatar; Maria Isabel Leite; Emma Ciafaloni; Kimiaki Utsugisawa; Sarah Bray; Kristina R. Patterson; Ankur Bhambri; Arati Kiran Kanchi; Sue Cheng; John Vissing; Richard Nowak
abstracts.affiliations: Chapel Hill, NC; Miami, FL; Oxford, United Kingdom; Rochester, NY; Hanamaki, Japan; Thousand Oaks, CA; Bradenton, FL; Copenhagen, Denmark; New Haven, CT
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia Gravis Inebilizumab Trial (MINT; NCT04524273), a placebo-controlled, phase 3, randomized trial, demonstrated significant improvements in Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Quantitative MG (QMG) scores in participants treated with inebilizumab vs placebo in the randomized, controlled period (RCP). OBJECTIVE: To evaluate 1-year efficacy and safety results of the 3-year MINT open-label period (OLP). METHODS: Participants with generalized MG were randomized 1:1 to receive 300 mg intravenous inebilizumab or placebo for 52 weeks (participants with anti–acetylcholine receptor antibodies) or 26 weeks (participants with anti–muscle-specific kinase antibodies) during the RCP, followed by an optional 3-year OLP wherein all participants received inebilizumab. This 1-year interim analysis includes participants who received any inebilizumab. RESULTS: Overall, 238 participants were enrolled in MINT; 208 entered the OLP (inebilizumab, 109; placebo, 99), and 188 completed 1 year. Baseline RCP MG-ADL and QMG scores were similar among participants. Mean improvements continued from baseline of the RCP to 1 year of the OLP for participants treated with inebilizumab/inebilizumab vs placebo/inebilizumab in the combined population (MG-ADL, –6.1 vs –5.9; QMG, –7.3 vs –6.9). No new safety signals were noted during the OLP. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: During 1 year of the OLP, participants experienced sustained improvements in MG- ADL and QMG scores supporting durability of response regardless of initial treatment in the RCP.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力Inebilizumab试验（MINT；NCT04524273）是一项安慰剂对照、3期、随机试验，显示在随机对照期（RCP）中，与安慰剂相比，接受inebilizumab治疗的参与者在重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）和定量重症肌无力（QMG）评分方面有显著改善。目的：评估3年MINT开放标签期（OLP）的1年疗效和安全性结果。方法：全身型MG参与者按1:1随机分配，在RCP期间接受300mg静脉inebilizumab或安慰剂治疗52周（抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性参与者）或26周（抗肌肉特异性激酶抗体阳性参与者），随后进入可选3年OLP，其中所有参与者均接受inebilizumab。本1年期中分析纳入接受过任何inebilizumab的参与者。结果：总体共238例参与者入组MINT；208例进入OLP（inebilizumab组109例；安慰剂组99例），188例完成1年。参与者间RCP基线MG-ADL和QMG评分相似。在合并人群中，inebilizumab/inebilizumab组与安慰剂/inebilizumab组从RCP基线至OLP 1年的平均改善持续存在（MG-ADL，–6.1 vs –5.9；QMG，–7.3 vs –6.9）。OLP期间未观察到新的安全性信号。总结/结论：在OLP 1年期间，参与者MG-ADL和QMG评分持续改善，支持无论RCP初始治疗如何均具有应答持久性。

abstracts.title: Phase 3 Myasthenia Gravis Inebilizumab Trial (MINT): Minimal Symptom Expression Achievement with Inebilizumab
abstracts.authors: Richard Nowak; Michael Benatar; Emma Ciafaloni; Maria Isabel Leite; Kimiaki Utsugisawa; John Vissing; Sarah Bray; Kristina R. Patterson; Catherine Najem; Sue Cheng; James F. Howard; Jr.
abstracts.affiliations: New Haven, CT; Miami, FL; Rochester, NY; Oxford, United Kingdom; Hanamaki, Japan; Copenhagen, Denmark; Thousand Oaks, CA; Bradenton, FL; Chapel Hill, NC
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Inebilizumab’s efficacy in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) was demonstrated in MINT, which met its primary endpoint (change from baseline in Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living [MG-ADL] score). OBJECTIVE: To determine the proportion of MINT participants who achieved minimal symptom expression (MSE) with inebilizumab. METHODS: MINT (NCT04524273) enrolled participants with anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive (AChR+; n=190) or anti-muscle-specific kinase antibody-positive (MuSK+; n=48) gMG who underwent a protocol-specified steroid taper and were randomized 1:1 to inebilizumab or placebo for 26 (MuSK+) or 52 (AChR+) weeks (Ws) (randomized controlled phase). The proportion of participants who achieved MSE (MG-ADL score 0 or 1) without rescue therapy (RT) and those who achieved ≥3- point improvements in MG-ADL or Quantitative MG (QMG) scores were examined. RESULTS: A greater proportion of participants receiving inebilizumab vs placebo achieved MSE without RT at W26 (combined, 29% vs 20%; AChR+, 27% vs 20%; MuSK+, 38% vs 17%) and W52 (AChR+, 46% vs 25%). A higher proportion of participants achieved ≥3-point improvements in MG-ADL scores without RT in the inebilizumab vs placebo group at W26 (combined, 69% vs 48%; AChR+, 68% vs 49%; MuSK+, 71% vs 46%) and W52 (AChR+, 72% vs 45%). A higher proportion of inebilizumab-treated participants achieved ≥3-point improvements in QMG scores without RT vs placebo at W26 (combined, 60% vs 41%; AChR+, 61% vs 40%; MuSK+, 57% vs 46%) and W52 (AChR+, 69% vs 42%). Data from the open-label phase will also be reported. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Inebilizumab is associated with notable improvements in disease severity and function in patients with gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Inebilizumab在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）中的疗效已在MINT中得到证实，该研究达到主要终点（重症肌无力日常生活活动量表[MG-ADL]评分较基线的变化）。目的：确定MINT参与者中接受inebilizumab后达到最小症状表达（MSE）的比例。方法：MINT（NCT04524273）入组抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR+；n=190）或抗肌肉特异性激酶抗体阳性（MuSK+；n=48）gMG参与者，这些参与者接受方案规定的激素减量，并按1:1随机分配至inebilizumab或安慰剂，治疗26周（MuSK+）或52周（AChR+）（随机对照阶段）。考察在未接受挽救治疗（RT）情况下达到MSE（MG-ADL评分0或1）的参与者比例，以及在未接受RT情况下MG-ADL或定量MG（QMG）评分改善≥3分的参与者比例。结果：与安慰剂相比，接受inebilizumab的参与者在W26达到无RT的MSE比例更高（合并，29% vs 20%；AChR+，27% vs 20%；MuSK+，38% vs 17%），在W52亦更高（AChR+，46% vs 25%）。在W26，inebilizumab组与安慰剂组相比，在未接受RT情况下MG-ADL评分改善≥3分的参与者比例更高（合并，69% vs 48%；AChR+，68% vs 49%；MuSK+，71% vs 46%），在W52亦更高（AChR+，72% vs 45%）。在W26，与安慰剂相比，接受inebilizumab治疗的参与者在未接受RT情况下QMG评分改善≥3分的比例更高（合并，60% vs 41%；AChR+，61% vs 40%；MuSK+，57% vs 46%），在W52亦更高（AChR+，69% vs 42%）。开放标签阶段数据也将报告。总结/结论：Inebilizumab与gMG患者疾病严重程度和功能的显著改善相关。

abstracts.title: Quality of Life in Myasthenia Gravis: Post Hoc Pooled Analysis of Phase 3 Rozanolixizumab Studies
abstracts.authors: Ali Habib; Zabeen Mahuwala; Renato Mantegazza; Robert Pascuzzi; Sabrina Sacconi; John Vissing; Jana Zschüntzsch; Jos Bloemers; Paul Mahoney; Thais Tarancon; Vera Bril
abstracts.affiliations: Orange, CA; Lexington, KY; Milan, Italy; Indianapolis, IN; Nice, France; Copenhagen, Denmark; Göttingen, Germany; Breda, Netherlands; Slough, United Kingdom; Madrid, Spain; Toronto, Canada
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) can significantly affect quality of life (QoL). In MycarinG (NCT03971422), one 6-week cycle of rozanolixizumab (7mg/kg or 10mg/kg) improved MG-QoL 15-item revised (MG-QoL15r) total scores compared with placebo in patients with gMG. OBJECTIVE: Evaluate the effect of long-term rozanolixizumab treatment on QoL in MycarinG and its open-label extensions MG0004 (NCT04124965) and MG0007 (NCT04650854). METHODS: In MG0004, patients received once-weekly rozanolixizumab for ≤52 weeks. In MG0007, one 6-week rozanolixizumab cycle was followed with further cycles upon symptom worsening. Final efficacy data were pooled across MycarinG, MG0004 (first 6 weeks) and MG0007 for patients with ≥2 symptom-driven cycles. Change from baseline (CFB) to Day 43 in MG-QoL15r item-level scores across Cycles 1–13 was assessed post hoc using means weighted by sample size. RESULTS: Overall, 129 patients received ≥2 symptom- driven cycles. Across 13 cycles (N=890 patient-cycles), weighted-mean scores improved for all MG-QoL15r items. Weighted-mean (standard deviation) CFB in item-level scores was: −0.4 (0.7) for “trouble using my eyes”, “trouble eating”, “bothered by limitations in performing work”, “difficulty speaking” (N=889 patient-cycles); −0.3 (0.7) for “limited social activity” and “limited ability to enjoy hobbies/fun activities”; −0.3 (0.6) for “frustrated by my MG”, “trouble meeting the needs of family”, “have to make plans around my MG”, “lost some personal independence”, “trouble walking”, “trouble getting around public places” and “overwhelmed by my MG”; −0.2 (0.5) for “depressed about my MG” and “trouble performing personal grooming”. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Long-term rozanolixizumab treatment demonstrated consistent efficacy across the range of impacts that MG symptoms have on health- related QoL. Funding: UCB.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）可显著影响生活质量（QoL）。在MycarinG研究（NCT03971422）中，一个6周周期的rozanolixizumab（7mg/kg或10mg/kg）较安慰剂改善了gMG患者的MG-QoL 15项修订版（MG-QoL15r）总分。目的：评估MycarinG及其开放标签扩展研究MG0004（NCT04124965）和MG0007（NCT04650854）中长期rozanolixizumab治疗对QoL的影响。方法：在MG0004中，患者每周接受一次rozanolixizumab，持续≤52周。在MG0007中，先接受一个6周rozanolixizumab周期，症状加重时再接受进一步周期。最终疗效数据在MycarinG、MG0004（前6周）和MG0007中接受≥2个症状驱动周期的患者中汇总。采用按样本量加权的均值，事后评估第1–13周期MG-QoL15r条目水平评分从基线至第43天的变化（CFB）。结果：总体而言，129例患者接受了≥2个症状驱动周期。在13个周期（N=890患者-周期）中，所有MG-QoL15r条目的加权平均评分均改善。条目水平评分的加权均值（标准差）CFB为：“使用眼睛有困难”、“进食有困难”、“因工作能力受限而困扰”、“说话困难”为−0.4（0.7）（N=889患者-周期）；“社交活动受限”和“享受爱好/娱乐活动的能力受限”为−0.3（0.7）；“因我的MG感到沮丧”、“难以满足家庭需求”、“必须围绕我的MG做计划”、“失去部分个人独立性”、“行走困难”、“在公共场所行动困难”和“被我的MG压垮”为−0.3（0.6）；“因我的MG感到抑郁”和“个人修饰有困难”为−0.2（0.5）。总结/结论：长期rozanolixizumab治疗在MG症状对健康相关QoL的广泛影响范围内显示出持续一致的疗效。资助：UCB。

abstracts.title: Quality of Life in Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Achieving Sustained versus Transient Clinical Outcomes in the Phase 3 VIVACITY-MG3 Trial
abstracts.authors: John Vissing; Carlo Antozzi; Kelly Gwathmey; Kavita Gandhi; Ibrahim Turkoz; Sheryl Pease; Nolan Campbell
abstracts.affiliations: Copenhagen, Denmark; Milan, Italy; Richmond, VA; Horsham, PA; Titusville, NJ; Raritan, NJ
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Minimal clinically important improvement in the Myasthenia-Gravis-Activities-of-Daily- Living (MG-ADL) score (MCI; ≥2-point improvement) or a composite response (CR) of ≥2-point improvement in MG- ADL and ≥3-point improvement in Quantitative- Myasthenia-Gravis scores are plausible treatment goals in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). OBJECTIVE: The Vivacity-MG3 post hoc analysis was conducted to evaluate health-related quality-of-life (HRQoL) in patients achieving sustained versus transient MCI or CR. METHODS: Nipocalimab- and placebo-treated patients were stratified by MCI or CR status over the 24-week double-blind phase: never achieved MCI/CR (No-MCI/CR), achieved MCI/CR sustained ≥8 weeks (sustained- MCI/CR), or achieved MCI/CR ≥1 time but not sustained for ≥8 weeks (transient-MCI/CR). Mean changes from baseline (CFB) to week 24 (W24) in MGQoL-15 revised (15r) and Neuro-QoL Fatigue scores were compared across groups using ANCOVA models. RESULTS: The MCI analysis included 129 patients (91 sustained-MCI, 29 transient-MCI, 9 no-MCI); the CR analysis included 125 patients (50 sustained-CR, 37 transient-CR, 38 no-CR). Sustained- versus transient-MCI patients demonstrated greater improvements in MGQoL-15r (least-square-mean CFB, −6.2 versus −2.0, p<0.001). Additionally, the sustained-MCI group had greater improvements in Neuro-QoL Fatigue (−19.5) versus transient-MCI (−7.5, p<0.001) and no-MCI (−8.5, p=0.04). Similarly, sustained-CR patients demonstrated greater improvements in MGQoL-15r (−9.6) versus transient-CR (−5.4, p<0.001) and no-CR (−3.6, p<0.001) and in Neuro-QoL fatigue (−29.2) versus transient-CR (−16.4, p<0.001) and no-CR (−12.2, p<0.001). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Patients achieving sustained versus transient MCI or CR demonstrated greater improvements in HRQoL and fatigue, suggesting 8-week sustained outcomes may be more impactful treatment goals than short-term transient response for gMG patients receiving advanced treatments.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力日常生活活动（MG-ADL）评分达到最小临床重要改善（MCI；≥2分改善）或复合应答（CR；MG-ADL改善≥2分且定量重症肌无力评分改善≥3分）是全身型重症肌无力（gMG）合理的治疗目标。目的：Vivacity-MG3事后分析旨在评估达到持续性与一过性MCI或CR患者的健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）。方法：在24周双盲期内，接受nipocalimab和安慰剂治疗的患者按MCI或CR状态分层：从未达到MCI/CR（No-MCI/CR）、达到MCI/CR并持续≥8周（sustained-MCI/CR）、或至少达到MCI/CR 1次但未持续≥8周（transient-MCI/CR）。采用ANCOVA模型比较各组MGQoL-15修订版（15r）和Neuro-QoL疲劳评分从基线至第24周（W24）的平均变化（CFB）。结果：MCI分析纳入129例患者（91例持续-MCI、29例一过性-MCI、9例无-MCI）；CR分析纳入125例患者（50例持续-CR、37例一过性-CR、38例无-CR）。持续-MCI与一过性-MCI患者相比，MGQoL-15r改善更大（最小二乘均值CFB，−6.2对−2.0，p<0.001）。此外，持续-MCI组Neuro-QoL疲劳改善（−19.5）大于一过性-MCI（−7.5，p<0.001）和无-MCI（−8.5，p=0.04）。同样，持续-CR患者MGQoL-15r改善（−9.6）大于一过性-CR（−5.4，p<0.001）和无-CR（−3.6，p<0.001），Neuro-QoL疲劳改善（−29.2）大于一过性-CR（−16.4，p<0.001）和无-CR（−12.2，p<0.001）。总结/结论：达到持续性而非一过性MCI或CR的患者HRQoL和疲劳改善更大，提示对于接受先进治疗的gMG患者，8周持续结局可能比短期一过性应答是更有影响力的治疗目标。

abstracts.title: Quality of Life in Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Achieving Sustained vs Transient Minimal Symptom Expression in the Phase 3 VIVACITY-MG3 Trial
abstracts.authors: Elena Cortés-Vicente; Nolan Campbell; Kavita Gandhi; Marie Fitzgibbon; Ibrahim Turkoz
abstracts.affiliations: Barcelona, Spain; Horsham, PA; Raritan, NJ; Titusville, NJ
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Phase-3 Vivacity-MG3 study (NCT04951622) demonstrated sustained disease control in patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) receiving nipocalimab+standard-of-care (SOC) vs those receiving placebo+SOC. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate minimal symptom expression (MSE, Myasthenia Gravis-Activities of Daily Living score: ≤1) and quality-of-life-(QoL) in patients achieving sustained vs transient MSE in Vivacity-MG3. METHODS: Seropositive patients from the study were stratified into groups based on MSE status over the 24- week double-blind phase: never achieved MSE (no MSE), achieved MSE and sustained for ≥8 weeks (sustained- MSE), or achieved MSE at least once but not sustained for ≥8 weeks (transient-MSE). Logistic regression models compared likelihood (odds ratio [OR]) of achieving sustained- or transient-MSE for nipocalimab+SOC vs placebo+SOC. Myasthenia-Gravis-QoL-(Revised)- Instrument (MG-QoL-15r) total score least-squares mean (LSM) change from baseline (CFB) to week 24 (W24) were compared across MSE groups. RESULTS: Of 153 patients overall, 35 achieved MSE by W24 (nipocalimab+SOC, n=24/77; placebo+SOC, n=11/76); 19 had sustained MSE (nipocalimab+SOC, n=15/77; placebo+SOC, n=4/76). Nipocalimab-treated patients were significantly more likely to achieve sustained MSE (OR [95% CI]: 4.35 [1.37, 13.81], p=0.013) vs placebo. At W24, sustained MSE patients demonstrated significantly greater improvements in MG-QoL-15r (CFB LSM [95% CI]: −12.7 [−16.3, −9.2]) vs transient-MSE (−8.7 [−12.5, −5.0], p=0.016) and vs no MSE (−4.1 [−7.0, −1.3], p<0.001). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Nipocalimab-treated patients were 4-times more likely to achieve and sustain MSE for ≥8-weeks than placebo when added to SOC. Those achieving sustained-MSE demonstrated greater improvements on MG-QoL-15r scores than those with transient-MSE. Sustained-MSE is an important and impactful treatment goal for gMG patients receiving advanced treatments.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：3期Vivacity-MG3研究（NCT04951622）显示，接受nipocalimab+标准治疗（SOC）的全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者较安慰剂+SOC患者获得持续疾病控制。目的：评估Vivacity-MG3中达到持续性与一过性最小症状表达（MSE，重症肌无力日常生活活动评分≤1）患者的MSE和生活质量（QoL）。方法：研究中的血清阳性患者根据24周双盲期内的MSE状态分层：从未达到MSE（no MSE）、达到MSE并持续≥8周（sustained-MSE）、或至少达到MSE 1次但未持续≥8周（transient-MSE）。采用logistic回归模型比较nipocalimab+SOC与安慰剂+SOC达到持续性或一过性MSE的可能性（比值比[OR]）。比较各MSE组重症肌无力生活质量修订版量表（MG-QoL-15r）总分从基线至第24周（W24）的最小二乘均值（LSM）变化（CFB）。结果：总体153例患者中，35例至W24达到MSE（nipocalimab+SOC，n=24/77；安慰剂+SOC，n=11/76）；19例为持续MSE（nipocalimab+SOC，n=15/77；安慰剂+SOC，n=4/76）。nipocalimab治疗患者达到持续MSE的可能性显著高于安慰剂（OR [95% CI]：4.35 [1.37, 13.81]，p=0.013）。至W24，持续MSE患者MG-QoL-15r改善显著大于一过性MSE（CFB LSM [95% CI]：−12.7 [−16.3, −9.2]对−8.7 [−12.5, −5.0]，p=0.016）和无MSE（−4.1 [−7.0, −1.3]，p<0.001）。总结/结论：在SOC基础上，nipocalimab治疗患者达到并持续MSE≥8周的可能性是安慰剂的4倍。达到持续MSE的患者MG-QoL-15r评分改善大于一过性MSE患者。对于接受先进治疗的gMG患者，持续MSE是一个重要且有影响力的治疗目标。

abstracts.title: Rozanolixizumab for Ocular Myasthenia Gravis: Study Design of a Phase 3, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Trial (Myvision) and Open-label Extension Study (Myvision-XT)
abstracts.authors: Suraj Muley; Ibironke Addy; Jos Bloemers; Sarah Cluck; Denis Flemm; Yamina Merazga; Sebastian Zamorano; Mark Kupersmith; Pushpa Narayanaswami
abstracts.affiliations: Phoenix, AZ; Monheim, Germany; Breda, Netherlands; Slough, United Kingdom; New York, NY; Farchim, Switzerland; Boston, MA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Ocular myasthenia gravis (oMG) affects only the ocular muscles, causing ptosis and/or diplopia. Diagnostic challenges and limited effective treatment options place a significant burden on oMG patients and can lead to suboptimal outcomes. Approximately 50% of patients may progress from ocular to generalized MG (gMG) within 1 year of onset. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the efficacy and long-term safety and tolerability of rozanolixizumab, a neonatal fragment crystallizable receptor blocker, in patients with oMG. METHODS: MyVision (MG0038/NCT07463521) is a Phase 3, multicenter, randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind study that will enroll ≥120 adults with acetylcholine receptor/muscle-specific tyrosine kinase autoantibody-positive or seronegative Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America Class I MG. Enrolled patients will have an MG Impairment Index (MGII) ocular score (patient-reported outcome [PRO] part) of ≥6 with ≥2 ocular items scoring ≥2 at both screening and baseline. Patients will be randomized 1:1 to receive weekly rozanolixizumab (dose based on approved gMG indication) or placebo for 6 weeks (one treatment cycle), followed by an observation period of up to 7 weeks. Eligible patients can enroll in the open-label extension study MyVision-XT (MG0039/NCT07465289) to receive further treatment cycles based on symptom worsening for up to 2 years. Primary outcomes are change from baseline to Day 43 in MGII ocular score (PRO part) in MyVision, and the incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events in MyVision-XT. RESULTS: The MyVision study is ongoing and currently recruiting patients. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: The Phase 3 MyVision and open-label extension studies will provide data on the efficacy and long-term safety of rozanolixizumab for the treatment of oMG. Funding: UCB.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：眼型重症肌无力（oMG）仅影响眼肌，导致上睑下垂和/或复视。诊断挑战和有限的有效治疗选择给oMG患者带来显著负担，并可能导致次优结局。约50%的患者可能在发病1年内从眼型进展为全身型MG（gMG）。目的：评估rozanolixizumab（一种新生儿Fc受体阻断剂）在oMG患者中的疗效及长期安全性和耐受性。方法：MyVision（MG0038/NCT07463521）是一项3期、多中心、随机、安慰剂对照、双盲研究，将入组≥120例乙酰胆碱受体/肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶自身抗体阳性或血清阴性的美国重症肌无力基金会I类MG成人患者。入组患者在筛选和基线时MG损害指数（MGII）眼部评分（患者报告结局[PRO]部分）≥6，且≥2个眼部条目评分≥2。患者按1:1随机接受每周rozanolixizumab（剂量基于已批准的gMG适应证）或安慰剂治疗6周（一个治疗周期），随后观察期最长7周。符合条件患者可进入开放标签扩展研究MyVision-XT（MG0039/NCT07465289），根据症状加重接受进一步治疗周期，最长2年。主要结局为MyVision中MGII眼部评分（PRO部分）从基线至第43天的变化，以及MyVision-XT中治疗中出现的不良事件发生率。结果：MyVision研究正在进行中，目前正在招募患者。总结/结论：3期MyVision及开放标签扩展研究将提供rozanolixizumab治疗oMG的疗效和长期安全性数据。资助：UCB。

abstracts.title: Time to Response and Minimal Symptom Expression with Gefurulimab in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis (gMG): 52-week Results from the Phase 3 Prevail Trial
abstracts.authors: Alexis Lizarraga; Mazen Dimachkie; Ha Young Shin; Shulian Shang; Sanjay Rakhade; Mathias Maurer
abstracts.affiliations: Rochester, NY; Kansas City, KS; Seoul, South Korea; Boston, MA; Würzburg, Germany
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Efficacy of gefurulimab, a novel dual- binding nanobody that blocks C5 activation, was demonstrated in adults with anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive (AChR-Ab+) gMG in the phase 3 PREVAIL trial (NCT05556096). OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the time to clinically meaningful responses and the proportion of patients achieving minimal symptom expression (MSE) with gefurulimab in the ongoing PREVAIL trial. METHODS: This post hoc analysis used data through 52 weeks (26-week randomized controlled treatment [RCT]; 26-week open-label extension [OLE]) to evaluate the timing of response in patients receiving gefurulimab in both RCT and OLE, measured as the time to first responses on MG-ADL (≥2- and ≥3-point reductions in total score from RCT baseline) and QMG (≥3- and ≥5- point reductions). Proportions of patients meeting the same response thresholds (response rate) and those achieving MSE were also evaluated. RESULTS: Overall, 131 patients were randomized to gefurulimab; 127 completed RCT and entered the OLE. The median (95% CI) time to first response was 1.3 (1.3- 2.1) and 2.3 (2.0-3.3) weeks for ≥2- and ≥3-point reductions in MG-ADL total score, respectively, and 4.3 (4.1-8.1) and 14.1 (8.1-30.3) weeks for ≥3- and ≥5-point reductions in QMG total score (n=131). Response rates across all OLE assessments were 72.2%-85.7% for ≥3- point MG-ADL score reduction and 48.4%-58.5% for ≥5- point QMG score reduction. MSE was achieved by 58/131 (44.3%) patients at any visit during 52 weeks; median (range) duration of total cumulative MSE was 25.9 (0.1- 51.1) weeks. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Through 52 weeks in PREVAIL, gefurulimab treatment resulted in early onset of clinically meaningful responses and durable MSE.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：gefurulimab是一种新型双结合纳米抗体，可阻断C5激活；其在抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）全身型肌无力（gMG）成人患者中的疗效已在3期PREVAIL试验（NCT05556096）中得到证实。目的：评估正在进行的PREVAIL试验中gefurulimab达到临床有意义应答的时间以及达到最小症状表达（MSE）的患者比例。方法：本事后分析使用截至52周的数据（26周随机对照治疗[RCT]；26周开放标签扩展[OLE]），评估在RCT和OLE中接受gefurulimab治疗患者的应答时间，测量指标为MG-ADL（总分较RCT基线降低≥2分和≥3分）和QMG（降低≥3分和≥5分）首次应答的时间。还评估了达到相同应答阈值的患者比例（应答率）以及达到MSE的患者比例。结果：总体而言，131例患者被随机分配至gefurulimab；127例完成RCT并进入OLE。MG-ADL总分降低≥2分和≥3分的首次应答中位时间（95% CI）分别为1.3（1.3-2.1）周和2.3（2.0-3.3）周；QMG总分降低≥3分和≥5分的首次应答中位时间分别为4.3（4.1-8.1）周和14.1（8.1-30.3）周（n=131）。在所有OLE评估中，MG-ADL评分降低≥3分的应答率为72.2%-85.7%，QMG评分降低≥5分的应答率为48.4%-58.5%。在52周内任何访视时，58/131（44.3%）例患者达到MSE；总累积MSE的中位（范围）持续时间为25.9（0.1-51.1）周。总结/结论：在PREVAIL试验中，截至52周，gefurulimab治疗导致临床有意义应答的早期出现和持久的MSE。

abstracts.title: Comparing Efficacy and Safety of Various Monoclonal Antibodies in Myasthenia Gravis: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
abstracts.authors: Waseem, Hassan; ul Abideen, Zain; Iqbal, Minahil; Ishtiaq, Saniya; Chen, Justin; Pitton Rissardo, Jamir; Fornari Caprara, Ana Leticia; Byroju, Vishnu; Lucke-Wold, Brandon; Dmytriw, Adam
abstracts.affiliations: Allama Iqbal Medical College, Lahore, Pakistan; King Edward Medical University, Lahore, Pakistan; Rawalpindi Medical University, Rawalpindi, Pakistan; Texas A&M College of Medicine, College Station, TX; Cooper University Hospital, Camden, NJ; Cooper University Healthcare, Camden, NJ; University of Florida, Morgantown, WV; Massachusetts General Hospital, Boston, MA
abstracts.abstract: Objective: This network meta-analysis aims to compare the safety and effectiveness of various doses of monoclonal antibodies used in Myasthenia Gravis (MG) treatment. Background: MG is an autoimmune disorder that causes muscle weakness due to disrupted synaptic transmission. Several monoclonal antibodies have been developed to treat MG. Design/Methods: PubMed, Cochrane Central, and ScienceDirect were searched through June 2025. A frequentist network meta-analysis was conducted using the "meta” and “netmeta” packages in RStudio version 4.3.3. Treatment rankings were determined by p-scores. Risk ratios (RRs) and mean differences (MD) were pooled for dichotomous and continuous outcomes to estimate the network effects. Quality assessment was done using the Cochrane Risk of Bias (RoB) 2.0 tool. Results: Eighteen randomized controlled trials (RCTs) were included in this network meta-analysis. Rozanolixzumab (ROZ) 10 mg/kg significantly decreased the MG Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) score compared to placebo (MD= -2.33; 95%CI:[-3.60, -1.06]; p = 0.0003) and was ranked best (p-score = 0.77) regarding this outcome. Batoclimab (BAT) 680 mg significantly reduced the Quantitative MG (QMG) score compared to placebo (MD= -5.17; 95%CI:[-6.44, -3.89]; p <0.0001) and was rated the top performer (p-score = 0.96) for this endpoint. Regarding the MG Composite (MGC) score, BAT 340 mg was ranked best (p-score = 0.82). Eculizumab (ECU) was ranked best (p-score = 0.93) regarding the 15-item revised MG Quality of Life (MG-QoL 15r) score. Belimumab (BEL) 10 mg/kg was ranked best in terms of adverse events (p-score = 0.87). Conclusions: ROZ 10 mg/kg ranked best for MG-ADL. BAT 680 mg significantly reduced QMG and ranked best. BAT 340 mg was best for MGC. ECU significantly decreased MG-QoL 15r and ranked best. BEL 10 mg/kg was ranked best regarding adverse events.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：本网络荟萃分析旨在比较用于重症肌无力（MG）治疗的各种剂量单克隆抗体的安全性和有效性。背景：MG是一种由于突触传递中断而导致肌肉无力的自身免疫性疾病。已有多种单克隆抗体被开发用于治疗MG。设计/方法：检索了截至2025年6月的PubMed、Cochrane Central和ScienceDirect。使用RStudio 4.3.3版本中的“meta”和“netmeta”包进行了频率学派网络荟萃分析。通过p评分确定治疗排名。合并二分类和连续结局的风险比（RR）和均值差（MD）以估计网络效应。使用Cochrane偏倚风险（RoB）2.0工具进行质量评估。结果：本网络荟萃分析纳入了18项随机对照试验（RCT）。与安慰剂相比，Rozanolixzumab (ROZ) 10 mg/kg显著降低了MG日常生活活动（MG-ADL）评分（MD= -2.33；95%CI:[-3.60, -1.06]；p = 0.0003），并且在该结局中排名最佳（p评分 = 0.77）。与安慰剂相比，Batoclimab (BAT) 680 mg显著降低了定量MG（QMG）评分（MD= -5.17；95%CI:[-6.44, -3.89]；p <0.0001），并且在该终点被评为最佳表现者（p评分 = 0.96）。关于MG复合（MGC）评分，BAT 340 mg排名最佳（p评分 = 0.82）。关于15项修订版MG生活质量（MG-QoL 15r）评分，Eculizumab (ECU) 排名最佳（p评分 = 0.93）。关于不良事件，Belimumab (BEL) 10 mg/kg排名最佳（p评分 = 0.87）。结论：ROZ 10 mg/kg在MG-ADL方面排名最佳。BAT 680 mg显著降低QMG并排名最佳。BAT 340 mg在MGC方面最佳。ECU显著降低MG-QoL 15r并排名最佳。BEL 10 mg/kg在不良事件方面排名最佳。

abstracts.conferenceFullName: 2026 American Academy of Neurology Annual Meeting Abstracts
abstracts.title: Comparing the Efficacy of Ravulizumab Versus Efgartigimod Among AChR-AB Positive Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Ismail, Muhammad; Bao, Fen; Elkhooly, Mahmoud
abstracts.affiliations: Minia University, Minia, Egypt; Wayne State University, Detroit, MI; Southern Illinois University, Springfield, IL
abstracts.abstract: Objective: This study examined the effect of ravulizumab and efgartigimod on various functional scales, including Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG). Background: Biological therapies that target the antibodies and interfere with their functions, such as the complement inhibitor (ravulizumab) or the neonatal FC receptor agonist (efgartigimod), have been recently approved for Acetylcholine receptor (AChR)-AB positive myasthenia gravis (MG), but their comparative effects on the functional scales are lacking. Design/Methods: A comprehensive literature search and analysis of PubMed, Google Scholar, and Scopus were conducted from January 1, 2015, to October 10, 2025. Each research study that evaluated the effects of ravulizumab and efgartigimod on different functional scales has been collected. RevMan software conducted a meta-analysis, and the effect size with subgroup analysis has been computed. Results: Three studies have been identified, all of which are randomized controlled trials. Functional scales were compared at the baseline and at 26 weeks of treatment. One hundred twenty-seven patients received ravulizumab, while 76 patients received efgartigimod. The overall mean difference among both medications was MD -2.0 (95% CI -1.59 to 1.2), P<0.78). Upon further subgroup analysis, the mean difference for the effect on MG-ADL and QMG was (MD=0.26, 95% CI -1.35 to 1.98, P=0.76) and (MD=-1.11, 95% CI -3.52 to 1.30, P=0.37), respectively. Conclusions: Although there is some evidence that efgartigimod provides rapid improvement, there is no difference among the medications in the longer duration. A further head-to-head trial is needed with a longer duration.

abstracts.sessionName: P9: Neuromuscular and Clinical Neurophysiology (EMG): Myasthenia Gravis Clinical Trials
abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：本研究考察了ravulizumab和efgartigimod对各种功能量表的影响，包括重症肌无力日常生活活动（MG-ADL）和定量重症肌无力（QMG）。背景：靶向抗体并干扰其功能的生物疗法，如补体抑制剂（ravulizumab）或新生儿Fc受体激动剂（efgartigimod），最近已被批准用于乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体阳性的重症肌无力（MG），但缺乏它们对功能量表影响的比较效果。设计/方法：对PubMed、Google Scholar和Scopus进行了全面的文献检索和分析，时间范围为2015年1月1日至2025年10月10日。收集了每项评估ravulizumab和efgartigimod对不同功能量表影响的研究。使用RevMan软件进行荟萃分析，并计算了效应量及亚组分析。结果：确定了三项研究，均为随机对照试验。在基线和治疗26周时比较了功能量表。127名患者接受了ravulizumab，而76名患者接受了efgartigimod。两种药物的总体均值差为MD -2.0（95% CI -1.59至1.2），P<0.78）。进一步的亚组分析显示，对MG-ADL和QMG影响的均值差分别为（MD=0.26，95% CI -1.35至1.98，P=0.76）和（MD=-1.11，95% CI -3.52至1.30，P=0.37）。结论：尽管有一些证据表明efgartigimod能提供快速改善，但在较长时间内两种药物之间没有差异。需要进行更长时间的进一步头对头试验。

abstracts.title: Effects of Cladribine on Immune Cell Subsets and Autoantibody Responses in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells in Vitro
abstracts.authors: Wu, Yin; Järvinen, Elina; Jack, Dominic; Derfuss, Tobias; Sun, Chia Chi
abstracts.affiliations: EMD Serono, Billerica, MA, USA, MA; Merck OY, Espoo, Finland (an affiliate of Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany), Finland; Merck Serono Ltd., Feltham, UK (an affiliate of Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany), United Kingdom; Department of Biomedicine, University of Basel, Basel, Switzerland, Switzerland; Departments of Neurology and Immunobiology, Yale School of Medicine, New Haven, CN, USA, CT
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To investigate the functional effects of cladribine on immune cells from generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs). Background: gMG is a B cell-driven, T cell-dependent, autoimmune disease characterized by autoantibody production. Cladribine incorporates into B and T lymphocytes, leading to their selective and temporal depletion. Cladribine tablets are approved for relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, while cladribine capsules are under evaluation for gMG in a Phase 3 clinical trial (MyClad; NCT06463587). Design/Methods: Whole blood was collected from people with gMG. Isolated PBMCs were treated with cladribine in vitro and stimulated to activate B and T cell proliferation or induce plasma cell differentiation. Flow cytometry was used to assess cladribine half-maximal inhibitory concentrations (IC 50) on cell depletion, cell proliferation, and plasma cell differentiation. Total IgG and anti-AChR IgG levels were analyzed using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays. Results: Cladribine demonstrated concentration-dependent depletion of naïve and proliferating B and T cell subsets, memory-B cells and plasmablasts in gMG PBMCs (n=10). IC 50 for total B cells = 0.03–0.06µM; T cells = 0.07–0.12µM; CD20 + T cells = 0.9µM [n=10]). In a plasma cell differentiation assay, cladribine reduced gMG plasma cells/plasmablasts (IC 50 =0.06µM; n=2), reduced production of IgG (IC 50 =0.3µM; n=12), and inhibited anti-AChR IgG production at 0.06 and 0.6µM; n=2. Conclusions: Cladribine, at concentrations intended to mimic the plasma exposure of people with gMG treated with oral cladribine, depletes B and T cell subsets, inhibits plasma cell differentiation, and reduces IgG and anti-AChR IgG production in gMG PBMCs in vitro. These data suggest that cladribine targets drivers of autoimmunity in gMG, supporting the upstream mechanism of cladribine in reducing autoantibody production in gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：研究克拉屈滨对全身型重症肌无力（gMG）外周血单个核细胞（PBMCs）免疫细胞的功能影响。背景：gMG是一种由B细胞驱动、T细胞依赖的自身免疫性疾病，其特征是自身抗体产生。克拉屈滨可进入B和T淋巴细胞，导致其选择性和暂时性耗竭。克拉屈滨片剂已获批用于复发型多发性硬化症，而克拉屈滨胶囊正在一项针对gMG的3期临床试验（MyClad；NCT06463587）中进行评估。设计/方法：从gMG患者采集全血。分离的PBMCs在体外用克拉屈滨处理，并刺激以激活B和T细胞增殖或诱导浆细胞分化。使用流式细胞术评估克拉屈滨在细胞耗竭、细胞增殖和浆细胞分化方面的半数最大抑制浓度（IC 50）。使用酶联免疫吸附试验分析总IgG和抗AChR IgG水平。结果：克拉屈滨在gMG PBMCs（n=10）中显示出对初始和增殖的B和T细胞亚群、记忆B细胞和浆母细胞的浓度依赖性耗竭。总B细胞的IC 50 = 0.03–0.06µM；T细胞= 0.07–0.12µM；CD20 + T细胞= 0.9µM [n=10]）。在浆细胞分化试验中，克拉屈滨减少了gMG浆细胞/浆母细胞（IC 50 =0.06µM；n=2），减少了IgG的产生（IC 50 =0.3µM；n=12），并在0.06和0.6µM浓度下抑制了抗AChR IgG的产生（n=2）。结论：在旨在模拟口服克拉屈滨治疗的gMG患者血浆暴露浓度的条件下，克拉屈滨在体外可耗竭gMG PBMCs中的B和T细胞亚群，抑制浆细胞分化，并减少IgG和抗AChR IgG的产生。这些数据表明克拉屈滨靶向gMG自身免疫的驱动因素，支持克拉屈滨在减少gMG自身抗体产生中的上游机制。

abstracts.title: Efgartigimod is a Unique FcRn Blocker That Allows IgG Reduction Without Broad Inhibition of Immune Responses
abstracts.authors: Steeland, Sophie; Heerlein, Kristin; Binazon, Ornella; Moshir, Mahan; Verhamme, Fien; Gistelinck, Fien; Podhorna, Jana
abstracts.affiliations: argenx, Belgium
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To investigate the effect of efgartigimod treatment on immune responses to vaccination. Background: Treatment with some immunosuppressive and B-cell–depleting therapies may lead to increased risk of severe infections in patients and may reduce immunogenicity of vaccines. Previous studies have demonstrated that efgartigimod, a human IgG1 antibody Fc fragment that reduces levels of IgG (including pathogenic autoantibodies) through neonatal Fc receptor blockade, does not impair cellular and humoral immune responses to antigenic challenges. Rates and severities of severe infections have been similar between efgartigimod- and placebo-treated participants in placebo-controlled studies and have not increased during long-term open-label studies. Design/Methods: Across several clinical studies in healthy volunteers and in participants with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (CIDP), immune thrombocytopenia (ITP), and pemphigus vulgaris (PV), intravenous efgartigimod or subcutaneous efgartigimod PH20 was administered in various dosing regimens. Vaccine-specific IgG titers and cellular immunity were assessed at multiple timepoints, including prevaccination, ≥4 weeks postvaccination, and ≤1 week after fourth efgartigimod administration (maximal IgG reduction). Results: In participants receiving efgartigimod, antigen–specific IgG titers increased from prevaccination to postvaccination, even during maximal IgG reduction. Additional data demonstrating preservation of cellular immune responses during efgartigimod treatment will be presented. Conclusions: Efgartigimod’s unique structure as an Fc fragment selectively reduces IgG antibodies and autoantibodies while preserving the ability to mount antigen-specific responses to immunization. This mechanism avoids both broader impacts on immunity and increased risk of infections observed with some immunosuppressive and B-cell–depleting therapies.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：研究efgartigimod治疗对疫苗接种免疫反应的影响。背景：使用某些免疫抑制剂和B细胞耗竭疗法可能导致患者严重感染风险增加，并可能降低疫苗的免疫原性。既往研究表明，efgartigimod（一种通过新生儿Fc受体阻断降低IgG（包括致病性自身抗体）水平的人IgG1抗体Fc片段）不会损害对抗原刺激的细胞和体液免疫反应。在安慰剂对照研究中，efgartigimod组和安慰剂组患者的严重感染发生率和严重程度相似，并且在长期开放标签研究中未增加。设计/方法：在健康志愿者以及全身型重症肌无力（gMG）、慢性炎性脱髓鞘性多发性神经病（CIDP）、免疫性血小板减少症（ITP）和寻常型天疱疮（PV）参与者的多项临床研究中，静脉注射efgartigimod或皮下注射efgartigimod PH20采用了多种给药方案。在多个时间点评估了疫苗特异性IgG滴度和细胞免疫，包括疫苗接种前、疫苗接种后≥4周以及第四次efgartimod给药后≤1周（最大IgG降低时）。结果：在接受efgartigimod的参与者中，即使在最大IgG降低期间，抗原特异性IgG滴度也从疫苗接种前增加到疫苗接种后。将提供显示efgartigimod治疗期间细胞免疫反应得以保留的额外数据。结论：Efgartigimod作为Fc片段的独特结构可选择性地降低IgG抗体和自身抗体，同时保留对免疫接种产生抗原特异性反应的能力。这种机制避免了使用某些免疫抑制剂和B细胞耗竭疗法时观察到的对免疫力的更广泛影响和感染风险的增加。

abstracts.title: Post-hoc Analysis of Descartes-08, BCMA-directed mRNA CAR-T Therapy, in Biologic Non-responsive Versus Biologic Naive Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Results from a Phase 2b Randomized Trial
abstracts.authors: Miljkovic, Milos; Vu, Tuan; Durmus, Hacer; Jewell, Christopher; Kamboh, Hafsa; Rybak, Eva; Fedak, Renee; Mozaffar, Tahseen; Howard, James
abstracts.affiliations: Cartesian, Gaithersburg, MD; University of South Florida, Tampa, FL; Department of Neurology, Istanbul Faculty of Medicine, Istanbul, Turkey; Cartesian, Frederick, MD; Cartesian, Gaithersburg, MD; Cartesian, MA; Cartesian, MD; University of California Irvine, Orange, CA; The University of North Carolina, Dept of Neurology, CB 7025, Chapel Hill, NC
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To compare the effects of Descartes-08 in biologic non-responsive and biologic naive patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). Background: Descartes-08 is an autologous, BCMA-directed mRNA chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy designed for outpatient administration without lymphodepleting chemotherapy. In a Phase 2b randomized study, treatment with Descartes-08 resulted in significant improvements in MG severity scores compared to placebo. This post-hoc analysis examined the impact of prior biologic drug exposure on outcomes. Design/Methods: Adults with non-MuSK+ gMG and MG-ADL ≥6 requiring immunosuppression were randomized 1:1 to receive six once-weekly infusions of Descartes-08 or placebo. For this post-hoc analysis, participants with exposure to CD20-targeting drugs, FcRn or complement inhibitors were deemed “biologic non-responders." Efficacy endpoints included mean change from baseline in MG-ADL and QMG scores at Month 3 through Month 12. Additional analyses explored serum cytokines as immune biomarkers of treatment response. Results: In the modified intent-to-treat population, 15 participants were randomized to Descartes-08 and 11 to placebo. In the biologic naive population (n=14), mean (SD) reduction in MG-ADL and QMG at Month 3 was -5.2(1.1) and -5.0(1.3) (Descrartes-08) versus -3.0(2.1) and -4.0(1.8) (placebo), respectively, and improved further at Month 12 (MG-ADL -7.1[1.9] and QMG -9.4[2.6]). In biologic non-responsive patients (n=12), mean (SD) reduction in MG-ADL and QMG at Month 3 was -2.5(1.3) and -2.2(2.0) (Descartes-08) versus -0.5(1.4) and 0.5(1.4) (placebo) and at Month 12, -2.0(0.7) and -3.0(1.9), respectively. Post-infusion differences in several key cytokines were noted between the two groups. Infusion-related reactions were the most common adverse events, with no cytopenia, infections, hypogammaglobulinemia, CRS or ICANS. Conclusions: Both biologic non-responders and the biologic naive participants had greater improvement in MG efficacy measures after Descartes-08 compared to placebo, with greater depth of response in the biologic naive group. Changes in key cytokines may underpin the differential response.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：比较Descartes-08在生物制剂无应答和生物制剂初治的全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者中的疗效。背景：Descartes-08是一种自体、BCMA靶向的mRNA嵌合抗原受体（CAR）T细胞疗法，设计用于门诊给药，无需淋巴细胞清除化疗。在一项2b期随机研究中，与安慰剂相比，Descartes-08治疗使MG严重程度评分显著改善。本事后分析探讨了既往生物制剂暴露对结局的影响。设计/方法：患有非MuSK+ gMG且MG-ADL≥6、需要免疫抑制治疗的成人按1:1随机分配，接受六次每周一次的Descartes-08或安慰剂输注。在本事后分析中，曾暴露于CD20靶向药物、FcRn或补体抑制剂的参与者被定义为“生物制剂无应答者”。疗效终点包括从基线至第3个月至第12个月MG-ADL和QMG评分的平均变化。额外分析探索了血清细胞因子作为治疗反应的免疫生物标志物。结果：在改良意向治疗人群中，15名参与者被随机分配至Descartes-08组，11名分配至安慰剂组。在生物制剂初治人群中（n=14），第3个月时MG-ADL和QMG的平均（SD）降低分别为-5.2（1.1）和-5.0（1.3）（Descartes-08组）对比-3.0（2.1）和-4.0（1.8）（安慰剂组），并在第12个月时进一步改善（MG-ADL -7.1[1.9]和QMG -9.4[2.6]）。在生物制剂无应答患者中（n=12），第3个月时MG-ADL和QMG的平均（SD）降低分别为-2.5（1.3）和-2.2（2.0）（Descartes-08组）对比-0.5（1.4）和0.5（1.4）（安慰剂组），在第12个月时分别为-2.0（0.7）和-3.0（1.9）。两组之间在输注后观察到几种关键细胞因子的差异。输注相关反应是最常见的不良事件，未出现血细胞减少、感染、低丙种球蛋白血症、CRS或ICANS。结论：与安慰剂相比，生物制剂无应答者和生物制剂初治参与者在接受Descartes-08治疗后，MG疗效指标均有更大改善，其中生物制剂初治组的应答深度更大。关键细胞因子的变化可能是差异反应的基础。

abstracts.title: Real-World Efficacy and Safety of Inebilizumab in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Li, Huining; Zhang, Chao; Jia, Dongmei; Pan, Jing; Wu, Ti
abstracts.affiliations: Tianjin Medical University General Hospital, Tianjin, China, People's Republic of; Tianjin Medical University General Hospital, China, People's Republic of
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To evaluate the real-world efficacy and safety of inebilizumab in patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). Background: Autoimmune gMG is characterized by fluctuating muscle weakness driven by pathogenic autoantibodies. Inebilizumab, a humanized monoclonal antibody targeting CD19, induces broad B-cell depletion and may mitigate disease activity by eliminating antibody-secreting cells, which are central to disease pathogenesis. Design/Methods: We retrospectively analyzed five patients with gMG (three acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive and two muscle-specific kinase antibody-positive) who received inebilizumab over a 15-month period. Concomitant glucocorticoids were tapered to a target dose of 5 mg/day. Clinical outcomes—including Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL), Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG), Myasthenia Gravis Composite (MGC), and MG Quality of Life 15-item scale (MG-QoL15)—were assessed at each visit. Results: Mean score changes from baseline to 15 months were QMG (−5.6), MG-ADL (−4.0), MGC (−6.4), and MG-QoL15 (−5.8). All patients achieved a prednisone dose of ≤5 mg/day by month 15. Serum IgM levels declined below the lower limit of normal in all patients, IgG levels were subnormal in two patients, and IgA levels remained stable. Reported adverse events included pneumonia and herpes zoster. Conclusions: Long-term B cell depletion with inebilizumab demonstrated sustained efficacy in reducing disease activity for generalized MG with controllable immune function impacts，making it a favorable option for gMG patients.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：评估inebilizumab在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者中的真实世界疗效和安全性。背景：自身免疫性gMG的特征是由致病性自身抗体驱动的波动性肌无力。Inebilizumab是一种靶向CD19的人源化单克隆抗体，可诱导广泛的B细胞耗竭，并可能通过消除在疾病发病机制中起核心作用的抗体分泌细胞来减轻疾病活动。设计/方法：我们回顾性分析了在15个月期间接受inebilizumab治疗的五名gMG患者（三名乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性和两名肌肉特异性激酶抗体阳性）。伴随的糖皮质激素逐渐减量至目标剂量5 mg/天。每次访视时评估临床结局——包括重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）、定量重症肌无力评分（QMG）、重症肌无力复合量表（MGC）和MG生活质量15项量表（MG-QoL15）。结果：从基线到15个月的平均评分变化为QMG（-5.6）、MG-ADL（-4.0）、MGC（-6.4）和MG-QoL15（-5.8）。所有患者在15个月时均达到泼尼松剂量≤5 mg/天。所有患者的血清IgM水平均降至正常下限以下，两名患者的IgG水平低于正常，IgA水平保持稳定。报告的不良事件包括肺炎和带状疱疹。结论：使用inebilizumab进行长期B细胞耗竭在减少全身型MG疾病活动方面显示出持续的疗效，且免疫功能影响可控，使其成为gMG患者的有利选择。

abstracts.title: Rescue Treatment of Inebilizumab in Refractory Myasthenia Gravis: A Case Report
abstracts.authors: Jiang, Qilong; Hu, Liqing; Zhang, Chaoyue; Deng, Yufei; LUO, HAOCHENG; Yang, Xiaojun; Yang, Li
abstracts.affiliations: The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou University of Chinese Medicine, Guangzhou, China, People's Republic of; The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou University of Chinese Medicine, China, People's Republic of; The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou University of Chinese Medicine, Guangzhou City, China, People's Republic of
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To report the efficacy and safety of the first rescue treatment of refractory myasthenia gravis patient with Inebilizumab (CD19 monoclonal antibody). Background: Refractory myasthenia gravis (MG) is defined as an inadequate response to at least two traditional immunotherapy treatments or other biologics, and patients may still experience recurrent crises, lacking safe and effective treatment options. Design/Methods: A 55-year-old male patient with acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive myasthenia gravis (MG) and a 5-year disease course underwent thymectomy in 2021 (pathology: type B2), with no significant myasthenic symptoms. In 2024, he developed bulbar muscle symptoms and progressed to myasthenic crisis twice. He received sequential treatments including plasmapheresis, intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) pulse therapy, efgartigimod, and telitacicept, all with suboptimal responses. The patient continued to experience recurrent crises and difficulty in weaning from respirator. In June 2024, after two courses of eculizumab combined with telitacicept, he was successfully extubated and discharged. In April 2025, he experienced another crisis (QMG score: 28, MG-ADL score: 18). Both glucocorticoid pulse therapy and eculizumab treatment proved ineffective. Subsequently, he received inebilizumab 300 mg on July 18, 2025, and August 1, 2025. Results: After 8 weeks of inebilizumab treatment, the QMG score decreased to 21(from 28) and the MG-ADL score to 13(from 18), with obvious improvement in respiratory and limb muscle strength. The patient achieved over 10 hours of daytime ventilator-free periods with nocturnal low-flow oxygen therapy. Only one mild upper respiratory tract infection occurred during treatment. Conclusions: Inebilizumab demonstrates rapid and sustained clinical improvement in refractory myasthenia gravis with a favorable tolerability profile, worth further validation in larger cohorts.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：报告首例使用Inebilizumab（CD19单克隆抗体）抢救治疗难治性重症肌无力患者的疗效和安全性。背景：难治性重症肌无力（MG）定义为对至少两种传统免疫治疗或其他生物制剂反应不足，患者可能仍会经历反复危象，缺乏安全有效的治疗选择。设计/方法：一名55岁男性患者，患有乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性重症肌无力（MG），病程5年，于2021年接受胸腺切除术（病理：B2型），无明显肌无力症状。2024年，他出现延髓肌症状并两次进展为肌无力危象。他接受了序贯治疗，包括血浆置换、静脉注射免疫球蛋白（IVIG）冲击治疗、efgartigimod和telitacicept，反应均欠佳。患者持续经历反复危象且难以脱离呼吸机。2024年6月，经过两个疗程的eculizumab联合telitacicept治疗后，他成功拔管出院。2025年4月，他再次出现危象（QMG评分：28，MG-ADL评分：18）。糖皮质激素冲击治疗和eculizumab治疗均无效。随后，他于2025年7月18日和2025年8月1日接受了inebilizumab 300 mg治疗。结果：inebilizumab治疗8周后，QMG评分降至21（从28下降），MG-ADL评分降至13（从18下降），呼吸肌和四肢肌力明显改善。患者白天可脱离呼吸机超过10小时，夜间接受低流量氧疗。治疗期间仅发生一次轻度上呼吸道感染。结论：Inebilizumab在难治性重症肌无力中显示出快速且持续的临床改善，且耐受性良好，值得在更大规模队列中进一步验证。

abstracts.title: The Efficacy of Eculizumab for Long-term Ventilator-dependent and Postoperative Crisis in Refractory Thymoma-associated Myasthenia Gravis: Two Case Reports
abstracts.authors: Chen*, Hui; Wu*, Yu; Liang, Guanbiao; Huang, Wen
abstracts.affiliations: The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangxi Medical University, China, People's Republic of; University of Pittsburgh School of Medicine, Pittsburgh, PA
abstracts.abstract: Objective: NA Background: * Hui Chen and Yu Wu contributed equally as co-first authors. Eculizumab is approved for refractory acetylcholine receptor antibody positive (AChR+) generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). However, real-world evidence remains limited in addressing two critical scenarios: prolonged ventilator-dependent Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America (MGFA) class V disease and thymoma-associated postoperative crises with multiple autoantibodies. Design/Methods: NA Results: Case 1: A 47-year-old woman with a history of thymoma (treated with CyberKnife in 2019) and follicular thyroid carcinoma (status post thyroidectomy in 2021) presented in March 2024 with limb weakness and dyspnea; she was diagnosed with AChR+ gMG. She exhibited 12-month ventilator dependence and refractoriness to conventional therapies and efgartigimod. Nevertheless, eculizumab enabled successful extubation within 10 days. Her Myasthenia Gravis–Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) score improved from 18 on admission to 0, reflecting functional recovery with independence in daily activities. Case 2: A 44-year-old woman presented in 2018 with right eyelid ptosis, mastication weakness, and limb weakness. She was diagnosed with AChR+, titin antibody positive (titin+), ryanodine receptor antibody positive (RyR+) gMG and thymoma. After initial medical management, she underwent resection of type B1 thymoma, with recurrence as type B2 in April 2021. In December 2024, PET-CT showed progressive pleural metastases, and thoracoscopic resection with left lower lobe wedge resection was performed in January 2025. She encountered postoperative crisis despite perioperative therapy with efgartigimod. Eculizumab improved symptoms by reducing MG-ADL scores from 12 to 4 in 10 days, with further improvement to 1 with maintenance therapy. Conclusions: These cases demonstrate eculizumab's efficacy in liberating long-term ventilator-dependent gMG patients with MGFA class V from respiratory support, as well as resolving postoperative crises in thymoma-associated, multi-antibody positive refractory gMG. Both patients showed improvement in MG-ADL scores, reflecting significant recovery. These findings provide valuable real-world evidence to guide management for high-risk clinical presentations.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：不适用 背景：* 陈慧和吴宇作为共同第一作者贡献相同。Eculizumab被批准用于难治性乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR+）全身型重症肌无力（gMG）。然而，在解决两种关键临床情况方面，真实世界证据仍然有限：长期依赖呼吸机的重症肌无力基金会美国（MGFA）V级疾病和伴有多种自身抗体的胸腺瘤相关术后危象。设计/方法：不适用 结果：病例1：一名47岁女性，有胸腺瘤病史（2019年接受射波刀治疗）和甲状腺滤泡状癌病史（2021年接受甲状腺切除术后），于2024年3月出现肢体无力和呼吸困难；她被诊断为AChR+ gMG。她表现出12个月的呼吸机依赖，并对常规治疗和efgartigimod无效。然而，eculizumab在10天内成功使其拔管。她的重症肌无力-日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）评分从入院时的18分改善至0分，反映了功能恢复和日常生活独立。病例2：一名44岁女性，于2018年出现右眼睑下垂、咀嚼无力和肢体无力。她被诊断为AChR+、肌联蛋白抗体阳性（titin+）、兰尼碱受体抗体阳性（RyR+）gMG和胸腺瘤。在初步药物治疗后，她接受了B1型胸腺瘤切除术，于2021年4月复发为B2型。2024年12月，PET-CT显示进行性胸膜转移，于2025年1月进行了胸腔镜切除术和左肺下叶楔形切除术。尽管围手术期使用了efgartigimod治疗，她仍遭遇了术后危象。Eculizumab在10天内将MG-ADL评分从12降至4，改善了症状，并通过维持治疗进一步改善至1。结论：这些病例证明了eculizumab在使长期依赖呼吸机的MGFA V级gMG患者脱离呼吸支持方面的疗效，以及在解决胸腺瘤相关、多抗体阳性难治性gMG的术后危象方面的疗效。两名患者的MG-ADL评分均有改善，反映了显著的恢复。这些发现为指导高风险临床表现的管理提供了有价值的真实世界证据。

abstracts.title: Acetylcholine Receptor-autoantibody Detection and Therapeutic Assessment of Nipocalimab in Seronegative Patients with Myasthenia Gravis in VIVACITY-MG3
abstracts.authors: Silke Miller; Gallen Triana-Baltzer; Hans Frykman; Anna Mammel; Pankaj Kumar; Marie Fitzgibbon; Michael Kutch; Laura Green; Sindhu Ramchandren; Matteo Gastaldi
abstracts.affiliations: San Diego, CA; Vancouver, Canada; Bellingham, WA; Raritan, NJ; Chesterbrook, PA; High Wycombe, United Kingdom; Titusville, NJ; Pavia, Italy
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Clustered acetylcholine receptor (AChR) cell-based assays (CBA) can detect autoantibodies in patients with myasthenia gravis (MG) who test seronegative using conventional radioimmuno- precipitation assays (RIPA). Nipocalimab, a fully human FcRn blocker, demonstrated sustained disease control in conventional seropositive patients with generalized MG (gMG). OBJECTIVE: To evaluate efficacy and safety of nipocalimab versus placebo in conventional seronegative gMG patients who were anti-AChR autoantibody-positive by CBA. METHODS: Vivacity-MG3 (NCT04951622) was a randomized, placebo-controlled study with a 24-week double-blind phase and an ongoing open-label extension phase. Samples from conventionally seronegative patients were tested for anti-AChR autoantibodies using a live CBA assay (Neurocode Laboratory). RESULTS: Using CBA, 16.3% (7/43; placebo=2; nipocalimab=5) of conventional seronegative patients were subsequently identified as positive. Nipocalimab versus placebo: mean (range) age: 52.4 (37–65) versus 64.5 (51–78) years; females: 80% versus 50%; baseline mean (±SD) MG-ADL score (8.5±2.72 versus 11.5±2.12) and QMG scores (14.9±2.90 versus 15.0±4.24) were similar across groups. At 24-weeks, change from baseline (mean±SE) in MG-ADL and QMG scores was as follows — nipocalimab (n=4): −5.8±2.96 and −4.6±2.59; placebo (n=2): −1.5±0.71 and 0.0±5.66, respectively, and all tested nipocalimab-treated patients achieved at least a 2-point (MG-ADL) and 3-point (QMG) improvement from baseline. Adverse events (AEs; ≥1/patient): nipocalimab=3/5; placebo=2/2. No AEs leading to treatment discontinuation or deaths occurred. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Nipocalimab demonstrates sustained disease control in seropositive patients detected using CBA, similar to its effect in conventional (RIPA) seropositive patients with gMG. More sensitive autoantibody detection in those initially identified as seronegative gMG will enable these patients to potentially benefit from targeted therapies like nipocalimab. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：聚集型乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）细胞学检测（CBA）可在常规放射免疫沉淀检测（RIPA）血清阴性的肌无力（MG）患者中检出自身抗体。nipocalimab是一种全人源FcRn阻断剂，在常规血清阳性全身型MG（gMG）患者中显示出持续疾病控制。目的：评估nipocalimab与安慰剂在常规血清阴性但经CBA检测为抗AChR自身抗体阳性的gMG患者中的疗效和安全性。方法：Vivacity-MG3（NCT04951622）是一项随机、安慰剂对照研究，包括24周双盲期和正在进行的开放标签扩展期。对常规血清阴性患者的样本使用活细胞CBA检测（Neurocode Laboratory）检测抗AChR自身抗体。结果：使用CBA检测，16.3%（7/43；安慰剂=2；nipocalimab=5）的常规血清阴性患者随后被鉴定为阳性。nipocalimab与安慰剂相比：平均（范围）年龄：52.4（37–65）岁 vs 64.5（51–78）岁；女性：80% vs 50%；基线平均（±SD）MG-ADL评分（8.5±2.72 vs 11.5±2.12）和QMG评分（14.9±2.90 vs 15.0±4.24）在各组间相似。第24周时，MG-ADL和QMG评分较基线的变化（平均±SE）如下——nipocalimab（n=4）：−5.8±2.96和−4.6±2.59；安慰剂（n=2）：分别为−1.5±0.71和0.0±5.66；所有接受检测的nipocalimab治疗患者均达到MG-ADL较基线至少改善2分和QMG至少改善3分。不良事件（AEs；≥1次/患者）：nipocalimab=3/5；安慰剂=2/2。未发生导致治疗中断的AEs或死亡。总结/结论：nipocalimab在经CBA检出的血清阳性患者中显示出持续疾病控制，与在常规（RIPA）血清阳性gMG患者中的效果相似。对最初被鉴定为血清阴性gMG的患者进行更敏感的自身抗体检测，将使这些患者可能从nipocalimab等靶向治疗中获益。海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: Assessment of Health-related Quality of Life Measures in Anti-muscle-specific Tyrosine Kinase Antibody-positive Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Post Hoc Analysis of the VIVACITY-MG3 Study
abstracts.authors: Rosemarie Walch; Marie Fitzgibbon; Nolan Campbell; Carly J. Paoli; Sheryl Pease; Ibrahim Turkoz; Sindhu Ramchandren; Mazen Dimachkie
abstracts.affiliations: Owosso, MI; Raritan, NJ; Horsham, PA; Titusville, NJ; Kansas City, KS
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab, an FcRn-blocking antibody, is approved for adults and adolescents with anti- acetylcholine receptor (AChR) or anti-muscle-specific tyrosine kinase-(MuSK)-antibody-positive generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). MuSK-antibody+ MG is often considered more severe, with poor treatment response resulting in low health-related quality of life (HRQoL). Nipocalimab-plus-standard-of-care (nipocalimab+SOC) demonstrated sustained disease control with meaningful HRQoL improvements in the 24-week (W) double-blind phase of Vivacity-MG3 (NCT04951622) in seropositive gMG patients. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate HRQoL changes in anti-MuSK- antibody+ patients in Vivacity-MG3 using patient-reported outcomes: 15-item MG-QoL (revised) instrument (MG- QoL15r), European QoL Group, 5 Dimension, 5 Level Questionnaire Visual Analog Scale (EQ-5D-VAS), and QoL in Neurological Disorders (Neuro-QoL) Fatigue scale. METHODS: Mean change from baseline (CFB) to W24 in MG-QoL15r, EQ-5D-VAS, and Neuro-QoL Fatigue were analyzed. The proportion of patients achieving meaningful within-person improvement (MWPI) in MG-QoL15r (minimal clinical improvement from baseline [MCI] of ≥4 points), EQ-5D-VAS (MCI of ≥10 points) and Neuro-QoL Fatigue (MCI ≥6.7 points) were measured for both treatment groups. RESULTS: Sixteen MuSK-antibody+ patients (nipocalimab +SOC: n=12; placebo+SOC: n=4) were included. At W24, mean (SD) CFB in nipocalimab+SOC (vs placebo+SOC) in MG-QoL15r, EQ-5D-VAS, and Neuro-QoL Fatigue indicated improvements from baseline: −5.8 (6.78; p=0.024) (vs −1.8 [1.89]; not significant [ns]), 10.20 (17.57; ns) (vs 15.0 [21.32], ns) and −11.6 (28.16; ns) (vs 1.8 [8.58], ns), respectively. At 24W (nipocalimab+SOC vs placebo+SOC), 6/10 (60.0%) (vs 0/4) achieved MWPI on MG-QoL15r; 4/10 (40.0%) (vs 2/4 [50.0%]) achieved MWPI on EQ-5D-VAS, and 6/10 (60.0%) (vs 0/4) achieved MWPI on Neuro-QoL Fatigue. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Nipocalimab demonstrated meaningful improvements in HRQoL in the anti-MuSK- antibody+ subgroup of patients with gMG. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：nipocalimab是一种FcRn阻断抗体，已获批用于抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）或抗肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶（MuSK）抗体阳性全身型肌无力（gMG）的成人和青少年患者。MuSK抗体阳性MG通常被认为更严重，治疗反应差导致健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）低。在Vivacity-MG3（NCT04951622）24周（W）双盲期中，nipocalimab联合标准治疗（nipocalimab+SOC）在血清阳性gMG患者中显示出持续疾病控制和有意义的HRQoL改善。目的：使用患者报告结局评估Vivacity-MG3中抗MuSK抗体阳性患者的HRQoL变化：15项MG-QoL（修订版）量表（MG-QoL15r）、欧洲生活质量组5维度5水平问卷视觉模拟量表（EQ-5D-VAS）和神经疾病生活质量（Neuro-QoL）疲劳量表。方法：分析MG-QoL15r、EQ-5D-VAS和Neuro-QoL疲劳从基线至W24的平均变化（CFB）。测量两组达到MG-QoL15r有意义个体内改善（MWPI；较基线最小临床改善[MCI]≥4分）、EQ-5D-VAS（MCI≥10分）和Neuro-QoL疲劳（MCI≥6.7分）的患者比例。结果：纳入16例MuSK抗体阳性患者（nipocalimab+SOC：n=12；安慰剂+SOC：n=4）。W24时，nipocalimab+SOC（vs安慰剂+SOC）在MG-QoL15r、EQ-5D-VAS和Neuro-QoL疲劳的平均（SD）CFB显示较基线改善：−5.8（6.78；p=0.024）（vs −1.8[1.89]；无显著性[ns]）、10.20（17.57；ns）（vs 15.0[21.32]，ns）和−11.6（28.16；ns）（vs 1.8[8.58]，ns）。W24时（nipocalimab+SOC vs安慰剂+SOC），6/10（60.0%）（vs 0/4）达到MG-QoL15r的MWPI；4/10（40.0%）（vs 2/4[50.0%]）达到EQ-5D-VAS的MWPI；6/10（60.0%）（vs 0/4）达到Neuro-QoL疲劳的MWPI。总结/结论：nipocalimab在gMG抗MuSK抗体阳性亚组患者中显示出有意义的HRQoL改善。海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: Complement versus Neonatal Fc Receptor Inhibition in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: A Comparative Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
abstracts.authors: Shradha Kakde; Meghnath Kakde; Shubhangi Kakade
abstracts.affiliations: Nanded, India
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Targeted biologic therapies have reshaped the management of generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). Complement inhibitors prevent membrane attack complex–mediated neuromuscular junction injury, whereas neonatal Fc receptor antagonists accelerate pathogenic immunoglobulin G clearance. Comparative efficacy across these two mechanisms has not been formally synthesized. OBJECTIVE: To compare clinical response, onset kinetics, and durability between complement inhibition and neonatal Fc receptor blockade in gMG using randomized controlled evidence. METHODS: We conducted a systematic review and meta- analysis of placebo-controlled Phase 2 and Phase 3 trials evaluating complement inhibitors and neonatal Fc receptor antagonists in adults with gMG. The primary outcome was Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living responder rate, defined as a sustained improvement of two or more points. Secondary outcomes included change in Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis score, time to clinical response, and serious adverse events. Random-effects models were used to pool treatment effects, and prespecified subgroup analyses compared drug classes. Exploratory meta-regression evaluated baseline disease severity and acetylcholine receptor antibody status as moderators of response. RESULTS: Both drug classes significantly increased responder probability compared with placebo. Complement inhibitors demonstrated durable functional improvement across follow-up intervals. Neonatal Fc receptor antagonists showed rapid onset of symptomatic improvement. Between-class heterogeneity was low to moderate. Safety profiles were acceptable, with mechanism-specific adverse event patterns. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Biologic therapies in gMG demonstrate a class-level therapeutic effect with distinct mechanistic response profiles. Complement inhibition appears associated with durable benefit, while neonatal Fc receptor blockade provides rapid symptomatic improvement, supporting mechanism-informed treatment selection. Shradha Kakde, MBBS IFCN International Scholarship Recipient Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：靶向生物制剂已重塑全身型肌无力（gMG）的管理。补体抑制剂阻止膜攻击复合物介导的神经肌肉接头损伤，而新生儿Fc受体拮抗剂加速致病性免疫球蛋白G清除。这两种机制之间的比较疗效尚未被正式综合。目的：使用随机对照证据比较补体抑制与新生儿Fc受体阻断在gMG中的临床应答、起效动力学和持久性。方法：我们对评估补体抑制剂和新生儿Fc受体拮抗剂用于gMG成人的安慰剂对照2期和3期试验进行了系统综述和荟萃分析。主要结局为肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）应答率，定义为持续改善2分或以上。次要结局包括定量肌无力（QMG）评分变化、临床应答时间和严重不良事件。使用随机效应模型合并治疗效应，预设亚组分析比较药物类别。探索性荟萃回归评估基线疾病严重程度和乙酰胆碱受体抗体状态作为应答调节因素。结果：与安慰剂相比，两类药物均显著提高应答概率。补体抑制剂在各随访间隔中显示出持久的功能改善。新生儿Fc受体拮抗剂显示出症状改善的快速起效。类别间异质性为低至中等。安全性特征可接受，具有机制特异性不良事件模式。总结/结论：gMG中的生物制剂显示出类别水平的治疗效应，具有不同的机制性应答特征。补体抑制似乎与持久获益相关，而新生儿Fc受体阻断提供快速症状改善，支持基于机制的治疗选择。Shradha Kakde，MBBS IFCN国际奖学金获得者 海报会议I和II
