abstracts.title: Effect of Nipocalimab on Pathogenic IgG and Complement Markers in Patients with Seropositive Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Exploratory Analysis in the VIVACITY-MG3 Study
abstracts.authors: Silke Miller; Jingyue Xi; Yanfei Zhang; Ruben Faelens; Marie Fitzgibbon; Sindhu Ramchandren; Sarah Hoffmann
abstracts.affiliations: San Diego, CA; Spring House, PA; Beerse, Belgium; Raritan, NJ; Titusville, NJ; Berlin, Germany
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Immunoglobulin (Ig)G class autoantibodies block and internalize acetylcholine receptor (AChR) and activate complement at the neuromuscular junction, leading to symptoms of myasthenia-gravis. Nipocalimab, a neonatal-Fc-receptor-blocker, substantially reduced circulating IgG, and demonstrated sustained disease control vs placebo during the 24-week Vivacity- MG3 study (NCT04951622). OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether nipocalimab reduces circulating complement components and activity indicative of complement activation. METHODS: Available serum samples from seropositive (positive for AChR/muscle-specific receptor-tyrosine- kinase [MuSK]/low-density lipoprotein-receptor-related protein-4 [LRP4] antibodies) patients were analyzed at baseline and Week 24 and least square means were compared (nipocalimab vs placebo) using linear mixed- model. Complement-markers measured were: C3d circulating immune-complexes (C3d-CIC), C1q immune- complex-binding (C1q-ICB), and total complement-activity (CH50). Parallel assays quantified total-IgG, IgG1/2/3, and anti-AChR titers, which informed nonlinear mixed-model previously presented. RESULTS: Baseline levels (LS-mean±SD) of complement- markers were comparable: nipocalimab vs placebo—CH50:103.48±5.92 vs 100.21±5.65; C1q ICB:7.40±1.78 vs 6.15±1.69; C3d CIC:7.60±0.94 vs 7.58±0.90. At Week 24, nipocalimab was associated with substantial and sustained reductions in total-IgG, IgG1/2/3, and anti-AChR titers (mean%[visual-predictive- check prediction interval]-total-IgG: -67.9[-69.9; -64.8] vs -1.3[-3.2; 3.3], IgG1: -64.8[-68.3;-62.4] vs -2.0[-4.0; 4.4], IgG2: -67.0[-70.4; -65.1] vs 1.8[-4.7; 4.9], IgG3: -55.2[-58.7; -49.9] vs 3.1[-5.4; 5.6], IgG4: -54.0[-62.0;-51.5] vs -2.0[-6.1; 6.5], Anti-AChR: -65.1[-72.9;-58.6] vs -12.2[-8.7; 9.6]). Concomitant decreases were observed in selected immune complex–associated complement markers (LS-mean±SD at Week 24 [nipocalimab vs placebo]—C3d-CIC:2.64±0.96 vs 7.25±0.92 [p<0.001], C1q-ICB:5.50±1.79 vs 6.87±1.71 [p=0.01]); no significant change in CH50 was detected. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Nipocalimab led to sustained reductions in IgG-subclasses and anti-AChR titers, accompanied by significant decreases in selected circulating-immune-complex–associated complement- markers, while no significant change in total complement activity was observed. Findings indicate that changes in selected complement-related markers following nipocalimab treatment warrant further exploration. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：免疫球蛋白（Ig）G类自身抗体阻断乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）并使其内化，同时激活神经肌肉接头处的补体，从而导致肌无力症状。Nipocalimab是一种新生儿Fc受体阻断剂，可显著降低循环IgG，并在为期24周的Vivacity-MG3研究（NCT04951622）中相较安慰剂显示出持续疾病控制。目的：评估nipocalimab是否降低提示补体激活的循环补体成分及活性。方法：对血清阳性（AChR/肌肉特异性受体酪氨酸激酶[MuSK]/低密度脂蛋白受体相关蛋白4[LRP4]抗体阳性）患者的可用血清样本在基线和第24周进行分析，并使用线性混合模型比较最小二乘均值（nipocalimab vs 安慰剂）。测定的补体标志物为：C3d循环免疫复合物（C3d-CIC）、C1q免疫复合物结合（C1q-ICB）和总补体活性（CH50）。平行检测定量总IgG、IgG1/2/3和抗AChR滴度，这些数据用于此前已展示的非线性混合模型。结果：补体标志物的基线水平（LS均值±SD）相当：nipocalimab vs 安慰剂——CH50：103.48±5.92 vs 100.21±5.65；C1q ICB：7.40±1.78 vs 6.15±1.69；C3d CIC：7.60±0.94 vs 7.58±0.90。第24周时，nipocalimab与总IgG、IgG1/2/3和抗AChR滴度的大幅且持续降低相关（平均%[视觉预测检查预测区间]——总IgG：-67.9[-69.9; -64.8] vs -1.3[-3.2; 3.3]，IgG1：-64.8[-68.3;-62.4] vs -2.0[-4.0; 4.4]，IgG2：-67.0[-70.4; -65.1] vs 1.8[-4.7; 4.9]，IgG3：-55.2[-58.7; -49.9] vs 3.1[-5.4; 5.6]，IgG4：-54.0[-62.0;-51.5] vs -2.0[-6.1; 6.5]，抗AChR：-65.1[-72.9;-58.6] vs -12.2[-8.7; 9.6]）。同时观察到部分免疫复合物相关补体标志物下降（第24周LS均值±SD[nipocalimab vs 安慰剂]——C3d-CIC：2.64±0.96 vs 7.25±0.92[p<0.001]，C1q-ICB：5.50±1.79 vs 6.87±1.71[p=0.01]）；未检测到CH50的显著变化。总结/结论：Nipocalimab导致IgG亚类和抗AChR滴度持续降低，并伴随部分循环免疫复合物相关补体标志物的显著下降，而总补体活性未见显著变化。研究结果表明，nipocalimab治疗后部分补体相关标志物的变化值得进一步探索。海报专场I和III

abstracts.title: Effect of Nipocalimab on Sustained Disease Control during Infections: Post-hoc Analysis of the VIVACITY-MG3 Study in Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Carlo Antozzi; Gonçalo M.C. Rodrigues; Marie Fitzgibbon; Robert Edwards; Ibrahim Turkoz; Michael Kutch; Sindhu Ramchandren; Ghazala Hayat
abstracts.affiliations: Milan, Italy; Madrid, Spain; Raritan, NJ; Spring House, PA; Titusville, NJ; Chesterbrook, PA; Saint Louis, MO
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab plus standard-of-care (SOC) showed sustained disease control versus placebo (+SOC) for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in the VIVACITY-MG3 study (NCT04496507). Although immunoglobulin-G levels were reduced in the nipocalimab group, the occurrence of infectious adverse events was comparable to placebo. Monitoring Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) scores helps assess symptom control and therapeutic adequacy during infection episodes. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the efficacy of nipocalimab treatment during/shortly after infection episodes in the double-blind phase of Vivacity-MG3 by measuring changes in MG-ADL and QMG scores. METHODS: Patients with infections/infestations/serious infections at any time point in the double-blind phase were analyzed. Pre-infection and post-infection MG-ADL and QMG scores were compared. Pre-infection MG-ADL/QMG score was the most recent observation recorded within 16 days immediately preceding infection start date. Post- infection MG-ADL/QMG score was the worst observation recorded from infection start date through 16 days after infection end date. RESULTS: Infection/infestations incidence was 42.9% in the nipocalimab group (mild/moderate/severe infection events=51/16/4) and 41.8% in the placebo group (41/15/3). The median (interquartile range [IQR]) duration of overall infections/moderate and severe infections were similar between the nipocalimab and placebo groups (10.0 days [6.0; 17.0]/12.5 [9.0; 17.0] and 12.0 days [7.0; 19.0]/11.5 [7.0; 16.0], respectively). Median (IQR) pre- infection to post-infection change in MG-ADL scores was 0.0 (−1.0; 1.0) in nipocalimab versus 1.0 (0.0; 2.0) in placebo, and in QMG scores was 0.0 (−1.0; 2.0) in nipocalimab versus 1.0 (−1.0; 1.0) in placebo. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Incidence of infections in the nipocalimab arm was comparable to that in the placebo arm despite immunoglobulin-G reduction. MG-ADL/QMG scores were unaltered during infections, demonstrating gMG symptom improvement maintenance and sustained disease control with nipocalimab. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在VIVACITY-MG3研究（NCT04496507）中，nipocalimab联合标准治疗（SOC）相较安慰剂（+SOC）在全身型肌无力（gMG）中显示出持续疾病控制。尽管nipocalimab组免疫球蛋白G水平降低，感染性不良事件的发生率与安慰剂相当。监测肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）和定量肌无力量表（QMG）评分有助于评估感染期间的症状控制和治疗充分性。目的：通过测量MG-ADL和QMG评分变化，评估Vivacity-MG3双盲阶段感染期间/感染后短期内nipocalimab治疗的疗效。方法：分析双盲阶段任何时间点发生感染/寄生虫感染/严重感染的患者。比较感染前和感染后MG-ADL和QMG评分。感染前MG-ADL/QMG评分为感染开始日期前16天内记录的最新观察值。感染后MG-ADL/QMG评分为从感染开始日期至感染结束日期后16天内记录的最差观察值。结果：nipocalimab组感染/寄生虫感染发生率为42.9%（轻/中/重度感染事件=51/16/4），安慰剂组为41.8%（41/15/3）。nipocalimab组和安慰剂组总体感染/中度和重度感染的中位（四分位距[IQR]）持续时间相似（分别为10.0天[6.0; 17.0]/12.5[9.0; 17.0]和12.0天[7.0; 19.0]/11.5[7.0; 16.0]）。MG-ADL评分从感染前至感染后的中位（IQR）变化在nipocalimab组为0.0（−1.0; 1.0），安慰剂组为1.0（0.0; 2.0）；QMG评分在nipocalimab组为0.0（−1.0; 2.0），安慰剂组为1.0（−1.0; 1.0）。总结/结论：尽管免疫球蛋白G降低，nipocalimab组感染发生率与安慰剂组相当。感染期间MG-ADL/QMG评分未改变，表明nipocalimab维持了gMG症状改善和持续疾病控制。海报专场I和III

abstracts.title: Effect of Nipocalimab on Sustained Disease Control in Anti-muscle-specific Tyrosine Kinase-antibody-positive Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: A Post Hoc Analysis of the VIVACITY-MG3 Study
abstracts.authors: Rosemarie Walch; Marie Fitzgibbon; Nolan Campbell; Carly J. Paoli; Ibrahim Turkoz; Sindhu Ramchandren; Mazen Dimachkie
abstracts.affiliations: Owosso, MI; Raritan, NJ; Horsham, PA; Titusville, NJ; Kansas City, KS
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab, an FcRn-blocking antibody, is approved for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) and anti- muscle-specific tyrosine kinase (MuSK)-antibody-positive adult and adolescent patients. MuSK-antibody+ patients are often considered more severe with poor response to standard-of-care treatments. Nipocalimab-plus-standard- of-care (nipocalimab+SOC) demonstrated sustained disease control in the 24-week (W) double-blind phase of Vivacity-MG3 (NCT04951622) in seropositive gMG patients. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate sustained efficacy with nipocalimab+SOC versus placebo+SOC in anti-MuSK- antibody+ patients in Vivacity-MG3. METHODS: Mean change from baseline (CFB) in the MG- Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Quantitative MG (QMG) scores were compared between study arms. The proportion of patients achieving Meaningful Clinical Improvement (MCI ≥2 point within-patient improvement versus baseline in MG-ADL), sustained response (MCI maintained for ≥8 weeks) and the proportion of patients with Minimal Symptom Expression (MSE: MG-ADL total score of 0/1) were summarized. RESULTS: Demographics and baseline characteristics for nipocalimab+SOC (n=12) and placebo+SOC (n=4) were: median(range) age: 56.5 (27–77) vs 36.5 (32–43) years; females: 83.3% vs 100%; mean(SD) scores at baseline: MG-ADL 9.8 (3.17) vs 9.0 (3.24); QMG: 15.6 (6.02) vs 18.8 (4.84). At W24, significant mean (SD) CFB were observed in nipocalimab+SOC in MG-ADL (−3.75[3.55]; n=10, p=0.010 vs placebo+SOC [n=4]:−0.50 [0.71];p=0.375) and QMG (−5.89 [4.75]; n=9, p=0.012 vs placebo+SOC [n=4]:−2.7 [2.53]; p=0.125). A greater proportion of nipocalimab+SOC-treated patients (10/12 [83.3%]) achieved MCI at any time during the study (vs placebo+SOC: 1/4 [25.0%]); 6/12 (50.0%) nipocalimab +SOC-treated patients sustained MCI for ≥8W (vs placebo +SOC: 0/4). At 24W, 3/12 (25.0%) nipocalimab+SOC- treated patients achieved MSE (vs placebo+SOC: 0/4). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Nipocalimab demonstrated meaningful clinical improvement and sustained disease control in a subgroup of anti-MuSK-antibody+ patients with gMG. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Nipocalimab是一种FcRn阻断抗体，已在抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）和抗肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶（MuSK）抗体阳性的成人和青少年全身型肌无力（gMG）患者中获批。MuSK抗体阳性患者通常被认为病情更重，对标准治疗反应不佳。在Vivacity-MG3（NCT04951622）为期24周（W）的双盲阶段中，nipocalimab联合标准治疗（nipocalimab+SOC）在血清阳性gMG患者中显示出持续疾病控制。目的：评估Vivacity-MG3中抗MuSK抗体阳性患者接受nipocalimab+SOC相较安慰剂+SOC的持续疗效。方法：比较各研究组间MG日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）和定量MG（QMG）评分自基线的平均变化（CFB）。总结达到有意义临床改善（MCI：MG-ADL较基线患者内改善≥2分）、持续缓解（MCI维持≥8周）的患者比例，以及达到轻微症状表达（MSE：MG-ADL总分0/1）的患者比例。结果：nipocalimab+SOC（n=12）和安慰剂+SOC（n=4）的人口学和基线特征为：中位（范围）年龄：56.5（27–77）vs 36.5（32–43）岁；女性：83.3% vs 100%；基线平均（SD）评分：MG-ADL 9.8（3.17）vs 9.0（3.24）；QMG：15.6（6.02）vs 18.8（4.84）。第24周时，nipocalimab+SOC在MG-ADL（−3.75[3.55]；n=10，p=0.010 vs 安慰剂+SOC[n=4]：−0.50[0.71]；p=0.375）和QMG（−5.89[4.75]；n=9，p=0.012 vs 安慰剂+SOC[n=4]：−2.7[2.53]；p=0.125）中观察到显著的平均（SD）CFB。nipocalimab+SOC治疗患者中更大比例（10/12[83.3%]）在研究期间任何时间达到MCI（vs 安慰剂+SOC：1/4[25.0%]）；6/12（50.0%）nipocalimab+SOC治疗患者维持MCI≥8周（vs 安慰剂+SOC：0/4）。第24周时，3/12（25.0%）nipocalimab+SOC治疗患者达到MSE（vs 安慰剂+SOC：0/4）。总结/结论：Nipocalimab在抗MuSK抗体阳性gMG患者亚组中显示出有意义的临床改善和持续疾病控制。海报专场I和III

abstracts.title: Efficacy and Safety of Nipocalimab: Switch from 15-mg/kg Every-2-weeks to 30 Mg/kg Every-4-weeks (VIVACITY-MG3 Open-label Extension)
abstracts.authors: Tuan Vu; Marie Fitzgibbon; Kavita Gandhi; Nolan Campbell; Yaowei Zhu; Jocelyn Leu; Ibrahim Turkoz; Sindhu Ramchandren
abstracts.affiliations: Tampa, FL; Raritan, NJ; Horsham, PA; Spring House, PA; Titusville, NJ
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab is approved for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in the U.S. and other countries as a 30-mg/kg loading dose, followed by 15-mg/kg every-2-weeks (q2w) for maintenance. During the Vivacity-MG3 open-label extension (OLE), patients from the double-blind phase received nipocalimab 15- mg/kg q2w. There was an option (later removed by protocol amendment) to switch to every-4-week (q4w) dosing. OBJECTIVE: To report efficacy and safety of nipocalimab in patients who switched from 15-mg/kg q2w to 30-mg/kg q4w in the OLE of Vivacity-MG3. METHODS: Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) scores were analyzed pre-switch and post-switch for patients switching from 15-mg/kg q2w to 30-mg/kg q4w. RESULTS: Overall, 153 patients entered the OLE; symptom improvements were maintained through a 60- week extension. Twenty-five patients switched to 30- mg/kg q4w (median [range] duration: 12.1 [0–48] weeks). In seropositive patients (n=21) (median [range] age: 48.0 [26.0–83.0] years; 61.9% females), mean (SD) MG-ADL and QMG scores at OLE baseline were 8.3 (3.50) and 14.8 (6.08), respectively. Prior to the switch, mean (SD) change from OLE baseline (CFB) was MG-ADL (n=16): −2.4 (3.15) and QMG (n=15): −2.6 (4.21); after the switch, mean (SD) CFB was MG-ADL (n=16): −2.0 (3.03) and QMG (n=15): −2.3 (3.79). Safety data for q4w were comparable with q2w. Infections and infestations were the most-reported adverse events (AEs; 48.0% vs 44.0%). No AEs led to death. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Temporary 30-mg/kg q4w nipocalimab dosing showed sustained clinical efficacy and a safety profile consistent with 15-mg/kg q2w dosing. Interpretation is limited by the small number of patients and short follow-up duration for q4w dosing. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Nipocalimab已在美国和其他国家获批用于全身型肌无力（gMG），给药方案为30 mg/kg负荷剂量，随后15 mg/kg每2周（q2w）维持。在Vivacity-MG3开放标签扩展（OLE）期间，双盲阶段患者接受nipocalimab 15 mg/kg q2w。曾有一个选项（后经方案修订删除）可转换为每4周（q4w）给药。目的：报告Vivacity-MG3的OLE中从15 mg/kg q2w转换为30 mg/kg q4w的患者中nipocalimab的疗效和安全性。方法：对从15 mg/kg q2w转换为30 mg/kg q4w的患者，分析转换前和转换后的肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）和定量肌无力量表（QMG）评分。结果：总体而言，153例患者进入OLE；症状改善在60周扩展期内得以维持。25例患者转换为30 mg/kg q4w（中位[范围]持续时间：12.1[0–48]周）。在血清阳性患者（n=21）中（中位[范围]年龄：48.0[26.0–83.0]岁；61.9%女性），OLE基线时MG-ADL和QMG平均（SD）评分分别为8.3（3.50）和14.8（6.08）。转换前，自OLE基线的平均（SD）变化（CFB）为MG-ADL（n=16）：−2.4（3.15）和QMG（n=15）：−2.6（4.21）；转换后，平均（SD）CFB为MG-ADL（n=16）：−2.0（3.03）和QMG（n=15）：−2.3（3.79）。q4w的安全性数据与q2w相当。感染和寄生虫感染是最常报告的不良事件（AE；48.0% vs 44.0%）。无AE导致死亡。总结/结论：临时30 mg/kg q4w的nipocalimab给药显示出持续临床疗效，安全性特征与15 mg/kg q2w给药一致。由于q4w给药患者数量少且随访时间短，解释受限。海报专场I和II

abstracts.title: Efficacy of Nipocalimab in Patients Early in Their Disease Course of Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Post Hoc Analysis of VIVACITY-MG3
abstracts.authors: Carlo Antozzi; Wim Noel; Marie Fitzgibbon; Wisam Karmous; Kavita Gandhi; Ibrahim Turkoz; Michael Kutch; Sindhu Ramchandren; Elena Cortés- Vicente
abstracts.affiliations: Milan, Italy; Antwerp, Belgium; Raritan, NJ; Horsham, PA; Cambridge, MA; Titusville, NJ; Barcelona, Spain
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab added to standard-of-care (SOC) showed greater improvement than placebo (+SOC) in Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) scores in the VIVACITY-MG3 study (NCT04496507). OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether efficacy was achievable in patients with generalized MG (gMG) diagnosed earlier (≤5 years) before study initiation. METHODS: Analysis included seropositive patients treated with nipocalimab or placebo diagnosed with gMG within the previous 5 years (below the cohort median of 5 years). Efficacy at Week 24 (W24) was assessed using MG-ADL (meaningful clinical improvement [MCI]: ≥2-point improvement; substantial clinical improvement [SCI]: ≥3- point improvement) and QMG (MCI: ≥3-point improvement; SCI: ≥4-point improvement) scores in patients diagnosed with gMG ≤5 years. Two-sample t-tests compared baseline-to-W24 changes between groups. RESULTS: Baseline demographics were generally balanced between nipocalimab and placebo-treated patients. At W24, MG-ADL reductions (mean [SD]) from baseline were greater with nipocalimab (−4.9 [2.88]) versus placebo (−2.7 [2.46]); difference: −2.22 (SE: 0.76); 95% CI (−3.74; −0.70); p=0.005. Similarly, QMG reductions (mean [SD]) from baseline were greater with nipocalimab (−5.1 [4.14]) versus placebo (−2.3 [3.20]); difference: −2.85 (SE:1.08); 95% CI (−5.03; −0.66); p=0.012. A greater proportion of patients receiving nipocalimab met minimal clinical improvement (MCI) and substantial clinical improvement (SCI) criteria for MG-ADL (87.1% versus 63.6% and 74.2% versus 40.9%) and QMG (53.8% versus 36.4% and 53.8% versus 22.7%) at W24 versus placebo. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In patients diagnosed with gMG in ≤5 years before study initiation, nipocalimab demonstrated greater efficacy versus placebo, achieving MCI and SCI in MG-ADL and QMG at W24. These findings highlight the benefit of nipocalimab in recently diagnosed patients with gMG. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在VIVACITY-MG3研究（NCT04496507）中，nipocalimab联合标准治疗（SOC）在重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）和定量重症肌无力（QMG）评分方面的改善优于安慰剂（+SOC）。目的：评估在研究开始前较早期（≤5年）诊断为全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的患者中是否可获得疗效。方法：分析纳入血清阳性、在研究开始前5年内（低于队列中位数5年）诊断为gMG并接受nipocalimab或安慰剂治疗的患者。在诊断为gMG≤5年的患者中，采用MG-ADL（有意义的临床改善[MCI]：≥2分改善；显著临床改善[SCI]：≥3分改善）和QMG（MCI：≥3分改善；SCI：≥4分改善）评分评估第24周（W24）的疗效。采用两样本t检验比较两组基线至W24的变化。结果：nipocalimab组与安慰剂组患者的基线人口学特征总体均衡。在W24，nipocalimab组MG-ADL自基线的下降（均值[SD]）大于安慰剂组（−4.9[2.88] vs −2.7[2.46]）；差异：−2.22（SE：0.76）；95%CI（−3.74；−0.70）；p=0.005。同样，nipocalimab组QMG自基线的下降（均值[SD]）大于安慰剂组（−5.1[4.14] vs −2.3[3.20]）；差异：−2.85（SE：1.08）；95%CI（−5.03；−0.66）；p=0.012。在W24，接受nipocalimab治疗的患者中达到MG-ADL的MCI和SCI标准者比例（87.1% vs 63.6%和74.2% vs 40.9%）以及QMG的MCI和SCI标准者比例（53.8% vs 36.4%和53.8% vs 22.7%）均高于安慰剂组。总结/结论：在研究开始前≤5年诊断为gMG的患者中，nipocalimab较安慰剂显示出更优疗效，在W24达到MG-ADL和QMG的MCI和SCI。这些发现凸显了nipocalimab在近期诊断的gMG患者中的获益。海报专场I和II

abstracts.title: Efficacy of Nipocalimab in Patients with Lower Baseline Score of Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living in VIVACITY-MG3 Study
abstracts.authors: Carlo Antozzi; Wim Noel; Wisam Karmous; Marie Fitzgibbon; Kavita Gandhi; Ibrahim Turkoz; Michael Kutch; Sindhu Ramchandren
abstracts.affiliations: Milan, Italy; Beerse, Belgium; Issy-les-Moulineaux, France; Raritan, NJ; Titusville, NJ; Chesterbrook, PA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is a chronic autoimmune disease characterized by fluctuating muscle weakness and fatigability. In VIVACITY-MG3 (NCT04496507), nipocalimab+standard-of-care (SOC) demonstrated greater improvement in Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) scores versus placebo+SOC. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether efficacy could be achieved in patients with lower baseline symptom burden (MG-ADL scores: 6–9). METHODS: Analysis included seropositive patients treated with nipocalimab+SOC or placebo+SOC with baseline MG-ADL score ≤9 (cohort median score). Changes from baseline (CFB) in MG-ADL (meaningful clinical improvement [MCI]: ≥2 point improvement; substantial clinical improvement [SCI]: ≥3-point improvement) and QMG (MCI: ≥3-point improvement; SCI: ≥4 point improvement) at Week 24 (W24) were evaluated and compared. RESULTS: Baseline demographics were generally balanced (nipocalimab+SOC [n=48] vs placebo+SOC [n=45]: median age: 51 vs 47 years; females: 64.6% vs 57.8%; mean±SD baseline MG-ADL: 7.6±0.87 vs 7.6±1.02; QMG: 13.6±4.27 vs 14.9±5.60). At W24, mean ±SD CFB in MG-ADL was greater with nipocalimab+SOC (−4.5±2.64) versus placebo+SOC (−2.3±2.37); difference: -2.23 (standard error [SE]: 0.588); 95% confidence interval (CI) (−3.41; −1.06); p<0.001. Similarly, CFB in QMG (mean±SD) was also greater with nipocalimab+SOC (−5.2±4.45) versus placebo+SOC (−1.9±3.69); difference: −3.38 (SE: 0.986); 95%CI (−5.34; −1.41); p=0.001. At W24, a significantly greater proportion of nipocalimab +SOC-treated patients met MCI and SCI criteria versus placebo+SOC (MG-ADL: MCI:85.0% vs 58.8% [p=0.017]; SCI: 72.5% vs 38.2% [p=0.005] and QMG: MCI: 62.9% vs 32.4% [p=0.016]; SCI: 57.1% vs 20.6% [p=0.003]). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In patients with baseline MG- ADL scores 6–9, nipocalimab demonstrated greater efficacy versus placebo, achieving MCI and SCI in MG- ADL and QMG at W24. Findings support the benefit of nipocalimab for sustained disease control in patients with generalized MG and lower baseline MG-ADL scores. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）是一种以波动性肌无力和易疲劳为特征的慢性自身免疫性疾病。在VIVACITY-MG3（NCT04496507）中，nipocalimab+标准治疗（SOC）在重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）和定量重症肌无力（QMG）评分方面的改善优于安慰剂+SOC。目的：评估在基线症状负担较低（MG-ADL评分：6–9）的患者中是否可获得疗效。方法：分析纳入基线MG-ADL评分≤9（队列中位评分）并接受nipocalimab+SOC或安慰剂+SOC治疗的血清阳性患者。评估并比较第24周（W24）MG-ADL（有意义的临床改善[MCI]：≥2分改善；显著临床改善[SCI]：≥3分改善）和QMG（MCI：≥3分改善；SCI：≥4分改善）自基线的变化（CFB）。结果：基线人口学特征总体均衡（nipocalimab+SOC[n=48] vs 安慰剂+SOC[n=45]：中位年龄：51 vs 47岁；女性：64.6% vs 57.8%；基线MG-ADL均值±SD：7.6±0.87 vs 7.6±1.02；QMG：13.6±4.27 vs 14.9±5.60）。在W24，nipocalimab+SOC组MG-ADL的CFB（均值±SD）大于安慰剂+SOC组（−4.5±2.64 vs −2.3±2.37）；差异：−2.23（标准误[SE]：0.588）；95%置信区间（CI）（−3.41；−1.06）；p<0.001。同样，nipocalimab+SOC组QMG的CFB（均值±SD）也大于安慰剂+SOC组（−5.2±4.45 vs −1.9±3.69）；差异：−3.38（SE：0.986）；95%CI（−5.34；−1.41）；p=0.001。在W24，nipocalimab+SOC治疗患者中达到MCI和SCI标准者比例显著高于安慰剂+SOC组（MG-ADL：MCI：85.0% vs 58.8%[p=0.017]；SCI：72.5% vs 38.2%[p=0.005]；QMG：MCI：62.9% vs 32.4%[p=0.016]；SCI：57.1% vs 20.6%[p=0.003]）。总结/结论：在基线MG-ADL评分为6–9的患者中，nipocalimab较安慰剂显示出更优疗效，在W24达到MG-ADL和QMG的MCI和SCI。这些发现支持nipocalimab在基线MG-ADL评分较低的全身型MG患者中实现持续疾病控制的获益。海报专场I和II

abstracts.title: Efgartigimod is a Unique Neonatal Fc Receptor Blocker that Allows Immunoglobulin g Reduction without Broad Inhibition of Immune Responses
abstracts.authors: Kristin Heerlein; Sophie Steeland; Ornella Binazon; Mahan Moshir; Fien M. Verhamme; Fien Gistelinck; Jana Podhorna
abstracts.affiliations: Ghent, Belgium
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Treatment with some immunosuppressive and B-cell–depleting therapies may lead to increased risk of severe infections in patients and may reduce immunogenicity of vaccines. Previous studies have demonstrated that efgartigimod, a human immunoglobulin (Ig) G1 antibody Fc fragment that reduces levels of IgG (including pathogenic autoantibodies) through neonatal Fc receptor blockade, does not impair cellular and humoral immune responses to antigenic challenges. Rates and severities of severe infections have been similar between efgartigimod- and placebo-treated participants in placebo-controlled studies and have not increased during long-term open-label studies. OBJECTIVE: To investigate the effect of efgartigimod treatment on immune responses to vaccination. METHODS: Across several clinical studies in healthy volunteers and in participants with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (CIDP), immune thrombocytopenia (ITP), and pemphigus vulgaris (PV), intravenous efgartigimod or subcutaneous efgartigimod PH20 was administered in various dosing regimens. Vaccine-specific IgG titers and cellular immunity were assessed at multiple timepoints, including prevaccination, ≥4 weeks postvaccination, and at maximal IgG reduction. RESULTS: In participants receiving efgartigimod, antigen–specific IgG titers increased from prevaccination to postvaccination, even during maximal IgG reduction. Additional data demonstrating preservation of cellular immune responses during efgartigimod treatment will be presented. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Efgartigimod’s unique structure as an Fc fragment selectively reduces IgG antibodies and autoantibodies while preserving the ability to mount antigen-specific responses to immunization. This mechanism avoids both broader impacts on immunity and increased risk of infections observed with some immunosuppressive and B-cell–depleting therapies. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：某些免疫抑制和B细胞清除治疗可能导致患者严重感染风险增加，并可能降低疫苗免疫原性。既往研究已表明，efgartigimod——一种人免疫球蛋白（Ig）G1抗体Fc片段，通过阻断新生儿Fc受体降低IgG（包括致病性自身抗体）水平——不会损害针对抗原刺激的细胞和体液免疫应答。在安慰剂对照研究中，efgartigimod组与安慰剂组参与者的严重感染发生率和严重程度相似，且在长期开放标签研究中未增加。目的：探讨efgartigimod治疗对疫苗接种免疫应答的影响。方法：在多项健康志愿者以及全身型重症肌无力（gMG）、慢性炎性脱髓鞘性多发性神经根神经病（CIDP）、免疫性血小板减少症（ITP）和寻常型天疱疮（PV）参与者的临床研究中，以多种给药方案给予静脉efgartigimod或皮下efgartigimod PH20。在多个时间点评估疫苗特异性IgG滴度和细胞免疫，包括接种前、接种后≥4周以及IgG最大降低时。结果：在接受efgartigimod的参与者中，抗原特异性IgG滴度从接种前至接种后升高，即使在IgG最大降低期间亦如此。将展示更多证明efgartigimod治疗期间细胞免疫应答得以保留的数据。总结/结论：efgartigimod作为Fc片段的独特结构可选择性降低IgG抗体和自身抗体，同时保留对免疫接种产生抗原特异性应答的能力。该机制避免了对免疫力的更广泛影响以及某些免疫抑制和B细胞清除治疗所观察到的感染风险增加。海报专场I和II

abstracts.title: Indirect Comparison of Nipocalimab Safety versus Neonatal Fc Receptor Blockers, C5 Complement Inhibitors, Rituximab and Intravenous Immunoglobulin in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Saiju Jacob; Brian Hutton; Suzy Van Sanden; Tom Denee; Wisam Karmous; Joris Diels; Kavita Gandhi; Carly J. Paoli; Mahmoud Hashim; Nils Erik Gilhus
abstracts.affiliations: Birmingham, United Kingdom; Ottawa, Canada; Beerse, Belgium; Breda, Netherlands; Issy les Moulineaux, France; Horsham, PA; Bergen, Norway
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab and standard of care (SOC) combination (nipocalimab) was generally well tolerated compared to placebo+SOC (placebo) in VIVACITY-MG3 (NCT04951622) among seropositive and seronegative adults with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). OBJECTIVE: To conduct indirect treatment comparisons (ITC) of nipocalimab safety outcomes (any adverse events [AEs] and serious adverse events [SAEs]) versus approved FcRn blockers (efgartigimod and rozanolixizumab), C5 complement inhibitors (ravulizumab, zilucoplan, and eculizumab), and off-label treatments (IVIG and rituximab). METHODS: A Bayesian network meta-analysis (NMA) was conducted on the acetylcholine receptor-positive (AChR+) population, selected to ensure comparability across eligible trials. Model selection was based on best-fit criteria. Base-case analyses included eligible trials with similar follow-up duration and sensitivity analyses included all trials independent of trial duration. Results are reported as odds-ratios (OR) and probability (P) of OR<1 favoring nipocalimab. RESULTS: The Bayesian NMA for AEs showed comparable results for nipocalimab versus other FcRn blockers and C5 inhibitors (P[OR<1]=16.7-83.8%) except for rozanolixizumab 10mg where nipocalimab was likely favorable (P[OR<1]=87.5%). For SAEs, nipocalimab results were comparable with eculizumab and efgartigimod (P[OR<1]=73.4%; 77.8%) and likely favorable versus other comparators (P[OR<1]: rozanolixizumab(7mg)=90.5%, zilucoplan=97.0%, efgartigimod(PH20 SC)=91.1%, rozanolixizumab(10mg)=95.9%, ravulizumab=99.4%). Compared to rituximab and IVIG, results were comparable for nipocalimab on AEs (P[OR<1]=50.1%; 54.3%) and were likely favorable for SAEs (P[OR<1]=96.4%; 96.0%). Results from base-case and sensitivity analyses were consistent. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: The benefit-risk profile is an important consideration when treating a chronic and fluctuating disease, like gMG. Based on ITCs, AE rates were comparable, while SAE results favored nipocalimab when compared with alternative gMG therapies. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在VIVACITY-MG3（NCT04951622）中，nipocalimab联合标准治疗（nipocalimab）在血清阳性和血清阴性全身型重症肌无力（gMG）成人中较安慰剂+SOC（安慰剂）总体耐受良好。目的：对nipocalimab的安全性结局（任何不良事件[AEs]和严重不良事件[SAEs]）与已获批FcRn阻断剂（efgartigimod和rozanolixizumab）、C5补体抑制剂（ravulizumab、zilucoplan和eculizumab）以及超说明书治疗（IVIG和rituximab）进行间接治疗比较（ITC）。方法：在乙酰胆碱受体阳性（AChR+）人群中开展贝叶斯网络荟萃分析（NMA），选择该人群以确保合格试验间的可比性。模型选择基于最佳拟合标准。基础病例分析纳入随访持续时间相似的合格试验，敏感性分析纳入所有试验而不考虑试验持续时间。结果以比值比（OR）和OR<1（有利于nipocalimab）的概率（P）报告。结果：AEs的贝叶斯NMA显示，nipocalimab与其他FcRn阻断剂和C5抑制剂结果相当（P[OR<1]=16.7–83.8%），但rozanolixizumab 10mg组nipocalimab可能更优（P[OR<1]=87.5%）。对于SAEs，nipocalimab与eculizumab和efgartigimod结果相当（P[OR<1]=73.4%；77.8%），且可能优于其他对照药（P[OR<1]：rozanolixizumab（7mg）=90.5%，zilucoplan=97.0%，efgartigimod（PH20 SC）=91.1%，rozanolixizumab（10mg）=95.9%，ravulizumab=99.4%）。与rituximab和IVIG相比，nipocalimab的AEs结果相当（P[OR<1]=50.1%；54.3%），SAEs可能更优（P[OR<1]=96.4%；96.0%）。基础病例和敏感性分析结果一致。总结/结论：在治疗gMG这类慢性波动性疾病时，获益-风险特征是重要考量。基于ITC，AEs发生率相当，而与其他gMG治疗相比，SAE结果有利于nipocalimab。海报专场I和II

abstracts.title: Long-term Safety and Efficacy of Nipocalimab: Approximately 2 Years of Follow-up Results from the Open-label Extension Phase of VIVACITY-MG3 Study
abstracts.authors: Carlo Antozzi; Tuan Vu; Sindhu Ramchandren; Richard Nowak; Constantine Farmakidis; Kumaraswamy Sivakumar; Panna Sanga; Ibrahim Turkoz; Yaowei Zhu; Marie Fitzgibbon; Michel Burcklen
abstracts.affiliations: Milan, Italy; Tampa, FL; Titusville, NJ; New Haven, CT; Kansas City, KS; Phoenix, AZ; Raritan, NJ; Basel, Switzerland
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In a broad population of autoantibody- positive generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) patients, nipocalimab demonstrated sustained improvement in MG- Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) scores over a 24-week double-blind phase and over a 60-week open-label extension (OLE) phase of the Vivacity-MG3 (NCT04951622) study. OBJECTIVE: To assess the long-term safety and efficacy of nipocalimab with additional follow-up, up to Week 96 of the ongoing OLE phase of nipocalimab treatment in gMG. METHODS: In Vivacity-MG3, adult patients with gMG (Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America Class II-IV), inadequately controlled (MG-ADL≥6) on standard-of-care (SOC) therapy, were randomized 1:1 to nipocalimab+SOC or placebo+SOC in the 24-week double-blind phase, followed by an option to enter the OLE phase. Efficacy and safety were evaluated in seropositive (anti-AChR positive, anti-MuSK positive, and/or anti-LRP4 positive) patients who received ≥1 dose of study treatment. RESULTS: In the seropositive efficacy analysis set (N=137) during the OLE, total duration of treatment (median [range]) for placebo/nipocalimab (n=66) and nipocalimab/nipocalimab (n=71) groups was 69.1-weeks (8–128) and 62.1-weeks (8–128) respectively. The mean (SD) change-from-baseline (CFB) in MG-ADL scores for those who reached 96-weeks of treatment with placebo/nipocalimab and nipocalimab/nipocalimab groups was –6.69(3.39) and –6.47(4.62), and CFB in Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) scores was –5.81(4.11) and –5.97(4.97) respectively. The mean (SD) percent CFB in IgG for the placebo/nipocalimab group was –63.24(14.31) and for the nipocalimab/nipocalimab group was –64.06(12.91). No new safety concerns were reported in the OLE phase. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In autoantibody-positive patients with gMG, long-term treatment with nipocalimab demonstrated sustained disease control through the 24- week double-blind phase and the 96-week OLE (120- weeks total) of the Vivacity-MG3 study. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.title: Minimal Symptom Expression with Claseprubart, an Active C1S Inhibitor, in Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Said Beydoun; Nils Erik Gilhus; Amit Sachdev; Maria Ait-Tihyaty; Caitlin Briggs; Uzma Siddiqui; Luke Hickey; Marianna Lalla; Marek Smilowski
abstracts.affiliations: Los Angeles, CA; Bergen, Norway; East Lansing, MI; Verdun, Canada; Raleigh, NC; Buffalo, NY; New York, NY; London, United Kingdom; Katowice, Poland
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: The classical complement pathway plays a significant role in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) pathology. Claseprubart is a potent monoclonal antibody that selectively targets the classical pathway by inhibiting active C1s (aC1s). OBJECTIVE: Remission is a key goal in gMG and achieving minimal symptom expression (MSE) with claseprubart is a key treatment objective. METHODS: MaGic (NCT06282159), is a global Phase 2, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial. Patients treated with claseprubart (300 mg, Q2W) were evaluated for MSE (MG-ADL ≤1 or QMG ≤3) compared with placebo. p-values were one-sided and nominal significance was assessed at alpha=0.1. Outcomes include the proportion of patients achieving MSE at Week 13 and anytime during the study, earliest timepoint of MSE achievement, and durability, defined as sustained MSE for at least 6 weeks. RESULTS: At Week 13, 37% of claseprubart-treated patients achieved MG-ADL-MSE versus 14% with placebo (OR 3.81; p=0.0550). Overall, 43% achieved MG-ADL- MSE at least once during the study versus 14% with placebo (OR: 4.72; p=0.0231). This effect was observed as early as Week 1 (median time to response was Week 3). Sustained remission-like states (for at least 6 weeks) were seen in all patients who achieved MSE. Similar results were observed using the QMG minimum symptom expression threshold. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Claseprubart patients were more than four times more likely to achieve MSE than placebo patients and MSE was observed as early as Week 1. Patients who achieved MSE maintained responses for at least 6 weeks. These results highlight the therapeutic potential of aC1s inhibition in AChR+ gMG. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：经典补体途径在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）病理中起重要作用。Claseprubart是一种强效单克隆抗体，通过抑制活性C1s（aC1s）选择性靶向经典途径。目的：缓解是gMG的关键目标，使用claseprubart实现最小症状表达（MSE）是关键治疗目标。方法：MaGic（NCT06282159）是一项全球II期、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验。接受claseprubart（300 mg，每2周一次）治疗的患者与安慰剂相比评估MSE（MG-ADL≤1或QMG≤3）。p值为单侧，名义显著性在alpha=0.1水平评估。结局包括第13周及研究期间任意时间达到MSE的患者比例、达到MSE的最早时间点以及持久性（定义为MSE持续至少6周）。结果：第13周时，37%的claseprubart治疗患者达到MG-ADL-MSE，安慰剂组为14%（OR 3.81；p=0.0550）。总体而言，43%的患者在研究期间至少一次达到MG-ADL-MSE，安慰剂组为14%（OR：4.72；p=0.0231）。该效应最早在第1周即可观察到（中位起效时间为第3周）。所有达到MSE的患者均出现持续缓解样状态（至少6周）。使用QMG最小症状表达阈值观察到相似结果。总结/结论：Claseprubart患者达到MSE的可能性是安慰剂患者的四倍以上，且MSE最早在第1周即可观察到。达到MSE的患者维持应答至少6周。这些结果突显了aC1s抑制在AChR+ gMG中的治疗潜力。海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: Myasthenia Gravis Inebilizumab Trial: 26-week Randomized Placebo-controlled and 26-week Open-label Results in Anti-muscle-specific Kinase Subgroup
abstracts.authors: Richard Nowak; Maria Isabel Leite; Michael Benatar; Emma Ciafaloni; John Vissing; Kimiaki Utsugisawa; Sarah Bray; Ankur Bhambri; Arati Kiran Kanchi; Sue Cheng; James F. Howard; Jr.

abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is caused by anti-muscle-specific kinase (MuSK+) and anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR+) antibodies targeting corresponding proteins in the synapse. The placebo (PBO)-controlled MG Inebilizumab (INEB) Trial (MINT) assessed INEB, a monoclonal antibody targeting CD19+ B cells, in patients with MuSK+ or AChR+ gMG. INEB vs PBO yielded significantly greater improvements in Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) scores at Week 26 in MINT. OBJECTIVE: To report key outcomes for the MuSK+ subpopulation from the first 26 weeks of the open-label period (OLP). METHODS: Participants with MuSK+ gMG in MINT (NCT04524273) were randomized 1:1 to 300 mg intravenous INEB or PBO for 26 weeks. Participants underwent a protocol-specified steroid taper (≤5 mg/day by week 24). After the randomized, controlled period (RCP), participants could receive INEB in the OLP. This pre-specified, interim, descriptive analysis included participants who received any dose of INEB during MINT. No statistical testing was done. RESULTS: Overall, 48 participants with MuSK+ were enrolled and randomized: 46 entered the OLP and 44 completed 26 weeks. Baseline MG-ADL and QMG scores were similar between groups, and mean scores decreased from baseline to Week 26 during the RCP (INEB –4.1, –5.0; PBO –3.1, –4.2, respectively). During the initial 26- week OLP (Week 52), the mean MG-ADL and QMG scores continued to decrease from baseline (INEB/INEB: –5.6, –6.1; PBO/INEB: –5.1, –7.4, respectively). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In this descriptive analysis, INEB demonstrated ongoing improvement in MG-ADL and QMG scores compared to baseline irrespective of initial randomization. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）由抗肌肉特异性激酶（MuSK+）和抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR+）抗体靶向突触中相应蛋白所致。安慰剂（PBO）对照的MG Inebilizumab（INEB）试验（MINT）评估了INEB（一种靶向CD19+ B细胞的单克隆抗体）在MuSK+或AChR+ gMG患者中的作用。在MINT中，与PBO相比，INEB在第26周时使重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）和定量重症肌无力（QMG）评分获得显著更大改善。目的：报告开放标签期（OLP）前26周MuSK+亚人群的关键结局。方法：MINT（NCT04524273）中的MuSK+ gMG参与者按1:1随机分配至300 mg静脉INEB或PBO治疗26周。参与者接受方案规定的激素减量（至第24周≤5 mg/天）。在随机对照期（RCP）后，参与者可在OLP中接受INEB。这项预设的中期描述性分析纳入在MINT期间接受任何剂量INEB的参与者。未进行统计学检验。结果：总体而言，48例MuSK+参与者入组并随机化：46例进入OLP，44例完成26周。两组基线MG-ADL和QMG评分相似，RCP期间平均评分从基线至第26周下降（INEB –4.1、–5.0；PBO –3.1、–4.2）。在初始26周OLP期间（第52周），平均MG-ADL和QMG评分较基线继续下降（INEB/INEB：–5.6、–6.1；PBO/INEB：–5.1、–7.4）。总结/结论：在这项描述性分析中，无论初始随机分组如何，INEB均显示出MG-ADL和QMG评分较基线的持续改善。海报会议I和II

abstracts.title: Propel: A Phase 3 Study Investigating the Neonatal Fragment Crystallizable Receptor Blocker Imeroprubart in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Richard Nowak; Michael Benatar; Sheetal Patel; Li-Yin Lee; Heinz Wiendl
abstracts.affiliations: New Haven, CT; Miami, FL; Durham, NC; Freiburg, Germany
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: An estimated 10%-20% of patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) experience inadequate disease control and/or intolerable side effects with conventional treatments. Blockade of the neonatal fragment crystallizable receptor (FcRn) is a newer treatment approach that reduces circulating immunoglobulin G (IgG), including pathogenic IgG autoantibodies underlying gMG. OBJECTIVE: Describe the design of a clinical trial of imeroprubart (IMVT-1402), an investigational FcRn blocker, in adults with gMG. METHODS: This Phase 3, multicenter, randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial will enroll approximately 231 individuals aged 18-80 years with mild to severe gMG (ie, Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America Class II, III, or IVa) at the screening visit, including antibody-positive (anti–acetylcholine receptor, anti–muscle-specific kinase, or anti–low-density lipoprotein receptor-related protein 4) and seronegative patients. A Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) score of ≥6 at screening and baseline is also required. Participants will be randomized 1:1:1 to receive 12 weekly doses of imeroprubart 600 mg, imeroprubart 300 mg, or placebo, administered subcutaneously with an autoinjector. All participants will subsequently receive blinded, active treatment for an additional 66 weeks. The primary endpoint is the change from baseline in MG-ADL score at Week 12 for antibody-positive participants. Key secondary endpoints include change from baseline in Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis score, proportion of participants achieving an MG-ADL score of 0 or 1, and proportion of participants with an improvement of ≥50% in MG-ADL score at Week 12. RESULTS: The trial (NCT07039916) is currently recruiting participants. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Results are expected to evaluate the efficacy and safety of imeroprubart in adults with mild to severe gMG. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.title: Targeted Immunotherapies in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Effectiveness of Neonatal Fc Receptor and Complement Inhibitors
abstracts.authors: Anagha Rayaprolu
abstracts.affiliations: Redmond, WA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is a chronic autoimmune disorder that presents with impaired neuromuscular transmission, causing persistent muscle weakness. New precision immunotherapies such as neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn) inhibitors and complement inhibitors have exhibited potential in reducing disease severity. We conducted a systematic review and meta- analysis to evaluate the effectiveness of these therapies in patients with generalized MG (gMG). OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the efficacy of FcRn and complement inhibitors in patients with gMG through a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs). METHODS: A systematic review identified Phase II and III RCTs analyzing FcRn inhibitors, such as efgartigimod, and complement inhibitors including zilucoplan and ravulizumab. The primary outcome was the number of patients who had clinically meaningful improvement in MG-Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) or Quantitative MG (QMG) scores. Published odds ratios and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were extracted, which were translated into log ORs. Standard errors were calculated. RESULTS: A total of 866 patients were included across the selected studies. The individual study ORs ranged from 2.90 to 4.95, favoring active treatment over the placebo. The pooled OR was 3.36 (95% CI: 2.52–4.47), indicating that patients receiving FcRn or complement inhibitors were significantly more likely to achieve clinical improvement. Heterogeneity was minimal (I^2 = 0%) and similar improvements were seen in both MG-ADL and QMG. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: These results show that FcRn and complement inhibitors consistently provide benefit for patients with generalized myasthenia gravis. These results portray targeted immunotherapies as effective treatment options and emphasize the need for continued investigation to optimize therapeutic strategies in this patient population. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）是一种慢性自身免疫性疾病，表现为神经肌肉传递受损，导致持续性肌无力。新型精准免疫治疗，如新生儿Fc受体（FcRn）抑制剂和补体抑制剂，已显示出减轻疾病严重程度的潜力。我们开展了一项系统评价和荟萃分析，以评估这些疗法在全身型MG（gMG）患者中的有效性。目的：通过随机对照试验（RCT）的荟萃分析，评估FcRn抑制剂和补体抑制剂在gMG患者中的疗效。方法：系统评价筛选出分析FcRn抑制剂（如efgartigimod）和补体抑制剂（包括zilucoplan和ravulizumab）的II期和III期RCT。主要结局为MG日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）或定量MG（QMG）评分出现临床意义改善的患者数量。提取已发表的比值比（OR）和95%置信区间（CI），并转换为对数OR。计算标准误。结果：所选研究共纳入866例患者。各研究OR范围为2.90至4.95，均支持活性治疗优于安慰剂。合并OR为3.36（95% CI：2.52–4.47），表明接受FcRn或补体抑制剂的患者达到临床改善的可能性显著更高。异质性极小（I^2 = 0%），MG-ADL和QMG均观察到相似改善。总结/结论：这些结果表明，FcRn和补体抑制剂对全身型重症肌无力患者持续带来获益。这些结果将靶向免疫治疗描述为有效的治疗选择，并强调需要继续研究以优化该患者人群的治疗策略。海报专场I和III

abstracts.title: Traditional Chinese Medicine as Adjunctive Therapy for Myasthenic Crisis: A Multicenter Randomized Controlled Trial
abstracts.authors: Xiao Huan; Sushan Luo; Chongbo Zhao; Zhe Ruan; Qilong Jiang; Jie Cao; Jianying Xi; Yafang Xu
abstracts.affiliations: Shanghai, China; Xi'an, China; GuangZhou, China; Jilin, China
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenic crisis (MC) carries high mortality and marked CD4+ T cell dysregulation. Astragalus (Huangqi) injection and Dushen Tang (single Panax ginseng root decoction) have plausible immunomodulatory properties but remain unevaluated in MC. OBJECTIVE: To assess whether adjunctive Astragalus injection and Dushen Tang improve outcomes and modulate CD4+ T cell subsets in MC. METHODS: In this multicenter, randomized, open-label, assessor-blinded trial, 55 MGFA Class V patients were assigned to conventional immunotherapy (corticosteroids plus IVIg; n=27) or Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) add-on therapy (plus Astragalus injection and Dushen Tang; n=28) for 14 days. Primary endpoint was MG-ADL change at Day 30. Secondary endpoints included ventilator dependency duration and QMG/MMT/MGC scores at Days 30 and 60. CD4+ T cell subsets were assessed by flow cytometry in a subgroup (n=22). RESULTS: The TCM add-on group showed greater MG- ADL improvement at Day 30 (11.9 vs. 8.4; p=0.021) and a trend toward shorter ventilator dependency (12.8 vs. 14.4 days; p=0.396). Functional scores and Day-60 minimal symptom expression rates were comparable (34% vs. 36%). One death occurred per group. Immunologically, the TCM add-on group showed reduced Th1 cells at Month 1 (22.0%→12.5%; p=0.028), reduced central memory T cells at Month 2 (46.0%→28.3%; p=0.023), and higher Treg proportions (8.0% vs. 4.8%; p=0.02). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Adjunctive Astragalus injection and Dushen Tang significantly improved early functional status in MC, with a trend toward reduced ventilator dependence. Suppression of pro-inflammatory Th1 and central memory T cells alongside Treg upregulation suggests accelerated immune homeostasis restoration. This safe regimen supports TCM-integrated MC management. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：肌无力危象（MC）死亡率高，并伴有显著的CD4+ T细胞失调。黄芪注射液和独参汤（单味人参根煎剂）具有可能的免疫调节特性，但在MC中尚未被评估。目的：评估辅助性黄芪注射液和独参汤是否能改善MC结局并调节CD4+ T细胞亚群。方法：在这项多中心、随机、开放标签、评估者盲法试验中，55例MGFA V级患者被分配接受常规免疫治疗（糖皮质激素联合IVIg；n=27）或中药（TCM）附加治疗（加用黄芪注射液和独参汤；n=28），疗程14天。主要终点为第30天MG-ADL变化。次要终点包括呼吸机依赖持续时间以及第30天和第60天的QMG/MMT/MGC评分。在亚组（n=22）中通过流式细胞术评估CD4+ T细胞亚群。结果：中药附加治疗组第30天MG-ADL改善更明显（11.9 vs. 8.4；p=0.021），呼吸机依赖持续时间有缩短趋势（12.8 vs. 14.4天；p=0.396）。功能评分和第60天最小症状表达率相当（34% vs. 36%）。每组各发生1例死亡。免疫学方面，中药附加治疗组第1个月Th1细胞降低（22.0%→12.5%；p=0.028），第2个月中央记忆T细胞降低（46.0%→28.3%；p=0.023），Treg比例更高（8.0% vs. 4.8%；p=0.02）。总结/结论：辅助性黄芪注射液和独参汤显著改善MC患者的早期功能状态，并呈呼吸机依赖减少趋势。抑制促炎性Th1和中央记忆T细胞并上调Treg，提示免疫稳态恢复加快。该方案安全性良好，支持中西医结合的MC管理。海报专场I和II

abstracts.title: When Should Therapies be Switched in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis? Implications of Treatment Response Kinetics
abstracts.authors: Heidi Aguas; Amit Sachdev
abstracts.affiliations: Novi, MI; Okemos, MI
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Determining when to switch therapies in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) remains a clinical challenge. Achieving minimal manifestations status (MMS) is a common treatment goal, yet therapies differ in response kinetics. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate how differences between rapid- acting biologic therapies and conventional immunosuppressive therapies influence treatment evaluation timelines. Rapid-acting biologic therapies produce early clinical improvement, while conventional immunosuppressive therapies often require longer treatment durations before maximal benefit is observed. Because most clinical trials evaluate efficacy during fixed double-blind periods, delayed therapeutic responses may be underrecognized in practice. METHODS: We performed a structured literature review. Extracted variables included therapy class, trial design, double-blind duration, sample size, outcome measures (MG-ADL, Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis [QMG], MGFA post-intervention status), time to clinical response, and rates of minimal manifestations. RESULTS: Thirty-three studies, including international guidelines, encompassing approximately 3,500 patients with gMG were analyzed. The median double-blind duration among randomized trials was 24 weeks. In the ADAPT trial, efgartigimod produced MG-ADL improvement as early as 1 week, with 60–70% responder rates; sustained responses were reported in ADAPT+. Eculizumab in REGAIN (n=125) demonstrated improvement within weeks. In contrast, comparative studies of azathioprine and mycophenolate (n=320) reported 10- to 17-month median times to minimal manifestations, while thymectomy in MGTX (n=126) showed progressive improvement over years. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Across studies, biologic therapies improved symptoms within 1–4 weeks, whereas conventional immunosuppressive therapies required 10–17 months. These findings support extended treatment evaluation, potentially up to twice the original double-blind trial duration, before switching therapies, and suggest a rapid induction strategy with FcRn inhibition followed by longer-term immunosuppressive maintenance. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：确定全身型重症肌无力（gMG）何时转换治疗仍是临床挑战。达到最小表现状态（MMS）是常见治疗目标，但不同疗法的应答动力学存在差异。目的：评估快速起效生物制剂与传统免疫抑制治疗之间的差异如何影响治疗评估时间线。快速起效生物制剂产生早期临床改善，而传统免疫抑制治疗通常需要更长治疗时间才能观察到最大获益。由于大多数临床试验在固定双盲期内评估疗效，延迟的治疗应答在临床实践中可能被低估。方法：我们进行了结构化文献综述。提取变量包括治疗类别、试验设计、双盲持续时间、样本量、结局指标（MG-ADL、定量重症肌无力[QMG]、MGFA干预后状态）、至临床应答时间以及最小表现率。结果：分析了33项研究（包括国际指南），涵盖约3,500例gMG患者。随机试验的中位双盲持续时间为24周。在ADAPT试验中，efgartigimod早在1周即产生MG-ADL改善，应答率为60–70%；ADAPT+报告了持续应答。REGAIN中的eculizumab（n=125）在数周内显示改善。相比之下，硫唑嘌呤和霉酚酸酯的比较研究（n=320）报告至最小表现的中位时间为10至17个月，而MGTX中的胸腺切除术（n=126）显示多年内逐步改善。总结/结论：跨研究显示，生物制剂在1–4周内改善症状，而传统免疫抑制治疗需要10–17个月。这些发现支持在转换治疗前延长治疗评估时间，可能长达原双盲试验持续时间的两倍，并提示采用FcRn抑制快速诱导后长期免疫抑制维持的策略。海报专场I和III

abstracts.authors: Y. Li1; T. Chang2; H. Yang3; S. Tan4; L. Luo5; X. Cao6; J. Hu7; B. Bu1; Z. Li1
abstracts.affiliations: 1Department of Neurology, Tongji Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, China; 2Department of Neurology, Tangdu Hospital, Air Force Medical University, Xi'an, China; 3Department of Neurology, Xiangya Hospital, Central South University, Changsha, China; 4epartment of Rare Diseases, Sichuan Provincial People's Hospital, School of Medicine, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Chengdu, China; 5Department of Neurology, Wuhan No.1 Hospital, Wuhan, China; 6Department of Neurology, Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, China; 7Department of Neurology, Taihe Hospital, Hubei University of Medicine, Shiyan, China
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is a chronic autoimmune neuromuscular disorder needing long-term immu- nosuppressive therapy. Eculizumab is a promising treatment, but real-world evidence on its efficacy and safety is limited. Methods: A retrospective cohort study was done across six medical centers, enrolling 60 MG patients on eculizumab. FIGURE 3 The serological indicators for the responsiveness to IVMP during acute attack of NMOSD and the implication for further rescue therapy. FIGURE 1 Longitudinal Distribution of MGFA Post-Intervention Status (PIS) (A) Percentage of patients classified as MMS+, improved, unchanged, worse, or deceased at baseline, Weeks 1, 4, 8, and the last follow-up. (B) Percentage of patients achieving MMS. Clinical data, including MG-Activities of Daily Living (ADL) scores, quantitative MG scores (QMG), and oral corticosteroid dosage at different time points (baseline, Weeks 1, 4, 8, and final follow-up before November 2024), were extracted from medical records Study outcomes included efficacy measures (changes in MG-ADL and QMG scores, Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America [MGFA] Post-Intervention Status [PIS], glucocorticoid dosage), and safety profile of eculizumab. Results: In this cohort, 30.95% of patients achieved minimal manifestation status or better by Week 8, increasing to 32.69% at final follow-up. Meanwhile, mean ADL scores significantly dropped from 8.13±3.99 at baseline to 5.59±3.72 by Week 1 and to 3.33±3.56 by the final follow-up (p < 0.0001). Clinically mean- ingful improvement up to 76.27% at final follow-up was also ob- served. In the thymoma-associated MG (TAMG) subgroup, ADL decreased rapidly compared to baseline (p < 0.001), and the non- TAMG cohort also improved significantly at each time point (p ≤ 0.026). Additionally, no treatment-related adverse events were observed. The quick drop in MG-ADL scores indicates its efficacy, and the steroid-sparing effect is crucial for long-term management. In TAMG, improvement was early, reaching max- imum benefit in the first week. Conclusion: This multicenter analysis shows eculizumab im- proves clinical outcomes in MG patients, reducing disease activ- ity and corticosteroid use.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：重症肌无力（MG）是一种需要长期免疫抑制治疗的慢性自身免疫性神经肌肉疾病。依库珠单抗是一种有前景的治疗方法，但其有效性和安全性的真实世界证据有限。方法：这是一项在六个医疗中心进行的回顾性队列研究，纳入了60名接受依库珠单抗治疗的MG患者。图3 NMOSD急性发作期间对IVMP反应性的血清学指标及其对后续挽救治疗的意义。图1 MGFA干预后状态（PIS）的纵向分布（A）在基线、第1、4、8周及末次随访时，被分类为MMS+、改善、无变化、恶化或死亡的患者百分比。（B）达到MMS的患者百分比。从医疗记录中提取了不同时间点（基线、第1、4、8周及2024年11月前的末次随访）的临床数据，包括MG-日常生活活动（ADL）评分、定量MG评分（QMG）和口服皮质类固醇剂量。研究结局包括疗效指标（MG-ADL和QMG评分的变化、美国重症肌无力基金会[MGFA]干预后状态[PIS]、糖皮质激素剂量）以及依库珠单抗的安全性特征。结果：在该队列中，30.95%的患者在第8周达到最小表现状态或更好，在末次随访时增加到32.69%。同时，平均ADL评分从基线的8.13±3.99显著下降至第1周的5.59±3.72，并在末次随访时降至3.33±3.56（p < 0.0001）。在末次随访时，观察到高达76.27%的患者具有临床意义的改善。在胸腺瘤相关MG（TAMG）亚组中，与基线相比ADL迅速下降（p < 0.001），非TAMG队列在每个时间点也显著改善（p ≤ 0.026）。此外，未观察到与治疗相关的不良事件。MG-ADL评分的快速下降表明其疗效，而激素节省效应对长期管理至关重要。在TAMG中，改善出现较早，在第一周达到最大获益。结论：这项多中心分析表明，依库珠单抗改善了MG患者的临床结局，降低了疾病活动度和皮质类固醇的使用。

abstracts.title: Effect of nipocalimab on pathogenic IgG and complement markers in patients with seropositive gMG: Exploratory analysis in Vivacity-MG3 study
abstracts.authors: S. Miller1; J. Xi2; Y. Zhang2; R. Faelens3; M. Fitzgibbon4; S. Ramchandren5; S. Hoffmann6
abstracts.affiliations: 1Johnson & Johnson, San Diego, USA; 2Johnson & Johnson, Spring House, USA; 3Johnson & Johnson, Beerse, Belgium; 4Johnson & Johnson, Raritan, USA; 5Johnson & Johnson, Titusville, USA; 6Neurology, Charité - Universitätsmedizin Berlin, Berlin, Germany
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Immunoglobulin (Ig)G class autoanti- bodies block and internalize the acetylcholine receptor (AChR) and activate complement at the neuromuscular junction, leading to symptoms of myasthenia gravis. Nipocalimab, a fully human neonatal-Fc-receptor blocker, substantially reduced circulat- ing IgG, including pathogenic subclasses, and demonstrated FIGURE 1 MG-ADL total score changes from baseline to Week 4. FIGURE 2 MG-ADL total score changes from study baseline over time- overall population. TABLE 1 Summary of treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs)- overall population. sustained efficacy versus placebo during 24-week Vivacity-MG3 study (NCT04951622). This post-hoc analysis evaluated whether nipocalimab reduces circulating complement components and activity indicative of complement activation, in Vivacity-MG3. Methods: Available serum samples from seropositive (positive for AChR/muscle-specific receptor tyrosine kinase [MuSK]/ Low-density Lipoprotein Receptor-related Protein-4 [LRP4]) participants were analysed at baseline and Week-24 and least square means were compared between placebo and nipo- calimab using linear mixed model. Complement markers mea- sured were: C3d circulating immune complexes (C3d-CIC), C1q immune complex binding (C1q-ICB), and total complement activity (CH50). Parallel assays quantified total IgG, IgG1/2/3, and anti AChR titers, which informed a nonlinear mixed-model previously presented. Results: Baseline levels of complement markers were com- parable across nipocalimab and placebo groups (Table-1). At Week-24, nipocalimab was associated with substantial and sus- tained reductions in IgG1/2/3, and anti AChR titers (Table-2). Concomitant decreases were observed in selected immune com- plex–associated complement markers (C3d-CIC and C1q-ICB, p < 0.05); no significant change in CH50 was detected (Table 1). Conclusion: Nipocalimab led to sustained reductions in IgG subclasses and anti-AChR titers, accompanied by significant decreases in selected circulating immune complex–associated complement markers, while no significant change in total com- plement activity was observed. These data indicate changes in selected complement-related markers following nipocalimab treatment; further exploration is needed to better understand the clinical relevance.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：免疫球蛋白（Ig）G类自身抗体在神经肌肉接头处阻断并内化乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）并激活补体，导致重症肌无力症状。Nipocalimab是一种全人源新生儿Fc受体阻滞剂，可显著降低循环IgG（包括致病性亚类），并在为期24周的Vivacity-MG3研究（NCT04951622）中显示出与安慰剂相比持续的疗效。这项事后分析评估了在Vivacity-MG3研究中，nipocalimab是否能降低指示补体激活的循环补体成分和活性。方法：分析了来自血清阳性（AChR/肌肉特异性受体酪氨酸激酶[MuSK]/低密度脂蛋白受体相关蛋白4[LRP4]阳性）参与者的可用血清样本，在基线和第24周进行分析，并使用线性混合模型比较安慰剂和nipocalimab之间的最小二乘均值。测量的补体标志物为：C3d循环免疫复合物（C3d-CIC）、C1q免疫复合物结合（C1q-ICB）和总补体活性（CH50）。平行检测了总IgG、IgG1/2/3和抗AChR滴度，这些数据为先前提出的非线性混合模型提供了信息。结果：补体标志物的基线水平在nipocalimab组和安慰剂组之间具有可比性（表1）。在第24周，nipocalimab与IgG1/2/3和抗AChR滴度的显著且持续降低相关（表2）。在选定的免疫复合物相关补体标志物（C3d-CIC和C1q-ICB，p < 0.05）中观察到伴随性降低；未检测到CH50的显著变化（表1）。结论：Nipocalimab导致IgG亚类和抗AChR滴度持续降低，并伴有选定的循环免疫复合物相关补体标志物的显著下降，而未观察到总补体活性的显著变化。这些数据表明nipocalimab治疗后选定的补体相关标志物发生变化；需要进一步探索以更好地理解其临床相关性。

abstracts.title: Efficacy and safety analysis of efgartigimod in patients with very-late-onset myasthenia gravis
abstracts.authors: Y. Zhao; M. Qu; X. Rong; X. Sun; L. Wang; M. Liu Department of Neurology, the Affiliated Hospital of Qingdao University, Qingdao, China
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an autoim- mune disorder caused by pathogenic IgG autoantibodies disrupt- ing the neuromuscular junction. Very-late-onset MG (VLOMG, onset ≥65 years) poses greater management challenges, with scarce data on efgartigimod (a novel FcRn antagonist) in this population. Methods: Retrospective analysis of 62 AChR antibody-positive VLOMG patients treated with efgartigimod (10 mg/kg IV weekly for 4 weeks, repeated after 4-week intervals) at Affiliated Hospital of Qingdao University (Nov 2023–Sep 2025), assess- ing MSE rate, corticosteroid reduction, MG-ADL/MG-QoL15r scores, muscle function, and adverse events (AEs). Results: A total of 62 eligible VLOMG patients were enrolled, of these, 15 completed 3 or more treatment cycles, 10 completed 2 cycles, and 37 completed 1 cycle. At the study endpoint, 41.9% (26/62) of patients had achieved MSE. MG-ADL/MG-QoL15r scores and corticosteroid doses significantly decreased across subgroups (1, 2, ≥3 cycles, all P < 0.05). MG-ADL/MG-QoL15r TABLE 1 Patient characteristics at efgartigimod initiation. scores with progressive improvement in ≥3-cycle patients. No serious AEs/deaths occurred; only 1 allergic rash. Conclusion: Efgartigimod is safe and effective for VLOMG, ameliorating symptoms, improving quality of life, and facilitat- ing corticosteroid reduction.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：重症肌无力（MG）是一种由致病性IgG自身抗体破坏神经肌肉接头引起的自身免疫性疾病。极晚发型MG（VLOMG，发病年龄≥65岁）带来了更大的管理挑战，关于efgartigimod（一种新型FcRn拮抗剂）在该人群中的数据很少。方法：对青岛大学附属医院（2023年11月至2025年9月）接受efgartigimod（10 mg/kg IV每周一次，持续4周，每4周间隔后重复）治疗的62名AChR抗体阳性VLOMG患者进行回顾性分析，评估MSE率、皮质类固醇减量、MG-ADL/MG-QoL15r评分、肌肉功能和不良事件（AEs）。结果：共纳入62名符合条件的VLOMG患者，其中15名完成了3个或更多治疗周期，10名完成了2个周期，37名完成了1个周期。在研究终点，41.9%（26/62）的患者达到了MSE。MG-ADL/MG-QoL15r评分和皮质类固醇剂量在各亚组（1、2、≥3个周期，所有P < 0.05）中均显著下降。表1 efgartigimod启动时的患者特征。在≥3个周期患者中，MG-ADL/MG-QoL15r评分呈现进行性改善。未发生严重不良事件/死亡；仅出现1例过敏性皮疹。结论：Efgartigimod对VLOMG安全有效，可改善症状、提高生活质量并促进皮质类固醇减量。

abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is a chronic autoimmune condition characterized by fluctuating mus- cle weakness and fatigue. Nipocalimab added to standard- of-care (SOC) showed greater improvement than placebo (+SOC) in Myasthenia-Gravis–Activities-of-Daily-Living (MG- ADL), and Quantitative-Myasthenia-Gravis (QMG) scores in VIVACITY-MG3 study (NCT04496507). This post hoc analy- sis evaluated whether efficacy was achievable in patients with generalized MG (gMG) diagnosed earlier (≤5 years) before study initiation. Methods: Analysis included seropositive patients treated with nipocalimab or placebo who had been diagnosed with gMG within ≤5 years (below the cohort median of 5 years). Efficacy at week (W)24 was assessed using MG-ADL (meaningful clinical improvement [MCI]: ≥2-point improvement; substantial clinical improvement [SCI]: ≥3-point improvement) and QMG (MCI: ≥3-point improvement; SCI: ≥4-point improvement) scores in patients diagnosed with gMG ≤5 years. Two-sample t-tests com- pared baseline-to-W24 changes between groups. Results: Baseline demographics were generally balanced be- tween nipocalimab and placebo-treated patients (Table 1). At W24, MG-ADL reductions (mean [SD]) from baseline were greater with nipocalimab (−4.9 [2.88]) versus placebo (−2.7 [2.46]); difference: −2.22 (SE: 0.76); 95% CI (−3.74; −0.70); p = 0.005. Similarly, QMG reductions (mean [SD]) from base- line were greater with nipocalimab (−5.1 [4.14]) versus placebo (−2.3 [3.20]); difference: −2.85 (SE:1.08); 95% CI (−5.03; −0.66); p = 0.012. A greater proportion of patients receiving nipocalimab met MCI and SCI criteria for MG-ADL and QMG at W24 versus placebo (Table 1). Conclusion: In patients diagnosed with gMG in ≤5 years be- fore study initiation, nipocalimab demonstrated greater efficacy versus placebo, achieving MCI and SCI in MG-ADL and QMG at W24. These findings highlight the benefit of nipocalimab in recently diagnosed patients with gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：重症肌无力（MG）是一种以波动性肌无力和疲劳为特征的慢性自身免疫性疾病。在VIVACITY-MG3研究（NCT04496507）中，在标准治疗（SOC）基础上加用nipocalimab在MG-日常生活活动（MG-ADL）和定量MG（QMG）评分方面显示出比安慰剂（+SOC）更大的改善。这项事后分析评估了在研究开始前诊断时间较早（≤5年）的全身型MG（gMG）患者中是否能达到疗效。方法：分析包括接受nipocalimab或安慰剂治疗、且在入组前诊断为gMG≤5年（低于队列中位数5年）的血清阳性患者。在第24周（W24）使用MG-ADL（有意义的临床改善[MCI]：≥2分改善；显著临床改善[SCI]：≥3分改善）和QMG（MCI：≥3分改善；SCI：≥4分改善）评分评估诊断为gMG≤5年患者的疗效。使用双样本t检验比较组间从基线到第24周的变化。结果：nipocalimab组和安慰剂组患者的基线人口学特征总体平衡（表1）。在第24周，nipocalimab组MG-ADL评分从基线的平均（SD）降低幅度更大（−4.9 [2.88]），而安慰剂组为（−2.7 [2.46]）；差异：−2.22（SE: 0.76）；95% CI (−3.74; −0.70)；p = 0.005。同样，nipocalimab组QMG评分从基线的平均（SD）降低幅度更大（−5.1 [4.14]），而安慰剂组为（−2.3 [3.20]）；差异：−2.85（SE:1.08）；95% CI (−5.03; −0.66)；p = 0.012。在第24周，接受nipocalimab治疗的患者达到MG-ADL和QMG的MCI和SCI标准的比例高于安慰剂组（表1）。结论：在研究开始前诊断为gMG≤5年的患者中，nipocalimab显示出优于安慰剂的疗效，在第24周达到了MG-ADL和QMG的MCI和SCI。这些发现强调了nipocalimab对新近诊断的gMG患者的获益。

abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is a chronic autoimmune disease characterised by fluctuating muscle weakness and fatigability, which may worsen without effec- tive treatment. In VIVACITY-MG3 (NCT04496507) study, nipocalimab added to standard-of-care (SOC), demonstrated greater improvement in Myasthenia-Gravis–Activities-of-Daily- Living (MG-ADL), and Quantitative-Myasthenia-Gravis (QMG) scores versus placebo (+SOC). This post hoc analysis evaluated FIGURE 1 Change in PDSS-2 (a) total score and (b) by domain from baseline to week 6 of opicapone treatment in PD patients with or with- out probable RBD. Methods: Analysis included seropositive patients treated with nipocalimab or placebo with baseline MG-ADL score below co- hort median score of 9. Efficacy was evaluated by changes in MG-ADL (meaningful clinical improvement [MCI]: ≥2-point improvement; substantial clinical improvement [SCI]: ≥3-point improvement), and QMG (MCI: ≥3-point improvement; SCI: ≥4- point improvement) scores at week (W) 24. Two-sample t-tests compared changes-from-baseline between groups. Results: In this population, baseline demographics were gen- erally balanced between nipocalimab and placebo-treated pa- tients (Table). At W24, MG-ADL reductions (mean [SD]) from baseline were greater with nipocalimab (−4.5 [2.64]) versus pla- cebo (−2.3 [2.37]); difference: −2.23 (standard error [SE]: 0.588); 95%CI (−3.41; −1.06); p < 0.001. QMG reductions (mean [SD]) were also greater with nipocalimab (−5.2 [4.45]) versus placebo (−1.9 [3.69]); difference: −3.38 (SE: 0.986); 95%CI (−5.34; −1.41); p = 0.001. A greater proportion of patients receiving nipocalimab met MCI and SCI criteria for MG-ADL and QMG at W24 versus placebo (Table). Conclusion: In patients with baseline MG ADL scores 6–9, nipocalimab demonstrated greater efficacy versus placebo, achieving MCI and SCI in MG ADL and QMG at W24. These results support the benefit of nipocalimab for sustained disease control in patients with gMG with lower baseline MG-ADL scores.

abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Patients with myasthenia gravis (MG) still require consolidation therapy after acute exacerbation to control symptoms and prevent relapse. This interim analysis aims to explore whether efgartigimod in addition to standard of care (SOC) provides added benefit as consolidation therapy. Methods: Adult patients with Acetylcholine Receptor (AChR) antibody-positive generalized MG who achieved clinically mean- ingful improvement after one treatment cycle of efgartigimod for acute exacerbation were enrolled in the study (NCT07079020). Patients were allocated to either efgartigimod plus SOC (EFG) group or SOC alone (SOCA) group based on real-world clinical decision-making, with a 6-month follow-up period. The primary endpoint was achievement of minimal symptom expression (MSE) within the second month of the consolidation phase and sustained MSE for more than four consecutive months. Results: A total of 112 patients with ≥2 months of follow-up by October 2025 were included (48 in SOCA group, 64 in EFG group). MSE was achieved in 64.58% of patients in the SOCA group and in 75% of patients in the EFG group (p = 0.010) (Figure 1). MG worsening was less frequently observed in the EFG group compared with the SOCA group, either relative to the previous visit (37.50% vs 50.00%, p = 0.013) or to the baseline (18.75% vs 35.42%, p = 0.016) (Figures 2 and 3). Conclusion: In this interim analysis, efgartigimod was associ- ated with higher rates of achieving MSE, and reduced risk of MG worsening in consolidation therapy. These findings sup- port the role of efgartigimod as a therapeutic strategy in post- exacerbation MG management.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：重症肌无力（MG）患者在急性加重后仍需巩固治疗以控制症状和预防复发。本中期分析旨在探讨在标准治疗（SOC）基础上加用efgartigimod作为巩固治疗是否能提供额外获益。方法：纳入乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体阳性全身型MG成年患者，这些患者在因急性加重接受一个治疗周期的efgartigimod后达到有临床意义的改善，并纳入研究（NCT07079020）。根据真实世界临床决策，患者被分配至efgartigimod联合SOC（EFG）组或单独SOC（SOCA）组，随访期为6个月。主要终点是在巩固期第二个月内达到最小症状表达（MSE）并维持MSE超过连续四个月。结果：截至2025年10月，共纳入112名随访≥2个月的患者（SOCA组48名，EFG组64名）。SOCA组64.58%的患者达到MSE，EFG组为75%（p = 0.010）（图1）。与SOCA组相比，EFG组MG恶化的发生率较低，无论是相对于前一次访视（37.50% vs 50.00%，p = 0.013）还是相对于基线（18.75% vs 35.42%，p = 0.016）（图2和3）。结论：在这项中期分析中，efgartigimod与巩固治疗中更高的MSE达成率和更低的MG恶化风险相关。这些发现支持efgartigimod作为MG急性加重后管理治疗策略的作用。

abstracts.title: Minimal symptom expression with claseprubart, an active C1S inhibitor, in patients with generalized myasthenia gravis
abstracts.authors: M. Smilowski1; N. Gilhus2; M. Ait-Tihyaty3; C. Briggs3; U. Siddiqui3; L. Hickey3; M. Lalla3; S. Beydoun4
abstracts.affiliations: 1Neurologia Śląska Centrum Medyczne, Katowice, Poland; 2Haukeland University Hospital, Bergen, Norway; 3Dianthus Therapeutics, New York, USA; 4University of Southern California, Los Angeles, USA
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: The classical complement pathway plays a significant role in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) pa- thology. Claseprubart is a potent monoclonal antibody that selec- tively targets the classical pathway by inhibiting active C1s (aC1s). Remission is a key goal in gMG and achieving minimal symptom expression (MSE) with claseprubart is a key treatment objective. Methods: MaGic (NCT06282159), is a global Phase 2, random- ized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial. Patients treated with claseprubart (300 mg, Q2W) were evaluated for MSE (MG-ADL ≤1 or QMG ≤3) compared with placebo. p-Values were one-sided and nominal significance was assessed at an alpha = 0.1. Outcomes in- clude proportion of patients achieving MSE at Week 13 and any- time during the study, earliest timepoint of MSE achievement, and durability defined as sustained MSE for at least 6 weeks. Results: At Week 13, 37% of claseprubart treated patients achieved MG-ADL-MSE versus 14% with placebo (OR 3.81; p = 0.0550). 43% achieved MG-ADL-MSE at least once during the study versus 14% of placebo (OR: 4.72; p = 0.0231). This effect was observed as early as Week 1 (median time to response was Week 3). Sustained remission-like states (for at least 6 weeks) were seen in all patients who achieved MSE. Similar results were observed using QMG minimum symptom expression threshold. Conclusion: Claseprubart patients were more than four times more likely to achieve MSE than placebo patients and MSE was observed as early as week 1. Patients who achieved MSE main- tained responses for at least 6 weeks. These results highlight the therapeutic potential of aC1s inhibition in AChR+ gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：经典补体通路在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）病理中起重要作用。Claseprubart是一种强效单克隆抗体，通过抑制活性C1s（aC1s）选择性靶向经典通路。缓解是gMG的关键目标，使用claseprubart达到最小症状表达（MSE）是一个关键治疗目标。方法：MaGic（NCT06282159）是一项全球性2期、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验。评估接受claseprubart（300 mg，每两周一次）治疗的患者与安慰剂相比的MSE（MG-ADL ≤1或QMG ≤3）。p值为单侧，名义显著性在α = 0.1水平评估。结局包括第13周和研究期间任何时间达到MSE的患者比例、达到MSE的最早时间点，以及定义为至少持续6周MSE的持久性。结果：在第13周，37%接受claseprubart治疗的患者达到MG-ADL-MSE，而安慰剂组为14%（OR 3.81；p = 0.0550）。43%在研究期间至少一次达到MG-ADL-MSE，而安慰剂组为14%（OR: 4.72；p = 0.0231）。这种效应最早在第1周观察到（中位应答时间为第3周）。所有达到MSE的患者均观察到持续至少6周的缓解样状态。使用QMG最小症状表达阈值观察到类似结果。结论：Claseprubart患者达到MSE的可能性是安慰剂患者的四倍以上，且MSE最早在第1周即可观察到。达到MSE的患者维持应答至少6周。这些结果突显了aC1s抑制在AChR+ gMG中的治疗潜力。

abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: The classical complement path- way plays a significant role in acetylcholine receptor-positive (AChR+) generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) pathology. Claseprubart is an investigational, clinical-stage, potent mono- clonal antibody engineered to selectively target the classical complement pathway, by selectively inhibiting activated C1s protein. The clinical benefit of claseprubart in gMG may be best supported by improvement across multiple validated scales to capture multi-dimensional improvement beyond single-scale analyses. Methods: AChR+ gMG patients treated with 300 mg clase- prubart subcutaneously once every 2 weeks in the MaGic study (NCT06282159) – a global Phase 2, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial – were analyzed for responses based on multiple assessments compared to placebo. p-values are one- sided, with nominal significance assessed at an alpha of 0.1. A re- sponder was defined as achieving an improvement in MG-ADL ≥ 3 and QMG ≥ 4. Endpoints include proportion of dual MG-ADL and QMG responders at Week 13, time to response, and proportion of responders sustaining response for at least 6 weeks. Results: 63% of claseprubart patients had dual response im- provement in MG-ADL ≥ 3 and QMG ≥ 4, versus 14% for placebo (OR 29.00; p = 0.0006). Dual responders were seen as early as Week 1. The median time to response was Week 3. All clase- prubart patients with dual response at Week 13 had maintained response for at least 6 weeks. Conclusion: Claseprubart-treated patients were more likely to achieve multi-dimensional response than placebo. Responses emerged early and were sustained, confirming rapid, robust, and durable benefit from claseprubart across functional and quanti- tative measures from both patient and clinician perspectives.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：经典补体通路在乙酰胆碱受体阳性（AChR+）全身型重症肌无力（gMG）病理中起重要作用。Claseprubart是一种处于临床研究阶段的强效单克隆抗体，通过选择性抑制活化的C1s蛋白，旨在选择性靶向经典补体通路。Claseprubart在gMG中的临床获益可能最好通过多个验证量表的改善来支持，以捕捉超越单一量表分析的多维度改善。方法：在MaGic研究（NCT06282159）——一项全球性2期、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验中，接受300 mg claseprubart皮下注射每两周一次的AChR+ gMG患者，与安慰剂相比，基于多项评估分析其应答。p值为单侧，名义显著性在α = 0.1水平评估。应答者定义为MG-ADL改善≥3且QMG改善≥4。终点包括第13周时MG-ADL和QMG双重应答者的比例、应答时间，以及维持应答至少6周的应答者比例。结果：63%的claseprubart患者达到MG-ADL改善≥3和QMG改善≥4的双重应答，而安慰剂组为14%（OR 29.00；p = 0.0006）。双重应答最早在第1周观察到。中位应答时间为第3周。所有在第13周达到双重应答的claseprubart患者均维持应答至少6周。结论：与安慰剂相比，接受claseprubart治疗的患者更有可能达到多维度应答。应答出现早且持久，证实了claseprubart在患者和临床医生角度的功能和定量测量方面具有快速、强效且持久的获益。

abstracts.title: Myasthenia gravis Inebilizumab trial: 26-week randomised-placebo controlled and 26-week open-label results in anti-muscle-specific kinase subgroup
abstracts.authors: J. Vissing1; M. Leite2; J. Howard; Jr.3; M. Benatar4; E. Ciafaloni5; K. Utsugisawa6; S. Bray7; A. Bhambri8; A. Kiran Kanchi8; S. Cheng8; R. Nowak9

abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Generalised myasthenia gravis (gMG) is caused by anti-muscle-specific kinase (MuSK+) and anti- acetylcholine receptor (AChR+) antibodies targeting corre- sponding proteins in the synapse. The placebo (PBO)-controlled MG Inebilizumab (INEB) Trial (MINT) assessed INEB, a mono- clonal antibody targeting CD19+ B cells, in patients with MuSK+ or AChR+ gMG. INEB vs PBO yielded significantly greater im- provements in MG Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Quantitative MG (QMG) scores at week 26 in MINT. Here we report key outcomes for the MuSK+ subpopulation from the first 26 weeks of the open-label period (OLP). Methods: Participants with MuSK+ gMG in MINT (NCT04524273) were randomised 1:1 to 300 mg intravenous INEB or PBO for 26 weeks. Participants underwent a protocol- specified steroid taper (≤5 mg/day by week 24). After the ran- domised, controlled period (RCP), participants could receive INEB in the OLP. This pre-specified, interim, descriptive analy- sis included participants who received any dose of INEB during MINT. No statistical testing was done. Results: Overall, 48 participants with MuSK+ were en- rolled and randomised: 46 entered the OLP and 44 completed 26 weeks. Baseline MG-ADL and QMG scores were similar between groups, and mean scores decreased from baseline to week 26 during the RCP (INEB –4.1, –5.0; PBO –3.1, –4.2, re- spectively). During the initial 26-week OLP (week 52), the mean MG-ADL and QMG scores continued to decrease from baseline (INEB/INEB: –5.6, –6.1; PBO/INEB: –5.1, –7.4, respectively; Figures 1–2; Table 1). Conclusion: In this descriptive analysis, INEB demonstrated ongoing improvement in MG-ADL and QMG scores compared to baseline irrespective of initial randomisation.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）由抗肌肉特异性激酶（MuSK+）和抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR+）抗体靶向突触中相应蛋白引起。安慰剂（PBO）对照的MG Inebilizumab（INEB）试验（MINT）评估了靶向CD19+B细胞的单克隆抗体INEB在MuSK+或AChR+ gMG患者中的疗效。在MINT中，第26周时，INEB与PBO相比，在MG日常生活活动（MG-ADL）和定量MG（QMG）评分方面取得了显著更大的改善。本文报告了开放标签期（OLP）前26周MuSK+亚组的关键结局。方法：MINT（NCT04524273）中的MuSK+ gMG参与者按1:1随机分配至300 mg静脉注射INEB或PBO，持续26周。参与者接受方案规定的类固醇减量（第24周时≤5 mg/天）。在随机对照期（RCP）后，参与者可在OLP中接受INEB。这项预先指定的中期描述性分析包括在MINT期间接受任何剂量INEB的参与者。未进行统计学检验。结果：总体而言，48名MuSK+参与者被纳入并随机分组：46名进入OLP，44名完成了26周。两组基线MG-ADL和QMG评分相似，在RCP期间，平均评分从基线至第26周下降（INEB分别为–4.1、–5.0；PBO分别为–3.1、–4.2）。在初始26周OLP（第52周）期间，平均MG-ADL和QMG评分从基线继续下降（INEB/INEB：分别为–5.6、–6.1；PBO/INEB：分别为–5.1、–7.4；图1-2；表1）。结论：在这项描述性分析中，无论初始随机分组如何，INEB在MG-ADL和QMG评分方面均显示出与基线相比持续的改善。

abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: The classical complement pathway plays a significant role in the pathogenesis of generalized myas- thenia gravis (gMG). Claseprubart is a monoclonal antibody that targets the classical pathway by inhibiting active C1s. The MaGic trial assessed the safety and efficacy of claseprubart in adults with acetylcholine receptor antibody positive (AChR+) gMG. Methods: MaGic (NCT06282159) is a randomized, double- blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 study. 65 participants with AChR+ gMG were randomized 1:1:1 to receive: claseprubart 300 mg (Q2W), claseprubart 600 mg (Q2W), or placebo for 13 weeks, followed by a 52-week open-label extension and 40- week safety follow-up. Endpoints at 13 weeks included safety, tolerability, efficacy (MG activities of daily living (MG-ADL), Quantitative MG score (QMG), Minimal Symptom Expression (MSE) and MG Composite scale (MGC). Results: Claseprubart was well tolerated with no serious ad- verse events, no serious bacterial infections, and no autoim- mune activation. Injection site reactions were infrequent and mild to moderate. At Week 13, claseprubart improved MG-ADL by 4.6 (p = 0.0113) for 300 mg, 5.4 (p = 0.0006) for 600 mg, and 2.8 for placebo (no significant difference between active treat- ment arms). Significant improvement in MG-ADL was observed as early as Week 1. At Week 13, claseprubart 300 mg improved QMG by 4.4 (p = 0.0144), claseprubart 600 mg by 4.5 (p = 0.0111), and 2.0 for placebo. MSE was achieved by 37% (300 mg) and 27% (600 mg) versus 14% for placebo. MGC for 300 mg was 8.7 (p = 0.0008), 8.6 (p = 0.0008) for 600 mg versus 3.1 for placebo. Conclusion: With a favorable safety profile, claseprubart demonstrated rapid, statistically significant, and clinically meaningful improvements in MG-ADL, QMG, MGC.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：经典补体通路在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的发病机制中起重要作用。Claseprubart是一种通过抑制活性C1s来靶向经典通路的单克隆抗体。MaGic试验评估了claseprubart在乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR+）gMG成人患者中的安全性和疗效。方法：MaGic（NCT06282159）是一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的2期研究。65名AChR+ gMG参与者按1:1:1随机分配接受：claseprubart 300 mg（每2周一次）、claseprubart 600 mg（每2周一次）或安慰剂，持续13周，随后进行52周开放标签扩展和40周安全性随访。第13周的终点包括安全性、耐受性、疗效（MG日常生活活动（MG-ADL）、定量MG评分（QMG）、最小症状表达（MSE）和MG复合量表（MGC））。结果：Claseprubart耐受性良好，无严重不良事件、无严重细菌感染、无自身免疫激活。注射部位反应不常见且为轻至中度。第13周时，claseprubart 300 mg组MG-ADL改善4.6分（p=0.0113），600 mg组改善5.4分（p=0.0006），安慰剂组改善2.8分（活性治疗组间无显著差异）。早在第1周就观察到MG-ADL的显著改善。第13周时，claseprubart 300 mg组QMG改善4.4分（p=0.0144），600 mg组改善4.5分（p=0.0111），安慰剂组改善2.0分。MSE在300 mg组达到37%，600 mg组达到27%，而安慰剂组为14%。MGC在300 mg组为8.7（p=0.0008），600 mg组为8.6（p=0.0008），安慰剂组为3.1。结论：凭借良好的安全性特征，claseprubart在MG-ADL、QMG、MGC方面显示出快速、统计学显著且具有临床意义的改善。

abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Efgartigimod safety has been investi- gated in multiple IgG-mediated autoimmune diseases, including generalised myasthenia gravis (gMG), primary immune throm- bocytopenia (ITP), and chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyradiculoneuropathy (CIDP), for which it has received reg- ulatory approval in multiple regions. We report the long-term TABLE 1 Baseline characteristics, and symptom improvement in MG- ADL and QMG scales. safety of efgartigimod in gMG, ITP, and CIDP, administered via varying dosing regimens. Methods: Data were pooled per disease from global clinical trials investigating varying efgartigimod dosing regimens and administration routes (intravenous 10 mg/kg; subcutaneous 1000 mg PH20 [coformulated with recombinant human hyalu- ronidase PH20]). Event rates (ER) were reported per participant year of follow-up (PYFU). Results: The analysis includes data from at least 874 patients representing ~1350 PYFU. Treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAE) were mostly mild-to-moderate in severity. During con- trolled trials, severe infection ERs were comparable between placebo- and efgartigimod-treated participants. Reported TEAE- related treatment discontinuation rates were consistently low. Rates of discontinuation and severe and serious TEAEs did not increase with additional treatment cycles (gMG) or prolonged ex- posure to weekly administration (ITP, CIDP). Further analyses of participant population subgroups are ongoing. No albumin re- duction or increases in low-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels were reported in efgartigimod-treated participants. No vaccina- tions, laboratory value monitoring, or pretreatment medications are required to receive efgartigimod. Efgartigimod was consis- tently well tolerated across trials in autoimmune diseases, in- cluding those with subcutaneous administration of efgartigimod. Conclusion: Efgartigimod was well tolerated and demonstrated a similar safety profile regardless of disease state, dosing regi- men, and length of exposure.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：Efgartigimod的安全性已在多种IgG介导的自身免疫性疾病中进行了研究，包括全身型重症肌无力（gMG）、原发性免疫性血小板减少症（ITP）和慢性炎性脱髓鞘性多发性神经根神经病（CIDP），并已在多个地区获得监管批准。我们报告efgartigimod在gMG、ITP和CIDP中的长期安全性，通过不同的给药方案给药。方法：数据按疾病汇总自全球临床试验，这些试验研究了不同的efgartigimod给药方案和给药途径（静脉注射10 mg/kg；皮下注射1000 mg PH20[与重组人透明质酸酶PH20共同配制]）。事件发生率（ER）按每参与者随访年（PYFU）报告。结果：该分析包括来自至少874名患者的数据，代表约1350 PYFU。治疗期间出现的不良事件（TEAE）大多为轻至中度严重程度。在对照试验期间，安慰剂组和efgartigimod组参与者的严重感染ER相当。报告的TEAE相关治疗停药率持续较低。停药率以及严重和重度TEAE的发生率并未随着额外的治疗周期（gMG）或延长每周给药暴露时间（ITP、CIDP）而增加。对参与者人群亚组的进一步分析正在进行中。在efgartigimod治疗的参与者中未报告白蛋白降低或低密度脂蛋白胆固醇水平升高。接受efgartigimod治疗无需接种疫苗、监测实验室值或使用预处理药物。Efgartigimod在自身免疫性疾病的试验中（包括皮下给药）始终耐受性良好。结论：Efgartigimod耐受性良好，并且无论疾病状态、给药方案和暴露时间长短，均显示出相似的安全性特征。
