abstracts.title: The immune modulatory effect of eculizumab on B cells in myasthenia gravis beyond the complement inhibition
abstracts.authors: J. Li; G. Luo; W. Jiang; C. Yang Department of Neurology, Tianjin Neurological Institute, Tianjin Medical University General Hospital, Tianjin, China
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Eculizumab has demonstrated high efficacy in patients with anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) an- tibody–positive myasthenia gravis (MG). It prevents the cleav- age of C5 into C5a and C5b, thereby blocking the formation of the membrane attack complex (MAC) in neuromuscular junc- tion. However, the potential off-target effects of eculizumab on immune cell modulation—mediated via C5a-C5aR1 axis during long-term treatment—remain incompletely understood. Methods: Patients with AChR Ab+ gMG receiving regular ec- ulizumab or prednisolone treatment were enrolled and divided into exploratory and validation cohorts. Bulk RNA-seq and flow cytometry were performed on peripheral immune cells. C5aR1 antagonist was administered to experimental autoimmune myasthenia gravis (EAMG) rats, and clinical scores, electro- myograms, immunofluorescence staining of nicotinic AChR (nAChR), and flow cytometric analysis of immune cells were performed. B cells were co-cultured with monocytes for in vitro analysis. Results: Bulk RNA sequencing revealed significant tran- scriptomic alterations in MG patients following eculizumab treatment, enriched in B-cell-related pathways. Long-term ec- ulizumab markedly reduced peripheral CD19+ B cells and their subsets (including memory B cells and antibody-secreting cells). H&E muscle biopsy with endomysial lymphocyte infiltration. Pathological increase of COX negative muscle fibers. FIGURE 1 Bulk RNA-Seq analysis of differential gene expression and functional associations in AChR antibody-positive generalized myas- thenia gravis patients before and after eculizumab treatment. C5aR1 is predominantly expressed on myeloid cells and is up- regulated during acute exacerbations of MG. In vivo and in vitro co-culture studies indicated that blocking C5a-C5aR1 signal- ing pathway in monocytes inhibited B-cell differentiation, pro- moted B-cell apoptosis, and reduced circulating B-cell numbers, likely through decreased BAFF secretion. Conclusion: In addition to blocking the terminal complement pathway, eculizumab modulates peripheral B-cell differentiation and survival by inhibiting the monocyte C5a-C5aR1-mediated BAFF secretion. This reveals its off-target immunomodula- tory effects and the mechanism of systemic immunoregulation during long-term therapy.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：Eculizumab在抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体阳性重症肌无力（MG）患者中显示出高效性。它阻止C5裂解为C5a和C5b，从而阻断神经肌肉接头处膜攻击复合物（MAC）的形成。然而，在长期治疗期间，eculizumab通过C5a-C5aR1轴对免疫细胞调节的潜在脱靶效应仍不完全清楚。方法：纳入接受常规eculizumab或泼尼松龙治疗的AChR Ab+ gMG患者，并分为探索队列和验证队列。对外周免疫细胞进行批量RNA测序和流式细胞术。对实验性自身免疫性重症肌无力（EAMG）大鼠给予C5aR1拮抗剂，并进行临床评分、肌电图、烟碱型AChR（nAChR）免疫荧光染色和免疫细胞流式细胞术分析。将B细胞与单核细胞共培养进行体外分析。结果：批量RNA测序揭示了eculizumab治疗后MG患者显著的转录组改变，富集于B细胞相关通路。长期eculizumab显著减少了外周CD19+ B细胞及其亚群（包括记忆B细胞和抗体分泌细胞）。C5aR1主要在髓系细胞上表达，并在MG急性加重期间上调。体内和体外共培养研究表明，阻断单核细胞中的C5a-C5aR1信号通路可抑制B细胞分化、促进B细胞凋亡并减少循环B细胞数量，这可能是通过减少BAFF分泌实现的。结论：除了阻断终末补体通路外，eculizumab还通过抑制单核细胞C5a-C5aR1介导的BAFF分泌来调节外周B细胞分化和存活。这揭示了其脱靶免疫调节效应以及长期治疗期间全身免疫调节的机制。

abstracts.title: Assessing the Relationship between Immunoglobulin g Level and Efficacy of Nipocalimab Measured Using Myasthenia Gravis-activities of Daily Living Scale
abstracts.authors: Zabeen Mahuwala; Ruben Faelens; Belén Valenzuela; Martine Neyens; Yaowei Zhu; Jocelyn Leu; Marie Fitzgibbon; Sindhu Ramchandren; Juan-José Pérez-Ruixo
abstracts.affiliations: Lexington, KY; Beerse, Belgium; Madrid, Spain; Spring House, PA; Raritan, NJ; Titusville, NJ
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab, a neonatal fragment crystallizable receptor (FcRn) blocker, prevents immunoglobulin G (IgG) recycling, lowers levels of circulating IgG antibodies, including pathogenic autoantibodies, and improves generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) symptoms. OBJECTIVE: To explore the longitudinal relationship between IgG level and Myasthenia Gravis-Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) score using semi-mechanistic pharmacometrics modeling with data from clinical studies of nipocalimab in gMG and healthy volunteers. METHODS: Data from phase-1 (n=5), phase-2 (n=1), and phase-3 (n=1;Vivacity-MG3) clinical studies were analyzed to characterize pharmacokinetics ([PK]; 3,429 serum nipocalimab concentrations[n=277]), pharmacodynamics ([PD]; 4,441 serum IgG concentrations[n=421]; 1,247 FcRn receptor occupancy data[n=78]). To establish the longitudinal relationship between IgG and MG-ADL, 2,317 absolute change from baseline (CFB) MG-ADL scores were analyzed in seropositive (anti-acetylcholine receptor, anti-muscle-specific receptor tyrosine kinase, anti- lipoprotein receptor-related protein-4) participants (n=220) with gMG using a previously developed nonlinear mixed- effects model. RESULTS: The previous model captured serum nipocalimab and total serum IgG concentrations of Vivacity-MG3 well. MG-ADL CFB drug effect was linearly related to IgG %CFB at 0.28 points per 10% IgG %CFB. In gMG, this resulted in approximately 2-points MG-ADL reduction for nipocalimab-induced 70% IgG reduction when adjusted for placebo effect. Slope of the regression line was dependent on baseline MG-ADL score. Age, body weight, race, ethnicity, sex, autoantibody status, gMG background therapy and gMG duration did not have a clinically relevant impact. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: The model confirmed IgG %CFB drives nipocalimab effect on MG-ADL. Total serum IgG reduction is a good predictor for efficacy in gMG, allowing for comparison of clinical effect across FcRn blockers.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Nipocalimab是一种新生儿Fc段受体（FcRn）阻断剂，可阻止免疫球蛋白G（IgG）再循环，降低循环IgG抗体（包括致病性自身抗体）水平，并改善全身型重症肌无力（gMG）症状。目的：利用来自nipocalimab在gMG和健康志愿者中临床研究的数据，通过半机制群体药效学建模，探讨IgG水平与重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）评分之间的纵向关系。方法：分析来自1期（n=5）、2期（n=1）和3期（n=1；Vivacity-MG3）临床研究的数据，以表征药代动力学（[PK]；3,429份血清nipocalimab浓度[n=277]）、药效学（[PD]；4,441份血清IgG浓度[n=421]；1,247份FcRn受体占有率数据[n=78]）。为建立IgG与MG-ADL之间的纵向关系，使用先前建立的非线性混合效应模型，对血清阳性（抗乙酰胆碱受体、抗肌肉特异性受体酪氨酸激酶、抗低密度脂蛋白受体相关蛋白-4）gMG受试者（n=220）的2,317个MG-ADL较基线绝对变化（CFB）评分进行分析。结果：先前的模型很好地拟合了Vivacity-MG3的血清nipocalimab和总血清IgG浓度。MG-ADL CFB的药物效应与IgG %CFB呈线性相关，为每10% IgG %CFB对应0.28分。在gMG中，经安慰剂效应校正后，nipocalimab诱导的70% IgG降低约导致2分MG-ADL下降。回归线斜率取决于基线MG-ADL评分。年龄、体重、种族、民族、性别、自身抗体状态、gMG背景治疗和gMG病程无临床相关影响。总结/结论：该模型证实IgG %CFB驱动nipocalimab对MG-ADL的效应。总血清IgG降低是gMG疗效的良好预测指标，可用于比较不同FcRn阻断剂的临床效应。

abstracts.title: Assessment of Health-related Quality of Life Measures in Anti-muscle-specific Tyrosine Kinase-antibody-positive Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Post Hoc Analysis of the VIVACITY-MG3 Study
abstracts.authors: Rosemarie Walch; Marie Fitzgibbon; Nolan Campbell; Carly J. Paoli; Sheryl Pease; Ibrahim Turkoz; Sindhu Ramchandren; Mazen Dimachkie
abstracts.affiliations: Owosso, MI; Raritan, NJ; Horsham, PA; Titusville, NJ; Kansas City, KS
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab, an FcRn-blocking antibody, is approved for adults and adolescents with anti- acetylcholine receptor (AChR) or anti-muscle-specific tyrosine kinase-(MuSK)-antibody-positive generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). MuSK-antibody+ MG is often considered more severe with poor treatment-response resulting in low health-related quality-of-life (HRQoL). Nipocalimab-plus-standard-of-care (nipocalimab+SOC) demonstrated sustained disease control with meaningful HRQoL improvements in the 24-week(W) double-blind- phase of Vivacity-MG3 (NCT04951622) in seropositive gMG patients. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate HRQoL changes in anti-MuSK- antibody+ patients in Vivacity-MG3 using patient-reported outcomes: 15-item MG-QoL (revised) instrument (MG- QoL15r), European QoL Group, 5 Dimension, 5 Level Questionnaire Visual Analog scale (EQ-5D-VAS), and QoL in Neurological Disorders (Neuro-QoL) Fatigue scale. METHODS: Mean change-from-baseline (CFB) to W24 in MG-QoL15r, EQ-5D-VAS and Neuro-QoL Fatigue were analyzed. Proportion of patients achieving meaningful- within-person-improvement (MWPI) in MG-QoL15r (minimal clinical improvement from baseline [MCI] of ≥4- points), EQ-5D-VAS (MCI of ≥10-points) and Neuro-QoL Fatigue (MCI of ≥6.7 points) were measured for both treatment groups. RESULTS: Sixteen MuSK-antibody+ patients (nipocalimab +SOC: n=12; placebo+SOC: n=4) were included. At W24, mean (SD) CFB in nipocalimab+SOC (vs placebo+SOC) in MG-QoL15r, EQ-5D-VAS and Neuro-QoL Fatigue indicated improvements from baseline: −5.8 (6.78; p=0.024) (vs −1.8 [1.89]; not significant [ns]), 10.20 (17.57; ns) (vs 15.0 [21.32]; ns) and −11.6 (28.16; ns) (vs 1.8 [8.58]; ns), respectively. At 24W (nipocalimab+SOC vs placebo+SOC), 6/10 (60.0%) (vs 0/4) achieved MWPI on MG-QoL15r; 4/10 (40.0%) (vs 2/4 [50.0%]) achieved MWPI on EQ-5D-VAS and 6/10 (60.0%) (vs 0/4) achieved MWPI on Neuro-QoL Fatigue. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Nipocalimab demonstrated meaningful improvements in HRQoL in the anti-MuSK- antibody+ subgroup of patients with gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Nipocalimab是一种FcRn阻断抗体，已获批用于抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体或抗肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶（MuSK）抗体阳性的成人及青少年全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者。MuSK抗体阳性MG常被认为病情更重、治疗反应差，导致健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）较低。在Vivacity-MG3（NCT04951622）为期24周（W）的双盲阶段中，nipocalimab联合标准治疗（nipocalimab+SOC）在血清阳性gMG患者中显示出持续疾病控制并带来有意义的HRQoL改善。目的：使用患者报告结局评估Vivacity-MG3中抗MuSK抗体阳性患者的HRQoL变化：15项MG-QoL（修订版）量表（MG-QoL15r）、欧洲生活质量组5维度5水平问卷视觉模拟量表（EQ-5D-VAS）以及神经系统疾病生活质量（Neuro-QoL）疲劳量表。方法：分析MG-QoL15r、EQ-5D-VAS和Neuro-QoL疲劳从基线至W24的平均变化（CFB）。测量两组治疗中达到MG-QoL15r有意义个体内改善（MWPI；较基线最小临床改善[MCI]≥4分）、EQ-5D-VAS（MCI≥10分）和Neuro-QoL疲劳（MCI≥6.7分）的患者比例。结果：共纳入16例MuSK抗体阳性患者（nipocalimab+SOC：n=12；安慰剂+SOC：n=4）。在W24，nipocalimab+SOC（对比安慰剂+SOC）在MG-QoL15r、EQ-5D-VAS和Neuro-QoL疲劳中的平均（SD）CFB显示较基线改善：分别为−5.8（6.78；p=0.024）（对比−1.8[1.89]；无显著性[ns]）、10.20（17.57；ns）（对比15.0[21.32]；ns）和−11.6（28.16；ns）（对比1.8[8.58]；ns）。在24W（nipocalimab+SOC对比安慰剂+SOC），6/10（60.0%）（对比0/4）在MG-QoL15r上达到MWPI；4/10（40.0%）（对比2/4[50.0%]）在EQ-5D-VAS上达到MWPI；6/10（60.0%）（对比0/4）在Neuro-QoL疲劳上达到MWPI。总结/结论：Nipocalimab在gMG抗MuSK抗体阳性亚组患者中显示出有意义的HRQoL改善。

abstracts.title: Effect of Nipocalimab on Pathogenic IgG and Circulating Immune Complex Levels: A Role in Myasthenia Gravis-activities of Daily Living Score Improvement in Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Ruben Faelens; Matthias Bruckner; Jingyue Xi; Yanfei Zhang; Silke Miller; Sindhu Ramchandren; Marie Fitzgibbon; Sarah Hoffmann
abstracts.affiliations: Beerse, Belgium; Ann Arbor, MI; Spring House, PA; San Diego, CA; Titusville, NJ; Raritan, NJ; Berlin, Germany
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab, a fully human neonatal- Fc-receptor-blocker, is approved in seropositive adult and adolescent patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). Nipocalimab substantially reduced circulating immunoglobulin-G (IgG), including pathogenic autoantibodies, and complement components in the phase-3 Vivacity-MG3 study. OBJECTIVE: To quantify the effect of nipocalimab- induced total and pathogenic anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) IgG reduction on complement C3d immune complex levels and Myasthenia Gravis-Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) improvement in patients with gMG. METHODS: Nonlinear-mixed-effects (NLME) model was used to model reductions in total IgG/anti-AChR levels and MG-ADL scores from phase-2 Vivacity-MG and Vivacity- MG3 through 12 and 24-weeks of nipocalimab treatment, respectively. Linear models were used to describe the sequential reduction of total IgG, anti-AChR, and C3d levels, and explore association with MG-ADL improvement at week-24 of Vivacity-MG3. RESULTS: NLME simulations predicted nipocalimab 15mg/kg every-2-weeks results in mean %change-from- baseline (CFB) −65.9% pre-dose IgG and mean %CFB −1.84 points MG-ADL (placebo-corrected) at steady-state. In the NLME model, %CFB total IgG fully explains the overall average effect on MG-ADL CFB (105%). Total IgG %CFB was linearly correlated with anti-AChR %CFB (slope of 1.03). At week-24 of the phase-3 study, anti- AChR reduction explains C3d reduction (p=0.042, 108%). There is a trend showing that C3d reduction explains MG- ADL reduction (p=0.232, 28.6%), but analysis of more timepoints is needed to establish this fully. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Substantial IgG reduction is an accurate predictor of overall average clinical efficacy in gMG. The symptom improvement observed in patients treated with nipocalimab is driven, at least in part, through reduced activation of the classical complement pathway.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Nipocalimab是一种全人源新生儿Fc受体阻断剂，已获批用于血清阳性成人及青少年全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者。在3期Vivacity-MG3研究中，nipocalimab大幅降低循环免疫球蛋白G（IgG），包括致病性自身抗体及补体成分。目的：量化nipocalimab诱导的总IgG及致病性抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）IgG降低对补体C3d免疫复合物水平及gMG患者重症肌无力-日常生活活动（MG-ADL）改善的影响。方法：采用非线性混合效应（NLME）模型，分别基于2期Vivacity-MG和Vivacity-MG3中nipocalimab治疗至12周和24周的数据，建模总IgG/抗AChR水平及MG-ADL评分的降低。采用线性模型描述总IgG、抗AChR和C3d水平的序贯性降低，并探索其与Vivacity-MG3第24周MG-ADL改善的关联。结果：NLME模拟预测，nipocalimab 15mg/kg每2周给药在稳态时导致给药前IgG平均较基线变化（%CFB）−65.9%，MG-ADL平均%CFB −1.84分（安慰剂校正）。在NLME模型中，总IgG %CFB完全解释了对MG-ADL CFB的总体平均效应（105%）。总IgG %CFB与抗AChR %CFB呈线性相关（斜率1.03）。在3期研究第24周，抗AChR降低解释了C3d降低（p=0.042，108%）。存在C3d降低解释MG-ADL降低的趋势（p=0.232，28.6%），但需分析更多时间点以完全确立。总结/结论：大幅IgG降低是gMG总体平均临床疗效的准确预测因素。接受nipocalimab治疗患者中观察到的症状改善至少部分通过减少经典补体通路激活驱动。

abstracts.title: Effect of Nipocalimab on Pathogenic Immunoglobulin g and Complement Markers in Patients with Seropositive gMG: Exploratory Analysis in VIVACITY-MG3 Study
abstracts.authors: Silke Miller; Jingyue Xi; Yanfei Zhang; Ruben Faelens; Marie Fitzgibbon; Sindhu Ramchandren; Sarah Hoffmann
abstracts.affiliations: San Diego, CA; Ann Arbor, MI; Spring House, PA; Beerse, Belgium; Raritan, NJ; Titusville, NJ; Berlin, Belgium
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Immunoglobulin-(Ig)G class autoantibodies block-and-internalize acetylcholine- receptor (AChR) and activate complement at the neuromuscular junction, leading to symptoms of myasthenia-gravis. Nipocalimab, a neonatal-Fc-receptor- blocker, substantially reduced circulating IgG, and demonstrated sustained disease control vs placebo during 24-week Vivacity-MG3-study (NCT04951622). OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether nipocalimab reduces circulating complement components and activity indicative of complement activation. METHODS: Available serum samples from seropositive (positive for AChR/muscle-specific receptor-tyrosine- kinase [MuSK]/low-density lipoprotein-receptor-related protein-4 [LRP4] antibodies) patients were analyzed at baseline and Week-24 and least-square-means were compared (nipocalimab vs placebo) using linear mixed- model. Complement-markers measured were: C3d circulating immune-complexes (C3d-CIC), C1q immune- complex-binding (C1q-ICB), and total complement-activity (CH50). Parallel assays quantified total-IgG, IgG1/2/3, and anti AChR titers, which informed nonlinear mixed-model previously presented. RESULTS: Baseline levels (LS-mean±SD) of complement- markers were comparable: nipocalimab vs placebo—CH50:103.48±5.92 vs 100.21±5.65; C1q ICB:7.40±1.78 vs 6.15±1.69; C3d CIC:7.60±0.94 vs 7.58±0.90. At Week-24, nipocalimab was associated with substantial and sustained reductions in total-IgG, IgG1/2/3, and anti-AChR titers (mean%[visual-predictive- check prediction interval]- total-IgG: −67.9[−69.9; −64.8] vs −1.3[−3.2;3.3], IgG1:−64.8[−68.3;−62.4] vs −2.0[−4.0;4.4], IgG2:−67.0[−70.4;−65.1] vs 1.8[−4.7;4.9], IgG3: −55.2[−58.7;−49.9] vs 3.1[−5.4;5.6], IgG4:−54.0[−62.0; −51.5] vs −2.0[−6.1; 6.5], anti-AChR:−65.1[−72.9;−58.6] vs −12.2[−8.7;9.6]). Concomitant decreases were observed in selected immune complex–associated complement markers (LS-mean±SD at Week-24 [nipocalimab vs placebo]—C3d-CIC:2.64±0.96 vs 7.25±0.92 [p<0.001], C1q-ICB:5.50±1.79 vs 6.87±1.71 [p=0.01]); no significant change in CH50 was detected. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Nipocalimab led to sustained reductions in IgG-subclasses and anti-AChR titers, accompanied by significant decreases in selected circulating-immune-complex–associated complement- markers, while no significant change in total complement activity was observed. Findings indicate changes in selected complement-related markers following nipocalimab treatment warrants further exploration.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：免疫球蛋白（Ig）G类自身抗体阻断并内化乙酰胆碱受体（AChR），并在神经肌肉接头激活补体，导致重症肌无力症状。Nipocalimab是一种新生儿Fc受体阻断剂，可大幅降低循环IgG，并在为期24周的Vivacity-MG3研究（NCT04951622）中较安慰剂显示出持续疾病控制。目的：评估nipocalimab是否降低提示补体激活的循环补体成分及活性。方法：分析血清阳性（AChR/肌肉特异性受体酪氨酸激酶[MuSK]/低密度脂蛋白受体相关蛋白4[LRP4]抗体阳性）患者基线和第24周可获得的血清样本，并使用线性混合模型比较最小二乘均值（nipocalimab对比安慰剂）。测量的补体标志物为：C3d循环免疫复合物（C3d-CIC）、C1q免疫复合物结合（C1q-ICB）和总补体活性（CH50）。平行检测定量总IgG、IgG1/2/3和抗AChR滴度，为此前展示的非线性混合模型提供信息。结果：补体标志物基线水平（LS均值±SD）相当：nipocalimab对比安慰剂——CH50：103.48±5.92对比100.21±5.65；C1q ICB：7.40±1.78对比6.15±1.69；C3d CIC：7.60±0.94对比7.58±0.90。在第24周，nipocalimab与总IgG、IgG1/2/3和抗AChR滴度的大幅且持续降低相关（平均%[视觉预测检验预测区间]——总IgG：−67.9[−69.9；−64.8]对比−1.3[−3.2；3.3]，IgG1：−64.8[−68.3；−62.4]对比−2.0[−4.0；4.4]，IgG2：−67.0[−70.4；−65.1]对比1.8[−4.7；4.9]，IgG3：−55.2[−58.7；−49.9]对比3.1[−5.4；5.6]，IgG4：−54.0[−62.0；−51.5]对比−2.0[−6.1；6.5]，抗AChR：−65.1[−72.9；−58.6]对比−12.2[−8.7；9.6]）。同时观察到部分免疫复合物相关补体标志物下降（第24周LS均值±SD[nipocalimab对比安慰剂]——C3d-CIC：2.64±0.96对比7.25±0.92[p<0.001]，C1q-ICB：5.50±1.79对比6.87±1.71[p=0.01]）；未检测到CH50显著变化。总结/结论：Nipocalimab导致IgG亚类和抗AChR滴度持续降低，伴随部分循环免疫复合物相关补体标志物显著下降，而总补体活性未见显著变化。研究结果表明，nipocalimab治疗后部分补体相关标志物的变化值得进一步探索。

abstracts.title: Effect of Nipocalimab on Sustained Disease Control during Infections: Post-hoc Analysis of the VIVACITY-MG3 Study in Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Carlo Antozzi; Gonçalo M.C. Rodrigues; Marie Fitzgibbon; Robert Edwards; Ibrahim Turkoz; Michael Kutch; Sindhu Ramchandren; Ghazala Hayat
abstracts.affiliations: Milan, Italy; Madrid, Spain; Raritan, NJ; Spring House, PA; Titusville, NJ; Chesterbrook, PA; Saint Louis, MO
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab plus standard-of-care (SOC) showed sustained disease control versus placebo (+SOC) for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in the Vivacity-MG3 study (NCT04951622). Although immunoglobulin-G levels were reduced in the nipocalimab group, occurrence of infectious adverse events was comparable to placebo. Monitoring MG-Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Quantitative MG (QMG) scores helps assess symptom control and therapeutic adequacy during infection episodes. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the efficacy of nipocalimab treatment during/shortly after infection episodes in the double-blind phase of Vivacity-MG3 by measuring changes in MG-ADL and QMG scores. METHODS: Patients with infections/infestations/serious infections at any timepoint in the double-blind phase were analyzed. Pre-infection and post-infection MG-ADL and QMG scores were compared. Pre-infection MG-ADL/QMG score was the most recent observation recorded within 16 days immediately preceding infection start-date. Post- infection MG-ADL/QMG score was the worst observation recorded from infection start-date through 16 days after infection end-date. RESULTS: Infection/infestations incidence was 42.9% in nipocalimab group (mild/moderate/severe infection events=51/16/4) and 41.8% in placebo (41/15/3). The median (interquartile range [IQR]) duration of overall infections/moderate and severe infections were similar between the nipocalimab and placebo groups (10.0 days [6.0; 17.0]/12.5[9.0; 17.0] and 12.0 days[7.0; 19.0]/11.5[7.0; 16.0], respectively). Median (IQR) pre- infection to post-infection change in MG-ADL scores was 0.0(−1.0; 1.0) in nipocalimab versus 1.0(0.0; 2.0) in placebo, and in QMG scores was 0.0(−1.0; 2.0) in nipocalimab versus 1.0(−1.0; 1.0) in placebo. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Incidence of infections in nipocalimab arm was comparable to placebo arm despite immunoglobulin-G reduction. abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在Vivacity-MG3研究（NCT04951622）中，nipocalimab联合标准治疗（SOC）较安慰剂（+SOC）在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）中显示出持续疾病控制。尽管nipocalimab组免疫球蛋白G水平降低，感染性不良事件的发生率与安慰剂相当。监测MG-日常生活活动（MG-ADL）和定量MG（QMG）评分有助于评估感染期间的症状控制和治疗充分性。目的：通过测量MG-ADL和QMG评分变化，评估Vivacity-MG3双盲阶段中nipocalimab在感染期间/感染后短期内的疗效。方法：分析双盲阶段任一时间点发生感染/寄生虫感染/严重感染的患者。比较感染前和感染后MG-ADL和QMG评分。感染前MG-ADL/QMG评分为感染开始日期前16天内记录的最新观察值。感染后MG-ADL/QMG评分为从感染开始日期至感染结束日期后16天记录的最差观察值。结果：感染/寄生虫感染发生率在nipocalimab组为42.9%（轻/中/重度感染事件=51/16/4），安慰剂组为41.8%（41/15/3）。总体感染/中度和重度感染的中位（四分位距[IQR]）持续时间在nipocalimab和安慰剂组之间相似（分别为10.0天[6.0；17.0]/12.5[9.0；17.0]和12.0天[7.0；19.0]/11.5[7.0；16.0]）。MG-ADL评分从感染前至感染后的中位（IQR）变化在nipocalimab组为0.0（−1.0；1.0），安慰剂组为1.0（0.0；2.0）；QMG评分在nipocalimab组为0.0（−1.0；2.0），安慰剂组为1.0（−1.0；1.0）。总结/结论：尽管免疫球蛋白G降低，nipocalimab组感染发生率与安慰剂组相当。感染期间MG-ADL/QMG评分未改变，表明nipocalimab维持了gMG症状改善和持续疾病控制。

abstracts.title: Effect of Nipocalimab on Sustained Disease Control in Anti-muscle-specific Tyrosine Kinase-antibody-positive Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: A Post Hoc Analysis of the VIVACITY-MG3 Study
abstracts.authors: Rosemarie Walch; Marie Fitzgibbon; Nolan Campbell; Carly J. Paoli; Ibrahim Turkoz; Sindhu Ramchandren; Mazen Dimachkie
abstracts.affiliations: Owosso, MI; Raritan, NJ; Horsham, PA; Titusville, NJ; Kansas City, KS
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab, an FcRn-blocking antibody, is approved for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) and anti- muscle-specific tyrosine kinase-(MuSK)-antibody-positive adult and adolescent patients. MuSK-antibody+ patients are often considered more severe with poor response to standard-of-care treatments. Nipocalimab-plus-standard- of-care (nipocalimab+SOC) demonstrated sustained disease control in the 24-week(W) double-blind-phase of Vivacity-MG3 (NCT04951622) in seropositive gMG patients. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate sustained efficacy with nipocalimab+SOC versus placebo+SOC in anti-MuSK- antibody+ patients in Vivacity-MG3. METHODS: Mean change-from-baseline (CFB) in the MG- Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Quantitative MG (QMG) scores were compared between study arms. Proportion of patients achieving Meaningful Clinical Improvement (MCI ≥2-point within-patient improvement versus baseline in MG-ADL), sustained response (MCI maintained for ≥8-weeks) and proportion of patients with Minimal Symptom Expression (MSE: MG-ADL total score of 0/1) were summarized. RESULTS: Demographics and baseline characteristics for nipocalimab+SOC(n=12) and placebo+SOC(n=4) were: median (range) age: 56.5 (27–77) vs 36.5 (32–43) years; females: 83.3% vs 100%; mean (SD) scores at baseline: MG-ADL 9.8 (3.17) vs 9.0 (3.24); QMG: 15.6 (6.02) vs 18.8 (4.84). At W24, significant mean (SD) CFB were observed in nipocalimab+SOC in MG-ADL (−3.75 [3.55]; n=10, p=0.010 vs placebo+SOC[n=4]:−0.50 [0.71]; p=0.375) and QMG (−5.89 [4.75]; n=9, p=0.012 vs placebo+SOC[n=4]:−2.7 [2.53]; p=0.125). Greater proportion of nipocalimab+SOC-treated patients (10/12[83.3%]) achieved MCI at any time during the study (vs placebo+SOC: 1/4[25.0%]); 6/12 (50.0%) nipocalimab +SOC-treated patients sustained MCI for ≥8W (vs placebo +SOC: 0/4). At 24W, 3/12 (25.0%) nipocalimab+SOC- treated patients achieved MSE (vs placebo+SOC: 0/4). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Nipocalimab demonstrated meaningful clinical improvement and sustained disease control in a subgroup of anti-MuSK-antibody+ patients with gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Nipocalimab是一种FcRn阻断抗体，已获批用于抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体阳性和抗肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶（MuSK）抗体阳性的成年及青少年全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者。MuSK抗体阳性患者通常被认为病情更重，对标准治疗反应较差。在Vivacity-MG3（NCT04951622）为期24周（W）的双盲阶段中，Nipocalimab联合标准治疗（nipocalimab+SOC）在血清阳性gMG患者中显示出持续疾病控制。目的：评估Vivacity-MG3中抗MuSK抗体阳性患者接受nipocalimab+SOC对比安慰剂+SOC的持续疗效。方法：比较各研究组间MG日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）和定量MG（QMG）评分较基线的平均变化（CFB）。总结达到有意义临床改善（MCI：MG-ADL较基线患者内改善≥2分）、持续应答（MCI维持≥8周）的患者比例以及达到最小症状表达（MSE：MG-ADL总分0/1分）的患者比例。结果：nipocalimab+SOC组（n=12）和安慰剂+SOC组（n=4）的人口学和基线特征为：中位（范围）年龄：56.5（27–77）岁 vs 36.5（32–43）岁；女性：83.3% vs 100%；基线平均（SD）评分：MG-ADL 9.8（3.17） vs 9.0（3.24）；QMG：15.6（6.02） vs 18.8（4.84）。在第24周，nipocalimab+SOC组观察到显著的MG-ADL平均（SD）CFB（−3.75 [3.55]；n=10，p=0.010 vs 安慰剂+SOC[n=4]：−0.50 [0.71]；p=0.375）和QMG平均（SD）CFB（−5.89 [4.75]；n=9，p=0.012 vs 安慰剂+SOC[n=4]：−2.7 [2.53]；p=0.125）。nipocalimab+SOC治疗患者中更大比例（10/12[83.3%]）在研究期间任意时间达到MCI（vs 安慰剂+SOC：1/4[25.0%]）；6/12（50.0%）nipocalimab+SOC治疗患者维持MCI≥8周（vs 安慰剂+SOC：0/4）。在第24周，3/12（25.0%）nipocalimab+SOC治疗患者达到MSE（vs 安慰剂+SOC：0/4）。总结/结论：Nipocalimab在抗MuSK抗体阳性gMG患者亚组中显示出有意义的临床改善和持续疾病控制。

abstracts.title: Effect of Nipocalimab on Sustained Disease Control in Patients who Responded after Week-2 of Treatment Initiation: Post-hoc Analysis of the VIVACITY-MG3 Study
abstracts.authors: Michael Weiss; Carly J. Paoli; Ibrahim Turkoz; Marie Fitzgibbon; Michael Kutch; Carlo Antozzi
abstracts.affiliations: Seattle, WA; Horsham, PA; Titusville, NJ; Raritan, NJ; Cambridge, MA; Milan, Italy
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab added to standard-of-care (SOC; [nipocalimab+SOC]) demonstrated rapid and substantial IgG reduction and clinical improvement within 2 weeks of treatment and sustained disease control through 24-weeks in the majority of autoantibody-positive (anti-AChR+/anti-MuSK+/anti-LRP4+) patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in the Vivacity-MG3 (NCT04951622) study. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the efficacy of nipocalimab +SOC treatment in patients who did not achieve clinical response within the first 2 weeks of treatment initiation in the double-blind phase. METHODS: This post-hoc analysis included patients with gMG who did not achieve meaningful clinical improvement (MCI; ≥2-point improvement in Myasthenia Gravis- Activities of Daily Living [MG-ADL] score) at week-1 or week-2 during the 24-weeks of the study. The proportion of patients achieving MCI from week-3 to week-24 and sustaining MCI response (longest uninterrupted duration of improvement) were assessed. RESULTS: By week-24, 71/77(92%) seropositive patients from the nipocalimab+SOC group, achieved clinical response and 48/77(62%) achieved clinical response at week-1/week-2 of treatment in double-blind phase. Of the remaining 29 patients, 23(79.3%) responded after week-2 of treatment with nipocalimab+SOC; 7(24.1%) patients achieved MCI at weeks 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 20, 22, 23, and 24. The proportion of these 29 patients who sustained MCI for at least 12-weeks, 16-weeks, and 20-weeks during the double-blind phase were 12(41.4%), 11(37.9%), and 7(24.1%), respectively. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Overall, 92% of nipocalimab- treated patients achieved meaningful clinical improvement during the 24-week study; most demonstrated rapid response. The majority of patients without an early- response improved after week-2. Once achieved, improvement was sustained for up to 20-weeks in a substantial proportion of patients.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在Vivacity-MG3（NCT04951622）研究中，Nipocalimab加用标准治疗（SOC；[nipocalimab+SOC]）在大多数自身抗体阳性（抗AChR+/抗MuSK+/抗LRP4+）全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者中显示出治疗开始2周内快速且大幅的IgG降低和临床改善，并在24周内维持持续疾病控制。目的：评估在双盲阶段治疗开始前2周内未达到临床应答的患者中nipocalimab+SOC治疗的疗效。方法：该事后分析纳入在研究24周期间第1周或第2周未达到有意义临床改善（MCI；重症肌无力日常生活活动量表[MG-ADL]评分改善≥2分）的gMG患者。评估第3周至第24周达到MCI的患者比例以及维持MCI应答（最长不间断改善持续时间）的情况。结果：截至第24周，nipocalimab+SOC组77例血清阳性患者中71例（92%）达到临床应答，其中48/77（62%）在双盲阶段治疗第1周/第2周达到临床应答。在其余29例患者中，23例（79.3%）在接受nipocalimab+SOC治疗第2周后应答；7例（24.1%）患者在第4、6、8、12、16、20、22、23和24周达到MCI。这29例患者在双盲阶段维持MCI至少12周、16周和20周的比例分别为12例（41.4%）、11例（37.9%）和7例（24.1%）。总结/结论：总体而言，92%的nipocalimab治疗患者在24周研究期间达到有意义的临床改善；大多数表现为快速应答。大多数无早期应答的患者在第2周后改善。一旦达到改善，相当比例患者的改善维持长达20周。

abstracts.title: Effects of Cladribine on Immune Cell Subsets and Autoantibody Responses in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells in Vitro
abstracts.authors: Yin Wu; Elina Järvinen; Dominic Jack; Tobias Derfuss; Chia Chi Sun
abstracts.affiliations: Billerica, MA; Espoo, Finland; Feltham, United Kingdom; Basel, Switzerland
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is a B-cell driven, T-cell dependent, autoimmune disease characterized by autoantibody production. Cladribine, currently being evaluated in the gMG Phase 3 MyClad trial (NCT06463587), works by targeting B- and T-cells, leading to their transient reduction and selective immune reconstitution. OBJECTIVE: Investigate the functional effects of cladribine on immune cells from gMG peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs). METHODS: PBMCs were isolated from acetylcholine receptor (AChR) seropositive people with gMG (Sanguine Biosciences), then cultured with or without cladribine, and stimulated to activate B- and T-cell proliferation or induce plasma cell differentiation in vitro. Cladribine half-maximal inhibitory concentrations (IC50) on B- and T-cell subset reduction, cell proliferation, and plasma cell differentiation were assessed by flow cytometry. Total immunoglobulin G (IgG) and anti-AChR IgG levels were analyzed using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays. RESULTS: Cladribine produced concentration-dependent reductions in B- and T-cell subset counts (n=10), including naïve Bcells, memory B-cells and plasmablasts (IC50=0.04–0.06μM); and naïve T-cells, T-effector memory, and CD4+ T-cells (IC50=0.10–0.24μM). Cladribine also inhibited B- (IC50=0.03μM) and T-cell (IC50=0.07μM) proliferation (n=10). Cladribine reduced gMG plasma cells (IC50=0.06μM; n=2), total IgG (IC50=0.3μM; n=11), and anti-AChR IgG production at 0.06 and 0.6μM (n=2). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: At concentrations mimicking plasma exposures being assessed in MyClad, cladribine reduced B-cell and T-cell subset counts, plasma cell differentiation, and total IgG and anti-AChR IgG production in AChR seropositive gMG PBMCs in vitro. These data point to cladribine targeting upstream drivers of autoimmunity to reduce autoantibody production, highlighting its potential as a disease-modifying therapy in gMG. Acknowledgement: This study was sponsored by the healthcare business of Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany (Research Organization Registry ID: https://ror.org/04vpzfb52). Medical writing support was provided by Frankie Sorrell, PhD, of Amica Scientific, and funded by the healthcare business of Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种B细胞驱动、T细胞依赖的自身免疫性疾病，以自身抗体产生为特征。Cladribine目前正在gMG III期MyClad试验（NCT06463587）中评估，其作用机制为靶向B细胞和T细胞，导致其短暂减少和选择性免疫重建。目的：研究cladribine对gMG外周血单个核细胞（PBMC）免疫细胞的功能影响。方法：从乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）血清阳性gMG患者（Sanguine Biosciences）分离PBMC，在有或无cladribine条件下培养，并刺激以激活B细胞和T细胞增殖或体外诱导浆细胞分化。通过流式细胞术评估cladribine对B细胞和T细胞亚群减少、细胞增殖和浆细胞分化的半数最大抑制浓度（IC50）。使用酶联免疫吸附试验分析总免疫球蛋白G（IgG）和抗AChR IgG水平。结果：Cladribine对B细胞和T细胞亚群计数产生浓度依赖性减少（n=10），包括初始B细胞、记忆B细胞和浆母细胞（IC50=0.04–0.06μM）；以及初始T细胞、T效应记忆细胞和CD4+ T细胞（IC50=0.10–0.24μM）。Cladribine还抑制B细胞（IC50=0.03μM）和T细胞（IC50=0.07μM）增殖（n=10）。Cladribine减少gMG浆细胞（IC50=0.06μM；n=2）、总IgG（IC50=0.3μM；n=11）以及在0.06和0.6μM时减少抗AChR IgG产生（n=2）。总结/结论：在模拟MyClad中所评估血浆暴露的浓度下，cladribine在体外减少AChR血清阳性gMG PBMC中的B细胞和T细胞亚群计数、浆细胞分化以及总IgG和抗AChR IgG产生。这些数据表明cladribine靶向自身免疫的上游驱动因素以减少自身抗体产生，突显其作为gMG疾病修饰治疗的潜力。致谢：本研究由德国达姆施塔特Merck KGaA医疗健康业务部门资助（研究组织注册ID：https://ror.org/04vpzfb52）。医学写作支持由Amica Scientific的Frankie Sorrell博士提供，并由德国达姆施塔特Merck KGaA医疗健康业务部门资助。

abstracts.title: Efficacy and Safety of Nipocalimab: Switch from 15-mg/kg Every-2-weeks to 30-mg/kg Every-4-weeks (VIVACITY-MG3 Open-label Extension)
abstracts.authors: Tuan Vu; Marie Fitzgibbon; Kavita Gandhi; Nolan Campbell; Yaowei Zhu; Jocelyn Leu; Ibrahim Turkoz; Sindhu Ramchandren
abstracts.affiliations: Tampa, FL; Raritan, NJ; Horsham, PA; Spring House, PA; Titusville, NJ
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab is approved for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in the US and other countries as a 30-mg/kg loading dose, followed by 15- mg/kg every-2-weeks (q2w) for maintenance. During the Vivacity-MG3 open-label extension (OLE), patients from the double-blind phase received nipocalimab 15-mg/kg q2w. There was an option (later removed by protocol amendment) to switch to every-4-week (q4w) dosing. OBJECTIVE: To report efficacy and safety of nipocalimab in patients who switched from 15-mg/kg q2w to 30-mg/kg q4w in OLE of Vivacity-MG3. METHODS: Myasthenia Gravis-Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) scores were analyzed pre-switch and post-switch for patients switching from 15-mg/kg q2w to 30-mg/kg q4w. RESULTS: Overall, 153 patients entered OLE; symptom improvements were maintained through a 60-week extension. Twenty-five patients switched to 30-mg/kg q4w (median [range] duration: 12.1 [0–48] weeks). In seropositive patients (n=21) (median [range] age: 48.0 [26.0–83.0] years; 61.9% females), mean (SD) MG-ADL and QMG scores at OLE baseline were 8.3 (3.50) and 14.8 (6.08), respectively. Prior to switch, mean (SD) change from OLE baseline (CFB) was MG-ADL (n=16): −2.4 (3.15) and QMG (n=15): −2.6 (4.21); after switch, mean (SD) CFB was MG-ADL (n=16): −2.0 (3.03) and QMG (n=15): −2.3 (3.79). Safety data for q4w were comparable with q2w. Infections and infestations were the most-reported adverse events (AEs; 48.0% vs 44.0%). No AEs led to death. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Temporary 30-mg/kg q4w nipocalimab dosing showed sustained clinical efficacy and a safety profile consistent with 15-mg/kg q2w dosing. Interpretation is limited by small patient number and short follow-up duration for q4w dosing.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Nipocalimab已在美国和其他国家获批用于全身型重症肌无力（gMG），给药方案为30 mg/kg负荷剂量，随后15 mg/kg每2周（q2w）维持。在Vivacity-MG3开放标签扩展（OLE）期间，双盲阶段患者接受nipocalimab 15 mg/kg q2w。存在转换为每4周（q4w）给药的选择（后经方案修订删除）。目的：报告Vivacity-MG3的OLE中从15 mg/kg q2w转换为30 mg/kg q4w的患者的nipocalimab疗效和安全性。方法：对从15 mg/kg q2w转换为30 mg/kg q4w的患者，分析转换前和转换后的重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）和定量重症肌无力（QMG）评分。结果：总体而言，153例患者进入OLE；症状改善在60周扩展期内维持。25例患者转换为30 mg/kg q4w（中位[范围]持续时间：12.1 [0–48]周）。在血清阳性患者（n=21）中（中位[范围]年龄：48.0 [26.0–83.0]岁；61.9%女性），OLE基线时MG-ADL和QMG平均（SD）评分分别为8.3（3.50）和14.8（6.08）。转换前，较OLE基线的平均（SD）变化（CFB）为MG-ADL（n=16）：−2.4（3.15）和QMG（n=15）：−2.6（4.21）；转换后，平均（SD）CFB为MG-ADL（n=16）：−2.0（3.03）和QMG（n=15）：−2.3（3.79）。q4w的安全性数据与q2w相当。感染和侵染是最常报告的不良事件（AE；48.0% vs 44.0%）。无AE导致死亡。总结/结论：临时30 mg/kg q4w nipocalimab给药显示出持续临床疗效，安全性特征与15 mg/kg q2w给药一致。解读受q4w给药患者数量少和随访时间短的限制。

abstracts.title: Efficacy of Nipocalimab in Patients Early in Their Disease Course of Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Post Hoc Analysis of VIVACITY-MG3
abstracts.authors: Carlo Antozzi; Wim Noel; Marie Fitzgibbon; Wisam Karmous; Kavita Gandhi; Ibrahim Turkoz; Michael Kutch; Sindhu Ramchandren; Elena Cortés-Vicente
abstracts.affiliations: Milan, Italy; Beerse, Belgium; Raritan, NJ; Issy-les- Moulineaux, France; Horsham, PA; Cambridge, MA; Titusville, NJ; Barcelona, Spain
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab added to standard-of-care (SOC) showed greater improvement than placebo (+SOC) in Myasthenia-Gravis–Activities-of-Daily-Living (MG-ADL), and Quantitative-Myasthenia-Gravis (QMG) scores in Vivacity-MG3 study (NCT04496507). OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether efficacy was achievable in patients with generalized MG (gMG) diagnosed earlier (≤5 years) before study initiation. METHODS: Analysis included seropositive patients treated with nipocalimab or placebo diagnosed with gMG within previous 5 years (below the cohort median of 5 years). Efficacy at week (W)24 was assessed using MG- ADL (meaningful clinical improvement [MCI]: ≥2-point improvement; substantial clinical improvement [SCI]: ≥3- point improvement) and QMG (MCI: ≥3-point improvement; SCI: ≥4-point improvement) scores in patients diagnosed with gMG ≤5 years. Two-sample t-tests compared baseline-to-W24 changes between groups. RESULTS: Baseline demographics were generally balanced between nipocalimab and placebo-treated patients. At W24, MG-ADL reductions (mean [SD]) from baseline were greater with nipocalimab (−4.9 [2.88]) versus placebo (−2.7 [2.46]); difference: −2.22 (SE: 0.76); 95% CI (−3.74; −0.70); p=0.005. Similarly, QMG reductions (mean [SD]) from baseline were greater with nipocalimab (−5.1 [4.14]) versus placebo (−2.3 [3.20]); difference: −2.85 (SE:1.08); 95% CI (−5.03; −0.66); p=0.012. A greater proportion of patients receiving nipocalimab met MCI and SCI criteria MG-ADL (87.1% versus 63.6% and 74.2% versus 40.9%) and QMG (53.8% versus 36.4% and 53.8% versus 22.7%) at W24 versus placebo. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In patients diagnosed with gMG in ≤5 years before study initiation, nipocalimab demonstrated greater efficacy versus placebo, achieving MCI and SCI in MG-ADL and QMG at W24. These findings highlight the benefit of nipocalimab in recently diagnosed patients with gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在Vivacity-MG3研究（NCT04496507）中，nipocalimab联合标准治疗（SOC）在重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）和定量重症肌无力量表（QMG）评分方面较安慰剂（+SOC）显示出更大改善。目的：评估在 study initiation 前较早诊断（≤5年）的全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者中是否可获得疗效。方法：分析纳入既往5年内（低于队列中位数5年）诊断为gMG的血清阳性患者，接受nipocalimab或安慰剂治疗。在第24周（W24）评估诊断gMG≤5年患者的疗效，采用MG-ADL（有意义的临床改善[MCI]：≥2分改善；显著临床改善[SCI]：≥3分改善）和QMG（MCI：≥3分改善；SCI：≥4分改善）评分。采用两样本t检验比较组间基线至W24的变化。结果：nipocalimab组与安慰剂组基线人口学特征总体均衡。在W24，nipocalimab组MG-ADL较基线的下降（均值[SD]）大于安慰剂组（−4.9[2.88] vs −2.7[2.46]）；差异：−2.22（SE：0.76）；95%CI（−3.74；−0.70）；p=0.005。同样，nipocalimab组QMG较基线的下降（均值[SD]）大于安慰剂组（−5.1[4.14] vs −2.3[3.20]）；差异：−2.85（SE：1.08）；95%CI（−5.03；−0.66）；p=0.012。在W24，接受nipocalimab的患者达到MG-ADL的MCI和SCI标准的比例（87.1% vs 63.6%和74.2% vs 40.9%）以及QMG的MCI和SCI标准的比例（53.8% vs 36.4%和53.8% vs 22.7%）均高于安慰剂组。总结/结论：在 study initiation 前≤5年内诊断为gMG的患者中，nipocalimab较安慰剂显示出更大疗效，在W24达到MG-ADL和QMG的MCI和SCI。这些发现突显了nipocalimab在近期诊断的gMG患者中的获益。

abstracts.title: Efficacy of Nipocalimab in Patients with Lower Baseline Score of Myasthenia Gravis Activity of Daily Living in VIVACITY-MG3 Study
abstracts.authors: Carlo Antozzi; Wim Noel; Wisam Karmous; Marie Fitzgibbon; Kavita Gandhi; Ibrahim Turkoz; Michael Kutch; Sindhu Ramchandren
abstracts.affiliations: Milan, Italy; Beerse, Belgium; Issy-les-Moulineaux, France; Raritan, NJ; Horsham, PA; Titusville, NJ; Chesterbrook, PA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is a chronic autoimmune disease characterized by fluctuating muscle weakness and fatigability. In VIVACITY-MG3 (NCT04496507), nipocalimab+standard-of-care (SOC), demonstrated greater improvement in Myasthenia-Gravis- Activities-of-Daily-Living (MG-ADL), and Quantitative- Myasthenia-Gravis (QMG) scores versus placebo+SOC. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether efficacy could be achieved in patients with lower baseline symptom burden (MG-ADL scores: 6–9). METHODS: Analysis included seropositive patients treated with nipocalimab+SOC or placebo+SOC with baseline MG-ADL score <9 (cohort median score). Changes from baseline (CFB) in MG-ADL (meaningful clinical improvement [MCI]:≥2-point improvement; substantial clinical improvement [SCI]:≥3-point improvement), and QMG (MCI:≥3-point improvement; SCI:≥4-point improvement) at week (W)24 were evaluated and compared. RESULTS: Baseline demographics were generally balanced (nipocalimab+SOC[n=48] vs placebo+SOC [n=45]: median age:51 vs 47-years; females:64.6% vs 57.8%; mean±SD baseline MG-ADL: 7.6±0.87 vs 7.6±1.02; QMG: 13.6±4.27 vs 14.9±5.60). At W24, mean ±SD CFB in MG-ADL were greater with nipocalimab+SOC (−4.5±2.64) vs placebo+SOC (−2.3±2.37); difference:−2.23 (standard error [SE]:0.588); 95%CI (−3.41;−1.06); p<0.001. Similarly, CFB in QMG (mean ±SD) were also greater with nipocalimab+SOC (−5.2±4.45) vs placebo+SOC (−1.9±3.69); difference:−3.38 (SE:0.986); 95%CI (−5.34;−1.41); p=0.001. At W24, a significantly greater proportion nipocalimab+SOC-treated patients met MCI and SCI criteria vs placebo+SOC (MG-ADL: MCI:85.0% vs 58.8% [p=0.017]; SCI: 72.5% vs 38.2% [p=0.005] and QMG: MCI:62.9% vs 32.4% [p=0.016]; SCI:57.1% vs 20.6% [p=0.003]). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In patients with baseline MG- ADL scores 6–9, nipocalimab demonstrated greater efficacy vs placebo, achieving MCI and SCI in MG-ADL and QMG at W24. Findings support the benefit of nipocalimab for sustained disease control in patients with generalized MG and lower baseline MG-ADL scores.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）是一种以波动性肌无力和易疲劳为特征的慢性自身免疫性疾病。在VIVACITY-MG3（NCT04496507）中，nipocalimab+标准治疗（SOC）在重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）和定量重症肌无力量表（QMG）评分方面较安慰剂+SOC显示出更大改善。目的：评估在基线症状负担较低（MG-ADL评分：6–9）的患者中是否可获得疗效。方法：分析纳入接受nipocalimab+SOC或安慰剂+SOC治疗、基线MG-ADL评分<9（队列中位评分）的血清阳性患者。评估并比较第24周（W24）MG-ADL（有意义的临床改善[MCI]：≥2分改善；显著临床改善[SCI]：≥3分改善）和QMG（MCI：≥3分改善；SCI：≥4分改善）较基线的变化（CFB）。结果：基线人口学特征总体均衡（nipocalimab+SOC[n=48] vs 安慰剂+SOC[n=45]：中位年龄：51 vs 47岁；女性：64.6% vs 57.8%；基线MG-ADL均值±SD：7.6±0.87 vs 7.6±1.02；QMG：13.6±4.27 vs 14.9±5.60）。在W24，nipocalimab+SOC组MG-ADL的CFB均值±SD大于安慰剂+SOC组（−4.5±2.64 vs −2.3±2.37）；差异：−2.23（标准误[SE]：0.588）；95%CI（−3.41；−1.06）；p<0.001。同样，nipocalimab+SOC组QMG的CFB（均值±SD）也大于安慰剂+SOC组（−5.2±4.45 vs −1.9±3.69）；差异：−3.38（SE：0.986）；95%CI（−5.34；−1.41）；p=0.001。在W24，nipocalimab+SOC治疗患者达到MCI和SCI标准的比例显著高于安慰剂+SOC组（MG-ADL：MCI：85.0% vs 58.8%[p=0.017]；SCI：72.5% vs 38.2%[p=0.005]；QMG：MCI：62.9% vs 32.4%[p=0.016]；SCI：57.1% vs 20.6%[p=0.003]）。总结/结论：在基线MG-ADL评分为6–9的患者中，nipocalimab较安慰剂显示出更大疗效，在W24达到MG-ADL和QMG的MCI和SCI。研究结果支持nipocalimab对基线MG-ADL评分较低的全身型MG患者实现持续疾病控制的获益。

abstracts.title: Indirect Comparison of Nipocalimab Safety versus FCRN Blockers, C5 Complement Inhibitors, Rituximab and IVIG in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Saiju Jacob; Brian Hutton; Suzy Van Sanden; Tom Denee; Wisam Karmous; Joris Diels; Kavita Gandhi; Carly J Paoli; Mahmoud Hashim; Nils Erik Gilhus
abstracts.affiliations: Birmingham, United Kingdom; Ottawa, Canada; Beerse, Belgium; Breda, Netherlands; Issy les Moulineaux, France; Horsham, PA; Bergen, Norway
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab and standard of care (SOC) combination (nipocalimab) was generally well tolerated compared to placebo+SOC (placebo) in VIVACITY-MG3 (NCT04951622) among seropositive and seronegative adults with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). OBJECTIVE: To conduct indirect treatment comparisons (ITC) of nipocalimab safety outcomes (any Adverse Events [AEs] and Serious Adverse Events [SAEs]) versus approved FcRn blockers (efgartigimod and rozanolixizumab), C5 complement inhibitors (ravulizumab, zilucoplan, and eculizumab), and off-label treatments (intravenous Immunoglobulin (IVIg) and rituximab). METHODS: A Bayesian network meta-analysis (NMA) was conducted on the Acetylcholine Receptor-positive (AChR+) population, selected to ensure comparability across eligible trials. Model selection was based on best-fit criteria. Base-case analyses included eligible trials with similar follow-up duration and sensitivity analyses included all trials independent of trial duration. Results are reported as odds-ratio (OR) and probability (P) of OR<1 favoring nipocalimab. RESULTS: The Bayesian NMA for AEs showed comparable results for nipocalimab versus other FcRn blockers and C5 inhibitors (P[OR<1]=16.7-83.8%) except for rozanolixizumab-10mg where nipocalimab was likely favorable (P[OR<1]=87.5%). For SAEs, nipocalimab results were comparable with eculizumab and efgartigimod (P[OR<1]=73.4%; 77.8%) and likely favorable versus other comparators (P[OR<1]: rozanolixizumab (7mg)=90.5%, zilucoplan=97.0%, efgartigimod (PH20 SC)=91.1%, rozanolixizumab (10mg)=95.9%, ravulizumab=99.4%). Compared to rituximab and IVIG, results were comparable for nipocalimab on AEs (P[OR<1]=50.1%; 54.3%) and were likely favorable for SAEs (P[OR<1]=96.4%; 96.0%). Results from base-case and sensitivity analyses were consistent. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: The benefit-risk profile is an important consideration when treating a chronic and fluctuating disease, like gMG. Based on ITCs, AE rates were comparable, while SAE results favored nipocalimab when compared with alternative gMG therapies.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在VIVACITY-MG3（NCT04951622）中，nipocalimab联合标准治疗（SOC）（nipocalimab）在血清阳性和血清阴性全身型重症肌无力（gMG）成人患者中较安慰剂+SOC（安慰剂）总体耐受良好。目的：对nipocalimab安全性结局（任何不良事件[AEs]和严重不良事件[SAEs]）与已获批FcRn阻断剂（efgartigimod和rozanolixizumab）、C5补体抑制剂（ravulizumab、zilucoplan和eculizumab）以及超说明书治疗（静脉注射免疫球蛋白[IVIg]和rituximab）进行间接治疗比较（ITC）。方法：在乙酰胆碱受体阳性（AChR+）人群中进行贝叶斯网络荟萃分析（NMA），选择该人群以确保合格试验间的可比性。模型选择基于最佳拟合标准。基础病例分析纳入随访持续时间相似的合格试验，敏感性分析纳入所有试验而不考虑试验持续时间。结果以比值比（OR）和OR<1（ favoring nipocalimab）的概率（P）报告。结果：AEs的贝叶斯NMA显示，nipocalimab与其他FcRn阻断剂和C5抑制剂结果相当（P[OR<1]=16.7–83.8%），但rozanolixizumab-10mg除外，nipocalimab可能更优（P[OR<1]=87.5%）。对于SAEs，nipocalimab与eculizumab和efgartigimod结果相当（P[OR<1]=73.4%；77.8%），且可能优于其他对照（P[OR<1]：rozanolixizumab（7mg）=90.5%，zilucoplan=97.0%，efgartigimod（PH20 SC）=91.1%，rozanolixizumab（10mg）=95.9%，ravulizumab=99.4%）。与rituximab和IVIg相比，nipocalimab在AEs方面结果相当（P[OR<1]=50.1%；54.3%），在SAEs方面可能更优（P[OR<1]=96.4%；96.0%）。基础病例和敏感性分析结果一致。总结/结论：在治疗gMG这类慢性波动性疾病时，获益-风险特征是重要考量。基于ITC，AE发生率相当，而SAE结果在与其他gMG疗法比较时 favoring nipocalimab。

abstracts.title: Long-term Safety and Efficacy of Nipocalimab: Approximately 2 Years Follow-up Results from the Open-label Extension Phase of VIVACITY-MG3 Study
abstracts.authors: Carlo Antozzi; Tuan Vu; Sindhu Ramchandren; Richard Nowak; Constantine Farmakidis; Kumaraswamy Sivakumar; Panna Sanga; Ibrahim Turkoz; Yaowei Zhu; Marie Fitzgibbon; Michel Burcklen

abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In a broad population of autoantibody- positive generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) patients, nipocalimab demonstrated sustained improvement in MG- Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) scores over 24-weeks double-blind and over 60-weeks of open-label extension (OLE) phase of Vivacity-MG3 (NCT04951622) study. OBJECTIVE: To assess the long-term safety and efficacy of nipocalimab with additional follow-up, up to Week-96, of ongoing OLE phase of nipocalimab treatment in gMG. METHODS: In Vivacity-MG3, adult patients with gMG (Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America Class II-IV), inadequately controlled (MG-ADL≥6) on standard-of-care (SOC) therapy, were randomized 1:1 to nipocalimab+SOC or placebo+SOC in 24-week double-blind phase, followed by an option to enter the OLE phase. Efficacy and safety were evaluated in seropositive (anti-AChR positive, anti- MuSK positive, and/or anti-LRP4 positive) patients who received ≥1 dose of study treatment. RESULTS: In the seropositive efficacy analysis set (N=137) during OLE, total duration of treatment (median [range]) for placebo/nipocalimab (n=66) and nipocalimab/nipocalimab (n=71) groups was 69.1 Weeks (8–128) and 62.1 Weeks (8–128), respectively. The mean (SD) change-from-baseline (CFB) in MG-ADL scores for those who reached 96-weeks of treatment with placebo/nipocalimab and nipocalimab/nipocalimab groups was –6.69(3.39) and –6.47(4.62), and CFB in Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) scores was –5.81(4.11) and –5.97(4.97), respectively. The mean (SD) percent CFB in IgG for placebo/nipocalimab group was –63.24(14.31) and for nipocalimab/nipocalimab group was –64.06(12.91). No new safety concerns were reported in OLE phase. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In autoantibody-positive patients with gMG, long-term treatment with nipocalimab demonstrated sustained disease control through the 24- week DB phase and the 96-week OLE (120-weeks total) of the Vivacity-MG3 study.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在广泛的自抗体阳性全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者人群中，nipocalimab在Vivacity-MG3（NCT04951622）研究24周双盲期和60周开放标签扩展（OLE）期显示出MG-日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）评分的持续改善。目的：评估nipocalimab在gMG中正在进行的OLE期额外随访至第96周的长期安全性和疗效。方法：在Vivacity-MG3中，接受标准治疗（SOC）但控制不佳（MG-ADL≥6）的成人gMG患者（美国重症肌无力基金会II-IV级）按1:1随机接受nipocalimab+SOC或安慰剂+SOC治疗24周双盲期，随后可选择进入OLE期。在接受≥1剂研究治疗的血清阳性（抗AChR阳性、抗MuSK阳性和/或抗LRP4阳性）患者中评估疗效和安全性。结果：在OLE期的血清阳性疗效分析集（N=137）中，安慰剂/nipocalimab组（n=66）和nipocalimab/nipocalimab组（n=71）的总治疗持续时间（中位[范围]）分别为69.1周（8–128）和62.1周（8–128）。达到96周治疗的安慰剂/nipocalimab组和nipocalimab/nipocalimab组MG-ADL评分较基线变化（CFB）均值（SD）分别为–6.69（3.39）和–6.47（4.62），定量重症肌无力（QMG）评分CFB分别为–5.81（4.11）和–5.97（4.97）。安慰剂/nipocalimab组IgG较基线变化百分比均值（SD）为–63.24（14.31），nipocalimab/nipocalimab组为–64.06（12.91）。OLE期未报告新的安全性问题。总结/结论：在自抗体阳性gMG患者中，nipocalimab长期治疗在Vivacity-MG3研究的24周双盲期和96周OLE期（总计120周）显示出持续的疾病控制。

abstracts.title: Myasthenia Gravis Inebilizumab Trial: 26-week Randomized-placebo Controlled and 26-week Open-label Results in Anti-muscle-specific Kinase Subgroup
abstracts.authors: Richard Nowak; Maria Isabel Leite; Michael Benatar; Emma Ciafaloni; John Vissing; Kimiaki Utsugisawa; Sarah Bray; Ankur Bhambri; Arati Kiran Kanchi; Sue Cheng; James F. Howard; Jr.
abstracts.affiliations: New Haven, CT; Oxford, United Kingdom; Miami, FL; Rochester, NY; Copenhagen, Denmark; Hanamaki, Japan; Thousand Oaks, CA; Bradenton, FL; Chapel Hill, NC
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is caused by anti-muscle-specific kinase (MuSK+) and anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR+) antibodies targeting corresponding proteins in the synapse. The placebo (PBO)-controlled MG Inebilizumab (INEB) Trial (MINT) assessed INEB, a monoclonal antibody targeting CD19+ B cells, in patients with MuSK+ or AChR+ gMG. INEB vs PBO yielded significantly greater improvements in MG Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Quantitative MG (QMG) scores at week 26 in MINT. OBJECTIVE: To report key outcomes for the MuSK+ subpopulation from the first 26 weeks of the open-label period (OLP). METHODS: Participants with MuSK+ gMG in MINT (NCT04524273) were randomized 1:1 to 300 mg intravenous INEB or PBO for 26 weeks. Participants underwent a protocol-specified steroid taper (≤5 mg/day by week 24). After the randomized, controlled period (RCP), participants could receive INEB in the OLP. This pre-specified, interim, descriptive analysis included participants who received any dose of INEB during MINT. No statistical testing was done. RESULTS: Overall, 48 participants with MuSK+ were enrolled and randomized: 46 entered the OLP and 44 completed 26 weeks. Baseline MG-ADL and QMG scores were similar32ew between groups, and mean scores decreased from baseline to week 26 during the RCP (INEB –4.1, –5.0; PBO –3.1, –4.2, respectively). During the initial 26-week OLP (week 52), the mean MG-ADL and QMG scores continued to decrease from baseline (INEB/INEB: –5.6, –6.1; PBO/INEB: –5.1, –7.4, respectively). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In this descriptive analysis, INEB demonstrated ongoing improvement in MG-ADL and QMG scores compared to baseline irrespective of initial randomization.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型肌无力（gMG）由抗肌肉特异性激酶（MuSK+）和抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR+）抗体靶向突触中相应蛋白所致。安慰剂（PBO）对照的肌无力Inebilizumab（INEB）试验（MINT）评估了INEB（一种靶向CD19+ B细胞的单克隆抗体）在MuSK+或AChR+ gMG患者中的作用。在MINT中，与PBO相比，INEB在第26周时使MG日常生活活动能力（MG-ADL）和定量MG（QMG）评分的改善显著更大。目的：报告开放标签期（OLP）前26周MuSK+亚人群的关键结局。方法：MINT（NCT04524273）中的MuSK+ gMG受试者按1:1随机接受300 mg静脉INEB或PBO治疗26周。受试者接受方案规定的激素减量（至第24周≤5 mg/天）。在随机对照期（RCP）后，受试者可在OLP中接受INEB。这项预先设定的中期描述性分析纳入在MINT期间接受任何剂量INEB的受试者。未进行统计学检验。结果：总体共纳入并随机48例MuSK+受试者：46例进入OLP，44例完成26周。两组基线MG-ADL和QMG评分相似，RCP期间从基线至第26周平均评分下降（INEB –4.1、–5.0；PBO –3.1、–4.2）。在初始26周OLP期间（第52周），平均MG-ADL和QMG评分较基线继续下降（INEB/INEB：–5.6、–6.1；PBO/INEB：–5.1、–7.4）。总结/结论：在这项描述性分析中，无论初始随机分组如何，INEB较基线均显示MG-ADL和QMG评分持续改善。

abstracts.title: Psychometric Evaluation of the Myasthenia Gravis Impairment Index Patient Reported Outcome Ocular Score in Ocular Myasthenia Gravis: Results from a Phase 3 Clinical Trial in Ocular Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Martina Orlovic; Rosa Jimenez; Wan-Yi Huang; Michael Mendes; Fien M. Verhamme; Fien Gistelinck; Cécile Blein; Jeffrey Guptill; Rebecca Cheng; Jennifer Beaumont; Gabriella Szatmary; Carolina Barnett-Tapia

abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Ocular myasthenia gravis (oMG) is an IgG autoantibody-mediated, condition primarily characterized by fluctuating diplopia and ptosis. Sensitive, interpretable patient-reported outcome (PRO) measures are essential to capture treatment effects on ocular symptoms. The Myasthenia Gravis Impairment Index (MGII) includes a (PRO) ocular score; however, evidence supporting its measurement properties in oMG has been limited. METHODS: Psychometric evaluation used Phase 3 ADAPT OCULUS data, a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled registrational study and the first dedicated pivotal trial evaluating a targeted therapy in adults with oMG. As the MGII (PRO) ocular score was the primary endpoint, we assessed item performance, reliability, validity, responsiveness, and thresholds for meaningful individual- and group-level interpretation (anchor /distribution based). RESULTS: Items showed minimal missingness and appropriate score distributions. The MGII (PRO) ocular score demonstrated good convergent/divergent validity and test–retest reliability (ICC >0.70). Known-groups analyses showed clear separation across anchor-defined severity groups. The score was responsive: greater improvement associated with greater improvement in reference measures (P<0.01). Strong correlations between MGII (PRO) ocular score change and anchors were observed (PGI-S ocular r=0.579; PGI-C ocular r=0.590; MG-ADL ocular r=0.448). Anchor-based analyses supported a 3-point threshold for meaningful individual- level change (range 3-4 points) and a 3-point threshold for meaningful group-level difference (range: 2–4 points). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: The MGII (PRO) ocular score demonstrates robust reliability, validity, and responsiveness in oMG. Its psychometric properties support its interpretability and suitability as a clinical trial endpoint for detecting treatment benefit in oMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：眼型肌无力（oMG）是一种由IgG自身抗体介导的疾病，主要表现为波动性复视和上睑下垂。敏感、可解释的患者报告结局（PRO）指标对于捕捉治疗对眼部症状的影响至关重要。肌无力损害指数（MGII）包含一个（PRO）眼部评分；然而，支持其在oMG中测量学特性的证据有限。方法：心理测量学评估使用3期ADAPT OCULUS数据，这是一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照注册研究，也是首个在oMG成人中评估靶向治疗的专门关键性试验。由于MGII（PRO）眼部评分是主要终点，我们评估了条目表现、信度、效度、反应性以及个体水平和组水平有意义解释的阈值（基于锚定/分布）。结果：条目缺失极少且评分分布适当。MGII（PRO）眼部评分显示出良好的聚合/区分效度和重测信度（ICC >0.70）。已知组分析显示在锚定定义的严重程度组之间具有清晰区分。该评分具有反应性：参考指标改善越大，评分改善越大（P<0.01）。观察到MGII（PRO）眼部评分变化与锚定指标之间强相关（PGI-S眼部 r=0.579；PGI-C眼部 r=0.590；MG-ADL眼部 r=0.448）。基于锚定的分析支持个体水平有意义变化的3分阈值（范围3-4分）和组水平有有意义差异的3分阈值（范围：2-4分）。总结/结论：MGII（PRO）眼部评分在oMG中显示出稳健的信度、效度和反应性。其心理测量学特性支持其可解释性及作为临床试验终点检测oMG治疗获益的适用性。

abstracts.conferenceFullName: 2026 MGFA Scientific Session (held within the AANEM Annual Meeting)
abstracts.title: Real-world Effectiveness and Steroid-sparing Effects of Efgartigimod in Myasthenia Gravis: A Single-center Study
abstracts.authors: Quantao Zeng; Song Tan
abstracts.affiliations: Chengdu, China; Chendu, China
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis is an autoimmune disorder of the neuromuscular junction characterized by fluctuating skeletal muscle weakness. Efgartigimod, a neonatal Fc receptor antagonist, reduces circulating immunoglobulin G and has demonstrated efficacy in clinical trials; however, real-world evidence remains limited. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the effectiveness and steroid- sparing effect of efgartigimod in patients with myasthenia gravis in a single-center real-world cohort. METHODS: This retrospective observational study included patients with myasthenia gravis treated with at least three cycles of efgartigimod. Patients were followed for 12 months. Changes in Activities of Daily Living (ADL) scores and prednisone dose were analyzed using paired statistical tests, with statistical significance set at p < 0.05. RESULTS: A total of 101 patients were included, with a mean age of 56 years and 46.5% male. Among them, 6.9% had thymoma and 86.1% were antibody-positive. The baseline mean ADL score was 7.1, and the average prednisone dose was 25.2 mg/day. After 12 months of treatment, the mean ADL score improved by 4.8 points from baseline. Meanwhile, the mean prednisone dose decreased by 22.6 mg/day, indicating a significant steroid- sparing effect. Clinical improvements were observed across patient subgroups. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Efgartigimod demonstrated significant clinical efficacy and a robust steroid-sparing effect in a real-world cohort of patients with myasthenia gravis, supporting its use in routine clinical practice.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：肌无力是一种神经肌肉接头自身免疫性疾病，以波动性骨骼肌无力为特征。Efgartigimod是一种新生儿Fc受体拮抗剂，可降低循环免疫球蛋白G，并已在临床试验中显示疗效；然而，真实世界证据仍然有限。目的：在单中心真实世界队列中评估efgartigimod对肌无力患者的有效性和激素节约效应。方法：这项回顾性观察性研究纳入接受至少3个周期efgartigimod治疗的肌无力患者。患者随访12个月。使用配对统计检验分析日常生活活动能力（ADL）评分和泼尼松剂量的变化，统计学显著性设定为p < 0.05。结果：共纳入101例患者，平均年龄56岁，46.5%为男性。其中6.9%有胸腺瘤，86.1%抗体阳性。基线平均ADL评分为7.1，平均泼尼松剂量为25.2 mg/天。治疗12个月后，平均ADL评分较基线改善4.8分。同时，平均泼尼松剂量减少22.6 mg/天，表明具有显著激素节约效应。在各患者亚组中均观察到临床改善。总结/结论：在真实世界肌无力患者队列中，efgartigimod显示出显著临床疗效和强健的激素节约效应，支持其在常规临床实践中的应用。

abstracts.conferenceFullName: 2026 MGFA Scientific Session (held within the AANEM Annual Meeting)
abstracts.title: Real-world Experience with Efgartigimod: A Single-center Study from Slovenia
abstracts.authors: Mateja Baruca Grad; Lea Leonardis
abstracts.affiliations: Ljubljana, Slovenia
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Efgartigimod has demonstrated efficacy in acetylcholine receptor antibody–positive generalized myasthenia gravis (AChR-Ab+ gMG) in randomized trials; however, real-world data on individualized dosing, immunosuppressive tapering, and patient-centered outcomes remain limited. OBJECTIVE: We evaluated the effectiveness and safety of efgartigimod in routine clinical practice at a tertiary neuromuscular center. METHODS: This retrospective, single-center real-world study included adults with AChR-Ab+ gMG treated with efgartigimod between December 2023 and August 2025. Outcomes included Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL), Myasthenia Gravis Composite (MGC), Myasthenia Gravis Quality of Life–15 revised (MG- QOL15r) scales change, corticosteroid and nonsteroidal immunosuppressive therapy (NSIST) reduction, intertreatment interval adjustments, rescue therapy use, hospitalizations, and safety. RESULTS: Twenty-one patients were included (median follow-up 53 weeks). By Week 12, median MG-ADL improved by 4 points, MGC decreased from 5.5 to 0, and MG-QOL15r improved from 14.5 to 4.0, with benefits maintained during follow-up in most patients. NSIST was discontinued at treatment initiation in all but one patient without apparent loss of disease control. Median daily methylprednisolone dose decreased from 12 mg to 4 mg by Week 36. Following initial fixed dosing, 71% of patients extended intertreatment intervals to ≥6 weeks. Rescue therapy use and hospitalizations declined. Infections were common but generally mild to moderate and manageable with prompt treatment. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In this real-world cohort, efgartigimod was associated with sustained clinical improvement, reduced immunosuppressive burden, individualized dosing feasibility, and an acceptable safety profile in AChR-Ab+ gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Efgartigimod已在随机试验中证明对乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性全身型肌无力（AChR-Ab+ gMG）有效；然而，关于个体化给药、免疫抑制减量和以患者为中心的结局的真实世界数据仍然有限。目的：我们在三级神经肌肉中心评估efgartigimod在常规临床实践中的有效性和安全性。方法：这项回顾性、单中心真实世界研究纳入2023年12月至2025年8月期间接受efgartigimod治疗的AChR-Ab+ gMG成人。结局包括肌无力日常生活活动能力（MG-ADL）、肌无力综合（MGC）、修订版肌无力生活质量-15（MG-QOL15r）量表变化、皮质类固醇和非甾体免疫抑制治疗（NSIST）减少、治疗间期调整、挽救治疗使用、住院和安全性。结果：共纳入21例患者（中位随访53周）。至第12周，中位MG-ADL改善4分，MGC从5.5降至0，MG-QOL15r从14.5改善至4.0，大多数患者在随访期间获益维持。除1例患者外，所有患者在治疗开始时停用NSIST，且无明显疾病控制丧失。中位每日甲泼尼龙剂量至第36周从12 mg降至4 mg。在初始固定给药后，71%的患者将治疗间期延长至≥6周。挽救治疗使用和住院减少。感染常见但通常为轻至中度，经及时治疗可控。总结/结论：在该真实世界队列中，efgartigimod与AChR-Ab+ gMG持续临床改善、免疫抑制负担降低、个体化给药可行性及可接受的安全性特征相关。

abstracts.conferenceFullName: 2026 MGFA Scientific Session (held within the AANEM Annual Meeting)
abstracts.title: Sustained Safety and Efficacy of Active C1S Inhibitor Claseprubart in Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Results from the Magic Study Open-label Extension
abstracts.authors: Tuan Vu; Stojan Peric; Pushpa Narayanaswami; Marek Smilowski; Agnieszka Slowik; Sankalp Gokhale; Caitlin Briggs; Uzma Siddiqui; Simrat Randhawa; Luke Hickey; Courtney Walls; Shahar Shelly; John Vissing
abstracts.affiliations: Lutz, FL; Berlin, Germany; Boston, MA; Katowice, Poland; Krakow, Poland; New York, NY; Raleigh, NC; Buffalo, NY; Haifa, Israel; Copenhagen, Denmark
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Claseprubart is the first monoclonal antibody in development for the treatment of generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) that inhibits the upstream classical complement pathway by blocking active C1s. The phase 2 MaGic study demonstrated that claseprubart was well-tolerated with clinically meaningful efficacy improvements after 13 weeks of treatment in adults with acetylcholine receptor antibody positive (AChR+) gMG. OBJECTIVE: To assess the sustained safety and efficacy of approximately 1 year of claseprubart treatment in the MaGic open-label extension (OLE). METHODS: MaGic (NCT06282159) is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 trial. Patients with AChR+ gMG received subcutaneous claseprubart 300mg (Q2W), claseprubart 600 mg (Q2W), or placebo for 13 weeks. Patients eligible for the 52-week OLE were switched to, or continued, Q2W 300 mg claseprubart. RESULTS: Sixty-three patients completed the 13-week randomized controlled trial (RCT); 60 enrolled in the OLE. To date, 52 patients are currently enrolled or completed the OLE. At OLE Week 36 (49 total weeks of treatment), claseprubart 300mg patients continuing treatment (n=15) showed sustained improvement in MG-activities of daily living (MG-ADL; -4.9 [standard deviation, SD 2.19]) and Quantitative MG score (QMG; -5.1 [SD 3.47]) versus RCT study baseline. Safety and tolerability of claseprubart in the OLE was consistent with the RCT. No patients in the continuous 300mg claseprubart arm developed a treatment-related serious adverse event. Additionally, patients switching from placebo to claseprubart showed rapid improvements in MG-ADL and QMG. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Forty-nine weeks of Q2W subcutaneous 300mg claseprubart treatment demonstrated sustained efficacy with a well-tolerated safety profile in patients with AChR+ gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Claseprubart是首个正在开发用于治疗全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的单克隆抗体，通过阻断活性C1s抑制上游经典补体通路。2期MaGic研究显示，claseprubart在乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR+）gMG成人患者中治疗13周后耐受性良好，并具有临床意义的疗效改善。目的：评估MaGic开放标签扩展（OLE）中claseprubart治疗约1年的持续安全性和疗效。方法：MaGic（NCT06282159）是一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的2期试验。AChR+ gMG患者接受皮下claseprubart 300mg（Q2W）、claseprubart 600mg（Q2W）或安慰剂治疗13周。符合52周OLE条件的患者转换为或继续接受Q2W 300mg claseprubart治疗。结果：63例患者完成了13周随机对照试验（RCT）；60例入组OLE。截至目前，52例患者目前仍在组或已完成OLE。在OLE第36周（总计49周治疗），继续治疗的claseprubart 300mg患者（n=15）较RCT研究基线显示MG日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL；-4.9[标准差，SD 2.19]）和定量MG评分（QMG；-5.1[SD 3.47]）持续改善。OLE中claseprubart的安全性和耐受性与RCT一致。持续300mg claseprubart组无患者发生治疗相关严重不良事件。此外，从安慰剂转换为claseprubart的患者MG-ADL和QMG迅速改善。总结/结论：Q2W皮下300mg claseprubart治疗49周在AChR+ gMG患者中显示出持续疗效和良好耐受的安全性特征。

abstracts.title: Vitaccess Real Myasthenia Gravis (MG) Reality Studies Protocol: Registry-based Mixed Method Studies on Treatment Outcomes in Patients Initiated on Zilucoplan OR Rozanolixizumab in the Real World
abstracts.authors: Zabeen Mahuwala; Kerina Bonar; Natasa Savic; Thais Tarancon; Jos Bloemers; Patrik Öhagen; Olivia Knowles; Carmen Petitjean; Hanna Skrobanski; Saiju Jacob
abstracts.affiliations: Lexington, KY; Slough, United Kingdom; Bulle, Switzerland; Madrid, Spain; Brussels, Belgium; Monheim, Germany; London, United Kingdom; Birmingham, United Kingdom
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Zilucoplan (complement C5 inhibitor) and rozanolixizumab (neonatal Fc receptor blocker) are targeted treatments for generalized MG (gMG) which showed efficacy in randomized-controlled trials (RCTs). However, real-world evidence (RWE) on outcomes and patient experience remains limited. OBJECTIVE: To characterize real-world outcomes in adults with gMG initiating zilucoplan or rozanolixizumab. METHODS: The Vitaccess REAL MG (VRMG) REALITY studies employ a registry-based concurrent embedded mixed-methods design. Quantitative retrospective longitudinal cohorts are derived from a multi-country VRMG registry, complemented by a nested qualitative enquiry with a stratified random-purposive subset (~20 participants per therapy). Patient-reported outcomes (PROs) with clinician and electronic medical record data are integrated with semi-structured online interviews to explore treatment experience. The primary outcome is change from baseline (CFB) in MG Activities of Daily Living total score; secondary outcomes include CFB in health-related quality of life (MG Quality of Life 15- Revised) and fatigue (MG Symptoms PRO Physical Fatigue Scale; Quality of Life in Neurological Disorders Short Form – Fatigue) total scores, treatment utilization, oral corticosteroid, non-steroidal immunosuppressive therapy and rescue therapy utilization, and healthcare resource utilization. PROs will be evaluated over the 12- month follow-up, while additional outcomes will be assessed at 6 and 12 months, using descriptive statistics and mixed models to account for repeated measurements. Qualitative data will undergo thematic analysis and be integrated to contextualize quantitative findings. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: By embedding a qualitative enquiry within the VRMG registry, this integrated mixed- methods design captures patient experience and longitudinal outcomes, extending RWE beyond RCTs on the use of zilucoplan and rozanolixizumab in routine care.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Zilucoplan（补体C5抑制剂）和rozanolixizumab（新生儿Fc受体阻断剂）是全身型MG（gMG）的靶向治疗药物，已在随机对照试验（RCT）中显示疗效。然而，关于结局和患者体验的真实世界证据（RWE）仍然有限。目的：描述开始使用zilucoplan或rozanolixizumab的gMG成人患者的真实世界结局。方法：Vitaccess REAL MG（VRMG）REALITY研究采用基于注册登记的同期嵌入式混合方法设计。定量回顾性纵向队列来源于多国VRMG注册登记，并辅以嵌套定性研究，采用分层随机-目的性抽样亚组（每种治疗约20名参与者）。患者报告结局（PROs）与临床医生和电子病历数据相结合，并与半结构化在线访谈整合，以探讨治疗体验。主要结局为MG日常生活活动量表总分较基线的变化（CFB）；次要结局包括健康相关生活质量（MG生活质量15-修订版）和疲劳（MG症状PRO躯体疲劳量表；神经疾病生活质量短表-疲劳）总分较基线的变化、治疗利用、口服糖皮质激素、非甾体免疫抑制治疗和挽救治疗利用以及医疗资源利用。PROs将在12个月随访期内评估，其他结局将在6个月和12个月时评估，使用描述性统计和混合模型处理重复测量。定性数据将进行主题分析并整合，以对定量发现进行情境化解释。总结/结论：通过在VRMG注册登记中嵌入定性研究，这种整合混合方法设计捕捉患者体验和纵向结局，将zilucoplan和rozanolixizumab在常规诊疗中使用的RWE扩展到RCT之外。

abstracts.title: Rituximab in acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive generalised myasthenia gravis: A single-centre experience
abstracts.authors: M. Noushad; C. Allen; A. Pinto; F. Fatehi; G. Burke Wessex Neuroscience Centre, Plymouth, UK
abstracts.abstract: Background and Aims: This study evaluated the effective- ness of rituximab in acetylcholine receptor antibody (AChR- Ab)-positive generalised myasthenia gravis (MG) patients with explosive onset, steroid intolerance, or treatment resistance at Wessex Neurological Centre (2018–2025). Methods: Retrospective analysis of 40 AChR-Ab-positive gen- eralised MG patients (mean age 60 ± 17 years; 58% male; mean baseline Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living [MG- ADL] 10 ± 6, Myasthenia Gravis Composite [MGC] 15 ± 9) re- ceiving rituximab (median initial dose 2000 mg). Outcomes included MG-ADL/MGC at baseline and 3–24 months, CD19 B-cell counts, IgG, prednisolone dose. Repeated-measures ANOVA assessed changes; McNemar tests compared pre/post RTX hospitalisations/plasmapheresis; p < 0.05 significant (JASP software). Results: MG-ADL (F(6,54) = 4.67, p = 0.001) and MGC (F(6,42) = 3.68, p = 0.005) improved significantly over time, though post-hoc pairwise differences were non-significant after Bonferroni correction. CD19 counts depleted markedly (F(6,12) = 10.71, p = 0.001); Rituximab led to clinically mean- ingful improvement, with 71% of patients achieving MCID (≥2- point MG-ADL and ≥3-point MGC reduction) at one or more visits, alongside sustained B-cell depletion and reduced rescue FIGURE 1 GDMT compliance. FIGURE 1 MG ADL reduction. FIGURE 2 MGC reduction. therapies. IgG remained stable (p = 0.93). Prednisolone dose re- duced (F(6,42) = 5.49, p = 0.001). Hospital admissions dropped from 47.5% to 20% pre/post RTX (p = 0.013); plasmapheresis from 50% to 25% (p = 0.021). No serious adverse events with RTX. Conclusion: Rituximab achieved sustained B-cell depletion, clinical improvement, and reduced rescue therapies/steroids in refractory AChR-MG without impacting IgG, supporting its role in difficult-to-treat cases.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：本研究评估了在Wessex神经中心（2018-2025年）使用利妥昔单抗治疗爆发性起病、类固醇不耐受或治疗抵抗的乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性全身型重症肌无力患者的有效性。方法：对40例AChR-Ab阳性全身型MG患者（平均年龄60±17岁；58%为男性；平均基线MG-ADL 10±6，MGC 15±9）接受利妥昔单抗（中位初始剂量2000 mg）进行回顾性分析。结局包括基线及3-24个月的MG-ADL/MGC、CD19 B细胞计数、IgG、泼尼松龙剂量。采用重复测量方差分析评估变化；McNemar检验比较RTX前后住院/血浆置换情况；p<0.05为显著性（JASP软件）。结果：MG-ADL（F(6,54)=4.67，p=0.001）和MGC（F(6,42)=3.68，p=0.005）随时间显著改善，但Bonferroni校正后事后两两差异不显著。CD19计数显著耗竭（F(6,12)=10.71，p=0.001）；利妥昔单抗带来临床有意义的改善，71%的患者在一次或多次访视中达到MCID（MG-ADL降低≥2分且MGC降低≥3分），同时伴有持续的B细胞耗竭和挽救治疗的减少。IgG保持稳定（p=0.93）。泼尼松龙剂量降低（F(6,42)=5.49，p=0.001）。RTX前后住院率从47.5%降至20%（p=0.013）；血浆置换从50%降至25%（p=0.021）。RTX无严重不良事件。结论：利妥昔单抗在难治性AChR-MG中实现了持续的B细胞耗竭、临床改善以及挽救治疗/类固醇的减少，且不影响IgG，支持其在难治病例中的作用。

abstracts.title: A Real-world Cohort of Patients With Myasthenia Gravis: The PPD™ CorEvitas™ Myasthenia Gravis Registry
abstracts.authors: Benatar, Michael; Middaugh, Nicole; Margolin, Zachary; Tremlett, Emily; Wertz, Debra; Wahl, Peter; Howard, James
abstracts.affiliations: University of Miami, Miami, FL; Thermo Fisher Scientific, MA; The University of North Carolina, Dept of Neurology, CB 7025, Chapel Hill, NC
abstracts.abstract: Objective: The PPD™ CorEvitas™ Myasthenia Gravis (MG) Registry was launched in October 2025 to evaluate long-term real-world safety and effectiveness of treatments for MG. Background: Autoimmune MG, a rare disorder of the neuromuscular junction, manifests with fluctuating muscle weakness and fatigue, impairing daily function and quality of life (1, 2). In 2021, the estimated incidence and prevalence of MG in the US were 3.1 and 37 per 100,000 persons, respectively, and are increasing (4). Recently approved medications for MG have demonstrated significant improvements in patient function and disease activity in the context of randomized clinical trials. Real-world evidence is critical to understanding longer-term safety and effectiveness of treatments. Design/Methods: The CorEvitas MG Registry is a prospective, observational cohort for adult patients with ocular and generalized forms of MG under the care of a neurologist in the US. Longitudinal data are collected from both patients and their treating physicians during routine clinical encounters under a structured and standardized data collection protocol. Patients may enroll if they start an enrollment-eligible medication non-steroidal immunosuppressants, complement inhibitors, neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn) inhibitors, or B-cell depleting agents at or within 12 months from enrollment. Results: Initial size of the registry site network will comprise ~50 US neurological practices, though there is no defined upper or lower limit on the number of patients or sites expected to participate. Data collected from patients and providers will include sociodemographic and lifestyle factors, prevalent and incident comorbidities/adverse events, disease activity measures (i.e. MG Composite [MGC], MG Impairment Index [MGII]) and validated patient-reported outcomes (MGQoL-15r, MG-ADL), exacerbations and crisis, and medication utilization. Conclusions: The CorEvitas MG Registry will provide a rich source of data for examining the real-world comparative effectiveness and safety of recently approved and standard of care therapies as the treatment landscape for MG continues to evolve.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：PPD™ CorEvitas™ 重症肌无力（MG）注册研究于2025年10月启动，旨在评估MG治疗药物的长期真实世界安全性和有效性。背景：自身免疫性MG是一种罕见的神经肌肉接头疾病，表现为波动性肌无力和疲劳，损害日常功能和生活质量（1,2）。2021年，美国MG的估计发病率和患病率分别为每10万人3.1例和37例，且呈上升趋势（4）。近期获批的MG药物在随机临床试验中显示出患者功能和疾病活动的显著改善。真实世界证据对于了解治疗的长期安全性和有效性至关重要。设计/方法：CorEvitas MG注册研究是一项前瞻性、观察性队列研究，对象为美国神经科医生诊治的成人眼肌型和全身型MG患者。在常规临床就诊期间，按照结构化和标准化的数据收集方案，从患者及其治疗医生处收集纵向数据。患者如果在入组时或入组后12个月内开始使用符合入组条件的药物（非甾体免疫抑制剂、补体抑制剂、新生儿Fc受体抑制剂或B细胞耗竭剂），则可入组。结果：注册研究站点网络的初始规模将包括约50个美国神经科诊所，但参与的患者或站点数量没有设定上限或下限。从患者和医生处收集的数据将包括社会人口学和生活方式因素、常见和新发合并症/不良事件、疾病活动度指标（即MGC、MGII）和经过验证的患者报告结局（MGQoL-15r、MG-ADL）、加重和危象以及药物使用情况。结论：随着MG治疗格局的不断演变，CorEvitas MG注册研究将为检查近期获批和标准治疗的真实世界比较有效性和安全性提供丰富的数据来源。

abstracts.title: Comparing Traditional and Novel Therapies in Myasthenia Gravis: A Single-center Observational Study
abstracts.authors: Yu, Fang; Li, Jin; Zaita, Brittany
abstracts.affiliations: Westchester Medical Center, Valhalla, NY; Westchester Medical Center, NY; Westchester Medical Center, Middletown, NY
abstracts.abstract: Objective: This study retrospectively evaluates the clinical outcomes of MG patients treated with traditional versus novel therapies. Background: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is a neurological autoimmune disorder affecting neuromuscular transmission. The advent of novel therapies such as complement inhibitors and FcRn antagonists, has provided additional therapeutic potentials. Design/Methods: A retrospective chart review was performed on MG patients at a single tertiary center. Patient demographics characteristics were collected. Traditional Therapy Group (T) patients received acetylcholinesterase inhibitors, corticosteroids, or immunosuppressants, while Novel Therapy Group (N), had biologics such as Eculizumab (Soliris), Ravulizumab (Ultomiris), Zilucoplan, or Efgartigimod (Vyvgart). Clinical parameters, including MG-ADL score changes, rescue therapy requirements (IVIG/PLEX), ICU admissions, and MG related hospitalizations, were analyzed. Results: A total of 23 patients were included (15 in T group and 8 in N group). The average age of patients: 61.8 (±21.48) (T) vs 59.75 (±20.40) (N) years (p=0.82), comparable sex distribution (p=0.30). The age of disease onset were: 49.75 (±25.41) (T) and 53.25 (±21.63) (N) years (p=0.75), while comparable median disease duration (p=0.21). 4/15 (T) and 1/8 (N) patients were ocular MG subtype (p=0.62). No difference regarding MG specific antibodies (p=0.64) or thymectomy (p=0.67) or MG related crisis (p=0.071). N group had more MG-ADL score improvement: 4.75 (±6.52) vs 0.31(±1.80) points (p=0.0162). Conclusions: Our study suggests that novel therapies may provide better symptom control but remain limited by cost and insurance barriers. Larger studies are needed to evaluate long-term efficacy, safety and cost-effectiveness.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：本研究回顾性评估了接受传统治疗与新型治疗的MG患者的临床结局。背景：重症肌无力是一种影响神经肌肉传递的神经自身免疫性疾病。新型疗法如补体抑制剂和FcRn拮抗剂的出现，提供了额外的治疗潜力。设计/方法：对一家三级医疗中心的MG患者进行回顾性病历审查。收集患者人口学特征。传统治疗组（T）患者接受乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂、皮质类固醇或免疫抑制剂，而新型治疗组（N）患者接受生物制剂如依库珠单抗、瑞武利珠单抗、齐鲁库普兰或艾加莫德。分析了临床参数，包括MG-ADL评分变化、挽救治疗需求（IVIG/PLEX）、ICU入院和MG相关住院。结果：共纳入23例患者（T组15例，N组8例）。患者平均年龄：T组61.8（±21.48）岁 vs N组59.75（±20.40）岁（p=0.82），性别分布相当（p=0.30）。发病年龄：T组49.75（±25.41）岁，N组53.25（±21.63）岁（p=0.75），中位病程相当（p=0.21）。T组4/15例和N组1/8例为眼肌型MG亚型（p=0.62）。MG特异性抗体（p=0.64）、胸腺切除术（p=0.67）或MG相关危象（p=0.071）方面无差异。N组MG-ADL评分改善更多：4.75（±6.52）分 vs 0.31（±1.80）分（p=0.0162）。结论：我们的研究表明，新型疗法可能提供更好的症状控制，但仍受成本和保险障碍的限制。需要更大规模的研究来评估长期疗效、安全性和成本效益。

abstracts.title: Comparing the Safety and Efficacy of Myasthenia Gravis Treatments: A Bayesian Network Meta-analysis Accounting for Inconsistencies in Trial Designs and Populations
abstracts.authors: Roy, Bhaskar; McLaren, Nilay; Zhong, Wayne; Hussain, Sheena; Nowak, Richard
abstracts.affiliations: Yale University, New Haven, CT; Yale School of Medicine, New Haven, CT; Yale School of Medicine, Hamden, CT; Kolkata Medical College, India; Yale University School of Medicine, New Haven, CT
abstracts.abstract: Objective: We compared the efficacy and safety of myasthenia gravis (MG) treatments leveraging a Bayesian hierarchical model accounting for the inconsistencies in trial designs and populations. Background: In the last decade, many novel targeted therapies have shown promise in treating generalized MG; however, no head-to-head prospective studies have compared efficacy and safety between one another, nor to existing therapies. As a viable alternative, we conducted a Bayesian network meta-analysis, designed to account for inconsistencies in study designs and populations. Design/Methods: Twenty-seven trials (publication date range: 1987-2025; placebo n=1,086; treatment n=1,232) reporting change from baseline in MG-Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) or Quantitative MG (QMG) score, targeting B-Cells, neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn), complement activity, CD40, Interleukin-6 signaling, immunoglobulin G, and broadscale immunosuppression were included. Results: QMG scores decreased by an average of -3.6 (95% Credible Interval: [-4.40, -2.72]) points more in patients treated with FcRn inhibitors than those treated with placebo/standard of care, followed by -2.59 [-3.93, -1.27] points for C5 complement inhibitors, and -2.50 [-5.15, 0.13] points for CD19 Depletion. MG-ADL scores decreased by -1.94 [-2.23, -1.67] in patients treated with FcRn inhibitors, -1.89 [-2.95, -0.83] for CD19 Depletion, and -1.78 [-2.43, -1.13] for C5 complement inhibitors. These results remained consistent in sensitivity analyses. In simulations, FcRn inhibitors had a probability of 0.873 of having the greatest QMG treatment effect and 0.834 for MG-ADL. Patients treated with FcRn inhibitors had greater odds of treatment-related adverse events (Odds Ratio: 2.20 [1.52, 3.38]) while C5 complement inhibitors and CD19 depletion showed comparable odds to placebo/standard of care. Conclusions: This meta-analysis cannot substitute randomized trials, but compares the benefits and adverse events of targeted therapies and will help make evidence-based therapeutic choices in MG.

abstracts.sessionName: P11: Neuromuscular and Clinical Neurophysiology (EMG): Myasthenia Gravis Treatments
abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：我们利用贝叶斯分层模型比较了重症肌无力治疗药物的疗效和安全性，该模型考虑了试验设计和人群的不一致性。背景：在过去十年中，许多新型靶向疗法在治疗全身型MG方面显示出前景；然而，尚无头对头前瞻性研究比较它们之间或与现有疗法之间的疗效和安全性。作为可行的替代方案，我们进行了一项贝叶斯网络荟萃分析，旨在解释研究设计和人群的不一致性。设计/方法：纳入了27项试验（发表日期范围：1987-2025年；安慰剂组n=1,086；治疗组n=1,232），报告了MG-ADL或QMG评分相对于基线的变化，靶向B细胞、新生儿Fc受体、补体活性、CD40、白介素-6信号、免疫球蛋白G和广泛免疫抑制。结果：接受FcRn抑制剂治疗的患者QMG评分平均降低-3.6分（95%可信区间：[-4.40, -2.72]），优于安慰剂/标准治疗，其次是C5补体抑制剂（-2.59 [-3.93, -1.27]）和CD19耗竭（-2.50 [-5.15, 0.13]）。接受FcRn抑制剂治疗的患者MG-ADL评分降低-1.94分（[-2.23, -1.67]），CD19耗竭为-1.89（[-2.95, -0.83]），C5补体抑制剂为-1.78（[-2.43, -1.13]）。这些结果在敏感性分析中保持一致。在模拟中，FcRn抑制剂具有最大QMG治疗效应的概率为0.873，MG-ADL为0.834。接受FcRn抑制剂治疗的患者发生治疗相关不良事件的几率更高（比值比：2.20 [1.52, 3.38]），而C5补体抑制剂和CD19耗竭的几率与安慰剂/标准治疗相当。结论：本荟萃分析不能替代随机试验，但比较了靶向治疗的获益和不良事件，将有助于在MG中做出基于证据的治疗选择。

abstracts.title: Concomitant Immunosuppressive Therapy Use With Ravulizumab: Analysis of the Global MG SPOTLIGHT Registry
abstracts.authors: Nowak, Richard; Habib, Ali; Meisel, Andreas; Scheiner, Christopher; Zeinali, Lida; Liu, Chuang; Pulley, Michael; Cutter, Gary; Gordon, Andrew
abstracts.affiliations: Yale University School of Medicine, New Haven, CT; University of California, Irvine, Irvine, CA; Charité Universitätsmedizin Berlin, Berlin, Germany; University of Tennessee Medical Center, Knoxville, TN; Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease, Mississauga, ON, Canada; Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease, Baar, Switzerland; University of Florida Jacksonville, Jacksonville, FL; University of Alabama At Birmingham, Birmingham, AL; Northwest Neurology, Ltd., Lake Barrington, IL
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To describe changes in concomitant immunosuppressive therapy (con-IST) use after ravulizumab initiation among patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in the global MG SPOTLIGHT Registry. Background: High-dose and long-term use of con-ISTs such as oral corticosteroids (OCS) are associated with short- and long-term adverse effects. The global MG SPOTLIGHT Registry (NCT04202341) assesses clinical practice outcomes with ravulizumab and eculizumab in adults with anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive (AChR-Ab+) gMG. Design/Methods: This analysis included patients treated with ravulizumab for ≥6 months with available con-IST (azathioprine, mycophenolate mofetil, intravenous immunoglobulin/plasma exchange, methotrexate, and OCS) data. Descriptive analyses characterized treatment changes after ravulizumab initiation. No adjustment for covariates was performed. Safety was assessed in all patients. Results: As of July 1, 2024, 44 patients fulfilled inclusion criteria for analysis (male: 70.5%; mean±SD age at enrollment: 68.3±13.0 years; mean±SD ravulizumab treatment duration: 1.3±0.8 years). At ravulizumab initiation, 19/44 (43.2%), 13/44 (29.5%), and 1/44 (2.3%) patients were receiving 1, 2, and ≥3 con-ISTs, respectively. Thereafter, 10/33 (30.3%) patients discontinued ≥1 con-IST, with 3/10 (30%) and 8/10 (80%) patients discontinuing within 3 months and 6 months of ravulizumab initiation, respectively. Following ravulizumab treatment, the number of patients receiving ≤5 and ≤10 mg/day OCS increased from 11/26 (42.3%) and 16/26 (61.5%), respectively, to 14/26 (53.8%) and 20/26 (76.9%) 3 months after ravulizumab initiation, and 16/26 (61.5%) and 20/26 (76.9%) 6 months after ravulizumab initiation. Ravulizumab was well tolerated, consistent with previous analyses and clinical trial data. Results with extended follow-up will be presented. Conclusions: Reduced con-IST and OCS burden was observed in patients with AChR-Ab+ gMG treated with ravulizumab in clinical practice, supporting a steroid-sparing role for ravulizumab.
