abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：描述全球MG SPOTLIGHT登记研究中，全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者启动ravulizumab治疗后，伴随免疫抑制治疗（con-IST）使用的变化。背景：高剂量和长期使用伴随免疫抑制治疗（如口服皮质类固醇[OCS]）与短期和长期不良事件相关。全球MG SPOTLIGHT登记研究（NCT04202341）评估了ravulizumab和eculizumab在抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）gMG成人患者中的临床实践结局。设计/方法：本分析纳入了接受ravulizumab治疗≥6个月且具有可用con-IST（硫唑嘌呤、霉酚酸酯、静脉注射免疫球蛋白/血浆置换、甲氨蝶呤和OCS）数据的患者。描述性分析描述了启动ravulizumab后治疗的变化。未进行协变量调整。对所有患者进行了安全性评估。结果：截至2024年7月1日，44名患者符合分析纳入标准（男性：70.5%；入组时平均±SD年龄：68.3±13.0岁；平均±SD ravulizumab治疗持续时间：1.3±0.8年）。在启动ravulizumab时，分别有19/44（43.2%）、13/44（29.5%）和1/44（2.3%）的患者正在接受1种、2种和≥3种con-IST。此后，10/33（30.3%）的患者停用了≥1种con-IST，其中3/10（30%）和8/10（80%）的患者分别在启动ravulizumab后3个月和6个月内停药。在ravulizumab治疗后，接受≤5 mg/天和≤10 mg/天OCS的患者人数从启动ravulizumab时的11/26（42.3%）和16/26（61.5%）分别增加到启动后3个月的14/26（53.8%）和20/26（76.9%），以及启动后6个月的16/26（61.5%）和20/26（76.9%）。Ravulizumab耐受性良好，与既往分析和临床试验数据一致。将呈现延长随访的结果。结论：在临床实践中，接受ravulizumab治疗的AChR-Ab+ gMG患者观察到con-IST和OCS负担减轻，支持ravulizumab的类固醇节约作用。

abstracts.abstract: Objective: To Assess the efficacy and safety of Zilucoplan in generalized myasthenia gravis in the real-life setting. Background: Generalized Myasthenia gravis (gMG) is a rare chronic autoimmune disease affecting the postsynaptic membrane of the neuromuscular junction. New treatment options, such as the C5 inhibitors, are growing with promising results. In this study we investigated the real-world use of Zilucoplan for AChR-positive gMG in Italy. Design/Methods: Zilucoplan was self-administered by daily subcutaneous injections. Efficacy was assessed by Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America Post-intervention status (MGFA-PIS), Myasthenia Gravis Activity of Daily Living (MG-ADL), Myasthenia Gravis Composite (MGC), Myasthenia Gravis quantitative (QMG) scales and 15-items Myasthenia Gravis Quality of Life (MG-QOL-15) questionnaire at baseline and after 1, 4, 12, 24 and 48 weeks. Results: 54 patients (37 females, aged 57.3) received zilucoplan with a mean follow-up of 26.4 weeks. We observed a clinical meaningful and significant reduction of MG-ADL, QMG, MGC and MG-QOL-15 scores from W4 to W12 and sustained at W24 of follow-up. The MG-ADL responder rate was 75.6% at W12 and 82.9% at W24. Minimal symptoms expression (MSE) was obtained in in 55.6% of patients at W48 with a mean reduction of the daily prednisone dose of 8.3 mg at W24. Previous long term IVIg was associated to a better response to MG-ADL at W12 at multivariate analysis. Conclusions: Zilucoplan was well-tolerated and effective in most patients with AChR-positive gMG. A clinical meaningful effect was reported since the first week and was sustained after 24 weeks. Further studies are needed to confirm these preliminary real-life data.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：在真实世界环境中评估Zilucoplan治疗全身型重症肌无力的疗效和安全性。背景：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种罕见的慢性自身免疫性疾病，影响神经肌肉接头的突触后膜。新的治疗选择，如C5抑制剂，正在增长并显示出有希望的结果。在本研究中，我们调查了Zilucoplan在意大利用于AChR阳性gMG的真实世界使用情况。设计/方法：Zilucoplan通过每日皮下注射自行给药。在基线以及第1、4、12、24和48周后，通过美国重症肌无力基金会干预后状态（MGFA-PIS）、重症肌无力日常生活活动（MG-ADL）、重症肌无力复合量表（MGC）、重症肌无力定量（QMG）量表和15项重症肌无力生活质量（MG-QOL-15）问卷评估疗效。结果：54名患者（37名女性，年龄57.3岁）接受了zilucoplan治疗，平均随访时间为26.4周。我们观察到从第4周到第12周，MG-ADL、QMG、MGC和MG-QOL-15评分出现具有临床意义且显著的降低，并在第24周随访时持续。MG-ADL应答率在第12周为75.6%，在第24周为82.9%。在第48周，55.6%的患者达到了最小症状表达（MSE），第24周时每日泼尼松剂量平均减少8.3 mg。在多变量分析中，既往长期IVIg与第12周时更好的MG-ADL反应相关。结论：Zilucoplan在大多数AChR阳性gMG患者中耐受性良好且有效。自第一周起即报告了具有临床意义的效果，并持续至24周后。需要进一步研究来确认这些初步的真实世界数据。

abstracts.abstract: Objective: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of efgartigimod in patients with myasthenia gravis (MG) and to determine whether response differs between AChR-positive and AChR-negative subtypes. Background: MG is an autoimmune neuromuscular disorder caused by IgG antibodies targeting the neuromuscular junction. Efgartigimod, a newly FDA-approved engineered Fc fragment of human IgG1, acts by blocking the neonatal Fc receptor, reducing IgG and pathogenic antibodies. Design/Methods: A comprehensive search was conducted in PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Cochrane CENTRAL databases until September 2025. Studies assessing the efficacy and safety of efgartigimod in MG were included. A random-effects model was used to calculate mean difference (MD) and proportions with corresponding 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Subgroup and sensitivity analyses were conducted. Results: Twenty-nine studies (1649 patients) were included. Overall, 83% of patients achieved clinically meaningful improvement (CMI; ≥ 2-point reduction in MG Activities of Daily Living [MG-ADL] score), and 36% achieved minimal symptom expression (MSE; MG-ADL score of 0 or 1) with no significant difference between AChR-positive and AChR-negative subtypes. MG-ADL score significantly decreased from baseline (MD: -4.3 points, 95% CI: -4.99 to -3.61), with no difference between the MG subtypes. Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis score (QMG; MD: -3.6 points, 95% CI: -4.28 to -2.91), Myasthenia Gravis Quality of Life 15-item revised scale (MG-QoL15r; MD: -5.57 points, 95% CI: -6.7 to -4.24), IgG levels (MD: -4.5 gram/litre, 95% CI: -7.02 to -1.99), and corticosteroid use (MD: -6.74 milligram/day, 95% CI: -9.4 to -4.09) showed significant reductions in the AChR-positive subtype, however, these outcomes were not reported in AChR-negative subtype. Serious Adverse events were reported in 6.5% of patients. Conclusions: Efgartigimod significantly improved clinical symptoms and quality of life in MG patients with no difference between subtypes. Further studies directly comparing efgartigimod with other interventions are needed, regardless of antibody subtype.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：评估efgartigimod在重症肌无力（MG）患者中的疗效和安全性，并确定AChR阳性和AChR阴性亚型之间的反应是否存在差异。背景：MG是一种由靶向神经肌肉接头的IgG抗体引起的自身免疫性神经肌肉疾病。Efgartigimod是一种新近FDA批准的、源自人IgG1的工程化Fc片段，通过阻断新生儿Fc受体，减少IgG和致病性抗体。设计/方法：在PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Cochrane CENTRAL数据库中进行了截至2025年9月的全面检索。纳入了评估efgartigimod在MG中疗效和安全性的研究。使用随机效应模型计算平均差（MD）和比例及其相应的95%置信区间（CI）。进行了亚组和敏感性分析。结果：纳入了29项研究（1649名患者）。总体而言，83%的患者实现了具有临床意义的改善（CMI；MG日常生活活动[MG-ADL]评分降低≥2分），36%的患者达到了最小症状表达（MSE；MG-ADL评分为0或1），AChR阳性和AChR阴性亚型之间无显著差异。MG-ADL评分较基线显著下降（MD：-4.3分，95% CI：-4.99至-3.61），MG亚型之间无差异。在AChR阳性亚型中，重症肌无力定量评分（QMG；MD：-3.6分，95% CI：-4.28至-2.91）、重症肌无力生活质量15项修订量表（MG-QoL15r；MD：-5.57分，95% CI：-6.7至-4.24）、IgG水平（MD：-4.5克/升，95% CI：-7.02至-1.99）和皮质类固醇使用量（MD：-6.74毫克/天，95% CI：-9.4至-4.09）均显示出显著降低，然而，这些结果在AChR阴性亚型中未报告。6.5%的患者报告了严重不良事件。结论：Efgartigimod显著改善了MG患者的临床症状和生活质量，亚型之间无差异。需要进一步研究直接比较efgartigimod与其他干预措施，无论抗体亚型如何。

abstracts.title: FcRn Inhibitors in gMG: Leveraging Continuing Education to Bridge Gaps in Clinical Practice
abstracts.authors: Hegde, Bharati; Scavone, Jillian; Scully, Emily; Rose, Kristin; Robinson, Katie

abstracts.abstract: Objective: To improve neurology clinicians’ knowledge, confidence, and behaviors in evaluating generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) disease severity and integrating targeted treatments such as neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn) inhibitors into clinical decision-making. Background: Many neurology clinicians face challenges in accurately assessing disease burden and optimizing treatment regimens for patients with gMG. Timely education is critical to ensure they are prepared to incorporate novel FcRn inhibitors into practice. Design/Methods: In February 2025, a live virtual continuing education (CE) webinar was provided, with live faculty moderation and question-and-answer sessions. The enduring version of the webinar will remain available through March 25, 2026. Pre- and post-test assessments were used to quantify the impact of education. Results: A total of 206 neurology clinicians participated in the education. Clinicians demonstrated limited baseline knowledge across all topics. Regarding assessment, 67% lacked knowledge of tools for gMG assessment and 62% were unfamiliar with the mechanisms of action of FcRn inhibitors. Of note, although 59% of clinicians assessed disease burden before determining treatment options, only 39% evaluated gMG antibody subtype. Baseline awareness of FcRn inhibitors was limited, with only 13% and 25% familiar with clinical evidence of nipocalimab efficacy and rozanolixizumab indication, respectively. These gaps translated into underuse in practice, with 44% of clinicians prescribing complement inhibitors but only 25% reporting experience with FcRn inhibitors. However, post-learning, clinicians were 30% more likely to consider the clinical evidence of FcRn inhibitors when making treatment decisions. Overall knowledge increased by 51%, with 88% of clinicians expressing greater confidence in managing gMG. Conclusions: This CE initiative revealed critical gaps in gMG management, particularly in disease assessment and familiarity with FcRn inhibitors. Education significantly improved neurology clinicians’ knowledge and confidence to integrate FcRn inhibitors into treatment decision-making, supporting more informed and personalized patient care.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：提高神经科临床医生在评估全身型重症肌无力（gMG）疾病严重程度以及将靶向治疗（如新生儿Fc受体[FcRn]抑制剂）整合到临床决策中的知识、信心和行为。背景：许多神经科临床医生在准确评估疾病负担和优化gMG患者治疗方案方面面临挑战。及时的教育对于确保他们准备好将新型FcRn抑制剂应用于实践至关重要。设计/方法：2025年2月，提供了一次现场虚拟继续教育（CE）网络研讨会，设有现场教师主持和问答环节。该网络研讨会的长期版本将持续开放至2026年3月25日。使用前后测试评估来量化教育的影响。结果：共有206名神经科临床医生参与了此次教育。临床医生在所有主题上的基线知识均有限。关于评估，67%的医生缺乏gMG评估工具的知识，62%不熟悉FcRn抑制剂的作用机制。值得注意的是，尽管59%的临床医生在确定治疗方案前评估了疾病负担，但只有39%评估了gMG抗体亚型。对FcRn抑制剂的基线认知有限，分别只有13%和25%的医生熟悉nipocalimab疗效和rozanolixizumab适应症的临床证据。这些差距转化为实践中的使用不足，44%的临床医生处方过补体抑制剂，但只有25%报告有使用FcRn抑制剂的经验。然而，学习后，临床医生在制定治疗决策时考虑FcRn抑制剂临床证据的可能性增加了30%。总体知识提高了51%，88%的临床医生表示在管理gMG方面更有信心。结论：这项CE计划揭示了gMG管理中的关键差距，特别是在疾病评估和对FcRn抑制剂的熟悉程度方面。教育显著提高了神经科临床医生将FcRn抑制剂整合到治疗决策中的知识和信心，支持更知情和个性化的患者护理。

abstracts.abstract: Objective: This retrospective cohort study aimed to delineate disease trajectories, antibody subtypes, and long-term outcomes in a large French Myasthenia gravis (MG) cohort. Background: MG is a heterogeneous autoimmune disorder with variable phenotypes and outcomes. Real-world studies are still scarce, especially regarding the trajectories of generalized, ocular, and seronegative cases in the era of new targeted therapies. Design/Methods: We retrospectively analyzed 119 MG patients followed over 18 year at the Mondor University Hospital neuromuscular reference center. Demographics, clinical, antibody status, thymic pathology, treatment patterns, and long-term outcome were collected. Outcomes included generalization, relapse, remission, and mortality. Kaplan-Meier, Cox regression, and logistic regression identified predictors. Results: The cohort included 77% (N= 92) anti-AChR, 5% (N=6) anti-MuSK, and 17.6% (N=21) seronegative patients. Generalized MG accounted 76% (N=90), ocular MG 24% (N=29). Relapses occurred in 72% (N=86). About half of ocular MG later generalized, often after two years, with higher generalization risk in female and late-onset MG. Severity at diagnosis and of the first relapse independently predicted long-term burden. Remission (MGFA 0–I) was achieved in 42% (N=50), more frequently in ocular and relapses-free patients. Seronegative patients had longer relapse-free intervals and a higher proportion of sustained ocular disease. At last follow-up, 31% (N=37) used anticholinesterase monotherapy, 62% (N=74) received corticosteroids (45% discontinued, N=33), and 80% (N=95) received azathioprine or mycophenolate. Rituximab, FcRn and complement inhibitors were used in 15% (N=18). Mortality was comparable to the general population. Conclusions: Early disease severity and occurrence of the first relapse were strong predictors of long-term outcomes in MG, underscoring the importance of early, risk-adapted management. Ongoing vigilance for generalization remains essential, particularly in ocular-onset and elderly-onset cases. In this real-world cohort, both conventional therapies and newer agents targeting FcRn or complement pathways were associated with high remission rates and facilitated corticosteroid tapering.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：这项回顾性队列研究旨在描述一个大型法国重症肌无力（MG）队列的疾病轨迹、抗体亚型和长期结局。背景：MG是一种异质性自身免疫性疾病，具有不同的表型和结局。在新型靶向治疗时代，关于全身型、眼肌型和血清阴性病例轨迹的真实世界研究仍然很少。设计/方法：我们回顾性分析了在蒙多尔大学医院神经肌肉参考中心随访超过18年的119例MG患者。收集了人口统计学、临床特征、抗体状态、胸腺病理、治疗模式和长期结局。结局包括全身化、复发、缓解和死亡率。采用Kaplan-Meier、Cox回归和逻辑回归确定预测因素。结果：队列包括77%（N=92）抗AChR抗体阳性、5%（N=6）抗MuSK抗体阳性和17.6%（N=21）血清阴性患者。全身型MG占76%（N=90），眼肌型MG占24%（N=29）。复发发生率为72%（N=86）。约一半的眼肌型MG后来发生全身化，通常在两年后，女性和晚发型MG的全身化风险更高。诊断时的严重程度和首次复发的严重程度独立预测长期负担。42%（N=50）的患者达到缓解（MGFA 0–I级），在眼肌型和无复发患者中更常见。血清阴性患者的无复发间隔更长，且持续性眼肌型疾病的比例更高。在最后一次随访时，31%（N=37）使用抗胆碱酯酶单药治疗，62%（N=74）接受皮质类固醇治疗（45%停药，N=33），80%（N=95）接受硫唑嘌呤或霉酚酸酯治疗。15%（N=18）使用了利妥昔单抗、FcRn和补体抑制剂。死亡率与一般人群相当。结论：早期疾病严重程度和首次复发的发生是MG长期结局的强预测因素，强调了早期、风险适应性管理的重要性。对全身化的持续警惕仍然至关重要，尤其是在眼肌型起病和老年起病的病例中。在这个真实世界队列中，传统疗法和靶向FcRn或补体通路的新型药物均与高缓解率相关，并有助于皮质类固醇减量。

abstracts.abstract: Objective: To determine outcomes in people with myasthenia gravis (pwMG) after exposure to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) for comorbid oncologic indications Background: ICIs are associated with immune-related adverse events (irAEs) including de novo myasthenia gravis and exacerbation of pre-existing autoimmune diseases. Design/Methods: PwMG treated with ICIs for comorbid oncologic indications were identified by systematic retrospective chart review at 17 tertiary medical centers and outcomes were obtained using a structured data instrument. Results: We identified 38 individuals (68% male; 16 AChR+, 1 MuSK+, 6 seronegative, and 8 unknown antibody status) with pre-existing MG who were treated with ICIs. Median age at time of ICI initiation was 75 years old. Fifteen pwMG (40%; 13 AChR+, 1 MuSK+, and 2 unknown) were diagnosed with a post-ICI MG exacerbation with a median onset of 63 days from first ICI dose. All MG exacerbations occurred while patients were on ICI therapy. Six MG exacerbations resolved with outpatient treatment; 7 resolved after treatment requiring hospital admission, including 3 ICU admissions and 1 intubation; and 2 ended with death. Three of the 7 patients with outpatient MG exacerbations were continued/restarted on ICI subsequently without further MG exacerbations. Myositis and myocarditis co-occurred with MG exacerbation in 4 and 3 patients, respectively. Both deaths associated with post-ICI MG exacerbations had concomitant myositis, one also with myocarditis. Fourteen pwMG (37%) were continued on MG immune therapies (azathioprine, mycophenolate, rituximab, or corticosteroids) after ICI initiation including 7 individuals who developed MG exacerbations. Excluding myositis and myocarditis, 2 pwMG (5.2%) had non-MG neurologic irAEs and 10 (26%) had non-neurologic irAEs. Seven subjects (18%) had full remission of their cancer at time of chart review. Conclusions: In this retrospective cohort study of individuals with pre-existing MG, MG exacerbations following ICI treatment for comorbid cancer were common and, in some patients, associated with myositis, myocarditis, and severe clinical outcomes.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：确定既往患有重症肌无力（pwMG）的患者在因合并肿瘤适应症暴露于免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）后的结局。背景：ICIs与免疫相关不良事件（irAEs）相关，包括新发重症肌无力和既往自身免疫性疾病的加重。设计/方法：通过系统回顾性病历审查，在17个三级医疗中心确定了因合并肿瘤适应症接受ICIs治疗的pwMG患者，并使用结构化数据工具获取结局。结果：我们确定了38名既往患有MG并接受ICIs治疗的个体（68%为男性；16名AChR抗体阳性，1名MuSK抗体阳性，6名血清阴性，8名抗体状态未知）。开始ICIs治疗时的中位年龄为75岁。15名pwMG（40%；13名AChR抗体阳性，1名MuSK抗体阳性，2名未知）被诊断为ICI后MG加重，中位发病时间为首次ICI剂量后63天。所有MG加重均发生在患者接受ICI治疗期间。6例MG加重经门诊治疗缓解；7例在需要住院的治疗后缓解，包括3例入住ICU和1例插管；2例以死亡告终。7名门诊MG加重患者中有3名随后继续/重新开始ICI治疗，未出现进一步的MG加重。肌炎和心肌炎分别与4名和3名患者的MG加重同时发生。两例与ICI后MG加重相关的死亡均伴有肌炎，其中一例还伴有心肌炎。14名pwMG（37%）在开始ICI治疗后继续接受MG免疫治疗（硫唑嘌呤、霉酚酸酯、利妥昔单抗或皮质类固醇），其中包括7名发生MG加重的个体。排除肌炎和心肌炎，2名pwMG（5.2%）出现非MG的神经性irAEs，10名（26%）出现非神经性irAEs。在病历审查时，7名受试者（18%）的癌症完全缓解。结论：在这项针对既往患有MG的个体的回顾性队列研究中，ICI治疗合并癌症后MG加重很常见，并且在部分患者中与肌炎、心肌炎和严重的临床结局相关。

abstracts.authors: Snook, Riley; Blackowicz, Michael; Weiskopf, Emma; Fogarty, Dan; Arora, Neha; Govindarajan, Raghav
abstracts.affiliations: Indiana University Health, Carmel, IN; Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease, Sharon, MA; Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease, MA; Definitive Healthcare LLC, Framingham, MA; HSHS St. Elizabeth Medical Group, O'Fallon, IL
abstracts.abstract: Objective: This study aims to present real-world evidence demonstrating the impact of both ravulizumab and efgartigimod on gMG-related healthcare resource utilization in patients initiating treatment within 2 years of diagnosis. Background: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is an autoimmune neuromuscular disorder characterized by fatigable muscle weakness. Suboptimally treated gMG can result in clinical deterioration, hospitalizations, and increased healthcare resource utilization. Ravulizumab, a complement C5 inhibitor, and efgartigimod, an FCRn inhibitor, are US FDA-approved therapies for anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody positive gMG. Design/Methods: Patients initiating ravulizumab or efgartigimod within 2 years of diagnosis were identified in Atlas (Definitive Healthcare), a hybrid open/closed US claims database set between 01/2017 to 12/2024. Patients had ≥1 year of continuous follow-up before and after initiation. The study compared hospitalizations and other healthcare resource utilization before and after initiation of ravulizumab or efgartigimod. Results: There were 114 ravulizumab patients and 639 efgartigimod patients who met the inclusion criteria. Initiators of ravulizumab within 2 years of diagnosis experienced an 81% (IRR=0.19; 95% CI: 0.12, 0.30; p<0.001) reduction in all-cause hospitalization compared to a 32% reduction (IRR=0.68; 95% CI: 0.53, 0.87; p=0.002) in early initiators of efgartigimod (p comparison <0.001). Similar trends observed for other healthcare resource endpoints will additionally be reported. Conclusions: Patients who initiated ravulizumab or efgartigimod within 2 years of diagnosis had significant reductions in healthcare resource utilization. However, those who started on ravulizumab had statistically significantly greater reduction. Timely initiation of potentially disease-modifying targeted treatments, such as C5 inhibitor therapy, may have implications for reducing healthcare resource utilization in patients with gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：本研究旨在提供真实世界证据，证明在诊断后2年内开始治疗的ravulizumab和efgartigimod对全身型重症肌无力（gMG）相关医疗资源利用的影响。背景：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种以波动性肌肉无力为特征的自身免疫性神经肌肉疾病。治疗欠佳的gMG可能导致临床恶化、住院和医疗资源利用增加。Ravulizumab（一种补体C5抑制剂）和efgartigimod（一种FcRn抑制剂）是美国FDA批准用于治疗抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性gMG的药物。设计/方法：在Atlas（Definitive Healthcare）数据库中识别了在诊断后2年内开始使用ravulizumab或efgartigimod的患者，该数据库是一个混合开放/封闭的美国索赔数据库，时间范围为2017年1月至2024年12月。患者在开始治疗前后均有≥1年的连续随访。研究比较了开始使用ravulizumab或efgartigimod前后的住院情况和其他医疗资源利用。结果：有114名ravulizumab患者和639名efgartigimod患者符合纳入标准。在诊断后2年内开始使用ravulizumab的患者，全因住院率降低了81%（IRR=0.19；95% CI: 0.12, 0.30；p<0.001），而早期开始使用efgartigimod的患者降低了32%（IRR=0.68；95% CI: 0.53, 0.87；p=0.002）（组间比较p<0.001）。其他医疗资源利用终点的类似趋势将另行报告。结论：在诊断后2年内开始使用ravulizumab或efgartigimod的患者，其医疗资源利用显著减少。然而，开始使用ravulizumab的患者减少幅度在统计学上显著更大。及时启动可能具有疾病修饰作用的靶向治疗，如C5抑制剂治疗，可能对减少gMG患者的医疗资源利用具有重要意义。

abstracts.title: KITE-363: An Autologous Anti-CD19/CD20 CAR-T Product for the Treatment of Neuroinflammatory Autoimmune Diseases
abstracts.authors: Lowe, Christine; Kim, Brian; Flores, Francisco; Margaitis, Jeremy; Calo, Alessandro; Konecny, Anna; Jaghatspanyan, Eva; Yoder, Sean; Ertel, Kenneth; Filosto, Simone; Murakami, Jodi; Barrett, David
abstracts.affiliations: Kite Pharma, Santa Monica, CA; Kite Pharma, CA
abstracts.abstract: Objective: This preclinical study evaluated KITE-363, a dual-targeting anti-CD19/CD20 CAR T-cell therapy in patients with myasthenia gravis (MG) or multiple sclerosis (MS). Background: B-cells drive pathogenesis of neuroinflammatory autoimmune diseases through several key mechanisms. B-cell depleting agents, including chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cells, have demonstrated potential for reestablishing immune tolerance and achieving rapid, durable remission. Dual-targeting of CD19 and CD20, variably expressed during B-cell maturation, may enhance efficacy over single-antigen approaches. Moreover, eliminating potentially pathogenic CD20 + T-cells and NK-cells may offer additional therapeutic benefits in autoimmune diseases. KITE-363 is an anti-CD19/CD20 CAR T-cell therapy incorporating both CD28 and 41BB costimulatory domains and is currently in Phase 1 clinical trials for relapsed/refractory B-cell lymphoma (NCT04989803) and refractory rheumatic autoimmune diseases (NCT07038447). Design/Methods: CD19 and CD20 expression on B-cells and T-cells from patients with MG or MS was analyzed by flow cytometry. Patient-derived anti-CD19/CD20 CAR T-cell products (KITE-363) were generated using a bicistronic lentiviral vector encoding anti-CD19 CAR (FMC63-CD28ζ) and anti-CD20 CAR (CD20-41BBζ). Immunophenotyping and in vitro functional assessments were performed. Results: In patients with MG or MS, most B-cells variably expressed both antigens (CD19 + CD20 +). Single-antigen positive CD19 + CD20 – plasmablasts, CD19 – CD20 + double negative (IgD – CD27 –) B-cells, CD20 + T-cells, and NK-cells were also detected. Patient-derived KITE-363 products exhibited high expression of both CARs. Antigen-specific functionality was demonstrated through cytokine secretion, proliferation, and cytotoxicity against CD19 + and/or CD20 + cell lines, autologous B-cells, and T-cells. Conclusions: Highly variable CD19 and CD20 expression on B-cell subsets and potent antigen-specific depletion of B-cells and CD20 + T-cells provide robust evidence for clinical development of KITE-363 in B-cell-mediated neuroinflammatory diseases. KITE-363 aims to comprehensively eliminate pathogenic B-cells and other immune cells with dual-antigen CD19/CD20 targeting and optimized co-stimulation to achieve durable, drug-free remission. A Phase 1 study is underway to evaluate the safety and efficacy of KITE-363 in refractory autoimmune neuroinflammatory diseases.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：这项临床前研究评估了KITE-363，一种双靶向抗CD19/CD20 CAR T细胞疗法，用于重症肌无力（MG）或多发性硬化（MS）患者。背景：B细胞通过几种关键机制驱动神经炎症性自身免疫性疾病的发病机制。B细胞耗竭剂，包括嵌合抗原受体（CAR）T细胞，已显示出在重建免疫耐受和实现快速、持久缓解方面的潜力。双靶向在B细胞成熟过程中表达可变的CD19和CD20，可能比单抗原方法提高疗效。此外，消除可能致病的CD20+ T细胞和NK细胞可能为自身免疫性疾病提供额外的治疗益处。KITE-363是一种抗CD19/CD20 CAR T细胞疗法，包含CD28和41BB共刺激结构域，目前正在进行针对复发/难治性B细胞淋巴瘤（NCT04989803）和难治性风湿性自身免疫性疾病（NCT07038447）的1期临床试验。设计/方法：通过流式细胞术分析MG或MS患者B细胞和T细胞上CD19和CD20的表达。使用编码抗CD19 CAR（FMC63-CD28ζ）和抗CD20 CAR（CD20-41BBζ）的双顺反子慢病毒载体生成患者来源的抗CD19/CD20 CAR T细胞产品（KITE-363）。进行了免疫表型分析和体外功能评估。结果：在MG或MS患者中，大多数B细胞可变地表达两种抗原（CD19+ CD20+）。还检测到单抗原阳性的CD19+ CD20-浆母细胞、CD19- CD20+双阴性（IgD- CD27-）B细胞、CD20+ T细胞和NK细胞。患者来源的KITE-363产品表现出两种CAR的高表达。通过针对CD19+和/或CD20+细胞系、自体B细胞和T细胞的细胞因子分泌、增殖和细胞毒性，证明了抗原特异性功能。结论：B细胞亚群上高度可变的CD19和CD20表达以及有效的抗原特异性B细胞和CD20+ T细胞耗竭，为KITE-363在B细胞介导的神经炎症性疾病中的临床开发提供了强有力的证据。KITE-363旨在通过双抗原CD19/CD20靶向和优化的共刺激全面消除致病性B细胞和其他免疫细胞，以实现持久的、无药物的缓解。一项1期研究正在进行中，以评估KITE-363在难治性自身免疫性神经炎症性疾病中的安全性和有效性。

abstracts.title: Long-term Safety and Efficacy of Subcutaneous Efgartigimod PH20 in Adult Participants With Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Final Results of the ADAPT-SC+ Study
abstracts.authors: Bhavaraju-Sanka, Ratna; Antozzi, Carlo; De Bleecker, Jan; Huang, Wan-Yi; Jimenez, Rosa; Verhamme, Fien; Liu, Li; Korobko, Denis; Meisel, Andreas; Utsugisawa, Kimiaki; Vu, Tuan; Wiendl, Heinz; Howard, James
abstracts.affiliations: University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio, TX; Fondazione IRCCS Istituto Neurologico Carlo Besta, Italy; Ghent University Hospital, Belgium; argenx, Belgium; State Budgetary Healthcare Institution of Novosibirsk Region "The State Novosibirsk Regional Clinical Hospital", Russian Federation; Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin, Germany; Hanamaki General Hospital, Japan; University of South Florida Morsani College of Medicine, FL; Institute of Translational Neurology, University Hospital Münster, Germany; The University of North Carolina, NC
abstracts.abstract: Objective: ADAPT-SC+ evaluated long-term safety and efficacy of subcutaneous (SC) efgartigimod PH20 (coformulated with recombinant human hyaluronidase PH20) in participants with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). Background: Efgartigimod, a human immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) Fc fragment, reduces IgG levels (including pathogenic autoantibodies) through neonatal Fc receptor blockade. During ADAPT-SC, efgartigimod PH20 SC demonstrated noninferior total IgG reduction to intravenous (IV) efgartigimod in participants with gMG. Participants completing ADAPT-SC or enrolled in ADAPT+ (efgartigimod IV open-label extension [OLE]) could enter the ADAPT-SC+ OLE study. Design/Methods: Efgartigimod PH20 SC 1000 mg was administered in cycles of 4 once-weekly injections. Subsequent cycles were initiated based on clinical evaluation (Year 1, ≥4 weeks between cycles; Year 2 and onward, ≥1 week between cycles following protocol amendment). Safety was assessed using incidence and severity of adverse events. Clinical efficacy was assessed using Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) scores. Results: During ADAPT-SC+, 180 participants received ≥1 efgartigimod PH20 SC injection (mean [SD] study duration, 2.6 [0.9] years; 459.4 participant years of follow-up). Adverse events were predominantly mild/moderate. Injection site reactions were mild/moderate, did not lead to discontinuation, and decreased in incidence with subsequent cycles. Efgartigimod remained well tolerated in participants whose cycle intervals shortened after Year 1. MG-ADL total score improvements in anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody–positive (AChR-Ab+) participants were observed by Week 1 and sustained through Week 163. 59.2% of AChR-Ab+ participants achieved minimal symptom expression (MG-ADL score, 0-1) at any time. Sustained improvements in quality-of-life measures were observed. Conclusions: Long-term treatment with efgartigimod PH20 SC was well tolerated and efficacious.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：ADAPT-SC+评估了皮下注射（SC）efgartigimod PH20（与重组人透明质酸酶PH20共同配制）在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）参与者中的长期安全性和有效性。背景：Efgartigimod是一种人免疫球蛋白G1（IgG1）Fc片段，通过新生儿Fc受体阻断降低IgG水平（包括致病性自身抗体）。在ADAPT-SC期间，efgartigimod PH20 SC在gMG参与者中显示出与静脉注射（IV）efgartigimod非劣效的总IgG降低。完成ADAPT-SC或入组ADAPT+（efgartigimod IV开放标签扩展[OLE]）的参与者可进入ADAPT-SC+ OLE研究。设计/方法：Efgartigimod PH20 SC 1000 mg以每周一次注射、共4次的周期给药。后续周期根据临床评估启动（第1年，周期之间≥4周；第2年及以后，方案修订后周期之间≥1周）。安全性通过不良事件的发生率和严重程度评估。临床疗效通过重症肌无力日常生活活动（MG-ADL）评分评估。结果：在ADAPT-SC+期间，180名参与者接受了≥1次efgartigimod PH20 SC注射（平均[SD]研究持续时间，2.6[0.9]年；459.4参与者年随访）。不良事件主要为轻度/中度。注射部位反应为轻度/中度，未导致停药，且随后续周期发生率降低。在第1年后周期间隔缩短的参与者中，efgartimod仍耐受良好。在抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）参与者中，MG-ADL总分改善在第1周观察到，并持续至第163周。59.2%的AChR-Ab+参与者在任何时间点达到最小症状表现（MG-ADL评分，0-1）。观察到生活质量的持续改善。结论：Efgartigimod PH20 SC的长期治疗耐受良好且有效。

abstracts.title: MG-ADL Subdomain Score Changes With Eculizumab or Ravulizumab: An Analysis of the Global MG SPOTLIGHT Registry
abstracts.authors: Juel, Vern; Macwan, Samir; Sacca, Francesco; Gordon, Andrew; Zeinali, Lida; Winkley, James; Liu, Chuang; Cutter, Gary; Dodig, Dubravka; Alpers, Joshua; Tandan, Rup
abstracts.affiliations: Duke University, Durham, NC; Eisenhower Health Center, Rancho Mirage, CA; University of Naples Federico II, Napoli, Italy; Northwest Neurology, Ltd., Lake Barrington, IL; Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease, Mississauga, ON, Canada; Baptist Health Medical Group Neurology, Lexington, KY; Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease, Baar, Switzerland; University of Alabama At Birmingham, Birmingham, AL; University of Toronto/Toronto Western Hospital, Toronto, ON, Canada; Erlanger Medical Center, Chattanooga, TN; University of Vermont Medical Center, Burlington, VT
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To assess changes in Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) subdomain scores after complement component 5 (C5) inhibitor therapy (C5IT, eculizumab and ravulizumab) initiation among patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). Background: The global MG SPOTLIGHT Registry (NCT04202341) collects data on real-world clinical safety and effectiveness of the C5ITs eculizumab and ravulizumab in adults with anti-acetylcholine antibody-positive (AChR-Ab+) gMG. Design/Methods: MG-ADL subdomain scores were assessed in patients enrolled in the MG SPOTLIGHT Registry who received eculizumab (eculizumab subgroup), ravulizumab (ravulizumab subgroup), or transitioned from eculizumab to ravulizumab (eculizumab-to-ravulizumab subgroup) with data available prior to C5IT initiation and during treatment. Results: As of July 1, 2024, 178 Registry patients fulfilled inclusion criteria for analysis (male: 55.7%; mean±SD age at MG diagnosis: 54.7±19.0yrs) with 89, 49, and 40 patients in the eculizumab, ravulizumab, and eculizumab-to-ravulizumab subgroups, respectively. Statistically significant reductions (P <0.05) in mean scores were observed for all MG-ADL subdomains after C5IT initiation. Reductions from prior to C5IT to last assessment during C5IT treatment ranged from 41.0% to 53.0% (ocular), 49.9% to 73.1% (bulbar), 40.7% to 58.6% (respiratory), and 33.7% to 71.4% (limbs) across the 3 subgroups. The proportions of patients with complete or partial improvement in individual MG-ADL subdomains during C5IT treatment were similar between the eculizumab and ravulizumab subgroups: 60.7% and 63.3% (ocular), 58.4% and 59.2% (bulbar), 51.7% and 49.0% (limbs), and 33.7% and 26.5% (respiratory), respectively. Among the eculizumab-to-ravulizumab subgroup, the proportions of patients with complete or partial improvement in individual subdomains were 67.5% (ocular), 67.5% (bulbar), 65.0% (limbs), and 45.0% (respiratory) at last assessment during ravulizumab treatment. Results with extended follow-up will be presented. Conclusions: These results from clinical practice show the broad benefit of complement C5 inhibition with eculizumab and ravulizumab in improving ocular, bulbar, respiratory, and limb function as indicated by MG-ADL subdomain score in patients with AChR-Ab+ gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：评估全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者启动补体成分5抑制剂（C5IT，依库珠单抗和ravulizumab）治疗后，重症肌无力日常生活活动（MG-ADL）子域评分的变化。背景：全球MG SPOTLIGHT注册研究（NCT04202341）收集了C5IT依库珠单抗和ravulizumab在抗乙酰胆碱抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）gMG成人患者中的真实世界临床安全性和有效性数据。设计/方法：对入组MG SPOTLIGHT注册研究、接受依库珠单抗（依库珠单抗亚组）、ravulizumab（ravulizumab亚组）或从依库珠单抗转换为ravulizumab（依库珠单抗转ravulizumab亚组）且在C5IT启动前和治疗期间有可用数据的患者，评估MG-ADL子域评分。结果：截至2024年7月1日，178名注册患者符合分析纳入标准（男性：55.7%；MG诊断时平均±SD年龄：54.7±19.0岁），依库珠单抗、ravulizumab和依库珠单抗转ravulizumab亚组分别有89、49和40名患者。C5IT启动后，所有MG-ADL子域的平均评分均观察到统计学显著降低（P <0.05）。从C5IT前到C5IT治疗期间最后一次评估，三个亚组的降低范围分别为：眼部41.0%至53.0%，延髓部49.9%至73.1%，呼吸部40.7%至58.6%，肢体部33.7%至71.4%。C5IT治疗期间，依库珠单抗和ravulizumab亚组中单个MG-ADL子域完全或部分改善的患者比例相似：眼部分别为60.7%和63.3%，延髓部分别为58.4%和59.2%，肢体部分别为51.7%和49.0%，呼吸部分别为33.7%和26.5%。在依库珠单抗转ravulizumab亚组中，ravulizumab治疗期间最后一次评估时单个子域完全或部分改善的患者比例为：眼部67.5%，延髓部67.5%，肢体部65.0%，呼吸部45.0%。将呈现延长随访的结果。结论：这些来自临床实践的结果表明，补体C5抑制（依库珠单抗和ravulizumab）在改善AChR-Ab+ gMG患者的眼部、延髓部、呼吸部和肢体功能方面具有广泛获益，如MG-ADL子域评分所示。

abstracts.title: Methodological Gaps in Myasthenia Gravis Clinical Practice Guidelines: A Scoping Review of Global Recommendations
abstracts.authors: Alarcon Ruiz, Christoper A.; Luna-Peralta, Gerardo; Tagle Lostaunau, Isabel Beatriz; Sifuentes Monge, Juan Manuel; Alfaro-Olivera, Maria; Arias Hancco, Víctor Andrés; Flores Quinteros, Diego Gabriel; Palomino Lescano, Henry; Pacheco Vargas, María Marcelina; Flores-Rodríguez, Nestor Carlos; Aquino Peña, Erasmo Francisco
abstracts.affiliations: Instituto Nacional de Ciencias Neurológicas; Universidad Científica del Sur, Lima, Peru; Universidad Nacional Mayor de San Marcos, Lima, Peru; Instituto Nacional de Ciencias Neurológicas, Lima, Peru
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To describe the characteristics and assess the quality of clinical practice guidelines (CPG) for diagnosis and treatment in adult myasthenia gravis (MG) patients. Background: MG is a rare autoimmune neuromuscular disease with heterogeneous clinical presentation and treatment response. These characteristics and the rapid development of new therapies are approached by evidence-based MG CPG. However, their methodological quality and consistency remain uncertain. Design/Methods: We conducted a scoping review of CPG offering specific recommendations for MG diagnostic and/or treatment in adults. On July 9 th, 2025, we searched seven databases and repositories, including PubMed and TripDatabase, for CPGs published or updated in the last six years. We used the Appraisal of Guidelines Research and Evaluation II (AGREE-II) tool to assess methodological quality, focusing on Domain 3 (Rigor of Development). Results: Ten CPG met inclusion criteria. Guidelines originated from the United States (n=3), Asia (n=3), Europe (n=3), and Latin-America (n=1). The median AGREE-II Domain 3 score was 52.5% (IQR: 31%-60%). Five CPG achieved ≥60% in AGREE-II Domain 3, reporting systematic reviews during development. Among their 112 recommendations, 11 from 1 CPG addressed MG diagnosis. Other two CPG formulated 21 and 5 recommendations for clinical assessment and therapeutic goals in MG patients, respectively. Only one CPG gave two recommendations for pyridostigmine. Three CPG presented 16 recommendations for classic immunosuppressants (oral corticosteroids, cyclosporine, tacrolimus, azathioprine, mycophenolate, and methotrexate) and 9 recommendations for biologics (rituximab, eculizumab, ravulizumab, and efgartigimod) with limited consensus between them. Thymectomy age-indications were conflicted (less than 50, 60 and 65 years old). Finally, 23 recommendations for myasthenic crisis or symptoms exacerbation focused on intensive care, intravenous immunoglobulin, and plasmapheresis. Conclusions: Half of the MG guidelines meet adequate methodological standards with inconsistent evidence synthesis and heterogeneous recommendations. Standardized and transparent updated international CPG are needed to support evidence-based care for MG patients worldwide.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：描述成人重症肌无力（MG）诊断和治疗临床实践指南（CPG）的特征并评估其质量。背景：MG是一种罕见的自身免疫性神经肌肉疾病，具有异质性的临床表现和治疗反应。这些特征以及新疗法的快速发展通过循证MG CPG来处理。然而，其方法学质量和一致性仍不确定。设计/方法：我们对提供成人MG诊断和/或治疗具体建议的CPG进行了范围综述。2025年7月9日，我们检索了七个数据库和存储库，包括PubMed和TripDatabase，查找在过去六年内发布或更新的CPG。我们使用指南研究与评估工具II（AGREE-II）评估方法学质量，重点关注领域3（制定的严谨性）。结果：十项CPG符合纳入标准。指南来自美国（n=3）、亚洲（n=3）、欧洲（n=3）和拉丁美洲（n=1）。AGREE-II领域3评分中位数为52.5%（IQR：31%-60%）。五项CPG在AGREE-II领域3得分≥60%，在制定过程中报告了系统评价。在其112条建议中，来自1项CPG的11条涉及MG诊断。另外两项CPG分别针对MG患者的临床评估和治疗目标制定了21条和5条建议。仅有一项CPG为吡啶斯的明提供了两条建议。三项CPG为经典免疫抑制剂（口服皮质类固醇、环孢素、他克莫司、硫唑嘌呤、霉酚酸酯和甲氨蝶呤）提出了16条建议，为生物制剂（利妥昔单抗、依库珠单抗、ravulizumab和efgartigimod）提出了9条建议，但共识有限。胸腺切除术的年龄适应症存在冲突（小于50、60和65岁）。最后，针对肌无力危象或症状加重的23条建议集中于重症监护、静脉注射免疫球蛋白和血浆置换。结论：一半的MG指南达到了足够的方法学标准，但证据综合不一致且建议异质性大。需要标准化、透明且更新的国际CPG来支持全球MG患者的循证护理。

abstracts.title: Patient Satisfaction With Ravulizumab Treatment for Generalized Myasthenia Gravis (gMG) in the United States (US)
abstracts.authors: Shugars, Chelsea; Poole, Brianna; Yee, Karen; Yu, Jeffrey; Betor, Nicole; Crevier, Elizabeth; Scheiner, Christopher
abstracts.affiliations: Erlanger Health System, Chattanooga, TN; University of Tennessee Medical Center, Knoxville, TN; Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease, Boston, MA; Avalere, DC
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To understand the real-world patient experience with ravulizumab, including health-related quality of life (HR-QoL) and other disease-related impacts, and to determine key drivers of the ravulizumab treatment experience using a patient satisfaction survey. Background: Anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive (AChR-Ab+) gMG is a rare, chronic, autoimmune disease. Ravulizumab, a terminal complement component 5 inhibitor with maintenance dosing of once every 8 weeks (Q8W), is approved for the treatment of AChR-Ab+ gMG. Here, we present results of a patient satisfaction survey among US adults with gMG receiving ravulizumab. Design/Methods: This cross-sectional, web-based survey, conducted from June–August 2025, was developed with input from patients and healthcare professionals. Participants were recruited from patient panels through a recruitment vendor partner and through US patient advisory groups. The survey assessed demographics/clinical characteristics, HR-QoL measures (eg, ability to socialize, function in a career, sleep, manage activities of daily living [ADL]), and treatment satisfaction. Results: The analysis included 124 respondents (female: 59%; mean±SD age: 47±13.3yrs; mean±SD Myasthenia Gravis ADL score: 6.5±4.3). Most respondents (73%) had received ravulizumab for ≥12mo; 55% initiated ravulizumab within 2yrs of diagnosis. Any improvement in ≥1 HR-QoL measure was reported in 96% of patients; significant improvement in ≥1 HR-QoL measure was reported in 75% of patients. Most frequently reported improvements were in the ability to socialize/maintain relationships (73%), the ability to function in a career (71%), real or perceived social isolation (71%), the ability to complete ADLs (70%), and the ability to participate in hobbies, leisure, or volunteering (70%). Respondents reported satisfaction with infusion frequency (79%), symptom relief (78%), HR-QoL improvements (76%), and their overall treatment experience (77%). Primary drivers of satisfaction included HR-QoL improvements (50%) and Q8W infusion frequency (23%). Conclusions: These results demonstrate that the majority of survey respondents with gMG receiving ravulizumab in the US were overall satisfied with ravulizumab and experienced meaningful HR-QoL improvements.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：了解ravulizumab治疗的真实世界患者体验，包括健康相关生活质量（HR-QoL）和其他疾病相关影响，并通过患者满意度调查确定ravulizumab治疗体验的关键驱动因素。背景：抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）gMG是一种罕见的慢性自身免疫性疾病。Ravulizumab是一种终末补体成分5抑制剂，维持剂量为每8周一次（Q8W），已获批用于治疗AChR-Ab+ gMG。在此，我们呈现一项针对接受ravulizumab治疗的美国成年gMG患者的患者满意度调查结果。设计/方法：这项横断面、基于网络的调查于2025年6月至8月进行，由患者和医疗保健专业人员共同参与制定。参与者通过招募供应商合作伙伴和美国患者咨询小组从患者小组中招募。调查评估了人口统计学/临床特征、HR-QoL指标（例如，社交能力、职业功能、睡眠、管理日常生活活动[ADL]的能力）和治疗满意度。结果：分析包括124名受访者（女性：59%；平均±SD年龄：47±13.3岁；平均±SD重症肌无力ADL评分：6.5±4.3）。大多数受访者（73%）接受ravulizumab治疗≥12个月；55%在诊断后2年内启动ravulizumab。96%的患者报告在≥1项HR-QoL指标上有任何改善；75%的患者报告在≥1项HR-QoL指标上有显著改善。最常报告的改善是社交/维持关系的能力（73%）、职业功能能力（71%）、真实或感知的社交孤立（71%）、完成ADL的能力（70%）以及参与爱好、休闲或志愿活动的能力（70%）。受访者对输液频率（79%）、症状缓解（78%）、HR-QoL改善（76%）和整体治疗体验（77%）表示满意。满意度的主要驱动因素包括HR-QoL改善（50%）和Q8W输液频率（23%）。结论：这些结果表明，在美国接受ravulizumab治疗的gMG患者中，大多数受访者对ravulizumab总体满意，并经历了有意义的HR-QoL改善。

abstracts.title: RESET-MG: Clinical Trial Evaluating Rese-cel (Resecabtagene Autoleucel), a Fully Human, Autologous 4-1BB-CD19-CAR T Cell Therapy in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis (gMG)
abstracts.authors: Habib, Ali; Ciurea, Stefan; Ulane, Christina; Reshef, Ran; Kang, Min; Seshadri, Madhav; Richman, David; Abedi, Mehrdad; Hogan, Jonathan; White, Yvonne; Gresh, Jennifer; Hull, Wayne; Furmanak, Thomas; Volkov, Jenell; Nunez, Daniel; Thompson, Dan; Stadanlick, Jason; Ishikawa, Larissa; Vorndran, Zach; Ellis, Alexandra; Flanagan, Steve; Werner, Mallorie; Cicarelli, Justin; Williams, Jazmean; Kobulsky, Danielle; Braccia, Domenick; Hadi-Nezhad, Fatemeh; Lam, Quynh; Basu, Samik; Tummala, Raj; Chang, David
abstracts.affiliations: UC Irvine, Orange, CA; Columbia University, New York, NY; UCSF, CA; UC Davis, Davis, CA; Cabaletta Bio, PA
abstracts.abstract: Objective: RESET-MG (NCT06359041) is a Phase 1/2 trial evaluating the safety and efficacy of rese-cel in 2 independent cohorts of anti-AChR-antibody-positive and anti-AChR-antibody-negative gMG. Background: gMG is a B-cell-mediated disease; most patients have detectable autoantibodies targeting the neuromuscular junction. Most available therapies require chronic administration, increasing the risk of side effects, and many patients remain refractory despite several treatments. Rese-cel is an investigational, fully human, autologous 4-1BB CD19-CAR T cell therapy, designed to deeply and transiently deplete CD19+ B-cells following a single, weight-based infusion, potentially enabling an “immune reset” with durable responses. Design/Methods: Eligible patients are 18-70 years old with MGFA Classification II-IV gMG and MG-ADL ≥6 despite ≥2 prior/current treatments. A single rese-cel infusion of 1x10^6 cells/kg is administered following standard preconditioning. All non-glucocorticoid immunomodulatory agents are discontinued by preconditioning; glucocorticoids are tapered post-infusion. Adverse events, gMG medications, gMG activity and translational endpoints are assessed. Results: As of September 2025, four patients (2 per cohort) have received rese-cel and completed ≥1 month follow-up. Grade 2 cytokine release syndrome occurred in 1 patient. The 2 evaluable patients achieved MG-ADL improvements from 17 to 0 (achieving minimal symptom expression) and 14 to 7, off all gMG medications, at 20- and 8-weeks post-infusion, respectively. The 3rd patient is not evaluable due to use of a prohibited cytotoxic medication that may have inhibited CAR T activity; the 4th patient has insufficient follow up. Rese-cel peaked by Day 14 and B-cells were depleted by Day 8 in all patients. Serum BAFF concentrations peaked following B-cell depletion. In the first treated patient, B-cells repopulated by Week 12 with predominantly transitional naïve cells (CD24 ++ /CD38 ++). Conclusions: These initial data suggest that rese-cel is well-tolerated and can cause immune reset in gMG, allowing patients to achieve meaningful clinical responses off gMG therapies. Both cohorts are fully enrolled, with post-treatment data forthcoming.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：RESET-MG（NCT06359041）是一项1/2期试验，在抗AChR抗体阳性和抗AChR抗体阴性的gMG两个独立队列中评估rese-cel的安全性和有效性。背景：gMG是一种B细胞介导的疾病；大多数患者可检测到针对神经肌肉接头的自身抗体。大多数现有疗法需要长期给药，增加了副作用风险，且许多患者尽管接受了多种治疗仍难治。Rese-cel是一种研究性的、全人源、自体4-1BB CD19-CAR T细胞疗法，旨在通过单次基于体重的输注后深度且短暂地耗竭CD19+ B细胞，可能实现具有持久应答的“免疫重置”。设计/方法：符合条件的患者年龄18-70岁，患有MGFA II-IV级gMG，且尽管接受过≥2种既往/当前治疗，MG-ADL评分仍≥6。在标准预处理后，单次输注1x10^6细胞/kg的rese-cel。所有非糖皮质激素免疫调节剂在预处理前停用；糖皮质激素在输注后逐渐减量。评估不良事件、gMG药物、gMG活动度和转化终点。结果：截至2025年9月，4名患者（每个队列2名）已接受rese-cel并完成≥1个月的随访。1名患者发生2级细胞因子释放综合征。2名可评估患者在停用所有gMG药物的情况下，分别在输注后20周和8周，MG-ADL评分从17改善至0（达到最小症状表达）和从14改善至7。第3名患者因使用了可能抑制CAR T活性的禁用细胞毒性药物而无法评估；第4名患者随访时间不足。所有患者的Rese-cel在Day 14达到峰值，B细胞在Day 8被耗竭。血清BAFF浓度在B细胞耗竭后达到峰值。在首例治疗患者中，B细胞在第12周重新增殖，主要为过渡性幼稚细胞（CD24 ++ /CD38 ++）。结论：这些初步数据表明，rese-cel耐受性良好，可在gMG中引起免疫重置，使患者在停用gMG疗法后达到有意义的临床应答。两个队列均已完全入组，治疗后的数据即将公布。

abstracts.abstract: Objective: To estimate the within-patient association between biologic therapy and hospitalization rates among adults with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). Background: Biologics are increasingly used in gMG. We aimed to provide real-world evidence of outcome improvement compared to non-biologics. Design/Methods: We retrospectively identified patients with gMG treated at Mass General Brigham treated with biologics defined as chronic administration of IVIg, SCIg, rituximab, eculizumab, ravulizumab, or efgartigimod. Outcome was gMG related hospitalization comparing pre- and post-biologic therapy. First 30-days after starting biologic were treated as washout. We constructed person-period data and fit patient fixed-effects (FE) Poisson model with log person-time offsets, clustering by patient and adjusting for Charlson-Comorbidity Index, MGFA Clinical Classification, time-since-diagnosis, and calendar quarter. The FE analysis was restricted to patients contributing both non-biologic and biologic time with complete covariates. Results: Seventy-seven patients with gMG met inclusion criteria. Median age at gMG diagnosis was 65 years [IQR 53–72] with 51% of females. MGFA-CC at diagnosis was I–III in 85%. Antibody data was available in 65 patients, 97% were AChR-positive and 3% MuSK-positive. Patients contributed 184.28 person-years (PY) off-biologic with 41 hospitalizations (22.25 per 100 PY) and 380.09 PY on-biologic with 36 hospitalizations (9.47 per 100 PY); crude post/pre biologic incidence rate ratio of hospitalizations was 0.43. In the FE model, current biologic exposure was associated with a markedly lower hospitalization rate (incidence rate ratio 0.01, 95% CI 0.00–0.09; p<0.001). 58/77 (75.3%) patients had zero on-biologic hospitalizations. Per-patient person-time contributed amounted to (median [IQR]): 0.73 PY [0.19–3.12] off-biologic; 4.01 PY [1.61–6.67] on-biologic. Drugs contributing on-biologic time included IVIg (n=65), rituximab (n=15), eculizumab (n=11), efgartigimod (n=7), and ravulizumab (n=3). Conclusions: In a within-patient design with lagging and temporal controls, biologic therapy was associated with fewer hospitalizations compared with non-biologics. The large effect-size reflects longer post-biologic follow-up and a high proportion of zero post-biologic hospitalizations.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：评估成人全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者中生物制剂治疗与住院率之间的患者内关联。背景：生物制剂在gMG中的应用日益增多。我们旨在提供与非生物制剂相比，结局改善的真实世界证据。设计/方法：我们回顾性识别了在Mass General Brigham接受治疗的gMG患者，这些患者接受了定义为慢性给予IVIg、SCIg、利妥昔单抗、依库珠单抗、ravulizumab或efgartigimod的生物制剂治疗。结局是比较生物制剂治疗前后的gMG相关住院情况。开始生物制剂后的前30天被视为洗脱期。我们构建了人-期数据，并拟合了患者固定效应（FE）泊松模型，以对数人-时间偏移量，按患者聚类，并根据Charlson合并症指数、MGFA临床分型、诊断后时间和日历季度进行调整。FE分析仅限于同时贡献了非生物制剂和生物制剂时间且协变量完整的患者。结果：77名gMG患者符合纳入标准。gMG诊断时的中位年龄为65岁[IQR 53–72]，51%为女性。诊断时的MGFA-CC为I–III级者占85%。65名患者有抗体数据，97%为AChR阳性，3%为MuSK阳性。患者贡献了184.28人年（PY）的非生物制剂时间，期间有41次住院（每100 PY 22.25次）；以及380.09 PY的生物制剂时间，期间有36次住院（每100 PY 9.47次）；粗算的生物制剂后/前住院发生率比为0.43。在FE模型中，当前生物制剂暴露与显著更低的住院率相关（发生率比0.01，95% CI 0.00–0.09；p<0.001）。58/77（75.3%）名患者在生物制剂治疗期间住院次数为零。每位患者贡献的人-时间中位数[IQR]为：非生物制剂期0.73 PY [0.19–3.12]；生物制剂期4.01 PY [1.61–6.67]。贡献生物制剂时间的药物包括IVIg（n=65）、利妥昔单抗（n=15）、依库珠单抗（n=11）、efgartigimod（n=7）和ravulizumab（n=3）。结论：在采用滞后和时间对照的患者内设计中，与非生物制剂相比，生物制剂治疗与更少的住院相关。较大的效应量反映了更长的生物制剂后随访时间和较高比例的生物制剂后零住院。

abstracts.abstract: Objective: To evaluate long-term clinical outcomes, treatment patterns, and predictors of efficacy of efgartigimod in acetylcholine receptor antibody–positive generalize myasthenia gravis (gMG). Background: Efgartigimod, a neonatal Fc receptor antagonist, lowers pathogenic IgG and has shown efficacy in gMG. Real-world data on long-term outcomes, steroid-sparing, bridging strategies, and predictors of response remain limited. Design/Methods: This multicenter retrospective study included 46 adult patients treated across 7 tertiary centers between April 2022 and March 2025. Data on demographics, clinical features, treatments, and outcomes were collected. The primary endpoints were improvement in MG-ADL scores and achievement of minimal symptom expression (MSE). Secondary endpoints included corticosteroid dose reduction, successful use of efgartigimod as short-term bridging therapy for disease stabilization, and safety outcomes. Results: The patients received 197 cycles (mean 4.3 per patient) at a mean interval of 9.8 weeks. 40 (86.9%) patients achieved a ≥2-point improvement in MG-ADL and 20 (43.5%) patients reached MSE after the first cycle, while 24 (52.2%) achieved MSE at any point. Overall 36 (78.3%) patients maintained a ≥2-point improvement in MG-ADL, with response patterns ranging from cyclical benefit to sustained remission, although 14 (35.9%) patients discontinued treatment due to insufficient efficacy. The prednisone dose was reduced in 17 of the 29 (58.6%) treated patients (from a mean of 30.9 to 16.8 mg/day, p=0.001), with a shorter disease duration independently predicting success. Bridging therapy was successful in a subset of 5 patients, particularly among the those receiving azathioprine or mycophenolate (OR=15.0, p=0.040). Adverse events were mild and occurred in 10 (21.7%) patients, only 1 of whom discontinued therapy. Conclusions: In real-world practice, efgartigimod was effective and well-tolerated in AChR-positive gMG. Distinct response patterns, a steroid-sparing effect linked to shorter disease duration, and successful bridging therapy in the presence of immunosuppressant support its role in personalized treatment strategies. Prospective validation of its use is warranted.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：评估efgartigimod在乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性全身型重症肌无力（gMG）中的长期临床结局、治疗模式和疗效预测因素。背景：Efgartigimod是一种新生儿Fc受体拮抗剂，可降低致病性IgG，并在gMG中显示出疗效。关于长期结局、激素节省、桥接策略和应答预测因素的真实世界数据仍然有限。设计/方法：这项多中心回顾性研究纳入了2022年4月至2025年3月期间在7个三级中心接受治疗的46名成年患者。收集了人口统计学、临床特征、治疗和结局数据。主要终点是MG-ADL评分的改善和达到最小症状表达（MSE）。次要终点包括皮质类固醇剂量减少、成功使用efgartigimod作为短期桥接疗法以实现疾病稳定，以及安全性结局。结果：患者接受了197个周期（平均每名患者4.3个周期），平均间隔9.8周。40名（86.9%）患者在第一个周期后MG-ADL评分改善≥2分，20名（43.5%）患者达到MSE，而24名（52.2%）患者在任意时间点达到MSE。总体而言，36名（78.3%）患者维持了MG-ADL评分≥2分的改善，反应模式从周期性获益到持续缓解不等，尽管14名（35.9%）患者因疗效不足而停止治疗。29名接受治疗的患者中有17名（58.6%）泼尼松剂量减少（从平均30.9 mg/天降至16.8 mg/天，p=0.001），较短的病程独立预测了成功减量。桥接治疗在一组5名患者中取得成功，尤其是在接受硫唑嘌呤或霉酚酸酯的患者中（OR=15.0，p=0.040）。不良事件轻微，发生在10名（21.7%）患者中，仅1名因此停止治疗。结论：在真实世界实践中，efgartigimod对AChR阳性gMG有效且耐受性良好。不同的反应模式、与较短病程相关的激素节省效应以及在存在免疫抑制剂的情况下成功的桥接治疗，支持其在个体化治疗策略中的作用。其使用的前瞻性验证是必要的。

abstracts.title: Real-world Treatment Patterns, Discontinuation, and Treatment Switches in Patients With Generalized Myasthenia Gravis (gMG): A Retrospective Claims Analysis
abstracts.authors: Anderson, Seth; Howard, James; Tkacz, Joseph; Wilson, Kathleen; Schinkel, Jill; Cavida, Dustin; Canales, Blanca; Patterson, Kristina
abstracts.affiliations: Amgen, CA; The University of North Carolina, Dept of Neurology, CB 7025, Chapel Hill, NC; Inovalon, MD; Inovalon, Bowie, MD; Amgen, IL; Amgen, TX; Amgen, PA
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To describe real-world treatment patterns, discontinuation, and treatment switching among a prevalent cohort of patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in the United States. Background: gMG is a chronic autoimmune disorder associated with fluctuating muscle weakness. Understanding treatment patterns, including steroid use and therapy switching, is essential to identify unmet needs in clinical practice. Design/Methods: This retrospective cohort study used administrative claims from the MORE2 Registry® and Medicare Fee-for-Service (2018–2024). Eligible patients were ≥18 years old with ≥1 inpatient or ≥2 outpatient claims for gMG and ≥12 months of continuous enrollment before and after index; ocular MG was excluded. Outcomes assessed included treatment patterns during the variable-length follow-up period. Results: Among 44,525 patients with prevalent gMG, oral corticosteroids (48%) were the most common therapy, followed by non-steroidal IST (25%). Biologic use was low (6%), with rituximab, eculizumab, and efgartigimod most frequently prescribed. Monotherapy predominated (57%), while 16% received combination regimens. Prednisone-equivalent dosing showed substantial exposure: 22% received ≥20 mg/day, 17% 10–<20 mg/day, 7% 5–<10 mg/day, and 2% >0–≤5 mg/day. The mean duration of the first treatment was 292 days. Regimen termination most often reflected discontinuation (61%), followed by stacking/add-on therapy (15%) and switching (9%). Notably, 35% of patients had treatment sequences that involved repeated courses of steroids separated by ≥60-day gaps. Illustrating how discontinuation often represented cycling back to corticosteroids rather than durable regimen change. These patterns highlight frequent interruptions in care, recurrent steroid cycling, and limited progression to biologics, consistent with payer-driven step therapy and barriers to biologic initiation. Conclusions: In this large real-world cohort, treatment of gMG remains dominated by steroids, with low biologic uptake and frequent discontinuation. High reliance on corticosteroid monotherapy and repeated cycling highlight persistent unmet need in managing gMG, underscoring the importance of expanding access to effective targeted therapies.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：描述美国全身型重症肌无力（gMG）现患人群的真实世界治疗模式、停药和治疗转换情况。背景：gMG是一种与波动性肌无力相关的慢性自身免疫性疾病。了解治疗模式，包括类固醇使用和治疗转换，对于识别临床实践中未满足的需求至关重要。设计/方法：这项回顾性队列研究使用了MORE2 Registry®和Medicare按服务项目收费（2018-2024年）的管理索赔数据。符合条件的患者年龄≥18岁，有≥1次住院或≥2次门诊gMG索赔，并且在索引日期前后有≥12个月的连续入组；排除眼肌型MG。评估的结局包括可变长度随访期间的治疗模式。结果：在44,525名gMG现患患者中，口服皮质类固醇（48%）是最常见的疗法，其次是非甾体类免疫抑制剂（25%）。生物制剂使用率低（6%），最常处方的是利妥昔单抗、依库珠单抗和efgartigimod。单药治疗占主导地位（57%），而16%接受了联合方案。泼尼松等效剂量显示显著暴露：22%的患者接受≥20 mg/天，17%接受10-<20 mg/天，7%接受5-<10 mg/天，2%接受>0-≤5 mg/天。首次治疗的平均持续时间为292天。方案终止最常见的原因是停药（61%），其次是叠加/附加治疗（15%）和转换（9%）。值得注意的是，35%的患者治疗序列涉及间隔≥60天的重复类固醇疗程。这表明停药通常代表循环回到皮质类固醇，而非持久的方案改变。这些模式突显了频繁的治疗中断、反复的类固醇循环以及向生物制剂的有限进展，这与支付方驱动的阶梯治疗和生物制剂启动障碍一致。结论：在这个大型真实世界队列中，gMG的治疗仍然以类固醇为主，生物制剂使用率低且停药频繁。对皮质类固醇单药治疗的高度依赖和反复循环突显了gMG管理中持续存在的未满足需求，强调了扩大有效靶向疗法可及性的重要性。

abstracts.title: Safety and Effectiveness of Efgartigimod in Japanese Patients With Generalized Myasthenia Gravis by Serological Profiles: Analysis of Post-marketing Surveillance
abstracts.authors: Teranishi, Hirofumi; Aoyagi, Ryohei; Harada, Daisuke; Watanabe, Mitsuru
abstracts.affiliations: argenx Japan K.K., Japan; Department of Neurology, Kyushu University Hospital, Fukuoka, Japan
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To assess the safety and effectiveness of efgartigimod for intravenous infusion (efgartigimod-IV) in patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) by serological profiles in real-world settings. Background: Efgartigimod is a human IgG1 Fc-fragment engineered to block the neonatal Fc receptor. Efgartigimod-IV is approved in Japan for gMG regardless of serological profiles, i.e., anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody positive (AChR-Ab+), anti-muscle-specific receptor kinase antibody positive (MuSK-Ab+) or double seronegative; anti-LRP4 antibody is not usually tested. Upon the direction by Japan regulatory authorities, post-marketing surveillance (PMS) is performed. Design/Methods: Patients with gMG who received efgartigimod-IV between May 2022 and September 2023 were registered for the PMS. Effectiveness was evaluated by Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) total score. Results: The safety analysis set consisted of 469 patients: 57.1% (n=268) AChR-Ab+, 13.4% (n=63) MuSK-Ab+, and 29.4% (n=138) double-seronegative. Overall, adverse drug reactions and serious adverse drug reactions were reported in 22.6% and 4.2% of patients, respectively. Generally, safety was consistent with the known safety profile of efgartigimod, and no specific signals were observed in any of the serological profiles. The effectiveness analysis set consisted of 307 patients with a similar composition ratio of serological profiles to the safety analysis set. Overall, mean MG-ADL total score decreased from 7.2 to 4.2 after three weeks from the first administration: −3.0 points (standard deviation: 2.98, p< 0.001). Significant score decreases were observed in each serological profile; −3.0 for AChR-Ab+, −3.7 for MuSK-Ab+, and −2.8 for double-seronegative. For oral glucocorticoid dose, the percentage of patient with ≤5 mg/day increased from 27.7% to 40.8%, and that with >15 mg/day decreased from 15.5% to 7.3% during one year treatment. Substantial oral glucocorticoid dose changes were observed regardless of serological profiles. Conclusions: In real-world settings, efgartigimod-IV was well tolerated and effective in patients with gMG regardless of serological profiles: AChR-Ab+, MuSK-Ab+, and double-seronegative.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：在真实世界环境中，根据血清学特征评估静脉输注艾加莫德（efgartigimod-IV）在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者中的安全性和有效性。背景：艾加莫德是一种人IgG1 Fc片段，经工程化改造以阻断新生儿Fc受体。艾加莫德-IV在日本获批用于所有血清学特征的gMG，即抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）、抗肌肉特异性受体酪氨酸激酶抗体阳性（MuSK-Ab+）或双血清阴性；抗LRP4抗体通常不检测。根据日本监管机构的要求，进行了上市后监测（PMS）。设计/方法：在2022年5月至2023年9月期间接受艾加莫德-IV治疗的gMG患者被纳入PMS注册。有效性通过重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）总分进行评估。结果：安全性分析集包括469例患者：57.1%（n=268）为AChR-Ab+，13.4%（n=63）为MuSK-Ab+，29.4%（n=138）为双血清阴性。总体而言，药物不良反应和严重药物不良反应的发生率分别为22.6%和4.2%。总体而言，安全性与艾加莫德已知的安全性特征一致，在任何血清学特征中均未观察到特定信号。有效性分析集包括307例患者，其血清学特征构成比与安全性分析集相似。总体而言，首次给药后三周，平均MG-ADL总分从7.2降至4.2：−3.0分（标准差：2.98，p<0.001）。在每个血清学特征组中均观察到显著的分数下降：AChR-Ab+组为−3.0，MuSK-Ab+组为−3.7，双血清阴性组为−2.8。对于口服糖皮质激素剂量，在一年治疗期间，剂量≤5 mg/天的患者比例从27.7%增加到40.8%，而剂量>15 mg/天的患者比例从15.5%降至7.3%。无论血清学特征如何，均观察到显著的口服糖皮质激素剂量变化。结论：在真实世界环境中，无论血清学特征（AChR-Ab+、MuSK-Ab+和双血清阴性）如何，艾加莫德-IV在gMG患者中均耐受性良好且有效。

abstracts.title: Use of Biologic Therapy in Seropositive Generalized Myasthenia Gravis in a Single Cohort
abstracts.authors: Taylor, Anne; Elser, Holly; Bird, Shawn; Khella, Sami; Karam, Chafic
abstracts.affiliations: University of Pennsylvania, Philadelphia, PA; Presbyterian Med Ctr/Dept of Neuro, Philadelphia, PA
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To characterize the indications and experiences of patients with seropositive generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) treated with biologic therapy. Background: Biologic therapies are recently available treatment options for gMG, but data regarding their uses and outcomes outside of clinical trials is limited. Design/Methods: Chart review of adult seropositive gMG patients treated with biologic therapy at the University of Pennsylvania between October 2020–July 2025 was conducted. Indication for initiating biologic therapy, outcome of therapy, ability to wean from biologic, and ability to wean from corticosteroids were recorded. Data were summarized descriptively using medians and interquartile ranges (IQR) for continuous variables, and percentages for categorical variables. Results: Among 588 persons with seropositive gMG, 87 (14.8%) received biologic therapy. The median age at diagnosis was 61 years (IQR: 16-91), and 55.1% were female. Biologics were primarily initiated due to inadequate response to first-line therapies (79.3%), less frequently for steroid sparing purposes (25.3%) or as bridge to other non-steroidal immunosuppressants (12.6%), and rarely for long-term maintenance (3.4%). More than one-third (40.2%) of patients had more than one indication for initiation. Use of biologic therapy was as follows: efgartigimod 57.5%, eculizumab 17.2%, ravulizumab 13.8%, rituximab 8.1%, and rozanolixizumab 3.4%. Approximately half (58.6%) of patients had success with the first biologic. 23.0% tried a second or third biologic, of whom 80.0% had success. 27.9% had started to wean from the biologic therapy. Among patients on steroids at the time they started therapy (N=58), 81.0% were able to start weaning from steroids. Conclusions: While only a subset of patients with MG are prescribed biologic therapy, the most common indication in this study was lack of adequate response to first line therapies. Our results suggest that the majority of patients experience symptomatic improvement and the ability to start weaning from steroids. Biologics were rarely used for long term maintenance treatment of seropositive gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：描述接受生物制剂治疗的血清阳性全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者的适应症和经验。背景：生物制剂是gMG近期可用的治疗选择，但关于其在临床试验之外的使用和结果的数据有限。设计/方法：对2020年10月至2025年7月期间在宾夕法尼亚大学接受生物制剂治疗的成人血清阳性gMG患者进行病历回顾。记录了启动生物制剂治疗的适应症、治疗结果、从生物制剂减停的能力以及从皮质类固醇减停的能力。数据使用连续变量的中位数和四分位距（IQR）以及分类变量的百分比进行描述性总结。结果：在588名血清阳性gMG患者中，87名（14.8%）接受了生物制剂治疗。诊断时的中位年龄为61岁（IQR：16-91），55.1%为女性。生物制剂主要因对一线治疗反应不充分而启动（79.3%），较少用于类固醇节省目的（25.3%）或作为其他非甾体免疫抑制剂的桥接治疗（12.6%），极少用于长期维持治疗（3.4%）。超过三分之一（40.2%）的患者启动治疗有不止一个适应症。生物制剂的使用情况如下：艾加莫德57.5%，依库珠单抗17.2%，拉武利珠单抗13.8%，利妥昔单抗8.1%，罗扎诺利西珠单抗3.4%。约一半（58.6%）的患者首次使用生物制剂成功。23.0%的患者尝试了第二种或第三种生物制剂，其中80.0%获得成功。27.9%的患者已开始从生物制剂减停。在开始治疗时正在使用类固醇的患者中（N=58），81.0%能够开始减停类固醇。结论：虽然只有一部分MG患者被处方生物制剂，但本研究中最常见的适应症是对一线治疗反应不充分。我们的结果表明，大多数患者症状得到改善，并能够开始减停类固醇。生物制剂很少用于血清阳性gMG的长期维持治疗。

abstracts.title: Analysis of Real-world Data Following the Use of Efgartigimod for the Treatment of Myasthenia Gravis in the Canadian Population Through the Mypath Patient Support Program
abstracts.authors: Carolina Barnett-Tapia; Charles Kassardjian; Oliver Blanchard; Ari Breiner; Nikky Olayunmoye; Cynthia Qi; Kristin Heerlein; Rommel Mangaser; Fabiana Cooke; Niki Bellafontaine; Zaeem Siddiqi; Dubravka Dodig; Vera Bril
abstracts.affiliations: Toronto, Canada; Montreal, Canada; Ghent, Belgium; Boston, MA; Neuss, Germany; Markham, Canada; Edmonton, Canada
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Efgartigimod, an FcRn blocker, indicated for the treatment of patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), is administered intravenously. OBJECTIVE: A prospective, observational study was conducted to assess real-world outcomes of efgartigimod in a Canadian gMG population. METHODS: Study patients (n=50) were enrolled via the argenx MyPath Patient Support Program (PSP) and initiated efgartigimod therapy in cycles of four once-weekly infusions, followed by a 4- week break for a total of three cycles. Data were generated during routine PSP clinical care touchpoints, in which patients responded to quality of life questionnaires. RESULTS: Patients had a mean age of 60.78 years (Standard Deviation [SD] 15.84) and primarily identified as white/Caucasian (64%). The majority of patients had a Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America classification of 2 (A/B) (54%) and reported previous usage of immunoglobulin (IVIg/SCIg) at baseline (78%). Improvement in MG-ADL scores was seen when compared to baseline, with minimal clinically important difference (MCID) observed at the end of Cycle 2 (mean change -3.00, SD 3.01, CI -3.94, -2.06) and remained below the MCID until the end of Cycle 3. MG-QoL15r scores also showed an improvement from baseline to one week post-Cycle 2 (mean change -5.28, SD 4.45; CI-6.89, -3.68). Efgartigimod was well tolerated with most adverse events being mild or moderate and nine patients (18%) discontinuing. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In conclusion, this real-world evidence from Canada shows that efgartigimod is well tolerated and effective, with an improvement in MG-ADL and MG-QoL15r in patients with gMG. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Efgartigimod是一种FcRn阻断剂，适用于全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者的治疗，经静脉给药。目的：开展一项前瞻性观察性研究，评估efgartigimod在加拿大gMG人群中的真实世界结局。方法：研究患者（n=50）通过argenx MyPath患者支持计划（PSP）入组，并开始efgartigimod治疗，每周期为四次每周一次输注，随后4周休息，共三个周期。数据在常规PSP临床护理接触点生成，患者在此期间回答生活质量问卷。结果：患者平均年龄为60.78岁（标准差[SD]15.84），主要以白人/高加索人为主（64%）。大多数患者的美国重症肌无力基金会分类为2（A/B）（54%），并在基线报告既往使用过免疫球蛋白（IVIg/SCIg）（78%）。与基线相比，MG-ADL评分出现改善，在第2周期结束时观察到最小临床重要差异（MCID）（平均变化-3.00，SD 3.01，CI -3.94，-2.06），并持续低于MCID直至第3周期结束。MG-QoL15r评分也从基线至第2周期后一周显示改善（平均变化-5.28，SD 4.45；CI -6.89，-3.68）。Efgartigimod耐受性良好，大多数不良事件为轻度或中度，9例患者（18%）停药。总结/结论：总之，来自加拿大的这一真实世界证据显示，efgartigimod耐受性良好且有效，gMG患者的MG-ADL和MG-QoL15r均有改善。海报会议I和II

abstracts.title: Bridging the Gap: A Proposed Algorithm for Transitioning Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis to Inebilizumab
abstracts.authors: Annie Hoang-Pham; Amit Sachdev
abstracts.affiliations: Lansing, MI; Okemos, MI
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Inebilizumab is a CD19-targeting monoclonal antibody approved for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). By depleting CD19+ B cells, it reduces pathogenic antibody production. Clinical improvement typically appears 18–26 weeks after initiation, complicating transitions from faster-acting therapies. OBJECTIVE: To propose a structured approach for safely transitioning patients with gMG to inebilizumab, considering drug interactions and therapeutic coverage. METHODS: Therapies were categorized by mechanistic compatibility: (1) Overlap-compatible therapies (complement inhibitors, chronic immunosuppressants, oral T-cell inhibitors). (2) Coverage-expanding therapies (CD20-targeting agents). (3) Washout-required therapies (FcRn inhibitors). Strategies and monitoring were tailored to each category. RESULTS: Overlap-compatible therapies permit straightforward transitions. Complement inhibitors can be continued through Week 24 and then tapered. Chronic immunosuppressants allow corticosteroid taper at Weeks 4-12. Oral T-cell inhibitors' slow kinetics prevent therapeutic gaps. Rituximab can be transitioned at any time to expand B-cell coverage. FcRn inhibitors accelerate IgG breakdown, reducing inebilizumab half-life. A washout of at least three half-lives, typically eight weeks, is required, with corticosteroid bridging to manage IgG rebound or symptom recurrence. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: This mechanism-based algorithm addresses the 18–26 week therapeutic gap by categorizing therapies based on drug interactions rather than offset kinetics alone. Complement and T-cell inhibitors permit overlap. CD20-targeting agents expand B-cell coverage. FcRn inhibitors uniquely require washout due to drug-drug interactions and bridging therapy to manage IgG rebound. Prospective studies are needed to validate safety and effectiveness. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Inebilizumab是一种靶向CD19的单克隆抗体，已获批用于全身型重症肌无力（gMG）。通过耗竭CD19+ B细胞，它减少致病性抗体产生。临床改善通常在开始治疗后18-26周出现，这使从起效更快的治疗转换变得复杂。目的：提出一种结构化方法，考虑药物相互作用和治疗覆盖，安全地将gMG患者转换至inebilizumab。方法：按机制兼容性对治疗进行分类：（1）可重叠治疗（补体抑制剂、慢性免疫抑制剂、口服T细胞抑制剂）。（2）扩展覆盖治疗（靶向CD20的药物）。（3）需要洗脱的治疗（FcRn抑制剂）。针对每一类别制定策略和监测方案。结果：可重叠治疗允许直接转换。补体抑制剂可继续使用至第24周，然后逐渐减量。慢性免疫抑制剂允许在第4-12周逐渐减停糖皮质激素。口服T细胞抑制剂的缓慢动力学可防止治疗空白。利妥昔单抗可在任何时间转换以扩展B细胞覆盖。FcRn抑制剂加速IgG分解，缩短inebilizumab半衰期。需要至少三个半衰期的洗脱，通常为八周，并使用糖皮质激素桥接以管理IgG反弹或症状复发。总结/结论：这一基于机制的算法通过根据药物相互作用而非仅根据消除动力学对治疗进行分类，解决了18-26周的治疗空白。补体和T细胞抑制剂允许重叠。靶向CD20的药物扩展B细胞覆盖。FcRn抑制剂因药物-药物相互作用独特地需要洗脱，并需要桥接治疗以管理IgG反弹。需要前瞻性研究验证安全性和有效性。海报会议I和II

abstracts.title: Characteristics of Patients with Myasthenia Gravis Receiving Innovative versus Traditional Therapies in the Vitaccess Real MG Registry
abstracts.authors: Mark Larkin; Fatemeh Amini; Emma Bagshaw; Alasdair Fellows; Carmen Petitjean; Zabeen Mahuwala
abstracts.affiliations: London, United Kingdom; Lexington, KY
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Innovative therapies are transforming myasthenia gravis (MG) treatment, but there remains a need for real-world evidence about their use. OBJECTIVE: To compare baseline characteristics of patients receiving innovative versus traditional therapies in the Vitaccess Real MG (VRMG) Registry. METHODS: UK and U.S. VRMG participants enrolled by 6th March 2026 were included. Participants were grouped according to routine MG medications received at, or ≤6 months prior to, enrollment (baseline). Innovative therapies included eculizumab, efgartigimod, inebilizumab, nipocalimab, ravulizumab, rituximab, rozanolixizumab, and zilucoplan. Traditional therapies included all other MG medications received for routine use. Participants receiving both types were assigned to the innovative group. For each group, patient characteristics, medical history, and baseline patient-reported outcomes were analyzed. RESULTS: At baseline, 33 participants were on innovative therapies and 72 on traditional therapies. The majority (78.8%) of those on innovative therapies were also receiving traditional therapies. Female:male distribution: innovative 45.5%:51.5%; traditional 48.6%:51.4%. Mean age at diagnosis: innovative 58 years; traditional 54 years. Mean age at baseline: innovative 65 years; traditional 61 years. Thymus involvement: innovative 29.4%; traditional 17.5%. History of thymectomy: innovative 3.0%; traditional 5.6%. Mean Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) scale score: innovative 5.17; traditional 4.62 (0–24 scale; higher scores indicate greater impairment). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: This analysis builds the real- world evidence about innovative MG therapies by exploring characteristics of patients on treatment in clinical practice. This is the first of several planned analyses on this topic using the VRMG Registry. Future analyses will explore longitudinal patient-reported and clinical outcomes, concomitant medication use, and resource use. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：创新疗法正在改变重症肌无力（MG）的治疗格局，但仍需关于其使用的真实世界证据。目的：比较Vitaccess Real MG（VRMG）注册研究中接受创新疗法与传统疗法的患者的基线特征。方法：纳入截至2026年3月6日入组的英国和美国VRMG参与者。参与者根据入组时或入组前≤6个月（基线）接受的常规MG药物进行分组。创新疗法包括依库珠单抗、艾加莫德、伊奈利珠单抗、nipocalimab、ravulizumab、利妥昔单抗、rozanolixizumab和zilucoplan。传统疗法包括用于常规使用的所有其他MG药物。同时接受两类疗法的参与者被分配至创新疗法组。对每组患者的特征、病史和基线患者报告结局进行分析。结果：在基线时，33名参与者接受创新疗法，72名接受传统疗法。接受创新疗法的参与者中大多数（78.8%）同时也接受传统疗法。女性:男性分布：创新疗法组45.5%:51.5%；传统疗法组48.6%:51.4%。诊断时平均年龄：创新疗法组58岁；传统疗法组54岁。基线时平均年龄：创新疗法组65岁；传统疗法组61岁。胸腺受累：创新疗法组29.4%；传统疗法组17.5%。胸腺切除术史：创新疗法组3.0%；传统疗法组5.6%。重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）平均评分：创新疗法组5.17；传统疗法组4.62（0–24量表；评分越高表示损害越重）。总结/结论：本分析通过探索临床实践中接受治疗患者的特征，为创新MG疗法积累了真实世界证据。这是使用VRMG注册研究针对该主题计划开展的若干分析中的第一项。未来分析将探索纵向患者报告结局和临床结局、合并用药及资源使用。海报会议I & II

abstracts.title: Clinical Efficacy of Efgartigimod among Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Real-world Evidence from a Patient Support Program in Canada
abstracts.authors: Zaeem Siddiqi; Carolina Barnett- Tapia; Oliver Blanchard; Bupe Mwaikambo; Dubravka Dodig; Richard Leckey; Michelle Mezei; Cécile Blein; Cecilia Vu; Mihir Dhingra; Grayson Beecher; Vera Bril
abstracts.affiliations: Edmonton, Canada; Toronto, Canada; Montreal, Canada; Vaughan, Canada; Bedford, Canada; Vancouver, Canada; Ghent, Belgium; Boston, MA; Gurugram, India
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Efgartigimod is the first approved neonatal Fc receptor blocker in Canada (2023) for the treatment of generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in adults who are anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody positive. Despite regulatory approval, evidence of its real- world effectiveness in Canada remains limited. OBJECTIVE: This study assessed symptom improvement and changes in concomitant treatment utilization among Canadian adults with gMG initiating efgartigimod based on data from patients enrolled in the MyPATH patient support program (PSP). METHODS: This retrospective analysis included adults (≥18 years) with gMG who enrolled in the MyPATH PSP and initiated efgartigimod between November 2023 and July 2025. Outcomes included self-reported Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) scores and changes in concomitant gMG therapies before and after efgartigimod initiation. RESULTS: Among 271 patients (49% male; mean age 62.4 years), the baseline mean (SD) MG-ADL score was 8.2 (3.9). After efgartigimod initiation, the mean (SD) best achieved MG-ADL score was 3.2 (2.9), reached at a mean of 15.4 weeks. Overall, 86% of patients achieved a ≥2- point improvement, and 56% achieved a ≥5-point improvement in MG-ADL. Among the 211 patients with available treatment information, concomitant therapies declined substantially following efgartigimod initiation: immunoglobulin therapy (77% to 4%), non-steroidal immunosuppressive therapy (39% to 10%), and corticosteroids (34% to 15%). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Efgartigimod was associated with clinically meaningful symptom improvement and reduced reliance on other gMG treatments in Canadian adults with gMG. Larger studies are needed to confirm these findings and further evaluate durability, quality of life outcomes, and healthcare resource implications. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：艾加莫德是加拿大（2023年）首个获批用于治疗抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性的成人全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的新生儿Fc受体阻断剂。尽管已获监管批准，其在加拿大的真实世界有效性证据仍然有限。目的：本研究基于入组MyPATH患者支持项目（PSP）的患者数据，评估开始使用艾加莫德的加拿大成人gMG患者的症状改善及合并治疗使用变化。方法：本回顾性分析纳入≥18岁、入组MyPATH PSP并在2023年11月至2025年7月期间开始使用艾加莫德的成人gMG患者。结局包括自我报告的重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）评分以及艾加莫德开始前后合并gMG治疗的变化。结果：在271名患者（49%男性；平均年龄62.4岁）中，基线MG-ADL平均（SD）评分为8.2（3.9）。开始艾加莫德后，平均（SD）最佳达到的MG-ADL评分为3.2（2.9），平均于15.4周达到。总体而言，86%的患者MG-ADL改善≥2分，56%的患者改善≥5分。在有可用治疗信息的211名患者中，开始艾加莫德后合并治疗大幅下降：免疫球蛋白治疗（77%降至4%）、非甾体免疫抑制治疗（39%降至10%）和糖皮质激素（34%降至15%）。总结/结论：艾加莫德与加拿大成人gMG患者具有临床意义的症状改善及对其他gMG治疗依赖的减少相关。需要更大规模的研究来证实这些发现，并进一步评估持久性、生活质量结局和医疗资源影响。海报会议I & II

abstracts.title: Efgartigimod Provides Rapid Clinical Improvements and Reduces Corticosteroid Use in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Initial Results from Premier
abstracts.authors: Gil Wolfe; Ashley Anderson; Christyn Edmundson; Deborah Gelinas; Cynthia Z. Qi; Min Yang; Tom Hughes; Lingyun Li; Glenn Phillips; Bruno Martins; Cheryl Xiang; Boya Lin; Kristin Heerlein; Cathleen Bergin; Vera Bril
abstracts.affiliations: Buffalo, NY; Houston, TX; Seattle, WA; Boston, MA; Toronto, Canada
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Efgartigimod is a neonatal Fc receptor blocker indicated for the treatment of generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in adults. OBJECTIVE: We report initial findings of the ongoing Prospective Real-world study of EfgartigiMod for patIents with gEneralized myasthenia gRavis (PREMIER). METHODS: Adult patients prescribed efgartigimod were recruited from enrollees of the efgartigimod patient support program in the US. Patients completed surveys before (baseline) and at weeks (WKs) 4, 12, 20, and 32 after efgartigimod initiation. Symptoms and functional status were assessed using MG Activities of Daily Living (MG- ADL). Patients were also asked to report corticosteroid use and dosage during the 4 weeks preceding each survey. RESULTS: To date, 143 patients enrolled in PREMIER and 52 completed the WK32 survey, with 75.0% continuing on efgartigimod. Mean (standard deviation) age at baseline was 64.8 (14.1); 48.9% were female. Baseline mean (SD) MG-ADL was 8.6 (3.4). By WK4, MG-ADL improved by 4.1 points (p<0.001). Improvements were sustained through WK32, with larger improvements (4.7 points; p<0.001) observed among those remaining on efgartigimod. The proportion of patients without corticosteroid use increased from 38.5% at baseline to 54.0% by WK4 (p<0.05), further increasing to 59.6% by WK32 (p<0.05). Among baseline corticosteroid users (56.6%; 81/143), 35.7% (10/28) were corticosteroid free by WK32, and high-dose corticosteroid use (>10 mg/day) declined from 69.1% (56/81) to 28.6% (8/28) (p<0.05). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Initial results from PREMIER show rapid and sustained improvements in symptoms, along with reduction in corticosteroid use. Future data will characterize the long-term experiences of these patients. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: PREMIER初步结果 Gil Wolfe（纽约州布法罗）、Ashley Anderson（德克萨斯州休斯顿）、Christyn Edmundson（华盛顿州西雅图）、Deborah Gelinas（马萨诸塞州波士顿）、Cynthia Z. Qi（波士顿）、Min Yang（波士顿）、Tom Hughes（波士顿）、Lingyun Li（波士顿）、Glenn Phillips（波士顿）、Bruno Martins（波士顿）、Cheryl Xiang（波士顿）、Boya Lin（波士顿）、Kristin Heerlein（波士顿）、Cathleen Bergin（波士顿）、Vera Bril（加拿大多伦多） 引言：艾加莫德是一种新生儿Fc受体阻断剂，适用于成人全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的治疗。目的：我们报告正在进行的艾加莫德治疗全身型重症肌无力患者前瞻性真实世界研究（PREMIER）的初步发现。方法：从美国艾加莫德患者支持项目的入组者中招募被处方艾加莫德的成年患者。患者在艾加莫德开始前（基线）及开始后第4、12、20和32周完成调查。使用MG日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）评估症状和功能状态。患者还被要求报告每次调查前4周内的糖皮质激素使用及剂量。结果：截至目前，143名患者入组PREMIER，52名完成第32周调查，其中75.0%继续使用艾加莫德。基线平均（标准差）年龄为64.8（14.1）岁；48.9%为女性。基线MG-ADL平均（SD）为8.6（3.4）。至第4周，MG-ADL改善4.1分（p<0.001）。改善持续至第32周，在继续使用艾加莫德的患者中观察到更大改善（4.7分；p<0.001）。未使用糖皮质激素的患者比例从基线38.5%增至第4周54.0%（p<0.05），至第32周进一步增至59.6%（p<0.05）。在基线糖皮质激素使用者（56.6%；81/143）中，35.7%（10/28）至第32周已停用糖皮质激素，高剂量糖皮质激素使用（>10 mg/天）从69.1%（56/81）降至28.6%（8/28）（p<0.05）。总结/结论：PREMIER的初步结果显示症状快速且持续改善，同时糖皮质激素使用减少。未来数据将描述这些患者的长期体验。海报会议I & III

abstracts.title: More Choices, Harder Decisions: What Clinicians and Patients Need to Know to Address Persistent Unmet Needs in the Context of a Rapidly Expanding Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Therapeutic Landscape
abstracts.authors: Vandana Gupta; Carole Drexel; Katie Kowalski; Gil Wolfe; Tuan Vu
abstracts.affiliations: Needham, MA; Washington, DC; Buffalo, NY; Lutz, FL
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: With the emergence of FcRn blockers and other therapies, the treatment landscape for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is rapidly expanding. Selecting the right therapy has become increasingly complex, underscoring the need for clinicians and patients to navigate treatment decisions together. OBJECTIVE: To assess the impact of an online, tethered educational initiative on clinician knowledge, confidence, and intended practice changes, and on patient/caregiver engagement with targeted therapies for gMG. METHODS: An online, tethered educational initiative targeting neurology clinicians and patients/caregivers launched in September 2025. The clinician track included a 60-minute accredited activity and microlearning modules; the patient track included a 30-minute program and social media outreach. Impact was assessed with pre- and post-activity test questions evaluating knowledge, confidence, and intended practice changes. Chi-square tests compared paired responses (P<0.05). RESULTS: As of February 2026, 1,978 clinicians participated. Mean correct responses improved from 48% pre-activity to 81% post-activity (+33%; p<.01). Significant gains were observed in interpretation of autoantibody testing (+39%; p<.01), understanding FcRn mechanism (+31%; p<.01), recognition of rozanolixizumab efficacy in MuSK+ disease (+30%; p<.01), and interpretation of nipocalimab durability data (+32%; p<.01). Fifty-two percent of clinicians reported intent to change practice, primarily applying updated guidelines (58%) and modifying treatment selection (40%). Among 626 patient/caregiver learners, 74% reported moderate or significant symptom burden despite steroid treatment. Post-activity, 93% expressed interest in targeted therapies and 72% reported comfort discussing treatment options with clinicians. Both clinicians and patients reported ongoing barriers (e.g., transport, cost, time) to accessing newer therapies. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Education improved clinician knowledge and confidence regarding targeted gMG therapies. Persistent patient symptom burden highlights ongoing unmet needs and reinforces the importance of continued education to support appropriate use of newer therapies. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：随着FcRn阻断剂及其他疗法的出现，全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的治疗格局正在迅速扩大。选择合适的治疗变得越来越复杂，凸显了临床医生和患者共同参与治疗决策的必要性。目的：评估一项在线联动教育项目对临床医生知识、信心和预期实践改变的影响，以及对患者/照护者参与靶向治疗的影响。方法：一项针对神经科临床医生和患者/照护者的在线联动教育项目于2025年9月启动。临床医生部分包括60分钟认证活动和微学习模块；患者部分包括30分钟项目和社交媒体推广。通过活动前后测试题评估影响，评价知识、信心和预期实践改变。采用卡方检验比较配对应答（P<0.05）。结果：截至2026年2月，1,978名临床医生参与。平均正确应答率从活动前48%提高至活动后81%（+33%；p<.01）。在自身抗体检测解读（+39%；p<.01）、FcRn机制理解（+31%；p<.01）、rozanolixizumab在MuSK+疾病中疗效的识别（+30%；p<.01）以及nipocalimab持久性数据解读（+32%；p<.01）方面观察到显著提升。52%的临床医生报告有意改变实践，主要是应用更新指南（58%）和调整治疗选择（40%）。在626名患者/照护者学习者中，74%报告尽管接受类固醇治疗仍有中度或显著症状负担。活动后，93%表达对靶向治疗的兴趣，72%报告能与临床医生舒适地讨论治疗选择。临床医生和患者均报告在获取较新疗法方面持续存在障碍（如交通、费用、时间）。总结/结论：教育改善了临床医生对gMG靶向治疗的知识和信心。持续的患者症状负担凸显了未满足需求，并强调继续教育以支持合理使用较新疗法的重要性。海报会议I & II

abstracts.title: Predictors of Safety and Efficacy of Thymectomy in Late-onset Myasthenia Gravis: A Multi-center Retrospective Study
abstracts.authors: Jiaxin Chen
abstracts.affiliations: Guangzhou, China
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Gradually emerging studies suggest that thymectomy represents a potentially effective therapeutic option for late-onset myasthenia gravis (LOMG). OBJECTIVE: This study aims to identify predictors of postoperative adverse events (AEs) and long-term clinical outcomes following thymectomy in this population. METHODS: Clinical data were drawn from ten participating medical centers. Logistic regression analysis was performed to analyze factors related to postoperative AEs, while Kaplan-Meier analysis and Cox regression were conducted to identify predictors of treatment response (remission and minimal manifestation status) in thymectomy for LOMG. Subgroup analysis focused on titin and RyR antibodies, observing both safety and efficacy for further insights. RESULTS: A total of 81 LOMG patients who had undergone thymectomy were eligible. Multivariate logistic regression showed that baseline MG-ADL ≤8 (OR=0.204, 95% CI=0.057-0.736, P=0.015) was a protective factor whereas bulbar symptoms (OR=6.743, 95% CI=1.354- 33.572, P=0.020) were a risk factor for postoperative AEs in LOMG following thymectomy. Furthermore, preoperative MG duration ≤36 months had a 2.440-fold (95% CI=1.093- 5.447, P=0.029) increased probability of achieving MMS or better status after thymectomy. Among 81 enrolled LOMG patients, 65 (80.2%) had titin and RyR antibodies results available. There was a trend toward poorer outcomes in LOMG with RyR-Ab positivity, either alone (P=0.060) or in combination with titin-Ab (P=0.052). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Preoperative MG conditions are predictors for short-term postoperative AEs and long- term clinical outcomes in surgical LOMG patients. Larger sample sizes are needed to enhance clinical screening of suitable cases before thymectomy, optimizing decision- making and improving disease management. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：逐渐增多的研究提示，胸腺切除术可能是晚发型重症肌无力（LOMG）的一种潜在有效治疗选择。目的：本研究旨在识别该人群胸腺切除术后不良事件（AEs）及长期临床结局的预测因素。方法：临床数据来自十家参与医疗中心。采用Logistic回归分析分析与术后AEs相关的因素，同时采用Kaplan-Meier分析和Cox回归识别LOMG胸腺切除术治疗反应（缓解和微小表现状态）的预测因素。亚组分析聚焦于titin和RyR抗体，观察安全性和疗效以进一步获得见解。结果：共有81例接受胸腺切除术的LOMG患者符合条件。多因素Logistic回归显示，基线MG-ADL≤8（OR=0.204，95% CI=0.057-0.736，P=0.015）是保护因素，而延髓症状（OR=6.743，95% CI=1.354-33.572，P=0.020）是LOMG胸腺切除术后术后AEs的危险因素。此外，术前MG病程≤36个月使胸腺切除术后达到MMS或更好状态的概率增加2.440倍（95% CI=1.093-5.447，P=0.029）。在81例入组LOMG患者中，65例（80.2%）有titin和RyR抗体结果可用。RyR-Ab阳性LOMG患者无论单独阳性（P=0.060）还是与titin-Ab联合阳性（P=0.052），均呈现结局较差的趋势。总结/结论：术前MG状况是接受手术的LOMG患者短期术后AEs和长期临床结局的预测因素。需要更大样本量以加强胸腺切除术前合适病例的临床筛查，优化决策并改善疾病管理。海报会议I和II
