abstracts.title: Pregnancy Enhanced Tracking with Neonatal and Infant Assessment: Design of a Safety Study for Nipocalimab in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Neelam Goyal; Christopher J. Robinson; Christiane Schneider-Gold; Diana Clements; Marie Fitzgibbon; Ibrahim Turkoz; Lorraine S. Gentner; Toyin Adewole; Lisa Schwartz; Melanie H. Jacobson
abstracts.affiliations: Palo Alto, CA; Mount Pleasant, SC; Bochum, Germany; Horshan, PA; Jersey City, NJ; Titusville, NJ; Raritan, NJ
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is a rare autoantibody-mediated disease frequently affecting individuals of childbearing potential. Nipocalimab is a neonatal Fc receptor blocker currently approved in the U.S., Europe, and other regions globally for treatment of gMG. However, its safety has not been studied in pregnant individuals with gMG. OBJECTIVE: Pregnancy Enhanced Tracking with Neonatal and Infant Assessment (PETUNIA) aims to determine the prevalence of pregnancy, maternal, and infant outcomes after exposure to nipocalimab during pregnancy. METHODS: PETUNIA is a global, non-interventional study using an enhanced pharmacovigilance approach aiming to estimate the prevalence of pregnancy outcomes, maternal complications, and neonatal and infant health outcomes among pregnant individuals with gMG exposed to nipocalimab in the post-marketing setting. From time of first approval, prospective and retrospective reports of nipocalimab exposure during pregnancy will be followed through the end of pregnancy, and for corresponding live births, through one year of life, via structured, targeted questionnaires administered to healthcare providers. The projected sample size is ≥162 total pregnancies with 50 prospectively reported over a 10-year-period from geographies where nipocalimab is approved and prescribed. RESULTS: Primary endpoints include pregnancy outcomes and maternal complications (fetal growth restriction, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, placental abruption, small for gestational age), serious infections in neonate/infant, and major congenital malformations. Proportions of nipocalimab-exposed pregnancies or neonates/infants with each endpoint will be calculated with 95% confidence intervals using exact methods. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: PETUNIA is designed to obtain real-world safety data on pregnant individuals with gMG exposed to nipocalimab in pregnancy to support clinical decision-making. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种罕见的自身抗体介导疾病，常影响育龄个体。Nipocalimab是一种新生儿Fc受体阻断剂，目前已在全球美国、欧洲及其他地区获批用于治疗gMG。然而，其安全性尚未在妊娠期gMG个体中进行研究。目的：妊娠增强追踪与新生儿及婴儿评估（PETUNIA）旨在确定妊娠期暴露于nipocalimab后妊娠、母体和婴儿结局的发生率。方法：PETUNIA是一项全球性、非干预性研究，采用增强药物警戒方法，旨在估计上市后环境中暴露于nipocalimab的妊娠期gMG个体中妊娠结局、母体并发症以及新生儿和婴儿健康结局的发生率。自首次获批起，妊娠期nipocalimab暴露的前瞻性和回顾性报告将通过向医疗保健提供者发放的结构化、针对性问卷，随访至妊娠结束，对于相应的活产，随访至出生后一年。预计样本量为≥162例总妊娠，其中50例前瞻性报告，来自nipocalimab获批并处方的地理区域，历时10年。结果：主要终点包括妊娠结局和母体并发症（胎儿生长受限、妊娠期高血压疾病、胎盘早剥、小于胎龄儿）、新生儿/婴儿严重感染以及重大先天畸形。将使用精确方法计算暴露于nipocalimab的妊娠或新生儿/婴儿中各终点比例及其95%置信区间。总结/结论：PETUNIA旨在获取妊娠期暴露于nipocalimab的gMG个体的真实世界安全性数据，以支持临床决策。海报会议I和II

abstracts.title: Retrospective Review of Treatment Switches to Nipocalimab in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Real World Health Care Provider Perspectives
abstracts.authors: Christen Kutz; Kathryn Bercury Russell; Nolan Campbell; Jacqueline Pesa
abstracts.affiliations: Colorado Springs, CO; Boston, MA; Wyoming, PA; Superior, CO
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Clarity on factors driving the decision to switch treatments for patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is needed to best inform clinical practice. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate data from neurology health care providers (HCPs) regarding their rationale for transitioning gMG patients from advanced therapies to nipocalimab. METHODS: An electronic survey of 450 neurology HCPs collected retrospective, de-identified data on gMG patients who transitioned from IVIG, anti-CD19 therapies, complement inhibitors, or FcRn inhibitors to nipocalimab. RESULTS: A total of 37 surveys, each representing a unique patient who transitioned to nipocalimab, were collected and analyzed. Patients were 57% male, 43% female; 62% Caucasian, 22% African American, 3% Asian, and 5% Hispanic/Latino. Prior to switching, 30% of patients were treated with IVIG, 16% efgartigimod hyaluronidase, 14% efgartigimod, 11% ravulizumab, and 11% rituximab. Top reasons for discontinuing prior therapy included fluctuating symptom control (57%), worsening symptoms (41%), lack of efficacy (27%), and avoiding intermittent treatment cycles (24%). Reasons for initiating nipocalimab included preference for consistent treatment schedule (68%), hope for improved efficacy (59%), and patient preference (32%). Among patients taking immunosuppressants and/or prednisone, 48% reduced or discontinued these medications. HCPs reported patient outcomes after nipocalimab as “very much improved” (27%), “much improved” (54%), “minimally improved” (14%), or “no change” (5%). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: These findings highlight factors driving transitions to nipocalimab in gMG, including preference for consistent dosing and improved efficacy. Many patients reduced or discontinued immunosuppressants or prednisone, and most HCPs reported clinical improvement, supporting nipocalimab as a beneficial option for patients with challenges on prior advanced therapies. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：需要明确驱动全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者治疗转换决策的因素，以最好地指导临床实践。目的：评估神经科医疗保健提供者（HCPs）关于将gMG患者从先进疗法转换为nipocalimab的理由的数据。方法：对450名神经科HCPs进行电子调查，收集从IVIG、抗CD19疗法、补体抑制剂或FcRn抑制剂转换为nipocalimab的gMG患者的回顾性、去标识化数据。结果：共收集并分析了37份调查，每份代表一名转换为nipocalimab的独特患者。患者中57%为男性，43%为女性；62%为白人，22%为非裔美国人，3%为亚洲人，5%为西班牙裔/拉丁裔。转换前，30%的患者接受IVIG治疗，16%接受efgartigimod透明质酸酶，14%接受efgartigimod，11%接受ravulizumab，11%接受利妥昔单抗。停用既往治疗的主要原因包括症状控制波动（57%）、症状恶化（41%）、缺乏疗效（27%）和避免间歇性治疗周期（24%）。启动nipocalimab的原因包括偏好一致的治疗方案（68%）、希望提高疗效（59%）和患者偏好（32%）。在服用免疫抑制剂和/或泼尼松的患者中，48%减少或停用了这些药物。HCPs报告nipocalimab后患者结局为“大大改善”（27%）、“明显改善”（54%）、“轻微改善”（14%）或“无变化”（5%）。总结/结论：这些发现突出了驱动gMG患者转换为nipocalimab的因素，包括偏好一致给药和提高疗效。许多患者减少或停用了免疫抑制剂或泼尼松，大多数HCPs报告临床改善，支持nipocalimab作为既往先进疗法面临挑战患者的有益选择。海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: Steroids Tapering among Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Receiving Efgartigimod: Interim Results from the Strive-gMG Chart Review A.
abstracts.authors: Gordon Smith; Andrea Corse; Ali Habib; Tuan Vu; Gil Wolfe; Cynthia Qi; Hongbo Yang; Nicholas Silvestri; Lingyun Li; Dongni Ye; Dustin Nowacek; Jamie Aldridge; Arash Mahajerin; Glenn Phillips; James F. Howard; Jr.
abstracts.affiliations: Richmond, VA; Chapel Hill, NC; Irvine, CA; Tampa, FL; Buffalo, NY; Boston, MA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Long-term steroid use among patients with gMG is associated with substantial complications. Efgartigimod, approved in the United States (U.S.) in 2021 for AChR antibody-positive gMG, has demonstrated clinical benefits that may facilitate steroid reduction. OBJECTIVE: This study evaluated real-world patterns of steroid tapering following efgartigimod initiation in the U.S. METHODS: STRIVE-gMG is a retrospective chart review of patients with gMG who received efgartigimod (≥2 cycles) and concurrent steroids at efgartigimod initiation. Data are collected from neurologists in a specialty panel and from participating medical centers. This interim analysis summarizes initial data from the neurologist panel. RESULTS: As of November 10, 2025, 41 patient charts from 15 neurologists were analyzed. All patients were AChR antibody-positive. At efgartigimod initiation, patients had a mean age of 48.9 years, mean disease duration of 3.7 years, and mean duration on current steroids of 1.1 years. Most (87.8%) had MGFA class II–III disease. Following efgartigimod initiation, all patients tapered steroids, with mean prednisone-equivalent dose decreasing from 30.4 mg/day at efgartigimod initiation to 8.6, 4.9, and 4.0 mg/day at months 6, 12, and 18, respectively; 68.3% discontinued steroids entirely, primarily due to stable disease control. At the end of follow-up, 92.7% remained on efgartigimod, with a median treatment duration of 17.1 months. All patients showed improvements in functional limitations and muscle weakness. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In this interim analysis, efgartigimod was associated with profound reductions in steroid dose while maintaining clinical improvement among patients with gMG. Future studies are needed to examine the impacts of steroid reduction on comorbidities and healthcare utilization. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：gMG患者长期使用类固醇与大量并发症相关。Efgartigimod于2021年在美国获批用于AChR抗体阳性gMG，已证明的临床获益可能有助于减少类固醇。目的：本研究评估美国gMG患者启动efgartigimod后类固醇减量的真实世界模式。方法：STRIVE-gMG是一项回顾性病历审查，纳入接受efgartigimod（≥2个周期）且在efgartigimod启动时同时使用类固醇的gMG患者。数据从专科小组的神经科医生和参与医疗中心收集。本中期分析总结了神经科医生小组的初始数据。结果：截至2025年11月10日，分析了来自15名神经科医生的41份患者病历。所有患者均为AChR抗体阳性。在efgartigimod启动时，患者平均年龄48.9岁，平均病程3.7年，当前类固醇平均使用时间1.1年。大多数（87.8%）为MGFA II–III级疾病。启动efgartigimod后，所有患者均逐渐减少类固醇，平均泼尼松等效剂量从efgartigimod启动时的30.4 mg/天降至第6、12和18个月时的8.6、4.9和4.0 mg/天；68.3%完全停用类固醇，主要由于疾病控制稳定。随访结束时，92.7%仍在接受efgartigimod，中位治疗持续时间17.1个月。所有患者的功能受限和肌无力均显示改善。总结/结论：在本中期分析中，efgartigimod与gMG患者类固醇剂量大幅减少相关，同时维持临床改善。需要未来研究检查类固醇减少对合并症和医疗保健利用的影响。海报会议I和II

abstracts.title: Structural Feasibility of Advanced Therapies for Generalized Myasthenia Gravis in Safety-net Care: Development and Application of a six-domain Evaluation Framework
abstracts.authors: Justin Romero; Amit Sachdev
abstracts.affiliations: Lansing, MI; Okemos, MI
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Advanced biologic therapies have expanded treatment options for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), yet real-world implementation may be limited by logistical and administrative barriers within safety-net healthcare systems. Structural factors such as medication storage requirements, infection-prevention infrastructure, and complex authorization processes may affect whether therapies can be delivered to patients experiencing housing instability or structural vulnerabilities. OBJECTIVE: To develop and apply a structured framework to evaluate the structural feasibility of advanced gMG therapies in safety-net care environments. METHODS: We developed the Myasthenia Gravis Structural Access and Feasibility Evaluation (MG-SAFE) framework, a six-domain assessment instrument evaluating implementation barriers across administration modality and patient burden, dosing frequency and visit burden, clinical monitoring requirements, infection-risk infrastructure, storage and handling practicality, and access/administrative feasibility. Domains were scored using a five-point Likert scale (1–5), with higher scores indicating greater structural feasibility. Composite MG- SAFE scores (range 6–30) were calculated for six FDA- approved advanced gMG therapies using publicly available prescribing information and regulatory documentation. RESULTS: Composite MG-SAFE scores ranged from 12 to 22. The highest structural feasibility scores were observed for efgartigimod IV and rozanolixizumab (score 22). Ravulizumab demonstrated greater feasibility (score 19) than eculizumab (score 18) due to less frequent dosing intervals. Efgartigimod SC demonstrated intermediate feasibility (score 18), while zilucoplan demonstrated the lowest feasibility (score 12), reflecting daily self-injection, refrigeration requirements, infection- risk infrastructure, and complex access pathways. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Structural feasibility varies substantially across advanced gMG therapies. The MG- SAFE framework provides a structured approach for evaluating implementation barriers and may help inform therapy selection and equitable access in safety-net neurology settings. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：先进生物制剂疗法已扩展了全身型肌无力（gMG）的治疗选择，但真实世界实施可能受限于安全网医疗体系内的后勤和行政障碍。诸如药物储存要求、感染预防基础设施以及复杂的授权流程等结构性因素，可能影响这些疗法能否提供给存在住房不稳定或结构性脆弱性的患者。目的：开发并应用一个结构化框架，以评估先进gMG疗法在安全网医疗环境中的结构性可行性。方法：我们开发了肌无力结构性可及性与可行性评估（MG-SAFE）框架，这是一个六域评估工具，评估实施障碍，涵盖给药方式和患者负担、给药频率和就诊负担、临床监测要求、感染风险基础设施、储存和处理实用性以及可及性/行政可行性。各域采用五点Likert量表（1–5分）评分，评分越高表示结构性可行性越高。使用公开可得的处方信息和监管文件，计算了六种FDA批准的先进gMG疗法的MG-SAFE综合评分（范围6–30）。结果：MG-SAFE综合评分范围为12至22。结构性可行性评分最高的是efgartigimod IV和rozanolixizumab（评分22）。由于给药间隔更少，ravulizumab显示出比eculizumab（评分18）更高的可行性（评分19）。Efgartigimod SC显示出中等可行性（评分18），而zilucoplan可行性最低（评分12），反映了每日自我注射、冷藏要求、感染风险基础设施和复杂的可及路径。总结/结论：先进gMG疗法之间的结构性可行性差异显著。MG-SAFE框架为评估实施障碍提供了一种结构化方法，可能有助于在安全网神经科环境中指导治疗选择和公平可及。海报会议I和II

abstracts.title: The Association between Physical Activity and Sedentary Behaviour with Daily Life Quality in Patients with Myasthenia Gravis: A Cross-sectional Study
abstracts.authors: Jiayu Shi; Yike Wang; Yangyu Huang; Jingwen Yan; Ying Tan; Yuzhou Guan
abstracts.affiliations: Beijing, China
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an autoimmune disorder characterized by muscle weakness and fatigue, significantly impacting patients' quality of life (QoL). While physical activity (PA) is suggested to be beneficial, many patients maintain sedentary lifestyles due to fear of symptom exacerbation. OBJECTIVE: To investigate the association between PA levels, sedentary behavior, and QoL in MG patients. METHODS: This cross-sectional study included 200 MG patients from Peking Union Medical College Hospital (2019–2021). PA levels were assessed using the Active Australia Survey, and sedentary time was measured via the Past-Day Recall of Sedentary Time. QoL was evaluated using the MG-QoL15 scale. Statistical analysis was conducted using Mann-Whitney tests, ANOVA, and multiple linear regression, adjusting for factors such as age, BMI, and disease duration. RESULTS: Approximately 48.3% of participants were sufficiently active, while 50.5% reported sedentary behavior exceeding 10 hours per day. A significant negative correlation was found between PA levels and MG-QoL15 scores (B=-0.004, p<0.001), indicating higher PA was associated with better QoL. Conversely, sedentary time showed a positive correlation with MG-QoL15 scores (B=0.0095, p<0.001), suggesting more sedentary behavior was linked to poorer QoL. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: The findings confirm that higher physical activity levels are associated with improved quality of life in MG patients, while prolonged sedentary behavior is detrimental. These results highlight the importance of promoting active lifestyles to enhance QoL in MG patients. Future research should explore interventions to reduce sedentary time and promote physical activity in this population. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：肌无力（MG）是一种以肌无力和疲劳为特征的自身免疫性疾病，显著影响患者的生活质量（QoL）。虽然建议进行体力活动（PA），但许多患者因担心症状加重而保持久坐生活方式。目的：探讨MG患者PA水平、久坐行为与QoL之间的关联。方法：本横断面研究纳入北京协和医院200例MG患者（2019–2021年）。PA水平采用Active Australia Survey评估，久坐时间通过Past-Day Recall of Sedentary Time测量。QoL采用MG-QoL15量表评估。统计分析采用Mann-Whitney检验、ANOVA和多元线性回归，并调整年龄、BMI和病程等因素。结果：约48.3%的参与者活动充分，而50.5%报告久坐行为超过每天10小时。PA水平与MG-QoL15评分呈显著负相关（B=-0.004，p<0.001），表明较高的PA与更好的QoL相关。相反，久坐时间与MG-QoL15评分呈正相关（B=0.0095，p<0.001），提示更多久坐行为与更差的QoL相关。总结/结论：研究结果证实，较高的体力活动水平与MG患者更好的生活质量相关，而长时间久坐行为有害。这些结果强调了促进积极生活方式以改善MG患者QoL的重要性。未来研究应探索减少久坐时间和促进该人群体力活动的干预措施。海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: Treatment Satisfaction and Physician–patient Cognitive Disparities in Patients with Myasthenia Gravis: A Multicenter Cross-sectional Survey
abstracts.authors: Ying Tan; Jingwen Yan; Yangyu Huang; Jiayu Shi; Jian Yin; Chongbo Zhao; Yuzhou Guan
abstracts.affiliations: Beijing, China; Shanghai, China
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is a rare autoimmune disorder requiring long-term treatment. In clinical practice, cognitive disparities often exist between physicians and patients regarding treatment outcomes, and patient needs may be overlooked. OBJECTIVE: In this study, we investigated the satisfaction of patients with MG with current treatments and determined the cognitive differences between patients and physicians regarding the goals of treating MG. METHODS: A multicenter cross-sectional study and analysis were conducted using the Cloud Service Platform for Rare Diseases from April to June 2025. Demographic data, the Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America (MGFA) clinical classification, current treatment status, and self-assessment of the effectiveness of treatment were collected from 898 patients with MG treated across 46 hospitals nationwide. Additionally, evaluations of the current MG treatment status were collected from 79 specialist physicians across the country. RESULTS: Among patients, 36.4% were "very satisfied" and 37.8% "relatively satisfied" with treatment. Common burdens included insomnia/cognitive fatigue (45.1%), anxiety from symptom fluctuation (41.6%), and financial stress (41.1%). Cushingoid appearance/weight gain was the most frequent side effect (19.3%). Among physicians, 81% were "relatively satisfied" with patient status. While 68.4% prioritized achieving guideline-recommended treatment targets, 16.5% never introduced MG self- assessment scales to patients. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Although most patients and physicians express satisfaction, significant disease burdens persist. The findings underscore the need to refine objective efficacy evaluations and improve the adoption of self-assessment tools in clinical practice. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：肌无力（MG）是一种需要长期治疗的罕见自身免疫性疾病。在临床实践中，医生和患者之间在治疗结局方面常存在认知差异，患者需求可能被忽视。目的：在本研究中，我们调查了MG患者对当前治疗的满意度，并确定了患者和医生在MG治疗目标方面的认知差异。方法：2025年4月至6月，使用罕见病云服务平台开展了一项多中心横断面研究和分析。收集了全国46家医院治疗的898例MG患者的人口学数据、美国肌无力基金会（MGFA）临床分型、当前治疗状态和治疗效果自我评估。此外，还收集了全国79名专科医生对当前MG治疗状态的评估。结果：在患者中，36.4%对治疗“非常满意”，37.8%“比较满意”。常见负担包括失眠/认知疲劳（45.1%）、症状波动引起的焦虑（41.6%）和经济压力（41.1%）。库欣样外观/体重增加是最常见的不良反应（19.3%）。在医生中，81%对患者状态“比较满意”。虽然68.4%优先考虑达到指南推荐的治疗目标，但16.5%从未向患者介绍MG自评量表。总结/结论：尽管大多数患者和医生表示满意，但显著的疾病负担仍然存在。研究结果强调需要完善客观疗效评估，并提高自评工具在临床实践中的采用。海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: Clinical features and outcomes of very late-onset myasthenia gravis: Insights from a greek center of reference
abstracts.authors: E. Strataki; D. Tzavella; K. Kournis; A. Vakrakou; V. Zouvelou
abstracts.affiliations: 1st Department of Neurology, National and Kapodistrian University of Athens, Athens, Greece, Eginition Hospital, ERN EURO-NMD
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: The demographic profile of myasthe- nia gravis (MG) has shifted in recent decades, with increasing prevalence among older individuals. This study investigates the clinical characteristics and outcomes of patients with very late- onset MG (VLOMG), defined as disease onset at ≥ 65 years. Methods: We retrospectively reviewed patients with VLOMG registered in the Specialized Myasthenia Clinic database be- tween Jan-2008 and Dec-2025. Results: A total of 102 patients were included (72 males, 30 females), with a mean follow-up of 47.86 months. Mean age at diagnosis was 73.88 ± 6.65 years (range: 65–91), with a mean diagnostic delay of 5.1 months. Thymoma was identified in 3.92%, autoimmune disease in 11.76%, malignancies in 17.65%, and other comorbidities in 91.18%. Overall, 99% were seropos- itive; 94.11% AChR-Abs(+) and 4.9% MuSK-Abs(+). AChR-Abs titers ranged from 0.8 to 433nM/L (mean 49.07 ± 76.28nM/L). Generalized MG was present in 80.39%, most commonly with oculo-bulbar involvement. Rescue therapies were required in 63.72%; 12.74% required intensive care admission and 5.88% mechanical ventilation. Long-term immunosuppression was used in 93.13%. Advanced immunotherapies included rituximab (17.65%), FcRn antagonists (6.86%), ravulizumab (1.96%), and to- cilizumab in one patient with concomitant thyroid eye disease. At last follow-up, 68.62% achieved minimal manifestations or better and 19.6% showed clinical improvement, on a mean daily prednisolone dose of 6.75mg. Conclusion: VLOMG represents a distinct MG subgroup char- acterized by male predominance, predominant bulbar phe- notype, rare thymoma and high AChR positivity. Despite a significant comorbidity burden, early immunosuppression en- ables effective disease control with low maintenance cortico- steroid doses. Novel and targeted immunotherapies may be safe and effective in elderly patients.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景和目的：近几十年来，重症肌无力（MG）的人口统计学特征发生了变化，在老年人中的患病率增加。本研究调查了极晚发型MG（VLOMG）患者的临床特征和结局，VLOMG定义为发病年龄≥65岁。方法：我们回顾性分析了2008年1月至2025年12月期间在专科重症肌无力门诊数据库中注册的VLOMG患者。结果：共纳入102例患者（男性72例，女性30例），平均随访47.86个月。诊断时的平均年龄为73.88 ± 6.65岁（范围：65–91），平均诊断延迟为5.1个月。胸腺瘤检出率为3.92%，自身免疫性疾病为11.76%，恶性肿瘤为17.65%，其他合并症为91.18%。总体而言，99%为血清阳性；94.11%为AChR抗体（+），4.9%为MuSK抗体（+）。AChR抗体滴度范围为0.8至433 nM/L（平均值49.07 ± 76.28 nM/L）。80.39%的患者为全身型MG，最常见的是眼-延髓受累。63.72%的患者需要抢救治疗；12.74%需要重症监护入院，5.88%需要机械通气。93.13%的患者使用了长期免疫抑制治疗。先进的免疫疗法包括利妥昔单抗（17.65%）、FcRn拮抗剂（6.86%）、拉武利珠单抗（1.96%），以及一名合并甲状腺眼病患者使用的托珠单抗。在最后一次随访时，68.62%的患者达到最小临床表现或更好，19.6%显示临床改善，平均每日泼尼松龙剂量为6.75 mg。结论：VLOMG代表一个独特的MG亚组，其特征为男性占优势、以延髓表型为主、胸腺瘤罕见和高AChR阳性率。尽管合并症负担显著，但早期免疫抑制治疗能够以较低的维持性皮质类固醇剂量实现有效的疾病控制。新型和靶向免疫疗法在老年患者中可能是安全有效的。

abstracts.title: Effectiveness of early efgartigimod use in adult gMG patients in Japan: A retrospective study
abstracts.authors: R. Aoyagi1; H. Teranishi1; K. Tsuda1; Y. Zheng2; J. Luo2; S. Inagaki2; M. Takahashi3; C. Blein4
abstracts.affiliations: 1argenx Japan, Tokyo, Japan; 2ZS Associates; 3Osaka University, Japan; 4argenx BVBA, Ghent, Belgium
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: This study evaluated the impact of intravenous/subcutaneous efgartigimod (EFG) on treatment burden in Japanese patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) between heavily pre-treated (HPT) and less heavily pre- treated (LHPT) cohorts. Methods: We conducted a retrospective cohort analysis using hospital-based claims from Medical Data Vision of adult gMG patients initiating EFG between May 2022, and April 2025. Eligible patients had 12-month baseline and follow-up obser- vation, oral glucocorticoids (GC) or non-steroidal immuno- suppressants within 90-days pre-EFG initiation, and no other biologics during follow-up (Figure 1). HPT was defined as > = 2 baseline fast-acting treatment (FT) cycles (intravenous immu- noglobulin, plasma exchange, intravenous methylprednisolone) or > = 20 mg/day prednisolone-equivalent oral GC dose within 90 days pre-EFG initiation; all others were LHPT. Outcomes were oral GC average daily dose (ADD) and FT cycles counts. Results: Among 260 patients identified, 58% were HPT and 42% were LHPT. Mean duration from first recorded gMG diagnosis to index, and EFG treatment duration did not differ between cohorts (HPT: 5.7 years, 455 days; LHPT: 5.9 years, 447 days; p = 0.635, p = 0.816 respectively). Mean oral GC ADD approxi- mately halved after EFG initiation in both cohorts (HPT: 19.1 to 9.6 mg/day, LHPT: 14.2 to 7.1 mg/day, baseline to follow-up). LHPT had higher proportion of patients achieving < = 5 mg/day throughout follow-up (Figure 2) and one-third as many FT cycles per patient versus HPT during follow-up (0.45 vs. 1.46, Figure 3). abstracts.abstractZh: 背景和目的：本研究评估了静脉/皮下注射艾加莫德（EFG）对日本全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者治疗负担的影响，比较了重度预治疗（HPT）和轻度预治疗（LHPT）队列。方法：我们使用Medical Data Vision的医院索赔数据，对2022年5月至2025年4月期间启动EFG的成人gMG患者进行了一项回顾性队列分析。符合条件的患者在EFG启动前90天内进行了12个月的基线和随访观察，使用了口服糖皮质激素（GC）或非甾体免疫抑制剂，并且在随访期间未使用其他生物制剂（图1）。HPT定义为在EFG启动前90天内基线快速作用治疗（FT）周期≥2个（静脉注射免疫球蛋白、血浆置换、静脉注射甲泼尼龙）或口服GC剂量≥20 mg/天泼尼松龙等效剂量；其余均为LHPT。结局指标为口服GC平均日剂量（ADD）和FT周期计数。结果：在确定的260例患者中，58%为HPT，42%为LHPT。从首次记录gMG诊断到索引日期的平均时间以及EFG治疗持续时间在队列间无差异（HPT：5.7年，455天；LHPT：5.9年，447天；p=0.635，p=0.816）。两个队列在EFG启动后，平均口服GC ADD大约减半（HPT：从19.1降至9.6 mg/天，LHPT：从14.2降至7.1 mg/天，从基线到随访）。LHPT组在整个随访期间达到≤5 mg/天的患者比例更高（图2），并且在随访期间每名患者的FT周期数是HPT组的三分之一（0.45 vs. 1.46，图3）。结论：LHPT组始终显示出较低的治疗负担，而两个队列均观察到有效的口服GC减量。在疾病管理的早期阶段启动EFG可能会改善真实世界的治疗结局。

abstracts.title: Efficacy and tolerability of nipocalimab in patients with generalized myasthenia gravis: Real-world experience from an Academic Center
abstracts.authors: J. Greenberg; M. Seyam; S. Muppidi; N. Goyal Department of Neurology and Neurological Sciences, Stanford University, Redwood City, USA
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Nipocalimab, a neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn) inhibitor, was approved in April 2025 for treatment of an- tibody positive generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). However, data from clinical practice is limited. Here we describe a single academic institution's experience with nipocalimab. Methods: A retrospective review of 11 gMG patients who received nipocalimab between May–November 2025 was conducted. Data was collected regarding demographics, comor- bidities, antibody status, treatment history, Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) scores, side effects, and corticosteroid dose. Results: Most patients were antibody positive (n = 9 acetylcho- line receptor, n = 1 muscle-specific tyrosine kinase, n = 1 sero- negative). Mean baseline MG-ADL was 8 (±3.98). In all patients, nipocalimab was started due to refractory symptoms and/or intolerable side effects with prior treatments. MG-ADL scores improved by a mean of 1.9 points (p = 0.017), and 63.6% (7/11) of patients had a clinically significant improvement (reduction ≥ 2 in MG-ADL score) at follow up 10.6 (±4.7) weeks after treatment initiation. Nine patients previously failed one or more FcRN in- hibitors (n = 6 efgartigimod, n = 1 rozanolixizumab, n = 2 both) due to inefficacy (n = 2) or wearing off between cycles (n = 7). 77.8% (7/9) tolerated nipocalimab, and the reduction in MG- ADL score remained statistically significant (p = 0.034). Only 1 patient reported wearing off. 100% (7/7) of patients on corti- costeroids successfully lowered or discontinued dosage without symptom worsening. Conclusion: We found nipocalimab to be effective, fast-acting, and well tolerated in patients with refractory gMG, leading to modest clinical improvement and steroid tapering in most pa- tients. Nipocalimab was effective in patients who had previously failed other FcRn inhibitors and wearing off between doses was uncommon.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：Nipocalimab，一种新生儿Fc受体（FcRn）抑制剂，于2025年4月获批用于治疗抗体阳性全身型重症肌无力（gMG）。然而，来自临床实践的数据有限。本文描述了一家学术机构使用nipocalimab的经验。方法：对2025年5月至11月期间接受nipocalimab治疗的11例gMG患者进行回顾性分析。收集了关于人口统计学、合并症、抗体状态、治疗史、重症肌无力日常生活活动能力（MG-ADL）评分、副作用和皮质类固醇剂量的数据。结果：大多数患者为抗体阳性（n=9乙酰胆碱受体，n=1肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶，n=1血清阴性）。平均基线MG-ADL评分为8（±3.98）。在所有患者中，由于既往治疗出现难治性症状和/或无法耐受的副作用而开始使用nipocalimab。在治疗开始后平均10.6（±4.7）周的随访中，MG-ADL评分平均改善1.9分（p=0.017），63.6%（7/11）的患者出现具有临床意义的改善（MG-ADL评分降低≥2分）。9名患者既往因无效（n=2）或周期间疗效减退（n=7）而未能从一种或多种FcRn抑制剂（n=6 efgartigimod，n=1 rozanolixizumab，n=2两者均使用）中获益。77.8%（7/9）的患者耐受nipocalimab，MG-ADL评分的降低仍具有统计学显著性（p=0.034）。仅1名患者报告疗效减退。100%（7/7）使用皮质类固醇的患者成功降低剂量或停药，且症状未加重。结论：我们发现nipocalimab对难治性gMG患者有效、起效快且耐受性良好，在大多数患者中实现了适度的临床改善和类固醇减量。Nipocalimab对既往其他FcRn抑制剂治疗失败的患者有效，且剂量间疗效减退不常见。

abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Generalized Myasthenia gravis (gMG) is a rare chronic autoimmune disease affecting the postsynap- tic membrane of the neuromuscular junction. New treatment options, such as the C5 inhibitors, are growing with promis- ing results. In this study we investigated the real-world use of Zilucoplan for AChR-positive gMG in Italy. Methods: Zilucoplan was self-administered by daily subcuta- neous injections. Efficacy was assessed by Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America Post-intervention status (MGFA- PIS), Myasthenia Gravis Activity of Daily Living (MG-ADL), Myasthenia Gravis Composite (MGC), Myasthenia Gravis quan- titative (QMG) scales and 15-items Myasthenia Gravis Quality of Life (MG-QOL-15) questionnaire at baseline and after 1, 4, 12, 24 and 48 weeks. Results: 54 patients (37 females, aged 57.3 years) were included in the follow-up analysis. Clinical improvements observed in the initial study were sustained over time, with stable or fur- ther reduced MG-ADL, QMG, MGC and MG-QOL-15r scored over weeks. Moreover, it was also observed a continued steroid- sparing effect and a reduction of hospitalization due to MG worsening. Treatment adherence remained high, and no new safety report emerged during the extended follow-up. Conclusion: Zilucoplan has proven to be well-tolerated and effective in most patients with AChR-positive gMG. A clinical meaningful effect was reported since the first week and was sus- tained during the following weeks. Further studies are needed to confirm these preliminary real-life data.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种罕见的慢性自身免疫性疾病，影响神经肌肉接头的突触后膜。新的治疗选择，如C5抑制剂，正在增多并显示出有希望的结果。在本研究中，我们调查了Zilucoplan在意大利AChR阳性gMG患者中的真实世界使用情况。方法：Zilucoplan通过每日皮下注射自行给药。在基线以及第1、4、12、24和48周后，通过美国重症肌无力基金会干预后状态（MGFA-PIS）、重症肌无力日常生活活动能力（MG-ADL）、重症肌无力复合量表（MGC）、重症肌无力定量（QMG）量表和15项重症肌无力生活质量（MG-QOL-15）问卷评估疗效。结果：54名患者（37名女性，平均年龄57.3岁）被纳入随访分析。初始研究中观察到的临床改善随时间持续，MG-ADL、QMG、MGC和MG-QOL-15r评分在数周内保持稳定或进一步降低。此外，还观察到持续的类固醇节省效应以及因MG加重导致的住院减少。治疗依从性仍然很高，并且在延长的随访期间没有出现新的安全性报告。结论：Zilucoplan已被证明对大多数AChR阳性gMG患者耐受性良好且有效。自第一周起即报告了具有临床意义的效应，并在随后几周内持续。需要进一步的研究来确认这些初步的真实世界数据。

abstracts.title: Patient preferences and willingness-to-pay for therapy in generalized myasthenia Gravis: A large- scale discrete choice experiment in China
abstracts.authors: Y. Xu1; L. Feng2; M. Zhang1; J. Zhou1; H. Xiao1; Y. Ni1; R. Wang2; Y. He2; Q. Jiang2; J. Peng2; H. Chen2; H. Zhou3; D. He1; S. Luo1; J. Xi1; J. Song1; C. Yan1; J. Lu1; C. Zhao1
abstracts.affiliations: 1Huashan Rare Disease Center and Department of Neurology, National Center for Neurological Disorders, Huashan Hospital, Fudan University, Shanghai, China; 2Department of Neurology, West China Hospital, Sichuan University/West China School of Nursing, Sichuan University, Chengdu, China; 3Department of Neurology, West China Hospital, Sichuan University, Chengdu, China
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Understanding patients' preferences for Generalised Myasthenia Gravis (gMG) is essential for in- formed treatment decisions. However, limited evidence is avail- able regarding how Chinese patients weigh safety, efficacy, onset speed, and convenience when choosing treatments. This study aimed to assess treatment preferences and willingness to pay (WTP) among Chinese patients. Methods: This multicenter, cross-sectional survey was con- ducted from March to August 2025 among gMG patients across China. A discrete choice experiment was used to quantify patient preferences by presenting hypothetical treatment scenarios. Results: Of 909 analysed patients, treatment safety was a key determinant of patient preferences. Oral administration was most preferred, followed by subcutaneous injection. Less fre- quent dosing was strongly favoured: once every 6 months, and once daily, compared to 2–3 times daily. Younger patients paid more attention to low-frequency dosing, subcutaneous injection, and liver and kidney function impairment than older patients. Patients with MGFA class II were more concerned about oral ad- ministration, once-weekly dosing, infection risk, and myelosup- pression. High-income patients (>¥100,000) favoured low risk of metabolic disease, infection, myelosuppression, and liver and kidney function impairment and infrequent (weekly, biweekly, or every-6-month), subcutaneous administration, and were less sensitive to cost compared to low- (< ¥50,000) and medium- income groups (¥50,000–100,000). Conclusion: Safety, infrequent and convenient administration route (oral/subcutaneous), affordable cost, and rapid onset of action were prioritised. Patients were willing to invest finan- cially in therapies that align with these preferences. Embedding TABLE 1 The disease characteristics and treatment of patients with gMG TABLE 2 Analysis of patients' medication preferences and willingness to pay. FIGURE 1 The selection probability of gMG patients. patient preferences in clinical decision-making and reimburse- ment policy can improve adherence, reduce disease burden, and enhance quality of life for individuals with gMG in China.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：了解全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者的偏好对于做出知情治疗决策至关重要。然而，关于中国患者在选择治疗时如何权衡安全性、疗效、起效速度和便利性的证据有限。本研究旨在评估中国患者的治疗偏好和支付意愿（WTP）。方法：这项多中心横断面调查于2025年3月至8月在中国gMG患者中进行。采用离散选择实验，通过呈现假设的治疗场景来量化患者偏好。结果：在分析的909名患者中，治疗安全性是患者偏好的关键决定因素。口服给药最受青睐，其次是皮下注射。较低频率的给药受到强烈青睐：每6个月一次和每日一次，相比于每日2-3次。年轻患者比老年患者更关注低频给药、皮下注射以及肝肾功能损害。MGFA II级患者更关注口服给药、每周一次给药、感染风险和骨髓抑制。高收入患者（>10万元人民币）相比于低收入（<5万元人民币）和中收入（5-10万元人民币）群体，更青睐低代谢疾病风险、感染、骨髓抑制和肝肾功能损害风险，以及低频（每周、每两周或每6个月一次）皮下给药，并且对成本较不敏感。结论：安全性、低频且方便的给药途径（口服/皮下）、可负担的成本和快速起效是优先考虑的因素。患者愿意为符合这些偏好的疗法进行财务投入。将患者偏好纳入临床决策和报销政策可以提高依从性、减轻疾病负担并改善中国gMG患者的生活质量。

abstracts.title: Rapid, sustained improvements with efgartigimod in symptoms, daily life, and patient satisfaction in gMG: Initial results from the PREMIER study
abstracts.authors: T. Ruck1; C. Qi2; M. Yang3; A. Anderson4; V. Bril5; C. Edmundson6; D. Gelinas7; T. Hughes2; G. Phillips2; L. Li2; B. Martins3; C. Xiang3; K. Heerlein2; C. Bergin2; B. Lin3; J. Liu3; G. Wolfe8
abstracts.affiliations: 1Department of Neurology, BG University-Hospital Bergmannsheil, Ruhr-University Bochum, Bochum, Germany; 2argenx US Inc, Boston, USA; 3Analysis Group, Inc. Boston, USA; 4Department of Neurology, Houston Methodist, Houston, USA; 5Ellen and Martin Prosserman Centre for Neuromuscular Diseases, University Health Network, Toronto General Hospital, University of Toronto, Toronto, Canada; 6Swedish Neuroscience Institute, Seattle, USA; 7Department of Neurology, UNC School of Medicine, Chapel Hill, USA; 8Department of Neurology, Jacobs School of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences, University at Buffalo, Buffalo, USA
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Efgartigimod is a neonatal Fc receptor blocker indicated for the treatment of generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in adults. We report initial findings of the ongoing Prospective Real-world study of EfgartigiMod for patIents with gEneralized myasthenia gRavis (PREMIER). Methods: Adult patients prescribed efgartigimod were recruited from enrollees of the efgartigimod patient support program in the US. Patients completed surveys before (baseline) and at weeks (WKs) 4, 12, 20, and 32 after efgartigimod initiation. Surveys included questions on gMG symptoms and patients’ functional status using MG Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL), Patient- Acceptable Symptom State (PASS), changes in ability to work, corticosteroid use, and overall treatment satisfaction. Results: To date, 143 patients enrolled in PREMIER and 52 completed the WK32 survey, with 75.0% continuing on efgartigi- mod. Mean (standard deviation) age at baseline was 64.8 (14.1); 48.9% were female. Mean baseline MG-ADL was 8.6, improving by 4.2 points by WK32 (p < 0.001), with larger improvements (4.7 points; p < 0.001) in those remaining on efgartigimod (Figure 1). Satisfaction with current disease (yes vs. no), assessed by PASS, increased from 25.2% at baseline to 51.9% at WK32 (p < 0.001) (Figure 2), and satisfaction with treatments improved from 38.5% to 71.2%. Ability to work improvements were reported by 42.9% (18 of 42 participants) by WK20. The proportion of pa- tients without corticosteroids increased from 38.5% at baseline to 59.6% by WK32 (p < 0.05) (Figure 3). Conclusion: Initial results from PREMIER show rapid and sus- tained improvements in symptoms, daily life, ability to work, and patient satisfaction, along with reduction in corticoste- roid use.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：Efgartigimod是一种新生儿Fc受体阻滞剂，适用于成人全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的治疗。我们报告正在进行的efgartigimod治疗gMG患者的前瞻性真实世界研究（PREMIER）的初步结果。方法：从美国efgartigimod患者支持计划的登记者中招募被处方efgartigimod的成年患者。患者在基线以及efgartigimod开始后第4、12、20和32周完成调查。调查包括关于gMG症状和患者功能状态的问题，使用MG日常生活活动能力（MG-ADL）、患者可接受的症状状态（PASS）、工作能力变化、皮质类固醇使用和总体治疗满意度。结果：迄今为止，143名患者参加了PREMIER，52名完成了第32周调查，其中75.0%继续使用efgartigimod。基线时的平均（标准差）年龄为64.8（14.1）岁；48.9%为女性。平均基线MG-ADL为8.6，到第32周改善了4.2分（p < 0.001），在继续使用efgartigimod的患者中改善更大（4.7分；p < 0.001）（图1）。通过PASS评估的对当前疾病的满意度（是 vs. 否）从基线的25.2%增加到第32周的51.9%（p < 0.001）（图2），对治疗的满意度从38.5%提高到71.2%。到第20周，42.9%（42名参与者中的18名）报告工作能力改善。未使用皮质类固醇的患者比例从基线的38.5%增加到第32周的59.6%（p < 0.05）（图3）。结论：PREMIER的初步结果显示，efgartigimod在症状、日常生活、工作能力和患者满意度方面实现了快速且持续的改善，同时减少了皮质类固醇的使用。

abstracts.title: Safety and effectiveness of efgartigimod in Japanese patients with generalized myasthenia gravis by serostatus: Post-marketing surveillance analysis
abstracts.authors: H. Teranishi1; R. Aoyagi1; D. Harada1; M. Watanabe2
abstracts.affiliations: 1argenx Japan K.K, Tokyo, Japan; 2Kyushu University Hospital, Fukuoka, Japan
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Efgartigimod for intravenous infu- sion (efgartigimod-IV) is approved in Japan for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) regardless of auto-antibody profiles. Post-marketing surveillance for efgartigimod-IV in gMG was performed to assess the safety and effectiveness in real-world settings in Japan. Methods: Patients with gMG who received efgartigimod-IV between May 2022 and September 2023 were registered. Effectiveness was evaluated by Myasthenia Gravis-Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) total and subdomain (ocular, bulbar, limb/gross motor, respiratory) scores. The change of oral gluco- corticoid dose was also evaluated. Results: The safety analysis set consisted of 469 patients: 57.1% (n = 268) anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody posi- tive (AChR-Ab+), 13.4% (n = 63) anti-muscle-specific recep- tor kinase antibody positive (MuSK-Ab+), and 29.4% (n = 138) double-seronegative. Adverse drug reaction and serious ad- verse drug reaction were reported in 22.6% and 4.2% of patients, respectively. No specific safety signals were observed in any of the serological profiles. The effectiveness analysis set consisted of 307 patients with a similar composition ratio of serological profile to the safety analysis set. After three weeks from the first administration, mean MG-ADL total score improved from 7.2 to 4.2: −3.0 points (standard deviation: 2.98, p < 0.001). Substantial improvements were observed in all subdomain scores regardless of serological profiles. Mean dose of oral glucocorticoid (stan- dard deviation) (mg/day) at baseline and one year later were 10.7 (7.42) and 7.7 (5.41), respectively. Conclusion: In real-world settings, efgartigimod-IV was well tolerated and effective in patients with gMG regardless of sero- logical profiles. Oral glucocorticoid dose reduction was observed after efgartigimod administration.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：Efgartigimod 静脉输注（efgartigimod-IV）在日本获批用于治疗全身型重症肌无力（gMG），无论自身抗体谱如何。对 gMG 中 efgartigimod-IV 进行上市后监测，以评估其在日本真实世界中的安全性和有效性。方法：注册了 2022 年 5 月至 2023 年 9 月期间接受 efgartigimod-IV 治疗的 gMG 患者。有效性通过重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）总分和子域（眼部、延髓、肢体/大运动、呼吸）评分进行评估。还评估了口服糖皮质激素剂量的变化。结果：安全性分析集包括 469 名患者：57.1%（n=268）抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+），13.4%（n=63）抗肌肉特异性受体酪氨酸激酶抗体阳性（MuSK-Ab+），29.4%（n=138）双血清阴性。药物不良反应和严重药物不良反应分别报告于 22.6% 和 4.2% 的患者。在任何血清学谱中均未观察到特定的安全性信号。有效性分析集包括 307 名患者，其血清学谱组成比例与安全性分析集相似。首次给药后三周，平均 MG-ADL 总分从 7.2 改善至 4.2：−3.0 分（标准差：2.98，p < 0.001）。无论血清学谱如何，所有子域评分均观察到显著改善。基线时和一年后口服糖皮质激素的平均剂量（标准差）（mg/天）分别为 10.7（7.42）和 7.7（5.41）。结论：在真实世界环境中，efgartigimod-IV 在 gMG 患者中耐受性良好且有效，无论血清学谱如何。在 efgartigimod 给药后观察到口服糖皮质激素剂量减少。

abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Efgartigimod is a human immunoglob- ulin G1 (IgG1) Fc fragment that blocks the neonatal Fc receptor. ADAPT-SC+ (NCT04818671) was an open-label extension study evaluating long-term safety and efficacy of subcutaneous (SC) efgartigimod PH20 (coformulated with recombinant human hy- aluronidase PH20) in participants with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). Methods: Efgartigimod PH20 SC 1000 mg was administered in cycles of 4 once-weekly injections. Subsequent cycles were initiated based on clinical evaluation (Year 1, ≥ 4 weeks between cycles; Year 2 and onward, ≥1 week between cycles following protocol amendment). Efficacy was assessed using Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL). Quality of life (QoL) impact was assessed during Year 1 using Myasthenia Gravis Quality of Life 15-Item Questionnaire, Revised (MG-QoL15r). Results: During ADAPT-SC+, 180 participants received ≥1 ef- gartigimod PH20 SC injection (mean [SD] study duration, 2.6 [0.9] years; 459.4 participant years of follow-up). Adverse events were predominantly mild/moderate (Table 1). After Year 1, ef- gartigimod remained well tolerated in both participants who av- eraged <4 weeks and ≥4 weeks between treatment cycles. Among anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody–positive (AChR-Ab+) par- ticipants, mean MG-ADL improvements were sustained from Week 1 through Week 163 (Figure 1). Most AChR-Ab+ partic- ipants (59.2%) achieved minimal symptom expression (MSE; MG-ADL score, 0–1) at least once, and 88.1% of those with MSE at least once sustained MSE during ≥4 weeks. Mean MG-QoL15r improvements were observed by Week 1 and sustained through Week 55 (Figure 2). Conclusion: Long-term efgartigimod PH20 SC treatment was well tolerated and led to sustained efficacy and QoL improve- ments during ADAPT-SC+.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：Efgartigimod 是一种人免疫球蛋白 G1（IgG1）Fc 片段，可阻断新生儿 Fc 受体。ADAPT-SC+（NCT04818671）是一项开放标签扩展研究，评估皮下（SC）注射 efgartigimod PH20（与重组人透明质酸酶 PH20 共同配制）在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）参与者中的长期安全性和有效性。方法：Efgartigimod PH20 SC 1000 mg 以每周期 4 次每周注射的方式给药。后续周期根据临床评估启动（第 1 年，周期之间间隔 ≥ 4 周；第 2 年及以后，方案修订后周期之间间隔 ≥ 1 周）。使用重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）评估疗效。在第 1 年使用重症肌无力生活质量 15 项问卷修订版（MG-QoL15r）评估生活质量（QoL）影响。结果：在 ADAPT-SC+ 期间，180 名参与者接受了 ≥ 1 次 efgartigimod PH20 SC 注射（平均 [SD] 研究持续时间，2.6 [0.9] 年；459.4 参与者年随访）。不良事件主要为轻度/中度（表 1）。第 1 年后，efgartigimod 在治疗周期平均间隔 <4 周和 ≥4 周的参与者中均保持良好耐受性。在抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）参与者中，平均 MG-ADL 改善从第 1 周持续到第 163 周（图 1）。大多数 AChR-Ab+ 参与者（59.2%）至少一次达到最小症状表达（MSE；MG-ADL 评分，0–1），并且 88.1% 至少一次达到 MSE 的参与者维持 MSE ≥ 4 周。平均 MG-QoL15r 改善在第 1 周观察到并持续到第 55 周（图 2）。结论：在 ADAPT-SC+ 中，长期 efgartigimod PH20 SC 治疗耐受性良好，并导致持续的疗效和生活质量改善。

abstracts.title: Steroids tapering among patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) receiving efgartigimod: Interim results from the STRIVE-gMG chart review
abstracts.authors: A. Habib1; N. Silvestri2; C. Qi2; H. Yang3; A. Corse4; G. Smith5; T. Vu6; G. Wolfe7; L. Li2; S. Lee3; Y. Wu3; D. Ye3; D. Nowacek2; J. Aldridge2; A. Mahajerin2; G. Philips2; J. Howard4

abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Long-term steroids use among pa- tients with gMG is associated with substantial complications. Efgartigimod, approved in the United States (US) in 2021 for AChR antibody-positive gMG, has demonstrated clinical bene- fits that may facilitate steroids reduction. This study evaluated real-world patterns of steroids tapering following efgartigimod initiation in the US. Methods: STRIVE-gMG is a retrospective chart review of pa- tients with gMG who received efgartigimod (≥2 cycles) and con- current steroids at efgartigimod initiation. Data are collected from neurologists in a specialty panel and from participating medical centers. This interim analysis summarizes initial data from the neurologist panel. Results: As of November 10, 2025, 41 patient charts from 15 neurologists were analyzed. All patients were AChR antibody- positive. At efgartigimod initiation, patients had a mean age of 48.9 years, mean disease duration of 3.7 years, and mean dura- tion on current steroids of 1.1 years. Most (87.8%) had MGFA class II–III disease. Following efgartigimod initiation, all pa- tients tapered steroids, with mean prednisone-equivalent dose decreasing from 30.4 mg/day at efgartigimod initiation to 8.6, TABLE 1 Demographics of study participants. Abbreviations: PwMS = Patient with Multiple Sclerosis; HC = Healthy Control; SD = Standard Deviation; IQR = Interquartile Range; EDSS = Expanded Disability Status Scale; p-values calculated using *Chi-Squared Te. TABLE 2 MR Imaging Characteristics describing mean normalized vol- umetry results.Abbreviations: PwMS = Patient with Multiple Sclerosis; HC = Healthy Control; SD = Standard Deviation. p-values calculated using Independent Samples T-Test. 4.9, and 4.0 mg/day at months 6, 12, and 18, respectively; 68.3% discontinued steroids entirely, primarily due to stable disease control. At the end of follow-up, 92.7% remained on efgartigi- mod, with a median treatment duration of 17.1 months. All patients showed improvements in functional limitations and muscle weakness. Conclusion: In this interim analysis, efgartigimod was asso- ciated with profound reductions in steroids dose while main- taining clinical improvement among patients with gMG. Future studies are needed to examine the impacts of steroids reduction on comorbidities and healthcare utilization.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：gMG 患者长期使用类固醇与严重并发症相关。Efgartigimod 于 2021 年在美国获批用于 AChR 抗体阳性 gMG，已显示出可能促进类固醇减量的临床获益。本研究评估了美国 efgartigimod 启动后类固醇减量的真实世界模式。方法：STRIVE-gMG 是一项回顾性病历审查，研究对象为接受 efgartigimod（≥2 个周期）并在 efgartigimod 启动时同时使用类固醇的 gMG 患者。数据从专科小组的神经科医生和参与医疗中心收集。本中期分析总结了来自神经科医生小组的初步数据。结果：截至 2025 年 11 月 10 日，分析了来自 15 位神经科医生的 41 份患者病历。所有患者均为 AChR 抗体阳性。在 efgartigimod 启动时，患者平均年龄为 48.9 岁，平均病程为 3.7 年，当前类固醇使用的平均持续时间为 1.1 年。大多数（87.8%）为 MGFA II–III 级疾病。启动 efgartigimod 后，所有患者均减少了类固醇用量，平均泼尼松等效剂量从 efgartigimod 启动时的 30.4 mg/天降至第 6、12 和 18 个月时的 8.6、4.9 和 4.0 mg/天；68.3% 完全停用类固醇，主要原因是疾病控制稳定。在随访结束时，92.7% 的患者仍在使用 efgartigimod，中位治疗持续时间为 17.1 个月。所有患者的功能限制和肌肉无力均有改善。结论：在这项中期分析中，efgartigimod 与 gMG 患者类固醇剂量的显著减少相关，同时维持了临床改善。未来的研究需要检查类固醇减少对合并症和医疗资源利用的影响。

abstracts.title: A Retrospective Case Series of Repeat Complete Thymectomy in Refractory Non-thymomatous Myasthenia Gravis: Clinical Outcomes via Robotic-associated Thoracoscopic Surgery
abstracts.authors: Spandana Chittajallu; Yaacov Anziska; Jason Shaw
abstracts.affiliations: Brooklyn, NY
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Thymectomy is a well-established treatment for acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibody- positive generalized Myasthenia Gravis (MG). Some patients remain refractory despite thymectomy and aggressive immunotherapy, potentially due to incomplete resection or residual ectopic thymic tissue. Evidence on repeat complete thymectomy in non-thymomatous MG is limited. OBJECTIVE: To describe clinical outcomes of repeat complete thymectomy via robotic-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (RATS) in two patients with long-standing refractory generalized MG. METHODS: Retrospective case series of two AChR antibody-positive patients with refractory non- thymomatous generalized MG (~7 years post-diagnosis) despite prior thymectomy and sequential trials of multiple immunosuppressive agents, who underwent repeat complete thymectomy via RATS at Maimonides Medical Center in 2025. Outcomes included MG Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) score, emergency department (ED) visits, myasthenic crises, and medication changes. RESULTS: Patient 1: A 25-year-old female (MG diagnosed 2016, initial RATS thymectomy 2018) remained refractory despite corticosteroids, IVIG, rituximab, azathioprine, mycophenolate, complement inhibitors, and FcRn antagonists, with frequent ED visits and myasthenic crises. Pre-operative MG-ADL was 4. Following repeat thymectomy, MG-ADL improved to 1 at 1- and 3-month follow-up with decreased ED visits and no crises. Patient 2: A 22-year-old female (MG diagnosed 2017, initial VATS thymectomy 2018) remained refractory despite similar sequential immunotherapy. Pre-operative MG-ADL was 4. MG-ADL improved to 1 at 1 and 3 months but worsened to 5 at 6 months despite IVIG and ravulizumab SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Repeat RATS thymectomy was associated with initial improvement in both patients, though durability varied. Divergent outcomes may reflect differences in initial surgical approach or disease biology. Larger studies are needed.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：胸腺切除术是乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体阳性全身型肌无力（MG）的成熟治疗方法。部分患者尽管接受胸腺切除术和积极免疫治疗仍难治，可能由于切除不完全或残留异位胸腺组织。非胸腺瘤性MG重复完整胸腺切除术的证据有限。目的：描述两例长期难治性全身型MG患者通过机器人辅助胸腔镜手术（RATS）行重复完整胸腺切除术的临床结局。方法：回顾性病例系列，纳入两例AChR抗体阳性难治性非胸腺瘤性全身型MG患者（诊断后约7年），尽管既往接受胸腺切除术并序贯试验多种免疫抑制药物，仍难治，于2025年在Maimonides Medical Center接受RATS重复完整胸腺切除术。结局包括MG日常生活活动（MG-ADL）评分、急诊科（ED）就诊、肌无力危象和药物变化。结果：患者1：25岁女性（2016年诊断MG，2018年初次RATS胸腺切除术），尽管使用皮质类固醇、IVIG、利妥昔单抗、硫唑嘌呤、霉酚酸酯、补体抑制剂和FcRn拮抗剂仍难治，频繁ED就诊和肌无力危象。术前MG-ADL为4。重复胸腺切除术后，MG-ADL在1个月和3个月随访时改善至1，ED就诊减少且无危象。患者2：22岁女性（2017年诊断MG，2018年初次VATS胸腺切除术），尽管类似序贯免疫治疗仍难治。术前MG-ADL为4。MG-ADL在1个月和3个月时改善至1，但在6个月时尽管使用IVIG和ravulizumab仍恶化至5。总结/结论：重复RATS胸腺切除术与两例患者的初始改善相关，但持久性不同。结局差异可能反映初始手术方式或疾病生物学差异。需要更大规模研究。

abstracts.title: AI-based Ocular Motor Digital Biomarkers for Precision Detection of Ocular Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Aimon Rahman; Preetham Bachina; Vishal Patel; Kemar Green; Ricardo Roda; Amanda Henderson; Andrew Carey; Goknur Kocak
abstracts.affiliations: Seattle, WA; Baltimore, MD; Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Ocular myasthenia gravis is a diagnostically challenging form of myasthenia gravis characterized by fluctuating ptosis, diplopia, and extraocular muscle fatigability. Existing diagnostic tests, including acetylcholine receptor antibody testing and single-fiber electromyography, may have reduced sensitivity in ocular presentations. Eye movements provide a dynamic physiologic signal that may reveal disease- specific ocular motor dysfunction. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether artificial intelligence–based analysis of multimodal eye-tracking data can identify ocular motor digital biomarkers for detection of ocular myasthenia gravis. METHODS: We studied eye-movement recordings from individuals with myasthenia gravis (MG) and neurologically normal controls during optokinetic nystagmus stimulation. Eye movements were captured using videonystagmography and analyzed as both raw video and derived waveform data. A three-dimensional residual neural network video classifier and a custom waveform classifier were trained to distinguish MG from control recordings. Models were evaluated using patient- level train-test splitting and compared across frame counts and sampling strategies. Model interpretability was assessed using gradient-weighted class activation mapping for the video classifier. RESULTS: The best-performing video classifiers achieved up to 100% accuracy, 100% sensitivity, and 100% specificity on internal testing. The best waveform classifier achieved 97.37% accuracy, 95.00% sensitivity, and 100% specificity. External validation of the waveform classifier using a Microsoft HoloLens–based eye-tracking system showed reduced but measurable generalizability, with performance limited by cross-device and real-world acquisition differences. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: AI–based multimodal eye- tracking can detect ocular motor digital biomarkers associated with myasthenia gravis. These findings support further development of noninvasive, scalable, and explainable tools for ocular myasthenia gravis screening and monitoring. Larger multicenter validation studies are needed.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：眼肌型重症肌无力是重症肌无力中诊断具有挑战性的一种形式，以波动性上睑下垂、复视和眼外肌易疲劳为特征。现有诊断检测，包括乙酰胆碱受体抗体检测和单纤维肌电图，在眼部表现中敏感性可能降低。眼动提供了一种动态生理信号，可能揭示疾病特异性的眼动功能障碍。目的：评估基于人工智能的多模态眼动追踪数据分析能否识别用于检测眼肌型重症肌无力的眼动数字生物标志物。方法：我们研究了重症肌无力（MG）个体和神经学正常对照在视动性眼震刺激期间的眼动记录。使用视频眼震图捕获眼动，并作为原始视频和衍生波形数据进行分析。训练了一个三维残差神经网络视频分类器和一个定制波形分类器，以区分MG与对照记录。模型使用患者水平的训练-测试拆分进行评估，并在帧数和采样策略之间进行比较。使用梯度加权类激活映射对视频分类器进行模型可解释性评估。结果：表现最佳的视频分类器在内部测试中达到高达100%的准确率、100%的敏感性和100%的特异性。最佳波形分类器达到97.37%的准确率、95.00%的敏感性和100%的特异性。使用基于Microsoft HoloLens的眼动追踪系统对波形分类器进行外部验证，显示泛化性降低但仍可测量，性能受跨设备和真实世界采集差异的限制。总结/结论：基于AI的多模态眼动追踪可以检测与重症肌无力相关的眼动数字生物标志物。这些发现支持进一步开发用于眼肌型重症肌无力筛查和监测的无创、可扩展且可解释的工具。需要更大规模的多中心验证研究。

abstracts.title: Acute Toxicity of CAR-T Cell Therapy in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: A Comparison with Other Autoimmune and Hematologic Conditions
abstracts.authors: Muhannad Seyam; Julia Greenberg; Lekha Mikkilineni; Ali Habib; Srikanth Muppidi
abstracts.affiliations: Mountain View, CA; Redwood City, CA; Palo Alto, CA; Orange, CA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: CAR-T cell therapy is increasingly used in severe autoimmune disease, yet its toxicity profile remains poorly characterized relative to its established hematologic indications. Comparative safety data remain sparse in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), where multiple platforms (persistent CD19, mRNA BCMA, bispecific) are in development. OBJECTIVE: To compare the incidence and severity of acute CAR-T toxicity across three cohorts: (1) gMG, (2) pooled autoimmune diseases (myositis, lupus, systemic sclerosis), and (3) hematologic malignancies. METHODS: Data were synthesized from 14 pivotal hematologic trials and 16 autoimmune CAR-T cohorts identified in primary publications and conference abstracts. Primary outcomes included grade ≥3 cytokine release syndrome (CRS) and any-grade immune effector cell- associated neurotoxicity syndrome (ICANS) per ASTCT 2019. RESULTS: Among 78 gMG patients across three platforms, acute toxicity was predominantly low-grade. Across 26 patients treated with persistent CD19 CAR-T, no grade ≥3 CRS occurred. Low-grade CRS occurred in 14 patients (10 grade 1, 4 grade 2), and only a single grade 1 ICANS event was reported. No CRS or ICANS was reported in 34 patients treated with BCMA-directed mRNA CAR-T. Among 18 patients who received a bispecific BCMA/CD19 construct, grade 1 CRS occurred in 7 patients without higher-grade CRS or ICANS. In contrast, other autoimmune cohorts and hematologic referents demonstrated higher toxicity (grade ≥3 CRS up to 13% and 46%; any-grade ICANS up to 12% and 64%, respectively). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Acute toxicity of CAR-T cell therapy in MG is relatively mild and substantially below the hematologic safety experience. These findings support continued expansion of CAR-T cell clinical trials in MG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：CAR-T细胞疗法越来越多地用于严重自身免疫性疾病，但相对于其已确立的血液学适应症，其毒性特征仍表征不足。在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）中，比较性安全性数据仍然稀少，多种平台（持久性CD19、mRNA BCMA、双特异性）正在开发中。目的：比较三个队列中急性CAR-T毒性的发生率和严重程度：（1）gMG，（2）汇总的自身免疫性疾病（肌炎、狼疮、系统性硬化症），和（3）血液系统恶性肿瘤。方法：数据综合自14项关键血液学试验和16个自身免疫CAR-T队列，这些来自主要出版物和会议摘要。主要结局包括根据ASTCT 2019的≥3级细胞因子释放综合征（CRS）和任何级别免疫效应细胞相关神经毒性综合征（ICANS）。结果：在三个平台的78例gMG患者中，急性毒性主要为低级别。在接受持久性CD19 CAR-T治疗的26例患者中，未发生≥3级CRS。14例患者发生低级别CRS（10例1级，4例2级），仅报告了1例1级ICANS事件。在接受BCMA导向mRNA CAR-T治疗的34例患者中，未报告CRS或ICANS。在接受双特异性BCMA/CD19构建体的18例患者中，7例发生1级CRS，无更高级别CRS或ICANS。相比之下，其他自身免疫队列和血液学参照显示出更高的毒性（≥3级CRS分别高达13%和46%；任何级别ICANS分别高达12%和64%）。总结/结论：CAR-T细胞疗法在MG中的急性毒性相对轻微，且显著低于血液学安全性经验。这些发现支持继续扩大MG中CAR-T细胞临床试验。

abstracts.title: Association of Earlier Efgartigimod Initiation with Improved Clinical Outcomes in Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Cynthia Qi; Carolina Barnett-Tapia; Arjun Seth; Kristin Heerlein; Rohit R. Menon; Jamie Aldridge; Charan Atluri; Helen Zhang; Tobias Ruck INTRODUCTION/OBJECTIVE: This study evaluated whether earlier initiation of efgartigimod was associated with improved outcomes in myasthenia gravis .
abstracts.affiliations: Boston, MA; Toronto, Canada; Chicago, IL; Neuss, Germany; Bengaluru, India; Shrewsbury, NJ; New York, NY; Düsseldorf, Germany
abstracts.abstract: METHODS: Adults with MG receiving efgartigimod for ≥1- year were identified from United States medical and pharmacy claims (IQVIA Longitudinal Access and Adjudication Data, April 2016–September 2025, reflecting estimates of real-world activity). Patients were stratified by treatment line at efgartigimod initiation (first/second-line vs. third-line+) and by time from MG diagnosis to initiation (<1, 1-3, and >3 years). Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) scores were assessed in a patient subset linked to a patient support program. Exacerbation rates and steroid dosing were evaluated pre- and post- efgartigimod. RESULTS: Among 1146 eligible adults (mean[SD] age: 62.3[15.2] years, 47% female), mean(SD) baseline MG- ADL score was 7.8 (3.8). Efgartigimod was initiated as first/second-line in 335 patients (29%), and within 1 year of diagnosis in 276 (24%). During the first 3 months, mean MG-ADL reductions were greater with earlier-line treatment and shorter time from diagnosis (first/second- line:4.8 vs. third-line+:3.5; <1 year:4.7; 1-3 years:3.6; >3 years:3.5 points), and sustained through follow-up. More patients initiating <1 year achieved minimal symptom expression (MG-ADL 0 -1) (50.4%; p<0.001). Most patients reduced steroids, with greater reductions in the <1 year versus >3 years group. Exacerbation rates followed similar patterns. CONCLUSION: While all groups showed meaningful improvements, earlier efgartigimod initiation and use earlier in the treatment algorithm were associated with better outcomes. Findings should be interpreted considering the observational design and potential confounding from baseline differences.

abstracts.abstractZh: 方法：从美国医疗和药房索赔数据（IQVIA纵向获取与裁定数据，2016年4月至2025年9月，反映真实世界活动的估计）中识别接受艾加莫德治疗≥1年的MG成人。患者按艾加莫德起始时的治疗线数（一线/二线 vs. 三线及以上）和从MG诊断到起始的时间（<1年、1-3年和>3年）分层。在链接到患者支持项目的患者子集中评估重症肌无力日常生活活动（MG-ADL）评分。评估艾加莫德治疗前后的加重率和类固醇剂量。结果：在1146例符合条件的成人中（平均[SD]年龄：62.3[15.2]岁，47%女性），平均（SD）基线MG-ADL评分为7.8（3.8）。艾加莫德作为一线/二线在335例患者（29%）中起始，并在诊断后1年内于276例（24%）中起始。在最初3个月，较早线治疗和较短诊断时间的平均MG-ADL降低更大（一线/二线：4.8 vs. 三线及以上：3.5；<1年：4.7；1-3年：3.6；>3年：3.5分），并持续至随访。更多在<1年起始的患者达到最小症状表达（MG-ADL 0-1）（50.4%；p<0.001）。大多数患者减少类固醇，<1年组比>3年组减少更大。加重率遵循相似模式。结论：虽然所有组均显示有意义的改善，但较早起始艾加莫德和在治疗算法中更早使用与更好的结局相关。鉴于观察性设计和基线差异的潜在混杂，应谨慎解释这些发现。

abstracts.title: Clinical Profile, Treatment, and Outcomes in 100 Patients with Myasthenia Gravis: Experience from a Single Neurology Unit
abstracts.authors: Nitin Agrawal; Bajrang Kumawa; Seshagiri Doniparthi; Monojit Debnath; Madhu Nagappa
abstracts.affiliations: Bangalore, India
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia Gravis (MG), the most common neuromuscular junction disorder is characterized by fluctuating, fatigable muscle weakness. It is a potentially serious but treatable immune-mediated disorder with significant heterogeneity in clinical severity and outcome. OBJECTIVE: To describe the clinical and immunological profiles and outcome in a large MG cohort from single neurology unit. METHODS: Cross-sectional analysis of clinical and demographic features, disease severity, antibody status, thymic abnormalities and treatment response in 100 MG patients. RESULTS: Mean age was 47.44±14.6 years, male: female ratio was 1.86:1, median symptom duration was 24 months, mean Myasthenia Muscle Score (MMS) was 84.87±22.4 and median MG Activities of Daily Living score (MG-ADL) was 2. Based on the MG Foundation of America (MGFA) clinical classification, 54% developed severe MG at least once during the disease course (MGFA IVB/V). Antibodies to acetylcholine receptor, muscle-specific kinase and titin were present in 90%, zero (0/12), and 57.4% (27/47), respectively. Chest imaging showed thymoma in 36. Median interval from symptom onset to treatment was 2.5 months. MG Status and Treatment Intensity (MG-STI) levels were 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 in 26, 5, 58, 7, 1, 0 and 3 patients respectively. Treatment included steroids (n=73), azathioprine (n=60), plasmapheresis (n=56), thymectomy (n=27), rituximab (n=7), intravenous immunoglobulins (n=6), mycophenolate mofetil (n=3), and methotrexate (n=3). Twenty-six patients attained complete stable/pharmacological remission SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In this cohort, an in-depth profiling of MG provides critical insights into the clinico- immunological and treatment aspects that contribute to the limited literature on MG cohorts from India/Southeast Asia and expands the regional database.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）是最常见的神经肌肉接头疾病，以波动性、易疲劳性肌无力为特征。它是一种可能严重但可治疗的免疫介导疾病，临床严重程度和结局具有显著异质性。目的：描述来自单一神经科单位的大型MG队列的临床和免疫学特征及结局。方法：对100例MG患者的临床和人口学特征、疾病严重程度、抗体状态、胸腺异常和治疗反应进行横断面分析。结果：平均年龄为47.44±14.6岁，男女比例为1.86:1，中位症状持续时间为24个月，平均肌无力肌肉评分（MMS）为84.87±22.4，中位MG日常生活活动评分（MG-ADL）为2。根据美国重症肌无力基金会（MGFA）临床分类，54%在病程中至少一次发展为严重MG（MGFA IVB/V）。乙酰胆碱受体、肌肉特异性激酶和titin抗体分别存在于90%、零（0/12）和57.4%（27/47）中。胸部影像显示36例胸腺瘤。从症状发作到治疗的中位间隔为2.5个月。MG状态和治疗强度（MG-STI）水平为0、1、2、3、4、5和6的患者分别为26、5、58、7、1、0和3例。治疗包括类固醇（n=73）、硫唑嘌呤（n=60）、血浆置换（n=56）、胸腺切除术（n=27）、利妥昔单抗（n=7）、静脉注射免疫球蛋白（n=6）、吗替麦考酚酯（n=3）和甲氨蝶呤（n=3）。26例患者达到完全稳定/药物缓解。总结/结论：在该队列中，对MG的深入分析提供了对临床免疫学和治疗方面的关键见解，有助于补充来自印度/东南亚MG队列的有限文献并扩展区域数据库。

abstracts.title: Clinical and Molecular Differentiation of Efgartigimod in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Lingyun Li; Sophie Steeland; Guanglong Ma; Andrew R. Crowley; Erwin Pannecoucke; Els Louagie; Jana Podhorna; Kristin Heerlein; Karen Silence; Liesbeth Heyndrickx; Ilse Rogiers; Jolien Van Santbergen; Vladimir Bobkov; Bianca Balbino; E. Sally Ward
abstracts.affiliations: Ghent, Belgium; Southampton, United Kingdom
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: The neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn) regulates immunoglobulin G (IgG) and serum albumin homeostasis. While FcRn is an attractive target for antibody-mediated autoimmune disorders such as generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), decreased albumin and increased lipid levels have been observed in previous studies with some FcRn blockers. As gMG is associated with an increased risk of cardiovascular (CV) disease, molecular differentiation of FcRn blockers with respect to albumin and lipid handling has clinical relevance. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the molecular and clinical differentiation of efgartigimod with respect to FcRn interaction and albumin and lipid handling and to report observed CV burden in patients with gMG. METHODS: Cellular/molecular analyses of multiple FcRn antagonists were performed to elucidate effects on albumin homeostasis. Clinical analyses from efgartigimod trials and patient claims data from the US, France, and Japan were assessed for CV-related adverse events and risk factors. RESULTS: Efgartigimod, a human IgG1 Fc fragment, binds FcRn in the native IgG orientation, preserving FcRn trafficking and albumin recycling. No downregulation of FcRn or steric hindrance of albumin binding was detected with efgartigimod treatment in vitro. Across efgartigimod clinical studies, no reductions in albumin or changes in lipoprotein levels were observed. From claims data, 20,275 patients were assessed; most patients had ≥1 CV risk factor and/or CV comorbidity (US, 93.5%; France, 56.6%; Japan, 65.7%). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Efgartigimod’s unique molecular structure avoids reduction of albumin levels and maintains cholesterol homeostasis while effectively targeting IgG autoantibodies. Given the high CV burden in gMG, careful assessment of CV risk factors is important when making treatment decisions.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：新生儿Fc受体（FcRn）调节免疫球蛋白G（IgG）和血清白蛋白的稳态。虽然FcRn是抗体介导的自身免疫性疾病（如全身型重症肌无力（gMG））的有吸引力的靶点，但在先前使用某些FcRn阻断剂的研究中观察到白蛋白降低和脂质水平升高。由于gMG与心血管（CV）疾病风险增加相关，FcRn阻断剂在白蛋白和脂质处理方面的分子差异具有临床相关性。目的：评估efgartigimod在FcRn相互作用以及白蛋白和脂质处理方面的分子和临床差异，并报告gMG患者中观察到的CV负担。方法：对多种FcRn拮抗剂进行细胞/分子分析，以阐明其对白蛋白稳态的影响。评估efgartigimod试验的临床分析以及来自美国、法国和日本的患者索赔数据中的CV相关不良事件和危险因素。结果：Efgartigimod是一种人IgG1 Fc片段，以天然IgG方向结合FcRn，保持FcRn转运和白蛋白再循环。在体外，efgartigimod处理未检测到FcRn下调或白蛋白结合的位阻现象。在efgartigimod的临床研究中，未观察到白蛋白降低或脂蛋白水平变化。从索赔数据中评估了20,275例患者；大多数患者有≥1个CV危险因素和/或CV合并症（美国93.5%；法国56.6%；日本65.7%）。总结/结论：Efgartigimod独特的分子结构在有效靶向IgG自身抗体的同时，避免了白蛋白水平降低并维持胆固醇稳态。鉴于gMG中高CV负担，在做出治疗决策时仔细评估CV危险因素很重要。

abstracts.title: Cnp-106: A First-in-human Phase 2A Study of an Antigen-specific, Immune-tolerizing Therapy for Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Richard J. Nowak; Aziz Shaibani; Emily Hong; Joseph Podojil; Derrick McCarthy; Erik Wambre; Adam Elhofy; Paul Peloso
abstracts.affiliations: New Haven, CT; Houston, TX; Evanston, IL; New York, NY
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: COUR Nanoparticles (CNPs) are biodegradable nanoparticles harnessing efferocytotic pathways to induce antigen-specific T-cell tolerance with convincing efficacy in preclinical autoimmune models. Human clinical trials in celiac and primary biliary cholangitis demonstrated favorable safety and efficacy of CNPs. CNP-106 is an investigational gMG-specific nanoparticle encapsulating seven acetylcholine receptor (AChR) peptides. OBJECTIVE: To report early safety in an ongoing Phase 2a study of CNP-106 in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) MGFA Class II-IV participants. METHODS: This randomized, double-blind, placebo- controlled dose ascending study evaluates three doses (150, 300, and 500 mg) delivered IV on Days 1 and 8 (n=54 planned) randomized 2Active:1Placebo. Efficacy assessments include MG-ADL, MG-QoL15r, QMG, and T cell assays assessing changes in AChR-specific immune response. RESULTS: Twelve participants were dosed (mean age 59; 9 males, 3 females) with 150 mg and 300 mg. No IV infusion interruptions occurred. All AEs were of Grade 1 (mild) or Grade 2 (moderate) severity except 1 SAE that was not treatment related. AEs reported by investigators as treatment related, were primarily mild and included headache (n=3), nausea (n=2), dizziness, abdominal pain, diarrhea, and sinusitis. Related laboratory or metabolic events included anemia, WBC in urine, and hypertension. All related AEs resolved within 2-24 hours, except sinusitis, which resolved in 5 days. One SAE (angina pectoris) in a subject with baseline hypertension and diabetes was considered unrelated to CNP-106/Placebo by the investigator. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Early clinical data demonstrates favorable tolerability and safety of CNP-106.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：COUR纳米颗粒（CNPs）是可生物降解的纳米颗粒，利用胞葬作用途径诱导抗原特异性T细胞耐受，在临床前自身免疫模型中具有令人信服的疗效。在乳糜泻和原发性胆汁性胆管炎的人体临床试验中，CNPs显示出良好的安全性和有效性。CNP-106是一种研究性gMG特异性纳米颗粒，封装了七种乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）肽。目的：报告正在进行的CNP-106在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）MGFA II-IV级参与者中进行的2a期研究的早期安全性。方法：这项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的剂量递增研究评估三种剂量（150、300和500 mg）在第1天和第8天静脉给药（计划n=54），按2活性:1安慰剂随机分组。疗效评估包括MG-ADL、MG-QoL15r、QMG以及评估AChR特异性免疫反应变化的T细胞检测。结果：12名参与者接受了150 mg和300 mg给药（平均年龄59岁；9名男性，3名女性）。未发生静脉输注中断。除1例与治疗无关的SAE外，所有AE均为1级（轻度）或2级（中度）严重程度。研究者报告为治疗相关的AE主要为轻度，包括头痛（n=3）、恶心（n=2）、头晕、腹痛、腹泻和鼻窦炎。相关实验室或代谢事件包括贫血、尿白细胞和高血压。除鼻窦炎在5天内缓解外，所有相关AE均在2-24小时内缓解。一例基线有高血压和糖尿病的受试者发生SAE（心绞痛），研究者认为与CNP-106/安慰剂无关。总结/结论：早期临床数据表明CNP-106具有良好的耐受性和安全性。

abstracts.title: Combining Population-based Studies and Cross-tissue Single-cell Rna Seq Reveal the Role of Hepatocyte Growth Factor in Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Rui Fan; Fei Xiao
abstracts.affiliations: Chongqing, China
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an autoimmune disease with an incompletely understood mechanism and limited treatment options. OBJECTIVE: The discovery of novel biomarkers is of critical clinical importance for the development of new therapeutic targets and the elucidation of pathogenic mechanisms in myasthenia gravis. METHODS: This study combined prospective cohort, mendelian randomization and cross-sectional cohort to identify potential pathogenic molecules for MG. Single-cell sequencing technology was used to construct a cross- tissue single-cell atlas including bone marrow, thymus, spleen, lymph and whole blood in experimental autoimmune myasthenia gravis (EAMG) model. In vitro and in vivo assays were performed to investigate therapeutic potential and underlying mechanisms of potential pathogenic molecules. RESULTS: The study found that plasma hepatocyte growth factor (HGF) levels are significantly associated with the onset, progression, and disease activity of MG. Cross- tissue single-cell atlas indicated Cd14+Vsir+ monocyte was the main cell source of HGF and significantly increased in blood and bone marrow. HGF receptor inhibitor improved disease symptoms by increasing neutrophil apoptosis via the mTOR signaling pathway. Neutrophil count and percentage were associated with MG onset and progression. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In this work, we highlight HGF play an important role in development of MG, and HGF receptor inhibitor may be a novel therapeutic strategy against MG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）是一种自身免疫性疾病，其机制尚未完全阐明，治疗选择有限。目的：发现新型生物标志物对于开发新的治疗靶点和阐明重症肌无力的致病机制具有关键临床意义。方法：本研究结合前瞻性队列、孟德尔随机化和横断面队列来识别MG的潜在致病分子。采用单细胞测序技术构建了实验性自身免疫性重症肌无力（EAMG）模型中包括骨髓、胸腺、脾脏、淋巴和全血的跨组织单细胞图谱。进行体外和体内实验以研究潜在致病分子的治疗潜力和潜在机制。结果：研究发现血浆肝细胞生长因子（HGF）水平与MG的发病、进展和疾病活动度显著相关。跨组织单细胞图谱表明Cd14+Vsir+单核细胞是HGF的主要细胞来源，并在血液和骨髓中显著增加。HGF受体抑制剂通过mTOR信号通路增加中性粒细胞凋亡来改善疾病症状。中性粒细胞计数和百分比与MG发病和进展相关。总结/结论：在本研究中，我们强调HGF在MG发展中起重要作用，HGF受体抑制剂可能是对抗MG的新型治疗策略。

abstracts.title: Comparing Longitudinal Treatment-related Adverse Risks of Infection in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Svetlana Faktorovich; Phuong Phan; Shirali Pandya; Casey Church; Dongxiao Zhang; Michael Blackowicz
abstracts.affiliations: Delray Beach, FL; Boston, MA; Somerville, MA; Vancouver, Canada; Sharon, MA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is a neuromuscular disorder characterized by fluctuating muscle weakness. Approved biologic options for generalized MG include complement inhibitors (e.g., ravulizumab ) and FcRn antagonists (e.g., efgartigimod), while B-cell-targeted agents (e.g., rituximab) are used off- label. While safety of these approved agents has been characterized in clinical trials, additional real-world evidence is needed to evaluate longer-term infection risks. OBJECTIVE: The objective of this study is to estimate and compare the real-world infection rates associated with gMG treatments. METHODS: This study was a retrospective longitudinal cohort study of patients with MG initiating ravulizumab, efgartigimod, rozanolixizumab, or rituximab using the Veeva Compass claims database from January 2017 to August 2025.Generalized estimating equations was used to compare annual infection rates across cohort, with adjustment for known and suspected confounders. RESULTS: Of 1,515 patients, 689 (46.1%) initiated rituximab, 555 (36.6%) efgartigimod, 218 (14.4%) ravulizumab, and 53 (3.5%) rozanolixizumab. After confounder adjustment, both efgartigimod and rituximab showed statistically significantly higher infection rates versus ravulizumab – efgartigimod by 47% (IRR=1.47, 95% CI: 1.17–1.84, p<0.001) and rituximab by 46% (IRR=1.46, 95% CI: 1.23–1.72, p<0.001). Rozanolixizumab suggested a similar trend but was underpowered to detect differences due to small sample size (IRR=1.34, 95% CI: 0.85–2.11, p=0.208). CONCLUSION: This study observed lower infection rates in patients receiving ravulizumab compared to those receiving other biologic therapies for gMG. Understanding real-world, long-term infection risk profiles for these drugs could help inform treatment decisions for MG, particularly for patients at higher risk of infection or infection-related complications.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）是一种以波动性肌无力为特征的神经肌肉疾病。全身型MG获批的生物制剂包括补体抑制剂（如ravulizumab）和FcRn拮抗剂（如efgartigimod），而B细胞靶向药物（如利妥昔单抗）为超说明书使用。虽然这些获批药物的安全性已在临床试验中表征，但仍需要额外的真实世界证据来评估长期感染风险。目的：本研究的目的是估计和比较与gMG治疗相关的真实世界感染率。方法：本研究是一项回顾性纵向队列研究，使用Veeva Compass索赔数据库（2017年1月至2025年8月）纳入开始使用ravulizumab、efgartigimod、rozanolixizumab或利妥昔单抗的MG患者。使用广义估计方程比较各队列的年感染率，并校正已知和可疑的混杂因素。结果：在1,515例患者中，689例（46.1%）开始使用利妥昔单抗，555例（36.6%）使用efgartigimod，218例（14.4%）使用ravulizumab，53例（3.5%）使用rozanolixizumab。校正混杂因素后，efgartigimod和利妥昔单抗的感染率均较ravulizumab有统计学显著升高——efgartigimod高47%（IRR=1.47，95% CI：1.17–1.84，p<0.001），利妥昔单抗高46%（IRR=1.46，95% CI：1.23–1.72，p<0.001）。Rozanolixizumab提示相似趋势，但因样本量小不足以检测差异（IRR=1.34，95% CI：0.85–2.11，p=0.208）。结论：本研究观察到接受ravulizumab的患者感染率低于接受其他gMG生物制剂治疗的患者。了解这些药物的真实世界长期感染风险特征有助于为MG治疗决策提供信息，特别是对于感染或感染相关并发症风险较高的患者。

abstracts.title: Complement C5 Inhibition Preserves the Neuromuscular Junction in Myasthenia Gravis: An Integrated Morphology and in Vivo Nerve-evoked Muscle Function Biomarker Platform in Rodent Models
abstracts.authors: Kristi Moore; Guoli Shi; Melissa Lasaro; Meera Ramanujam; Ruba Bou-Chahine; Christopher Ward
abstracts.affiliations: New Haven, CT; Baltimore, MD
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In myasthenia gravis (MG), activity- dependent muscle weakness is marked by acetylcholine receptor (AChR) autoantibodies that block AChR, promote its internalization, and trigger complement-mediated postsynaptic neuromuscular junction (NMJ) injury. As emerging and established immunotherapies reshape MG care, NMJ anchored mechanistic biomarkers are needed to assess durable treatment response and differentiate therapies. OBJECTIVE: To establish and validate a translational myasthenia gravis (MG) model in rat linking complement- mediated neuromuscular junction (NMJ) injury, structural remodeling, in vivo nerve-evoked muscle function, and assess anti-C5 therapeutics. METHODS: We used sub-Q injection of purified AChR in rats to model chronic Experimental Autoimmune MG (EAMG). Rats were randomized to vehicle control, EAMG, or EAMG plus anti-C5. Neuromuscular function was quantified longitudinally via clinical scoring in conscious rats and at endpoint with nerve-evoked isometric plantarflexor torque (PFT) under anesthesia. Postsynaptic NMJ morphology was quantified by high-resolution confocal microscopy of bungarotoxin-labeled AChRs. RESULTS: Temporal assessment of clinical scores revealed progressive neuromuscular function deficits in EAMG. Nerveevoked PFT at end-point showed little change in peak torque or frequency response yet revealed marked inability to sustain tetanic torque with repetitive contractions. Concordantly, NMJs exhibited increased area and fragmentation. After 3 weeks, anti- C5 therapy normalized clinical scores but only partly restored in vivo nerve-evoked PFT and partially rescued NMJ morphology. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Nerve-evoked functional testing closely correlates with NMJ damage, detects NMJ recovery with anti-C5, and outperforms clinical scores and standard measures, supporting its use to monitor disease progression, therapeutic efficacy, and differentiate treatment responders.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在重症肌无力（MG）中，活动依赖性肌无力以乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）自身抗体为标志，这些抗体阻断AChR、促进其内化，并触发补体介导的突触后神经肌肉接头（NMJ）损伤。随着新兴和已确立的免疫治疗重塑MG诊疗，需要以NMJ为锚点的机制性生物标志物来评估持久治疗反应并区分不同疗法。目的：建立并验证一种转化性大鼠重症肌无力（MG）模型，将补体介导的神经肌肉接头（NMJ）损伤、结构重塑、体内神经诱发肌肉功能相联系，并评估抗C5治疗。方法：我们采用皮下注射纯化AChR在大鼠中建立慢性实验性自身免疫性重症肌无力（EAMG）模型。大鼠被随机分配至溶媒对照、EAMG或EAMG加抗C5组。神经肌肉功能通过清醒大鼠的临床评分纵向量化，并在终点于麻醉下用神经诱发的等长跖屈肌扭矩（PFT）量化。突触后NMJ形态通过α-银环蛇毒素标记AChR的高分辨率共聚焦显微镜量化。结果：临床评分的时间评估显示EAMG出现进行性神经肌肉功能缺陷。终点的神经诱发PFT在峰值扭矩或频率反应上变化不大，但显示重复收缩时维持强直扭矩的能力明显不足。一致地，NMJ表现出面积增加和碎片化。3周后，抗C5治疗使临床评分正常化，但仅部分恢复体内神经诱发PFT，并部分挽救NMJ形态。总结/结论：神经诱发功能测试与NMJ损伤密切相关，可检测抗C5治疗后的NMJ恢复，并优于临床评分和标准测量，支持其用于监测疾病进展、治疗疗效并区分治疗应答者。

abstracts.title: Corticosteroid and Biologic Use in a Real-world Population with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis in the United States, Europe and Canada
abstracts.authors: Carolina Barnett-Tapia; Seth Anderson; Shakira Hakimzadah; Jamie Sebaaly; Jenny Park; Gregor Gibson; Hannah Connolly; Shiva Lauretta Birija; Beth Poirrette; Amy Foster; Ankur Bhambri; James F. Howard; Jr.
abstracts.affiliations: Toronto, Canada; Thousand Oaks, CA; Bollington, United Kingdom; Malvern, PA; Chapel Hill, NC
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is a chronic, autoantibody-mediated disease characterized by impaired neuromuscular transmission, leading to fluctuating muscle weakness and fatigue. OBJECTIVE: To characterize real-world regional treatment patterns involving corticosteroids, non-steroidal immunosuppressants, and targeted biologic therapies in clinical practice settings. METHODS: Data were drawn from the Adelphi MG Disease Specific Programme (DSP)™, a cross-sectional survey of physicians and their patients with gMG in Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, the United Kingdom and the United States, from January 2024 - November 2025. Physicians reported patient-level demographics, clinical characteristics and treatment. RESULTS: A total of 162 neurologists reported on 999 patients with gMG. Mean patient age was 54.0, and 50.2% were male. The mean (standard deviation [SD]) Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) score was 4.4 (3.4), with most patients (59.2%) classified as Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America (MGFA) class II. At the time of the survey, 88.4% of patients were receiving treatment. Among treated patients, 40.7% were prescribed corticosteroids, most commonly prednisone (35.7%), with a mean (SD) dose of 19.5 mg (18.2), indicating a persistent steroid burden. Of those treated, 35.7% (n=316) used biologics; among these, non-mutually exclusive classes included C5 inhibitors (n=130), FcRn inhibitors (n=128) and rituximab/biosimilar (n=62). Mean (SD) biologic therapy duration was 1.2 (1.2) years, with a mean administration frequency of 2.3 (4.0) times/month. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Corticosteroids and biologic therapies are commonly used in gMG across the seven countries studied. Persistent corticosteroid use despite biologic therapy highlights ongoing treatment burden. Strategies that reduce steroid exposure while maintaining efficacy may improve patient outcomes.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种慢性、自身抗体介导的疾病，以神经肌肉传递受损为特征，导致波动性肌无力和疲劳。目的：描述临床实践环境中涉及糖皮质激素、非甾体免疫抑制剂和靶向生物制剂的真实世界区域治疗模式。方法：数据来自Adelphi MG疾病特定项目（DSP）™，这是一项对加拿大、法国、德国、意大利、西班牙、英国和美国gMG医生及其患者的横断面调查，时间为2024年1月至2025年11月。医生报告了患者层面的人口学、临床特征和治疗。结果：共162名神经科医生报告了999例gMG患者。患者平均年龄为54.0岁，50.2%为男性。重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）平均（标准差[SD]）评分为4.4（3.4），大多数患者（59.2%）被归类为美国重症肌无力基金会（MGFA）II级。调查时，88.4%的患者正在接受治疗。在接受治疗的患者中，40.7%被处方糖皮质激素，最常见为泼尼松（35.7%），平均（SD）剂量为19.5 mg（18.2），表明持续的激素负担。在接受治疗者中，35.7%（n=316）使用生物制剂；其中非互斥类别包括C5抑制剂（n=130）、FcRn抑制剂（n=128）和利妥昔单抗/生物类似药（n=62）。生物制剂治疗平均（SD）持续时间为1.2（1.2）年，平均给药频率为2.3（4.0）次/月。总结/结论：在所研究的七个国家中，糖皮质激素和生物制剂在gMG中常用。尽管使用生物制剂仍持续使用糖皮质激素，凸显持续的治疗负担。在保持疗效的同时减少激素暴露的策略可能改善患者结局。

abstracts.title: Efficacy and Safety of Cizutamig, a BCMA×CD3 T-cell Engager, in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Interim Results from a Phase 1B Dose-escalation Study
abstracts.authors: Karim Masri; Chongbo Zhao; Jie Song; Qilong Jiang; Jamie Haddon; Ken Song; Jenny Jiang; Peter Wung; Tim Lu; Cherry Mao; Kuan-Chieh Huang; Mazen Dimachkie; Gil Wolfe; Jeremias Motte; Karim Masri
abstracts.affiliations: San Diego, CA; Shanghai, China; GuangZhou, China; Victoria, Canada; Seattle, WA; San Francisco, CA; San Mateo, CA; San Carlos, CA; Kansas City, KS; Buffalo, NY; Bochum, Germany
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Cizutamig is a BCMA×CD3 T-cell engager that depletes B cells, plasma cells, and plasmablasts and reduces autoantibodies while minimizing cytokine release syndrome (CRS). OBJECTIVE: To evaluate safety, pharmacodynamics (PD), and efficacy of cizutamig in seropositive (AChR or MuSK) generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). METHODS: A Phase 1b, open-label, dose-escalation and dose-expansion study was conducted in seropositive gMG patients (MGFA Class II–IVb). To date, 12 patients have been dosed across four cohorts. Interim data, including efficacy, PD, and safety, with a minimum of 12 weeks of follow-up are presented for two of four: cohort 1 and 2 (n=3/cohort). RESULTS: For both cohorts, the mean age was 41; 67% were female; Baseline QMG 22.3, MG-ADL 9.0. All patients achieved sustained ≥3-point QMG and ≥2-point MG-ADL improvement for ≥12 weeks and minimal symptom expression (MSE; MG-ADL ≤1). Mean QMG and MG-ADL change from Baseline (CFB) at Week 12: −19.3 and −7.7 (cohort 1) and −13.0 and −8.7 (cohort 2), respectively. Substantial median decreases (> 90%) from Baseline in peripheral B cells, serum free light chains, and AChR autoantibodies were observed in all patients. No treatment-emergent CRS, immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome (ICANS), AESIs, or DLAEs occurred; all patients with TEAEs had maximum Grade ≤2. One non-treatment-emergent Grade 3 pneumonia SAE occurred (cohort 1; resolved). Updated data for all cohorts will be presented. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Cizutamig induced durable, clinically meaningful improvement across established assessments of gMG with on-target PD activity and was well tolerated with no CRS or ICANS. These data support continued development as a potential therapy for gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Cizutamig是一种BCMA×CD3 T细胞衔接器，可清除B细胞、浆细胞和浆母细胞并减少自身抗体，同时尽量减少细胞因子释放综合征（CRS）。目的：评估cizutamig在血清阳性（AChR或MuSK）全身型重症肌无力（gMG）中的安全性、药效动力学（PD）和疗效。方法：在血清阳性gMG患者（MGFA II–IVb级）中开展了一项1b期、开放标签、剂量递增和剂量扩展研究。迄今，已有12例患者在四个队列中接受给药。本文呈现四个队列中两个（队列1和2，每队列n=3）至少12周随访的期中数据，包括疗效、PD和安全性。结果：两个队列平均年龄均为41岁；67%为女性；基线QMG 22.3，MG-ADL 9.0。所有患者均实现持续≥12周的QMG改善≥3分和MG-ADL改善≥2分，并达到最小症状表达（MSE；MG-ADL≤1）。第12周QMG和MG-ADL相对基线的平均变化（CFB）分别为：队列1为−19.3和−7.7，队列2为−13.0和−8.7。所有患者均观察到外周B细胞、血清游离轻链和AChR自身抗体相对基线的中位大幅下降（>90%）。未发生治疗中出现CRS、免疫效应细胞相关神经毒性综合征（ICANS）、AESI或DLAE；所有发生TEAE的患者最高分级≤2级。发生1例非治疗中出现3级肺炎SAE（队列1；已缓解）。将呈现所有队列的更新数据。总结/结论：Cizutamig在既定的gMG评估中诱导持久、具有临床意义的改善，具有靶向PD活性，且耐受性良好，无CRS或ICANS。这些数据支持其作为gMG潜在疗法的继续开发。
