abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：通过描述来自美国大型健康索赔数据库的重症肌无力（MG）患者的人口统计学、临床特征和治疗模式，全面了解MG患者的特征。背景：MG是一种罕见的神经肌肉接头自身免疫性疾病，导致致残性的易疲劳性肌无力。设计/方法：这是一项对Optum Clinformatics® Data Mart数据的回顾性、非干预性、真实世界描述性分析。纳入2011年1月1日至2022年12月31日期间使用≥2个ICD-9和-10代码诊断为MG且在MG诊断前连续入组12个月的成人（≥18岁）。指标日期为首次MG诊断或首次诊断前30天内首次处方吡啶斯的明。报告了指标后期间的人口统计学、临床特征和治疗模式。结果：共识别出12,322例患者：平均年龄68.4（SD±14.1）岁，50.5%为女性，70.4%拥有Medicare保险。中位随访时间为991（IQR: 487–1846）天。62.0%的患者出现全身性症状：疲劳（28.7%）、吞咽困难（27.5%）、肌无力（25.6%）和呼吸困难（24.3%）。近三分之一（32.0%）的患者Charlson合并症指数评分≥3。在诊断后180天内开始治疗的患者（57.4%）最常使用乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂（AChEi，55.8%）或口服皮质类固醇（OCS）/OCS+AChEi（33.1%）；其中，48.2%在停用先前治疗后90天内换用二线治疗。30%的患者在指标后期间未接受治疗。总体而言，47.5%接受了OCS；其中，71.3%接受>20 mg/天，54.6%接受≥40 mg/天。根据严格定义的标准，7.9%为难治性MG。6.7%和48.5%的患者分别发生MG危象和加重，平均每例患者发生1.9次和5.3次。结论：这项回顾性索赔数据库研究利用跨越13年期间超过12,000例个体的数据，提供了美国MG患者的全面真实世界特征描述。

abstracts.title: Clinical Course and Serologic Profile of Myasthenia Gravis in a Single-Center Cohort from Western Mexico (2017–2025)
abstracts.authors: Becerra Aguiar, Naomi; Castro Velazquez, Edson; Gomez Figueroa, Enrique
abstracts.affiliations: Centro Universitario de Ciencias de la Salud, Universidad de Guadalajara, Guadalajara, Jalisco, México., Guadalajara, Mexico; Centro Universitario de Tonala, Universidad de Guadalajara, Tonala, Jalisco, México., Mexico; Hospital Civil de Guadalajara Fray Antonio Alcalde, Zapopan, Mexico
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To describe demographics, clinical severity, serologic profile, thymic pathology, and early generalization in a cohort with Myasthenia Gravis (MG) from Hospital Civil de Guadalajara Fray Antonio Alcale, Mexico. Background: MG is a autoimmune disorder of the neuromuscular junction that causes weakness in striated muscles. Data from Latin American public hospitals on MG remain limited, particularly regarding time to generalization and diagnostic pathways. Design/Methods: We retrospectively analized adults with MG (January 1, 2017–October 1, 2025). Variables included age, sex, Osserman class, presenting phenotype, generalization (yes/no) with time to generalization (months), Myasthenia Gravis Composite (MGC), Jolly test, AChR/MuSK antibodies, thymoma, and thymectomy. We report medians and proportions, compare generalized vs ocular-only using Mann–Whitney U and Fisher exact tests, and evaluate Osserman class vs generalization. Results: We included 53 patients; median age was 53 [34–67] years; 64.2% were women. At presentation, 44/53 were generalized and 9/53 ocular. Out of the 53, 84.9% ever generalized. Time to generalization was rapid: median 1 month [0–2] (n=45). AChR antibodies were positive in 71.8% of those tested (n=39); MuSK positivity was not observed (n=4 tested). Jolly was positive in 55.6% (n=45). Thymoma prevalence (known) was 40.0%; 46.3% underwent thymectomy. Osserman class strongly aligned with generalization: ≥2 vs 1A had markedly higher odds of generalization (Fisher p=9.3×10⁻⁶). Between generalized vs ocular-only groups, we found no statistically significant differences in age (p=0.052), sex (p=0.682), AChR positivity (p=0.655), or Jolly positivity (p=0.684). Conclusions: In our cohort, generalization was common and typically rapid, often within the first months of symptom onset. AChR-seropositivity predominated, MuSK testing was infrequent, and thymoma was relatively common. Osserman class remained a strong bedside stratifier for generalization risk. These findings underscore the need for early counseling about generalization, timely immunotherapy optimization, and systematic antibody testing in resource-constrained settings.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：描述墨西哥瓜达拉哈拉弗雷·安东尼奥·阿尔卡尔德市民医院重症肌无力（MG）队列的人口统计学、临床严重程度、血清学特征、胸腺病理和早期全身化情况。背景：MG是一种神经肌肉接头的自身免疫性疾病，导致横纹肌无力。来自拉丁美洲公立医院关于MG的数据仍然有限，特别是关于全身化时间和诊断路径的数据。设计/方法：我们回顾性分析了成人MG患者（2017年1月1日至2025年10月1日）。变量包括年龄、性别、Osserman分级、初发表型、全身化（是/否）及全身化时间（月）、重症肌无力复合量表（MGC）、Jolly试验、AChR/MuSK抗体、胸腺瘤和胸腺切除术。我们报告中位数和比例，使用Mann-Whitney U检验和Fisher精确检验比较全身化组与仅眼肌组，并评估Osserman分级与全身化的关系。结果：我们纳入53例患者；中位年龄53 [34–67]岁；64.2%为女性。初诊时，44/53为全身型，9/53为眼肌型。在53例患者中，84.9%最终出现全身化。全身化时间迅速：中位1个月 [0–2]（n=45）。AChR抗体阳性率为71.8%（检测n=39）；未观察到MuSK阳性（检测n=4）。Jolly试验阳性率为55.6%（n=45）。胸腺瘤患病率（已知）为40.0%；46.3%接受了胸腺切除术。Osserman分级与全身化高度一致：≥2级对比1A级全身化几率显著更高（Fisher p=9.3×10⁻⁶）。在全身化组与仅眼肌组之间，年龄（p=0.052）、性别（p=0.682）、AChR阳性率（p=0.655）或Jolly阳性率（p=0.684）均无统计学显著差异。结论：在我们的队列中，全身化常见且通常迅速，常在症状出现后的最初几个月内发生。AChR血清阳性占主导，MuSK检测不频繁，胸腺瘤相对常见。Osserman分级仍然是全身化风险的强效床旁分层工具。这些发现强调了在资源有限的环境中，需要早期进行关于全身化的咨询、及时优化免疫治疗以及进行系统性抗体检测。

abstracts.title: Design of a Phase 2a Study to Evaluate the Safety, Efficacy, and Tolerability of Intravenous Empasiprubart as an Add-On Therapy to Intravenous Efgartigimod in Adult Participants With Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Guptill, Jeff; Bilgraer, Raphael; Gaëlle-Dosne, Anne; Steeland, Sophie; Heerlein, Kristin; Vangeneugden, Tony; Ramos Masa, Maria
abstracts.affiliations: argenx, Belgium
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To present the design of a Phase 2a, proof-of-concept study evaluating safety, efficacy, and tolerability of empasiprubart add-on therapy in participants with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) who partially respond to efgartigimod. This is the first of multiple gMG regimens being assessed within a platform study. Background: gMG is driven by multiple mechanisms and manifests differently in each patient. In some, a single therapy may not sufficiently address all gMG mechanisms. Efgartigimod, an immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) Fc fragment, alleviates gMG symptoms in many patients by blocking neonatal Fc receptor–mediated IgG recycling. Empasiprubart, an IgG1 antibody, selectively blocks complement C2. For patients with partial response to efgartigimod, empasiprubart add-on therapy could further improve outcomes. Design/Methods: The study consists of 3 parts (total duration, ~54 weeks). Part A: ~50 adult participants with acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive (AChR-Ab+) gMG receive 1 efgartigimod treatment cycle (4 once-weekly intravenous infusions followed by a 4-week treatment-free period). Part B: participants with partial response to efgartigimod (Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living [MG-ADL] improvements ≥2 with total remaining ≥5) receive 2 cycles of efgartigimod with intravenous empasiprubart coadministered at the first and last infusions of each cycle. Part C (safety follow-up): 4 additional cycles with efgartigimod monotherapy. Participants not meeting partial response criteria during Part A proceed to Part C. Results: Primary endpoints will evaluate safety and tolerability during Parts A and B. Secondary endpoints will evaluate efficacy, including MG-ADL. Conclusions: Results of this study will provide proof-of-concept data on empasiprubart as an add-on therapy to efgartigimod for adults with AChR-Ab+ gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：介绍一项2a期概念验证研究的设计，该研究评估empasiprubart作为附加疗法在对efgartigimod部分应答的全身型重症肌无力（gMG）参与者中的安全性、有效性和耐受性。这是平台研究中评估的多个gMG治疗方案中的第一个。背景：gMG由多种机制驱动，并在每位患者中表现不同。在某些患者中，单一疗法可能不足以解决所有gMG机制。Efgartigimod是一种免疫球蛋白G1（IgG1）Fc片段，通过阻断新生儿Fc受体介导的IgG再循环来缓解许多gMG患者的症状。Empasiprubart是一种IgG1抗体，选择性阻断补体C2。对于对efgartigimod部分应答的患者，empasiprubart附加疗法可能进一步改善结局。设计/方法：该研究由3个部分组成（总持续时间约54周）。A部分：约50名乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）gMG成人参与者接受1个efgartigimod治疗周期（每周一次静脉输注，共4次，随后是4周无治疗期）。B部分：对efgartigimod部分应答的参与者（重症肌无力日常生活活动量表[MG-ADL]改善≥2分且总分仍≥5分）接受2个周期的efgartigimod治疗，并在每个周期的第一次和最后一次输注时联合静脉注射empasiprubart。C部分（安全性随访）：额外4个周期的efgartigimod单药治疗。在A部分期间未达到部分应答标准的参与者进入C部分。结果：主要终点将评估A部分和B部分期间的安全性和耐受性。次要终点将评估有效性，包括MG-ADL。结论：本研究的结果将为empasiprubart作为efgartigimod附加疗法用于AChR-Ab+ gMG成人患者提供概念验证数据。

abstracts.title: Differences in Mortality Among Medicare Beneficiaries With and Without Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Jackson, Louis; Zhdanava, Maryia; Pesa, Jacqueline; Boonmak, Porpong; Chen, Grace; Liu, Daisy; Pilon, Dominic; Govindarajan, Raghav
abstracts.affiliations: Johnson & Johnson., Horsham, PA; Analysis Group, Inc., Montreal, QC, Canada; Analysis Group, Inc., Boston, MA; Analysis Group, Inc., Montréal, QC, Canada; HSHS St. Elizabeth Medical Group, O'Fallon, IL
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To assess differences in mortality among Medicare beneficiaries with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) and without MG. Background: gMG is a rare autoimmune disorder characterized by loss of neuromuscular function that may progress to life-threatening exacerbation or crisis. While the overall burden of gMG is well documented, real-world mortality data among older adults remain limited. Design/Methods: A prevalent cohort design was used based on the 100% Medicare Fee-for-Service Database (10/01/2019–12/31/2023). The gMG cohort included patients with evidence of active disease (≥1 MG-related admission or ≥2 MG-related visits ≥30 days apart) and ≥1 MG diagnosis confirmed by a neurologist; random MG diagnosis defined index date. The non-MG cohort had no MG diagnoses and was matched 10:1 to the gMG cohort on age and index year. Cohorts were further balanced using overlap weighting on sex, race, region, and mortality-related comorbidities. Mortality was evaluated using Kaplan-Meier and Cox proportional hazards models, censoring at the end of eligibility or data. Results: 37,321 and 373,210 patients were included in the gMG and non-MG cohorts, respectively. Post-weighting, the gMG and non-MG cohorts had similar demographics (mean age: 74.2-74.4 years; 47.1-47.2% males). Hypertension (gMG: 81.2%; non-MG: 76.9%) and dyslipidemia (75.8%; 74.6%) were most common comorbidities. Mean follow-up duration was 18.9 and 18.1 months in the gMG and non-MG cohorts, respectively. At 12, 24, and 36 months, survival rates between the gMG and non-MG cohorts were 85.3% vs 86.2%, 78.0% vs 79.3%, and 72.5% vs 73.9%, respectively. Across all time points, gMG patients were at 7-8% higher risk of mortality compared to non-MG patients (all p<0.001). Conclusions: Medicare beneficiaries with gMG had consistently higher mortality than those without MG. These findings highlight the need to better identify and understand drivers of excess mortality, which may provide targeted management strategies for this vulnerable population.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：评估患有全身型重症肌无力（gMG）和无MG的医疗保险受益人在死亡率上的差异。背景：gMG是一种罕见的自身免疫性疾病，其特征是神经肌肉功能丧失，可能进展为危及生命的加重或危象。虽然gMG的总体负担已有充分记录，但老年人中的真实世界死亡率数据仍然有限。设计/方法：基于100% Medicare按服务收费数据库（2019年10月1日至2023年12月31日）采用现患队列设计。gMG队列包括有活动性疾病证据（≥1次MG相关住院或≥2次间隔≥30天的MG相关就诊）且至少有1名神经科医生确认的MG诊断的患者；随机MG诊断定义为索引日期。非MG队列无MG诊断，并按年龄和索引年份与gMG队列进行10:1匹配。使用重叠加权法在性别、种族、地区和死亡率相关合并症上进一步平衡队列。使用Kaplan-Meier和Cox比例风险模型评估死亡率，并在资格或数据结束时进行删失。结果：gMG和非MG队列分别纳入37,321名和373,210名患者。加权后，gMG和非MG队列的人口统计学特征相似（平均年龄：74.2-74.4岁；男性：47.1-47.2%）。高血压（gMG：81.2%；非MG：76.9%）和血脂异常（75.8%；74.6%）是最常见的合并症。gMG和非MG队列的平均随访时间分别为18.9个月和18.1个月。在12、24和36个月时，gMG和非MG队列的生存率分别为85.3% vs 86.2%、78.0% vs 79.3%和72.5% vs 73.9%。在所有时间点，gMG患者的死亡风险比非MG患者高7-8%（所有p<0.001）。结论：患有gMG的医疗保险受益人的死亡率始终高于无MG者。这些发现强调了需要更好地识别和理解超额死亡率的驱动因素，这可能为这一脆弱人群提供有针对性的管理策略。

abstracts.abstract: Objective: To identify predictors of early mortality (within 30 days) in patients with myositis/myasthenia (MM) associated with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI). Background: MM shows heterogeneous clinical features and severity. Early recognition and immunosuppressive treatments may improve outcomes, but markers of rapid deterioration are lacking. Design/Methods: This nationwide retrospective study in Spain collected information on MM patients through March 2025 using a web-based structured questionnaire. Syndromes were centrally classified as definite, probable, or possible, and severity was assessed using Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America (MGFA) classification. Results: We recruited 153 patients from 36 hospitals. Median age was 72 years [IQR 66–78] and 67% were male. By consensus definitions, 79 (52%) had definite/probable myositis, 14 (9%) definite/probable myasthenia, 57 (37%) fulfilled criteria for both disorders and 3 (2%) only possible myositis (excluded from analyses). At disease nadir 102/150 (68%) patients reached MGFA class III–V. Higher MGFA class correlated with elevated Troponin T (TnT, n=49, ρ=0.506, p=0.001) and CK (n=123, ρ=0.272, p=0.002), but not Troponin I (n=53, ρ=0.106, p=0.444). All patients discontinued ICI; 144/150 (96%) received immunosuppressants. At day +30, 108/150 (72%) had improved, 22 (15%) were unchanged and 20 (13%) had died. Patients who died early showed more frequently dyspnea (75% vs. 41%, p=0.007), palpitations (15% vs. 3%, p=0.050), dysphonia (65% vs. 45%, p=0.098), AChR-antibody positivity (65% vs. 28%, p=0.002) and concurrent myocarditis (76.5% vs. 46.5%, p=0.035), with higher TnT levels (1577 vs. 421 ng/L, p=0.013). In multivariable analysis, ventilatory support and AChR-positivity independently increased early mortality (OR=4.95; 95%CI 1.41-17.54, p=0.013 and OR=3.62; 95%CI 1.07-12.20, p=0.038 respectively). Conclusions: TnT and CK levels in the acute phase correlated with MGFA class, indicating potential as biomarkers of neuromuscular involvement and severity. Early mortality remains a major challenge, underscoring the need for timely management strategies.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：识别与免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）相关的肌炎/肌无力（MM）患者早期死亡（30天内）的预测因素。背景：MM表现出异质性的临床特征和严重程度。早期识别和免疫抑制治疗可能改善预后，但缺乏快速恶化的标志物。设计/方法：这项在西班牙进行的全国性回顾性研究通过基于网络的结构化问卷收集了截至2025年3月的MM患者信息。综合征被集中分类为明确、可能或可疑，并使用美国重症肌无力基金会（MGFA）分类评估严重程度。结果：我们招募了来自36家医院的153名患者。中位年龄为72岁[IQR 66–78]，67%为男性。根据共识定义，79名（52%）患有明确/可能的肌炎，14名（9%）患有明确/可能的肌无力，57名（37%）符合两种疾病的标准，3名（2%）仅为可能的肌炎（从分析中排除）。在疾病最低点时，102/150（68%）的患者达到MGFA III–V级。较高的MGFA分级与升高的肌钙蛋白T（TnT，n=49，ρ=0.506，p=0.001）和CK（n=123，ρ=0.272，p=0.002）相关，但与肌钙蛋白I无关（n=53，ρ=0.106，p=0.444）。所有患者均停用ICI；144/150（96%）接受了免疫抑制剂治疗。在第+30天，108/150（72%）的患者改善，22名（15%）无变化，20名（13%）死亡。早期死亡的患者更常出现呼吸困难（75% vs. 41%，p=0.007）、心悸（15% vs. 3%，p=0.050）、发声困难（65% vs. 45%，p=0.098）、AChR抗体阳性（65% vs. 28%，p=0.002）和并发心肌炎（76.5% vs. 46.5%，p=0.035），且TnT水平更高（1577 vs. 421 ng/L，p=0.013）。在多变量分析中，呼吸机支持和AChR阳性独立增加了早期死亡风险（OR=4.95；95%CI 1.41-17.54，p=0.013和OR=3.62；95%CI 1.07-12.20，p=0.038）。结论：急性期的TnT和CK水平与MGFA分级相关，表明其作为神经肌肉受累和严重程度的生物标志物的潜力。早期死亡率仍然是一个主要挑战，强调了及时管理策略的必要性。

abstracts.authors: Remuzgo-Cabezas, Angela; Luna-Peralta, Gerardo; Alegre-Cordero, Ivan; Rudas-Sulca, Bryan; Alarcon-Ruiz, Christoper A.

abstracts.abstract: Objective: To summarize evidence on the effectiveness of Remission (R), minimal manifestations (MM), Slight Improvement (SI), and Patient-Acceptable Symptom State (PASS) as therapeutic goals in Myasthenia Gravis (MG). Background: MG is an autoimmune disease characterized by fluctuating weakness. While achieving R or MM is often prioritized, their true impact on patient-centered outcomes remains uncertain. Design/Methods: We systematically searched PubMed, Scopus, and CENTRAL (till August 2025) for studies comparing outcomes in MG patients achieving R, MM, SI, or PASS. Random-effects models estimated pooled effects; heterogeneity was assessed with I². Risk of bias was evaluated using the Newcastle-Ottawa scale and certainty with GRADE. Results: Nine studies (5 cohort, 4 cross-sectional; 6,165 patients) were included. Compared to R, achieving MM was linked to worse MG-QoL-15 (MD 2.70; 95% CI: 1.61–3.79; I² = 87%), MG-ADL (MD 0.70; 95% CI: 0.19–1.21; I² = 90%), and QMG (MD 2.46; 95% CI: 1.39–3.52; I² = 72%). Versus SI, MM reduced myasthenic crisis risk (OR 0.32; 95% CI: 0.17–0.61) and QMG scores (MD –4.68; 95% CI: –6.36 to –3.00; I² = 91%). Compared to R, SI worsened MG-QoL-15 (MD 6.60; 95% CI: 3.85–9.35; I² = 92%), MG-ADL (MD 3.10; 95% CI: 0.38–5.82; I² = 85%), and QMG (MD 7.36; 95% CI: 6.72–7.99; I² = 0%). Achieving PASS improved MG-QoL-15 (MD –12.18; 95% CI: –18.73 to –5.64; I² = 90%), MG-ADL (MD –4.07; 95% CI: –5.93 to –2.22; I² = 88%), and QMG (MD –6.65; 95% CI: –7.53 to –5.78; I² = 0%).. Risk of bias was low–moderate (cohorts) and moderate–high (cross-sectional). Certainty of evidence was very low across outcomes. Conclusions: Achieving MM or R in MG may improve quality of life, function, and symptoms, with very low certainty. MM generally showed worse outcomes than R. PASS appears promising as a treatment goal. Higher-quality studies are needed to confirm these results and guide recommendations.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：总结关于缓解（R）、最小表现（MM）、轻微改善（SI）和患者可接受症状状态（PASS）作为重症肌无力（MG）治疗目标有效性的证据。背景：MG是一种以波动性无力为特征的自身免疫性疾病。虽然实现R或MM通常被优先考虑，但它们对以患者为中心的结果的真正影响仍不确定。设计/方法：我们系统检索了PubMed、Scopus和CENTRAL（截至2025年8月），寻找比较达到R、MM、SI或PASS的MG患者结局的研究。使用随机效应模型估计合并效应；用I²评估异质性。使用纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表评估偏倚风险，并使用GRADE评估确定性。结果：纳入9项研究（5项队列，4项横断面；6,165名患者）。与R相比，达到MM与更差的MG-QoL-15（MD 2.70；95% CI: 1.61–3.79；I² = 87%）、MG-ADL（MD 0.70；95% CI: 0.19–1.21；I² = 90%）和QMG（MD 2.46；95% CI: 1.39–3.52；I² = 72%）相关。与SI相比，MM降低了肌无力危象风险（OR 0.32；95% CI: 0.17–0.61）和QMG评分（MD –4.68；95% CI: –6.36至–3.00；I² = 91%）。与R相比，SI恶化了MG-QoL-15（MD 6.60；95% CI: 3.85–9.35；I² = 92%）、MG-ADL（MD 3.10；95% CI: 0.38–5.82；I² = 85%）和QMG（MD 7.36；95% CI: 6.72–7.99；I² = 0%）。达到PASS改善了MG-QoL-15（MD –12.18；95% CI: –18.73至–5.64；I² = 90%）、MG-ADL（MD –4.07；95% CI: –5.93至–2.22；I² = 88%）和QMG（MD –6.65；95% CI: –7.53至–5.78；I² = 0%）。偏倚风险为低-中等（队列）和中等-高（横断面）。各结局的证据确定性非常低。结论：在MG中达到MM或R可能会改善生活质量、功能和症状，但确定性非常低。MM的结局通常比R差。PASS作为治疗目标似乎很有前景。需要更高质量的研究来确认这些结果并指导建议。

abstracts.title: Factors Associated with Recurrent Clinical Events among Pediatric Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Patients in the United States
abstracts.authors: Liu, Zhiwen; Pesa, Jacqueline; Jackson, Louis; Lin, Liang-Yuan; Campbell, Alicia; Govindarajan, Raghav
abstracts.affiliations: Johnson & Johnson, Titusville, NJ; Johnson & Johnson, Horsham, PA; HSHS St. Elizabeth Medical Group, O'Fallon, IL
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To estimate rates of exacerbation and myasthenic crisis and identify associated risk factors for crisis and repeat exacerbations among commercially-insured children with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in the United States. Background: Clinical events in MG are costly and repeat events indicate insufficient disease management. Design/Methods: MG patients aged 2-17 years were identified from MarketScan® commercial insurance data (01/01/2010 to 06/30/2025) based on ≥1 inpatient or ≥2 outpatient claims (within 60-days) for MG and ≥6 months of continuous enrollment before the first qualified MG diagnosis (index date). Exacerbation and crisis rates were calculated separately for ages 2-11 and 12-17. To assess factors associated with crisis and repeat exacerbation, a nested case-control design considered patients with an event in the follow-up period as cases (corresponding event date as new case index date) and those without events as controls (date at the end of the follow-up as the new control index date). The 6-month period before the new index date was used to pre-select risk factors. Results: The study included 508 gMG patients (226 aged 2-11; 282 aged 12-17). Over 25% of 2-11 year-olds experienced ≥1 exacerbation and 15.5% experienced ≥1 crisis in the follow-up period; incidence rate (95% confidence interval [CI]) per 100 person-years was 18.2 (11.4–29.1) for exacerbation and 9.3 (5.1-17.1) for crisis. Among those 12-17, 34.8% and 16.7% experienced exacerbation and crisis; incidence rates 22.8 (16.9-30.1) and 7.3 (4.7-11.4). Logistic regression models found female, prior exacerbation, acetylcholinesterase inhibitors, corticosteroids, and intravenous immunoglobulin treatment as significantly associated with repeat exacerbations and crises. Conclusions: Pediatric gMG patients had high rates of clinical events. Crisis and repeat exacerbation were associated with prior exacerbation and common MG treatments. This study highlights the burden of MG in this patient population and the need for improved treatments to reduce disease burden.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：评估美国商业保险的全身型重症肌无力（gMG）儿童患者的加重和肌无力危象发生率，并识别与危象和反复加重相关的风险因素。背景：MG中的临床事件代价高昂，反复事件表明疾病管理不足。设计/方法：从MarketScan®商业保险数据（2010年1月1日至2025年6月30日）中识别2-17岁的MG患者，依据为≥1次住院或≥2次门诊索赔（60天内）以及首次合格MG诊断（索引日期）前连续参保≥6个月。分别计算2-11岁和12-17岁年龄组的加重和危象发生率。为评估与危象和反复加重相关的因素，采用巢式病例对照设计，将随访期间发生事件的患者视为病例（相应事件日期作为新病例索引日期），未发生事件的患者视为对照（随访结束日期作为新对照索引日期）。使用新索引日期前6个月的时间段预选风险因素。结果：研究纳入508例gMG患者（226例2-11岁；282例12-17岁）。超过25%的2-11岁儿童在随访期间经历了≥1次加重，15.5%经历了≥1次危象；每100人年的发生率（95%置信区间[CI]）为加重18.2（11.4–29.1），危象9.3（5.1-17.1）。在12-17岁组中，34.8%和16.7%经历了加重和危象；发生率分别为22.8（16.9-30.1）和7.3（4.7-11.4）。Logistic回归模型发现，女性、既往加重、乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂、皮质类固醇和静脉注射免疫球蛋白治疗与反复加重和危象显著相关。结论：儿童gMG患者临床事件发生率较高。危象和反复加重与既往加重和常见MG治疗相关。本研究强调了该患者人群中MG的负担，以及需要改进治疗以减轻疾病负担。

abstracts.title: Healthcare Costs in Commercially Insured Pediatric Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis in the United States
abstracts.authors: Liu, Zhiwen; Pesa, Jacqueline; Jackson, Louis; Lin, Liang-Yuan; Campbell, Alicia; Govindarajan, Raghav
abstracts.affiliations: Johnson & Johnson, Titusville, NJ; Johnson & Johnson, Horsham, PA; HSHS St. Elizabeth Medical Group, O'Fallon, IL
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To assess the incremental healthcare costs associated with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in commercially insured children. Background: gMG is a rare autoimmune disease associated with high healthcare resource utilization and costs among adults. Data on pediatric patients remain limited. Design/Methods: Using MarketScan® data (01/01/2010–06/30/2025), we identified a retrospective cohort of patients aged 2–17 with ≥1 inpatient or ≥2 outpatient MG diagnosis codes within 60 days and ≥6 months of continuous commercial insurance enrollment before the first qualifying MG diagnosis (index date). Controls (non-MG) were selected randomly. Patients were followed until disenrollment, death, or end of data. Costs were compared between cohorts using inverse probability of treatment weighting to adjust for baseline characteristics. Subgroup analyses evaluated costs among gMG patients experiencing exacerbation or crisis. Results: A total of 508 gMG (66% female; mean age 11.3 years) and 5178 non-MG patients were identified. Weighted cohorts were well-balanced. Mean total healthcare costs per-patient-per-month (PPPM) were $6295 vs $226 for gMG vs controls (mean difference $6069; 95% confidence interval $4681-7457). Inpatient and outpatient ((unrelated to office visits) costs were the primary drivers of total costs for gMG cases vs controls inpatient: $2872 vs $27 ($2844; $1819-$3870); outpatient $2568 vs $84 ($2483; $1860-$3107) PPPM, respectively. Immunoglobulin therapies alone accounted for 48% of outpatient costs Weighted analysis of MG patients experiencing exacerbation or crisis vs those who did not experience such events revealed total costs of $14,154 vs $3378 PPPM ($10,776; $6575-$14,976) for patients with vs without exacerbation and $16,474 vs $4684 PPPM ($11,790; $5063-$18,518) for patients with vs without crisis. Conclusions: Pediatric gMG patients had higher healthcare costs than non-gMG patients. Patients with MG exacerbations and crises had approximately 4 times higher costs vs gMG patients without such events, highlighting the need for improved treatments to reduce the frequency of costly events.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：评估商业保险儿童全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者的增量医疗费用。背景：gMG是一种罕见的自身免疫性疾病，在成人中与高医疗资源利用率和费用相关。儿童患者的数据仍然有限。设计/方法：使用MarketScan®数据（2010年1月1日至2025年6月30日），我们识别了一个回顾性队列，包括年龄2-17岁、在60天内至少有1次住院或2次门诊MG诊断代码、且在首次合格MG诊断（索引日期）前有至少6个月连续商业保险入组的患者。对照组（非MG）随机选择。患者被随访至退保、死亡或数据结束。使用逆概率治疗加权调整基线特征后比较队列间的费用。亚组分析评估了经历加重或危象的gMG患者的费用。结果：共识别出508名gMG患者（66%女性；平均年龄11.3岁）和5178名非MG患者。加权队列平衡良好。gMG组与对照组相比，每患者每月（PPPM）平均总医疗费用分别为6295美元 vs 226美元（平均差6069美元；95%置信区间4681-7457美元）。住院和门诊（非办公室就诊相关）费用是gMG病例总费用的主要驱动因素，与对照组相比：住院费用分别为2872美元 vs 27美元（平均差2844美元；95%置信区间1819-3870美元）；门诊费用分别为2568美元 vs 84美元（平均差2483美元；95%置信区间1860-3107美元）PPPM。仅免疫球蛋白治疗就占门诊费用的48%。对经历加重或危象的MG患者与未经历此类事件的患者进行加权分析显示，有加重与无加重患者的PPPM总费用分别为14,154美元 vs 3378美元（平均差10,776美元；95%置信区间6575-14,976美元），有危象与无危象患者的PPPM总费用分别为16,474美元 vs 4684美元（平均差11,790美元；95%置信区间5063-18,518美元）。结论：儿童gMG患者的医疗费用高于非gMG患者。经历MG加重和危象的患者费用约为无此类事件的gMG患者的4倍，凸显了对改进治疗以减少高费用事件频率的需求。

abstracts.title: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Induced Myasthenia Gravis-like Clinical Presentation: A Single Center Case Series
abstracts.authors: Figueiredo Pucci, Gabriela; Levenson, Joshua; McNeish, Brendan; Lacomis, David; Sun, Fang
abstracts.affiliations: University of Pittsburgh, Pittsburgh, PA; University of Pittsburgh School of Medicine, PA; University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, MN; University of Pittsburgh School of Medicine, Pittsburgh, PA
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To characterize immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) induced myasthenia gravis (MG)-like clinical presentation and overlap manifestations with myositis and/or myocarditis. Background: ICI induced MG-like symptoms are associated with high fatality rate (up to 40-60%) when overlapping with myositis and myocarditis. Understanding this condition is critical to developing treatment strategies. Design/Methods: We examined 21 patients who presented to our medical center with ICI induced MG-like symptoms from April 2023 to July 2025. Clinical, laboratory, and electrodiagnostic findings were evaluated. Treatment regimens and outcomes were analyzed. Results: 86% of cases overlapped with myositis, 76% overlapped with myositis and myocarditis. 71% survived 90 days. Most common symptoms were proximal weakness (71%), myalgia (67%), dyspnea (52%), ptosis (38%), and respiratory failure (33%). Time from ICI treatment to symptom onset was shorter when overlapped with myocarditis (days, 22 vs 105, p=0.007). Peak CK and Troponin levels were higher with myocarditis (CK, 412 vs 1694, P= 0.008; Troponin, 32 vs 1859, p= 0.0001). Acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibodies were frequently detected (46%). Abnormal decrement on repetitive nerve stimulation (RNS) was found in 3 patients (2 overlapped with myocarditis and myositis, 1 overlapped with myositis). Most patients were off chronic immunosuppression by 12 weeks after index admission. No recurrent symptoms of MG or myositis in surviving patients. No observed difference in chronic clinical course in patients with or without positive AChR antibody on diagnosis, or in patients with or without abnormal RNS. All patients treated with abatacept and ruxolitinib for myocarditis survived (n=6). Conclusions: ICI induced MG-like symptoms often present with concurrent myotoxicity. Most patients demonstrated a monophasic clinical course despite AChR antibody status or evidence of abnormal RNS on symptom onset. These differences from idiopathic MG should be confirmed in prospective cohorts to guide acute treatment strategies and prevent unnecessary long-term immunosuppression which could obliterate the anti-tumor effect of ICI.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：描述免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）诱导的重症肌无力（MG）样临床表现及其与肌炎和/或心肌炎的重叠表现。背景：ICI诱导的MG样症状在与肌炎和心肌炎重叠时与高死亡率（高达40-60%）相关。理解这一状况对于制定治疗策略至关重要。设计/方法：我们检查了2023年4月至2025年7月期间在我院就诊的21名出现ICI诱导的MG样症状的患者。评估了临床、实验室和电诊断结果。分析了治疗方案和结局。结果：86%的病例与肌炎重叠，76%与肌炎和心肌炎重叠。71%的患者存活超过90天。最常见的症状是近端无力（71%）、肌痛（67%）、呼吸困难（52%）、上睑下垂（38%）和呼吸衰竭（33%）。从ICI治疗到症状出现的时间在重叠心肌炎时更短（天数，22 vs 105，p=0.007）。重叠心肌炎时，峰值CK和肌钙蛋白水平更高（CK，412 vs 1694，P=0.008；肌钙蛋白，32 vs 1859，p=0.0001）。乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体频繁检出（46%）。3名患者重复神经电刺激（RNS）发现异常递减（2名重叠心肌炎和肌炎，1名重叠肌炎）。大多数患者在索引入院后12周内停用慢性免疫抑制。存活患者中无MG或肌炎症状复发。在诊断时AChR抗体阳性或阴性患者之间，或在RNS异常或正常患者之间，未观察到慢性临床病程的差异。所有接受阿巴西普和鲁索替尼治疗心肌炎的患者均存活（n=6）。结论：ICI诱导的MG样症状常伴有并发肌毒性。尽管存在AChR抗体状态或症状出现时RNS异常的证据，大多数患者表现为单相临床病程。这些与特发性MG的差异应在前瞻性队列中得到确认，以指导急性治疗策略并防止不必要的长期免疫抑制，后者可能消除ICI的抗肿瘤效应。

abstracts.abstract: Objective: To describe the correlation between ME&MGTM digital biomarkers (dBMKs) and corresponding MG-ADL and MG-QoL15r sub-items from the decentralized ME&MGopenTM study (NCT05566964). Background: Symptoms of generalized Myasthenia gravis (gMG), a rare auto-immune neuromuscular disorder characterized by fatigable muscle weakness, are routinely captured via patient-reported outcomes (PROs) questionnaires. MG-ADL and MG-QoL15r assess daily activities with 8 questions scored from 0-3, and quality of life with 15 questions scored from 0-2; higher scores indicate higher severity and worse quality of life, respectively. DBMKs provide objective measures for patients to assess their symptoms, at home, by performing smartphone-based active tests. ME&MGTM evaluates five gMG symptoms: ptosis, dysarthria, respiratory function, upper and lower limb weakness mirrored in 5 MG-ADL and 3 MG-QOL15r items. In ME&MGopen, gMG patients performed ME&MGTM tests for one year. Design/Methods: ME&MGTM dBMKS MyEyelids, MyVoice, MyBreathing, MyArms and MyLegs respectively measure Margin-to-reflex-distance-1, dysarthria, sustained phonation, holding duration and number of sit-to-stand, corresponding to sub-items of MG-ADL/MG-QoL15r. Completed tests were reviewed for quality (inaccurate dBMKs values and agreement with human measurements) before analysis. The relationship between dBMKs and sub-items was determined using mixed models analyses. Results: 156 (67.9% female, mean age 58.7±15.8, mean disease duration 11.2±12.3) participants completed digital tests and questionnaires, monthly. A total of 9,106 evaluations were collected and 90.4% of them were of good quality. DBMKs scores for ptosis, breathing, and limb weakness decreased with increasing symptom severity assessed by PROs. Dysarthria scores increased with symptom severity. Ptosis, dysarthria and limb weakness scores showed significant associations (all p<0.019) with aforementioned sub-items of MG-ADL/MG-QoL-15r scores. Conclusions: Significant associations between ME&MGTM dBMKs and clinical assessments support their potential use in clinical settings to track gMG manifestations. These findings highlight the importance of the ongoing validation study DOMYA (NCT05564936).

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：描述ME&MGTM数字生物标志物（dBMKs）与来自分散式ME&MGopenTM研究（NCT05566964）的相应MG-ADL和MG-QoL15r子项之间的相关性。背景：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种以易疲劳性肌无力为特征的罕见自身免疫性神经肌肉疾病，其症状通常通过患者报告结局（PRO）问卷来捕获。MG-ADL和MG-QoL15r分别通过8个评分0-3的问题评估日常活动，以及通过15个评分0-2的问题评估生活质量；分数越高表示严重程度越高和生活质量越差。DBMKs通过让患者在家中进行基于智能手机的主动测试，提供客观的评估指标。ME&MGTM评估五种gMG症状：上睑下垂、构音障碍、呼吸功能、上肢和下肢无力，这反映在5个MG-ADL和3个MG-QoL15r项目中。在ME&MGopen研究中，gMG患者进行了一年的ME&MGTM测试。设计/方法：ME&MGTM dBMKs MyEyelids、MyVoice、MyBreathing、MyArms和MyLegs分别测量边缘反射距离-1、构音障碍、持续发声、保持时间和从坐到站次数，对应于MG-ADL/MG-QoL15r的子项。完成的测试在分析前经过质量审查（不准确的dBMKs值以及与人工测量的一致性）。使用混合模型分析确定dBMKs与子项之间的关系。结果：156名参与者（67.9%女性，平均年龄58.7±15.8岁，平均病程11.2±12.3年）每月完成数字测试和问卷。共收集了9,106次评估，其中90.4%质量良好。上睑下垂、呼吸和肢体无力的dBMKs评分随着PRO评估的症状严重程度增加而降低。构音障碍评分随着症状严重程度增加而增加。上睑下垂、构音障碍和肢体无力的评分与上述MG-ADL/MG-QoL-15r评分的子项显示出显著关联（所有p<0.019）。结论：ME&MGTM dBMKs与临床评估之间的显著关联支持其在临床环境中追踪gMG表现的潜在用途。这些发现强调了正在进行的验证研究DOMYA（NCT05564936）的重要性。

abstracts.title: Missed Opportunities for Pharmacist Intervention Among Medicare Fee-for-Service Beneficiaries With Myasthenia Gravis: A Real-world Claims Analysis
abstracts.authors: Thompson, Judith; Chan, Philip K.; Iyer, Stephanie; Dongarwar, Deepa; Greene, Laura
abstracts.affiliations: UCB, Atlanta, GA; Inovalon, Bowie, MD; The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, Chapel Hill, NC
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To describe pharmacist interactions among Medicare Fee-for-Service (FFS) beneficiaries with myasthenia gravis (MG), using documented medication management services (MMS: Medication Therapy Management [MTM] or Evaluation and Management [E/M] encounters) and prescription fills as proxies. Background: Pharmacists are underutilized in chronic disease management. They are highly trained and uniquely positioned to optimize medication use, improve therapeutic outcomes, and reduce adverse events for individuals with complex regimens, like myasthenia gravis (MG). Design/Methods: A retrospective observational cohort study was conducted using 100% Medicare FFS Parts A, B, and D claims during January 1, 2018- December 31, 2021. Beneficiaries were included if they had ≥1 inpatient or ≥2 outpatient claims for MG (ICD-10-CM G70.xx), were aged ≥18 years, had continuous enrollment during the 12-month baseline period, and no evidence of clinical trial participation. Pharmacist interactions were estimated from Medicare Part D dispensing events and vaccinations administered at the pharmacy. Descriptive statistics summarized demographics, clinical characteristics, service uptake, and engagement. Multivariable zero-inflated negative binomial models examined factors associated with pharmacist interactions. Results: Among 32,200 eligible beneficiaries (mean age: 74.9 years; 48.1% female) during the 12-month baseline period, beneficiaries filled an average of 53.1 (SD: 32.5) prescriptions per patient per year (PPPY). Using a proxy definition, 99.3% of beneficiaries were MTM-eligible yet, there were only 60 unique MMS recipients. At 24 months post-index, beneficiaries had a cumulative mean of 198.7 prescription fills for any medication and 70.4 for MG-related medications. Additionally, 73.9% received flu or COVID-19 vaccinations at the pharmacy. In adjusted models MG-specific fills showed a 7.3-fold higher rate among those aged 18–29 (95% CI: 5.9–8.9; p < 0.0001), while males had 4.1% more MG-specific fills than females (95% CI: 1.02–1.06; p<0.0001). Conclusions: The high frequency of pharmacy interactions, related to prescription fills and pharmacy administered vaccinations, highlights missed opportunities for pharmacist engagement to improve medication optimization.

abstracts.sessionName: P11: Neuromuscular and Clinical Neurophysiology (EMG): Myasthenia Gravis Treatments
abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：通过记录药物管理服务（MMS：药物治疗管理[MTM]或评估与管理[E/M]接触）和处方配药作为代理指标，描述重症肌无力（MG）的Medicare按服务收费（FFS）受益人中药剂师互动情况。背景：药剂师在慢性病管理中的应用不足。他们受过高度培训，具有独特优势，能够优化药物使用、改善治疗结果并减少复杂治疗方案（如重症肌无力[MG]）患者的不良事件。设计/方法：使用2018年1月1日至2021年12月31日期间100%的Medicare FFS A、B和D部分索赔数据进行回顾性观察队列研究。纳入标准为：有≥1次住院或≥2次门诊MG索赔（ICD-10-CM G70.xx）、年龄≥18岁、在12个月基线期内连续参保且无临床试验参与证据。药剂师互动通过Medicare D部分配药事件和药房接种的疫苗进行估算。描述性统计总结了人口统计学、临床特征、服务使用和参与情况。多变量零膨胀负二项模型分析了与药剂师互动相关的因素。结果：在32,200名符合条件的受益人（平均年龄：74.9岁；48.1%为女性）中，基线12个月期间，每位患者每年（PPPY）平均配药53.1次（标准差：32.5）。使用代理定义，99.3%的受益人有资格接受MTM，但仅有60名独特的MMS接受者。在索引后24个月，受益人累计平均配药198.7次（任何药物）和70.4次（MG相关药物）。此外，73.9%的受益人在药房接种了流感或COVID-19疫苗。在调整模型中，18–29岁年龄组的MG特异性配药率高出7.3倍（95% CI：5.9–8.9；p < 0.0001），而男性的MG特异性配药率比女性高4.1%（95% CI：1.02–1.06；p < 0.0001）。结论：与处方配药和药房接种疫苗相关的高频率药房互动，凸显了药剂师参与以改善药物优化的错失机会。

abstracts.title: Myasthenia Gravis and Chronic Myeloid Leukemia: A Rare Intersection of Autoimmunity and Malignancy
abstracts.authors: Butala, Esha
abstracts.affiliations: Nuvance Health, Poughkeepsie, NY
abstracts.abstract: Objective: NA Background: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an autoimmune disorder caused by antibodies against acetylcholine receptors (AChR) or related proteins at the neuromuscular junction. It causes fatigable weakness involving ocular, bulbar, and respiratory muscles. It affects 150-200 people out of every million, 10-12% having another autoimmune disease. Coexistence with a hematologic malignancy such as chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) is exceedingly rare. CML is a myeloproliferative neoplasm driven by the BCR-ABL1 fusion oncogene, accounting for 15% of adult leukemias. The incidence is 1-2 per 100,000 persons annually. Tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) such as dasatinib have transformed CML into a chronic disease. Although autoimmune complications of TKIs and paraneoplastic syndromes can occur, concurrent MG and CML have been described only in isolated reports. Design/Methods: NA Results: An 81-year-old man with recently diagnosed MG presented with dysphagia, ptosis, and respiratory distress. After one dose of IVIG, he rapidly declined, requiring intubation and plasmapheresis (PLEX). Marked leukocytosis to 24,700 prompted hematology evaluation, revealing BCR–ABL positivity consistent with CML. After completing five PLEX sessions, he improved and was discharged on prednisone and pyridostigmine. Outpatient therapy with dasatinib 100 mg daily stabilized his CML. Later, he transitioned to efgartigimod (Vyvgart) infusions every eight weeks, enabling steroid taper, cessation of pyridostigmine, and sustained neurologic remission. 12 months later, he remained asymptomatic and in hematologic remission. Conclusions: This rare coexistence of MG and CML suggests shared immune dysregulation. In MG, loss of tolerance drives autoantibody formation. In CML, BCR–ABL-mediated clonal expansion alters cytokine and immune signaling. Chronic immune activation may link these processes. Future studies should explore immune profiling to identify convergent pathways, such as Fc receptor signaling and cytokine cross-talk, to guide precision therapies addressing both autoimmunity and malignancy

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：不适用 背景：重症肌无力（MG）是一种自身免疫性疾病，由针对神经肌肉接头处乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）或相关蛋白的抗体引起。它会导致眼肌、延髓肌和呼吸肌的易疲劳性无力。每百万人中有150-200人患病，其中10-12%患有另一种自身免疫性疾病。与慢性粒细胞白血病（CML）等血液系统恶性肿瘤共存的情况极为罕见。CML是一种由BCR-ABL1融合癌基因驱动的骨髓增殖性肿瘤，占成人白血病的15%。年发病率为每10万人1-2例。酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（TKI）如达沙替尼已将CML转变为一种慢性疾病。尽管TKI的自身免疫并发症和副肿瘤综合征可能发生，但MG和CML同时出现仅在个别报告中描述过。设计/方法：不适用 结果：一名81岁近期诊断为MG的男性出现吞咽困难、上睑下垂和呼吸窘迫。在接受一剂IVIG后，病情迅速恶化，需要插管和血浆置换（PLEX）。显著的白细胞增多至24,700促使血液学评估，发现BCR-ABL阳性，符合CML。完成五次PLEX治疗后，他病情好转，出院时服用泼尼松和吡啶斯的明。门诊使用达沙替尼100 mg每日一次稳定了他的CML。随后，他转为每八周接受一次efgartigimod（Vyvgart）输注，从而实现了激素减量、停用吡啶斯的明并维持神经学缓解。12个月后，他仍无症状且处于血液学缓解状态。结论：MG和CML的这种罕见共存提示存在共同的免疫失调。在MG中，耐受性丧失驱动自身抗体形成。在CML中，BCR-ABL介导的克隆扩增改变了细胞因子和免疫信号传导。慢性免疫激活可能连接这些过程。未来的研究应探索免疫谱分析以识别汇聚通路，如Fc受体信号传导和细胞因子串扰，以指导同时针对自身免疫和恶性肿瘤的精准治疗。

abstracts.title: Obesity, In-hospital Outcomes, and Disparities in Myasthenia Gravis Exacerbation: A Nationwide Analysis
abstracts.authors: Maaz, Hafiz; Sohaib, Muhammad; Chaychi, Muhammad Tayyab Muzaffar; Shakil, Rawdah; Ahmed, Muhammad; Kamal, Haris
abstracts.affiliations: Quaid-e-Azam Medical College, Bahawalpur Pakistan, Bahawalpur, Pakistan; Rollins Shool of Public Health, Emory University, Marietta, GA; University of South Florida, Tampa, FL; Dow University of Health Sciences, Karachi, Pakistan; Medical College of Georgia, Augusta University, Rome, GA; University of Texas At Houston, Houston, TX
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To investigate the association of obesity with inpatient outcomes in myasthenia gravis exacerbation and crisis using the national inpatient sample database for the years 2016-2022. Background: Studies have shown that myasthenia gravis and obesity are associated. However, data of class-specific associations and outcomes are limited. Design/Methods: We identified myasthenia gravis (G700*) and obesity (E66) using ICD-10 codes, with obesity stratified by BMI (Class I: 30–34.9, II: 35–39.9, III: ≥40). Outcomes during myasthenia gravis exacerbation hospitalization were measured such as mortality, discharge home, length of stay, and cost, use of plasmapheresis. We used survey-weighted multivariate regression, adjusting for demographics, comorbidity index, and APR-DRG severity, with statistical significance at p<0.05. Results: Of ~300,000 Myasthenia Gravis (MG) hospitalizations, 64,965 were for MG exacerbation (mean age 62.8 years), with 23.8% obesity prevalence. In the exacerbation cohort, Class II obesity was associated with 52% lower in-hospital mortality (aOR 0.48, 95% CI 0.26–0.88), with an adjusted mortality rate of 2.17% versus 4.34% in non-obese patients. Patients with Class I (aOR 1.20) and Class II obesity (aOR 1.30) had higher odds of being discharged home. In contrast, Class III obesity was linked to an 8% longer length of stay (LOS) (IRR 1.08). Mortality risk increased with age (aOR 1.073 per year) and comorbidity score (aOR 1.175 per point). While obesity did not increase hospital charges, significant racial disparities were observed. Compared to White patients, Black patients had 28% lower odds of home discharge (aOR 0.72, p<0.001) and a 13% longer LOS (IRR 1.13, p<0.001). Total hospital charges were substantially higher for Hispanic ($109,509) and Asian ($114,987) patients versus White patients ($86,964, p<0.001). Conclusions: In MG exacerbation hospitalization

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：利用2016-2022年全国住院患者样本数据库，研究肥胖与重症肌无力加重和危象住院结局的关联。背景：研究表明重症肌无力和肥胖相关。然而，关于肥胖分级特异性关联和结局的数据有限。设计/方法：我们使用ICD-10代码识别重症肌无力（G700*）和肥胖（E66），并根据BMI对肥胖进行分层（I级：30–34.9，II级：35–39.9，III级：≥40）。测量了重症肌无力加重住院期间的结局，如死亡率、出院回家、住院时间和费用、血浆置换的使用。我们使用调查加权多变量回归，调整了人口统计学、合并症指数和APR-DRG严重程度，统计学显著性设定为p<0.05。结果：在约300,000例MG住院中，64,965例为MG加重（平均年龄62.8岁），肥胖患病率为23.8%。在加重队列中，II级肥胖与院内死亡率降低52%相关（aOR 0.48，95% CI 0.26–0.88），调整后的死亡率为2.17%，而非肥胖患者为4.34%。I级（aOR 1.20）和II级肥胖（aOR 1.30）患者出院回家的几率更高。相反，III级肥胖与住院时间延长8%相关（IRR 1.08）。死亡风险随年龄（每岁aOR 1.073）和合并症评分（每分aOR 1.175）增加而增加。虽然肥胖并未增加住院费用，但观察到显著的种族差异。与白人患者相比，黑人患者出院回家的几率低28%（aOR 0.72，p<0.001），住院时间长13%（IRR 1.13，p<0.001）。西班牙裔（109,509美元）和亚裔（114,987美元）患者的总住院费用显著高于白人患者（86,964美元，p<0.001）。结论：在MG加重住院中

abstracts.title: Preclinical Characterization of MGAC-007, a First-in-Class Antigen Drug Conjugate for AChR⁺ Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Oved, Kfir; Denkberg, Galit; Reef, Sharon; Arman, Inbar; Pinzur, Lena; Mazor, Roei D.; Harel, Ofer; Erez, Shir; Atiya, Yael; Dowery, Reem; Benatar, Michael; De Baets, Marc; Wolfe, Gil; Kaminski, Henry
abstracts.affiliations: Canopy Immunotherapeutics, Megadim, Israel; Canopy Immunotherapeutics, Tzukei Yam, Israel; Canopy Immunotherapeutics, Haifa, Israel; University of Miami, Miami, FL; Maastricht University, Netherlands; Univ. At Buffalo, SUNY, Buffalo, NY; George Washington University, Washington, DC
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To report the preclinical development of MGAC-007, a novel Antigen Drug Conjugate (AgDC) designed for the treatment of Acetylcholine receptor–positive Myasthenia Gravis (AChR⁺ MG). Background: AChR⁺ MG is an antibody-mediated autoimmune disorder in which a small fraction of B cells produces anti-AChR antibodies that impair neuromuscular transmission and cause fluctuating weakness. Current treatments rely on chronic immunosuppression, increasing infection and malignancy risk while failing to address the disease’s root cause. Canopy Immuno-Therapeutics developed AgDCs: biologics which employ two complementary mechanisms of action (MoA) that specifically sequester pathogenic autoantibodies (MoA1) and selectively eliminate their autoreactive B-cell sources (MoA2), while preserving protective immunity. MGAC-007, Canopy’s lead AgDC, is advancing to a Phase I clinical trial in patients with AChR⁺ MG in 2026. Design/Methods: Ex vivo, in vitro, and in vivo studies were conducted to characterize MGAC-007’s functional activity across its dual mechanisms of action, including assays for autoantibody depletion, B-cell receptor (BCR) binding and cytotoxicity, and potency evaluation in MG animal models. Results: In ex vivo assays using sera from AChR⁺ MG patients, MGAC-007 selectively depleted a median of 73% of pathogenic anti-AChR antibodies while preserving protective titers. In vitro, MGAC-007 selectively lysed AChR-reactive hybridoma cells in a BCR-dependent manner, while sparing unrelated BCR clones. In a passive-transfer myasthenic crisis rat model, MGAC-007 reduced circulating pathogenic antibodies by up to 90% within two hours, restored motor function, reduced mortality by 85–100% and normalized muscle histology versus controls. Furthermore, pretreatment with MGAC-007 reduced the AChR-specific titer of mice immunized with AChR by up to 73%, confirming targeted depletion of AChR-specific B cells with autoreactive potential. Conclusions: Preclinical data strongly support the continued development of MGAC-007, which demonstrates proof-of-concept safety & efficacy as a first-in-class therapy for AChR⁺ MG. Its potential as a targeted immunotherapy will be further evaluated in an upcoming multinational Phase I clinical trial.

abstracts.sessionName: S14: Updates on Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：报告MGAC-007的临床前开发，这是一种新型抗原药物偶联物（AgDC），旨在治疗乙酰胆碱受体阳性重症肌无力（AChR⁺ MG）。背景：AChR⁺ MG是一种抗体介导的自身免疫性疾病，其中一小部分B细胞产生抗AChR抗体，损害神经肌肉传递并导致波动性无力。目前的治疗依赖于慢性免疫抑制，增加了感染和恶性肿瘤风险，同时未能解决疾病的根本原因。Canopy Immuno-Therapeutics开发了AgDC：这些生物制品采用两种互补的作用机制（MoA），特异性隔离致病性自身抗体（MoA1）并选择性消除其自身反应性B细胞来源（MoA2），同时保护保护性免疫。MGAC-007是Canopy的主要AgDC，将于2026年在AChR⁺ MG患者中推进至I期临床试验。设计/方法：进行了离体、体外和体内研究，以表征MGAC-007在其双重作用机制下的功能活性，包括自身抗体耗竭、B细胞受体（BCR）结合和细胞毒性测定，以及在MG动物模型中的效力评估。结果：在使用AChR⁺ MG患者血清的离体测定中，MGAC-007选择性耗竭了中位73%的致病性抗AChR抗体，同时保留了保护性抗体滴度。在体外，MGAC-007以BCR依赖性方式选择性裂解AChR反应性杂交瘤细胞，同时不伤害无关的BCR克隆。在被动转移的重症肌无力危象大鼠模型中，与对照组相比，MGAC-007在两小时内将循环致病性抗体降低高达90%，恢复运动功能，将死亡率降低85-100%，并使肌肉组织学正常化。此外，用MGAC-007预处理可将用AChR免疫的小鼠的AChR特异性抗体滴度降低高达73%，证实了具有自身反应潜能的AChR特异性B细胞的靶向耗竭。结论：临床前数据强有力支持MGAC-007的持续开发，该药物作为AChR⁺ MG的首创疗法展示了概念验证的安全性和有效性。其作为靶向免疫疗法的潜力将在即将开展的多国I期临床试验中进一步评估。

abstracts.title: Prevalence and Prognostic Significance of Autoantibody Profiles in Progression of Ocular Myasthenia Gravis to Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: kwak, ginger; Gonzalez Gutierrez, Erie; Vuppala, Amrita Amanda; Carlson, Chad
abstracts.affiliations: Medical College of Wisconsin, Wauwatosa, WI; Medical College of Wisconsin, Milwaukee, WI; Froedtert Eye Institute, Milwaukee, WI; Froedtert & Medical College of Wisconsin, Milwaukee, WI
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To determine the proportion of ocular myasthenia gravis (OMG) patients with multiple autoantibody positivity and evaluate whether the presence of multiple autoantibodies is associated with an increased risk of progression from OMG to generalized myasthenia gravis (GMG). Background: Acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibodies are found in approximately 50% of patients with OMG and are associated with an increased risk of the disease progressing to GMG. The relationship between the presence, type, and number of autoantibodies in OMG and the clinical course of the disease remains unclear. Design/Methods: We performed a retrospective, single-center chart review of all patients diagnosed with myasthenia gravis (MG) at Froedtert Hospital between January 1, 2016, and August 1, 2023. Clinical data were abstracted from electronic medical records to characterize patient demographics, disease features, treatments, and outcomes. Results: A total of 268 patients with a MG diagnosis were included. Among patients with three positive antibodies, a higher proportion developed generalized MG (26 out of 35, or 74.3%) compared with those with fewer or no antibodies. Among those with 0 antibodies, the distribution of patients who did and did not develop GMG is nearly even. Overall, 67.9% of antibody-negative patients did not develop GMG, while 67.9% of antibody-positive patients did develop GMG. There was a statistically significant association between the number of positive antibodies and the development of generalized MG (p = 0.024), and Linear-by-Linear Association (p = 0.003). Patients with binding antibody positive were significantly more likely to start with or develop GMG (Chi-Square = 29.595, p < 0.001). Conclusions: Across multiple analyses and outcome measures, antibody positivity—especially the presence of multiple antibodies—is strongly associated with higher likelihood of transformation to GMG.

abstracts.sessionName: P11: Neuro-ophthalmology/Neuro-otology: Vestibular and Efferent Neuro-ophthalmic Dysfunction
abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：确定眼肌型重症肌无力（OMG）患者中多种自身抗体阳性的比例，并评估多种自身抗体的存在是否与OMG进展为全身型重症肌无力（GMG）的风险增加相关。背景：乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体在约50%的OMG患者中发现，并与疾病进展为GMG的风险增加相关。OMG中自身抗体的存在、类型和数量与疾病临床病程之间的关系仍不清楚。设计/方法：我们对2016年1月1日至2023年8月1日期间在Froedtert医院诊断为重症肌无力（MG）的所有患者进行了一项回顾性、单中心病历审查。从电子病历中提取临床数据，以描述患者人口统计学、疾病特征、治疗和结局。结果：共纳入268名诊断为MG的患者。在三种抗体阳性的患者中，进展为全身型MG的比例更高（35人中的26人，即74.3%），相比之下，抗体较少或无抗体的患者比例较低。在0种抗体的患者中，进展为GMG和未进展为GMG的患者分布几乎相等。总体而言，67.9%的抗体阴性患者未进展为GMG，而67.9%的抗体阳性患者进展为GMG。阳性抗体数量与全身型MG的发展之间存在统计学显著关联（p = 0.024），线性关联检验（p = 0.003）。结合抗体阳性的患者更可能以GMG起病或进展为GMG（卡方=29.595，p < 0.001）。结论：在多项分析和结局指标中，抗体阳性——尤其是多种抗体的存在——与转化为GMG的可能性更高密切相关。

abstracts.title: Proximal Complement Inhibition in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Shelly, Shahar; Lalla, Marianna; Zhao, Yang; Rehaume, Linda; Cross, Jennifer; Vu, Tuan
abstracts.affiliations: Rambam Health Care Campus, Israel; Dianthus Therapeutics, NY; University of South Florida, Tampa, FL
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To determine whether active C1s (aC1s) inhibition by claseprubart (DNTH103) suppresses generation of C3a, C3b and membrane attack complex (MAC), and whether its complement inhibition profile is different to that of the C5 inhibitor ravulizumab. Background: In generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), pathogenic antibodies activate the classical complement pathway, culminating in MAC mediated injury at the neuromuscular junction (NMJ). Levels of complement components at the level of C3 have been associated with gMG disease severity in animal models. C5 inhibitors block MAC formation and improve clinical outcomes, but they do not reduce the upstream inflammatory fragments C3a and C3b, which potentially drive NMJ injury and amplify immune responses even without new MAC formation. Design/Methods: We quantified MAC formation using the Wieslab® Complement Classical Pathway assay in 1% normal human serum (NHS). Measured C3a in supernatants by ELISA and assessed C3b deposition on sensitized human red blood cells in 5% NHS by flow cytometry. For each assay, we tested dilution series of claseprubart, ravulizumab, and an isotype control. Results: In head-to-head assays, claseprubart to ravulizumab produced comparable inhibition of MAC formation, confirming similar terminal pathway blockade. In contrast, only upstream aC1s inhibition with claseprubart resulted in near complete inhibition of the generation of C3a and C3b under the assay conditions tested, while ravulizumab did not. These findings were reproduced across three independent experiments, supporting a mechanistic distinction between upstream (aC1s) and downstream (C5) blockade. Conclusions: Upstream aC1s inhibition with claseprubart prevented MAC formation and reduced C3a and C3b to minimal levels, demonstrating potentially broader inflammatory control than C5 blockade and supporting the possibility for added clinical benefit while sparing the alternative and lectin pathways. These effects may provide immunological advantages by preserving innate defense mechanisms and pathophysiological advantages by limiting complement mediated injury at the neuromuscular junction.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：确定claseprubart（DNTH103）对活性C1s（aC1s）的抑制是否能抑制C3a、C3b和膜攻击复合物（MAC）的生成，以及其补体抑制谱是否与C5抑制剂ravulizumab不同。背景：在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）中，致病性抗体激活经典补体通路，最终在神经肌肉接头（NMJ）处形成MAC介导的损伤。在动物模型中，C3水平的补体成分与gMG疾病严重程度相关。C5抑制剂可阻断MAC形成并改善临床结局，但它们不会减少上游炎症片段C3a和C3b，这些片段即使在无新MAC形成的情况下也可能驱动NMJ损伤并放大免疫反应。设计/方法：我们使用Wieslab®补体经典通路检测法在1%正常人血清（NHS）中定量MAC形成。通过ELISA测量上清液中的C3a，并通过流式细胞术评估5% NHS中致敏人红细胞上的C3b沉积。对于每个检测，我们测试了claseprubart、ravulizumab和同种型对照的稀释系列。结果：在头对头检测中，claseprubart与ravulizumab对MAC形成的抑制程度相当，证实了相似的末端通路阻断。相比之下，在测试的检测条件下，只有claseprubart对上游aC1s的抑制导致C3a和C3b的生成几乎完全被抑制，而ravulizumab则没有。这些发现在三个独立实验中重复，支持上游（aC1s）和下游（C5）阻断之间的机制区别。结论：claseprubart对上游aC1s的抑制阻止了MAC形成，并将C3a和C3b降至最低水平，显示出比C5阻断更广泛的炎症控制潜力，并支持在保留替代途径和凝集素途径的同时获得额外临床获益的可能性。这些效应可能通过保留先天防御机制提供免疫学优势，并通过限制神经肌肉接头处的补体介导损伤提供病理生理学优势。

abstracts.title: Rituximab Combined With Plasma Exchange as Induction Therapy for Patients With Generalized Myasthenia
abstracts.authors: Alba Isasi, María; Cabrera, Jose Maria; Charry, Paola; Fonseca, Elianet; Guasp, Mar; Alberti, Blanca; Guerra-Fernandez, Victor; calvi, Alberto; Llufriu, Sara; Hernando, Ana; Sepulveda, María; Cid, Joan; Lozano, Miquel; Blanco Morgado, Yolanda; Saiz, Albert; Martinez-Hernandez, Eugenia
abstracts.affiliations: Hospital Clinic Barcelona, Barcelona, Spain; Hospital Clinic Barcelona, Spain
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To investigate the feasibility, safety and clinical response to combine Rituximab and plasma exchange (PLEX) as induction therapy for patients with seropositive generalized myasthenia gravis (MG). Background: These therapies have shown effective in refractory MG, but their combination, which could theoretically offer synergistic benefits, has not been evaluated. Design/Methods: In this single-centre, open-label study patients with moderate-severe symptoms new-onset or exacerbated MG were recruited. Rituximab was administered before and after 6 PLEX sessions and intravenous immunoglobulin replacement doses every two PLEX. PLEX were performed through peripheral venous access with ultrasound guidance when needed. Tolerability and clinical severity were assessed by MGFA classification, MG-ADL score and documenting concomitant medications at baseline and after 6 months. Results: Between December 2022-October 2025, we included 13 patients; 7 (54%) were women with median age of 65 years (IQR: 51-78). All patients had positive AChR-antibodies, and one had concurrent MuSK. At baseline, 1 patient was in MGFA class V, 6 in IV, 4 III and 2 IIb; all received pyridostigmine, 12 prednisone (median dose 30 mg/d; IQR 19-45), 4 azathioprine and 1 mycophenolate. Five (40%) patients were treated at onset-MG (median MG-ADL=8; IQR: 5-13) and 8 (60%) for predominantly bulbar exacerbations (MG-ADL=6.5; IQR: 5-8). Only mild adverse effects were observed in 3 (23%) patients. Therapy was extended for 11 (85%) patients, in 7 (64%) with 6 additional PLEX sessions over 2 months and in 4 (36%) with maintenance monthly PLEX sessions. At 6 months, 8 of 10 evaluated patients (80%) showed clinically meaningful improvement (MG-ADL=2.5; IQR: 1-5) with decreased dose of prednisone (median dose 20 mg/d; IQR: 12-38), and 2 (20%) did not respond (MG-ADL=6.5;IQR 5-8) and were switched to C5-inhibitor therapy. Conclusions: In our patients, the antibody- and B cell-depleting combinational was feasible, safe and efficacious as induction therapy, showing a favourable 6-month response in most cases.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：确定眼肌型重症肌无力（OMG）患者中多种自身抗体阳性的比例，并评估多种自身抗体的存在是否与OMG进展为全身型重症肌无力（GMG）的风险增加相关。背景：乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体在约50%的OMG患者中发现，并与疾病进展为GMG的风险增加相关。OMG中自身抗体的存在、类型和数量与疾病临床病程之间的关系仍不清楚。设计/方法：我们对2016年1月1日至2023年8月1日期间在Froedtert医院诊断为重症肌无力（MG）的所有患者进行了一项回顾性、单中心病历审查。从电子病历中提取临床数据，以描述患者人口统计学、疾病特征、治疗和结局。结果：共纳入268名诊断为MG的患者。在三种抗体阳性的患者中，进展为全身型MG的比例更高（35人中的26人，即74.3%），相比之下，抗体较少或无抗体的患者比例较低。在0种抗体的患者中，进展为GMG和未进展为GMG的患者分布几乎相等。总体而言，67.9%的抗体阴性患者未进展为GMG，而67.9%的抗体阳性患者进展为GMG。阳性抗体数量与全身型MG的发展之间存在统计学显著关联（p = 0.024），线性关联检验（p = 0.003）。结合抗体阳性的患者更可能以GMG起病或进展为GMG（卡方=29.595，p < 0.001）。结论：在多项分析和结局指标中，抗体阳性——尤其是多种抗体的存在——与转化为GMG的可能性更高密切相关。

abstracts.title: Self-reported Clinical Characteristics of a U.S. Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Population Treated With Standard of Care Therapy: Results From a Real-world Patient Survey
abstracts.authors: Pesa, Jacqueline; Jackson, Louis; Gibson, Gregor; Connolly, Hannah; Birija, Shiva; Poirrette, Beth; Foster, Amy; Govindarajan, Raghav
abstracts.affiliations: Johnson & Johnson, Horsham, PA; Adelphi Real World, Macclesfield, United Kingdom; HSHS St. Elizabeth Medical Group, O'Fallon, IL
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To explore characteristics among generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) patients treated with standard of care (SOC) therapies. Background: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is a rare, autoimmune condition affecting the neuromuscular junction. As the MG treatment landscape has evolved to include novel, targeted immunotherapies, clinicians have the option to tailor treatment based on clinical characteristics to potentially improve outcomes and patient satisfaction. Design/Methods: Data came from a US-based survey of gMG patients conducted in October 2024 and included those prescribed SOC at time of survey. Patients self-reported demographics, clinical characteristics current treatment satisfaction and disease status. Descriptive statistics are presented. Results: Overall, 157 patients were included: mean (standard deviation; SD) age of 50 (14) years, 89% female, and 39 (16) years at diagnosis. Respectively, 38.9% were Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America class II, 50.3% class III and (10.8%) class IV. Mean (SD) myasthenia gravis – activities of daily living (MG-ADL) score was 8.5 (3.4) and 86.6% had a score of < 5. The most frequently reported symptoms were physical fatigue (91.7%), weakness in arms (72.0%) and weakness in legs (72.0%). In the 12 months prior to survey, 59.9% reported experiencing at least one symptom exacerbation, 36.3% reported at least one hospitalization and 14.0% reported a myasthenic crisis. Mean (SD) time on current treatment was 2.9 (4.2) years. Overall, 32.5% of patients reported being either dissatisfied or very dissatisfied with their current treatment and 28.7% described their condition/symptoms as worse than 12 months ago. Conclusions: Self-reported high MG-ADL scores, frequent clinical events and persisting symptoms in this patient population with gMG highlights the existing unmet need in patients treated with SOC. These findings suggest there exists a high proportion of gMG patients for whom advanced therapies should be considered to provide sustained symptom control and reduce clinical events.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：探讨接受标准治疗（SOC）的全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者的特征。背景：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种罕见的、影响神经肌肉接头的自身免疫性疾病。随着MG治疗领域的发展，出现了新型靶向免疫疗法，临床医生可以根据临床特征选择个体化治疗，以潜在地改善结局和患者满意度。设计/方法：数据来自2024年10月进行的一项基于美国的gMG患者调查，包括调查时正在接受SOC处方的患者。患者自我报告人口统计学、临床特征、当前治疗满意度和疾病状态。呈现描述性统计结果。结果：共纳入157名患者：平均（标准差；SD）年龄50（14）岁，89%为女性，诊断时平均年龄39（16）岁。分别有38.9%为美国重症肌无力基金会II级，50.3%为III级，10.8%为IV级。平均（SD）重症肌无力-日常生活活动能力（MG-ADL）评分为8.5（3.4），86.6%的患者评分<5。最常报告的症状是身体疲劳（91.7%）、手臂无力（72.0%）和腿部无力（72.0%）。在调查前的12个月内，59.9%报告至少经历一次症状加重，36.3%报告至少一次住院，14.0%报告肌无力危象。当前治疗的平均（SD）持续时间为2.9（4.2）年。总体而言，32.5%的患者报告对当前治疗不满意或非常不满意，28.7%描述其状况/症状比12个月前更差。结论：该gMG患者群体中自我报告的高MG-ADL评分、频繁的临床事件和持续存在的症状，突显了接受SOC治疗的患者中存在的未满足需求。这些发现表明，有高比例的gMG患者应考虑使用先进疗法以提供持续的症状控制并减少临床事件。

abstracts.title: Sleep Disorders in Myasthenia Gravis: A Systematic Review on Prevalence, Clinical Associations, and the Accuracy of Assessment Methodologies
abstracts.authors: Yakubu, Aliu; Lawal, Farouk; Nwaze, Chukwuma; Egede, Favour; Olalude, Oluwakemi; Anifalaje, Olorungbami
abstracts.affiliations: University of Texas Medical Branch, US, Galveston, TX; Good Hope Hospital, Birmingham,UK, United Kingdom; Lagos University Teaching Hospital, Lagos, Nigeria, Lagos, Nigeria; University of Benin Teaching Hospital, Benin City, Edo State, Nigeria, Nigeria; Lagos State University Teaching Hospital, Ikeja, Lagos, Nigeria, Nigeria; Dumfries and Galloway Royal Infirmary, Scotland, United Kingdom
abstracts.abstract: Objective: This systematic review synthesizes evidence on the prevalence, types, and assessment challenges of sleep disorders in Myasthenia gravis. Background: Sleep disorders are a frequently reported yet poorly characterized aspect of myasthenia gravis(MG), a chronic autoimmune neuromuscular disorder marked by fluctuating muscle weakness. Beyond motor impairment, MG patients often experience systemic fatigue, mood disturbances, and impaired daily functioning, all of which may be compounded by disrupted sleep. Upper-airway and respiratory muscle weakness, medication effects, and autonomic changes plausibly contribute to insomnia, obstructive sleep apnea, restless legs syndrome and excessive daytime sleepiness. Despite their potential impact, these manifestations remain underrecognized, and the accuracy of standard screening tools in this population continues to represent a major clinical challenge. Design/Methods: A systematic search of PubMed, Embase, and PsycInfo was conducted from inception to April 2025. Observational studies reporting on sleep disorders in clinically diagnosed MG patients were included. Study quality was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute tools. Results: Of 812 unique records, 27 studies (n= 3,889 participants) were included. The prevalence was 15-79% for obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and 38-77% for poor sleep quality (PSQI >5). Restless leg syndrome (5-47.6%) and excessive daytime sleepiness (12-75%) were also highly prevalent. Higher Body mass index and male sex were significant risk factors for OSA and sleep-disordered breathing. A critical finding was the significant discrepancy between subjective questionnaires and objective polysomnography (PSG). Subjective questionnaires overestimated OSA risk due to symptom overlap, while objective polysomnography provided more specific diagnoses. Notably, most studies found no significant association between MG disease severity scores and sleep disorders. Sleep disorders were strongly correlated with worsened MG-specific quality of life, fatigue, and depression scores. Conclusions: Sleep disorders are exceedingly common in MG, but their assessment is confounded by the inherent limitations of subjective questionnaires. The dissociation from disease severity suggests a distinct, multifactorial pathophysiology.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：本系统综述综合了关于重症肌无力（MG）中睡眠障碍的患病率、类型和评估挑战的证据。背景：睡眠障碍是MG中一个经常被报告但特征描述不足的方面，MG是一种以波动性肌无力为特征的慢性自身免疫性神经肌肉疾病。除了运动障碍，MG患者经常经历全身性疲劳、情绪障碍和日常功能受损，所有这些都可能因睡眠中断而加剧。上气道和呼吸肌无力、药物影响以及自主神经变化可能合理地导致失眠、阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停、不宁腿综合征和日间过度嗜睡。尽管有潜在影响，这些表现仍未得到充分认识，且标准筛查工具在该人群中的准确性仍然是一个主要的临床挑战。设计/方法：对PubMed、Embase和PsycInfo进行了从建库至2025年4月的系统检索。纳入了报告临床确诊MG患者睡眠障碍的观察性研究。使用乔安娜布里格斯研究所工具评估研究质量。结果：在812条独特记录中，纳入了27项研究（n=3,889名参与者）。阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）的患病率为15-79%，睡眠质量差（PSQI>5）的患病率为38-77%。不宁腿综合征（5-47.6%）和日间过度嗜睡（12-75%）也非常普遍。较高的体重指数和男性是OSA和睡眠呼吸障碍的显著风险因素。一个关键发现是主观问卷与客观多导睡眠图（PSG）之间存在显著差异。由于症状重叠，主观问卷高估了OSA风险，而客观多导睡眠图提供了更具体的诊断。值得注意的是，大多数研究发现MG疾病严重程度评分与睡眠障碍之间无显著关联。睡眠障碍与恶化的MG特异性生活质量、疲劳和抑郁评分密切相关。结论：睡眠障碍在MG中极为常见，但其评估受到主观问卷固有局限性的干扰。与疾病严重程度的分离表明存在一种独特的、多因素的病理生理学。

abstracts.title: Social Determinants of Health in Urban Patients With Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Gaspar, Veronica; Bhavaraju-Sanka, Ratna
abstracts.affiliations: UT Health San Antonio, San Antonio, TX; UT Health Science Center @ San Antonio, San Antonio, TX
abstracts.abstract: Objective: This research project seeks to identify the social determinants of health (SDOH) faced by Myasthenia Gravis (MG) patients who receive care locally either at a university academic center or a county hospital-affiliated clinic, the latter of which is part of a safety net hospital system for uninsured and underinsured individuals. Background: The data on SDOH faced by MG patients is limited. More information is needed for health care providers to better address the needs of their patients. Design/Methods: We conducted a retrospective chart review of MG patients and collected data on demographics, home address, employment status, insurance coverage, comorbidities, health behaviors, emergency department (ED) visits, hospitalizations, most recent MG-ADL score, and clinic no-shows. Home address was used to determine neighborhood disadvantage using the Area Deprivation Index (ADI) which is a validated tool reflecting 17 different domains of SDOH including education level, income, housing, and employment. Results: Included in this study, are a group of 39 patients seen at the county-affiliated hospital (group A) and 330 seen at the university academic center (group B). Group A had a higher percentage of Hispanic/Latino patients (69.2% vs 39.7%) and a higher proportion of Spanish speakers (25.6% vs 2.1%). Group A also had higher unemployment rates (35.9% vs 7.0%) and disability (17.9% vs 3.6%). Group A had lower use of private insurance (15.4% vs 63.3%) and greater usage of an income-based county-sponsored financial assistance program (23.1% vs 0.3%). More than half of Group A had homes in the most disadvantaged neighborhoods (ADI decile 9 and 10). Finally, Group A had higher rates of clinic no-shows, ED visits and hospitalizations. Conclusions: The two groups varied in demographics, employment, insurance coverage, and neighborhood disadvantage, and had different rates of clinic no-shows, ED visits and hospitalizations. More research is needed to better understand and address these disparities.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：本研究旨在识别在本地大学学术中心或县医院附属诊所（后者是面向无保险和保险不足人群的安全网医院系统的一部分）接受治疗的重症肌无力（MG）患者所面临的社会健康决定因素（SDOH）。背景：关于MG患者所面临的SDOH的数据有限。医疗保健提供者需要更多信息来更好地满足患者的需求。设计/方法：我们对MG患者进行了回顾性病历审查，收集了人口统计学、家庭住址、就业状况、保险覆盖范围、合并症、健康行为、急诊科（ED）就诊、住院、最近的MG-ADL评分以及诊所失约情况的数据。家庭住址用于通过区域剥夺指数（ADI）确定社区劣势，ADI是一个经过验证的工具，反映了SDOH的17个不同领域，包括教育水平、收入、住房和就业。结果：本研究包括在县附属医院就诊的39名患者（A组）和在大学学术中心就诊的330名患者（B组）。A组中西班牙裔/拉丁裔患者的比例更高（69.2% vs 39.7%），西班牙语使用者的比例也更高（25.6% vs 2.1%）。A组的失业率（35.9% vs 7.0%）和残疾率（17.9% vs 3.6%）也更高。A组使用私人保险的比例较低（15.4% vs 63.3%），而使用基于收入的县级财政援助计划的比例更高（23.1% vs 0.3%）。超过一半的A组患者居住在劣势最严重的社区（ADI十分位数9和10）。最后，A组的诊所失约率、急诊就诊率和住院率更高。结论：两组在人口统计学、就业、保险覆盖范围和社区劣势方面存在差异，并且在诊所失约率、急诊就诊率和住院率方面也不同。需要更多的研究来更好地理解和解决这些差异。

abstracts.title: Synergistic Clinical Improvement in a Refractory AChR-positive Non-thymomatous Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Patient Treated With Concurrent Zilucoplan and Rozanolixizumab
abstracts.authors: Wei, Miao Iris; Darki, Leila; Beydoun, Said
abstracts.affiliations: University of Southern California, CA; University of Southern California, Los Angeles, CA
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To describe a patient with refractory AChR-positive generalized MG who required multiple biologic transitions and achieved significant clinical improvement with concurrent zilucoplan and rozanolixizumab therapy. Background: Zilucoplan, a complement C5 inhibitor, and rozanolixizumab, an FcRn (neonatal Fc receptor) antagonist, are novel targeted agents approved for generalized myasthenia gravis (MG). Both have demonstrated efficacy in reducing disease activity through their distinct mechanisms. However, the concurrent use of these agents has not been systematically studied, and data on potential synergistic effects are lacking. Design/Methods: A 70-year-old female patient developed ocular myasthenia gravis in June 2023, confirmed as AChR-positive and initially responsive to prednisone and pyridostigmine. She progressed to generalized disease with bulbar involvement and respiratory failure in July 2024, requiring intubation. Despite multiple courses of IVIG and plasma exchange, she experienced recurrent relapses and was transferred to our facility. On initial evaluation, patient had stage V MG by MGFA criteria. She was started on eculizumab, achieving marked clinical improvement. She was later transitioned to ravulizumab with initial stability but relapsed in early 2025 despite high-dose steroids, necessitating additional plasma exchange. Zilucoplan was initiated. Due to ongoing disease activity and difficulty tapering steroids, rozanolixizumab was added. Results: Following initiation of zilucoplan, the patient showed gradual improvement but remained steroid-dependent with limited tolerance for tapering. Due to refractoriness, rozanolixizumab was added, which allowed successful steroid tapering, reaching minimal symptoms expression (Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living Scale=0) within 4 months, which persisted till her last evaluation in September 2025. Conclusions: This case highlights the potential synergistic benefit of dual-pathway inhibition. This combination may be feasible as zilucoplan (a macrocyclic peptide) and rozanolixizumab (a monoclonal antibody) have distinct mechanisms and no known pharmacologic interaction. Further research is needed to evaluate the safety, efficacy, and immunologic rationale of concurrent use in larger controlled studies.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：描述一名难治性AChR阳性全身型MG患者，该患者需要多次生物制剂转换，并通过同时使用zilucoplan和rozanolixizumab治疗实现了显著的临床改善。背景：Zilucoplan（一种补体C5抑制剂）和rozanolixizumab（一种FcRn拮抗剂）是获批用于全身型重症肌无力（MG）的新型靶向药物。两者均通过其独特的机制在减少疾病活动方面显示出疗效。然而，这些药物的同时使用尚未得到系统研究，且缺乏关于潜在协同效应的数据。设计/方法：一名70岁女性患者于2023年6月出现眼肌型重症肌无力，确诊为AChR阳性，最初对泼尼松和吡啶斯的明有反应。她于2024年7月进展为伴有延髓受累和呼吸衰竭的全身型疾病，需要插管。尽管接受了多个疗程的IVIG和血浆置换，她仍反复复发，并被转至我院。初次评估时，患者根据MGFA标准为V期MG。她开始使用eculizumab，取得了显著的临床改善。后来她转为使用ravulizumab，初期病情稳定，但在2025年初尽管使用了大剂量类固醇仍复发，需要额外的血浆置换。随后启动了zilucoplan。由于疾病活动持续且难以减量类固醇，加用了rozanolixizumab。结果：在启动zilucoplan后，患者逐渐改善，但仍依赖类固醇，且对减量耐受性有限。由于难治性，加用了rozanolixizumab，这使得类固醇成功减量，并在4个月内达到最小症状表达（MG-ADL=0），这一状态持续至她2025年9月的最后一次评估。结论：本病例突显了双通路抑制的潜在协同获益。这种组合可能是可行的，因为zilucoplan（一种大环肽）和rozanolixizumab（一种单克隆抗体）具有不同的机制，且没有已知的药理学相互作用。需要在更大规模的对照研究中进一步评估同时使用的安全性、有效性和免疫学原理。

abstracts.title: The Phase Four OCTAGON Study Investigating Oral Corticosteroid Tapering in Adult Patients With Generalized Myasthenia Gravis (gMG) Treated With Ravulizumab: Trial in Progress
abstracts.authors: Yungher, Benjamin; Weiskopf, Emma; Aguzzi, Rasha; Sabatella, Guido
abstracts.affiliations: Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease, Boston, MA
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To describe OCTAGON, a phase 4 study evaluating the effectiveness and safety of a rapid, predefined oral corticosteroid (OCS) tapering schedule in adult patients with gMG receiving ravulizumab. Background: OCS are used to treat patients with anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive (AChR-Ab+) gMG. However, high-dose therapy and long-term use—even at lower doses—are associated with substantial systemic adverse effects (AEs). Ravulizumab, a complement component 5 inhibitor approved for AChR-Ab+ gMG, enables reduction and discontinuation of OCS, while maintaining symptom control. Treatment guidelines recommend steroid-sparing strategies, yet clinical practice trends employ prolonged OCS tapering regimens with higher steroid exposure and risk of associated AEs compared with faster tapering. OCTAGON is a global phase 4, prospective, multicenter, single-arm study investigating OCS tapering in adult patients with gMG receiving ravulizumab (NCT07221838). Design/Methods: Planned enrollment: ~75 adults with gMG, receiving ravulizumab Q8W and a stable OCS regimen equivalent to a daily average of ≥7.5mg/day for ≥4weeks. A tapering schedule based on baseline (BL) OCS dose will be assessed. Patients with BL OCS 7.5-10mg/day will reduce by 2.5mg/day Q4W to 2.5mg/day, then by 1.25mg/day Q4W until completion. Patients with BL OCS >10mg/day will reduce by 5mg/day Q2W to 10mg/day, then follow the schedule for those with BL OCS 7.5-10mg/day. Primary endpoint is the proportion of patients who discontinue OCS or reduce to ≤5mg/day (if the reason for no further OCS reduction is suspected adrenal insufficiency) and maintain for ≥4weeks without gMG clinical deterioration. Results: N/A Conclusions: OCTAGON addresses a critical unmet need for an evidence-based rapid OCS tapering schedule in patients with gMG. Results will provide a framework for effective and safe OCS treatment management in the targeted immunotherapy era, minimizing risks associated with prolonged corticosteroid exposure, while optimizing outcomes for patients with gMG receiving ravulizumab.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：描述OCTAGON研究，这是一项评估在接受ravulizumab治疗的成人gMG患者中，快速、预定义的口服皮质类固醇（OCS）减量方案的疗效和安全性的4期研究。背景：OCS用于治疗抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）gMG患者。然而，高剂量治疗和长期使用（即使剂量较低）与显著的全身性不良事件（AE）相关。Ravulizumab是一种获批用于AChR-Ab+ gMG的补体成分5抑制剂，能够在维持症状控制的同时减少和停用OCS。治疗指南推荐类固醇减量策略，然而临床实践趋势倾向于采用更长的OCS减量方案，与快速减量相比，这会导致更高的类固醇暴露和相关AE风险。OCTAGON是一项全球性4期、前瞻性、多中心、单臂研究，旨在调查接受ravulizumab治疗的成人gMG患者的OCS减量情况（NCT07221838）。设计/方法：计划入组：约75名成人gMG患者，接受ravulizumab Q8W治疗，并且每日平均剂量相当于≥7.5mg/天的稳定OCS方案持续≥4周。将根据基线（BL）OCS剂量评估减量方案。BL OCS为7.5-10mg/天的患者将每4周减少2.5mg/天至2.5mg/天，然后每4周减少1.25mg/天直至完成。BL OCS >10mg/天的患者将每2周减少5mg/天至10mg/天，然后遵循BL OCS为7.5-10mg/天患者的方案。主要终点是停用OCS或减量至≤5mg/天（如果不再进一步减量OCS的原因是怀疑肾上腺功能不全）并维持≥4周且无gMG临床恶化的患者比例。结果：不适用。结论：OCTAGON解决了gMG患者对基于证据的快速OCS减量方案的关键未满足需求。结果将为靶向免疫治疗时代有效且安全的OCS治疗管理提供框架，最大限度地减少与长期皮质类固醇暴露相关的风险，同时优化接受ravulizumab治疗的gMG患者的结局。

abstracts.title: Thymectomy and Survival – The Role of Thymic Malignancy and MG
abstracts.authors: Ani, Mor; Shelly, Shahar; Ramon-Gonen, Roni; Miron, Keren
abstracts.affiliations: Rambam Medical Center, Haifa, Israel; Bar-Ilan University, Ramat Gan, Israel
abstracts.abstract: Objective: Compare mortality and malignancy in patients following thymectomy over a 10-year period versus controls. Background: A recent publication suggest that thymectomy is associated with increased mortality and cancer risk following the procedure. We aim in this study to validate and extend these findings. Design/Methods: We identified thymectomy patients and patients who underwent coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) or valve replacement surgery between the years 1986-2025. All patients who died within 90 days of surgery were excluded. Controls with prior myocardial infarction or prior thymectomy were excluded. Kaplan–Meier analysis and propensity score matching by age and sex were used. Results: Among 425 thymectomy patients (median age 54 years; 50.4% women) and 5,401 matched controls (median age 67 years; 32.6% women), survival did not differ significantly after adjustment for baseline characteristics (hazard ratio 0.78; 95% CI 0.54–1.13; p = 0.19).Among thymectomy patients, survival varied according to indication. Those with thymic malignancy had markedly worse outcomes than patients without malignancy (p<0.0001), whereas myasthenia gravis (MG) was not associated with reduced survival (p=0.14). Survival did not differ by sex within the thymectomy group (p=0.64), although in the control cohort, female sex was associated with higher mortality (p<0.0001). In both cohorts, advancing age correlated with increased mortality (p<0.0001). After matching for age and sex, survival curves between the thymectomy and control groups showed no significant difference (p=0.077). Conclusions: Thymectomy was not associated with increased mortality compared with matched controls. Thymic malignancy, but not myasthenia gravis, was linked to poorer survival. Older age remained the principal predictor of mortality, while sex influenced outcomes only in the control cohort. These findings suggest that previously reported adverse survival after thymectomy may reflect baseline confounding rather than a causal effect.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：比较胸腺切除术后患者与对照组在10年期间的死亡率和恶性肿瘤发生率。背景：最近的一篇出版物提示胸腺切除术与术后死亡率和癌症风险增加相关。本研究旨在验证并扩展这些发现。设计/方法：我们识别了1986年至2025年间接受胸腺切除术的患者以及接受冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）或瓣膜置换手术的患者。排除了术后90天内死亡的所有患者。排除了既往有心肌梗死或既往胸腺切除术的对照组。使用了Kaplan-Meier分析和按年龄和性别进行的倾向评分匹配。结果：在425名胸腺切除术患者（中位年龄54岁；50.4%为女性）和5,401名匹配对照组（中位年龄67岁；32.6%为女性）中，根据基线特征调整后，生存率无显著差异（风险比0.78；95% CI 0.54–1.13；p = 0.19）。在胸腺切除术患者中，生存率因适应症而异。患有胸腺恶性肿瘤的患者结局明显差于无恶性肿瘤的患者（p<0.0001），而重症肌无力（MG）与生存率降低无关（p=0.14）。在胸腺切除术组内，生存率无性别差异（p=0.64），尽管在对照组中，女性与更高的死亡率相关（p<0.0001）。在两个队列中，年龄增长均与死亡率增加相关（p<0.0001）。在按年龄和性别匹配后，胸腺切除术组和对照组之间的生存曲线无显著差异（p=0.077）。结论：与匹配的对照组相比，胸腺切除术与死亡率增加无关。胸腺恶性肿瘤（而非重症肌无力）与较差的生存率相关。年龄增长仍是死亡率的主要预测因素，而性别仅在对照组中影响结局。这些发现表明，先前报道的胸腺切除术后不良生存率可能反映了基线混杂因素而非因果关系。

abstracts.authors: Narayanaswami, Pushpa; Mantegazza, Renato; Barnett Tapia, Carolina; Cortes-Vicente, Elena; Freimer, Miriam; Gilhus, Nils; Habib, Ali A.; Howard Jr., James F.; Kostera-Pruszczyk, Anna; Leite, M. abstracts.affiliations: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Boston, MA; Fondazione IRCCS, Istituto Nazionale Neurologico Carlo Besta, Milan, Italy; General Hospital, University of Toronto, Toronto, ON, Canada; Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau, Barcelona, Spain; The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center, Columbus, OH; Haukeland University Hospital, Bergen, Norway; University of California, Irvine, Orange, CA; The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, Chapel Hill, NC; Medical University of Warsaw, Warsaw, Poland; Nuffield Department of Clinical Neurosciences - University of Oxford, Oxford, United Kingdom; Charité Universitätsmedizin Berlin, Berlin, Germany; University of Kansas Medical Center, Kansas City, KS; Pasteur 2 Hospital, Centre Hospitalier Universitaire de Nice, Nice, France; University at Buffalo, buffalo, NY; Tokyo Metropolitan Neurological Hospital, Tokyo, Japan; Chiba University, Chiba, Japan; Hanamaki General Hospital, Hanamaki, Japan
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To develop globally relevant consensus recommendations to define and operationalize treatment goals for patients with myasthenia gravis (MG). Background: Treatment goals are important in guiding individualized treatment selection and therapeutic adjustments in MG, but limited guidance is available on how to define, implement and achieve goals. Design/Methods: An international panel of MG experts was formed. A review of the literature was conducted to inform the development of consensus recommendations. Relevant topics were selected by the steering committee and draft recommendations developed for each topic by the methodologist. The RAND/UCLA appropriateness method was used to achieve formal consensus. All panel members rated the draft recommendations online on a scale of 1 (extremely inappropriate) to 9 (extremely appropriate). Panelists provided comments and suggestions for modifications. The methodologist modified recommendations for further rating rounds, based on summary scores and qualitative panel feedback. Recommendations that achieved agreement as appropriate by four rounds of voting were accepted. Results: Seventeen MG experts from North America, Europe and Asia rated the recommendations. Overall, 21 recommendations reached agreement as appropriate. Recommendation 1 defined the ongoing treatment goal in MG as “to work towards, achieve and sustain minimal symptoms and treatment-related adverse events, with a patient-acceptable quality of life (using validated measures)”. Subsequent recommendations described how to implement and achieve this goal for individual patients, across six areas: establishing and sustaining a treatment goal; working towards early symptom control; infection screening and vaccination; pregnancy/family planning; fatigue and comorbidity management; and managing impending crisis and crisis. Recommendations emphasise the importance of patient engagement and education, reassessing and changing treatment to achieve goals, and care coordination with other specialists. The recommendations will be presented in full. Conclusions: Expert consensus was reached on a range of globally relevant recommendations for treatment goals in MG. These recommendations will inform patient care for optimal disease outcomes.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：制定全球相关的共识建议，以定义重症肌无力（MG）患者的治疗目标并使其可操作化。背景：治疗目标对于指导MG个体化治疗选择和调整很重要，但关于如何定义、实施和实现目标的指导有限。设计/方法：成立了一个国际MG专家小组。进行了文献综述，为制定共识建议提供信息。指导委员会选择了相关主题，方法学家为每个主题制定了建议草案。采用RAND/UCLA适当性方法达成正式共识。所有小组成员在线对建议草案进行评分，评分范围为1（极不适当）到9（极适当）。小组成员提供了修改意见和评论。方法学家根据汇总分数和定性小组反馈修改建议，以进行进一步的评分轮次。经过四轮投票达成一致认为适当的建议被接受。结果：来自北美、欧洲和亚洲的17位MG专家对建议进行了评分。总体而言，21条建议达成一致认为适当。建议1将MG的持续治疗目标定义为“努力实现并维持最小症状和治疗相关不良事件，并具有患者可接受的生活质量（使用经过验证的测量工具）”。后续建议描述了如何在六个领域为个体患者实施和实现这一目标：建立和维持治疗目标；努力实现早期症状控制；感染筛查和疫苗接种；妊娠/计划生育；疲劳和合并症管理；以及管理即将发生的危象和危象。建议强调了患者参与和教育、重新评估和改变治疗以实现目标、以及与其他专科医生协调护理的重要性。将完整呈现这些建议。结论：就MG治疗目标的一系列全球相关建议达成了专家共识。这些建议将为患者护理提供信息，以实现最佳疾病结局。
