abstracts.title: Treatment Patterns of Biologic Therapies in a Real-world United States Myasthenia Gravis Population: A Claims Data Analysis
abstracts.authors: Lal, Lincy; Miller-Wilson, Lesley-Ann; Princic, Nicole; Lew, Carolyn; Streicher, Nicholas; Edwards, Yuriy
abstracts.affiliations: Immunovant, Inc., New York, NY; Merative, Ann Arbor, MI; Medstar Georgetown University Hospital, Washington, DC
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To describe treatment patterns of biologic therapies among newly treated patients with myasthenia gravis (MG). Background: Newer biologic therapies for MG (neonatal fragment crystallizable receptor blockers, C5 complement inhibitors, anti-CD20 therapies) aim to address unmet clinical needs; however, real-world evidence describing treatment patterns of these drugs is limited. Design/Methods: Data were drawn from the Merative™ MarketScan® databases from July 1, 2016–September 30, 2024. Continuous enrollment for ≥6 months before and ≥12 months after the earliest date of any MG treatment was required. Treatment patterns were examined among patients who received biologics. Results: Of 2,943 treated patients with MG, 219 had ≥1 claim for a biologic therapy (mean [SD] age, 57.5 [15.1] years; 53.4% male). The mean (SD) time from MG diagnosis to first use of a biologic (biologic index date) was 24.3 (20.9) months. Most patients (98.1%) initiated a biologic as a third- or later-line therapy. The mean (SD) biologic treatment duration was 5.4 (6.9) months, and 65.3% of patients used a biologic in combination with other treatment classes (acetylcholinesterase inhibitors, immunosuppressants, oral glucocorticoids [OG], intravenous immunoglobulin). More patients used OG in the 6 months prior to biologic index date (n=161; 73.5%) than during biologic treatment (n=90; 41.1%). Among patients using biologic therapy with OG, 78.9% (n=71) started on a medium/high OG dose (>5 mg/day prednisone equivalence) at initiation of the biologic, and of those, 38.0% (n=27) moved to low/maintenance dosing (≤5 mg/day prednisone equivalence) during biologic treatment. MG exacerbations and crises were observed in 35.6% and 1.4% of patients during biologic treatment, respectively. Conclusions: Biologic therapies were largely initiated as third- or later-line treatment, with a mean treatment duration of <6 months. Patients continued to experience exacerbations/crises and use OG during biologic treatment. These findings highlight the need for effective biologic therapies earlier in the disease course to improve clinical outcomes.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：描述新治疗的重症肌无力（MG）患者中生物制剂的治疗模式。背景：MG的新型生物制剂（新生儿Fc受体阻滞剂、C5补体抑制剂、抗CD20疗法）旨在解决未满足的临床需求；然而，描述这些药物治疗模式的真实世界证据有限。设计/方法：数据来自2016年7月1日至2024年9月30日的Merative™ MarketScan®数据库。要求在任何MG治疗的最早日期前连续入组≥6个月，之后连续入组≥12个月。对接受生物制剂的患者检查了治疗模式。结果：在2,943名接受治疗的MG患者中，219人至少有1次生物制剂治疗索赔（平均[SD]年龄，57.5[15.1]岁；53.4%为男性）。从MG诊断到首次使用生物制剂（生物制剂索引日期）的平均（SD）时间为24.3（20.9）个月。大多数患者（98.1%）将生物制剂作为三线或更后线治疗启动。平均（SD）生物制剂治疗持续时间为5.4（6.9）个月，65.3%的患者将生物制剂与其他治疗类别（乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂、免疫抑制剂、口服糖皮质激素[OG]、静脉注射免疫球蛋白）联合使用。在生物制剂索引日期前6个月内使用OG的患者（n=161；73.5%）多于生物制剂治疗期间（n=90；41.1%）。在使用生物制剂联合OG的患者中，78.9%（n=71）在启动生物制剂时从中/高剂量OG（>5 mg/天泼尼松等效剂量）开始，其中38.0%（n=27）在生物制剂治疗期间转为低/维持剂量（≤5 mg/天泼尼松等效剂量）。在生物制剂治疗期间，分别有35.6%和1.4%的患者观察到MG加重和危象。结论：生物制剂主要作为三线或更后线治疗启动，平均治疗持续时间<6个月。患者在生物制剂治疗期间继续经历加重/危象并使用OG。这些发现强调了在疾病早期使用有效生物制剂以改善临床结局的必要性。

abstracts.title: Unmet Needs Amongst Patients With Generalized Myasthenia Gravis in the U.S.: A Descriptive Comparison Across Two Time Periods Using the MGFA Global MG Patient Registry
abstracts.authors: Park, Jenny; Nowak, Richard; Meyers, Andrea; Canales, Blanca; Anderson, Seth; Park, Minjee; Zurinaga, Amaia; Patterson, Kristina; Bhambri, Ankur; Habib, Ali
abstracts.affiliations: Amgen Inc., Thousand Oaks, CA; Yale University School of Medicine, New Haven, CT; Amgen Inc., Humble, TX; Alira Health, Basel, Switzerland; Alira Health, Barcelona, Spain; Amgen Inc., Deerfield, IL; University of California, Irvine, Orange, CA
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To descriptively compare clinical burden, quality of life, comorbidities, and healthcare resource utilization (HRU) among U.S. myasthenia gravis (MG) patients enrolled in the MGFA Global MG Patient Registry (MGFAPR) across two time periods: before and after biologic availability. Background:. Design/Methods: This retrospective, cross-sectional study analyzed enrollment surveys from adults with MG in the MGFAPR. Cohort A comprised patients enrolled in 2013–2017 and Cohort B in 2020–2024. Between-cohort comparisons used descriptive statistics with two-sided tests at α=0.05; an exploratory matched analysis, based on age, gender, and disease duration, was also conducted. Results: The analysis included 2,926 adults from MGFAPR, comprising 2,203 in Cohort A and 723 in Cohort B. Mean age at enrollment was 58.0 (SD 15.2) in Cohort A and 59.3 (SD 15.3) in Cohort B, and women comprised 62% and 63% of each cohort, respectively. Biologic use remained modest (Cohort A: 1.6%, Cohort B: 11.0%) and steroid use remained high around 40% in both cohorts; intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIg) (Cohort A: 17%, Cohort B: 27%) and plasma exchange (PLEX) (Cohort A: 5%, Cohort B: 9%) significantly increased. Clinical burden remained elevated as measured by significantly higher MG-ADL scores (Cohort A: 5.45, Cohort B: 6.12). Quality of life as measured by MG-QoL15r showed no statistical difference. Psychosocial, autoimmune, and cardiovascular comorbid burden significantly increased. HRU was significantly higher in Cohort B (p<0.001) as observed by ER visits (Cohort A: 12%, Cohort B: 19%) and hospitalizations (Cohort A: 8%, Cohort B: 14%). Differences across cohorts persisted, even after matched analyses. Conclusions: In this large U.S. registry, patient-reported burden remained substantial in 2020–2024, despite the availability of new targeted therapies, as compared to 2013–2017. While the uptake of new therapies was limited, these findings highlight growing unmet needs and opportunities to further optimize and improve disease management.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：描述性比较在两个时间段（生物制剂可用之前和之后）入组MGFA全球MG患者登记处（MGFAPR）的美国重症肌无力（MG）患者的临床负担、生活质量、合并症和医疗资源利用（HRU）。背景：。设计/方法：这项回顾性、横断面研究分析了MGFAPR中成年MG患者的入组调查问卷。队列A包括2013-2017年入组的患者，队列B包括2020-2024年入组的患者。队列间比较使用描述性统计和α=0.05的双侧检验；还进行了一项基于年龄、性别和病程的探索性匹配分析。结果：分析包括来自MGFAPR的2,926名成年人，其中队列A有2,203人，队列B有723人。入组时平均年龄在队列A为58.0岁（SD 15.2），队列B为59.3岁（SD 15.3），女性分别占每个队列的62%和63%。生物制剂使用率仍然不高（队列A：1.6%，队列B：11.0%），两个队列的类固醇使用率仍保持在40%左右；静脉注射免疫球蛋白（IVIg）（队列A：17%，队列B：27%）和血浆置换（PLEX）（队列A：5%，队列B：9%）显著增加。通过显著更高的MG-ADL评分（队列A：5.45，队列B：6.12）衡量，临床负担仍然很高。通过MG-QoL15r测量的生活质量显示无统计学差异。心理社会、自身免疫和心血管合并症负担显著增加。队列B的HRU显著更高（p<0.001），表现为急诊就诊（队列A：12%，队列B：19%）和住院（队列A：8%，队列B：14%）。即使在匹配分析后，队列间的差异仍然存在。结论：在这个大型美国登记处中，与2013-2017年相比，尽管有新的靶向疗法可用，2020-2024年患者报告的负担仍然很大。虽然新疗法的采用有限，但这些发现强调了日益增长的未满足需求以及进一步优化和改善疾病管理的机会。

abstracts.title: Updated Characterization of Clinical and Immunological Endotypes in Acetylcholine Receptor–Positive Myasthenia Gravis: Expanded Analysis of 601 Patients
abstracts.authors: Oved, Kfir; Denkberg, Galit; Pinzur, Lena; Arman, Inbar; Mazor, Roei D.; Reef, Sharon; Harel, Ofer; Erez, Shir; Atiya, Yael; Dowery, Reem; Lazaridis, Konstantinos; Wilf-Yarkoni, Adi
abstracts.affiliations: Canopy Immuno-Therapeutics, Haifa, Israel, Megadim, Israel; Canopy Immuno-Therapeutics, Haifa, Israel, Nofit, Israel; Canopy Immuno-Therapeutics, Haifa, Israel, Tzukei Yam, Israel; Canopy Immuno-Therapeutics, Haifa, Israel, Haifa, Israel; Canopy Immuno-Therapeutics, Haifa, Israel, Yokneam, Israel; Dept. of Immunology, Hellenic Pasteur Institute, Athens, Greece, Athens, Greece; Rabin Medical Center, Petach Tikva, Israel and Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Petach Tikva, Israel
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To expand the clinical-immunological characterization of acetylcholine receptor–positive Myasthenia Gravis (AChR⁺ MG) using an enlarged multicenter cohort of 601 patients. Background: AChR⁺ MG is a chronic antibody-mediated autoimmune disorder causing fluctuating muscle weakness due to AChR-targeting autoantibodies in the neuromuscular junction. Our previous study of 513 AChR⁺ MG patients identified two major endotypes distinguished by sex, age of onset, titer, thymic involvement and AChR subunit immunodominance. Here we present updated analyses incorporating additional patients and extended clinical data to strengthen these findings. Design/Methods: This ongoing large-scale, multicenter, cross-sectional study includes prospectively recruited AChR⁺ MG patients and biobank-derived serum samples meeting diagnostic criteria of clinical MG and anti-AChR IgG ≥0.5nM. Clinical data were correlated with total and subunit-specific anti-AChR titers, thymic histology, age, sex, and MGFA disease severity. Statistical correlations and unsupervised principal component analyses were used to define clinical–immunological associations and data clustering patterns. Results: The updated dataset includes 601 AChR⁺ MG patients (49% female; median age: 65.9 years). Anti-AChR titers correlated positively with disease severity and were significantly higher in female versus male patients (median 12.7nM vs. 7.8nM, p=0.0001). Alpha and gamma subunit immunodominance maintained their sex-related patterns, with males showing greater alpha immunodominance (median α%: 23% vs. 15.3%, p=0.0209) and females showing greater gamma immunodominance (median γ%: 29% vs. 23%, p=0.0029). Gamma immunodominance was also associated with higher titers and early-onset disease. Principal component analysis confirmed the previously reported two endotypes corresponding to early-onset, gamma-immunodominant, thymic-hyperplastic disease in females (Endotype A) and predominantly late-onset, alpha-immunodominant, lower-titer disease (Endotype B). Conclusions: Expanded analysis of 601 AChR⁺ MG patients further substantiates the existence of two MG endotypes with unique clinical and immunological profiles. These findings suggest distinct underlying etiologies with potential implications for sex-dependent precision medicine, women’s health, and the development of novel therapeutic approaches for MG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：使用扩大的601名患者的多中心队列，扩展对乙酰胆碱受体阳性重症肌无力（AChR⁺ MG）的临床-免疫学特征描述。背景：AChR⁺ MG是一种慢性抗体介导的自身免疫性疾病，由于神经肌肉接头处靶向AChR的自身抗体导致波动性肌肉无力。我们之前对513名AChR⁺ MG患者的研究确定了两种主要的内型，其区别在于性别、发病年龄、滴度、胸腺受累和AChR亚基免疫优势。在此，我们展示了纳入更多患者和扩展临床数据以加强这些发现的更新分析。设计/方法：这项正在进行的大型、多中心、横断面研究包括前瞻性招募的AChR⁺ MG患者和生物库来源的血清样本，这些样本符合临床MG和抗AChR IgG≥0.5nM的诊断标准。临床数据与总抗AChR滴度和亚基特异性抗AChR滴度、胸腺组织学、年龄、性别和MGFA疾病严重程度相关。使用统计相关性和无监督主成分分析来定义临床-免疫学关联和数据聚类模式。结果：更新后的数据集包括601名AChR⁺ MG患者（49%为女性；中位年龄：65.9岁）。抗AChR滴度与疾病严重程度呈正相关，并且女性患者显著高于男性患者（中位数12.7nM vs. 7.8nM，p=0.0001）。Alpha和gamma亚基免疫优势保持了其性别相关模式，男性表现出更大的alpha免疫优势（中位数α%：23% vs. 15.3%，p=0.0209），女性表现出更大的gamma免疫优势（中位数γ%：29% vs. 23%，p=0.0029）。Gamma免疫优势还与更高的滴度和早发性疾病相关。主成分分析证实了先前报道的两种内型，对应于女性中早发性、gamma免疫优势、胸腺增生性疾病（内型A）和主要为晚发性、alpha免疫优势、低滴度疾病（内型B）。结论：对601名AChR⁺ MG患者的扩展分析进一步证实了存在两种具有独特临床和免疫学特征的MG内型。这些发现提示了不同的潜在病因，对性别依赖性精准医学、女性健康以及开发MG新型治疗方法具有潜在意义。

abstracts.title: Urinary Dysfunction in Myasthenia Gravis: Clinical Burden and Association with MG-ADL
abstracts.authors: Shihada, Kamel; Gorenshtein, Alon; Wolfe, Gil; Shelly, Shahar
abstracts.affiliations: Bar-Ilan University, Nof Hgalil, Israel; Rambam Medical Center, Haifa, Israel; Univ. At Buffalo, SUNY, Buffalo, NY
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To assess the prevalence, predictors, and clinical significance of urinary dysfunction in myasthenia gravis (MG) patients compared with matched controls. Background: Myasthenia gravis primarily affects skeletal muscles, yet non-motor manifestations, particularly urinary incontinence (UI) and overactive bladder (OAB) symptoms, remain underexplored in MG. Given the impact of UI on quality of life, systematic investigation in MG is clinically important. Design/Methods: Eighty-six MG patients and 90 age- and sex-matched inpatient controls were evaluated in a cross-sectional, case-control study. All participants completed the International Consultation on Incontinence Questionnaire-Short Form (ICIQ-UI SF) and the Overactive Bladder Symptom Score (OABSS). MG severity was assessed using the Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) scale. MG patients were further categorized into early-onset (EOMG), late-onset (LOMG), and very late-onset (VLOMG) subgroups. Logistic regression identified predictors of UI, and Kaplan-Meier analysis was used to evaluate time to first recalled UI symptoms. Results: MG patients had over four times higher prevalence of UI symptoms (ICIQ-UI SF ≥6 in 52.3% vs. 12.2% in controls; p<0.001). LOMG patients exhibited the highest UI prevalence (63.2%) and progressed most rapidly to UI, while EOMG patients had the latest onset. OAB symptoms were also more prominent in MG, marked by higher OABSS (p<0.001), increased nocturia (≥3/night: 27.9% vs 11.1%; p=0.004), and greater urgency episodes (≥2/day: 38.4% vs 2.2%; p<0.001). MG-ADL score independently predicted UI (OR 2.38; 95% CI 1.04–5.46; p=0.041). Conclusions: UI and OAB symptoms are more common in MG patients than in controls. Disease severity, as assessed by MG-ADL, is an independent predictor of UI, and age at disease onset may influence the timing of UI development. Routine screening and proactive management of UI in MG are warranted to improve patient quality of life and functional outcomes.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：评估重症肌无力（MG）患者与匹配对照组相比，泌尿功能障碍的患病率、预测因素和临床意义。背景：重症肌无力主要影响骨骼肌，但非运动表现，特别是尿失禁（UI）和膀胱过度活动症（OAB）症状，在MG中仍未得到充分探索。鉴于UI对生活质量的影响，在MG中进行系统性研究具有临床重要性。设计/方法：在一项横断面病例对照研究中，评估了86名MG患者和90名年龄和性别匹配的住院对照。所有参与者均完成了国际尿失禁咨询问卷简表（ICIQ-UI SF）和膀胱过度活动症症状评分（OABSS）。使用重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）评估MG严重程度。MG患者进一步分为早发型（EOMG）、晚发型（LOMG）和极晚发型（VLOMG）亚组。逻辑回归确定了UI的预测因素，并使用Kaplan-Meier分析评估首次回忆UI症状的时间。结果：MG患者的UI症状患病率是对照组的四倍以上（ICIQ-UI SF ≥6：52.3% vs. 12.2%；p<0.001）。LOMG患者的UI患病率最高（63.2%），且进展至UI最快，而EOMG患者发病最晚。OAB症状在MG中也更为突出，表现为更高的OABSS（p<0.001）、夜尿增多（≥3次/晚：27.9% vs 11.1%；p=0.004）和更频繁的尿急发作（≥2次/天：38.4% vs 2.2%；p<0.001）。MG-ADL评分独立预测UI（OR 2.38；95% CI 1.04–5.46；p=0.041）。结论：MG患者的UI和OAB症状比对照组更常见。通过MG-ADL评估的疾病严重程度是UI的独立预测因素，发病年龄可能影响UI发生的时间。建议对MG患者进行常规筛查和主动管理UI，以改善患者的生活质量和功能结局。

abstracts.abstract: Objective: The ongoing DOMYA (NCT05564936) study’s objective is to validate ME&MG™ clinical performance by comparing individual’s Quantitative MG (QMG) scores to home-measured digital biomarkers’ scores in people with gMG and healthy controls (HCs). Background: Generalized Myasthenia Gravis (gMG) is a rare autoimmune disease characterized by fluctuating muscle weakness, making it essential to monitor symptoms between infrequent clinical visits. ME&MGTM is a software as medical device (SaMD) allowing remote self-assessment of gMG symptoms using five digital biomarkers (dBMKs) measuring ptosis, dysarthria, respiratory function, upper and lower limb muscle weakness. In the ME&MGopen decentralized study, proof-of-concept was established with dBMKs’ scores correlating with MG-ADL (daily activities) and MG-QoL-15r (quality of life) sub-scores. Design/Methods: DOMYA aims to recruit 94 adult patients with anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive gMG and 50 HCs in France and the USA. Patients are monitored for one year with in-clinic visits at days 0, 90 and 365, along with monthly home-performed ME&MGTM active tests in the mornings and evenings. HCs will perform active tests in-clinic on day 0 and at home on day 1. Correlation coefficients between dBMKs and ptosis, speech, lung function, limb stretch sub-items of QMG, will be calculated to determine the clinical significance of dBMKs and, safety related to the SaMD will be reported. Results: As of October 2025, a total of 93 out of 94 gMG patients (France: 46; USA: 47) and 47 out of 50 HCs (France: 20; USA: 27) have been recruited; with 16 patients having already completed the study. Study completion is anticipated by November 2026. Conclusions: ME&MGTM dBMKs reliability and quality have been established in the ME&MGopen study. Validation of their clinical performance and safety in DOMYA will further support dBMKs’ adoption for objective tracking of gMG symptoms in routine practice to support HCPs in their decision-making processes.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：正在进行的DOMYA（NCT05564936）研究旨在通过比较全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者和健康对照（HC）的定量MG（QMG）评分与居家测量的数字生物标志物评分，来验证ME&MG™的临床性能。背景：全身型重症肌无力是一种罕见的自身免疫性疾病，其特征是波动性肌无力，因此在不频繁的临床访视之间监测症状至关重要。ME&MG™是一种作为医疗器械的软件（SaMD），允许使用五种数字生物标志物（dBMKs）远程自我评估gMG症状，这些标志物可测量上睑下垂、构音障碍、呼吸功能、上肢和下肢肌无力。在ME&MGopen分散式研究中，已建立了概念验证，显示dBMK评分与MG-ADL（日常生活活动）和MG-QoL-15r（生活质量）子评分相关。设计/方法：DOMYA旨在招募法国和美国的94名抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性的成年gMG患者和50名HC。患者将接受为期一年的监测，在第0、90和365天进行临床访视，并在早晚进行每月一次的居家ME&MG™主动测试。HC将在第0天在临床进行主动测试，并在第1天在家中进行。将计算dBMK与QMG的上睑下垂、言语、肺功能、肢体伸展子项目之间的相关系数，以确定dBMK的临床意义，并将报告与SaMD相关的安全性。结果：截至2025年10月，已招募94名gMG患者中的93名（法国：46名；美国：47名）和50名HC中的47名（法国：20名；美国：27名）；其中16名患者已完成研究。研究预计于2026年11月完成。结论：ME&MG™ dBMK的可靠性和质量已在ME&MGopen研究中得到证实。在DOMYA中验证其临床性能和安全性将进一步支持dBMK在常规实践中用于客观追踪gMG症状，以支持医疗保健专业人员的决策过程。

abstracts.title: West Nile Virus Meningoencephalitis Exacerbating Ocular Myasthenia Gravis and Facial Nerve Palsy
abstracts.authors: Barakat, Ayla; Marsia, Shayan; Barakat, Farah; Cencer, Samantha
abstracts.affiliations: Corewell Health, Grand Rapids, MI; Alfaisal University, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia; Corewell Health, Grand Rapids, MI
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To describe a rare case of West Nile virus (WNV) meningoencephalitis unmasking latent ocular Myasthenia Gravis (MG) and causing sequential contralateral facial nerve palsy. Background: A 49-year-old man with a history of hyperlipidemia, diabetes, obesity, and prior left-sided Bell’s palsy presented with fever, neck pain, headache, diarrhea, and confusion. CSF studies showed elevated protein (76 mg/dL) and normal glucose (59 mg/dL). MRI brain revealed ventriculitis of the left occipital horn. CSF and serum were positive for WNV IgM/IgG, consistent with WNV meningoencephalitis. EEG showed no seizures. During hospitalization, he developed left eye ptosis, diplopia, and saccadic eye movements concerning for ocular MG. Acetylcholine receptor antibody returned positive, and symptoms improved on pyridostigmine. While recovering in inpatient rehabilitation, he developed acute right facial droop. Stroke workup including CT/CTA/CTP and MRI was negative. Examination confirmed right lower motor neuron facial weakness with intact limb and bulbar strength, consistent with new contralateral facial nerve palsy. Design/Methods: NA Results: This case illustrates a rare overlap between viral neuroinvasive disease and autoimmune neuromuscular pathology. Prior reports have shown delayed MG onset after WNV infection, suggesting a postinfectious immune mechanism. In this case, ocular MG became clinically apparent during active infection, implying direct immune activation and loss of tolerance triggered by WNV. The subsequent contralateral Bell’s palsy likely represents an immune-mediated cranial neuropathy within the same inflammatory spectrum. The clinical course underscores the potential for viral infections to unmask latent autoimmune processes and to affect multiple cranial nerves through parainfectious mechanisms. Conclusions: WNV meningoencephalitis can trigger or worsen autoimmune disorders such as ocular MG and produce multifocal cranial neuropathies. Awareness of this interaction is crucial, as treatment choices like corticosteroids may carry dual risks in the setting of active infection and MG. Recognizing atypical or sequential cranial neuropathies in viral encephalitis should prompt evaluation for overlapping autoimmune etiologies.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：通过记录药物管理服务（MMS：药物治疗管理[MTM]或评估与管理[E/M]接触）和处方配药作为代理指标，描述重症肌无力（MG）的Medicare按服务收费（FFS）受益人中药剂师互动情况。背景：药剂师在慢性病管理中的应用不足。他们受过高度培训，具有独特优势，能够优化药物使用、改善治疗结果并减少复杂治疗方案（如重症肌无力[MG]）患者的不良事件。设计/方法：使用2018年1月1日至2021年12月31日期间100%的Medicare FFS A、B和D部分索赔数据进行回顾性观察队列研究。纳入标准为：有≥1次住院或≥2次门诊MG索赔（ICD-10-CM G70.xx）、年龄≥18岁、在12个月基线期内连续参保且无临床试验参与证据。药剂师互动通过Medicare D部分配药事件和药房接种的疫苗进行估算。描述性统计总结了人口统计学、临床特征、服务使用和参与情况。多变量零膨胀负二项模型分析了与药剂师互动相关的因素。结果：在32,200名符合条件的受益人（平均年龄：74.9岁；48.1%为女性）中，基线12个月期间，每位患者每年（PPPY）平均配药53.1次（标准差：32.5）。使用代理定义，99.3%的受益人有资格接受MTM，但仅有60名独特的MMS接受者。在索引后24个月，受益人累计平均配药198.7次（任何药物）和70.4次（MG相关药物）。此外，73.9%的受益人在药房接种了流感或COVID-19疫苗。在调整模型中，18–29岁年龄组的MG特异性配药率高出7.3倍（95% CI：5.9–8.9；p < 0.0001），而男性的MG特异性配药率比女性高4.1%（95% CI：1.02–1.06；p < 0.0001）。结论：与处方配药和药房接种疫苗相关的高频率药房互动，凸显了药剂师参与以改善药物优化的错失机会。

abstracts.title: A Case Report of Nivolumab-induced Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Simran Qureshi; Nishant Kumar; Nagaratna Sarvadevabatla
abstracts.affiliations: Detroit, MI
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION/BACKGROUND: Nivolumab is a monoclonal antibody immune checkpoint inhibitor used to treat recurrent or metastatic malignancies, including non- small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), melanoma, renal cell carcinoma, and advanced esophageal carcinoma. By targeting programmed cell death protein-1 (PD-1), it enhances T-cell–mediated immune responses. Despite its efficacy, it can cause immune-related adverse events affecting multiple organ systems. Neuromuscular (NM) complications such as myasthenia gravis (MG) are rare but potentially life-threatening. CASE REPORT: This case report describes nivolumab- induced MG in a patient with NSCLC and highlights diagnostic and management challenges associated with immune-related neuromuscular toxicity. It is based on a retrospective review of a patient’s clinical presentation, diagnostic evaluation, treatment, and outcomes following nivolumab therapy, supplemented by a focused literature review of immune-related adverse events associated with PD-1 inhibitors. Evaluation revealed bulbar-predominant neuromuscular weakness. Acetylcholine receptor antibodies were positive, with negative muscle-specific kinase antibodies, confirming MG. Respiratory parameters remained stable without evidence of acute respiratory compromise. A patient with left lower lobe lung adenocarcinoma and hilar adenopathy presented with progressive fatigue, dysphagia to solids, blurred vision, and exertional dyspnea after prior nivolumab exposure. The patient had a history of nivolumab-induced MG and autoimmune myocarditis requiring immunosuppression, plasmapheresis, and prolonged ventilatory support. Current findings were consistent with a mild MG exacerbation. Symptoms improved following escalation of pyridostigmine and close respiratory monitoring. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Nivolumab-associated MG is a serious complication. Early recognition of bulbar symptoms and respiratory monitoring are essential. Careful risk–benefit assessment of continued immunotherapy is critical, underscoring the need for greater clinical awareness and further research. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.authors: Devika Puri; Ya-Hsun Lee; Rami Hawila; Le Kang; Kelly G. Gwathmey
abstracts.affiliations: Richmond, VA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an autoimmune neuromuscular disorder that imposes significant physical and psychosocial burden on patients. While newer targeted therapies (e.g. C5 inhibitors and neonatal Fc receptor antagonists) have broadened the therapeutic landscape, patient perspectives on symptom improvement and treatment burden remain unknown. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the patient-perceived benefits and burdens of MG therapies, and their treatment preferences. METHODS: A 20-item treatment survey was administered to adult, generalized MG patients during this cross- sectional study. The survey assessed treatment satisfaction, treatment priorities, and burden of treatment utilizing Likert-scale responses. Patients were classified as treated with traditional therapies (TT) only (e.g., corticosteroids, non-steroidal immunosuppressants) or novel therapies (NT). Descriptive statistics were performed for each questionnaire item and response distributions were compared using chi-square tests. Fisher’s exact test determined the difference in side effect burden. RESULTS: A total of 49 patients provided evaluable responses (TT, n=20; NT, n=29). There was no statistically significant difference in mean scores across domains including symptom relief, fatigue improvement, mental health effects, convenience, and overall satisfaction scores between groups (p >0.05). The NT group demonstrated higher scores in several domains, including certainty that treatment would prevent MG crisis/exacerbation (p = 0.18) and confidence that positive attributes of the therapeutic outweigh negative attributes (p = 0.18). Reported side effects were not significantly different between groups (p =0.15). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Patient-reported experiences were similar between patients treated with traditional and novel therapies, although novel therapies demonstrated slightly higher satisfaction across several domains. Larger studies are needed to better understand treatment preferences and priorities. Devika Puri, BS Medical Student Research Award Recipient Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）是一种自身免疫性神经肌肉疾病，给患者带来显著的身体和心理社会负担。尽管新型靶向治疗（如C5抑制剂和新生儿Fc受体拮抗剂）拓宽了治疗格局，但患者对症状改善和治疗负担的看法仍不清楚。目的：评估患者感知的MG治疗获益和负担及其治疗偏好。方法：本横断面研究对成年全身型MG患者进行了一项20项治疗调查。调查使用Likert量表评估治疗满意度、治疗优先事项和治疗负担。患者被分类为仅接受传统治疗（TT）（如皮质类固醇、非甾体免疫抑制剂）或新型治疗（NT）。对每个问卷项目进行描述性统计，并使用卡方检验比较应答分布。Fisher精确检验确定副作用负担的差异。结果：共49例患者提供可评估应答（TT，n=20；NT，n=29）。两组在症状缓解、疲劳改善、心理健康影响、便利性和总体满意度评分等领域的平均评分无统计学显著差异（p >0.05）。NT组在多个领域得分更高，包括对治疗可预防MG危象/加重的确定性（p = 0.18）和对治疗正面属性超过负面属性的信心（p = 0.18）。两组报告的副作用无显著差异（p =0.15）。总结/结论：接受传统治疗和新型治疗的患者报告的经历相似，尽管新型治疗在多个领域的满意度略高。需要更大规模的研究以更好地理解治疗偏好和优先事项。Devika Puri，BS医学生研究奖获得者 海报会议I和II

abstracts.title: Beyond Income, Education, and Insurance Coverage: The Utility of Core-5 Social Risk Screening in Neuromuscular Practice for Black Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Judith Thompson; Gina Banks; Melissa Blunck; Krishleen Kohli; Kristie Holt; Brittany Gant; Dawn Warner; Lisa Robbins; Sondra Rothwell; James A. Washington; III
abstracts.affiliations: Smyrna, GA; Florissant, MO; Summit, NJ; Summit , NJ; Stone Mountain, GA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Traditional socioeconomic status (SES) indicators, such as education, income, and insurance coverage are frequently used to measure overall social determinants of health (SDOH). However, among Black patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), these indicators may fall short in helping clinicians identify the presence of deleterious social risks relevant to neuromuscular (NM) health outcomes. OBJECTIVE: To examine whether the CORE-5, a 5-item social risk screening tool (housing, food security, transportation, utilities, and safety), may identify clinically relevant patient needs not captured by traditional SES indicators. METHODS: Eligible participants completed a 70-item survey (N=207). A subsample of survey participants (n=16) was selected for 1:1 semistructured interviews. Descriptive statistics were used to summarize traditional SES indicators and CORE-5 total and item-level social risk scores. Qualitative interview data were thematically analyzed. RESULTS: The study sample exceeded national averages relative to educational attainment, income, and health insurance for Black adults residing in the United States (61% held a bachelor’s degree or higher; 78% reported an annual household income of ≥$50,000; and 97% reported having health insurance, with only 12.6% covered by Medicaid). Despite being highly resourced across traditional domains used to measure SDOH, mean CORE-5 scores (12.5; range 5-25) indicated unmet social risks, with safety concerns emerging as the most prominent domain. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Relevant social risks persisted among the study sample, despite high socioeconomic resources. CORE-5 screening identified clinically meaningful risks not captured by traditional SES indicators. Incorporation of CORE-5 screening during NM evaluation and management visits may support more inclusive, patient-centered care and justify higher-level billing codes. Funding: UCB Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：传统社会经济地位（SES）指标，如教育、收入和保险覆盖，常被用于衡量整体健康社会决定因素（SDOH）。然而，在黑人全身型肌无力（gMG）患者中，这些指标可能不足以帮助临床医生识别与神经肌肉（NM）健康结局相关的有害社会风险的存在。目的：探讨CORE-5这一包含5个条目（住房、食品安全、交通、公用事业和安全）的社会风险筛查工具，是否能识别传统SES指标未捕捉到的临床相关患者需求。方法：符合条件的参与者完成了一项70条目调查（N=207）。从调查参与者中选取一个子样本（n=16）进行1:1半结构化访谈。采用描述性统计总结传统SES指标及CORE-5总分和条目水平社会风险评分。对定性访谈数据进行主题分析。结果：研究样本在教育程度、收入和医疗保险方面超过美国黑人成年人的全国平均水平（61%拥有学士学位或更高学历；78%报告家庭年收入≥50,000美元；97%报告拥有医疗保险，仅12.6%由Medicaid覆盖）。尽管在用于衡量SDOH的传统领域资源充足，CORE-5平均评分（12.5；范围5-25）提示存在未满足的社会风险，其中安全担忧成为最突出的领域。总结/结论：尽管社会经济资源较高，研究样本中仍存在相关社会风险。CORE-5筛查识别出传统SES指标未捕捉到的具有临床意义的风险。在NM评估和管理访视中纳入CORE-5筛查可能支持更具包容性、以患者为中心的照护，并为更高水平的计费代码提供依据。资助：UCB Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.title: Biologic Therapies versus Conventional Immunotherapy for High-acuity Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Fady Tawfik; Marshall Mendoza; Eric Yalley; Ronak Bhatia; Michael Boulis; Justyna Sienkaniec; Jesse Manyard; Miriam Michael
abstracts.affiliations: Washington, DC; Bryan, TX
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an autoimmune neuromuscular disorder characterized by fluctuating weakness and fatigability. Although biologic therapies targeting complement, neonatal Fc receptor, and B cells have emerged for refractory disease, comparative effectiveness data versus conventional immunotherapy in high-acuity MG remain sparse. OBJECTIVE: To compare clinical outcomes in high-acuity MG patients treated with biologic therapies versus conventional immunotherapy. METHODS: Using the TriNetX US Collaborative Network, we identified 874 patients receiving biologics (complement inhibitors, FcRn antagonists, and B-cell depleting agents) and 4,821 receiving conventional immunotherapy within six months of high-acuity disease markers. After exclusions, 1:1 propensity score matching balanced 628 patients per cohort for demographics, comorbidities, and MG severity. Outcomes were assessed from Day 1 through Day 365 after treatment initiation. RESULTS: Following matching, biologic therapy was associated with lower risks of hospitalization (HR 0.626, 95% CI 0.514-0.761), mechanical ventilation (HR 0.566, 95% CI 0.322-0.996), noninvasive ventilation (HR 0.349, 95% CI 0.200-0.608), rescue IVIG (HR 0.486, 95% CI 0.386-0.611), critical care utilization (HR 0.515, 95% CI 0.363-0.732), rescue plasmapheresis (HR 0.553, 95% CI 0.402-0.761), emergency department visits (HR 0.751, 95% CI 0.581-0.970), and infections (HR 0.704, 95% CI 0.547-0.908). Myasthenic crisis was similar (HR 0.916, 95% CI 0.776-1.083). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In high-acuity MG, biologic therapies were associated with lower healthcare utilization and fewer infectious complications than conventional immunotherapy, while myasthenic crisis rates were similar. These findings support prospective evaluation of biologics in high-acuity MG. Fady Tawfik, BS President's Research Initiative Award Recipient Medical Student Research Award Recipient Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：肌无力（MG）是一种以波动性无力和易疲劳为特征的自身免疫性神经肌肉疾病。尽管针对补体、新生儿Fc受体和B细胞的生物制剂已用于难治性疾病，但与常规免疫治疗相比，其在高危MG中的比较有效性数据仍然稀少。目的：比较接受生物制剂与常规免疫治疗的高危MG患者的临床结局。方法：使用TriNetX美国协作网络，我们识别了874例在高危疾病标志物六个月内接受生物制剂（补体抑制剂、FcRn拮抗剂和B细胞清除剂）的患者和4,821例接受常规免疫治疗的患者。排除后，1:1倾向评分匹配使每队列628例患者在人口学、合并症和MG严重程度方面达到平衡。结局从治疗开始第1天评估至第365天。结果：匹配后，生物制剂治疗与较低的住院风险（HR 0.626，95% CI 0.514-0.761）、机械通气（HR 0.566，95% CI 0.322-0.996）、无创通气（HR 0.349，95% CI 0.200-0.608）、挽救性IVIG（HR 0.486，95% CI 0.386-0.611）、重症监护使用（HR 0.515，95% CI 0.363-0.732）、挽救性血浆置换（HR 0.553，95% CI 0.402-0.761）、急诊就诊（HR 0.751，95% CI 0.581-0.970）和感染（HR 0.704，95% CI 0.547-0.908）相关。肌无力危象相似（HR 0.916，95% CI 0.776-1.083）。总结/结论：在高危MG中，与常规免疫治疗相比，生物制剂治疗与较低的医疗资源利用和较少的感染并发症相关，而肌无力危象发生率相似。这些发现支持在高危MG中对生物制剂进行前瞻性评估。Fady Tawfik, BS President's Research Initiative Award Recipient Medical Student Research Award Recipient Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.authors: Albert Cook
abstracts.affiliations: Johns Creek, GA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Efgartigimod alfa is a neonatal Fc receptor antagonist proven useful in the treatment of patients with anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibody positive, generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). The ADAPT trial demonstrated improvement in Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL), Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG), and Myasthenia Gravis–Specific Activities of Daily Living (MSE) scores in Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America (MGFA) Class 2, 3, and 4 patients treated with efgartigimod. Reduction of circulating AChR antibodies has also been observed. A variety of other metrics have also been used to evaluate motor performance in gMG patients. Among these are various electrophysiologic procedures, including repetitive nerve stimulation (RNS). OBJECTIVE: To determine changes in RNS decrement in gMG patients studied both before and after administration of efgartigimod. METHODS: Five patients with symptomatic gMG were identified as suitable candidates for treatment with efgartigimod. RNS was performed shortly before initiation, and repeated shortly after completion of the first 4-week round of efgartigimod administration. One patient underwent RNS on 2 subsequent occasions. Correlation with patients' clinical progression was also noted. RESULTS: RNS decrement improved in all five patients evaluated before and after administration of efgartigimod. The rate of RNS improvement mirrored improvement in clinical metrics, with some variability in rates of improvement. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: RNS is an accessible procedure that may prove useful in gMG patients that do not respond quickly to treatment with efgartigimod. Patients that respond more slowly to treatment may display more limited improvement in RNS decrement. Patients that do not respond to treatment, but show pronounced improvement in RNS decrement, may require evaluation for alternative explanations for persistent weakness. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：艾加莫德α是一种新生儿Fc受体拮抗剂，已被证明对治疗抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体阳性的全身型肌无力（gMG）患者有用。ADAPT试验显示，接受艾加莫德治疗的美国肌无力基金会（MGFA）2、3和4级患者中，肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）、定量肌无力（QMG）和肌无力特异性日常生活活动（MSE）评分均有改善。也已观察到循环AChR抗体减少。多种其他指标也被用于评估gMG患者的运动表现。其中包括各种电生理检查，包括重复神经刺激（RNS）。目的：确定gMG患者在艾加莫德给药前后RNS递减的变化。方法：确定5例有症状的gMG患者为艾加莫德治疗的合适候选者。在开始治疗前不久进行RNS，并在完成第一轮4周艾加莫德给药后不久重复进行。1例患者随后又进行了2次RNS。还记录了与患者临床进展的相关性。结果：在艾加莫德给药前后评估的所有5例患者中，RNS递减均改善。RNS改善速率与临床指标改善相平行，改善速率存在一定变异性。总结/结论：RNS是一种可及的操作，可能对艾加莫德治疗反应不快的gMG患者有用。对治疗反应较慢的患者可能显示RNS递减改善更有限。对治疗无反应但RNS递减明显改善的患者，可能需要评估持续性无力的其他解释。Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.title: Checkpoint Inhibitor-induced Myasthenia Gravis, Myositis, and Myocarditis: A Rare But Serious Complication Presenting with Bilateral Eyes Shut
abstracts.authors: Henrik Ehrhardt; Shan Chen
abstracts.affiliations: New Brunswick, NJ
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION/BACKGROUND: Checkpoint inhibitor- induced myasthenia gravis, myositis, and myocarditis (Triple M syndrome) is a rare side effect of checkpoint inhibitor immunotherapies with high rates of in-hospital mortality. It usually presents with rapid onset proximal muscle weakness, severe fatigue, chest pain, ptosis, and diplopia. Here we present a case of bilateral complete ptosis with diplopia. CASE REPORT: An 83-year-old man with metastatic melanoma presented to the hospital in 2023 with bilateral complete ptosis such that his eyes could only open manually or with tape. Once open, he experienced diagonal diplopia. Symptoms started two days after his second cycle of ipilimumab and nivolumab. Labs were notable for elevation of creatinine kinase (CK) above 2,600 units per liter and troponin above 400 nanograms per liter. He was initially treated with high-dose methylprednisolone and IVIG therapy with reduction in troponin and CK but minimal clinical improvement. With plasma exchange his dysphagia and dyspnea improved, but there was minimal improvement in ptosis and diplopia, and he could not tolerate pyridostigmine due to diarrhea. He received four weekly doses of rituximab and continued on oral prednisone which was tapered off four months later. His residual symptoms of slight double vision and exertional fatigue resolved on re-initiation of a low dose of prednisone. No acetylcholine receptor (AChR) or muscle- specific kinase autoantibodies were detected and his repetitive nerve stimulation study was also negative. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Triple M syndrome can present with bilateral complete ptosis, diplopia, and bulbar weakness with negative anti-AChR antibody. It requires trialing multiple immunotherapies, but treatment response may be delayed for months. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.title: Clinical Significance of Cerebrospinal Fluid and Serum Interleukin-17 Levels in Patients with Myasthenia Gravis: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
abstracts.authors: Gabriel Elguera; Mauricio Barbaran Salomon; Valeria Apesteguia Romero; Anapaula Cabanillas Seminario; Alejandra Matos Navarro; Geraldine Cáceres Sánchez; Alvaro Jara Carcahusto; Kevin Cervera; Miguel Francisco Cabanillas Lazo
abstracts.affiliations: Lima, Peru; Cercado de Lima, Peru; Callao, Peru
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an autoimmune neuromuscular disorder. Interleukin-17 (IL-17) has been proposed as a potential inflammatory mediator in MG pathogenesis, although reported circulating levels remain inconsistent. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate circulating IL-17 levels in patients with MG compared with healthy controls and explore differences between generalized and ocular MG. METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies measuring serum IL-17 levels in MG was conducted. Five databases (PubMed, Scopus, Embase, Web of Science, and Google Scholar) were searched. Risk of bias was assessed using the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale (NOS). Standardized mean differences (SMD) were calculated using Hedges’ g under a random-effects model. Statistical heterogeneity was assessed using the I² statistic. RESULTS: From 1,471 records identified, nine studies met inclusion criteria. Eight studies, including 561 participants (294 MG patients and 267 controls), were included in the primary meta-analysis. IL-17 levels were significantly higher in MG patients compared with controls (SMD = 1.15; 95% CI 0.15–2.14; p = 0.024; I² = 91.9%). A secondary analysis comparing generalized and ocular MG included three studies (151 participants) and showed no significant difference (SMD = −0.85; 95% CI −1.76 to 0.07; p=0.069; I²=80.5%). Risk of bias was overall moderate to low. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: IL-17 levels appear elevated in MG, supporting a potential role of Th17-mediated inflammation in disease pathogenesis. Further studies are needed to clarify its clinical utility as a biomarker. Gabriel Elguera, BS ANF International Scholarship Recipient Medical Student Research Award Recipient Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）是一种自身免疫性神经肌肉疾病。白细胞介素-17（IL-17）被认为是MG发病机制中潜在的炎症介质，尽管已报道的循环水平仍不一致。目的：评估MG患者与健康对照者相比的循环IL-17水平，并探讨全身型与眼肌型MG之间的差异。方法：对测量MG患者血清IL-17水平的观察性研究进行系统综述和荟萃分析。检索了五个数据库（PubMed、Scopus、Embase、Web of Science和Google Scholar）。使用纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表（NOS）评估偏倚风险。在随机效应模型下使用Hedges' g计算标准化均数差（SMD）。使用I²统计量评估统计异质性。结果：从识别的1,471条记录中，九项研究符合纳入标准。八项研究（包括561名参与者：294例MG患者和267例对照）被纳入主要荟萃分析。与对照相比，MG患者的IL-17水平显著升高（SMD = 1.15；95% CI 0.15–2.14；p = 0.024；I² = 91.9%）。比较全身型与眼肌型MG的二次分析纳入三项研究（151名参与者），显示无显著差异（SMD = −0.85；95% CI −1.76至0.07；p=0.069；I²=80.5%）。偏倚风险总体为中至低。总结/结论：MG中IL-17水平似乎升高，支持Th17介导的炎症在疾病发病机制中的潜在作用。需要进一步研究以阐明其作为生物标志物的临床效用。Gabriel Elguera，BS ANF国际奖学金获得者 医学生研究奖获得者 海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: Design of a Phase 2A Study to Evaluate the Safety, Efficacy, and Tolerability of Empasiprubart as an Add-on Therapy to Efgartigimod in Adult Participants with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Jeffrey Guptill; Raphael Bilgraer; Anne-Gaëlle Dosne; Sophie Steeland; Kristin Heerlein; Tony Vangeneugden; Maria Ramos Masa
abstracts.affiliations: Ghent, Belgium
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is driven by multiple mechanisms and manifests differently in each patient. In some, a single therapy may not sufficiently address all gMG mechanisms. Efgartigimod, an immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) Fc fragment, alleviates gMG symptoms in many patients by blocking neonatal Fc receptor–mediated IgG recycling. Empasiprubart, an IgG1 antibody, selectively blocks complement C2. For patients with partial response to efgartigimod, empasiprubart add- on therapy could further improve outcomes. OBJECTIVE: To present the design of a Phase 2a, proof- of-concept study evaluating safety, efficacy, and tolerability of empasiprubart add-on therapy in participants with gMG who partially respond to efgartigimod. This is the first of multiple gMG regimens being assessed within a platform study. METHODS: The study consists of 3 parts (total duration, approximately 54 weeks). Part A: approximately 50 adult participants with acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive (AChR-Ab+) gMG receive 1 efgartigimod treatment cycle (4 once-weekly intravenous infusions followed by a 4-week treatment-free period). Part B: participants with partial response to efgartigimod (Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living [MG-ADL] improvements ≥2 with total remaining ≥5) receive 2 cycles of efgartigimod with intravenous empasiprubart coadministered at the first and last infusions of each cycle. Part C (safety follow-up): 4 additional cycles with efgartigimod monotherapy. RESULTS: Primary endpoints will evaluate safety and tolerability during Parts A and B. Secondary endpoints will evaluate efficacy, including MG-ADL. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Results of this study will provide proof-of-concept data on empasiprubart as an add-on therapy to efgartigimod for adults with AChR-Ab+ gMG. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）由多种机制驱动，且在每个患者中表现不同。在某些患者中，单一治疗可能无法充分应对所有gMG机制。艾加莫德（Efgartigimod）是一种免疫球蛋白G1（IgG1）Fc片段，通过阻断新生儿Fc受体介导的IgG再循环来缓解许多gMG患者的症状。Empasiprubart是一种IgG1抗体，选择性阻断补体C2。对于对艾加莫德部分应答的患者，empasiprubart附加治疗可能进一步改善结局。目的：展示一项2a期概念验证研究的设计，该研究评估empasiprubart附加治疗在对艾加莫德部分应答的gMG参与者中的安全性、疗效和耐受性。这是在一个平台研究中评估的多种gMG方案中的第一个。方法：该研究包括3个部分（总持续时间约54周）。A部分：约50名乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）gMG成年参与者接受1个艾加莫德治疗周期（4次每周一次静脉输注，随后4周无治疗期）。B部分：对艾加莫德部分应答的参与者（重症肌无力日常生活活动量表[MG-ADL]改善≥2且总分剩余≥5）接受2个艾加莫德周期，并在每个周期的首次和末次输注时联合静脉给予empasiprubart。C部分（安全性随访）：额外4个艾加莫德单药治疗周期。结果：主要终点将评估A部分和B部分期间的安全性和耐受性。次要终点将评估疗效，包括MG-ADL。总结/结论：该研究结果将提供empasiprubart作为艾加莫德附加治疗用于AChR-Ab+ gMG成年患者的概念验证数据。海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: Factors Associated with Recurrent Clinical Events among Pediatric Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Patients in the United States
abstracts.authors: Jacqueline Pesa; Zhiwen Liu; Louis Jackson; Liang-Yuan Lin; Raghav Govindarajan
abstracts.affiliations: Superior, CO; Titusville, NJ; North Wales, PA; Oxford, MS; Shiloh, IL
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Clinical events in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) are costly and repeat events indicate insufficient disease management. OBJECTIVE: To estimate rates of exacerbation and myasthenic crisis and identify risk factors among commercially insured children with gMG in the United States. METHODS: MG patients aged 2-17 years were identified from MarketScan® commercial insurance data (01/01/2010 to 06/30/2025) based on ≥1 inpatient or ≥2 outpatient claims (within 60 days) for MG and ≥6 months of continuous enrollment before the first qualifying MG diagnosis (index date). Exacerbation and crisis rates were calculated separately for ages 2-11 and 12-17. A nested case-control design defined cases as patients with an event during follow-up (event date as case index date) and controls as those without events (end of follow-up as control index date); the prior 6 months were used to identify risk factors. RESULTS: The study included 508 gMG patients (226 aged 2-11; 282 aged 12-17). Among those aged 2-11, >25% experienced ≥1 exacerbation and 15.5% ≥1 crisis; incidence rates per 100 person-years were 18.2 (95% CI 11.4–29.1) and 9.3 (5.1-17.1), respectively. Among those aged 12-17, 34.8% and 16.7% experienced exacerbation and crisis; incidence rates were 22.8 (16.9-30.1) and 7.3 (4.7-11.4). Logistic regression identified female sex, prior exacerbation, acetylcholinesterase inhibitors, corticosteroids, and intravenous immunoglobulin as significantly associated with repeat exacerbations and crises. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Pediatric gMG patients had high rates of clinical events. Crisis and repeat exacerbation were associated with prior exacerbation and common MG treatments, highlighting the need for improved treatments to reduce disease burden. Jacqueline Pesa, PhD, MPH Pediatric Research Award Recipient Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的临床事件代价高昂，重复事件表明疾病管理不足。目的：估计美国商业保险儿童gMG中加重和肌无力危象的发生率，并确定危险因素。方法：从MarketScan®商业保险数据（2010年1月1日至2025年6月30日）中，根据≥1次住院或≥2次门诊索赔（60天内）诊断为MG，且在首次合格MG诊断（索引日期）前连续参保≥6个月，识别2-17岁MG患者。分别计算2-11岁和12-17岁的加重和危象发生率。采用巢式病例对照设计，病例定义为随访期间发生事件的患者（事件日期作为病例索引日期），对照定义为未发生事件者（随访结束作为对照索引日期）；使用前6个月识别危险因素。结果：研究纳入508例gMG患者（226例2-11岁；282例12-17岁）。在2-11岁者中，>25%经历≥1次加重，15.5%经历≥1次危象；每100人年发病率分别为18.2（95% CI 11.4–29.1）和9.3（5.1-17.1）。在12-17岁者中，34.8%和16.7%经历加重和危象；发病率分别为22.8（16.9-30.1）和7.3（4.7-11.4）。逻辑回归确定女性、既往加重、乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂、皮质类固醇和静脉注射免疫球蛋白与重复加重和危象显著相关。总结/结论：儿童gMG患者临床事件发生率高。危象和重复加重与既往加重及常见MG治疗相关，突显需要改进治疗以减轻疾病负担。Jacqueline Pesa，PhD，MPH 儿科研究奖获得者 海报会议I和II

abstracts.title: Generalized Myasthenia Gravis and Employment: Estimating the Percentage of Jobs Functionally Inaccessible to Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Patients Due to Symptom Variability
abstracts.authors: Emily Myers; Amit Sachdev
abstracts.affiliations: Monroe, MI; Okemos, MI
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized autoimmune myasthenia gravis (gMG) patients experience fluctuating disease burden. Characteristic elements include muscle weakness and fatigue and reflect ocular, oropharyngeal, respiratory, and limb presentations. An estimated 80.7% of prime-age (age 25-54) adults are employed. Accordingly, in the United States, an individual's employment status carries significant economic and social implications. Traditionally, gMG has been observed in higher rates among women in their 20s and men in their 60s. In the U.S., the poverty rate for prime-age adults who are not working is approximately 28%. OBJECTIVE: There is limited data available to quantify what percentage of jobs are functionally inaccessible to gMG patients. This literature review aims to fill this gap. METHODS: A comprehensive review was performed related to gMG, employment, and disease severity. Employment age groups are defined by the U.S. Census Bureau. Disease severity was defined by Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America (MGFA) criteria. RESULTS: Fifty percent of gMG patients are unemployed. Even among the 50% who remain in the labor force, nearly a third report disease-associated job changes. We find that 15-20% of all jobs are inaccessible to gMG patients, 47% of jobs require substantial accommodation due to bulbar symptoms, and 65% due to visual impairment. In aggregate, 65% of the job market appears potentially restricted to patients with gMG. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Patients with gMG should be considered at very high risk of needing disability support or workplace accommodations. Early referral to social work, occupational therapy may be of use, in addition to proactive discussion regarding employability between patient and provider. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型自身免疫性重症肌无力（gMG）患者经历波动的疾病负担。特征性要素包括肌无力和疲劳，反映眼、口咽、呼吸和肢体表现。估计80.7%的壮年（25-54岁）成人就业。因此，在美国，个人的就业状况具有重大经济和社会影响。传统上，gMG在20多岁女性和60多岁男性中观察到的发生率较高。在美国，未工作的壮年成人贫困率约为28%。目的：可用于量化gMG患者功能上无法从事的工作百分比的数据有限。本文献综述旨在填补这一空白。方法：对gMG、就业和疾病严重程度进行了全面综述。就业年龄组由美国人口普查局定义。疾病严重程度由美国重症肌无力基金会（MGFA）标准定义。结果：50%的gMG患者失业。即使在仍留在劳动力中的50%中，近三分之一报告因疾病相关的工作变动。我们发现15-20%的所有工作对gMG患者功能上无法从事，47%的工作因延髓症状需要大量便利调整，65%因视觉损害需要调整。总体而言，65%的就业市场似乎可能对gMG患者受限。总结/结论：gMG患者应被视为极需要残疾支持或工作场所便利调整的高风险人群。早期转介社会工作、职业治疗可能有帮助，此外患者与提供者之间应主动讨论就业能力。海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: Healthcare Costs in Commercially Insured Pediatric Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis in the United States
abstracts.authors: Jacqueline Pesa; Zhiwen Liu; Louis Jackson; Liang-Yuan Lin; Raghav Govindarajan
abstracts.affiliations: Superior, CO; Titusville, NJ; North Wales, PA; Oxford, MS; Shiloh, IL
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is a rare autoimmune disease associated with high healthcare resource utilization and costs among adults. Data on pediatric patients remain limited. OBJECTIVE: To assess the incremental healthcare costs associated with gMG in commercially insured children. METHODS: Using MarketScan® data (01/01/2010–06/30/2025), we identified a retrospective cohort of patients aged 2–17 with ≥1 inpatient or ≥2 outpatient MG diagnosis codes within 60 days and ≥6 months of continuous commercial insurance enrollment before the first qualifying MG diagnosis (index date). Controls (non-MG) were selected randomly. Patients were followed until disenrollment, death, or end of data. Costs were compared between cohorts using inverse probability of treatment weighting to adjust for baseline characteristics. Subgroup analyses evaluated costs among gMG patients experiencing exacerbation or crisis. RESULTS: A total of 508 gMG (66% female; mean age 11.3 years) and 5,178 non-MG patients were identified. Weighted cohorts were well-balanced. Mean total healthcare costs per-patient-per-month (PPPM) were $6,295 vs $226 for gMG vs controls (mean difference $6,069; 95% CI $4,681-7,457). Inpatient and outpatient (excluding office visits) costs were the primary drivers: inpatient $2,872 vs $27 and outpatient $2,568 vs $84 PPPM, respectively. Immunoglobulin therapies accounted for 48% of outpatient costs. Weighted analyses showed higher total costs among patients with exacerbation ($14,154 vs $3,378 PPPM) or crisis ($16,474 vs $4,684 PPPM). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Pediatric gMG patients had higher healthcare costs than non-gMG patients. Exacerbations and crises were associated with approximately 4-fold higher costs, highlighting the need for improved treatments to reduce these costly events. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型肌无力（gMG）是一种罕见的自身免疫性疾病，在成人中与高医疗资源利用和高费用相关。儿童患者的数据仍然有限。目的：评估商业保险儿童中与gMG相关的增量医疗费用。方法：使用MarketScan®数据（2010年1月1日至2025年6月30日），我们识别了一个回顾性队列，纳入年龄2–17岁、在60天内具有≥1次住院或≥2次门诊MG诊断代码、且在首次合格MG诊断（索引日期）前具有≥6个月连续商业保险参保的患者。对照（非MG）为随机选择。患者随访至退保、死亡或数据结束。使用逆概率治疗加权调整基线特征后比较队列间费用。亚组分析评估了发生加重或危象的gMG患者的费用。结果：共识别508例gMG患者（66%女性；平均年龄11.3岁）和5,178例非MG患者。加权队列平衡良好。gMG与对照的每患者每月（PPPM）平均总医疗费用分别为6,295美元与226美元（平均差6,069美元；95% CI 4,681–7,457）。住院和门诊（不包括诊室就诊）费用是主要驱动因素：住院费用分别为PPPM 2,872美元与27美元，门诊费用分别为PPPM 2,568美元与84美元。免疫球蛋白治疗占门诊费用的48%。加权分析显示，发生加重（PPPM 14,154美元 vs 3,378美元）或危象（PPPM 16,474美元 vs 4,684美元）的患者总费用更高。总结/结论：儿童gMG患者的医疗费用高于非gMG患者。加重和危象与约4倍更高的费用相关，突出需要改进治疗以减少这些高费用事件。海报会议I & II

abstracts.title: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Associated Immune Related Adverse Events: Two Cases of Myositis, Myasthenia Gravis, and Myocarditis Related to Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors
abstracts.authors: John Murray; Megan Esch
abstracts.affiliations: Danville, PA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION/BACKGROUND: Immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) immune-related adverse events (irAEs) are inflammatory side effects associated with malignancy- directed immunotherapies. The syndrome of myocarditis, myasthenia gravis, and myositis (MMM) is a rare multisystem irAE. Two cases of suspected MMM are presented. CASE REPORT: A 76-year-old female with COPD, chronic hypoxemic respiratory failure, and non-small cell lung carcinoma presented one month after induction of immunotherapy with durvalumab with progressive shortness of breath, myalgias, fatigue, and subcostal/epigastric pain. She exhibited asymmetric eyelid ptosis and subtle gaze paresis. Serum studies revealed elevated troponin, aldolase, creatine kinase, and transaminases with negative acetylcholine receptor binding antibodies (AChR-Ab). Treatment included methylprednisolone and plasmapharesis; later rituximab, abatacept, and ruxolitinib. A 77-year-old male with hepatocellular carcinoma presented one month after induction with durvalumab and tremelimumab with horizontal diplopia and generalized fatigue. Neurologic exam revealed asymmetric eyelid ptosis with positive ice pack test. Serum studies were similar, with positive AChR- Ab. Treatment included methylprednisolone and plasmapharesis; later abatacept and ruxolitinib. Both patients experienced respiratory muscle weakness and failure requiring intubation, and ultimately died. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: MMM is rare, with high rates of morbidity and mortality from cardiopulmonary complications. Respiratory failure, rather than cardiovascular complication, predominates in these cases, notably worsening shortly after high dose steroids. There remains question of optimal steroid dosing when a multisystem irAE includes myasthenia gravis, given the potential for worsening symptoms after induction with high doses of steroids. John Murray, MD Resident and Fellow Member Award Recipient Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.title: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor-induced Myasthenia Gravis-like Clinical Presentation: A Single Center Case Series
abstracts.authors: Fang Sun; Gabriela Figueiredo Pucci; Joshua Levenson; Brendan McNeish; David Lacomis
abstracts.affiliations: Pittsburgh, PA; Ann Arbor, MI
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION/BACKGROUND: Immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI)-induced myasthenia gravis (MG)-like symptoms are associated with a high fatality rate (up to 40 -60%) when overlapping with myositis and myocarditis. Understanding this condition is critical to developing treatment strategies. CASE REPORT: We examined 21 patients who recently presented with ICI-induced MG-like symptoms. Eighty-six percent of cases overlapped with myositis, and 76% overlapped with myositis and myocarditis. Seventy-one percent survived 90 days. The most common symptoms were proximal weakness (71%), myalgia (67%), dyspnea (52%), ptosis (38%), and respiratory failure (33%). Time from ICI treatment to symptom onset was shorter when overlapped with myocarditis (days, 22 vs 105, p=0.007). Peak creatine kinase (CK) and troponin levels were higher with myocarditis (CK, 412 vs 1694, p=0.008; troponin, 32 vs 1859, p=0.0001). Acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibodies were frequently detected (46%). Abnormal decrement on repetitive nerve stimulation (RNS) was found in 3 patients. Most patients were off chronic immunosuppression by 12 weeks after index admission. There were no recurrent symptoms of MG or myositis in surviving patients. No observed difference in chronic clinical course was seen in patients with or without positive AChR antibody on diagnosis, or in patients with or without abnormal RNS. All patients treated with abatacept and ruxolitinib for myocarditis survived (n=6). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: ICI-induced MG-like symptoms often present with concurrent myotoxicity. Most patients demonstrated a monophasic clinical course despite AChR antibody status or evidence of abnormal RNS at symptom onset. These differences from idiopathic MG should be confirmed in prospective cohorts to guide acute treatment strategies and prevent unnecessary long- term immunosuppression, which could obliterate the anti- tumor effect of ICI. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.title: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor–associated Myasthenia Gravis: Clinical Characteristics, Treatment Response, and Outcomes — a Systematic Review and Pooled Analysis
abstracts.authors: Meghnath Kakde; Shradha Kakde; Shubhangi Kakade
abstracts.affiliations: Nanded, India
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Immune checkpoint inhibitors have transformed cancer therapy but are increasingly associated with immune-related neuromuscular complications, including myasthenia gravis (MG). MG occurring after immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy often shows rapid progression, early respiratory involvement, and substantial morbidity and mortality. However, pooled clinical outcome data remain limited. OBJECTIVE: To synthesize available evidence describing clinical presentation, treatment response, and outcomes of MG associated with immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy. METHODS: A systematic review and pooled analysis of observational studies and prospective cohorts reporting adult patients with immune checkpoint inhibitor–associated MG was performed. The primary outcome was in-hospital mortality. Secondary outcomes included requirement for mechanical ventilation, overlap with inflammatory muscle disease or heart muscle inflammation, presence of acetylcholine receptor antibodies, and response to immunotherapy including intravenous immunoglobulin, plasma exchange, and corticosteroids. Random-effects models were used to estimate pooled proportions and odds ratios, and heterogeneity was assessed using the I-squared statistic. RESULTS: MG associated with immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy frequently presented with bulbar weakness and respiratory compromise, and many patients required intensive care and invasive mechanical ventilation. Overlap syndromes, particularly inflammatory muscle disease and heart muscle inflammation, were common and were associated with worse outcomes and higher mortality. Early treatment with IVIG or plasma exchange appeared to improve outcomes compared with corticosteroids alone. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Immune checkpoint inhibitor–associated MG represents a severe neuromuscular complication with substantial mortality. Early recognition, close respiratory monitoring, and prompt initiation of aggressive immunotherapy may improve outcomes and should be prioritized in multidisciplinary cancer care. Meghnath Kakde, MBBS IFCN International Scholarship Recipient Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：免疫检查点抑制剂改变了癌症治疗，但越来越多地与免疫相关神经肌肉并发症相关，包括肌无力（MG）。免疫检查点抑制剂治疗后发生的MG常表现为快速进展、早期呼吸受累以及显著的发病率和死亡率。然而，汇总的临床结局数据仍然有限。目的：综合现有证据，描述与免疫检查点抑制剂治疗相关MG的临床表现、治疗反应和结局。方法：对报告成人免疫检查点抑制剂相关MG的观察性研究和前瞻性队列进行系统综述和汇总分析。主要结局为院内死亡率。次要结局包括需要机械通气、与炎性肌肉疾病或心肌炎症重叠、乙酰胆碱受体抗体存在，以及对免疫治疗（包括静脉注射免疫球蛋白、血浆置换和皮质类固醇）的反应。使用随机效应模型估计汇总比例和比值比，并使用I平方统计量评估异质性。结果：与免疫检查点抑制剂治疗相关的MG常表现为延髓无力和呼吸功能受损，许多患者需要重症监护和有创机械通气。重叠综合征，特别是炎性肌肉疾病和心肌炎症，较常见，并与更差结局和更高死亡率相关。与单用皮质类固醇相比，早期使用IVIG或血浆置换似乎改善结局。总结/结论：免疫检查点抑制剂相关MG是一种严重的神经肌肉并发症，死亡率较高。早期识别、密切呼吸监测和及时启动积极免疫治疗可能改善结局，应在多学科癌症护理中优先考虑。Meghnath Kakde，MBBS，IFCN国际奖学金获得者，海报会议I & III

abstracts.title: Integrated Clinical and Autonomic Phenotypes in Myasthenia Gravis: Cluster Analysis of Metabolic and Depressive Burden in a Colombian Multicenter Study
abstracts.authors: Angie Naranjo; Carlos Conde; Marta Dallos
abstracts.affiliations: Bucaramanga, Colombia
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is a chronic neuromuscular disorder characterized by fluctuating weakness and heterogeneous neurological expression. Beyond immunological mechanisms, metabolic, psychological, and autonomic factors may contribute to disease burden. OBJECTIVE: We aimed to identify multidimensional patterns associated with neurological severity in Colombian patients with MG. METHODS: We conducted a multicenter cross-sectional study in adults with confirmed MG, directly recruited and comprehensively evaluated by our team in three Colombian cities. Sociodemographic and clinical information was collected through structured assessment. Variables included antibody status, duration of disease, treatments, comorbidities, body mass index, depressive symptom score, blood pressure, electrocardiographic measures, and respiratory sinus arrhythmia indices derived from cardiac recordings. Neurological severity was categorized according to standard clinical classification. Associations were explored using correlation and contingency analyses. Unsupervised cluster analysis integrating clinical, metabolic, psychological, and autonomic variables was performed to identify multidimensional phenotypes. RESULTS: Twenty-five patients were included; seventy- six percent were women and mean age was 49.4 years. Thyroid disease was the most frequent comorbidity. Higher neurological severity correlated with higher body mass index and greater depressive symptom burden. Patients with more severe disease more frequently required IVIG therapy. Cluster analysis identified distinct profiles combining neurological severity, metabolic status, depressive symptoms, and respiratory sinus arrhythmia patterns. Electrocardiographic markers showed variability across clusters, suggesting heterogeneity in autonomic regulation. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In this Colombian neuromuscular cohort, neurological severity clustered with metabolic and depressive factors and demonstrated variability in autonomic markers. These findings support integrated phenotyping in MG. Angie Naranjo, MSc IFCN International Scholarship Recipient Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）是一种慢性神经肌肉疾病，以波动性无力和异质性神经学表现为特征。除免疫学机制外，代谢、心理和自主神经因素也可能导致疾病负担。目的：我们旨在识别哥伦比亚MG患者中与神经学严重程度相关的多维模式。方法：我们在三个哥伦比亚城市开展了一项多中心横断面研究，纳入确诊MG的成人，由我们的团队直接招募并进行全面评估。通过结构化评估收集社会人口学和临床信息。变量包括抗体状态、疾病持续时间、治疗、合并症、体重指数、抑郁症状评分、血压、心电图指标以及从心脏记录中得出的呼吸性窦性心律不齐指数。神经学严重程度根据标准临床分类进行分级。采用相关性和列联分析探讨关联。进行无监督聚类分析，整合临床、代谢、心理和自主神经变量，以识别多维表型。结果：共纳入25例患者；76%为女性，平均年龄49.4岁。甲状腺疾病是最常见的合并症。较高的神经学严重程度与较高的体重指数和更大的抑郁症状负担相关。疾病更严重的患者更常需要IVIG治疗。聚类分析识别出结合神经学严重程度、代谢状态、抑郁症状和呼吸性窦性心律不齐模式的不同特征谱。心电图标志物在各聚类间显示变异性，提示自主神经调节的异质性。总结/结论：在这个哥伦比亚神经肌肉队列中，神经学严重程度与代谢和抑郁因素聚类，并显示自主神经标志物的变异性。这些发现支持MG中的整合表型分析。Angie Naranjo，理学硕士，IFCN国际奖学金获得者，海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: Intimate Partner Violence in Female Early-onset Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: 1,541 Affected Patients in the United States
abstracts.authors: Nichole VanElls; Amit Sachdev
abstracts.affiliations: East Lansing, MI; Okemos, MI
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Female early-onset generalized myasthenia gravis (EOgMG) occurs during peak reproductive and career-building years. The disease often threatens functional independence, converting intimate partners into necessary, life-sustaining caregivers. OBJECTIVE: To analyze the structural vulnerabilities of patients with EOgMG and estimate the population in dependent relationships who would like to leave. METHODS: This study utilized United States (U.S.) generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) prevalence data (82,715 adults) to isolate the EOgMG female cohort (diagnosed before age 40). To this cohort of approximately 8,272 patients, established sociological risk multipliers were applied: a 1.4x disability multiplier for intimate partner violence (IPV) and a 70% latent intent to leave factor. Covariate analysis was conducted to assess the impact of socioeconomic and demographic factors, including employment status, ethnicity, and education level, on relationship dependency and exit barriers. RESULTS: EOgMG causes functional decline and a risk of myasthenic crisis (MC) affecting 15% to 20% of patients. Abusers can weaponize this by withholding medications or delaying emergency assistance. While disabled women face a 40% greater risk of IPV than non-disabled peers, 98% identify their disability as the primary barrier to seeking help. Applying the 1.4x risk multiplier and 70% intent factor results in an entrapment rate of 18.6%, identifying 1,541 female EOgMG patients in the U.S. currently trapped in abusive relationships due to IPV. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Entrapment in EOgMG is a structural and logistical failure rather than a lack of will. Neurologists must implement mandatory IPV screening and advocate for specialized respite care to replace the abuser’s caregiving role with safe, professional support. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：女性早发型全身型重症肌无力（EOgMG）发生于生殖和职业建设的黄金年龄。该疾病常威胁功能独立性，使亲密伴侣成为必要的、维持生命的照护者。目的：分析EOgMG患者的结构性脆弱性，并估计处于依赖关系中希望离开的人群规模。方法：本研究利用美国（U.S.）全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患病率数据（82,715名成人）分离出EOgMG女性队列（40岁前诊断）。对约8,272例患者的该队列应用已确立的社会学风险乘数：亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）的1.4倍残疾乘数和70%的潜在离开意愿因子。进行协变量分析以评估社会经济和人口因素（包括就业状况、族裔和教育水平）对关系依赖和退出障碍的影响。结果：EOgMG导致功能下降和肌无力危象（MC）风险，影响15%至20%的患者。施虐者可通过扣留药物或延迟紧急救助将此武器化。虽然残疾女性面临比非残疾同龄人高40%的IPV风险，但98%将残疾视为寻求帮助的主要障碍。应用1.4倍风险乘数和70%意愿因子得出被困率为18.6%，识别出美国目前有1,541例女性EOgMG患者因IPV被困于虐待关系中。总结/结论：EOgMG中的被困是结构和后勤失败，而非缺乏意愿。神经科医生必须实施强制性IPV筛查，并倡导专门的喘息照护，以安全、专业的支持取代施虐者的照护角色。海报会议I和II

abstracts.authors: Helen Schönborn; Anna Kole
abstracts.affiliations: Köln, Germany; Paris, France
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Ocular symptoms of myasthenia gravis (MG), including diplopia and ptosis, impose a complex burden on daily functioning that may not be fully captured by clinical assessment alone; however, patient experiences and the perspectives of patient organizations remain underrepresented in clinical trial design. OBJECTIVE: To understand the lived experience, unmet needs, and trial-related preferences of people living with ocular MG (oMG) or generalized MG (gMG) with ocular symptoms. METHODS: This mixed-methods study included an online questionnaire assessing symptom burden, diagnostic journey, and expectations regarding trial participation, and a semi-structured focus group with 10 MG/oMG patient experts representing recognized patient organizations from 10 countries. Data were analyzed thematically to identify key challenges and priorities. RESULTS: Participants reported significant functional, emotional, and socioeconomic impacts of oMG, exacerbated by limited access to specialized and multidisciplinary care, particularly in rural settings. Visual symptoms impaired driving, digital device use, and work productivity, leading to loss of independence, social isolation, and safety risks at home, including during childcare and cooking. Patients strongly favored steroid- sparing therapies, improved symptom control, and prevention of progression to gMG. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Ocular MG imposes a substantial and multifaceted burden affecting independence, daily functioning, and emotional well-being. Findings highlight important gaps in access to specialized and multidisciplinary care, as well as persistent unmet therapeutic needs. Incorporating patient perspectives may help better align clinical management and research priorities with outcomes that matter most to people living with MG. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）的眼部症状，包括复视和上睑下垂，对日常功能造成复杂负担，可能无法仅通过临床评估完全捕捉；然而，患者体验和患者组织的观点在临床试验设计中仍代表性不足。目的：了解患有眼型MG（oMG）或伴眼部症状的全身型MG（gMG）患者的真实体验、未满足需求和试验相关偏好。方法：这项混合方法研究包括一项在线问卷，评估症状负担、诊断历程和对试验参与的期望，以及与代表10个国家公认患者组织的10名MG/oMG患者专家进行的半结构化焦点小组。对数据进行主题分析，以识别关键挑战和优先事项。结果：参与者报告oMG对功能、情感和社会经济产生显著影响，且因获得专科和多学科护理的机会有限而加剧，尤其是在农村地区。视觉症状损害驾驶、数字设备使用和工作生产力，导致失去独立性、社会隔离和家庭安全风险，包括在育儿和烹饪期间。患者强烈偏好保类固醇治疗、改善症状控制和预防进展为gMG。总结/结论：眼型MG造成重大且多方面的负担，影响独立性、日常功能和情绪健康。研究结果突显了获得专科和多学科护理的重要差距，以及持续未满足的治疗需求。纳入患者观点可能有助于更好地使临床管理和研究优先事项与MG患者最关心的结局保持一致。海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: Long-term Safety and Sustained Efficacy of Subcutaneous Efgartigimod PH20 in Participants with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis during ADAPT-SC+
abstracts.authors: Ratna Bhavaraju-Sanka; Carlo Antozzi; Jan L. De Bleecker; Wan- Yi Huang; Rosa H. Jimenez; Fien M. Verhamme; Li Liu; Denis Korobko; Andreas Meisel; Kimiaki Utsugisawa; Anna Kostera-Pruszczyk; Jan J. G. M. Verschuuren; Tuan Vu; Heinz Wiendl; James F. Howard; Jr.
abstracts.affiliations: San Antonio, TX; Milano, Italy; Ghent, Belgium; Novosibirsk, Russia; Berlin, Germany; Hanamaki, Japan; Warsaw, Poland; Leiden, Netherlands; Tampa, FL; Münster, Germany; Chapel Hill, NC
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Efgartigimod, a human immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) Fc fragment, reduces IgG levels (including pathogenic autoantibodies) through neonatal Fc receptor blockade. During ADAPT-SC, subcutaneous (SC) efgartigimod PH20 demonstrated noninferior total IgG reduction to intravenous (IV) efgartigimod in participants with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). Participants completing ADAPT-SC or enrolled in ADAPT+ (efgartigimod IV open-label extension [OLE]) could enter the ADAPT-SC+ OLE study. OBJECTIVE: ADAPT-SC+ evaluated long-term safety and efficacy of efgartigimod PH20 SC (coformulated with recombinant human hyaluronidase PH20) in participants with gMG. METHODS: Efgartigimod PH20 SC 1000 mg was administered in cycles of 4 once-weekly injections. Subsequent cycles were initiated based on clinical evaluation (year 1, ≥4 weeks between cycles; year 2 and onward, ≥1 week between cycles following protocol amendment). Safety was assessed using incidence and severity of treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs). Clinical efficacy was assessed using Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) scores. RESULTS: During ADAPT-SC+, 180 adult participants received ≥1 efgartigimod PH20 SC injection (mean [SD] study duration, 2.6 [0.9] years; 459.4 participant years of follow-up). TEAEs were predominantly mild/moderate. Efgartigimod remained well tolerated in participants whose cycle intervals shortened after year 1. MG-ADL total score improvements in anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody–positive (AChR-Ab+) participants were observed by week 1 and sustained through week 163. 59.2% of AChR-Ab+ participants achieved minimal symptom expression (MSE; MG-ADL score, 0-1) at any time, of which 83.3% sustained MSE during consecutive assessments over ≥8 weeks. Additional long-term efficacy analyses will be presented at the congress. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Long-term treatment with efgartigimod PH20 SC was well tolerated and efficacious. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：Efgartigimod是一种人免疫球蛋白G1（IgG1）Fc片段，通过新生儿Fc受体阻断降低IgG水平（包括致病性自身抗体）。在ADAPT-SC中，皮下（SC）efgartigimod PH20在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）参与者中显示出总IgG降低非劣于静脉（IV）efgartigimod。完成ADAPT-SC或入组ADAPT+（efgartigimod IV开放标签扩展[OLE]）的参与者可进入ADAPT-SC+ OLE研究。目的：ADAPT-SC+评估efgartigimod PH20 SC（与重组人透明质酸酶PH20共配制）在gMG参与者中的长期安全性和疗效。方法：Efgartigimod PH20 SC 1000 mg以4次每周一次注射为周期给药。后续周期根据临床评估启动（第1年，周期间隔≥4周；第2年及以后，方案修订后周期间隔≥1周）。安全性通过治疗中出现的不良事件（TEAE）的发生率和严重程度评估。临床疗效使用重症肌无力日常生活活动（MG-ADL）评分评估。结果：在ADAPT-SC+期间，180名成人参与者接受≥1次efgartigimod PH20 SC注射（平均[SD]研究持续时间2.6[0.9]年；459.4参与者年随访）。TEAE主要为轻/中度。在第1年后周期间隔缩短的参与者中，efgartigimod仍耐受良好。抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）参与者的MG-ADL总分改善在第1周即观察到，并持续至第163周。59.2%的AChR-Ab+参与者在任何时间达到最小症状表达（MSE；MG-ADL评分0-1），其中83.3%在≥8周的连续评估中维持MSE。更多长期疗效分析将在大会上展示。总结/结论：efgartigimod PH20 SC长期治疗耐受良好且有效。海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: Malignancy Risk in Myasthenia Gravis Patients Treated with Mycophenolate and Azathioprine in the Medicare Population
abstracts.authors: Michael Hehir; David Bruckman; Jesse Schold; Ikjae Lee; Benjamin Claytor; Yuebing Li
abstracts.affiliations: South Burlington, VT; Cleveland, OH; Aurora, CO; New York, NY
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Mycophenolate (MMF) and azathioprine (AZA) remain the most commonly prescribed non-steroid traditional immunosuppressants for myasthenia gravis (MG) patients. After efficacy, safety is rated as the most important treatment consideration for MG patients and physicians. Early data indicates a higher risk of malignancy in patients treated with AZA and a similar risk of increased malignancy is likely with other immunosuppressants, presenting a safety concern for MG patients. OBJECTIVE: Estimate malignancy incidence and hazard for Medicare-aged MG patients treated with AZA or MMF in an effort to improve treatment decisions. METHODS: Retrospective analysis of malignancy incidence and hazard utilized Poisson and Cox regression models in MG patients treated with MMF or AZA vs. matched controls in the Medicare Fee-For-Service claims database; non-melanoma skin malignancies were excluded. MG patients and matched controls were identified among beneficiaries enrolled from 2006-2019 utilizing validated methodology. RESULTS: Incidence rate ratio (IRR) and hazard ratio (HR) of malignancy were no different in 5,585 MG patients compared to 26,194 non-MG matched controls (IRR 0.92; 95% CI 0.83-1.02; HR 0.93; 0.82-1.07). Malignancy IRR and hazard ratio were similar between MG patients exposed to MMF/AZA (N=1795) and MG patients not exposed to MMF/AZA (N=3790) (IRR 0.87; 0.72-1.05; HR 1.21; 0.96-1.51). The most common malignancies observed among exposed and non-exposed MG patients were genitourinary, gastrointestinal, respiratory/chest, hematological, and endocrine. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: There does not appear to be an increased malignancy risk with the use of AZA/MMF among Medicare-aged MG patients. This data may be reassuring to patients and clinicians utilizing these immunotherapies. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：吗替麦考酚酯（MMF）和硫唑嘌呤（AZA）仍是重症肌无力（MG）患者最常用的非甾体传统免疫抑制剂。在疗效之后，安全性被MG患者和医生评为最重要的治疗考量。早期数据表明，接受AZA治疗的患者恶性肿瘤风险更高，其他免疫抑制剂也可能存在类似的恶性肿瘤风险增加，这给MG患者带来了安全性担忧。目的：估计接受AZA或MMF治疗的Medicare年龄MG患者的恶性肿瘤发生率和风险比，以改善治疗决策。方法：采用Poisson和Cox回归模型，在Medicare按服务收费索赔数据库中，对接受MMF或AZA治疗的MG患者与匹配对照者的恶性肿瘤发生率和风险比进行回顾性分析；排除非黑色素瘤皮肤恶性肿瘤。采用经验证的方法，在2006-2019年参保的受益人中发现MG患者和匹配对照者。结果：5,585例MG患者与26,194例非MG匹配对照者相比，恶性肿瘤的发病率比（IRR）和风险比（HR）无差异（IRR 0.92；95% CI 0.83-1.02；HR 0.93；0.82-1.07）。暴露于MMF/AZA的MG患者（N=1795）与未暴露于MMF/AZA的MG患者（N=3790）之间，恶性肿瘤IRR和风险比相似（IRR 0.87；0.72-1.05；HR 1.21；0.96-1.51）。在暴露和未暴露的MG患者中观察到的最常见恶性肿瘤为泌尿生殖系统、胃肠道、呼吸/胸部、血液系统和内分泌系统恶性肿瘤。总结/结论：在Medicare年龄MG患者中，使用AZA/MMF似乎并未增加恶性肿瘤风险。这些数据可能对使用这些免疫疗法的患者和临床医生具有安抚作用。海报会议I和III

abstracts.affiliations: Melrose, MA; Burlington, MA; Manchester, MA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Neuromuscular diseases may cause respiratory muscle weakness, leading to respiratory failure requiring intubation and mechanical ventilation. Early recognition and elective intubation may improve outcomes. OBJECTIVE: To identify factors associated with delayed recognition of impending respiratory failure in hospitalized patients with Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) or myasthenia gravis (MG). METHODS: We conducted a retrospective quality improvement study at Lahey Clinic identifying patients with neuromuscular respiratory failure requiring intubation from June 2021 to December 2025. Patients with GBS or MG were included; those intubated at another institution or immediately on arrival were excluded. Three physicians independently reviewed cases, and only patients deemed emergently intubated were included. RESULTS: Ten patients met inclusion criteria: 7 with GBS and 3 with MG. Neurology participated in all cases (primary team 4, consult 6). Respiratory mechanics were undocumented in 4. Among the remaining 6, 3 had NIF weaker than −30 cm H2O including 2 ≤−15 cm H2O; yet only 1 was initially monitored in the ICU. Four patients had respiratory failure primarily due to bellows weakness, six due to combined bellows and bulbar weakness. Bedside respiratory documentation was inconsistent. Among GBS patients, none had a documented EGRIS score; retrospectively, 3 had scores ≥4, only 1 was initially monitored in the ICU. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Delayed recognition of respiratory failure in GBS and MG was associated with inconsistent assessment and underuse of risk stratification tools such as EGRIS, even in high-risk cases. Targeted education and consistent use of standardized evaluation may improve early identification of patients at risk for decompensation. Juan Pablo Espinosa, MD Resident and Fellow Member Award Recipient Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：神经肌肉疾病可导致呼吸肌无力，进而引起需要插管和机械通气的呼吸衰竭。早期识别和择期插管可能改善结局。目的：识别与吉兰-巴雷综合征（GBS）或重症肌无力（MG）住院患者即将发生呼吸衰竭的延迟识别相关的因素。方法：我们在Lahey Clinic开展了一项回顾性质量改进研究，识别2021年6月至2025年12月期间需要插管的神经肌肉呼吸衰竭患者。纳入GBS或MG患者；排除在其他机构插管或到达时立即插管的患者。三名医生独立审查病例，仅纳入被判定为紧急插管的患者。结果：十例患者符合纳入标准：7例GBS和3例MG。神经科参与了所有病例（原发团队4例，会诊6例）。4例未记录呼吸力学。在其余6例中，3例NIF弱于−30 cm H2O，包括2例≤−15 cm H2O；然而仅1例最初在ICU监测。4例患者的呼吸衰竭主要归因于风箱式呼吸肌无力，6例归因于风箱式和延髓无力合并。床旁呼吸记录不一致。在GBS患者中，无一例记录EGRIS评分；回顾性分析中，3例评分≥4，仅1例最初在ICU监测。总结/结论：GBS和MG中呼吸衰竭的延迟识别与评估不一致以及风险分层工具（如EGRIS）使用不足相关，即使在高风险病例中也是如此。有针对性的教育和标准化评估的一致使用可能改善对失代偿风险患者的早期识别。Juan Pablo Espinosa，医学博士，住院医师和研究员会员奖获得者 海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: Muscle Pain: Investigation into Mechanisms of Complement-mediated Muscle Injury and the Prevalence of Pain in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Eaman Ahmad; Shems Hamdan; Amit Sachdev
abstracts.affiliations: South Lyon, MI; East Lansing, MI; Okemos, MI
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Complement-mediated injury at the neuromuscular junction (NMJ) is a well-established mechanism in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). Activation of the classical complement pathway leads to C3 activation and formation of the membrane attack complex, which damages the postsynaptic membrane and disrupts neuromuscular transmission, contributing to muscle weakness. While these mechanisms are well described, pain remains an understudied outcome in patients with gMG. OBJECTIVE: This study aims to evaluate potential mechanisms linking complement activation to muscle injury and pain in gMG and to assess the prevalence and characteristics of pain in this population. METHODS: A literature review was conducted following PRISMA guidelines, focusing on studies related to complement activation, gMG, and pain. Future phases of this project will include analysis of patient-reported symptoms from Facebook posts and other online support communities to better characterize pain in gMG. RESULTS: Existing literature identifies complement- mediated lysis as a primary driver of NMJ injury in gMG. Furthermore, several studies suggest that pain may be more common than traditionally recognized. In one study of 331 neuromuscular patients, many with gMG, 67% reported experiencing pain within the past three months. Although current research primarily focuses on weakness, repeated cycles of complement-mediated injury and repair may lead to localized inflammation and sensitization of muscle nociceptors, potentially contributing to pain. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Pain appears to be a common but underinvestigated symptom in gMG. Further research investigating biological mechanisms with patient-reported outcomes is needed to better understand the role of complement activation in pain experienced by individuals with gMG. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：神经肌肉接头（NMJ）的补体介导损伤是全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的公认机制。经典补体途径的激活导致C3激活和膜攻击复合物形成，后者损伤突触后膜并破坏神经肌肉传递，导致肌无力。虽然这些机制已被充分描述，但疼痛仍是gMG患者中研究不足的结局。目的：本研究旨在评估将补体激活与gMG中肌肉损伤和疼痛联系起来的潜在机制，并评估该人群中疼痛的患病率和特征。方法：按照PRISMA指南进行文献综述，重点关注与补体激活、gMG和疼痛相关的研究。本项目的未来阶段将包括分析来自Facebook帖子和其他在线支持社区的患者报告症状，以更好地描述gMG中的疼痛特征。结果：现有文献确定补体介导的裂解是gMG中NMJ损伤的主要驱动因素。此外，多项研究表明疼痛可能比传统认识的更为常见。在一项纳入331例神经肌肉疾病患者（其中许多为gMG）的研究中，67%报告在过去三个月内经历过疼痛。尽管当前研究主要关注无力，但补体介导的损伤和修复的反复循环可能导致局部炎症和肌肉伤害感受器敏化，可能促成疼痛。总结/结论：疼痛似乎是gMG中常见但研究不足的症状。需要进一步研究生物学机制并结合患者报告结局，以更好地理解补体激活在gMG患者疼痛中的作用。海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: New-onset Seropositive Myasthenia Gravis Following Glucagon-like Peptide 1 Receptor Agonist Initiation: A Case Report
abstracts.authors: Mao Liu; Jonathan Morena
abstracts.affiliations: Durham, NC
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION/BACKGROUND: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) are used for the management of Type 2 diabetes and obesity and have broad immunomodulatory effects. Limited evidence suggests they may trigger autoimmune conditions. CASE REPORT: A 55-year-old female started semaglutide (Ozempic), a GLP-1 RA for Type 2 diabetes and obesity. Within a few days, the patient developed left-sided fatigable ptosis, blurred vision, and intermittent binocular vertical diplopia. She was referred to an ophthalmologist, and AChR antibodies were positive (AChR antibodies: binding 7.8 nmol/L, blocking 40%, and modulating 76%; striational antibodies 1:1000), confirming a diagnosis of myasthenia gravis (MG). Chest CT showed no thymoma. The patient developed dysphagia and was referred to neurology. Pyridostigmine and prednisone provided symptomatic improvement, but with side effects of diarrhea and insomnia. She was referred to our institution. Repetitive nerve stimulation of the left facial nerve demonstrated a 13.4% compound muscle action potential amplitude decrement at three minutes post exercise. She had worsened dysphagia with nasal regurgitation of liquids and was hospitalized to receive IVIG with subsequent improvement. She continues to receive care with ongoing therapeutic adjustments. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Our case highlights a temporal association between GLP-1 RA therapy and the onset of seropositive MG. While existing research into GLP-1 RAs and MG shows inconsistent results regarding direct causality, real-world data indicate an increased risk for several other autoimmune conditions. With the increasing utilization of GLP-1 RAs and lack of long-term safety data, clinicians should maintain a high degree of suspicion for new-onset autoimmune disorders such as MG. Mao Liu, MD Resident and Fellow Member Award Recipient Poster Sessions I & III
