abstracts.title: Onset Pattern and Risk Factors for Generalisation in Ocular Myasthenia Gravis at a Tertiary Neuroscience Center in Singapore
abstracts.authors: Christen Lim; Josiah Chai
abstracts.affiliations: Singapore, Singapore
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Onset patterns and course of myasthenia gravis (MG) vary across populations, but contemporary Southeast Asian data are limited. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate clinical features and generalization risk in ocular-onset patients from a Singaporean institutional MG cohort. METHODS: We retrospectively identified consecutive patients in an institutional MG database (2006-2025). Baseline data included demographics, onset pattern (ocular vs generalized), acetylcholine receptor antibody (AChR-Ab) status, repetitive nerve stimulation (RNS) and thymoma, with test-specific denominators reflecting missing data. In ocular-onset patients, we recorded subsequent generalization and time to generalization, censoring non-generalized patients at last visit. RESULTS: Fifty-one patients were included; median age 60 years (IQR 46-68), 31 (58.8%) male, predominantly Chinese (82.4%). Thirty-three (64.7%) had ocular onset. Overall, 39/50 (78.0%) were AChR-Ab positive and 18/32 (56.3%) had abnormal RNS. Ocular₂onset patients were older (median 61 vs 51 years, p=0.035), more often male (72.7% vs 33.3%, p=0.0086), with lower thymoma (6.1% vs 35.3%, p=0.013) and RNS abnormality rates (40.0% vs 90.9%, p=0.0084) than generalized-onset patients. Fifteen (45.5%) ocular-onset patients generalized over median 5.4 years, with 1-, 2- and 5-year generalization rates of 27.3%, 30.3% and 39.4% (5-year 95% CI 22.7-56.1%). Generalization was more frequent in AChR-Ab-positive (14/15 vs 12/17, p=0.178), RNS-abnormal (5/9 vs 3/11, p=0.362) and thymomatous patients (2/15 vs 0/16, p=0.226), although these trends were inconclusive with this sample size. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In this Singaporean MG cohort, ocular onset was common and 39.4% of ocular- onset patients generalized within 5 years. Baseline AChR- Ab status, RNS findings, and thymomatous state may assist early risk stratification and counselling in multiethnic Southeast Asian clinics. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）的起病模式和病程在不同人群中存在差异，但当代东南亚数据有限。目的：评估来自新加坡某机构MG队列中以眼肌起病患者的临床特征和全身化风险。方法：我们回顾性识别了机构MG数据库（2006-2025年）中的连续患者。基线数据包括人口学特征、起病模式（眼肌型 vs 全身型）、乙酰胆碱受体抗体（AChR-Ab）状态、重复神经刺激（RNS）和胸腺瘤，并采用检测特异性分母以反映缺失数据。在眼肌起病患者中，我们记录后续全身化及至全身化的时间，未全身化患者在末次访视时删失。结果：共纳入51例患者；中位年龄60岁（IQR 46-68），31例（58.8%）为男性，以华人为主（82.4%）。33例（64.7%）为眼肌起病。总体而言，39/50（78.0%）为AChR-Ab阳性，18/32（56.3%）RNS异常。眼肌起病患者较全身起病患者年龄更大（中位61 vs 51岁，p=0.035），男性更多（72.7% vs 33.3%，p=0.0086），胸腺瘤（6.1% vs 35.3%，p=0.013）和RNS异常率（40.0% vs 90.9%，p=0.0084）更低。15例（45.5%）眼肌起病患者在中位5.4年内发生全身化，1年、2年和5年全身化率分别为27.3%、30.3%和39.4%（5年95% CI 22.7-56.1%）。全身化在AChR-Ab阳性（14/15 vs 12/17，p=0.178）、RNS异常（5/9 vs 3/11，p=0.362）和胸腺瘤患者（2/15 vs 0/16，p=0.226）中更常见，但在此样本量下这些趋势尚无定论。总结/结论：在该新加坡MG队列中，眼肌起病常见，39.4%的眼肌起病患者在5年内发生全身化。基线AChR-Ab状态、RNS结果和胸腺瘤状态可能有助于多族裔东南亚诊所的早期风险分层和咨询。海报会议I & II

abstracts.title: Patient Perspectives on Meaningful Change in the Myasthenia Gravis Impairment Index Patient-reported Outcome Ocular Score
abstracts.authors: Martina Orlovic; Rosa Jimenez; Wan-Yi Huang; Michael Mendes; Fien M. Verhamme; Fien Gistelinck; Jason Randall; Sophie Hughes; Gabriella Szatmary; Carolina Barnett- Tapia
abstracts.affiliations: Gent, Belgium; Hingham, MA; Boston, MA; Ghent, Belgium; Kent, United Kingdom; Chapel Hill, NC; Toronto, Canada
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: The Myasthenia Gravis Impairment Index (MGII) has been validated in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) and includes a Patient-Reported Outcome (PRO) ocular score (items 1-6). Evidence supporting how well this subscore captures meaningful within-patient change and is interpretable in ocular myasthenia gravis (oMG) is limited. This study aimed to characterize patients’ experiences during the first 4 weeks of treatment during a clinical trial (NCT06558279, ADAPT OCULUS) and to assess the meaningfulness of changes captured by the MGII (PRO) ocular score. METHODS: Thirty semi-structured exit interviews, approximately 20% of the ADAPT OCULUS population, were conducted in a blinded sample of patients with oMG across global sites. Interviews explored symptom changes, meaningfulness, and perceived changes in MGII (PRO) ocular score items and Patient Global Impression (PGI-S/C) responses. Interviews were audio-recorded, transcribed, and analyzed using thematic analysis. RESULTS: Double vision (83%) and eyelid drooping (73%) were most salient to patients. Over 59% of patients reported meaningful improvements in these symptoms, resulting in benefits to daily functioning such as driving, screen use, and social engagement. Most patients reported improvement (>30%) or stability (>44%) on MGII (PRO) ocular score items. Overall, any improvements were described as meaningful, while “no change” was also valued as prevention of symptom progression. Patients generally identified a 1-category improvement on MGII (PRO) ocular as the smallest meaningful change. Findings were concordant with PGI-S/C responses. CONCLUSION: Patient-reported improvements or stabilization in oMG symptoms were meaningful to oMG patients. The findings support the clinical relevance, interpretability, and meaningful within-patient change of the MGII (PRO) ocular score as an endpoint in oMG trials. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力损害指数（MGII）已在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）中得到验证，并包含患者报告结局（PRO）眼肌评分（条目1-6）。支持该子评分在眼肌型重症肌无力（oMG）中捕捉患者内有意义变化及可解释性的证据有限。本研究旨在描述临床试验（NCT06558279，ADAPT OCULUS）治疗前4周内患者的体验，并评估MGII（PRO）眼肌评分所捕捉变化的临床意义。方法：在来自全球多个中心的oMG患者盲法样本中进行了30次半结构化退出访谈，约占ADAPT OCULUS人群的20%。访谈探讨了症状变化、意义感以及MGII（PRO）眼肌评分条目和患者总体印象（PGI-S/C）应答的感知变化。访谈进行录音、转录，并采用主题分析进行分析。结果：复视（83%）和眼睑下垂（73%）是患者最突出的症状。超过59%的患者报告这些症状有有意义的改善，从而对驾驶、屏幕使用和社交参与等日常功能产生获益。大多数患者报告MGII（PRO）眼肌评分条目改善（>30%）或稳定（>44%）。总体而言，任何改善均被描述为有意义，而“无变化”也被视为防止症状进展而受到重视。患者通常将MGII（PRO）眼肌评分改善1个类别认定为最小有意义变化。研究结果与PGI-S/C应答一致。结论：患者报告的oMG症状改善或稳定对oMG患者具有意义。研究结果支持MGII（PRO）眼肌评分作为oMG试验终点的临床相关性、可解释性和患者内有意义变化。海报会议I & II

abstracts.title: Polysomnographic Evaluation of Sleep in MuSK-positive Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Beyza Arslan; Pinar Kahraman Koytak; Kayihan Uluc; Kadriye Agan; Gulin Sunter
abstracts.affiliations: Istanbul, Turkey
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Sleep-disordered breathing is increasingly recognized in neuromuscular disorders; however, data in anti–muscle-specific kinase (MuSK) positive myasthenia gravis (MG) remain limited. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate sleep characteristics and sleep- disordered breathing in MuSK-MG patients using polysomnography and to investigate associations with MG severity and sleep-related clinical measures. METHODS: Nine patients with anti-MuSK positive MG and nine age- and sex-matched healthy controls were prospectively evaluated. All participants underwent overnight polysomnography (PSG) and a Multiple Sleep Latency Test (MSLT). Clinical assessment included MG Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL), Quantitative MG score (QMG), MG Composite (MGC), and MG Quality of Life-15 (MGQoL-15), as well as sleep questionnaires, including the Epworth Sleepiness Scale, Berlin Questionnaire, STOP-BANG, Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index, and Insomnia Severity Index. Groups were compared using appropriate statistical tests, and correlations between apnea–hypopnea index (AHI) and clinical variables were analyzed. RESULTS: Demographic characteristics were comparable between groups. Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) was identified in 6 of 9 patients (66.7%) with MuSK-MG (4 mild, 2 moderate), whereas none of the controls had OSA (p=0.009). Patients demonstrated higher AHI values than controls (median 8.4 vs 3.7 events/h; p=0.008), particularly during non–rapid eye movement sleep (p=0.011). AHI correlated with STOP-BANG, Berlin Questionnaire, and Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index scores but not with MG severity scales. MSLT parameters did not differ between groups. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: OSA appears frequent in anti- MuSK MG, even in clinically stable disease. Predominant NREM-related respiratory events may reflect bulbar and oropharyngeal muscle involvement. Screening questionnaires may help identify patients who would benefit from polysomnography, highlighting the importance of systematic sleep evaluation in MuSK-MG. Beyza Arslan, MD Resident and Fellow Member Award Recipient Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：睡眠呼吸障碍在神经肌肉疾病中日益受到认识；然而，抗肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶（MuSK）阳性重症肌无力（MG）的数据仍然有限。目的：使用多导睡眠图评估MuSK-MG患者的睡眠特征和睡眠呼吸障碍，并探讨其与MG严重程度及睡眠相关临床指标的关系。方法：前瞻性评估9例抗MuSK阳性MG患者和9例年龄、性别匹配的健康对照。所有参与者接受整夜多导睡眠图（PSG）和多次睡眠潜伏期试验（MSLT）。临床评估包括MG日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）、定量MG评分（QMG）、MG复合评分（MGC）和MG生活质量-15（MGQoL-15），以及睡眠问卷，包括Epworth嗜睡量表、柏林问卷、STOP-BANG、匹兹堡睡眠质量指数和失眠严重程度指数。组间采用适当统计检验进行比较，并分析呼吸暂停-低通气指数（AHI）与临床变量之间的相关性。结果：两组人口学特征相当。9例MuSK-MG患者中6例（66.7%）发现阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）（4例轻度，2例中度），而对照组无OSA（p=0.009）。患者AHI值高于对照（中位8.4 vs 3.7次/小时；p=0.008），尤其在非快速眼动睡眠期（p=0.011）。AHI与STOP-BANG、柏林问卷和匹兹堡睡眠质量指数评分相关，但与MG严重程度量表无关。MSLT参数组间无差异。总结/结论：OSA在抗MuSK MG中似乎常见，即使在临床稳定的疾病中也是如此。以NREM为主的呼吸事件可能反映延髓和口咽部肌肉受累。筛查问卷可能有助于识别可从多导睡眠图获益的患者，强调在MuSK-MG中系统睡眠评估的重要性。Beyza Arslan，医学博士住院医师和研究员会员奖获得者 海报会议I & II

abstracts.title: Symptom Severity Assessment Using Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living in Active-treatment Phase: Vibrance-MG Phase 2/3 Study of Nipocalimab in Adolescents with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Tuan Vu; Marie Fitzgibbon; Ibrahim Turkoz; Dan Huang; Carly J. Paoli; Jelena Dukovski
abstracts.affiliations: Tampa, FL; Raritan, NJ; Titusville, NJ; Neuss, Germany; Horsham, PA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab added to standard-of-care (SOC) demonstrated substantial immunoglobulin G reduction and sustained disease control in the 24-week open-label Phase 2/3 vibrance-mg (NCT05265273) study in adolescents (aged 12 to <18 years) with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the impact of nipocalimab+SOC treatment on Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) items and domains in adolescents from vibrance-mg through 24 weeks. METHODS: Baseline floor effects (score=0) distribution was evaluated using item-level frequency distributions. Mean/median change-from-baseline (CFB) for all 8 items and 4 domains of the MG-ADL were evaluated through 24 weeks. Based on items/domains score distributions, those patients with ≥1 point improvement in domains/items were evaluated; negative change in scores indicates improvement. RESULTS: At baseline (n=8) the mean (range) MG-ADL domain scores were 1.31 (0–3) bulbar, 0.25 (0–1) respiratory, 0.69 (0–3) limb, and 2.13 (1–3) ocular. The mean (SD) CFB to Week 24 (n=7/8; 1 ongoing in study at time of data cutoff) was −0.79 (0.76) bulbar, −0.21 (0.39) limb, 0.07 (0.45) respiratory, and −1.64 (0.80) ocular. With regard to achieving ≥1 point improvement in MG-ADL domain scores, 3(42.9%) patients achieved this in bulbar, 1(14.3%) in limb, none in respiratory, and 6 (85.7%) in ocular. At baseline, median MG-ADL item scores were 0.00–1.25 (range 0–2.5); the proportion of patients achieving ≥1 point improvement in MG-ADL item scores over 24 weeks was 2 (28.6%) in chewing, 5 (71.4%) in eyelid-droop, 4(57.1%) in double-vision, and 1 (14.3%) each, for talking, swallowing, and impairment in brushing teeth/combing hair. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Nipocalimab+SOC improved scores for individual domains and items of MG-ADL after 24 weeks of treatment in adolescents with gMG, demonstrating sustained disease control across a broad range of symptoms. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在24周开放标签2/3期vibrance-mg研究（NCT05265273）中，在标准治疗（SOC）基础上加用nipocalimab在12至<18岁全身型重症肌无力（gMG）青少年中显示出大幅免疫球蛋白G降低和持续疾病控制。目的：评估vibrance-mg中nipocalimab+SOC治疗至24周对青少年MG日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）条目和域的影响。方法：使用条目水平频率分布评估基线地板效应（评分=0）分布。评估至24周所有8个条目和4个域的MG-ADL相对基线变化（CFB）均值/中位数。根据条目/域评分分布，评估域/条目改善≥1分的患者；评分负向变化表示改善。结果：基线时（n=8）MG-ADL域评分均值（范围）为延髓1.31（0–3）、呼吸0.25（0–1）、肢体0.69（0–3）、眼肌2.13（1–3）。至第24周（n=7/8；数据截止时1例仍在研究中）的CFB均值（SD）为延髓−0.79（0.76）、肢体−0.21（0.39）、呼吸0.07（0.45）、眼肌−1.64（0.80）。关于MG-ADL域评分改善≥1分，延髓3例（42.9%）、肢体1例（14.3%）、呼吸无、眼肌6例（85.7%）达到。基线时MG-ADL条目评分中位数为0.00–1.25（范围0–2.5）；24周内MG-ADL条目评分改善≥1分的患者比例分别为咀嚼2例（28.6%）、眼睑下垂5例（71.4%）、复视4例（57.1%），说话、吞咽和刷牙/梳头困难各1例（14.3%）。总结/结论：在gMG青少年中，nipocalimab+SOC治疗24周后改善了MG-ADL各域和条目的评分，证明在广泛症状范围内持续疾病控制。海报会议I & III

abstracts.title: The Duke Myasthenia Gravis Clinic Registry: IV. Does Race Affect the Outcome of Treatment of Myasthenia Gravis? A Single Center Retrospective Analysis
abstracts.authors: Mao Liu; Chunlu Ma; Michael Lutz; Vern Juel; Janice Massey; Lisa Hobson-Webb; Shruti Raja; Donald Sanders
abstracts.affiliations: Durham, NC
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Few studies have investigated the role of race in the long-term outcome of patients with myasthenia gravis (MG). OBJECTIVE: The aim of this study is to analyze clinical characteristics and treatment outcomes related to race in patients with MG. METHODS: This is a retrospective review of data from patients seen between 1980 and 2016 and followed for at least two years in the Duke MG Clinic. Treatment goal (TG) was defined as achieving Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America (MGFA) post-intervention status of “minimal manifestations” or better. Multivariable logistic regression analysis and Cox proportional hazards (CPH) modeling were performed to assess the effect of race on TG by adjusting for other variables. RESULTS: Among 855 patients (692 White, 81%; 163 Black, 19%), Black patients had a younger median age at onset (32 vs 56 years, p<0.001), female predominance (61% vs 47%, p=0.001), higher muscle-specific tyrosine kinase antibody rate (40% vs 15%, p<0.001), and higher rate of thymectomy (58% vs. 39%, p<0.001). Disease duration, follow-up duration, and the proportion achieving and median time to TG were similar between the two racial groups. Neither multivariable logistic regression nor CPH modeling identified race as an independent predictor of TG. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Although racial differences were observed in patients with MG, long-term outcomes were similar in Black and White patients. Our study suggests that following treatment guidelines is important in achieving favorable MG outcomes. Mao Liu, MD Resident and Fellow Member Award Recipient Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：很少有研究探讨种族对重症肌无力（MG）患者长期结局的影响。目的：本研究旨在分析MG患者中与种族相关的临床特征和治疗结局。方法：这是一项回顾性数据回顾，纳入1980年至2016年间在Duke MG诊所就诊并随访至少2年的患者。治疗目标（TG）定义为达到美国重症肌无力基金会（MGFA）干预后状态“微小表现”或更好。采用多变量logistic回归分析和Cox比例风险（CPH）模型，在调整其他变量后评估种族对TG的影响。结果：在855例患者中（白人692例，81%；黑人163例，19%），黑人患者的中位发病年龄更年轻（32岁 vs 56岁，p<0.001），女性占优势（61% vs 47%，p=0.001），肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶抗体阳性率更高（40% vs 15%，p<0.001），胸腺切除术率更高（58% vs 39%，p<0.001）。两个种族组之间的疾病持续时间、随访持续时间、达到TG的比例以及达到TG的中位时间相似。多变量logistic回归和CPH模型均未将种族确定为TG的独立预测因素。总结/结论：尽管在MG患者中观察到种族差异，但黑人和白人患者的长期结局相似。我们的研究表明，遵循治疗指南对于获得良好的MG结局很重要。Mao Liu，医学博士，住院医师和研究员会员奖获得者，海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: The Phase 4 Octagon Study Investigating Oral Corticosteroid Tapering in Adult Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Treated with Ravulizumab: Trial in Progress
abstracts.authors: Benjamin Yungher; Emma Weiskopf; Rasha Aguzzi; Guido Sabatella
abstracts.affiliations: Boston, MA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Oral corticosteroids (OCS) are used to treat patients with anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody- positive (AChR-Ab+) generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). Treatment guidelines recommend steroid-sparing strategies, yet clinical practice trends employ prolonged OCS tapering regimens with higher steroid exposure and risk of adverse events (AEs) compared with faster tapering. Ravulizumab, a complement component 5 inhibitor approved for AChR-Ab+ gMG, enables reduction and discontinuation of OCS, while maintaining symptom control. OBJECTIVE: To describe OCTAGON, a Phase 4, prospective, multicenter, single-arm study (NCT07221838) evaluating the effectiveness and safety of a rapid, predefined OCS-tapering schedule in adult patients with gMG receiving ravulizumab. METHODS: Planned enrollment: ~75 adults with gMG, receiving ravulizumab Q8W and a stable OCS regimen equivalent to a daily average of ≥7.5mg/day for ≥4weeks. A tapering schedule based on baseline (BL) OCS dose will be assessed. Patients with BL OCS 7.5-10mg/day will reduce by 2.5mg/day Q4W to 2.5mg/day, then by 1.25mg/day Q4W until completion. Patients with BL OCS >10mg/day will reduce by 5mg/day Q2W to 10mg/day, then follow the schedule for those with BL OCS 7.5- 10mg/day. Primary endpoint is the proportion of patients who discontinue OCS or reduce to ≤5mg/day and maintain for ≥4weeks without gMG clinical deterioration. RESULTS: The trial (NCT07221838) is currently enrolling participants. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: OCTAGON addresses a critical unmet need for an evidence-based rapid OCS tapering schedule in patients with gMG. Results will provide a framework for effective and safe OCS treatment management in the targeted immunotherapy era, minimizing risks associated with prolonged corticosteroid exposure, while optimizing outcomes for patients with gMG receiving ravulizumab. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：口服皮质类固醇（OCS）用于治疗抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR-Ab+）全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者。治疗指南推荐减少类固醇用量的策略，但临床实践趋势采用延长OCS减量方案，与更快减量相比，类固醇暴露更高且不良事件（AE）风险更高。Ravulizumab是一种获批用于AChR-Ab+ gMG的补体成分5抑制剂，可在维持症状控制的同时减少和停用OCS。目的：描述OCTAGON，这是一项4期、前瞻性、多中心、单臂研究（NCT07221838），评估在接受ravulizumab治疗的成人gMG患者中，快速、预定义OCS减量方案的有效性和安全性。方法：计划入组约75例成人gMG患者，接受ravulizumab每8周一次（Q8W）以及稳定OCS方案，相当于每日平均≥7.5 mg/天持续≥4周。将评估基于基线（BL）OCS剂量的减量方案。基线OCS为7.5-10 mg/天的患者将每4周（Q4W）减少2.5 mg/天至2.5 mg/天，然后每4周减少1.25 mg/天直至完成。基线OCS>10 mg/天的患者将每2周（Q2W）减少5 mg/天至10 mg/天，然后遵循基线OCS为7.5-10 mg/天患者的方案。主要终点是停用OCS或减至≤5 mg/天并维持≥4周且无gMG临床恶化的患者比例。结果：该试验（NCT07221838）目前正在入组参与者。总结/结论：OCTAGON针对gMG患者对基于证据的快速OCS减量方案的关键未满足需求。结果将为靶向免疫治疗时代有效且安全的OCS治疗管理提供框架，最大限度降低与长期皮质类固醇暴露相关的风险，同时优化接受ravulizumab治疗的gMG患者的结局。海报会议I和II

abstracts.title: Toward Clinically Meaningful Longitudinal Data in Myasthenia Gravis: A Co-developed, Diagnosis-confirmed Registry Model
abstracts.authors: Renee Willmon; Minjee Park; Jared Adams; Jennifer Lannon; Gary Cutter; Neelam Goyal; Srikanth Muppidi; Richard Nowak
abstracts.affiliations: Toronto, Canada; Basel, Switzerland; Walnut Creek, CA; Miami, FL; Birmingham, AL; Palo Alto, CA; New Haven, CT
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Rapid expansion of targeted therapies for myasthenia gravis (MG) has increased the need for longitudinal real-world data reflecting treatment utilization, clinical outcomes, and patient experience. Patient registries are often limited by unconfirmed diagnoses, infrequent data capture, high attrition, and incomplete characterization of disease burden. The absence of ICD-9/10 codes to distinguish ocular MG further constrains many datasets. OBJECTIVE: To describe the methodology and early implementation of a prospective patient-reported MG registry. METHODS: The AXIS MG registry is a U.S.-based 10- year longitudinal study conducted by the Autoimmune Neurology Alliance and Alira Health. It is the first of multiple planned registries covering autoimmune neurology conditions. The design enables linkage with clinician-reported data and administrative claims data, and is overseen by scientific and patient governance committees. RESULTS: Adults with MG may self-enroll with required diagnosis verification. Participants are recruited through diverse channels. Participation involves monthly digital questionnaires incorporating validated measures (MG- ADL, MG-QOL-15r) capturing symptom variability, treatment exposure, and quality of life. To promote retention and data completeness, participants will receive stipends. Optional open-ended modules, co-developed with the patient committee and advocacy partners, capture patient-prioritized outcomes and contextual factors influencing treatment selection and disease management. Registry launch and feasibility metrics will be assessed through enrollment rates, geographic distribution, diagnosis verification, completion rates, and retention. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: This scalable framework enables diagnosis-confirmed longitudinal MG data generation in an evolving therapeutic landscape, informing research and care standards that industry and academic investigators are invited to access for retrospective and prospective research. An enrollment update and descriptive analyses will be presented. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）靶向治疗的快速扩展增加了对反映治疗使用、临床结局和患者体验的纵向真实世界数据的需求。患者登记研究常受限于诊断未确认、数据采集频率低、失访率高以及疾病负担特征描述不完整。缺乏可区分眼肌型MG的ICD-9/10编码进一步限制了许多数据集。目的：描述一项前瞻性患者报告MG登记研究的方法学和早期实施情况。方法：AXIS MG登记研究是一项由Autoimmune Neurology Alliance和Alira Health开展的美国10年纵向研究。它是计划中覆盖自身免疫性神经疾病的一系列登记研究中的首个。该设计可与临床医生报告数据和行政索赔数据链接，并由科学和患者治理委员会监督。结果：成人MG患者可自行入组，但需进行诊断验证。参与者通过多种渠道招募。参与内容包括每月数字问卷，纳入经过验证的量表（MG-ADL、MG-QOL-15r），捕捉症状变异性、治疗暴露和生活质量。为提高保留率和数据完整性，参与者将获得津贴。可选开放式模块由患者委员会和倡导伙伴共同开发，捕捉患者优先关注的结局以及影响治疗选择和疾病管理的背景因素。登记研究启动和可行性指标将通过入组率、地理分布、诊断验证、完成率和保留率进行评估。总结/结论：这一可扩展框架可在不断演变的治疗格局中生成诊断确认的纵向MG数据，为研究和照护标准提供信息，并邀请行业和学术研究者访问以进行回顾性和前瞻性研究。将展示入组更新和描述性分析。海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: Upstream versus Downstream Complement Blockade: Potential Mechanistic Advantages of AC1S Targeting in Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Tuan Vu; Marianna Lalla; Yang Zhao; Linda Rehaume; Jennifer Cross; Shahar Shelly
abstracts.affiliations: Lutz, FL; London, United Kingdom; New York, NY; Haifa, Israel
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), pathogenic antibodies activate the classical complement pathway, culminating in membrane attack complex (MAC)-mediated injury at the neuromuscular junction (NMJ). Levels of complement components (C3) have been associated with disease severity in animal models. C5 inhibitors block MAC formation and improve clinical outcomes, without reducing the upstream inflammatory fragments (C3a, C3b), which potentially drive NMJ injury and amplify immune responses in addition to MAC formation. OBJECTIVE: We determined whether active C1s (aC1s) inhibition by claseprubart (DNTH103) suppresses generation of C3a, C3b, and MAC in comparison with the C5 inhibitor ravulizumab. METHODS: MAC formation was quantified using the Wieslab Complement Classical Pathway assay in 1% normal human serum (NHS). C3a in supernatants was measured by ELISA and C3b deposition on sensitized human red blood cells in 5% NHS was assessed by flow cytometry. For each assay, we tested dilution series of claseprubart, ravulizumab, and an isotype control. RESULTS: In head-to-head assays, claseprubart and ravulizumab produced comparable inhibition of MAC formation, confirming similar downstream blockade. Only upstream aC1s inhibition with claseprubart resulted in near-complete reduction of C3a and C3b levels, while ravulizumab did not. Findings were reproduced across three independent experiments, supporting a mechanistic upstream (aC1s)-downstream (C5) inhibition distinction. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Upstream aC1s inhibition with claseprubart prevented MAC formation and reduced C3a and C3b levels, demonstrating broader inflammatory control beyond C5 blockade. Thus upstream inhibition may provide both pathological and immunological advantages. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）中，致病抗体激活经典补体途径，最终导致神经肌肉接头（NMJ）处膜攻击复合物（MAC）介导的损伤。在动物模型中，补体成分（C3）水平与疾病严重程度相关。C5抑制剂阻断MAC形成并改善临床结局，但不减少上游炎症片段（C3a、C3b），这些片段除MAC形成外还可能驱动NMJ损伤并放大免疫反应。目的：我们确定claseprubart（DNTH103）对活性C1s（aC1s）的抑制与C5抑制剂ravulizumab相比，是否抑制C3a、C3b和MAC的生成。方法：在1%正常人血清（NHS）中使用Wieslab补体经典途径试验定量MAC形成。通过ELISA测定上清液中的C3a，并通过流式细胞术评估5% NHS中致敏人红细胞上的C3b沉积。对于每种试验，我们测试了claseprubart、ravulizumab和同型对照的稀释系列。结果：在头对头试验中，claseprubart和ravulizumab对MAC形成产生 comparable 抑制，确认了下游阻断相似。只有claseprubart对上游aC1s的抑制导致C3a和C3b水平接近完全降低，而ravulizumab则没有。结果在三次独立实验中重现，支持上游（aC1s）-下游（C5）抑制的机制区别。总结/结论：claseprubart对上游aC1s的抑制阻止了MAC形成并降低了C3a和C3b水平，证明其超越C5阻断的更广泛炎症控制。因此，上游抑制可能提供病理学和免疫学双重优势。海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: YTB323 in Treatment-resistant Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Sentinel Cohort Findings of an Ongoing Phase 1/2 Study
abstracts.authors: Rachana Gandhi Mehta; James F. Howard; Jr.; Alexander Gill; Ajay Kilaru; Martin Stangel; Joann Whittle; Jean-Baptiste Noury
abstracts.affiliations: Winston-Salem, NC; Chapel Hill, NC; Cambridge, MA; Basel, Switzerland; Brest, France
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Despite advances in treatment, some patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) continue to experience inadequate disease control. YTB323 is an autologous, CD19-directed CAR T-cell therapy that has shown a positive benefit-risk profile in other autoimmune conditions. OBJECTIVE: To report baseline demographics, clinical characteristics, safety and early clinical outcome data from the sentinel cohort of an ongoing Phase 1/2 study of YTB323 in patients with treatment-resistant gMG (NCT06704269). METHODS: This open-label study consists of a sentinel cohort of three participants and an expansion cohort of twelve participants. After washout of immunosuppressive therapy and prophylactic IVIG, a single dose of YTB323 was administered post-lymphodepletion; safety events and clinical outcomes were monitored over time. RESULTS: The sentinel cohort consisted of two females and one male (age range 32–62 years) with acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive (AChR+) gMG (MGFA class IIIa–IVa). At data cutoff, the last completed study visit for each participant was Day 120, Day 56, and Day 28, respectively. All three participants achieved peripheral B- cell aplasia and developed transient neutropenia and lymphopenia. All three experienced Grade 1 cytokine release syndrome, which resolved with a single dose of tocilizumab in two participants and without intervention in the other. There were no reports of immune effector cell- associated neurotoxicity syndrome, infection after lymphodepletion, clinically significant hypogammaglobulinemia, or gMG exacerbation or crisis. Early clinical outcome data will be provided in the presentation. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: No unexpected safety signals were reported, and no study stopping rules were met in this sentinel cohort analysis, supporting continued enrollment and evaluation in the ongoing expansion cohort. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：尽管治疗已有进展，部分全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者仍存在疾病控制不佳。YTB323是一种自体、靶向CD19的CAR T细胞疗法，已在其他自身免疫性疾病中显示出良好的获益-风险特征。目的：报告正在进行的YTB323治疗难治性gMG患者的1/2期研究（NCT06704269）哨兵队列的基线人口学、临床特征、安全性和早期临床结局数据。方法：这项开放标签研究包括一个由3名受试者组成的哨兵队列和一个由12名受试者组成的扩展队列。在洗脱免疫抑制治疗和预防性IVIG后，于淋巴细胞清除后给予单剂YTB323；随时间监测安全性事件和临床结局。结果：哨兵队列由2名女性和1名男性组成（年龄范围32–62岁），均为乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性（AChR+）gMG（MGFA分级IIIa–IVa）。截至数据截止时，每名受试者最后完成的研究访视分别为第120天、第56天和第28天。所有3名受试者均达到外周B细胞再生障碍，并出现一过性中性粒细胞减少和淋巴细胞减少。所有3名受试者均发生1级细胞因子释放综合征，其中2名受试者经单剂托珠单抗治疗后缓解，另1名未干预即缓解。未报告免疫效应细胞相关神经毒性综合征、淋巴细胞清除后感染、有临床意义的低丙种球蛋白血症或gMG加重或危象。早期临床结局数据将在报告中提供。总结/结论：该哨兵队列分析未报告非预期安全性信号，未达到研究停止规则，支持在正在进行的扩展队列中继续入组和评估。海报会议I和II

abstracts.title: Anti-Titin antibodies and thymoma in myasthenia gravis: A 10-year age-adjusted portuguese cohort study
abstracts.authors: M. Almeida1; I. Carvalho1; A. Geraldo1; R. Cunha2; L. Negrão1; A. Matos1; L. Almendra1
abstracts.affiliations: 1Neuromuscular and Neurophysiology Unit, Department of Neurology – Unidade Local de Saúde de Coimbra, Coimbra, Portugal; 2Clinical Pathology Laboratory – Unidade Local de Saúde de Coimbra, Coimbra, Portugal
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Anti-titin antibodies are detected in approximately one-third of patients with myasthenia gravis (MG) and are considered a sensitive biomarker for thymoma in patients aged ≤50 years. However, their high prevalence in late- onset MG reduces specificity, limiting their clinical utility in older patients. We aimed to assess the predictive value of anti- titin antibodies for thymoma in a Portuguese MG cohort. Methods: We conducted a retrospective study of all patients newly diagnosed with MG between January 1, 2015, and August 1, 2025. Anti-titin antibody status was assessed by immunoblot- ting, and thymoma was evaluated using chest CT, PET-CT, or histopathology. Associations between anti-titin positivity, age, and thymoma were analyzed. Results: Among 114 MG patients (mean age 66.6 years), 34 had thymoma and 81 were anti-titin–positive. In patients <50 years, anti-titin positivity showed a non-significant trend toward asso- ciation with thymoma (OR 4.44, p = 0.181). In patients ≥50 years, anti-titin positivity was not predictive of thymoma (OR 0.44, p = 0.171) and was inversely associated with thymoma in those aged 50–75 years (OR 0.23, p = 0.042). Age significantly modified the predictive value of anti-titin antibodies (p = 0.039). Anti-titin positivity was markedly more frequent in older non-thymoma patients (≥50: 81.2% vs <50: 27.3%, p<0.001), while sensitivity among thymoma patients was similar across age groups. Conclusion: In MG patients over 50 years, anti-titin antibod- ies show reduced specificity for thymoma due to high positiv- ity among non-thymoma cases. In patients aged 50–75 years, anti-titin positivity may favor the absence of thymoma. These findings highlight the age-dependent limitations of anti-titin an- tibodies in thymoma prediction.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景和目的：抗肌联蛋白抗体在大约三分之一的MG患者中可检测到，被认为是年龄≤50岁患者胸腺瘤的敏感生物标志物。然而，它们在晚发型MG中的高患病率降低了特异性，限制了其在老年患者中的临床效用。我们旨在评估葡萄牙MG队列中抗肌联蛋白抗体对胸腺瘤的预测价值。方法：我们对2015年1月1日至2025年8月1日期间所有新诊断为MG的患者进行了回顾性研究。通过免疫印迹法评估抗肌联蛋白抗体状态，并使用胸部CT、PET-CT或组织病理学评估胸腺瘤。分析了抗肌联蛋白阳性、年龄和胸腺瘤之间的关联。结果：在114名MG患者（平均年龄66.6岁）中，34名患有胸腺瘤，81名抗肌联蛋白阳性。在<50岁的患者中，抗肌联蛋白阳性与胸腺瘤的关联呈非显著性趋势（OR 4.44，p = 0.181）。在≥50岁的患者中，抗肌联蛋白阳性不能预测胸腺瘤（OR 0.44，p = 0.171），并且在50-75岁的患者中与胸腺瘤呈负相关（OR 0.23，p = 0.042）。年龄显著改变了抗肌联蛋白抗体的预测价值（p = 0.039）。抗肌联蛋白阳性在年龄较大的非胸腺瘤患者中显著更常见（≥50岁：81.2% vs <50岁：27.3%，p<0.001），而在胸腺瘤患者中，各年龄组的敏感性相似。结论：在50岁以上的MG患者中，由于非胸腺瘤病例中阳性率高，抗肌联蛋白抗体对胸腺瘤的特异性降低。在50-75岁的患者中，抗肌联蛋白阳性可能提示无胸腺瘤。这些发现强调了抗肌联蛋白抗体在胸腺瘤预测中的年龄依赖性局限性。

abstracts.title: Autoimmune comorbidities affect thymoma-associated Myasthenia Gravis outcome
abstracts.authors: F. Habetswallner; S. Falso; S. Marini; M. Marini; E. Aulitto; C. Bressi; M. Larossi; A. Evoli; R. Iorio Catholic University of the Sacred Heart, Rome, Italy
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Thymoma-associated Myasthenia Gravis (TAMG) represents a clinical entity with poorer progno- sis when compared to other MG subtypes. Outcome predictors are lacking. We conducted a retrospective study to identify clini- cal variables associated with favorable MG outcome as minimal manifestation or better according to MGFA post-intervention status (MGFA-PIS). Methods: We retrieved information from clinical records of consecutive TAMG patients seen at our Institution between January 2005 and May 2025. Outcome predictors as patient de- mographics, MG severity (at onset and at maximum severity) and related treatment, pathologic variables, thymoma stage (ac- cording to Masaoka classification) and histotypes (according to WHO classification were assessed by univariate and multivari- ate analyses performed in R 4.3.1 Software Version.A favorable outcome was defined as achieving MM-or-better. Results: A total of 118 patients [59 (50%) females, median age (IQR, years)= 63 (54–78)] with acetylcholine receptor antibody positive MG (AChR-MG), and histologically confirmed thy- moma were included. The outcome was assessed by MGFA-PIS at the last follow-up. Fourteen cases were excluded either due to missing data or to follow-up period < 1 year. abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：胸腺瘤相关重症肌无力（TAMG）与其他MG亚型相比预后较差，目前缺乏预后预测因素。我们进行了一项回顾性研究，以确定与良好MG结局（根据MGFA干预后状态（MGFA-PIS）定义为达到最小表现或更好）相关的临床变量。方法：我们检索了2005年1月至2025年5月期间在我院连续就诊的TAMG患者的临床记录。通过R 4.3.1软件版本进行单变量和多变量分析，评估了患者人口统计学、MG严重程度（发病时和最大严重程度时）及相关治疗、病理变量、胸腺瘤分期（根据Masaoka分类）和组织学类型（根据WHO分类）等结局预测因素。良好结局定义为达到MM或更好。结果：共纳入118例患者[59例（50%）女性，中位年龄（IQR，岁）= 63（54–78）]，均为乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性MG（AChR-MG）且经组织学证实为胸腺瘤。通过末次随访时的MGFA-PIS评估结局。14例因数据缺失或随访时间<1年被排除。单变量逻辑回归显示，存在与胸腺瘤相关或无关、且在患者病史中任何时间发生的自身免疫合并症（AIC），与达到“MM或更好”的可能性显著降低相关，OR 0.25（95% CI，0.08–0.72；p = 0.006）。有和没有AIC的患者在随访持续时间上没有显著差异。结论：AIC可影响TAMG患者的临床结局，在治疗决策中应予以仔细考虑。

abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Thymoma-associated Myasthenia Gravis (TAMG) represents a challenging clinical phenotype. While anti-complement therapy (C5IT) and neonatal-Fc- receptor inhibitors (aFcRn) have expanded the therapeutic landscape, comparative data regarding their efficacy in TAMG are lacking. This study evaluated the comparative efficacy and corticosteroid (CS)-sparing potential of C5IT versus aFcRn in TAMG patients. Methods: We conducted a retrospective study of 93 AChR- positive TAMG patients (58 C5IT maintenance; 35 aFcRn cycles) across eight Italian centers. The primary endopoint included longitudinal changes in MG-ADL, QMG, daily CS dosage over 12 months (Table 1). LMM was performed to assess treatment- by-time interactions. aFcRn patients were stratified into “short responders” (mean cycles-intervals < 8 weeks) and “long- responders” (mean cycles-intervals > = 8 weeks). Results: Baseline demographics and disease severity were comparable between cohorts. While both groups exhibited clin- ical improvement, LMM analysis demonstrated a significant treatment-by-time interaction favouring C5IT for MG-ADL (F = 8.48, p = 0.004) and daily CS reduction (F = 6.284, p = 0.013). C5IT achieved greater mean reductions in MG-ADL (−6.43 vs. −3.21) and daily CS dosage (−10.8 mg vs. −6.6 mg) compared to aFcRn. Subgroup analysis revealed that aFcRn “short respond- ers” (43% of the cohort) had significantly inferior outcomes com- pared to both C5IT and aFcRn “long responders”. Conclusion: In TAMG patients, chronic C5IT maintenance regimen provides a greater overall clinical improvement and daily corticosteroids compared to aFcRn cycle-based treatment schedule in TAMG patients. aFcRn patients requiring frequent cycling (< 8 weeks) had suboptimal responses, whereas those with sustained durability mirrored C5IT efficacy. These found- ing highlight the necessity of predictive factors to identify po- tential “short responders” and optimize personalized treatment selection and administration schedules.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：胸腺瘤相关重症肌无力（TAMG）是一种具有挑战性的临床表型。虽然抗补体治疗（C5IT）和新生儿Fc受体抑制剂（aFcRn）扩展了治疗选择，但缺乏它们在TAMG中疗效的比较数据。本研究评估了C5IT与aFcRn在TAMG患者中的比较疗效和皮质类固醇（CS）节省潜力。方法：我们在意大利八个中心进行了一项回顾性研究，纳入93例AChR阳性TAMG患者（58例接受C5IT维持治疗；35例接受aFcRn周期治疗）。主要终点包括12个月内MG-ADL、QMG、每日CS剂量的纵向变化（表1）。采用线性混合模型（LMM）评估治疗与时间的交互作用。aFcRn患者被分为“短应答者”（平均周期间隔<8周）和“长应答者”（平均周期间隔>=8周）。结果：两组基线人口统计学和疾病严重程度相当。虽然两组均表现出临床改善，但LMM分析显示，在MG-ADL（F = 8.48，p = 0.004）和每日CS减少（F = 6.284，p = 0.013）方面，存在显著的治疗与时间交互作用，有利于C5IT。与aFcRn相比，C5IT在MG-ADL（-6.43 vs. -3.21）和每日CS剂量（-10.8 mg vs. -6.6 mg）方面实现了更大的平均降低。亚组分析显示，aFcRn“短应答者”（占队列的43%）的结局显著劣于C5IT和aFcRn“长应答者”。结论：在TAMG患者中，与基于aFcRn周期治疗方案相比，慢性C5IT维持方案提供了更大的总体临床改善和每日皮质类固醇节省。需要频繁周期治疗（<8周）的aFcRn患者反应欠佳，而具有持续持久性的患者疗效与C5IT相当。这些发现强调了需要预测因素来识别潜在的“短应答者”，并优化个体化治疗选择和给药方案。

abstracts.authors: J. Howard Jr1; S. Anderson2; B. Canales2; J. Park2; G. Gibson3; H. Connolly3; S. Birija3; B. Poirrette3; A. Foster3; A. Bhambri2
abstracts.affiliations: 1Department of Neurology, The University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill, North Carolina; 2Amgen Inc. Thousand Oaks, USA; 3Adelphi Real World, Bollington, UK
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Generalised myasthenia gravis (gMG) is a neuromuscular condition manifesting as fluctuating muscle weaknesses and fatigue. Treatments include corticosteroids and targeted biologic treatments. This study describes corticosteroid and biologic use in a multi-country sample of gMG patients. Methods: Data were drawn from the Adelphi MG Disease Specific Programme (DSP)™, a cross-sectional survey of neurol- ogists and their patients with gMG in the France, Germany, Italy, Spain, UK and United States, from January 2024 - November 2025. Physicians provided patient-level demographics, clinical characteristics and treatment. Results: Overall, 146 neurologists reported on 917 gMG pa- tients, patient demographics are shown by country in TABLE 1 Physicians reported a mean (Standard Deviation; SD) Myasthenia Gravis - Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) score of 4.5 (3.3) and 59.8% of patients were in Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America class II. At time of survey, 88.3% of pa- tients were prescribed a gMG treatment. Of those, 40.4% were prescribed corticosteroids, most commonly prednisone (35.6%). Patients had been prescribed their current regimen of corticoste- roids for a mean (SD) 1.8 (2.8) years and 43.1% were prescribed a dosage ≥20 mg. Among patients on treatment, 37.2% were pre- scribed biologics. Patients had been prescribed their current bio- logic treatment regimen, for a mean (SD) 1.1 (1.2) years at survey and the biologic was administered a mean (SD) 2.3 (4.1) times per month. Conclusion: Corticosteroid and biologic therapies were fre- quently prescribed in the six countries included in this analy- sis. Reducing steroid burden and frequent administrations of biologic therapies whilst maintaining efficacy could benefit this population.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种神经肌肉疾病，表现为波动性肌无力和疲劳。治疗包括皮质类固醇和靶向生物制剂。本研究描述了多国gMG患者样本中皮质类固醇和生物制剂的使用情况。方法：数据来自Adelphi MG疾病特定项目（DSP）™，这是一项于2024年1月至2025年11月在法国、德国、意大利、西班牙、英国和美国进行的神经科医生及其gMG患者的横断面调查。医生提供了患者水平的人口统计学、临床特征和治疗信息。结果：总体而言，146名神经科医生报告了917例gMG患者，按国家划分的患者人口统计学见表1。医生报告的平均（标准差；SD）重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）评分为4.5（3.3），59.8%的患者处于重症肌无力基金会美国II级。在调查时，88.3%的患者接受了gMG治疗。其中，40.4%的患者使用了皮质类固醇，最常见的是泼尼松（35.6%）。患者使用当前皮质类固醇方案的平均（SD）时间为1.8（2.8）年，43.1%的患者剂量≥20 mg。在接受治疗的患者中，37.2%使用了生物制剂。患者使用当前生物治疗方案的平均（SD）时间为1.1（1.2）年，生物制剂平均（SD）每月给药2.3（4.1）次。结论：在本分析涵盖的六个国家中，皮质类固醇和生物制剂疗法被频繁处方。在维持疗效的同时减少类固醇负担和生物制剂的频繁给药可能使该人群受益。

abstracts.title: Do we really need non-steroidal immunosuppressants in generalized myasthenia gravis treated with new targeted therapies? A pilot study
abstracts.authors: V. Vera1; E. Rossini1; L. Leonardi2; G. Antonini1; S. Morino2; M. Garibaldi1; A. Lauletta1; F. Forcina1; L. Tufano1; D. Marando1; L. Fionda2
abstracts.affiliations: 1Department of Neuroscience, Mental Health and Sensory Organs (NESMOS), SAPIENZA University of Rome, Rome, Italy; 2Neuromuscular and Rare Diseases Centre, Neurology Unit, Sant’Andrea Hospital, Rome, Italy
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Targeted biologic therapies, including complement and neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn) inhibitors, have transformed the treatment of generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). However, the role of concomitant non-steroidal immu- nosuppressants (NSIST) remains uncertain. This study evalu- ated whether background NSIST influences clinical outcomes and corticosteroid reduction in gMG patients treated with tar- geted therapies. Methods: We conducted a retrospective, observational study including adult gMG patients treated with complement in- hibitors or anti-FcRn agents (n = 41). Clinical outcomes were assessed at baseline and during follow-up using Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) and Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) scales. Achievement of Minimal Symptom Expression (MSE), MG Foundation of America Post- Intervention Status (MGFA-PIS), and changes in corticosteroid dose were analyzed. Results: Twenty patients received background NSIST (Group 1), while 21 did not (Group 2). Baseline MG-ADL scores and cor- ticosteroid doses were comparable between groups (9.10 ± 4.36 vs 8.24 ± 3.38) (22.17 ± 13.81 mg vs 22.06 ± 16.43). Baseline QMG scores were slightly higher in Group 1 (14.0 ± 5.1 vs 10.9 ± 4.8; p = 0.049). Both groups showed significant improvement in MG-ADL and QMG scores at all follow-up time points, without differences in clinical scale improvement comparing the two groups. Rates of MSE achievement, MGFA-PIS improvement, and corticosteroid tapering did not differ between groups. Conclusion: Our pilot analysis indicates that concomitant use of NSIST does not appear to be associated with greater improve- ment in clinical outcomes, enhance corticosteroid-sparing ef- fects or increased disease stability. Larger, prospective studies are needed to optimize treatment strategies in gMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：靶向生物疗法，包括补体和新生儿Fc受体（FcRn）抑制剂，已改变了全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的治疗。然而，伴随使用的非甾体免疫抑制剂（NSIST）的作用仍不确定。本研究评估了在接受靶向治疗的gMG患者中，背景NSIST是否影响临床结局和皮质类固醇减量。方法：我们进行了一项回顾性观察性研究，纳入接受补体抑制剂或抗FcRn药物治疗的成人gMG患者（n = 41）。在基线和随访期间使用重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）和定量重症肌无力（QMG）量表评估临床结局。分析了达到最小症状表达（MSE）、MG基金会美国干预后状态（MGFA-PIS）以及皮质类固醇剂量的变化。结果：20例患者接受了背景NSIST（第1组），21例未接受（第2组）。两组基线MG-ADL评分和皮质类固醇剂量相当（9.10 ± 4.36 vs 8.24 ± 3.38）（22.17 ± 13.81 mg vs 22.06 ± 16.43）。第1组的基线QMG评分略高（14.0 ± 5.1 vs 10.9 ± 4.8；p = 0.049）。两组在所有随访时间点的MG-ADL和QMG评分均有显著改善，两组间临床量表改善无差异。两组在MSE达标率、MGFA-PIS改善和皮质类固醇减量方面无差异。结论：我们的初步分析表明，伴随使用NSIST似乎与临床结局的更大改善、增强皮质类固醇节省效应或增加疾病稳定性无关。需要更大规模的前瞻性研究来优化gMG的治疗策略。

abstracts.title: Healthcare costs of generalized myasthenia gravis in Germany: A real-world retrospective cohort study
abstracts.authors: C. Schneider-Gold1; S. Anderson2; I. Bucholz2; V. Višković3; A. Marzà-Florensa4; M. Ludwig3; A. Postema4; A. Bhambri2
abstracts.affiliations: 1Department of Neurology, St. Josef-Hospital, Bochum, Germany; 2Amgen Inc, Thousand Oaks, USA; 3InGef - Institute for Applied Health Research Berlin GmbH, Berlin, Germany; 4PHARMO Institute for Drug Outcomes Research, Utrecht, The Netherlands
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is a chronic autoimmune neuromuscular disorder character- ized by muscle weakness and fatigue affecting daily activities. This study describes patient characteristics and healthcare costs among patients with gMG in Germany. Methods: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using anonymized secondary healthcare claims data from the InGef database from 2017 to 2024. Patients aged ≥18 years with ≥1 in- patient or ≥2 outpatient diagnoses and ≥12 months of continu- ous enrollment before and after the index date were included. Follow-up was variable length with a minimum of 12 months. Annualized healthcare costs per patient per year (PPPY) were calculated across outpatient, inpatient, emergency department, and pharmacy services. Results: A total of 4,025 patients with gMG were identified (mean age 61.2 years, standard deviation 16.7 years; 49.3 per- cent female). Median total healthcare costs were 6,115.06 euros (interquartile range 2,942.54 to 13,011.55 euros) PPPY, with gMG-related costs of 1,279.06 euros (interquartile range 346.74 to 3,238.00 euros). Costs were higher among patients with ≥1 exacerbation (N = 2,144; median total costs 7,757.87 euros PPPY; median gMG-related costs 2,262.18 euros PPPY) and among patients with ≥1 myasthenic crisis (N = 93; median total costs 34,605.52 euros PPPY; median gMG-related costs 14,928.98 euros PPPY). Conclusion: This real-world study demonstrates the substan- tial economic burden of gMG in Germany. Higher costs among patients with exacerbations and myasthenic crises emphasize the impact of disease severity and the need for improved disease management.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种慢性自身免疫性神经肌肉疾病，其特征为影响日常活动的肌无力和疲劳。本研究描述了德国gMG患者的患者特征和医疗费用。方法：我们利用InGef数据库2017年至2024年的匿名二级医疗索赔数据，进行了一项回顾性队列研究。纳入标准为年龄≥18岁、有≥1次住院或≥2次门诊诊断、且在指数日期前后均有≥12个月连续参保的患者。随访时间可变，最短为12个月。计算了门诊、住院、急诊和药房服务的每位患者每年（PPPY）的年化医疗费用。结果：共识别出4,025名gMG患者（平均年龄61.2岁，标准差16.7岁；49.3%为女性）。中位总医疗费用为6,115.06欧元（四分位距2,942.54至13,011.55欧元）PPPY，其中gMG相关费用为1,279.06欧元（四分位距346.74至3,238.00欧元）。在至少有一次加重（N=2,144；中位总费用7,757.87欧元PPPY；中位gMG相关费用2,262.18欧元PPPY）和至少有一次肌无力危象（N=93；中位总费用34,605.52欧元PPPY；中位gMG相关费用14,928.98欧元PPPY）的患者中，费用更高。结论：这项真实世界研究显示了德国gMG的巨大经济负担。加重和肌无力危象患者的更高费用强调了疾病严重程度的影响以及改善疾病管理的必要性。

abstracts.conferenceFullName: 12th Congress of the European Academy of Neurology - Abstract Book
abstracts.title: Immediate FcRn inhibitor initiation following fast-acting treatment in generalised myasthenia gravis: A single-centre retrospective cohort study
abstracts.authors: K. Yanagisawa; T. Ishii; T. Saito; M. Zenko; T. Aoki; A. Sugie; H. Myojin; T. Saito; Y. Kondo; K. Sato; T. Uchiyama Department of Neurology, Seirei Hamamatsu General Hospital, Shizuoka, Japan
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Early initiation of fast-acting treat- ment (FT; intravenous immunoglobulin, plasma exchange, or intravenous methylprednisolone) improves long-term outcomes in patients with generalised myasthenia gravis (gMG). However, the optimal approach to achieve durable disease control after FT remains unclear. We hypothesised that the timely initiation of an FcRn inhibitor (FcRn-i) as a "consolidation therapy" follow- ing FT may promote sustained benefit, particularly in patients with shorter disease duration. Methods: This retrospective single-centre cohort study in- cluded adults with gMG treated with FcRn-i between January 2022 and September 2025. Immediate initiation was defined as FcRn-i administration within 60 days after the last FT and dis- ease duration ≤2 years; all others were classified as deferred. The primary outcome was the time to treatment escalation to addi- tional FT or C5 inhibitor therapy. Group differences were anal- ysed using Kaplan–Meier curves with log-rank tests and Firth's penalised Cox models adjusted for age and MGFA classification. Results: Thirty-eight patients were included (immediate, n = 8; deferred, n = 30). Median follow-up was 355 days (IQR 190–572). Treatment escalation occurred in 0/8 immediate patients and 15/30 deferred patients. Kaplan–Meier analysis showed a signif- icant difference (log-rank p = 0.02). In Firth's Cox model, imme- diate initiation was associated with a markedly lower hazard of treatment escalation (HR 0.09, 95% CI 0.001–0.70). Conclusion: Immediate post-FT initiation of FcRn-i was associ- ated with a reduced hazard of treatment escalation to additional FT or C5 inhibitor therapy. This consolidation-type strategy may support more stable disease control in patients early in the dis- ease course and will be further evaluated in larger cohorts.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者中，早期启动快速起效治疗（FT；静脉注射免疫球蛋白、血浆置换或静脉注射甲泼尼龙）可改善长期结局。然而，FT后实现持久疾病控制的最佳方法仍不明确。我们假设，在FT后及时启动FcRn抑制剂（FcRn-i）作为“巩固治疗”可能促进持续获益，尤其是在病程较短的患者中。方法：这项回顾性单中心队列研究纳入了2022年1月至2025年9月期间接受FcRn-i治疗的成人gMG患者。立即启动定义为在最后一次FT后60天内给予FcRn-i且病程≤2年；其余患者归类为延迟启动。主要结局是至需要额外FT或C5抑制剂治疗的治疗升级时间。使用Kaplan-Meier曲线（log-rank检验）和经年龄及MGFA分级校正的Firth惩罚Cox模型分析组间差异。结果：共纳入38名患者（立即启动，n=8；延迟启动，n=30）。中位随访时间为355天（IQR 190–572）。立即启动组0/8名患者和延迟启动组15/30名患者发生了治疗升级。Kaplan-Meier分析显示显著差异（log-rank p=0.02）。在Firth Cox模型中，立即启动与显著更低的治疗升级风险相关（HR 0.09，95% CI 0.001–0.70）。结论：FT后立即启动FcRn-i与降低额外FT或C5抑制剂治疗升级的风险相关。这种巩固型策略可能有助于在疾病早期病程中实现更稳定的疾病控制，并将在更大规模队列中进一步评估。

abstracts.title: Making the invisible audible: A real-world connected speech study in myasthenia gravis
abstracts.authors: A. Zanghì; P. Di Filippo; C. Rutigliano; C. Avolio; E. D'Amico University of Foggia, Italy
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Bulbar involvement in myasthenia gravis (MG) impairs voice and speech, yet subtle changes may be overlooked. Methods: We conducted a cross-sectional study of consecu- tively enrolled adults with confirmed MG at a single center. Participants completed standardized voice recordings and contemporaneous clinical assessments (Myasthenia Gravis– Activities of Daily Living [MG-ADL] and revised Myasthenia Gravis Quality of Life [rMG-QOL15]). Tasks included sus- tained vowels, standardized reading, and spontaneous speech. Acoustic metrics comprised root-mean-square intensity (RMS, dB) and fundamental frequency (F0, Hz). Results: Seventeen patients were enrolled (median age 58 years; 52.9% female). Median MG-ADL was 6.0 and mean rMG-QOL15 was 16.6, with no significant correlation (? = 0.09, p = 0.74). Male participants exhibited significant intensity reductions in con- nected speech: reading (-3.22 dB, IQR -5.98 to -2.09; pBH = 0.031; r = 0.84) and spontaneous speech (-5.46 dB, IQR -6.11 to -4.93; pBH = 0.031; r = 0.84). Female participants showed smaller, non- significant changes ( = -2.2 dB; all pBH > 0.7). F0 shifts were modest and non-significant after correction. Across the cohort, MG-ADL correlated with both RMS and F0 drops in unadjusted models but not after adjusting for sex. rMG-QOL15 showed no overall association, although females demonstrated a correla- tion between F0 drop and QOL burden (r = 0.77, p = 0.014). Conclusion: Connected-speech intensity decrements, partic- ularly in males, represent a robust acoustic marker of bulbar involvement in MG not captured by patient-reported outcomes.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：重症肌无力（MG）的延髓受累会损害声音和言语，但细微变化可能被忽视。方法：我们对单中心连续入组的经确诊的成人MG患者进行了一项横断面研究。参与者完成了标准化语音记录和同期临床评估（重症肌无力-日常生活活动量表[MG-ADL]和修订版重症肌无力生活质量量表[rMG-QOL15]）。任务包括持续元音、标准化阅读和自发言语。声学指标包括均方根强度（RMS，dB）和基频（F0，Hz）。结果：共入组17名患者（中位年龄58岁；52.9%为女性）。中位MG-ADL为6.0，平均rMG-QOL15为16.6，两者无显著相关性（?=0.09，p=0.74）。男性参与者在连贯言语中表现出显著的强度降低：阅读（-3.22 dB，IQR -5.98至-2.09；pBH=0.031；r=0.84）和自发言语（-5.46 dB，IQR -6.11至-4.93；pBH=0.031；r=0.84）。女性参与者表现出较小且无显著性的变化（=-2.2 dB；所有pBH>0.7）。校正后F0变化较小且无显著性。在整个队列中，MG-ADL在未校正模型中与RMS和F0下降相关，但在校正性别后则无此关联。rMG-QOL15未显示总体关联，但女性表现出F0下降与生活质量负担之间的相关性（r=0.77，p=0.014）。结论：连贯言语的强度衰减，尤其是在男性中，是MG延髓受累的一个稳健的声学标志，而患者报告结局未能捕捉到这一点。

abstracts.affiliations: 1Centre de Référence Des Maladies Neuromusculaires AOC, CHRU de Brest, Brest, France; 2Département d'information médicale, CHU de Lille, Lille, France; 3Epimentis (PELyon), Lyon, France; 4J&J Innovative Medicine, Issy-les-Moulineaux, France; 5Département de Neurologie, APHP, CHU Henri Mondor, Créteil, France
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Acute events drive the short-term burden in myasthenia gravis (MG). This study evaluated the one-year risk of MG crises (MGc) and exacerbations (MGe) after diagnosis of MG and its generalized form (gMG), and character- ized the nature of these acute episodes. Methods: This French health claims database (SNDS) study included patients diagnosed with MG or gMG in 2022 using algorithms based on ICD-10 codes and treatment dispensing, including first- and second-line maintenance therapies and cri- sis treatments (IVIg or plasma exchange). MGc were defined as hospitalization with respiratory failure, intubation, mechanical ventilation, or enteral feeding. MGe included MGc, acute IVIg/ plasma exchange, or MG hospitalization. Analyses reported patients with ≥ 1 event within one year, incidence rates per 100 patient-years (100PY) [95% CI], and event components. Results: There were 1,197 patients with MG diagnosed in 2022 (50.7% males, age: 62.4 ± 18.0), and 859 patients with gMG. MGc occurred in 76 MG (6.3%) and 89 gMG (10.4%) patients. MGe affected 685 MG (57.2%) and 619 gMG (72.1%) patients. In MG, the incidence rates were 6.8/100PY [5.4;8.5] for MGc and 117.7/100PY [109.2;126.8] for MGe, while they were11.7/100PY [9.5;14.5] and 236.3/100PY [218.4;255.6], respectively in gMG. Of MG patients with MGc, 81.6% had mechanical ventilation, 46.1% intubation, and 44.7% respiratory failure. Conclusion: MGe are frequent in the first year following the di- agnosis, particularly in gMG patients. MGc is a life-threatening acute event whose incidence is not negligible in the first year. These results highlight the importance of early prevention and prompt therapeutic intervention in gMG patients.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：急性事件驱动着重症肌无力（MG）的短期负担。本研究评估了MG及其全身型（gMG）诊断后一年内MG危象（MGc）和加重（MGe）的风险，并描述了这些急性发作的特征。方法：这项法国健康索赔数据库（SNDS）研究纳入了2022年根据基于ICD-10代码和药物配发（包括一线和二线维持治疗及危机治疗[IVIg或血浆置换]）的算法诊断为MG或gMG的患者。MGc定义为因呼吸衰竭、插管、机械通气或肠内营养住院。MGe包括MGc、急性IVIg/血浆置换或MG住院。分析报告了在一年内发生≥1次事件的患者、每100患者年（100PY）的发病率[95% CI]以及事件组成部分。结果：2022年有1,197名患者诊断为MG（50.7%为男性，年龄：62.4±18.0岁），859名患者诊断为gMG。76名MG患者（6.3%）和89名gMG患者（10.4%）发生MGc。685名MG患者（57.2%）和619名gMG患者（72.1%）发生MGe。在MG患者中，MGc的发病率为6.8/100PY [5.4;8.5]，MGe的发病率为117.7/100PY [109.2;126.8]；而在gMG患者中，分别为11.7/100PY [9.5;14.5]和236.3/100PY [218.4;255.6]。在发生MGc的MG患者中，81.6%接受了机械通气，46.1%接受了插管，44.7%出现呼吸衰竭。结论：MGe在诊断后的第一年内很常见，尤其是在gMG患者中。MGc是一种危及生命的急性事件，其在第一年的发生率不可忽视。这些结果强调了在gMG患者中进行早期预防和及时治疗干预的重要性。

abstracts.title: Progression and exacerbation timing in myasthenia gravis: Real-world evidence from France (RELIEF study)
abstracts.authors: T. Gendre1; D. Theis2; E. Guyot3; M. Nolin3; M. Belhassen3; I. Rodriguez4; J. Meijer4; L. Gautier4; J. Dupin4; J. Noury5
abstracts.affiliations: 1Département de Neurologie, APHP, CHU Henri Mondor, Créteil, France; 2Département d'information médicale, CHU de Lille, Lille, France; 3Epimentis (PELyon), Lyon, France; 4J&J Innovative Medicine, Issy-les-Moulineaux, France; 5Centre de Référence Des Maladies Neuromusculaires AOC, CHRU de Brest, Brest, France
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Understanding the timing of pro- gression and acute events in myasthenia gravis (MG) is critical for optimizing care. This study aimed to estimate the time-to- progression from MG to its generalized (gMG) and refractory forms, and to assess the time-to-first exacerbation or crisis. Methods: Adults with incident MG between 2014 and 2022 were identified in the French health claims database (SNDS) using algorithms based on ICD-10 codes and treatment patterns, including first- and second-line maintenance therapies and crisis treatments (IV immunoglobulins or plasma exchange). Patients were classified as MG, gMG, or refractory gMG accord- ingly. Exacerbations were defined as first acute immunoglobu- lin/plasma exchange, hospitalization for MG or MG crisis; crises included hospitalization with respiratory failure, intubation, ventilation, or enteral feeding. Kaplan-Meier analyses estimated progression and first exacerbation/crisis event timing. Results: Among 10,284 MG patients (49.3% males, mean age: 61.3 ± 18.2) the probability of gMG diagnosis was 49.0% within 12 months and 60.9% within 60 months (MST: 413 days [369; 459]) (see Figure 1). Of 6,905 gMG patients, the probability of re- fractory disease was 19.8% at 12 months and 34.1% at 60 months (see Figure 2). In MG patients, probability of exacerbation was 55.1% [54.1; 56.1] at 12 months and 63.5% [62.5;64.5] at 60 months (probability of crisis: 6.1% [5.6;6.6] and 10.0% [9.4;10.7], respectively). Conclusion: These real-world findings demonstrate rapid progression to gMG in majority of patients, with a significant proportion of these developing refractory disease. Most also ex- perience exacerbation (including crisis) within one year of di- agnosis, underscoring the need for early and sustained disease control.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：了解重症肌无力（MG）进展和急性事件的时间对于优化治疗至关重要。本研究旨在估计从MG进展为其全身型（gMG）和难治型的时间，并评估首次加重或危象的时间。方法：使用基于ICD-10代码和治疗模式的算法，在法国健康索赔数据库（SNDS）中识别2014年至2022年间新发MG的成人患者，包括一线和二线维持治疗以及危象治疗（IV免疫球蛋白或血浆置换）。患者相应地被分类为MG、gMG或难治性gMG。加重定义为首次急性免疫球蛋白/血浆置换、因MG住院或MG危象；危象包括因呼吸衰竭、插管、通气或肠内喂养住院。Kaplan-Meier分析估计了进展和首次加重/危象事件的时间。结果：在10,284名MG患者中（49.3%为男性，平均年龄：61.3 ± 18.2岁），12个月内诊断为gMG的概率为49.0%，60个月内为60.9%（中位生存时间：413天[369; 459]）（见图1）。在6,905名gMG患者中，12个月内出现难治性疾病的概率为19.8%，60个月内为34.1%（见图2）。在MG患者中，12个月内加重的概率为55.1% [54.1; 56.1]，60个月内为63.5% [62.5; 64.5]（危象概率：分别为6.1% [5.6; 6.6] 和10.0% [9.4; 10.7]）。结论：这些真实世界发现表明，大多数患者迅速进展为gMG，其中相当一部分发展为难治性疾病。大多数患者在诊断后一年内也经历了加重（包括危象），这强调了早期和持续疾病控制的必要性。

abstracts.title: Risk of myasthenia gravis exacerbation during pregnancy and postpartum: A nationwide cohort study
abstracts.authors: L. O´Connor1; K. Gabrysch2; A. Wikström3; A. Rostedt Punga1
abstracts.affiliations: 1Department of Medical Sciences, Clinical Neurophysiology, Uppsala University, Uppsala, Sweden; 2Uppsala Clinical Research Center, Uppsala University, Uppsala, Sweden; 3Department of Women´s and Children's Health, Uppsala University, Uppsala, Sweden
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Pregnancy and postpartum represent unique physiological states that may influence autoimmune dis- eases such as myasthenia gravis (MG). Evidence on MG exacer- bations during these periods is scarce and often based on small case series. We aimed to assess the risk of MG exacerbation during pregnancy and up to one year postpartum using nation- wide longitudinal register data. Methods: We conducted a population-based cohort study in- cluding women with MG and their pregnancies in Sweden FIGURE 2 Biological brain age is highest in MS patients compared to controls in model using brain parenchymal fractions and DVR (A) com- pared to models using PFs alone (B) or BraineageR (C). Mean absolute error displayed. between 1987 and 2019. Data were obtained through linkage of the Swedish MG Register with national health and sociode- mographic registers. The primary outcome was hospital admis- sions for MG during pregnancy and up to one year postpartum, compared with the year preceding pregnancy. Cox regression models estimated hazard ratios (HR), adjusting for disease du- ration and thymectomy. Secondary outcomes included changes in immunosuppressive MG medications and whether women conceived during periods of relative disease stability. Results: Our findings indicate that pregnancy is generally asso- ciated with clinical stability, whereas the postpartum period may carry an increased risk of exacerbation in a subset of women. Patterns of immunosuppressive therapy appear to reflect these trends. These results provide population-level evidence on MG risk dynamics surrounding pregnancy. Conclusion: This nationwide cohort study offers novel insights into MG risk dynamics during pregnancy and postpartum. These insights will inform clinical counselling and manage- ment strategies for women with MG planning pregnancy.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：妊娠和产后代表了可能影响自身免疫性疾病（如重症肌无力（MG））的特殊生理状态。关于这些时期MG加重的证据很少，且通常基于小型病例系列。我们旨在利用全国范围的纵向登记数据，评估妊娠期间及产后一年内MG加重的风险。方法：我们进行了一项基于人群的队列研究，纳入了1987年至2019年间瑞典患有MG的女性及其妊娠。数据通过将瑞典MG登记册与国家健康和社会人口登记册关联获得。主要结局是妊娠期间及产后一年内因MG住院，与妊娠前一年进行比较。Cox回归模型估计了风险比（HR），并调整了病程和胸腺切除术。次要结局包括免疫抑制MG药物的变化以及女性是否在疾病相对稳定期受孕。结果：我们的研究结果表明，妊娠通常与临床稳定性相关，而产后时期可能在一部分女性中增加加重风险。免疫抑制治疗的模式似乎反映了这些趋势。这些结果提供了关于妊娠前后MG风险动态的人群水平证据。结论：这项全国性队列研究为妊娠和产后期间MG的风险动态提供了新的见解。这些见解将为计划妊娠的MG女性的临床咨询和管理策略提供信息。

abstracts.title: Significant correlations between ME&MGTM digital biomarkers and equivalent MG-ADL and MG-QoL15r sub-items scores
abstracts.authors: C. Barnett-Tapia1; S. Lehnerer2; S. Bieuvelet3; L. Carment3; C. Gorin3; N. Pesic-Heuvrard3; D. Ravindra3; N. Sellami3; B. Dutta4; B. Yungher4; S. Zinaï3; J. Howard Jr5
abstracts.affiliations: 1Ellen and Martin Prosserman Centre for Neuromuscular Diseases, Division of Neurology, Department of Medicine, University Health Network, University of Toronto, Toronto, Ontario, Canada; 2Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin, corporate member of Freie Universität Berlin and Humboldt- Universität zu Berlin, Department of Neurology with Experimental Neurology, Charitéplatz 1; 10117 Berlin, Germany; 3Ad Scientiam, Paris, France; 4Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease, Boston, USA; 5University of North Carolina, Department of Neurology, Chapel Hill, USA
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Symptoms of generalized Myasthenia Gravis (gMG) are routinely captured via patient-reported out- comes (PROs) questionnaires. MG-ADL and MG-QoL15r assess daily activities and quality of life; high scores indicate higher se- verity and worse quality of life. Digital biomarkers (dBMKs) pro- vide objective measures for remote symptoms’ self-assessment through smartphone-based active tests. ME&MGTM evaluates five gMG symptoms: ptosis, dysarthria, breathing, upper and lower limb weakness mirrored in 5 MG-ADL and 3 MG-QOL15r items. In the decentralized ME&MGopen study (NCT05566964), patients performed ME&MGTM tests for one year. Here, we de- scribe the correlation between dBMKs and corresponding MG- ADL and MG-QoL15r sub-items. Methods: Completed ME&MGTM tests were reviewed for quality: inaccurate dBMKs values and agreement with human measurements. The relationship between dBMKs and sub-items was determined using mixed models analyses. We expected neg- ative associations with MyBreathing, MyEyelids, Mylegs and MyArms and positive correlations with MyVoice. Results: 156 participants completed digital tests and question- naires monthly (Figure 1). A total of 9106 evaluations were col- lected, of which 90.4% were of good quality. DBMKs scores for ptosis, breathing, and limb weakness decreased with increas- ing PRO assessed symptom severity and scores for dysarthria decreased with severity (Figure 2). Ptosis, dysarthria and limb weakness scores showed significant associations (all p < 0.019) with aforementioned sub-items of the MG-ADL and MG-QoL- 15r questionnaires. Conclusion: Significant associations between clinical ME&MGTM dBMKs and clinical assessments support their potential use in clinical settings to track gMG manifestations. These findings highlight the importance of the ongoing DOMYA validation study (NCT05564936).

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景与目的：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的症状通常通过患者报告结局（PRO）问卷来捕获。MG-ADL和MG-QoL15r评估日常活动和生活质量；高分表示更严重的病情和更差的生活质量。数字生物标志物（dBMKs）通过基于智能手机的主动测试提供远程症状自我评估的客观测量。ME&MGTM评估五种gMG症状：上睑下垂、构音障碍、呼吸、上肢和下肢无力，这些症状反映在5个MG-ADL和3个MG-QOL15r项目中。在去中心化的ME&MGopen研究（NCT05566964）中，患者进行了为期一年的ME&MGTM测试。在此，我们描述了dBMKs与相应MG-ADL和MG-QoL15r子项目之间的相关性。方法：对完成的ME&MGTM测试进行质量审查：不准确的dBMKs值以及与人工测量的一致性。使用混合模型分析确定dBMKs与子项目之间的关系。我们预期MyBreathing、MyEyelids、Mylegs和MyArms呈负相关，而MyVoice呈正相关。结果：156名参与者每月完成数字测试和问卷（图1）。共收集了9106次评估，其中90.4%质量良好。上睑下垂、呼吸和肢体无力的dBMKs评分随着PRO评估的症状严重程度增加而降低，构音障碍的评分也随着严重程度增加而降低（图2）。上睑下垂、构音障碍和肢体无力的评分与上述MG-ADL和MG-QoL15r问卷的子项目显示出显著关联（所有p < 0.019）。结论：临床ME&MGTM dBMKs与临床评估之间的显著关联支持其在临床环境中追踪gMG表现的潜在用途。这些发现强调了正在进行的DOMYA验证研究（NCT05564936）的重要性。

abstracts.title: A Patient with Seronegative Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Transitioned to Ravulizumab: A Case Report
abstracts.authors: Sonia Caraballo
abstracts.affiliations: Schaumburg, IL
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Patients with seronegative generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) have limited treatment options, with ravulizumab currently approved only for anti- acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibody–positive gMG. OBJECTIVE: Describe a case report of a patient with seronegative gMG demonstrating a clinically meaningful benefit with ravulizumab. METHODS: Relevant medical history, symptom expression, and treatment history were evaluated for a patient with seronegative gMG treated with ravulizumab for 5 months. RESULTS: A 72-year-old, male patient presented with seronegative gMG (Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living [MG-ADL] score, 9) and a history of hypertension, type 1 diabetes, hyperlipidemia, aortic stenosis, hypothyroidism, cataract, obstructive sleep apnea, and Parkinson’s disease. Initial symptoms included intermittent ptosis of the left eyelid, voice changes, intermittent left- sided weakness, and right lower extremity weakness accompanied by tremors. The patient reported difficulty engaging in physical activity and exacerbation of symptoms following exertion. He was evaluated multiple times since initial presentation using a variety of assays, and he received initial treatment with prednisone, mycophenolate mofetil, intravenous immunoglobulin, and rozanolixizumab with partial symptom improvement. The patient was transitioned to ravulizumab and experienced marked clinical improvement (MG-ADL, 0) 7 days following initial infusion, reporting minimal symptom expression and well-controlled disease without limitations, including regular physical activity. At a follow-up appointment 2 months following ravulizumab initiation, the patient reported that a delay in ravulizumab infusion led to increased fatigue and ptosis, which resolved following ravulizumab treatment. The patient also tapered his corticosteroid use during this time. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: A patient with seronegative gMG achieved a clinically meaningful improvement in symptoms with ravulizumab treatment.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：血清阴性全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者治疗选择有限，而ravulizumab目前仅获批用于抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体阳性gMG。目的：描述一例血清阴性gMG患者在接受ravulizumab治疗后显示出有临床意义获益的病例报告。方法：评估一例接受ravulizumab治疗5个月的血清阴性gMG患者的相关病史、症状表现和治疗史。结果：一名72岁男性患者，表现为血清阴性gMG（重症肌无力日常生活活动量表[MG-ADL]评分9分），既往有高血压、1型糖尿病、高脂血症、主动脉瓣狭窄、甲状腺功能减退、白内障、阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停和帕金森病病史。初始症状包括左眼睑间歇性上睑下垂、声音改变、间歇性左侧无力和右下肢无力伴震颤。患者诉难以进行体力活动，且用力后症状加重。自初次就诊以来，他使用多种检测方法接受了多次评估，并接受了泼尼松、吗替麦考酚酯、静脉注射免疫球蛋白和rozanolixizumab的初始治疗，症状部分改善。患者转换为ravulizumab治疗，在首次输注后7天出现显著临床改善（MG-ADL评分0分），报告症状表达极少、疾病控制良好且无受限，包括可进行规律体力活动。在ravulizumab开始后2个月的随访中，患者报告ravulizumab输注延迟导致疲劳和上睑下垂加重，经ravulizumab治疗后缓解。患者在此期间还逐渐减少了糖皮质激素用量。总结/结论：一例血清阴性gMG患者在接受ravulizumab治疗后获得有临床意义的症状改善。

abstracts.conferenceFullName: 2026 MGFA Scientific Session (held within the AANEM Annual Meeting)
abstracts.title: Age-related Differences in Persistence with Standard-of-care Treatment for Generalized Myasthenia Gravis in the United States
abstracts.authors: Jacqueline Pesa; Maryia Zhdanava; Louis Jackson; Porpong Boonmak; Anabelle Tardif- Samson; Gokce Gokkoca; Dominic Pilon
abstracts.affiliations: Superior, CO; Montreal, Canada; North Wales, PA; Paris, France
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Age-related differences in treatment persistence in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) remain poorly understood. OBJECTIVE: To assess treatment persistence on standard-of-care treatments among children, adolescents, and young adults, compared with adults with gMG in the United States. METHODS: Patients initiating standard-of-care treatment (index date; acetylcholinesterase inhibitor, systemic corticosteroid, non-steroidal immunosuppressant) following the first neurologist-confirmed gMG diagnosis were selected from Komodo Research Database (01/2017–05/2025). Patients were stratified by age at index (children: 2–11; adolescents: 12–17; young adults: 18–29; adults: ≥30 years). Baseline characteristics were assessed during the 12-month pre-index period. Persistence on standard-of-care treatment was defined as no gap of ≥60 days in supply and described using the Kaplan-Meier method. Comparisons by age group versus adults were conducted using a multivariable Cox model in which the age group was included as a time-varying covariate, adjusting for demographics, comorbidities, and key baseline gMG-related characteristics and treatments. Patients who did not discontinue treatment were censored at end of eligibility/data. RESULTS: 145 children (60% female), 159 adolescents (63% female), 531 young adults (72% female), and 13,122 adults (48% female) were included. Persistence rates were 40.6%, 37.1%, 36.0%, and 46.0% at 24 months in each age group, respectively. Compared with adults, persistence was 12% lower among young adults (hazard ratio: 0.88; p=0.038), and not significantly different among children or adolescents. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Persistence was found to be low among all age groups but lowest in young adults, indicating a need for more efficacious treatments and improved management strategies in these populations.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）中治疗持续性的年龄相关差异仍知之甚少。目的：评估美国儿童、青少年和年轻成人gMG患者与成人相比在标准治疗中的治疗持续性。方法：从Komodo Research Database（2017年1月至2025年5月）中选取首次神经科医生确诊gMG诊断后开始标准治疗（索引日期；乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂、全身性糖皮质激素、非甾体类免疫抑制剂）的患者。患者按索引时年龄分层（儿童：2–11岁；青少年：12–17岁；年轻成人：18–29岁；成人：≥30岁）。在索引前12个月期间评估基线特征。标准治疗持续性定义为供应中断不足≥60天，采用Kaplan-Meier法描述。按年龄组与成人进行比较，使用多变量Cox模型，其中年龄组作为时变协变量纳入，并校正人口学、合并症及关键基线gMG相关特征和治疗。未停止治疗的患者在资格/数据结束时删失。结果：纳入145名儿童（60%女性）、159名青少年（63%女性）、531名年轻成人（72%女性）和13,122名成人（48%女性）。各年龄组24个月时的持续性率分别为40.6%、37.1%、36.0%和46.0%。与成人相比，年轻成人的持续性低12%（风险比：0.88；p=0.038），儿童或青少年无显著差异。总结/结论：所有年龄组的持续性均较低，但年轻成人最低，提示这些人群需要更有效的治疗和更好的管理策略。

abstracts.conferenceFullName: 2026 MGFA Scientific Session (held within the AANEM Annual Meeting)
abstracts.title: An Anti-acetylcholine Receptor Negative Patient with Myasthenic Crisis Responsive to Ravulizumab
abstracts.authors: Eduardo Estephan; Weverton Carlos da Silva Teixeira; Beatriz Silva; Antonio Albert Zambon; Edmar Zanoteli
abstracts.affiliations: São Paulo, Brazil
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Complement inhibition has emerged as an effective targeted therapy for acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibody–positive generalized myasthenia gravis (MG). Eligibility for these therapies is typically determined by the detection of AChR binding antibodies. However, some seronegative patients may harbor other pathogenic AChR antibodies, such as blocking or modulating antibodies, or may test positive in more sensitive assays, including cell-based or clustered AChR assays. OBJECTIVE: To illustrate the possibility of treating seronegative myasthenia gravis with complement inhibitors, including for emergency situations. METHODS: Case report of a seronegative myasthenic patient treated with ravulizumab during an impending crisis. RESULTS: We report a 44-year-old woman with refractory generalized MG initially classified as seronegative based on negative anti-AChR binding antibodies and anti-MuSK (muscle specific tyrosine kinase). Disease onset occurred in nine years ago, with progressive generalized weakness, bulbar involvement, and recurrent myasthenic crises requiring intensive care and multiple intubations. Despite treatment with pyridostigmine, prednisone, and azathioprine, she remained severely symptomatic, with marked functional impairment and frequent infection- triggered exacerbations. After nine years of disease, following a severe deterioration associated with infection and prolonged ventilatory support, with inadequate response to plasma exchange, she received ravulizumab. Approximately 10 days after first infusion, she demonstrated marked clinical improvement—including recovery of head control, improved bulbar function, and the ability to sit and ambulate short distances—corroborated by a substantial reduction in MG- ADL score from 20 to 11, being subsequently discharged from the ICU. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Reliance solely on AChR binding antibodies by radioimmunoassay for therapeutic eligibility may exclude patients who could benefit from complement inhibitors.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：补体抑制已成为乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体阳性全身型重症肌无力（MG）的有效靶向治疗。这些治疗的资格通常由AChR结合抗体检测决定。然而，一些血清阴性患者可能携带其他致病性AChR抗体，如阻断性或调节性抗体，或在更敏感的检测中呈阳性，包括基于细胞的或聚集AChR检测。目的：说明用补体抑制剂治疗血清阴性重症肌无力的可能性，包括在紧急情况下。方法：一例血清阴性重症肌无力患者在即将发生危象期间接受ravulizumab治疗的病例报告。结果：我们报告一名44岁女性难治性全身型MG患者，最初基于抗AChR结合抗体和抗MuSK（肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶）抗体阴性被归类为血清阴性。疾病发生于9年前，表现为进行性全身无力、延髓受累和反复肌无力危象，需重症监护和多次插管。尽管接受吡啶斯的明、泼尼松和硫唑嘌呤治疗，她仍有严重症状，功能损害明显，并频繁因感染触发加重。病程9年后，在一次与感染相关的严重恶化和长时间通气支持、血浆置换反应不足后，她接受了ravulizumab。首次输注后约10天，她表现出显著临床改善——包括头部控制恢复、延髓功能改善以及能够坐起和短距离行走——并得到MG-ADL评分从20分大幅降至11分的印证，随后从ICU出院。总结/结论：仅依赖放射免疫法检测AChR结合抗体来确定治疗资格，可能会排除可能从补体抑制剂获益的患者。

abstracts.title: Analysis of Associations between Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) Total Scores and Myasthenic Exacerbations and Crises Risk Using a US Open Claims Database and Chart Notes
abstracts.authors: Arjun Seth; Karen Yee; Justin Lee; Jeffrey Yu; Nicholas Streicher
abstracts.affiliations: Chicago, IL; Boston, MA; Washington, DC
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) exacerbations/crises impose substantial disease burden; therefore, improving risk prediction methods for these events could meaningfully improve patient outcomes. Evaluating MG-ADL score as a potential prognostic marker for MG exacerbations/crises warrants additional study. OBJECTIVE: To quantify associations between MG-ADL total score and risk of exacerbations/crises in adult patients with MG. METHODS: In this retrospective study, NorstellaLinQ claims data (1/1/2021-9/30/2025) were used to identify adults with ≥2 MG claims filed by a nonophthalmologist specialist ≥30 days apart and continuous quarterly activity 6 months before and 12 months after the index date. The index date was the first MG-ADL total score recorded. Outcomes included number and incidence rate ratios (IRR) of exacerbations and crises during follow-up. IRRs were calculated by negative binomial regression, which included MG-ADL score, age at diagnosis, and sex. RESULTS: Overall, 868 patients (with exacerbations/crises, n=118; without exacerbations/crises, n=750) were included. Mean(SD) age at diagnosis was 63.0(16.4) years. Baseline MG-ADL scores were significantly higher in patients with exacerbations/crises during follow-up vs those without (mean[SD]=7.2[4.6] vs 5.1[4.3]; P<0.001). A 1-point increase in baseline MG-ADL total score raised the risk of exacerbations by 11% (IRR [95% CI]=1.11[1.06-1.16]; P<0.001) and crises by 9% (1.09[1.02-1.17]; P=0.009). Removing age as a predictor from the models did not appreciably alter the MG-ADL effect estimates (IRR ~1.09-1.11). Baseline predicted event rates were 0.10 for exacerbations and 0.04 for crises. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Higher MG-ADL scores were associated with higher risk of exacerbations and crises across 12 months, suggesting MG-ADL may have clinical utility as a risk predictor for these serious events.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）病情加重/危象带来沉重的疾病负担；因此，改进这些事件的风险预测方法可能显著改善患者结局。评估MG-ADL评分作为MG加重/危象潜在预后标志物值得进一步研究。目的：量化成人MG患者MG-ADL总分与加重/危象风险之间的关联。方法：在这项回顾性研究中，使用NorstellaLinQ理赔数据（2021年1月1日至2025年9月30日）识别成人患者，要求其有≥2次由非眼科专科医生提交的MG理赔且间隔≥30天，并在索引日期前6个月和索引日期后12个月具有连续季度活动。索引日期为首次记录的MG-ADL总分。结局包括随访期间加重和危象的数量及发生率比（IRR）。IRR通过负二项回归计算，模型包括MG-ADL评分、诊断时年龄和性别。结果：共纳入868例患者（伴加重/危象，n=118；不伴加重/危象，n=750）。诊断时平均（SD）年龄为63.0（16.4）岁。随访期间发生加重/危象的患者基线MG-ADL评分显著高于未发生者（平均[SD]=7.2[4.6] vs 5.1[4.3]；P<0.001）。基线MG-ADL总分每增加1分，加重风险升高11%（IRR [95% CI]=1.11[1.06-1.16]；P<0.001），危象风险升高9%（1.09[1.02-1.17]；P=0.009）。从模型中移除年龄作为预测因素并未明显改变MG-ADL效应估计值（IRR约1.09-1.11）。基线预测事件率：加重为0.10，危象为0.04。总结/结论：较高的MG-ADL评分与12个月内较高的加重和危象风险相关，提示MG-ADL可能具有作为这些严重事件风险预测指标的临床效用。

abstracts.title: Assessing Diagnostic Sensitivity of Repetitive Nerve Stimulation of Hypoglossal versus Facial Nerve in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Hebatallah Rashed
abstracts.affiliations: Cairo, Egypt
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: The diagnostic yield of hypoglossal nerve stimulation with tongue muscle recording in MG patients with bulbar symptoms was previously demonstrated. Later, investigators showed the good sensitivity of hypoglossal nerve stimulation (the active electrode on the submental region and the reference electrode on the chin), but facial nerve stimulation was superior. OBJECTIVE: To assess the diagnostic sensitivity of hypoglossal RNS (from the submental complex with the active electrode on the submental region and the reference electrode contralaterally) vs facial RNS in adults with generalized MG (gMG). METHODS: A prospective study of 13 adults with gMG. RNS at 3 Hz of 13 facial and hypoglossal nerves was performed at rest. Baseline amplitudes of compound muscle action potential (CMAP), and the change in amplitude and area between the first and fifth responses (decrement) were recorded. Abnormal RNS was a decrement in the CMAP and/or area of ≥10%. RESULTS: Ten patients had controlled gMG and 3 had refractory gMG. Only one patient had bulbar symptoms. Baseline mean amplitudes of hypoglossal nerves were significantly higher than those of facial nerves. No statistically significant difference between mean amplitude decrement in hypoglossal nerves and facial nerves. Interestingly, patients with controlled gMG did not have abnormal amplitude or area decrement in facial nerves; however, 5 controlled patients had abnormal area decrement in hypoglossal nerves. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Baseline hypoglossal RNS with surface electrodes over the submental complex was more sensitive baseline facial RNS in mild gMG with or without bulbar symptoms. A larger cohort is needed to validate these findings.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：此前已证实对伴有延髓症状的MG患者行舌下神经刺激并记录舌肌的诊断价值。随后，研究者显示舌下神经刺激（活动电极置于颏下区域、参考电极置于颏部）具有良好的敏感性，但面神经刺激更优。目的：评估成人全身型MG（gMG）中舌下神经RNS（记录颏下复合肌肉动作电位，活动电极置于颏下区域、参考电极置于对侧）与面神经RNS的诊断敏感性。方法：一项纳入13例成人gMG患者的前瞻性研究。在静息状态下对13条面神经和舌下神经行3 Hz RNS。记录复合肌肉动作电位（CMAP）基线波幅，以及第1次与第5次反应之间波幅和面积的变化（递减）。异常RNS定义为CMAP和/或面积递减≥10%。结果：10例患者为控制良好的gMG，3例为难治性gMG。仅1例患者有延髓症状。舌下神经基线平均波幅显著高于面神经。舌下神经与面神经的平均波幅递减差异无统计学意义。值得注意的是，控制良好的gMG患者面神经未见异常的波幅或面积递减；然而，5例控制良好的患者舌下神经出现异常面积递减。总结/结论：在伴或不伴延髓症状的轻度gMG中，采用颏下复合肌肉表面电极的基线舌下神经RNS比基线面神经RNS更敏感。需要更大样本队列验证这些发现。

abstracts.title: Assessment of the Quality of Life of Patients with Myasthenia Gravis in the Neurology Department of the National University Hospital Center of Fann (Chnu of Fann)
abstracts.authors: Serigne Abdou Aziz Fall; Ndiaga Matar Gaye; Ka Mamadou; Adjaratou Dieynabou Sow; Moustapha Ndiaye
abstracts.affiliations: Dakar, Senegal
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis is a rare autoimmune neuromuscular disorder associated with significant functional disability and socio-professional impact. OBJECTIVE: To assess health-related quality of life in patients with myasthenia gravis by analyzing sociodemographic characteristics, disease severity using the Garches scale, MG-ADL, and MG-QOL15-F scores. METHODS: We conducted a 18-month cross-sectional descriptive study including patients followed for myasthenia gravis. RESULTS: A total of 37 patients were included. The median age was 32.7 years, and generalized myasthenia was predominant (86.5%). The median delay between symptom onset and diagnosis was 11 months. The initial median Garches score was 44/100, improving to 85/100 under treatment. Quality of life assessment showed a moderate impairment, with a mean MG-ADL score of 3.7/24 and a mean MG-QOL15-F score of 12.7/60. A strong positive correlation was found between MG-ADL and MG-QOL15-F scores (r = 0.82; p < 0.0001). Disease severity was significantly associated with quality of life impairment. Certain specific impairments, such as speech and swallowing disorders as well as diplopia, had a major impact on patients’ daily lives. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In our setting, health-related quality of life in myasthenia gravis patients remains insufficiently documented. These findings highlight the importance of early diagnosis and comprehensive management to improve functional outcomes and quality of life.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力是一种罕见的自身免疫性神经肌肉疾病，伴有显著的功能残疾和社会职业影响。目的：通过分析社会人口学特征、使用Garches量表、MG-ADL和MG-QOL15-F评分评估疾病严重程度，评估重症肌无力患者的健康相关生活质量。方法：我们开展了一项为期18个月的横断面描述性研究，纳入接受重症肌无力随访的患者。结果：共纳入37例患者。中位年龄为32.7岁，以全身型肌无力为主（86.5%）。症状发作至诊断的中位延迟为11个月。初始Garches评分中位数为44/100，治疗后改善至85/100。生活质量评估显示中度受损，MG-ADL平均评分为3.7/24，MG-QOL15-F平均评分为12.7/60。MG-ADL与MG-QOL15-F评分呈强正相关（r=0.82；p<0.0001）。疾病严重程度与生活质量受损显著相关。某些特定损害，如言语和吞咽障碍以及复视，对患者日常生活有重大影响。总结/结论：在我们所处的环境中，重症肌无力患者的健康相关生活质量仍缺乏充分记录。这些发现强调了早期诊断和综合管理以改善功能结局和生活质量的重要性。

abstracts.title: Clinical Outcomes, Healthcare Resource Utilization, and Costs before and after Immunoglobulin Initiation in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Jacqueline Pesa; Maryia Zhdanava; Louis Jackson; Porpong Boonmak; Anabelle Tardif- Samson; Fanny Jiang; Dominic Pilon
abstracts.affiliations: Superior, CO; Montreal, Canada; North Wales, PA; Toronto, Canada
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Immunoglobulin is used as rescue therapy in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). Its real- world impact on clinical outcomes, healthcare resource utilization (HRU), and costs is not well characterized. OBJECTIVE: To compare gMG exacerbations and crises, HRU, and costs before and after immunoglobulin initiation for gMG in the United States. METHODS: Adults initiating immunoglobulin (index date) after the first neurologist-confirmed gMG diagnosis were identified from Komodo Research Database (01/2017- 05/2025). Exacerbations, crises, HRU, and costs were described during the 12-month pre- and post-index periods and compared using paired generalized estimating equations. RESULTS: 1,718 patients were included (mean age: 60.5 years; 50.8% female; 13.0% used immunoglobulin before the first neurologist-confirmed gMG diagnosis). In the post- versus pre-index period, number of immunoglobulin claims increased 8.5-fold (means: 12.1 vs 1.4) and prevalence of chronic use increased 8.3-fold (71.5% vs 8.7%; both p<0.01). Despite this, prevalence of exacerbations increased by 13% overall (67.4% vs 59.5%) and by 28% in emergency department (ED) setting (16.4% vs 12.9%; both p<0.01), while prevalence of exacerbations in inpatient setting (29.5% vs 30.8%) and crises (3.1% vs 3.8%) remained similar. The number of gMG-related inpatient admissions increased by 14% (means: 0.59 vs 0.52; p=0.01) and ED-related visits by 72% (means: 0.45 vs 0.26; p<0.01). All-cause total healthcare costs increased by $117,730 (mean: $184,047 vs $66,318; p<0.01) with immunoglobulin accounting for 64.9% of the increase. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Continued and increased use of immunoglobulin were not associated with improvements in clinical outcomes and acute gMG-related HRU, highlighting unmet need in gMG management.
