abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：免疫球蛋白在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）中用作挽救治疗。其对临床结局、医疗资源利用（HRU）和成本的现实世界影响尚未充分描述。目的：比较美国gMG患者启动免疫球蛋白前后gMG加重和危象、HRU及成本。方法：从Komodo Research Database（2017年1月至2025年5月）识别在首次神经科医生确诊gMG诊断后启动免疫球蛋白（索引日期）的成人患者。描述索引前和索引后12个月期间的加重、危象、HRU和成本，并使用配对广义估计方程进行比较。结果：共纳入1,718例患者（平均年龄60.5岁；女性50.8%；13.0%在首次神经科医生确诊gMG诊断前已使用免疫球蛋白）。与索引前相比，索引后免疫球蛋白理赔数增加8.5倍（均值：12.1 vs 1.4），慢性使用患病率增加8.3倍（71.5% vs 8.7%；均p<0.01）。尽管如此，加重总体患病率增加13%（67.4% vs 59.5%），急诊（ED）环境中增加28%（16.4% vs 12.9%；均p<0.01），而住院环境中的加重患病率（29.5% vs 30.8%）和危象（3.1% vs 3.8%）保持相似。gMG相关住院次数增加14%（均值：0.59 vs 0.52；p=0.01），ED相关就诊增加72%（均值：0.45 vs 0.26；p<0.01）。全因总医疗成本增加117,730美元（均值：184,047美元 vs 66,318美元；p<0.01），其中免疫球蛋白占增量的64.9%。总结/结论：持续和增加的免疫球蛋白使用与临床结局及gMG相关急性HRU的改善无关，凸显gMG管理中未满足的需求。

abstracts.title: Clinical, Paraclinical, Therapeutic, and Outcome Profile of Patients with Autoimmune Myasthenia Gravis Associated with Thymoma OR Thymic Hyperplasia: A Case Series of 5 Patients at the Fann University
abstracts.authors: Serigne Abdou Aziz Fall; Ndiaga Matar Gaye; Ka Mamadou; Adjaratou Dieynabou Sow; Moustapha Ndiaye
abstracts.affiliations: Dakar, Senegal
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Autoimmune myasthenia is frequently associated with thymic abnormalities that may affect disease progression. Although thymectomy remains a cornerstone of management, some patients experience favorable outcomes with medical therapy alone, underscoring the importance of our study. OBJECTIVE: To analyze the clinical, paraclinical, therapeutic, and outcome profiles of patients with autoimmune myasthenia gravis associated with thymoma or thymic hyperplasia, in order to better define their prognosis. METHODS: We conducted a longitudinal descriptive study in the Neurology Department of the National University Hospital Center of Fann over a period of two and a half years. RESULTS: Five patients were included, all of whom tested positive for anti-acetylcholine receptor antibodies (anti- AChR). Thymoma was identified in three patients, while thymic hyperplasia was found in two patients. The median age at diagnosis was 34.8 years. The sex ratio was 0.67, with two men (40%) and three women (60%).Symptomatic treatment consisted of pyridostigmine and ambenonium. Background therapy included corticosteroids, azathioprine, mycophenolate mofetil, and rituximab. Notably, none of the patients underwent thymectomy. The median follow-up duration was 30 months.During follow-up, two patients (40%) each experienced one clinical relapse. No severe complications or deaths were observed. The mean number of consultations was four per year.The mean myasthenic score was 74.16 ± 10.41 out of 100, and the mean MG-QOL-15-F quality of life score was 6.6 ± 6 out of 60. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Our findings suggest that thymectomy should not be systematically indicated in autoimmune myasthenia gravis, highlighting the importance of an individualized therapeutic approach.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：自身免疫性肌无力常与胸腺异常相关，胸腺异常可能影响疾病进展。尽管胸腺切除术仍是管理的基石，但部分患者仅接受药物治疗即可获得良好结局，这凸显了本研究的重要性。目的：分析伴胸腺瘤或胸腺增生的自身免疫性重症肌无力患者的临床、辅助检查、治疗及结局特征，以更好地界定其预后。方法：我们在Fann国家大学医院中心神经内科开展了一项为期两年半的纵向描述性研究。结果：共纳入5例患者，全部抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体（anti-AChR）阳性。3例患者发现胸腺瘤，2例发现胸腺增生。诊断时中位年龄为34.8岁。性别比为0.67，其中男性2例（40%）、女性3例（60%）。对症治疗包括吡啶斯的明和安贝氯铵。背景治疗包括皮质类固醇、硫唑嘌呤、吗替麦考酚酯和利妥昔单抗。值得注意的是，无患者接受胸腺切除术。中位随访时间为30个月。随访期间，2例患者（40%）各经历1次临床复发。未观察到严重并发症或死亡。平均每年就诊4次。平均肌无力评分为74.16 ± 10.41分（满分100分），平均MG-QOL-15-F生活质量评分为6.6 ± 6分（满分60分）。总结/结论：我们的发现提示，在自身免疫性重症肌无力中不应系统性地指示胸腺切除术，凸显了个体化治疗策略的重要性。

abstracts.title: Comparing AChR-Ab-positive and AChR-Ab-negative Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: An ADAPT-SERON-informed Analysis from the German Myasthenia Gravis Registry (Myareg) Including Antibody-defined Subtypes
abstracts.authors: Paolo Doksani; Jana Jarecki; Cécile Blein; Roland Derwand; Sihui Zhao; Judith ter Horst; Frauke Stascheit; Andreas Meisel; Sarah Hoffmann
abstracts.affiliations: Berlin, Germany; Zürich, Switzerland; Luxembourg, Luxembourg; Boston, MA; Ghent, Belgium; Amsterdam, Netherlands
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Patients with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) without detectable acetylcholine receptor antibodies (AChR-Ab-negative) are currently underrepresented in studies. This heterogeneous trial- informed group comprises triple-seronegative, MuSK-Ab- positive, and LRP4-Ab-positive. OBJECTIVE: To characterize similarities and differences in disease characteristics between AChR-Ab-positive and AChR-Ab-negative gMG in the German MyaReg registry. METHODS: This cross-sectional registry analysis included adults with gMG (MGFA class II-IV) at registry enrollment. Adult gMG patients were classified by AChR-Ab-status, following ADAPT-SERON categorization. Within the AChR-Ab-negative group, triple-seronegative, MuSK-Ab- positive, and LRP4-Ab-positive subtypes were prespecified for assessments. Disease characteristics included Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG- ADL), Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis Score (QMG), Myasthenia Gravis Quality of Life 15-item scale (MG- QoL15), and Chalder fatigue scale scores. RESULTS: We analyzed 768 AChR-Ab-positive and 292 AChR-Ab-negative patients; the latter included 159 triple- seronegative, 20 MuSK-Ab-positive, and 21 LRP4-Ab- positive patients. Compared with AChR-Ab-positive patients, triple-seronegative and AChR-Ab-negative patients were younger at onset (52.35±20.92 versus 46.79±15.71 and 45.57±16.24 years; both ps<0.001) and more frequently female (55.2%, 74.2% and 71.6%). AChR-Ab-negative patients showed higher MG-ADL, QMG, and fatigue scores than AChR-Ab-positive (MG- ADL: 6.92±3.91 versus 4.77±3.61; QMG: 8.38±5.57 versus 6.93±5.36; fatigue: 21.00±6.03 versus 18.44±6.56; all ps<0.006), with similar or more pronounced differences in the triple-seronegative subtype. Detailed results, including MuSK- and LRP4-positive subtypes, will be presented at the congress. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: AChR-Ab-negative gMG is a heterogeneous group, predominantly triple-seronegative subtype. AChR-Ab-negative and triple-seronegative patients showed higher disease severity and fatigue than AChR-Ab-positive, underscoring the need for better characterization of antibody-defined subtypes.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：无可检测乙酰胆碱受体抗体（AChR-Ab阴性）的全身型重症肌无力（gMG）患者在研究中目前代表性不足。这一异质的、由试验信息定义的群体包括三抗体血清阴性、MuSK-Ab阳性和LRP4-Ab阳性患者。目的：在德国MyaReg注册研究中描述AChR-Ab阳性与AChR-Ab阴性gMG之间疾病特征的相似性和差异。方法：这项横断面注册分析纳入注册入组时患有gMG（MGFA II-IV级）的成人。成人gMG患者按AChR-Ab状态分类，遵循ADAPT-SERON分类。在AChR-Ab阴性组内，预先指定三抗体血清阴性、MuSK-Ab阳性和LRP4-Ab阳性亚型进行评估。疾病特征包括重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）、定量重症肌无力评分（QMG）、重症肌无力生活质量15项量表（MG-QoL15）和Chalder疲劳量表评分。结果：我们分析了768例AChR-Ab阳性和292例AChR-Ab阴性患者；后者包括159例三抗体血清阴性、20例MuSK-Ab阳性和21例LRP4-Ab阳性患者。与AChR-Ab阳性患者相比，三抗体血清阴性和AChR-Ab阴性患者起病年龄更年轻（52.35±20.92岁对比46.79±15.71岁和45.57±16.24岁；两者p<0.001），且女性比例更高（55.2%、74.2%和71.6%）。AChR-Ab阴性患者的MG-ADL、QMG和疲劳评分高于AChR-Ab阳性患者（MG-ADL：6.92±3.91对比4.77±3.61；QMG：8.38±5.57对比6.93±5.36；疲劳：21.00±6.03对比18.44±6.56；所有p<0.006），三抗体血清阴性亚型的差异相似或更明显。包括MuSK阳性和LRP4阳性亚型在内的详细结果将在大会上展示。总结/结论：AChR-Ab阴性gMG是一个异质群体，以三抗体血清阴性亚型为主。AChR-Ab阴性和三抗体血清阴性患者较AChR-Ab阳性患者表现出更高的疾病严重程度和疲劳，凸显了更好地描述抗体定义亚型的必要性。

abstracts.title: Comparing Functional Outcomes between Traditional Nsist versus Targeted Molecular Therapies for Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Zayd Siddiq; Krishna Pokala
abstracts.affiliations: Richardson, TX; Austin, TX
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: The recent introduction of targeted molecular therapies have expanded our options for treatment of generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). These therapies include FcRn receptor antagonists, complement inhibitors, and B cell depleting agents. However, traditional nonsteroid immunosuppressive therapies (NSIST) such as methotrexate, mycophenolate, and azathioprine among others, are still widely used in current clinical practice. Comparative studies focusing on the functional outcomes between patients receiving these two types of therapies remain limited. OBJECTIVE: To compare clinical outcomes among AChR antibody positive MG patients treated with traditional NSIST versus the newer targeted molecular therapies by using change in Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) score. METHODS: We plan to conduct a retrospective study of adult patients with AChR antibody positive MG at our outpatient clinic over a 4 year period from January 2022 through December 2025. We will have two cohorts split into patients who received traditional NSIST and those who received newer molecular therapies. The primary outcome studied will be change in MG-ADL scores at 1, 6 and 12 months post-treatment, when available. Secondary outcomes will include average daily steroid dose reduction. RESULTS: The data is currently being analyzed and results will be presented in the full study. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: This study will provide real- world comparative effectiveness data evaluating functional outcomes between traditional NSIST and targeted molecular therapies in AChR antibody positive MG patients. The findings may help guide treatment selection and be useful in future investigations.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：近期靶向分子治疗的出现扩大了全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的治疗选择。这些治疗包括FcRn受体拮抗剂、补体抑制剂和B细胞清除剂。然而，传统非甾体免疫抑制治疗（NSIST），如甲氨蝶呤、吗替麦考酚酯和硫唑嘌呤等，在当前临床实践中仍被广泛使用。聚焦于接受这两类治疗患者功能结局的比较研究仍然有限。目的：通过重症肌无力日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）评分变化，比较接受传统NSIST与较新靶向分子治疗的AChR抗体阳性MG患者的临床结局。方法：我们计划对2022年1月至2025年12月4年期间在我院门诊就诊的AChR抗体阳性MG成人患者开展回顾性研究。我们将分为两个队列：接受传统NSIST的患者和接受较新分子治疗的患者。主要研究结局为治疗后1、6和12个月时MG-ADL评分的变化（如可获得）。次要结局将包括平均每日类固醇剂量减少。结果：数据目前正在分析中，结果将在完整研究中展示。总结/结论：本研究将提供真实世界比较有效性数据，评估传统NSIST与靶向分子治疗在AChR抗体阳性MG患者中的功能结局。这些发现可能有助于指导治疗选择，并可用于未来研究。

abstracts.title: Corticosteroid Use, Comorbidities, and Mortality among Patients with Myasthenia Gravis in the United States
abstracts.authors: Christopher Scheiner; Karen Yee; Justin Lee; Jeffrey Yu; Nicholas Streicher
abstracts.affiliations: Knoxville, TN; Boston, MA; Washington, DC
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Oral corticosteroids (OCS) are commonly used to treat myasthenia gravis (MG) but are associated with substantial systemic adverse effects. OBJECTIVES: To compare the incidence of OCS- associated comorbidities between patients with MG receiving a cumulative OCS dose of >1825mg over 1y and those who did not use OCS, and to quantify cumulative OCS exposure, utilization, and association with all-cause mortality in MG. METHODS: Retrospective analysis (Komodo Health® open/closed claims database; 1/1/2016-12/31/2023) examined patients ≥18y with ≥3 claims (≥30d apart) of MG diagnosis code ICD-10 filed via nonophthalmologic specialist, with continuous enrollment from 12mo baseline through 24mo follow-up. Outcomes included mean daily dose of OCS, OCS-related comorbidities, and all-cause mortality (0 vs >1825mg/y). RESULTS: Among 34,084 eligible patients, 9970 (29.3%) received OCS >1825mg/y and 13,324 (39.1%) received no OCS. A greater proportion of those receiving OCS >1825mg/y were males (56.7% vs 48.7%) and were slightly younger at diagnosis (mean age, 66.5y vs 67.7y) compared with the no OCS group. Patients receiving OCS >1825mg/y had an average dose starting at 26-27mg/d and tapered to ~8 mg/d by 24mo. The cumulative incidence ratios (CIR) of comorbidities were significantly higher in the OCS >1825mg/y group, including type 2 diabetes (CIR=1.54), osteoporosis/fracture (CIR=1.31), gastrointestinal disorders (CIR=1.31), and obesity (CIR=1.23). OCS >1825mg/y was associated with significantly higher all-cause mortality compared with no OCS (log-rank P<0.001), with lower survival probability at 5y (0.88 vs 0.95). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In patients with MG, those receiving OCS >1825mg/y were associated with a higher incidence of comorbidities and all-cause mortality compared with patients not treated with OCS.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：口服皮质类固醇（OCS）常用于治疗重症肌无力（MG），但与显著的全身性不良反应相关。目的：比较1年内累积OCS剂量>1825mg的MG患者与未使用OCS患者之间OCS相关合并症的发生率，并量化MG中累积OCS暴露、使用情况及其与全因死亡率的关联。方法：回顾性分析（Komodo Health®开放/封闭理赔数据库；2016年1月1日至2023年12月31日）检查了≥18岁、有≥3次（间隔≥30天）由非眼科专科医生提交的MG诊断代码ICD-10理赔记录、且从12个月基线至24个月随访期间连续入组的患者。结局包括OCS平均每日剂量、OCS相关合并症和全因死亡率（0对比>1825mg/年）。结果：在34,084例符合条件的患者中，9970例（29.3%）接受OCS>1825mg/年，13,324例（39.1%）未接受OCS。与无OCS组相比，接受OCS>1825mg/年者中男性比例更高（56.7%对比48.7%），诊断时年龄略年轻（平均年龄66.5岁对比67.7岁）。接受OCS>1825mg/年患者的平均剂量起始为26-27mg/天，至24个月时逐渐减至约8mg/天。OCS>1825mg/年组的合并症累积发生率比（CIR）显著更高，包括2型糖尿病（CIR=1.54）、骨质疏松/骨折（CIR=1.31）、胃肠道疾病（CIR=1.31）和肥胖（CIR=1.23）。与无OCS相比，OCS>1825mg/年与显著更高的全因死亡率相关（log-rank P<0.001），5年生存概率更低（0.88对比0.95）。总结/结论：在MG患者中，接受OCS>1825mg/年者与未接受OCS治疗的患者相比，合并症发生率和全因死亡率更高。

abstracts.title: Diagnostic Challenges of LRP4 Antibody Testing in Myasthenia Gravis: A Case Series of four LRP4 Positive Cases with Uncertain Diagnostic Significance
abstracts.authors: Katherine Kinnard; Ehtesham Khalid
abstracts.affiliations: Gretna, LA; Kenner, LA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia Gravis (MG) is an autoimmune neuromuscular junction disorder typically diagnosed using acetylcholine receptor (AChR) and muscle-specific kinase (MuSK) antibodies. In seronegative cases, low-density lipoprotein receptor-related protein 4 (LRP4) antibodies have emerged as a potential biomarker; however, their diagnostic reliability remains uncertain. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the clinical significance of positive LRP4 antibody results in patients with suspected MG. METHODS: We performed a retrospective case series of four patients (2016-2024) referred for suspected MG with positive LRP4 antibodies and negative AChR/MuSK serology. All patients underwent comprehensive evaluation, including neurological examination, serologic testing, and single-fiber electromyography (sfEMG). LRP4 antibodies were detected via indirect immunofluorescence assay. Descriptive analysis was performed. RESULTS: All four patients presented with symptoms suggestive of MG, including ocular, bulbar, or generalized weakness. Despite positive LRP4 antibody results, none demonstrated objective evidence of neuromuscular junction transmission failure. sfEMG findings were normal or nondiagnostic, and clinical features lacked reproducible fatigability. Alternative diagnoses were established in all cases. These findings indicate false-positive LRP4 antibody results. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In isolation, positive LRP4 antibodies lack diagnostic specificity for MG and increase the risk of misdiagnosis. This case series highlights the importance of integrating clinical, serologic, and electrophysiologic data when evaluating suspected MG. Greater standardization and validation of LRP4 assays are needed before routine clinical reliance.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）是一种自身免疫性神经肌肉接头疾病，通常通过乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）和肌肉特异性激酶（MuSK）抗体进行诊断。在血清阴性病例中，低密度脂蛋白受体相关蛋白4（LRP4）抗体已成为潜在的生物标志物；然而，其诊断可靠性仍不确定。目的：评估疑似MG患者中LRP4抗体阳性结果的临床意义。方法：我们开展了一项回顾性病例系列研究，纳入4例因疑似MG转诊、LRP4抗体阳性且AChR/MuSK血清学阴性的患者（2016-2024年）。所有患者均接受了全面评估，包括神经系统检查、血清学检测和单纤维肌电图（sfEMG）。LRP4抗体通过间接免疫荧光法检测。采用描述性分析。结果：所有4例患者均表现出提示MG的症状，包括眼肌、延髓或全身性无力。尽管LRP4抗体结果阳性，但无一例显示出神经肌肉接头传递失败的客观证据。sfEMG结果正常或无法诊断，临床特征缺乏可重复的疲劳性。所有病例均确立了替代诊断。这些发现表明LRP4抗体结果为假阳性。总结/结论：单独而言，LRP4抗体阳性缺乏对MG的诊断特异性，并增加误诊风险。本病例系列强调了在评估疑似MG时整合临床、血清学和电生理数据的重要性。在常规临床依赖LRP4检测之前，需要对其检测方法进行更大程度的标准化和验证。

abstracts.title: Durability of Response Following Retreatment with Descartes-08, an Autologous BCMA-directed Mrna CAR-T Cell Therapy, in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: 12-month Follow-up
abstracts.authors: James F. Howard; Jr.; Mamatha Pasnoor; Nizar Chahin; Hafsa Kamboh; Eva Rybak; Renee Fedak; Milos Miljkovic; Tuan Vu
abstracts.affiliations: Chapel Hill, NC; Kansas City, KS; Portland, OR; Frederick, MD; Andover, MA; Washington, DC; Lutz, FL
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapies have improved outcomes in oncology and autoimmune diseases, though relapses and incomplete responses remain. Descartes-08 is a chemotherapy-free, mRNA-based T-cell product with transient anti-BCMA CAR expression enabling repeat dosing. Prior studies demonstrated durable improvements after the initial treatment course in MG outcomes through Month 12 with a well-tolerated safety profile. We evaluate outcomes following retreatment with Descartes-08. OBJECTIVE: Explore efficacy, safety, and durability of response to retreatment with Descartes-08 in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). METHODS: Patients who received full-dose Descartes-08 as 6 once-weekly outpatient infusions in a phase 2 study and experienced recurrence of symptoms had the option of retreatment. Clinical outcomes were assessed by mean change from retreatment baseline in MG-ADL and QMG scores through Month 12. RESULTS: 6 participants were retreated and included in this analysis. 83.3% were AChR+ with a mean age of 61.7 years and baseline MG-ADL prior to retreatment of 9.2. Participants who received retreatment with Descartes-08 exhibited improvements in MG severity scores at Month 4 (mean change from baseline: MG-ADL and QMG were -5.5, and -6.3, p=0.0001 for both), maintained through Month 12 (-5.7 and -8.0, p<0.0001 for both, respectively). 33% of patients sustained minimal symptom expression from Month 4 through 12. Retreatment was well tolerated, without evidence of CRS or ICANS, hypogammaglobulinemia, or cytopenias. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Patients who experienced recurrence of MG symptoms after the initial Descartes-08 treatment course achieved deep and sustained improvements upon retreatment, with efficacy observed throughout study participation. No new safety concerns were observed.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：嵌合抗原受体（CAR）T细胞疗法已改善肿瘤和自身免疫性疾病的结局，但复发和不完全缓解仍然存在。Descartes-08是一种无化疗、基于mRNA的T细胞产品，具有瞬时抗BCMA CAR表达，可实现重复给药。既往研究显示，在初始治疗疗程后，MG结局至第12个月持续改善，且安全性特征耐受良好。我们评估了Descartes-08再治疗后的结局。目的：探索Descartes-08再治疗在全身型重症肌无力（gMG）中的疗效、安全性和缓解持久性。方法：在一项2期研究中接受完整剂量Descartes-08（6次每周一次门诊输注）并出现症状复发的患者可选择再治疗。临床结局通过再治疗基线至第12个月MG-ADL和QMG评分的平均变化进行评估。结果：6例参与者接受了再治疗并纳入本分析。83.3%为AChR+，平均年龄61.7岁，再治疗前基线MG-ADL为9.2。接受Descartes-08再治疗的参与者在第4个月表现出MG严重程度评分的改善（相对基线的平均变化：MG-ADL和QMG分别为-5.5和-6.3，两者p=0.0001），并维持至第12个月（分别为-5.7和-8.0，两者p<0.0001）。33%的患者从第4个月至第12个月持续维持轻微症状表达。再治疗耐受良好，无CRS或ICANS、低丙种球蛋白血症或血细胞减少的证据。总结/结论：在初始Descartes-08治疗疗程后出现MG症状复发的患者，再治疗后获得了深度且持续的改善，在整个研究参与期间均观察到疗效。未观察到新的安全性问题。

abstracts.title: Durable Responses with Autologous t Cell Immunotherapy Specifically Targeting Anti-MuSK Antibody-positive b Cells without Lymphodepletion Preconditioing in Patients with MuSK Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Nizar Chahin; David Richman; Mazen Dimachkie; Ali Habib; Richard T. Maziarz; Mehrdad Abedi; Joseph McGuirk; Stefan Ciurea; Jenell Volkov; Daniel Nunez; Yvonne White; Gwendolyn K. Binder; Samik Basu; Raj Tummala; David Chang
abstracts.affiliations: Portland, OR; Davis, CA; Kansas City, KS; Orange, CA; Irvine, CA; Philadelphia, PA; Philadelphia , PA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: A subtype of myasthenia gravis (MG) is caused by autoantibodies directed against muscle-specific tyrosine kinase (MuSK). Autologous MuSK chimeric autoantibody receptor (CAAR) T cells target only pathogenic B cells expressing anti-MuSK autoantibodies. OBJECTIVE: This study (NTC05451212) is evaluating MuSK-CAART in MuSK MG patients without lymphodepletion. METHODS: Eligible MuSK MG patients had positive anti- MuSK antibody, MGFA Classification I-IVa, and MG Composite score of ≥4. After a single infusion of MuSK- CAART, outcomes were assessed. RESULTS: After discontinuing immunosuppressives, 7 patients were infused with MuSK-CAART cells (A1: n=3, 5×10⁸; A2: n=4, 2.5×10⁹). All patients had previously received rituximab, IVIg or both. MuSK-CAART levels peaked 4–29 days post-infusion. Low-grade cytokine release syndrome occurred in 2 patients in A2, 1 of whom also experienced grade 4 hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, managed with glucocorticoids and tocilizumab. MG-Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) ≥2-point improvements off immunosuppressive therapies were achieved by 3-6 months in 1 subject in A1 and all 4 patients in A2, generally maintained in 3 patients up to 30 months; disease worsening occurred in 2 patients in A2 at 4 and 11 months. The 3 patients with sustained responses were in minimum symptom expression, off immunosuppressive medications and glucocorticoids, at their last visit (18-30 months). Similar improvements in Quantitative MG and corresponding reductions in anti- MuSK antibodies were observed. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In refractory patients, a single MuSK-CAART infusion targeting <5% of B cells without lymphodepletion provided durable improvements (18-30 months) for 3/7 MuSK MG patients off immunosuppressive medications and glucocorticoids. An intermediate dose may balance safety with potential long-term disease control.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）的一个亚型由针对肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶（MuSK）的自身抗体引起。自体MuSK嵌合自身抗体受体（CAAR）T细胞仅靶向表达抗MuSK自身抗体的致病性B细胞。目的：本研究（NTC05451212）正在评估MuSK-CAART在不进行淋巴细胞清除的MuSK MG患者中的应用。方法：符合条件的MuSK MG患者具有抗MuSK抗体阳性、MGFA分级I-IVa以及MG复合评分≥4。单次输注MuSK-CAART后评估结局。结果：停用免疫抑制剂后，7例患者接受了MuSK-CAART细胞输注（A1：n=3，5×10⁸；A2：n=4，2.5×10⁹）。所有患者既往均接受过利妥昔单抗、IVIg或两者。MuSK-CAART水平在输注后4-29天达峰。A2组2例患者发生低级别细胞因子释放综合征，其中1例还发生4级噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增生症，经糖皮质激素和托珠单抗处理。在停用免疫抑制治疗的情况下，A1组1例受试者和A2组全部4例患者在3-6个月内实现MG-日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）≥2分改善，3例患者一般维持至30个月；A2组2例患者分别在4个月和11个月出现疾病恶化。3例持续缓解的患者在末次访视时（18-30个月）处于轻微症状表达，且未使用免疫抑制药物和糖皮质激素。观察到定量MG评分相似改善及抗MuSK抗体相应下降。总结/结论：在难治性患者中，单次靶向<5% B细胞且不进行淋巴细胞清除的MuSK-CAART输注，使3/7例MuSK MG患者在停用免疫抑制药物和糖皮质激素的情况下获得持久改善（18-30个月）。中等剂量可能平衡安全性与潜在长期疾病控制。

abstracts.title: Factors Associated with Recurrent Clinical Events among Pediatric Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Patients in the United States
abstracts.authors: Jacqueline Pesa; Zhiwen Liu; Louis Jackson; Liang-Yuan Lin; Raghav Govindarajan
abstracts.affiliations: Superior, CO; Titusville, NJ; North Wales, PA; University, MS; Shiloh, IL
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Clinical events in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) are costly and repeat events indicate insufficient disease management. OBJECTIVE: To estimate rates of exacerbation and myasthenic crisis and identify risk factors among commercially insured children with gMG in the United States. METHODS: MG patients aged 2-17 years were identified from MarketScan® commercial insurance data (01/01/2010 to 06/30/2025) based on ≥1 inpatient or ≥2 outpatient claims (within 60-days) for MG and ≥6 months of continuous enrollment before the first qualifying MG diagnosis (index date). Exacerbation and crisis rates were calculated separately for ages 2-11 and 12-17. A nested case-control design defined cases as patients with an event during follow-up (event date as case index date) and controls as those without events (end of follow-up as control index date); the prior 6 months were used to identify risk factors. RESULTS: The study included 508 gMG patients (226 aged 2-11; 282 aged 12-17). Among those aged 2-11, >25% experienced ≥1 exacerbation and 15.5% ≥1 crisis; incidence rates per 100 person-years were 18.2 (95% CI 11.4–29.1) and 9.3 (5.1-17.1), respectively. Among those 12-17, 34.8% and 16.7% experienced exacerbation and crisis; incidence rates: 22.8 (16.9-30.1) and 7.3 (4.7-11.4). Logistic regression identified female sex, prior exacerbation, acetylcholinesterase inhibitors, corticosteroids, and intravenous immunoglobulin as significantly associated with repeat exacerbations and crises. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Pediatric gMG patients had high rates of clinical events. Crisis and repeat exacerbation were associated with prior exacerbation and common MG treatments, highlighting the need for improved treatments to reduce disease burden.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的临床事件费用高昂，重复事件提示疾病管理不足。目的：估算美国商业保险儿童gMG患者的加重和肌无力危象发生率，并识别危险因素。方法：从MarketScan®商业保险数据（2010年1月1日至2025年6月30日）中，根据≥1次住院或≥2次门诊索赔（60天内）诊断MG，且首次合格MG诊断（索引日期）前连续参保≥6个月，识别2-17岁MG患者。加重和危象发生率分别按2-11岁和12-17岁计算。采用巢式病例对照设计，病例定义为随访期间发生事件的患者（事件日期为病例索引日期），对照为未发生事件者（随访结束为对照索引日期）；使用此前6个月识别危险因素。结果：研究纳入508例gMG患者（226例2-11岁；282例12-17岁）。在2-11岁患者中，>25%经历≥1次加重，15.5%经历≥1次危象；每100人年发生率分别为18.2（95% CI 11.4-29.1）和9.3（5.1-17.1）。在12-17岁患者中，34.8%和16.7%分别经历加重和危象；发生率分别为22.8（16.9-30.1）和7.3（4.7-11.4）。Logistic回归识别出女性、既往加重、乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂、糖皮质激素和静脉注射免疫球蛋白与重复加重和危象显著相关。总结/结论：儿童gMG患者临床事件发生率高。危象和重复加重与既往加重及常见MG治疗相关，凸显需要改进治疗以减轻疾病负担。

abstracts.conferenceFullName: 2026 MGFA Scientific Session (held within the AANEM Annual Meeting)
abstracts.title: Healthcare Costs in Commercially Insured Pediatric Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis in the United States
abstracts.authors: Jacqueline Pesa; Zhiwen Liu; Louis Jackson; Liang-Yuan Lin; Raghav Govindarajan
abstracts.affiliations: Superior, CO; Titusville, NJ; North Wales, PA; University, MS; Shiloh, IL
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is a rare autoimmune disease associated with high healthcare resource utilization and costs among adults. Data on pediatric patients remain limited. OBJECTIVE: To assess the incremental healthcare costs associated with gMG in commercially insured children. METHODS: Using MarketScan® data (01/01/2010–06/30/2025), we identified a retrospective cohort of patients aged 2–17 with ≥1 inpatient or ≥2 outpatient MG diagnosis codes within 60 days and ≥6 months of continuous commercial insurance enrollment before the first qualifying MG diagnosis (index date). Controls (non-MG) were selected randomly. Patients were followed until disenrollment, death, or end of data. Costs were compared between cohorts using inverse probability of treatment weighting to adjust for baseline characteristics. Subgroup analyses evaluated costs among gMG patients experiencing exacerbation or crisis. RESULTS: A total of 508 gMG (66% female; mean age 11.3 years) and 5178 non-MG patients were identified. Weighted cohorts were well balanced. Mean total healthcare costs per-patient-per-month (PPPM) were $6295 vs $226 for gMG vs controls (mean difference $6069; 95% CI $4681-7457). Inpatient and outpatient (excluding office visits) costs were the primary drivers: inpatient $2872 vs $27 and outpatient $2568 vs $84 PPPM, respectively. Immunoglobulin therapies accounted for 48% of outpatient costs. Weighted analyses showed higher total costs among patients with exacerbation ($14,154 vs $3378 PPPM) or crisis ($16,474 vs $4684 PPPM). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Pediatric gMG patients had higher healthcare costs than non-gMG patients. Exacerbations and crises were associated with ~4-fold higher costs, highlighting the need for improved treatments to reduce these costly events.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）是一种罕见的自身免疫性疾病，在成人中与高医疗资源利用和高医疗费用相关。儿童患者的数据仍然有限。目的：评估在商业保险儿童中与gMG相关的增量医疗费用。方法：使用MarketScan®数据（2010年1月1日至2025年6月30日），我们识别了一个回顾性队列，纳入年龄2–17岁、在60天内具有≥1个住院或≥2个门诊MG诊断代码、且在首次符合条件MG诊断（索引日期）前具有≥6个月连续商业保险参保的患者。对照（非MG）为随机选取。患者随访至退保、死亡或数据结束。使用逆概率治疗加权调整基线特征后比较队列间费用。亚组分析评估了发生加重或危象的gMG患者的费用。结果：共识别508例gMG患者（66%女性；平均年龄11.3岁）和5178例非MG患者。加权队列均衡良好。gMG与对照的每患者每月（PPPM）平均总医疗费用分别为6295美元与226美元（平均差6069美元；95% CI 4681–7457）。住院和门诊（不包括诊室就诊）费用是主要驱动因素：住院费用分别为2872美元与27美元PPPM，门诊费用分别为2568美元与84美元PPPM。免疫球蛋白治疗占门诊费用的48%。加权分析显示，发生加重（14,154美元 vs 3378美元PPPM）或危象（16,474美元 vs 4684美元PPPM）的患者总费用更高。总结/结论：儿童gMG患者的医疗费用高于非gMG患者。加重和危象与约4倍更高的费用相关，突显了需要改进治疗以减少这些高费用事件。

abstracts.title: Healthcare Provider Perspectives on Barriers and Challenges to Equitable Care among Patient Subpopulations with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: A U.S. National Survey
abstracts.authors: Amanda Guidon; Ashley Anderson; Anziska Yaacov; Gretchen Ayer; Michael Hehir; Ehtesham Khalid; Shaida Khan; Hannah Machemehl; Rodrigo Rodriguez; Danyelle Quinn; Brienne Stairs; Judith Thompson
abstracts.affiliations: Boston, MA; Houston, TX; Brooklyn, NY; Middlebury, VT; Burlington, VT; New Orleans, LA; Dallas, TX; Arden, NC; Los Angeles, CA; Guelph, Canada; Smyrna, GA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Limited evidence on healthcare providers' (HCP) perspectives on drivers of healthcare inequities for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in the U.S. hinders development of population health interventions. OBJECTIVE: This study aims to characterize barriers to care for gMG patients, with a focus on disproportionately affected subpopulations. METHODS: In a cross-sectional descriptive survey conducted in 2026, U.S. HCPs with experience treating gMG identified barriers and underlying challenges to caring for selected at-risk gMG patient subpopulations. Barriers considered were access (to provider or care network), affordability (care/treatment cost burden), awareness (patient/HCP disease/system knowledge gaps), availability (diagnostic, regulatory, supply limitations), and adoptability (treatment acceptance/preferences). RESULTS: 125 of 307 (40.7%) invited HCPs (91.2% MD, 90.4% neuromuscular medicine specialty, 85.6% with >5 years managing gMG) provided the following perspectives. Access was considered the primary barrier for people with limited healthcare options due to geography (85.5%), ethnic or racial minorities (43.2%), older (65-79 years; 28.8%) and much older (≥80 years; 31.2%) adults, driven by challenges accessing gMG experts and referral networks. Affordability was reported as the primary barrier for people who are uninsured (60.0%), or on Medicaid or other publicly subsidized insurance (42.4%), driven by cost of care. HCPs identified awareness as the primary barrier for individuals with limited English proficiency (61.6%), younger people (18-26 years; 41.1%), and women of childbearing age (37.9%), driven by patient knowledge gaps or unmet needs. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: HCPs identified diverse barriers and challenges to high-quality, equitable gMG care across patient subpopulations. Informed strategies are needed to close these gaps and improve outcomes.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：关于医疗服务提供者（HCP）对美国全身型重症肌无力（gMG）医疗不公平驱动因素看法的证据有限，阻碍了人群健康干预措施的制定。目的：本研究旨在描述gMG患者获得医疗服务的障碍，重点关注受影响不成比例的亚人群。方法：在2026年开展的一项横断面描述性调查中，具有gMG治疗经验的美国HCP识别了为特定高风险gMG患者亚人群提供医疗服务时的障碍及其潜在挑战。所考虑的障碍包括可及性（获得提供者或医疗网络）、可负担性（医疗/治疗费用负担）、认知（患者/HCP疾病/系统知识差距）、可获得性（诊断、监管、供应限制）和可接受性（治疗接受度/偏好）。结果：307名受邀HCP中有125名（40.7%）提供了以下观点（91.2%为MD，90.4%为神经肌肉医学专业，85.6%管理gMG超过5年）。对于因地理原因医疗选择有限者（85.5%）、少数族裔或种族少数群体（43.2%）、老年人（65–79岁；28.8%）和更年长者（≥80岁；31.2%），可及性被认为是主要障碍，其驱动因素为获得gMG专家和转诊网络的挑战。对于无保险者（60.0%）或参加Medicaid或其他公共补贴保险者（42.4%），可负担性被报告为主要障碍，其驱动因素为医疗费用。HCP将认知确定为主要障碍的人群包括英语水平有限者（61.6%）、年轻人（18–26岁；41.1%）和育龄女性（37.9%），其驱动因素为患者知识差距或未满足需求。总结/结论：HCP识别了不同患者亚人群在获得高质量、公平gMG医疗方面的多样障碍和挑战。需要制定有依据的策略来弥合这些差距并改善结局。

abstracts.title: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Induced Myasthenia Gravis-like Clinical Presentation: A Single Center Case Series
abstracts.authors: Fang Sun; Gabriela Figueiredo Pucci; Brendan McNeish; David Lacomis; Joshua Levenson
abstracts.affiliations: Pittsburgh, PA; Ann Arbor, MI
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: ICI induced MG-like symptoms are associated with high fatality rate (up to 40-60%) when overlapping with myositis and myocarditis. Understanding this condition is critical to developing treatment strategies. RESULTS: We examined 21 patients who recently presented to our medical center with ICI induced MG-like symptoms. 86% of cases overlapped with myositis, 76% overlapped with myositis and myocarditis. 71% survived 90 days. Most common symptoms were proximal weakness (71%), myalgia (67%), dyspnea (52%), ptosis (38%), and respiratory failure (33%). Time from ICI treatment to symptom onset was shorter when overlapped with myocarditis (days, 22 vs 105, p=0.007). Peak CK and Troponin levels were higher with myocarditis (CK, 412 vs 1694, P= 0.008; Troponin, 32 vs 1859, p= 0.0001). Acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibodies were frequently detected (46%). Abnormal decrement on repetitive nerve stimulation (RNS) was found in 3 patients. Most patients were off chronic immunosuppression by 12 weeks after index admission. No recurrent symptoms of MG or myositis in surviving patients. No observed difference in chronic clinical course in patients with or without positive AChR antibody on diagnosis, or in patients with or without abnormal RNS. All patients treated with abatacept and ruxolitinib for myocarditis survived (n=6). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: ICI induced MG-like symptoms often present with concurrent myotoxicity. Most patients demonstrated a monophasic clinical course despite AChR antibody status or evidence of abnormal RNS on symptom onset. These differences from idiopathic MG should be confirmed in prospective cohorts to guide acute treatment strategies and prevent unnecessary long- term immunosuppression which could obliterate the anti- tumor effect of ICI.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：ICI诱导的MG样症状在与肌炎和心肌炎重叠时与高病死率（高达40–60%）相关。理解这一疾病对于制定治疗策略至关重要。结果：我们检查了21例近期因ICI诱导MG样症状就诊于本医疗中心的患者。86%的病例与肌炎重叠，76%与肌炎和心肌炎重叠。71%存活90天。最常见的症状为近端无力（71%）、肌痛（67%）、呼吸困难（52%）、上睑下垂（38%）和呼吸衰竭（33%）。与心肌炎重叠时，从ICI治疗到症状出现的时间更短（天，22 vs 105，p=0.007）。合并心肌炎时峰值CK和肌钙蛋白水平更高（CK，412 vs 1694，P=0.008；肌钙蛋白，32 vs 1859，p=0.0001）。乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体常被检出（46%）。3例患者重复神经刺激（RNS）显示异常递减。大多数患者在索引入院后12周时已停用长期免疫抑制。存活患者未出现MG或肌炎复发症状。诊断时AChR抗体阳性或阴性患者、或RNS异常或正常患者在长期临床病程方面未观察到差异。所有因心肌炎接受abatacept和ruxolitinib治疗的患者均存活（n=6）。总结/结论：ICI诱导的MG样症状常伴随肌毒性。尽管诊断时AChR抗体状态或RNS异常证据不同，大多数患者表现为单相临床病程。这些与特发性MG的差异应在前瞻性队列中确认，以指导急性治疗策略并避免不必要的长期免疫抑制，后者可能削弱ICI的抗肿瘤效应。

abstracts.title: Integrated Group-based and Machine Learning Analysis Reveals Sex-related Clinical Signatures in Autoimmune Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Paolo Doksani; Sarah Hoffmann; Sonja Katz; Frauke Stascheit; Jan D. Lünemann; Jana Zschüntzsch; Meneske Oeztuerk; Adela della Marina; Michael Schroeter; Andreas Meisel; Martijn Tannemaat; Sophie Lehnerer
abstracts.affiliations: Berlin, Germany; Zürich, Switzerland; Münster, Germany; Göttingen, Germany; Bochum, Germany; Essen, Germany; Köln, Germany; Leiden, Netherlands
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Despite epidemiological and clinical evidence for a relevant role of sex in autoimmune myasthenia gravis (MG), sex-related heterogeneity and its implications for care remains limited. OBJECTIVE: This updated analysis from the German Myasthenia Gravis Registry (MyaReg), now including 3094 patients aimed to characterize sex-related differences and evaluated whether machine learning (ML) identifies patterns relevant to diagnosis and patient stratification. METHODS: We combined age-adjusted group comparisons with unsupervised (PCA/UMAP) and supervised (Random Forest Classifier) ML models and externally validated the model using data from the Dutch MG registry (n=419). The main outcome was biological sex (female or male). RESULTS: In MyaReg, 54.8% were female. Women were younger at onset (mean 44.3 vs. 57.8 years) and had longer diagnosis delay (mean 1.9 vs. 0.9 years), greater disease severity (QMG 7.4 vs. 4.8; MG-ADL 5 vs. 3.6), more seronegative MG (21.5% vs. 15.2%), and more autoimmune comorbidities (37.1% vs. 12.8%). Unsupervised clustering revealed clear sex-related data structure. Boruta identified eight key variables sufficient for sex estimation. A Random Forest classifier trained on these features achieved reliable discrimination (ROC–AUC 0.74 development cohort, 0.75 validation cohort). SHAP analysis showed that sex estimation was primarily driven by younger age at disease onset, autoimmune comorbidity, higher disease severity, diagnostic delay, fatigue, affective symptoms, and limb- predominant weakness at onset. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: ML reveals reproducible, sex- related patterns in MG capturing differences in diagnostic delay, disease burden, comorbidity, and onset phenotype. These findings highlight the need for greater diagnostic awareness and sex-informed patient stratification to support more equitable care.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：尽管流行病学和临床证据表明性别在自身免疫性重症肌无力（MG）中具有重要作用，但性别相关异质性及其对诊疗的影响仍有限。目的：这项来自德国重症肌无力登记研究（MyaReg）的更新分析现纳入3094例患者，旨在描述性别相关差异，并评估机器学习（ML）是否能识别与诊断和患者分层相关的模式。方法：我们将年龄调整的组间比较与无监督（PCA/UMAP）和有监督（随机森林分类器）ML模型相结合，并使用荷兰MG登记研究数据（n=419）对模型进行外部验证。主要结局为生物学性别（女性或男性）。结果：在MyaReg中，54.8%为女性。女性发病更年轻（平均44.3 vs 57.8岁），诊断延迟更长（平均1.9 vs 0.9年），疾病严重程度更高（QMG 7.4 vs 4.8；MG-ADL 5 vs 3.6），血清阴性MG更多（21.5% vs 15.2%），自身免疫共病更多（37.1% vs 12.8%）。无监督聚类揭示了清晰的性别相关数据结构的。Boruta识别出八个足以估计性别的关键变量。基于这些特征训练的随机森林分类器实现了可靠区分（开发队列ROC–AUC 0.74，验证队列0.75）。SHAP分析显示，性别估计主要由发病年龄较轻、自身免疫共病、疾病严重程度较高、诊断延迟、疲劳、情感症状和起病时肢体为主型无力驱动。总结/结论：ML揭示了MG中可重复的性别相关模式，捕捉了诊断延迟、疾病负担、共病和起病表型的差异。这些发现强调需要提高诊断意识并进行性别知情的患者分层，以支持更公平的医疗。

abstracts.title: Malignancy Risk in Myasthenia Gravis Patients Treated with Mycophenolate and Azathioprine in the Medicare Population
abstracts.authors: Michael Hehir; David Bruckman; Jesse Schold; Ikjae Lee; Benjamin Claytor; Yuebing Li
abstracts.affiliations: South Burlington, VT; Cleveland, OH; Denver, CO; New York, NY
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Mycophenolate (MMF) and azathioprine (AZA) remain the most commonly prescribed non-steroid traditional immunosuppressants for myasthenia gravis (MG) patients. After efficacy, safety is rated the most important treatment consideration for MG patients and physicians. Early data indicates a higher risk of malignancy in patients treated with AZA, a similar risk of increased of malignancy is likely with other immunosuppressants, presenting a safety concern for MG patients. OBJECTIVE: Estimate malignancy incidence and hazard for Medicare aged MG patients treated with AZA or MMF in an effort to improve treatment decisions. METHODS: Retrospective analysis of malignancy incidence and hazard utilized Poisson and Cox regression models in MG patients treated with MMF or AZA vs. matched controls in Medicare Fee-For-Service claims database; non-melanoma skin malignancies were excluded. MG patients and matched controls were identified among beneficiaries enrolled 2006-2019 utilizing validated methodology. RESULTS: Incidence rate ratio (IRR) and hazard ratio (HR) of malignancy were no different in 5585 MG patients compared to 26194 non-MG matched controls (IRR 0.92 95% CI (0.83-1.02); HR 0.93 (0.82-1.07)). Malignancy IRR and hazard ratio were similar between MG patients exposed to MMF/AZA (N=1795) and MG patients not exposed to MMF/AZA (N=3790) (IRR 0.87 (0.72-1.05); HR = 1.21 (0.96-1.51)). The most common malignancies observed among exposed and non-exposed MG patients were genitourinary, gastrointestinal, respiratory/chest, hematological, and endocrine. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: There does not appear to be an increased malignancy risk with the use of AZA/MMF among Medicare age MG patients. This data may be reassuring to patients and clinicians utilizing these immunotherapies.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：吗替麦考酚酯（MMF）和硫唑嘌呤（AZA）仍是重症肌无力（MG）患者最常用的非甾体传统免疫抑制剂。在疗效之后，安全性被MG患者和医生评为最重要的治疗考量。早期数据表明接受AZA治疗的患者恶性肿瘤风险更高，其他免疫抑制剂也可能存在类似的恶性肿瘤风险增加，这给MG患者带来安全性担忧。目的：估计接受AZA或MMF治疗的Medicare年龄MG患者的恶性肿瘤发生率和风险比，以改善治疗决策。方法：采用Poisson和Cox回归模型对Medicare按服务付费理赔数据库中接受MMF或AZA治疗的MG患者与匹配对照进行恶性肿瘤发生率和风险比的回顾性分析；排除非黑色素瘤皮肤恶性肿瘤。采用经验证的方法在2006-2019年入组的受益人中发现MG患者和匹配对照。结果：5585例MG患者与26194例非MG匹配对照相比，恶性肿瘤的发病率比（IRR）和风险比（HR）无差异（IRR 0.92，95% CI（0.83-1.02）；HR 0.93（0.82-1.07））。暴露于MMF/AZA的MG患者（N=1795）与未暴露于MMF/AZA的MG患者（N=3790）之间，恶性肿瘤IRR和风险比相似（IRR 0.87（0.72-1.05）；HR=1.21（0.96-1.51））。在暴露和未暴露的MG患者中观察到的最常见恶性肿瘤为泌尿生殖系统、胃肠道、呼吸/胸部、血液系统和内分泌系统。总结/结论：在Medicare年龄MG患者中，使用AZA/MMF似乎并未增加恶性肿瘤风险。这些数据可能对使用这些免疫疗法的患者和临床医生具有安抚作用。

abstracts.title: Moyasthenia Gravis: A Rare Presentation of MUSK+ Myasthenia Gravis in a Patient with Known Moyamoya Disease
abstracts.authors: Danielle Giammarco; Shehroz Rana; Anthony Rainey
abstracts.affiliations: Bethlehem, PA; Allentown, PA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Moyamoya disease (MMD)/Moyamoya syndrome (MMS) is a non-atherosclerotic, non- inflammatory angiopathy. MMD/MMS has been reported to occur simultaneously with autoimmune conditions, most notably Grave’s disease, lupus and type 1 diabetes. There is one documented case of Myasthenia Gravis (MG) comorbid with MMS and Grave’s disease-associated thyrotoxicosis. RESULTS: We report a case of MG in a 28-year-old female with known MMD complicated by ischemic stroke. She underwent left indirect bypass by encephalodurosynangiosis and was stable for 5 years. The patient later presented with dysarthria and dysphagia, followed by development of progressive bilateral ptosis and intermittent diplopia. Work-up revealed stability of MMD with no evidence of vascular event. Pyridostigmine challenge showed no improvement. MuSK antibodies were found to be positive with a level of 69.6 nmol/L (reference range 0.0-0.02). She had mild elevation in ESR and CRP with the remainder of autoimmune work-up negative. CT chest showed enlarged thymic tissue for which she is undergoing evaluation for thymoma. She is planned to start inebilizumab infusions. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Here we present the first reported case of MuSK + MG in a patient with MMD. This case, alongside prior reports of autoimmune disease co- occurring with MMD/MMS, highlights the possibility of immune dysregulation contributing to MMD pathogenesis. Genetic studies have revealed mutations in RNF213 gene to be involved in MMD development, but no link has been established between this mutation and predisposition to autoimmune disease. More recently, the RNF213 protein has been linked to immune modulation supporting the possibility of immune dysregulation as a contributor to both autoimmune phenomenon and MMD/MMS.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：烟雾病（MMD）/烟雾综合征（MMS）是一种非动脉粥样硬化性、非炎症性血管病。已有报道MMD/MMS与自身免疫性疾病同时发生，最显著的是Grave病、狼疮和1型糖尿病。有一例记录在案的MG与MMS及Grave病相关甲状腺毒症共病的病例。结果：我们报告一例28岁女性MG患者，已知患有MMD并并发缺血性卒中。她接受了左侧脑硬膜动脉血管融通术间接搭桥，稳定5年。患者后来出现构音障碍和吞咽困难，随后出现进行性双侧上睑下垂和间歇性复视。检查显示MMD稳定，无血管事件证据。吡啶斯的明激发试验未见改善。MuSK抗体阳性，水平为69.6 nmol/L（参考范围0.0-0.02）。她有轻度ESR和CRP升高，其余自身免疫检查阴性。胸部CT显示胸腺组织增大，正在评估胸腺瘤。她计划开始inebilizumab输注。总结/结论：我们在此报告首例MMD患者中MuSK+MG的病例。该病例与既往自身免疫性疾病与MMD/MMS共存的报告一起，提示免疫失调可能参与MMD发病机制。遗传学研究已揭示RNF213基因突变参与MMD发展，但尚未建立该突变与自身免疫性疾病易感性之间的联系。最近，RNF213蛋白已被与免疫调节联系起来，支持免疫失调可能同时促进自身免疫现象和MMD/MMS的可能性。

abstracts.title: Patient Acceptable Symptom State in MG Patients – Cross-sectional Study
abstracts.authors: Piotr Szczudlik; Ewa Sobieszczuk; Karol Badowski; Dariusz Orzechowski; Beata Szyluk; Anna Kostera-Pruszczyk
abstracts.affiliations: Warsaw, Poland
abstracts.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To assess patient acceptable symptom state (PASS) in tertiary center cohort. METHODS: Cross-sectional study of 101 MG patients, age 60.7+18.5 years, 67.3% F, 42.6% with EOMG, conducted between Feb2024 to Jun2025. RESULTS: 91% of patients received AChEI , 72.3% glucocorticoids (CS), 20.8% AZA, 19.8% MFM, 2% MTX, 44.6% were treated with IVIG (23.8%- previous year), 12.9% with PLEX (5.9% previous year). 13.9% had history of myasthenic crisis, 15% had ocular symptoms only. 40.6% of patients were PASS-positive, with MG-ADL 4.4+3.8 vs. 8.3+4.1 in PASS-negative, MGQoL15 was 16.3+10.5 vs. 32.2+12.3, respectively (p<0.05). Patients treated with CS had lower MGQoL15 (27.22+13.7 vs. 16.9+11.6, p<0.05) as compared with untreated, with no significant differences in MG-ADL, age or sex between groups. Patients treated with IVIG or PLEX within last 12 months had worse MGQoL15 (29.9+15.2 vs. 23.0+13.7, p<0.05) and MG-ADL (8.1+5.1 vs. 5.5+4.0, p<0.05). Females, as compared with males were more often PASS- negative; 51.5% vs. 27.3%), had higher MG-ADL (6.8+4.5 vs. 4.4+3.6) and MGQoL (26.8+14.0 vs. 19.7+14.2) p<0.05. There were no differences between PASS-positive and negative in age, history of myasthenic crisis. More patients with only ocular or no symptoms were PASS- positive (67%) compared with gMG (35%, p<0.01), with better MGQoL15 (9.7+10.3 vs. 28.2+12.8, p<0.001). Threshold for PASS-positive answer was <=4.0 points in MG-ADL (sensitivity 58%, specificity 75%). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Nearly 60% of patients do not accept their MG state. Treatment with CS had negative impact on PASS-status despite no differences in MG-ADL, sex or age, compared with those who not CS-treated.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：评估三级中心队列中的患者可接受症状状态（PASS）。方法：对101例MG患者进行横断面研究，年龄60.7±18.5岁，67.3%为女性，42.6%为早发型MG（EOMG），研究于2024年2月至2025年6月进行。结果：91%的患者接受AChEI，72.3%接受糖皮质激素（CS），20.8%接受AZA，19.8%接受MFM，2%接受MTX，44.6%接受IVIG治疗（23.8%为前一年），12.9%接受PLEX（5.9%为前一年）。13.9%有肌无力危象史，15%仅有眼部症状。40.6%的患者为PASS阳性，其MG-ADL为4.4±3.8，而PASS阴性者为8.3±4.1，MGQoL15分别为16.3±10.5 vs. 32.2±12.3（p<0.05）。与未治疗者相比，接受CS治疗的患者MGQoL15更低（27.22±13.7 vs. 16.9±11.6，p<0.05），组间MG-ADL、年龄或性别无显著差异。过去12个月内接受IVIG或PLEX治疗的患者MGQoL15更差（29.9±15.2 vs. 23.0±13.7，p<0.05）且MG-ADL更差（8.1±5.1 vs. 5.5±4.0，p<0.05）。与男性相比，女性更常为PASS阴性（51.5% vs. 27.3%），MG-ADL更高（6.8±4.5 vs. 4.4±3.6）且MGQoL更高（26.8±14.0 vs. 19.7±14.2），p<0.05。PASS阳性与阴性者在年龄、肌无力危象史方面无差异。仅有眼部症状或无症状的患者中PASS阳性者更多（67%），相比全身型MG（35%，p<0.01），且MGQoL15更好（9.7±10.3 vs. 28.2±12.8，p<0.001）。PASS阳性回答的阈值为MG-ADL≤4.0分（敏感性58%，特异性75%）。总结/结论：近60%的患者不接受其MG状态。与未接受CS治疗者相比，CS治疗对PASS状态有负面影响，尽管MG-ADL、性别或年龄无差异。

abstracts.title: Revisiting the Neuromuscular Junction in Acetylcholine Receptor Antibody-positive Myasthenia Gravis: A Multimodal Study of Human Endplate Pathology
abstracts.authors: Sarah Hoffmann; Katharina Brokamp; Andreas Meisel; Paolo Doksani; Andreas Roos; Andreas Hentschel; Carsten Dittmayer; Markus Schülke; Jens-Carsten Rückert; Matthias Pumberger; Friederike Schömig; Werner Stenzel; Corinna Preusse
abstracts.affiliations: Berlin, Germany; Essen, Germany; Bochum, Germany
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Contemporary human tissue studies of the neuromuscular junction (NMJ) in AChR-ab-positive MG are scarce. We revisited human NMJ pathology in intercostal muscle using immunohistochemistry, electron microscopy, and complementary transcriptomic and proteomic analyses. OBJECTIVE: To characterize human NMJ pathology in AChR-ab+ MG and relate structural, inflammatory, and molecular findings across tissue-based analyses. METHODS: Intercostal muscle biopsies from 58 patients with AChR-ab+ MG obtained during thymectomy were compared with non-diseased controls from scoliosis surgery. Immunohistochemistry included C5b-9 staining and assessment of inflammatory cell infiltration. Targeted transcript analyses were performed by real-time qPCR, alongside proteomic profiling. Electron microscopy assessed detailed postsynaptic ultrastructure. RESULTS: C5b-9-positive endplates were present in all AChR-ab+ MG biopsies and absent in controls; within individual biopsies, the proportion of positive NMJs ranged from 25% to 100%. CD68-positive macrophages and CD8- positive T cells were present near NMJs, whereas B cells were not detected. In selected cases, inflammatory cells were also observed in presynaptic neural structures. Electron microscopy revealed a heterogeneous spectrum of NMJ pathology, ranging from preserved junctions to simplified postsynaptic folds, rarefaction, and focal plumping. Transcriptomic and proteomic analyses showed only limited differences in whole-tissue muscle. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: AChR-ab+ MG is characterized by complement deposition at the NMJ, whereas ultrastructural involvement is heterogeneous rather than uniformly destructive. This refined view of endplate pathology aligns with rapid clinical improvement seen with novel targeted therapies. The limited transcriptomic and proteomic signal likely reflects dilution of NMJ-specific changes in whole-muscle tissue, supporting targeted NMJ-enriched molecular approaches to better resolve disease mechanisms.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：AChR抗体阳性MG的当代人神经肌肉接头（NMJ）组织研究很少。我们使用免疫组化、电子显微镜以及补充的转录组学和蛋白质组学分析，重新审视了肋间肌中人NMJ病理。目的：表征AChR-ab+MG的人NMJ病理，并将基于组织的分析中的结构、炎症和分子发现联系起来。方法：将胸腺切除术中获得的58例AChR-ab+MG患者的肋间肌活检与脊柱侧弯手术的非疾病对照进行比较。免疫组化包括C5b-9染色和炎症细胞浸润评估。通过实时qPCR进行靶向转录分析，同时进行蛋白质组学分析。电子显微镜评估详细的突触后超微结构。结果：C5b-9阳性终板存在于所有AChR-ab+MG活检中，而在对照中缺失；在单个活检内，阳性NMJ的比例范围为25%至100%。CD68阳性巨噬细胞和CD8阳性T细胞存在于NMJ附近，而未检测到B细胞。在选定病例中，突触前神经结构中 also 观察到炎症细胞。电子显微镜揭示了NMJ病理的异质性谱，从保留的接头到简化的突触后褶皱、稀疏化和局灶性肿胀。转录组学和蛋白质组学分析显示全组织肌肉中仅有有限差异。总结/结论：AChR-ab+MG的特征是NMJ处补体沉积，而超微结构受累是异质性的而非均匀破坏性的。这种对内板病理的精细认识与新型靶向治疗所见的快速临床改善相一致。有限的转录组学和蛋白质组学信号可能反映了全肌肉组织中NMJ特异性变化的稀释，支持采用靶向NMJ富集的分子方法以更好地解析疾病机制。

abstracts.title: Symptom Severity Assessment Using MG-ADL Items and Domains in Active-treatment Phase: Vibrance-MG Phase 2/3 Study of Nipocalimab in Adolescents with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Tuan Vu; Marie Fitzgibbon; Ibrahim Turkoz; Dan Huang; Carly J Paoli; Jelena Dukovski
abstracts.affiliations: Tampa, FL; Raritan, NJ; Titusville, NJ; Neuss, Germany; Horsham, PA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nipocalimab added to standard-of-care (SOC) demonstrated substantial immunoglobulin-G reduction and sustained disease control in 24-weeks open-label phase-2/3 vibrance-mg (NCT05265273) study in adolescents (aged 12 to <18 years) with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG). OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the impact of nipocalimab+SOC treatment on MG-ADL items and domains in adolescents from vibrance-mg through 24-weeks. METHODS: Baseline floor effects (score=0) distribution was evaluated using item-level frequency distributions. Mean/median change-from-baseline (CFB) for all 8-items and 4-domains of Myasthenia Gravis-Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) were evaluated through 24-weeks. Based on items/domains score distributions, those patients with ≥1-point improvement in domains/items were evaluated; negative change in scores indicate improvement. RESULTS: At baseline (n=8) the mean (range) MG-ADL domain scores were 1.31(0–3) bulbar, 0.25(0–1) respiratory, 0.69(0–3) limb, and 2.13(1–3) ocular. The mean (SD) CFB to week-24 was (n=7/8; 1 ongoing in study at time of data cut-off) were −0.79(0.76) bulbar, −0.21(0.39) limb, 0.07(0.45) respiratory, and −1.64(0.80) ocular. With regard to achieving ≥1 point improvement in MG-ADL domain scores, 3(42.9%) patients achieved this in bulbar, 1(14.3%) in limb, none in respiratory, and 6(85.7%) in ocular. At baseline, median MG-ADL item scores were 0.00–1.25 (range 0–2.5); proportion of patients achieving ≥1 point improvement in MG-ADL item scores over 24-weeks were 2(28.6%) in chewing, 5(71.4%) eyelid-droop, 4(57.1%) double-vision, and 1(14.3%) each for talking, swallowing, and impairment in brushing teeth/combing hair. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Nipocalimab+SOC improved scores for individual domains and items of MG-ADL after 24-weeks of treatment in adolescents with gMG, demonstrating sustained disease control across a broad range of symptoms.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在标准治疗（SOC）基础上加用nipocalimab，在针对12至<18岁全身型肌无力（gMG）青少年的24周开放标签2/3期vibrance-mg研究（NCT05265273）中，显示出大幅降低免疫球蛋白G并持续控制疾病。目的：评估vibrance-mg研究中nipocalimab+SOC治疗对青少年MG-ADL条目和维度的影响，随访至24周。方法：采用条目水平频率分布评估基线地板效应（评分=0）分布。评估重症肌无力-日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）全部8个条目和4个维度至24周的平均/中位自基线变化（CFB）。根据条目/维度评分分布，评估在维度/条目上改善≥1分的患者；评分负向变化表示改善。结果：基线时（n=8），MG-ADL维度平均（范围）评分为延髓1.31（0–3）、呼吸0.25（0–1）、肢体0.69（0–3）、眼肌2.13（1–3）。至第24周的平均（SD）CFB（n=7/8；数据截止时1例仍在研究中）为延髓−0.79（0.76）、肢体−0.21（0.39）、呼吸0.07（0.45）、眼肌−1.64（0.80）。在MG-ADL维度评分改善≥1分方面，延髓3例（42.9%）、肢体1例（14.3%）、呼吸无、眼肌6例（85.7%）达到。基线时，MG-ADL条目评分中位数为0.00–1.25（范围0–2.5）；24周内MG-ADL条目评分改善≥1分的患者比例分别为咀嚼2例（28.6%）、眼睑下垂5例（71.4%）、复视4例（57.1%），说话、吞咽和刷牙/梳头受限各1例（14.3%）。总结/结论：在gMG青少年中，nipocalimab+SOC治疗24周后改善了MG-ADL各维度和条目的评分，显示在广泛症状范围内持续控制疾病。

abstracts.title: Thymectomy Outcomes in Myasthenia Gravis: Comparative Analysis between Treatment before and after five Years
abstracts.authors: Eduardo Estephan; Beatriz Silva; Weverton Carlos da Silva Teixeira; Antonio Alberto Zambon; Edmar Zanoteli
abstracts.affiliations: São Paulo, Brazil; Sào Paulo, Brazil
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Thymectomy is one of the standard treatments for myasthenia gravis (MG) with positive anti- acetylcholine receptor antibody. It is primarily validated and performed early in the natural history of the disease. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to evaluate the benefits of thymectomy performed after five years of MG onset in patients younger them 65 years old, analyzing the impact of remission or minimal symptoms. METHODS: Analysis of data from medical records at a tertiary care center in Neuromuscular Diseases in São Paulo. A retrospective comparative clinical evaluation was performed using the MG-ADL and MG-Composite scales between the pre-surgery attend and the last clinical evaluation. RESULTS: Data from 180 patients with myasthenia gravis treated with thymectomy were analyzed. 80 patients from tested cases were positive for anti-Ach antibody. Approximately 22% underwent thymectomy after 5 years of diagnosis, with an average of 11 years between diagnosis and surgery. The mean MG-ADL scale score at the last assessment of these patients was 2.72 points and mean MG Composite scale score was 4.24 points. Clinical remission or minimal disease symptoms occurred in 51% of this group of patient. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Our observational retrospective study suggests that approximately half of patients younger than 65 years old can experienced significative disease improvement with thymectomy even when performed after 5 years of diagnosis. Nevertheless, further studies are needed to clarify the real possible benefit of this treatment in this specific group of MG patients.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：胸腺切除术是抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性重症肌无力（MG）的标准治疗之一。该治疗主要在疾病自然病程早期得到验证并实施。目的：本研究旨在评估在MG发病五年后、年龄小于65岁的患者中实施胸腺切除术的获益，分析其对缓解或轻微症状的影响。方法：分析圣保罗一家神经肌肉疾病三级诊疗中心的病历数据。采用MG-ADL和MG-Composite量表，对术前就诊与末次临床评估进行回顾性比较临床评价。结果：分析了180例接受胸腺切除术治疗的MG患者数据。80例受检病例抗Ach抗体阳性。约22%在诊断5年后接受胸腺切除术，诊断与手术之间平均间隔11年。这些患者末次评估时MG-ADL量表平均评分为2.72分，MG Composite量表平均评分为4.24分。该组患者中51%出现临床缓解或轻微疾病症状。总结/结论：我们的观察性回顾性研究提示，即使胸腺切除术在诊断5年后实施，约半数小于65岁的患者仍可获得显著疾病改善。然而，仍需进一步研究以明确该治疗在这一特定MG患者群体中的真实可能获益。

abstracts.title: Thymectomy with Nipocalimab for Treatment-refractory Juvenile Myasthenia Gravis: A Case Report
abstracts.authors: Abhik Banerjee; Arthur Wang; Taylor Shannon; Rachel Eisenbarth; Sokena Zaidi; Deepti Nagesh; Leigh Maria Ramos-Platt
abstracts.affiliations: Los Angeles, CA; South Pasadena, CA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia Gravis (MG) is the largest group of neuromuscular junction disorders and is characterized by auto-antibodies targeted against the post-synaptic membrane. Juvenile Myasthenia Gravis (JMG) presents with fatiguability before the age of 18, accounts for approximately 10% of all MG cases, and has an estimated incidence of 1-5 cases per million. In contrast to generalized MG, clinical trials involving JMG and treatment recommendations are limited. Furthermore, recent studies of MG and JMG have identified racial and ethnic differences in disease prevalence and severity. OBJECTIVE: This case report examines the efficacy of nipocalimab following thymectomy in anti-acetylcholine receptor positive treatment-refractory JMG. METHODS: Following hospital discharge from the pediatric intensive care unit and through shared decision- making between clinicians and the patient's family for maintenance therapy options, the patient started nipocalimab infusions. The patient was serially evaluated through clinical examination, anti-acetylcholine receptor serologies were measured during hospital course and in follow up outpatient setting, and myasthenia gravis activities of daily living (MG-ADL) scales were calculated when appropriate. RESULTS: Thymectomy followed by nipocalimab infusion results in sustained improvements in MG-ADL score and anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody titers in a patient with treatment-refractory JMG. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: The case report demonstrates the efficacy of thymectomy with nipocalimab for treatment- refractory JMG. Additionally, the patient is LatinX, an ethnic group not explicitly represented or studied in the original Vivacity Trial and with known health disparities in disease presentation compared to the general population. Further studies examining health care disparities and socioeconomic determinates of health in JMG to identify appropriate targeted interventions are needed.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）是神经肌肉接头疾病中最大的一组，其特征是针对突触后膜的自身抗体。青少年重症肌无力（JMG）在18岁前出现易疲劳，约占所有MG病例的10%，估计发病率为每百万1–5例。与全身型MG相比，涉及JMG的临床试验和治疗推荐有限。此外，近期关于MG和JMG的研究已发现疾病患病率和严重程度存在种族和民族差异。目的：本病例报告考察胸腺切除术后使用nipocalimab在抗乙酰胆碱受体阳性、治疗难治性JMG中的疗效。方法：在从儿科重症监护室出院后，经临床医生与患者家属共同决策维持治疗选择，患者开始nipocalimab输注。通过临床检查对患者进行系列评估，在住院期间和随访门诊中检测抗乙酰胆碱受体血清学，并在适当时计算重症肌无力日常生活活动（MG-ADL）量表。结果：胸腺切除术后继以nipocalimab输注，使一例治疗难治性JMG患者的MG-ADL评分和抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体滴度获得持续改善。总结/结论：本病例报告证明胸腺切除术联合nipocalimab对治疗难治性JMG的疗效。此外，该患者为拉丁裔，这一族裔群体在原始Vivacity试验中未被明确代表或研究，且与一般人群相比在疾病表现上存在已知健康差异。需要进一步研究JMG中的医疗保健差异和健康的社会经济决定因素，以确定适当的针对性干预措施。

abstracts.title: Time-to-treatment Delays for Novel Immunotherapies in Myasthenia Gravis: Quantifying Real-world Barriers and Clinical Consequences
abstracts.authors: Danielle Kei Pua; Aiswarya Raj; Fang Yu; Brittany Zaita; Jin Li
abstracts.affiliations: White Plains, NY; Valhalla, NY; New Rochelle, NY
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Emerging novel immunotherapies for Myasthenia Gravis (MG) has been associated with improved outcomes and mitigated disability. Novel disease modifying agents (nDMT) including complement inhibitors, FcRn antagonists and B-cell depleting therapies now represent first- and second-line options for curbing MG exacerbations and disease activity. Initiation of therapy involves sequential mandatory pre-infusion steps that may serve as barriers to timely initiation of care. These barriers have not yet been quantified in current literature. OBJECTIVE: Identify and analyze real-world barriers to initiation of novel immunotherapy agents in myasthenia gravis. METHODS: We identified patients at Westchester Medical Center (Valhalla, NY) diagnosed with MG with plan to initiate a nDMT. Time from decision-to-treat to initiation of nDMT was extracted. Reasons for delays and MG disease activity were extracted. Concomitant immunotherapy and steroid use were extracted. Each nDMT was analyzed as a distinct epoch. RESULTS: Among 13 patients (median age 61, 77% female) with myasthenia gravis and median disease duration of 5 years (IQR 5), 20 nDMT epochs were analyzed. Median time to initiation was 33 days, with shorter intervals observed in post-discharge patients. Two patients experienced MG exacerbation while awaiting treatment. Four patients failed initiation due to insurance delays (2) and gaps in follow-up care (2), with 3 patients exceeding 100 days to initiation secondary to insurance coverage delays. Concomitant immunotherapy use was present in 4 epochs, and concomitant steroid use was present in 10 epochs. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Real-world delays in MG treatment initiation emphasizes the need for streamlined care pathways to prevent exacerbation and disability.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：新兴的重症肌无力（MG）新型免疫疗法与结局改善和残疾减轻相关。新型疾病修饰药物（nDMT），包括补体抑制剂、FcRn拮抗剂和B细胞耗竭疗法，现已成为控制MG加重和疾病活动的一线和二线选择。治疗启动涉及一系列强制性输注前步骤，这些步骤可能成为及时启动治疗的障碍。这些障碍尚未在当前文献中被量化。目的：识别并分析真实世界中启动MG新型免疫治疗药物的障碍。方法：我们在Westchester Medical Center（纽约州Valhalla）识别了诊断为MG并计划启动nDMT的患者。提取从决定治疗到启动nDMT的时间。提取延迟原因和MG疾病活动。提取合并免疫治疗和类固醇使用情况。每种nDMT作为一个独立时段进行分析。结果：在13例MG患者（中位年龄61岁，77%女性）中，中位疾病病程为5年（IQR 5），分析了20个nDMT时段。中位启动时间为33天，出院后患者观察到更短的间隔。2例患者在等待治疗期间经历MG加重。4例患者因保险延迟（2例）和随访照护缺口（2例）未能启动，其中3例因保险覆盖延迟而启动时间超过100天。4个时段存在合并免疫治疗使用，10个时段存在合并类固醇使用。总结/结论：真实世界中MG治疗启动的延迟强调需要简化照护路径以预防加重和残疾。

abstracts.title: Use of PLEX, IVIG, and SCIG as Maintenance Therapies in Myasthenia Gravis: Unmet Evidence Needs and Real-world Data from the Vitaccess Real MG Registry
abstracts.authors: Mark Larkin; Fatemeh Amini; Alasdair Fellows; Emma Bagshaw; Amanda Hayes; Emma Ward
abstracts.affiliations: London, United Kingdom
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Although more commonly used for exacerbations, plasma exchange (PLEX), intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIg) and subcutaneous immunoglobulin (SCIg) are used as maintenance therapies in a small proportion of myasthenia gravis (MG) patients: typically, those with refractory disease, treated in specialist centers, and where innovative treatments are not approved or readily available. Data on clinical value and usage rates in the maintenance setting are limited. OBJECTIVE: This analysis collected real-world data on maintenance use of PLEX, IVIg, and SCIg to better understand the treatment landscape and the needs of patients with refractory MG. METHODS: The Vitaccess Real MG (VRMG) Registry is an international MG patient registry, collecting patient- reported and clinical data. Data from healthcare site- recruited participants were analyzed to identify those receiving maintenance PLEX, IVIg, or SCIg at baseline. Demographic and clinical characteristics were explored. RESULTS: By 27 April 2026, 75 site-recruited participants were enrolled, across 1 UK and 6 US sites. Participants receiving treatments of interest as maintenance therapy at baseline: PLEX n=1 (1.33%), IVIg n=5 (6.67%), SCIg n=2 (2.67%). All were US-based. Age: 40-50 years n=4, 50+ years n=4. Sex: female n=4, male n=4. MGFA class: unknown n=3, Class I n=2, Class II n=3. Mean MG-ADL score: 3.8. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Real-world data from the VRMG Registry reveal a small proportion of MG patients receiving maintenance PLEX, IVIg, or SCIg. As recruitment continues, data from a larger sample should prove valuable in assessing clinical characteristics, unmet needs, and quality of life in people with refractory MG, and exploring different approaches to its management.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：血浆置换（PLEX）、静脉注射免疫球蛋白（IVIg）和皮下注射免疫球蛋白（SCIg）虽更常用于加重期，但在小部分重症肌无力（MG）患者中也被用作维持治疗：通常为难治性疾病患者、在专科中心接受治疗者，以及创新治疗未获批或不易获得的情况。关于维持治疗背景下临床价值和使用率的数据有限。目的：本分析收集PLEX、IVIg和SCIg维持使用的真实世界数据，以更好地了解难治性MG的治疗格局和患者需求。方法：Vitaccess Real MG（VRMG）注册研究是一项国际MG患者注册研究，收集患者报告和临床数据。对来自医疗中心招募参与者的数据进行分析，以识别基线时接受维持性PLEX、IVIg或SCIg治疗者。探讨了人口学和临床特征。结果：截至2026年4月27日，共入组75名中心招募参与者，来自1个英国中心和6个美国中心。基线时接受目标治疗作为维持治疗的参与者：PLEX n=1（1.33%）、IVIg n=5（6.67%）、SCIg n=2（2.67%）。均为美国患者。年龄：40-50岁 n=4，50岁以上 n=4。性别：女性 n=4，男性 n=4。MGFA分级：未知 n=3，I级 n=2，II级 n=3。平均MG-ADL评分：3.8。总结/结论：来自VRMG注册研究的真实世界数据显示，小部分MG患者接受维持性PLEX、IVIg或SCIg治疗。随着招募继续，来自更大样本的数据应有助于评估难治性MG患者的临床特征、未满足需求和生活质量，并探索其管理的不同方法。

abstracts.title: Validation of Myasthenia Gravis Outcome Measure Thresholds in a Real-world Clinical Practice Cohort: A Retrospective Duke MG Registry Study
abstracts.authors: Chunlu Ma; Karandeep Bhatti; Michael Lutz; Shruti Raja; Vern Juel; Lisa Hobson-Webb; Janice Massey; Donald Sanders
abstracts.affiliations: Durham, NC
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Clinically meaningful improvement in myasthenia gravis (MG) is often assessed using the Post- Intervention Status (PIS) or change in outcome measures (OMs). Validity of established minimal clinical difference (MCD) thresholds for MG OMs has not been confirmed in large real-world cohorts. OBJECTIVE: Validation of MCD thresholds for MG OMs METHODS: Retrospective study using the Duke MG Registry. Time to improvement used two PIS-based definitions: Minimal change (Improved or better, sustained >30 days); Treatment goal (TG)–based definition (Minimal Manifestations or better). Kaplan–Meier and Cox models estimated time-to-event and predictors. MCD validation used PIS as the external criterion, with receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses evaluating MG-Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL), Quantitative MG Score (QMG), MG Composite (MGC), and MG-Manual Muscle Testing (MG-MMT) under both definitions. RESULTS: Among 679 MG patients, 93.8% improved under the minimal change definition (median 300 days) vs 71.1% under the TG-based definition (median 854 days). Male sex and ocular MG predicted faster improvement under the TG-based definition, while longer disease duration predicted slower improvement under the minimal change definition (C-index 0.571 vs 0.533). Under the minimal change definition, ROC analyses showed good discrimination for MG-ADL (AUC=0.796), MG-MMT (AUC=0.791), and QMG (AUC=0.788); under the TG- based definition, discrimination was attenuated for all OMs, but QMG remained best-performing. MG-MMT ≥3- point decrease performed most consistently in all analyses. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Minimal clinical improvement was achieved by most patients, but timelines and predictors differed by endpoint definition. TG-based definition better differentiated patient trajectories. Published MCD thresholds were confirmed for QMG and MG-MMT, especially under the TG-based definition.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）的临床有意义改善通常采用干预后状态（PIS）或结局指标（OMs）变化进行评估。已建立的MG结局指标最小临床差异（MCD）阈值的有效性尚未在大型真实世界队列中得到确认。目的：验证MG结局指标的MCD阈值。方法：使用Duke MG注册研究进行回顾性研究。至改善时间采用两种基于PIS的定义：最小变化（改善或更好，持续>30天）；基于治疗目标（TG）的定义（微小表现或更好）。Kaplan–Meier和Cox模型估计至事件时间及预测因素。MCD验证以PIS作为外部标准，采用受试者工作特征（ROC）分析评估MG日常生活活动量表（MG-ADL）、定量MG评分（QMG）、MG复合评分（MGC）和MG徒手肌力测试（MG-MMT）在两种定义下的表现。结果：在679例MG患者中，93.8%在最小变化定义下改善（中位300天），而基于TG的定义下为71.1%（中位854天）。男性性别和眼肌型MG预测基于TG定义下更快的改善，而较长病程预测最小变化定义下较慢的改善（C指数0.571 vs 0.533）。在最小变化定义下，ROC分析显示MG-ADL（AUC=0.796）、MG-MMT（AUC=0.791）和QMG（AUC=0.788）具有良好的区分度；在基于TG的定义下，所有结局指标的区分度均减弱，但QMG仍表现最佳。MG-MMT≥3分下降在所有分析中表现最为一致。总结/结论：大多数患者达到最小临床改善，但时间线和预测因素因终点定义而异。基于TG的定义更好地区分了患者轨迹。已发表的MCD阈值在QMG和MG-MMT中得到确认，尤其是在基于TG的定义下。

abstracts.title: A Case of Autoimmune Limbic Encephalitis, Myasthenia Gravis, and Malignant Thymoma
abstracts.authors: Ho, Marjorie; Kim, Jocelyn; Davila-siliezar, Pamela; Duarte-Celada, Walter
abstracts.affiliations: Texas Tech University Health Sciences, Lubbock, TX; TTUHSC, Midland, TX
abstracts.abstract: Objective: Both anti-glutamic acid decarboxylase 65 (GAD65) limbic encephalitis (LE) and myasthenia gravis (MG) have been associated with thymomas. However, in very rare instances these two autoimmune diseases coexist together. We present a case of MG associated to malignant thymoma, who also developed a challenging case of LE. Background: N/A Design/Methods: N/A Results: A 46-year-old man presented with a 3-month history of transient diplopia and generalized weakness that worsened through the day. He was found to have seropositive MG and started on pyridostigmine; associated with malignant thymoma and underwent surgical resection next month Five months later, he developed new onset seizures and following his surgery, he developed agitation and confusion. Seizures were difficult to control. He underwent serial magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brain, which showed multiple evolving subcortical/cortical T2 hyperintense lesions over the next 2 months, none of them with contrast enhancement. The lesions were bilateral, mainly affecting the left temporal lobe, but also affecting the right occipital, and bilateral frontal lobes. The electroencephalogram showed epileptogenicity from the left temporo-occipital region and right frontal area. Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) did not reveal evidence of infection. Levetiracetam failed to control the seizures, and was later switched to brivaracetam and phenytoin. Due to concern of autoimmune encephalitis, patient was started on high-dose steroids followed by cyclophosphamide. Serum and CSF autoimmune encephalitis panel yielded a positive result for anti-GAD65. The addition of steroids and anti-epileptic drugs finally controlled the seizure Conclusions: This case highlights the rare coexistence of anti-GAD65 limbic encephalitis and MG in the same patient, probably converging together by a malignant thymoma. Anti-GAD65 LE has been associated with seizures and behavioral changes; rarely linked to malignant tumors (4-6%), most commonly thymoma. Only one other cases of anti-GAD encephalitis associated to MG have been reported in the literature.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：抗谷氨酸脱羧酶65（GAD65）边缘叶脑炎（LE）和重症肌无力（MG）均与胸腺瘤相关。然而，这两种自身免疫性疾病同时存在的情况非常罕见。我们报告一例与恶性胸腺瘤相关的MG病例，该患者还出现了具有挑战性的LE病例。背景：不适用 设计/方法：不适用 结果：一名46岁男性，有3个月的短暂复视和全身无力病史，症状在一天中加重。他被发现为血清阳性MG，并开始使用吡啶斯的明；与恶性胸腺瘤相关，并于一个月后接受了手术切除。五个月后，他出现新发癫痫，并且在手术后出现躁动和意识模糊。癫痫难以控制。他在接下来的2个月内接受了系列脑磁共振成像（MRI），显示多个进展性皮质下/皮质T2高信号病灶，均无对比增强。病灶为双侧性，主要影响左侧颞叶，但也影响右侧枕叶和双侧额叶。脑电图显示左侧颞枕区和右侧额叶区域有致痫性。脑脊液（CSF）未显示感染证据。左乙拉西坦未能控制癫痫，后来改用布瓦西坦和苯妥英。由于担心自身免疫性脑炎，患者开始接受大剂量类固醇治疗，随后使用环磷酰胺。血清和CSF自身免疫性脑炎小组检测出抗GAD65阳性。添加类固醇和抗癫痫药物最终控制了癫痫。结论：本病例强调了抗GAD65边缘叶脑炎和MG在同一患者中的罕见共存，可能由恶性胸腺瘤共同介导。抗GAD65 LE与癫痫和行为改变相关；很少与恶性肿瘤相关（4-6%），最常见的是胸腺瘤。文献中仅报道过另一例与MG相关的抗GAD脑炎病例。

abstracts.title: An Atypical Presentation of Neurosyphilis Mimicking Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Siddiqui, Hammad; Khan, Haris; Hamed, Laith; Ali, Arsalan
abstracts.affiliations: Texas College of Osteopathic Medicine, Richardson, TX; UNTHSC College of Biomedical and Translational Sciences, TX; USF Morsani College of Medicine, TX; University of Texas at Dallas, TX
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To present an atypical case of neurosyphilis masking as suspected Myasthenia Gravis at initial time of presentation. Background: Neurosyphilis is a CNS infection caused by Treponema Pallidum and typically presents with a plethora of symptoms ranging from tabes dorsalis, cranial nerve palsies, stroke-like symptoms, and personality changes. Due to the multitude and variation of symptoms aligning with other disease states, neurosyphilis is known as the great Mimicker. Design/Methods: N/A Results: A 53-year-old male with past medical history of rectal polyps, prior stroke, motor vehicular accident, and type 2 diabetes, presented with severe constipation for two months with a two-week history of blurry vision, ataxia, bilateral ptosis, dysphagia, and dysarthria. Physical examination revealed ⅘ strength in the bilateral lower extremities, areflexia, and decreased sensation to pinprick and light touch. He was initially diagnosed with Myasthenia Gravis, for which he was started on Mestinon. Imaging studies yielded no acute intracranial abnormalities or large vessel occlusion/stenosis. A lumbar puncture was performed, which showed elevated protein and leukocytosis. He was then started on a 5-day course of IVIG for suspected Miller-Fisher syndrome. CSF culture was negative for GQ1b antibody, and viral PCR for VZV and HSV 1 & 2 yielded negative results. ANA, MPO IgG, and proteinase–3 IgG were also negative. His RPR titer result was positive at 1:64, as well as a positive CSF VDRL, which confirmed the diagnosis of neurosyphilis. He was started on IV penicillin, and showed marked improvement in his symptoms. Conclusions: Patients presenting with subacute neurologic symptoms and indeterminate workups should have neurosyphilis as a differential diagnosis. CSF analysis and serologic testing facilitate early diagnosis and treatment planning, which are critical for timely clinical recovery.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：评估美国商业保险的全身型重症肌无力（gMG）儿童患者的加重和肌无力危象发生率，并识别与危象和反复加重相关的风险因素。背景：MG中的临床事件代价高昂，反复事件表明疾病管理不足。设计/方法：从MarketScan®商业保险数据（2010年1月1日至2025年6月30日）中识别2-17岁的MG患者，依据为≥1次住院或≥2次门诊索赔（60天内）以及首次合格MG诊断（索引日期）前连续参保≥6个月。分别计算2-11岁和12-17岁年龄组的加重和危象发生率。为评估与危象和反复加重相关的因素，采用巢式病例对照设计，将随访期间发生事件的患者视为病例（相应事件日期作为新病例索引日期），未发生事件的患者视为对照（随访结束日期作为新对照索引日期）。使用新索引日期前6个月的时间段预选风险因素。结果：研究纳入508例gMG患者（226例2-11岁；282例12-17岁）。超过25%的2-11岁儿童在随访期间经历了≥1次加重，15.5%经历了≥1次危象；每100人年的发生率（95%置信区间[CI]）为加重18.2（11.4–29.1），危象9.3（5.1-17.1）。在12-17岁组中，34.8%和16.7%经历了加重和危象；发生率分别为22.8（16.9-30.1）和7.3（4.7-11.4）。Logistic回归模型发现，女性、既往加重、乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂、皮质类固醇和静脉注射免疫球蛋白治疗与反复加重和危象显著相关。结论：儿童gMG患者临床事件发生率较高。危象和反复加重与既往加重和常见MG治疗相关。本研究强调了该患者人群中MG的负担，以及需要改进治疗以减轻疾病负担。

abstracts.title: Cardiovascular Manifestations in Myasthenia Gravis: Beyond the Neuromuscular Junction
abstracts.authors: Riaño, Diana; Cardenas Cruz, Andres Felipe; Rebolledo Del Toro, Martin; Ricaurte-Fajardo, Andres; Marentes, Alba Lucia
abstracts.affiliations: Pontificia Universidad Javeriana, Colombia
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To characterize structural, electrical, and autonomic cardiovascular manifestations in patients with myasthenia gravis (MG) evaluated at a tertiary university hospital in Colombia. Background: Although MG is classically a disorder of the neuromuscular junction, cardiovascular involvement—ranging from arrhythmias and myocarditis to autonomic dysfunction—has been increasingly recognized, affecting 10–16% of patients. Pathophysiologic mechanisms include thymoma-associated myocarditis and cross-reactive autoantibodies such as anti-Kv1.4. Evidence of baroreflex asynergy and nocturnal sympathetic hyperactivity suggests an underdiagnosed form of cardiac dysautonomia in MG. Design/Methods: A descriptive case-series study included adults (≥18 years) with confirmed MG evaluated between January 2019 and January 2025 at Hospital Universitario San Ignacio, Bogotá. Demographic, clinical, and immunologic data (anti-acetylcholine receptor [AChR] and anti-muscle-specific kinase [MuSK] antibodies), thymoma status, and treatment were recorded. Cardiovascular assessment included symptoms, 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG), and transthoracic echocardiography (TTE). Autonomic modulation was evaluated using the ΔHR/ΔSBP index (change in heart rate per change in systolic blood pressure), calculated by linear regression for daytime and nighttime intervals. Quantitative variables were analyzed using Mann–Whitney U tests. Results: Fourteen patients were included (median age 55.5 years; 71% female). Thymoma was present in 43%, and 50% were receiving immunosuppressive therapy. Cardiovascular symptoms included palpitations (71%), hypotension (29%), and chest pain (21%). ECG abnormalities were frequent: sinus tachycardia (5), atrial flutter (2), sinus bradycardia (2), atrial fibrillation (1), prolonged QTc (1), and low voltage (2). Only 4 patients had normal ECGs. Mean left ventricular ejection fraction was 60.7% vs 62.8% in patients without ECG alterations (p = 0.517). Scatterplot analysis of the ΔHR/ΔSBP index revealed baroreflex asynergy and nocturnal sympathetic overactivity in several cases. Conclusions: Cardiovascular manifestations in MG may be subclinical yet diverse, encompassing arrhythmias and autonomic dysregulation. Routine ECG, TTE, and circadian autonomic assessment could facilitate early detection and multidisciplinary management of this underrecognized complication.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：描述在哥伦比亚一所三级大学医院评估的重症肌无力（MG）患者的结构性、电生理性和自主神经性心血管表现。背景：尽管MG经典上是一种神经肌肉接头的疾病，但心血管受累——范围从心律失常和心肌炎到自主神经功能障碍——已越来越多地被认识到，影响10-16%的患者。病理生理机制包括胸腺瘤相关心肌炎和交叉反应性自身抗体如抗Kv1.4。压力反射不协调和夜间交感神经过度活跃的证据表明MG中存在一种未被充分诊断的心脏自主神经病变形式。设计/方法：一项描述性病例系列研究，纳入2019年1月至2025年1月期间在波哥大San Ignacio大学医院评估的经确诊MG的成人（≥18岁）。记录了人口统计学、临床和免疫学数据（抗乙酰胆碱受体[AChR]和抗肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶[MuSK]抗体）、胸腺瘤状态和治疗。心血管评估包括症状、12导联心电图（ECG）和经胸超声心动图（TTE）。使用ΔHR/ΔSBP指数（心率变化与收缩压变化之比）评估自主神经调节，通过线性回归计算白天和夜间间隔。使用Mann-Whitney U检验分析定量变量。结果：纳入14名患者（中位年龄55.5岁；71%为女性）。胸腺瘤占43%，50%正在接受免疫抑制治疗。心血管症状包括心悸（71%）、低血压（29%）和胸痛（21%）。ECG异常常见：窦性心动过速（5例）、心房扑动（2例）、窦性心动过缓（2例）、心房颤动（1例）、QTc延长（1例）和低电压（2例）。仅4名患者ECG正常。平均左心室射血分数为60.7%，而ECG无改变的患者为62.8%（p = 0.517）。ΔHR/ΔSBP指数的散点图分析显示，数例患者存在压力反射不协调和夜间交感神经过度活跃。结论：MG中的心血管表现可能是亚临床的，但多种多样，包括心律失常和自主神经调节失调。常规ECG、TTE和昼夜自主神经评估可能有助于早期发现和多学科管理这种未被充分认识的并发症。

abstracts.title: Designing AChR-mimicking Nanobody Decoys to Neutralize Pathogenic IgG1 Autoantibodies in Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Gavande, Dev; Ramamoorthy, Divya
abstracts.affiliations: Dr. Justin Wakeland High School, Frisco, TX; Moxie Scientist, Georgetown, TX
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To design nanobody-based decoys that mimic the α1-subunit of the acetylcholine receptor (AChR), preferentially binding to Immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) autoantibodies, preventing antibody blocking and antigenic modulation in Myasthenia Gravis (MG). Background: Myasthenia Gravis is an autoimmune neuromuscular disorder primarily caused by IgG1 and IgG3 autoantibodies that target the AChR at the neuromuscular junction, impairing muscle activation and causing weakness through antibody blocking, antigenic modulation, and complement activation. The α1-subunit of AChR, particularly its Main Immunogenic Region (MIR), is the primary site recognized by IgG1. Design/Methods: In-silico modeling was conducted using Schrödinger Suite (BioLuminate, Maestro). Protein-protein interactions between AChR and IgG1 (PDB: 5HBT), were analyzed to identify key residue interactions. Residue scanning was performed to predict beneficial mutations enhancing stability and Prime-MMGBSA calculations were used to evaluate the binding free energies of the engineered decoys. Results: Protein interaction analysis (PIA) revealed key interactions on residues 30-39 and 8-10 inclusively on the AChR receptor. The results from PIA were carried forward for the residue scanning calculations to identify multiple α1-subunit fragments that could be mutated and truncated into smaller engineered Pepenzymes (Peptide nano enzymes). Prime-MMGBSA (Molecular Mechanics Generalized Born Surface Area) calculations showed that specific mutated Pepenzymes significantly lowered binding free energy, suggesting stronger and more stable antibody interactions compared to native AChR. The mutants that showed significant improvement in the MMGBSA scores were 71F (-46.55 kcal/mol) and 70T (-45.78 kcal/mol) compared to the WT (-29.36 kcal/mol). Structural visualization confirmed that these designed decoys preserved critical epitope structural elements. Conclusions: This study demonstrates that computationally designed nanobody decoys can mimic the AChR α1-subunit and preferentially bind to pathogenic IgG1 autoantibodies, as the decoy had ~1.5x the binding free energy compared to the wild type. By diverting antibody activity away from native receptors, this approach offers a targeted, non-immunosuppressive therapeutic strategy for Myasthenia Gravis.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：设计基于纳米抗体的诱饵，模拟乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）的α1亚基，优先结合免疫球蛋白G1（IgG1）自身抗体，阻止重症肌无力（MG）中的抗体阻断和抗原调节。背景：重症肌无力是一种自身免疫性神经肌肉疾病，主要由靶向神经肌肉接头处AChR的IgG1和IgG3自身抗体引起，通过抗体阻断、抗原调节和补体激活损害肌肉激活并导致无力。AChR的α1亚基，特别是其主要免疫原区（MIR），是IgG1识别的主要位点。设计/方法：使用Schrödinger Suite（BioLuminate, Maestro）进行计算机模拟建模。分析了AChR与IgG1（PDB: 5HBT）之间的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用，以识别关键的残基相互作用。进行残基扫描以预测增强稳定性的有益突变，并使用Prime-MMGBSA计算评估工程化诱饵的结合自由能。结果：蛋白质相互作用分析（PIA）揭示了AChR受体上残基30-39和8-10的关键相互作用。PIA的结果被用于残基扫描计算，以识别多个α1亚基片段，这些片段可以被突变和截短成更小的工程化Pepenzymes（肽纳米酶）。Prime-MMGBSA（分子力学广义玻恩表面积）计算显示，特定的突变Pepenzymes显著降低了结合自由能，表明与天然AChR相比，抗体相互作用更强、更稳定。在MMGBSA评分中显示出显著改善的突变体是71F（-46.55 kcal/mol）和70T（-45.78 kcal/mol），而野生型（WT）为-29.36 kcal/mol。结构可视化证实，这些设计的诱饵保留了关键的表位结构元素。结论：本研究表明，计算机设计的纳米抗体诱饵可以模拟AChR α1亚基并优先结合致病性IgG1自身抗体，因为诱饵的结合自由能约为野生型的1.5倍。通过将抗体活性从天然受体转移开，这种方法为重症肌无力提供了一种靶向的、非免疫抑制的治疗策略。

abstracts.title: Muscle Specific Kinase Antibody Positive Myasthenia Gravis With Thymoma: A Rare Case Report
abstracts.authors: Elena, Rosario Mercedes; Moroni, Agustina; Rugiero Rodriguez, Marcelo; Bettini, Mariela; Kenny, Juan Ignacio
abstracts.affiliations: Italian Hospital of Buenos Aires, CABA, Argentina
abstracts.abstract: Objective: N/A Background: Approximately 10–20% of patients with myasthenia gravis (MG) have thymoma-associated MG, characterized by the presence of a thymic epithelial tumor or thymoma. Anti–acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibodies are detected in the vast majority of these patients. In contrast, thymic abnormalities are uncommon in patients with muscle-specific kinase (MuSK) antibody–positive MG. Design/Methods: N/A Results: We report the case of an 80-year-old male patient with a history of thymoma incidentally identified on follow-up thoracic imaging after a respiratory infection. Complete thymectomy revealed a WHO type B2 thymoma, Masaoka stage IIa. One month postoperatively, the patient developed binocular diplopia. After six months, he reported dysphagia, and at nine months he was referred to neurology for dysarthria and fluctuating nasal speech. Neurological examination revealed bilateral ptosis, diplopia in primary gaze, and nasal voice exacerbated by fatigability maneuvers, with no additional relevant findings. Laboratory studies showed elevated TSH levels; brain and orbital MRI revealed no significant abnormalities. AChR antibodies were negative (<0.02 nMol/L) on two separate radioimmunoassays. Single-fiber electromyography of the orbicularis oculi muscle showed increased jitter (97.3 µs) and blocking, consistent with impaired neuromuscular transmission. A trial of cholinesterase inhibitors was poorly tolerated due to gastrointestinal adverse effects and was discontinued. Given the high clinical suspicion of myasthenic syndrome, oral methylprednisolone was initiated and titrated to 20 mg/day, resulting in marked improvement in approximately six weeks. Subsequently, anti–MuSK antibodies were tested and found to be positive at 1.53 nMol/L (positive >0.05 nMol/L) using radioimmunoassay. Conclusions: To the best of the authors’ knowledge, only five cases of thymoma-associated myasthenia gravis seronegative for AChR antibodies but positive for anti-MuSK antibodies have been reported in the literature to date. Further studies are warranted to clarify the underlying mechanisms of this association.
