abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：不适用。背景：约10-20%的重症肌无力（MG）患者患有胸腺瘤相关MG，其特征是存在胸腺上皮肿瘤或胸腺瘤。绝大多数这些患者可检测到抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体。相比之下，肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶（MuSK）抗体阳性的MG患者中胸腺异常并不常见。设计/方法：不适用。结果：我们报告一例80岁男性患者，有胸腺瘤病史，在呼吸道感染后随访胸部影像时偶然发现。完全胸腺切除术显示WHO B2型胸腺瘤，Masaoka IIa期。术后一个月，患者出现双眼复视。六个月后，他报告吞咽困难，九个月时因构音障碍和波动性鼻音被转诊至神经科。神经系统检查显示双侧上睑下垂、原发性凝视复视以及疲劳试验加重的鼻音，无其他相关发现。实验室检查显示TSH水平升高；脑部和眼眶MRI未见明显异常。两次独立的放射免疫测定中AChR抗体均为阴性（<0.02 nMol/L）。眼轮匝肌的单纤维肌电图显示颤抖增加（97.3 µs）和阻滞，与神经肌肉传递受损一致。胆碱酯酶抑制剂试验因胃肠道不良反应耐受性差而停用。鉴于肌无力综合征的临床高度怀疑，开始口服甲泼尼龙并逐渐加量至20 mg/天，约六周后显著改善。随后，使用放射免疫测定法检测抗MuSK抗体，结果为阳性，为1.53 nMol/L（阳性>0.05 nMol/L）。结论：据作者所知，迄今为止文献中仅报道了五例AChR抗体阴性但抗MuSK抗体阳性的胸腺瘤相关重症肌无力病例。需要进一步研究以阐明这种关联的潜在机制。

abstracts.title: Myasthenia Dx -App: A Structured Tool for The Diagnosis of Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Prakash, Swayam; Das Gupta, Ishan
abstracts.affiliations: KINS Institute of Neurosciences, Siliguri, India
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To develop an objective, standardized and efficient diagnostic tool and reporting system for Ice test and Neostigmine test for the diagnosis of Myasthenia Gravis by way of a smart phone App (Myasthenia -Dx). Background: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is a rare autoimmune neurological disorder affecting neuromuscular junction causing fluctuating muscle weakness and fatigue. It has two major forms, Ocular Myasthenia Gravis (OMG) and Generalized Myasthenia Gravis (GMG). In OMG symptoms are restricted to the eye muscles, causing ptosis and diplopia whereas in GMG, symptoms are more generalized. More than 50% of patients of MG have ocular presentation. Ice test and Neostigmine test are simple yet high value bed side diagnostic tool for MG, however, objective and structured methods of reporting is lacking, and no smart phone-based diagnostic-application exists as of date. Design/Methods: Suspected patients of MG with ocular features are taken for Ice Test first then subsequently Neostigmine Test using Myasthenia-Dx App. The app integrates two key diagnostic procedures into a guided workflow (vide QR code), allowing clinicians to systematically document patient demographics and clinical findings, capture standardized facial photographs at intervals, record objective clinical measurements viz. Palpebral Fissure, MRD and automatically generate structured reports facilitating quick bedside diagnosis. If margin reflex distance (MRD) or mid-pupillary diameter of Palpebral fissure increases by 2 mm or more, test is reported positive otherwise negative. Results: Ice test is highly sensitive (86-92%) and specific (79-100%) for MG, making it the fastest, simplest and the most risk-free clinical test, whereas Neostigmine test has a sensitivity approx. 85% and specificity 84-100%. However, false negative and false positive results can occur. Conclusions: Myasthenia-Dx is a clinical decision-support tool designed to streamline the diagnostic process for Myasthenia Gravis. This app reduces manual effort, improves documentation accuracy, and enhances efficiency during initial patient assessments for suspected Myasthenia Gravis

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：通过智能手机应用程序（Myasthenia-Dx）开发一种客观、标准化且高效的诊断工具和报告系统，用于重症肌无力（MG）诊断的冰试验和新斯的明试验。背景：重症肌无力是一种罕见的自身免疫性神经肌肉疾病，影响神经肌肉接头，导致波动性肌肉无力和疲劳。它有两种主要形式：眼肌型重症肌无力（OMG）和全身型重症肌无力（GMG）。在OMG中，症状局限于眼肌，引起上睑下垂和复视，而在GMG中，症状更为全身化。超过50%的MG患者有眼部表现。冰试验和新斯的明试验是MG简单但高价值的床旁诊断工具，然而，缺乏客观和结构化的报告方法，且迄今为止不存在基于智能手机的诊断应用程序。设计/方法：疑似有眼部特征的MG患者首先使用Myasthenia-Dx应用程序进行冰试验，随后进行新斯的明试验。该应用程序将两个关键诊断程序整合到一个引导工作流程中（见二维码），允许临床医生系统地记录患者人口统计学和临床发现，按时间间隔拍摄标准化面部照片，记录客观临床测量值（如睑裂高度、MRD），并自动生成结构化报告，促进快速床旁诊断。如果边缘反射距离（MRD）或瞳孔中点睑裂直径增加2 mm或更多，则报告为阳性，否则为阴性。结果：冰试验对MG高度敏感（86-92%）和特异（79-100%），使其成为最快、最简单且最无风险的临床测试，而新斯的明试验的敏感性约为85%，特异性为84-100%。然而，可能出现假阴性和假阳性结果。结论：Myasthenia-Dx是一种临床决策支持工具，旨在简化重症肌无力的诊断过程。该应用程序减少了手动工作，提高了文档准确性，并提高了疑似重症肌无力患者初始评估的效率。

abstracts.title: Rippling Muscle as an Isolated Symptom of Antibody Positive Myasthenia Gravis: Case Report
abstracts.authors: Fry, Colin; Malik, Rabia
abstracts.affiliations: Rush University Medical Center, Chicago, IL
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To describe a case of isolated muscle rippling as the sole manifestation of antibody-positive myasthenia gravis (MG) confirmed by single-fiber electromyography (SFEMG). Background: Rippling muscle disease can be hereditary or immune-mediated, with the latter associated with myasthenia gravis. Muscle rippling without muscle weakness or fatigue has not been well characterized in the literature. Immune mediated muscle rippling disease (iRMD) with myasthenia gravis (MG) was first reported in the 1990s by Drs. Ansevin and Agamanolis. Since the initial description, more publications have described an association between iRMD and MG with or without thymoma or positive serum acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibodies. Cases have been published describing alleviation of muscle rippling correlating with remission of myasthenic symptoms with proper immunotherapy. To our knowledge, isolated muscle rippling as the initial and sole manifestation of MG has not previously been reported. Design/Methods: Clinical, serologic, and electrodiagnostic evaluations were performed in a patient presenting with isolated muscle rippling. SFEMG was used to assess neuromuscular transmission. A literature review was conducted to examine proposed mechanisms linking immune-mediated RMD and MG. Results: A 59-year-old male presented with 6 months of odd sensations, spontaneous movements of muscles, and elevated serum creatinine kinase. These movements were described as waves across his thighs and calves with activation and subsequent relaxation. He denied any weakness, eyelid drooping, double vision, or speech changes. Genetic testing, including the CAV3 gene, was negative. He was found to have positive AChR antibodies. He also had an EMG capturing these muscle movements, that were shown to be electrodiagnostically silent. Subsequent single-fiber EMG showed mildly abnormal jitter consistent with MG. Chest CT did not reveal evidence of a mediastinal mass. Conclusions: Muscle rippling is a rarely associated finding in myasthenia gravis. In isolation, it should be considered as an early presenting sign of MG, prompting workup including AChR antibody testing and EMG.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：描述一例孤立性肌肉波动作为抗体阳性重症肌无力（MG）唯一表现，并经单纤维肌电图（SFEMG）证实的病例。背景：波动性肌肉疾病可以是遗传性或免疫介导的，后者与重症肌无力相关。无肌肉无力或疲劳的肌肉波动在文献中尚未得到很好的描述。伴有重症肌无力（MG）的免疫介导的波动性肌肉疾病（iRMD）最早由Ansevin和Agamanolis博士在1990年代报道。自最初描述以来，更多出版物描述了iRMD与MG（伴或不伴胸腺瘤或血清乙酰胆碱受体[AChR]抗体阳性）之间的关联。已发表的病例描述了肌肉波动的缓解与适当的免疫治疗后肌无力症状的缓解相关。据我们所知，孤立性肌肉波动作为MG的首发和唯一表现此前尚未报道。设计/方法：对一名表现为孤立性肌肉波动的患者进行了临床、血清学和电诊断评估。使用SFEMG评估神经肌肉传递。进行了文献回顾以检查连接免疫介导的RMD和MG的拟议机制。结果：一名59岁男性，表现为6个月的奇怪感觉、肌肉自发运动和血清肌酸激酶升高。这些运动被描述为在激活和随后放松时，大腿和小腿上的波浪状。他否认任何无力、眼睑下垂、复视或言语改变。基因检测，包括CAV3基因，为阴性。发现其AChR抗体阳性。他还有一次EMG捕捉到了这些肌肉运动，显示为电诊断学上的静息。随后的单纤维EMG显示轻度异常的颤抖，符合MG。胸部CT未显示纵隔肿块证据。结论：肌肉波动是重症肌无力中一种罕见的伴随发现。孤立出现时，应被视为MG的早期表现体征，促使进行包括AChR抗体检测和EMG在内的检查。

abstracts.title: Severe Transient Neonatal Myasthenia Gravis in a Late Preterm Infant: Diagnostic and Management Challenges
abstracts.authors: Kieu, Quynh; Shah, Naman; Thomas, Julian; Kayyal, Simon
abstracts.affiliations: CHOC, Orange, CA; CHOC, Long Beach, CA; CHOC, Houston, TX
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To describe the diagnostic and management challenges of severe transient neonatal myasthenia gravis (TNMG) in a late preterm infant with a significant family history. Background: TNMG is a rare, self-limited disorder affecting 10–15% of neonates born to mothers with myasthenia gravis (MG), due to transplacental transfer of maternal anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibodies. Clinical features include hypotonia, respiratory distress, and feeding difficulties, often mimicking other neuromuscular disorders. Family history and maternal disease severity may influence neonatal outcomes. Design/Methods: We report newborn delivered via emergent cesarean section for cord prolapse, born to a mother with MG and severe polyhydramnios. At birth, the infant was hypotonic, apneic, and cyanotic, requiring positive pressure ventilation. Neurologic exam showed profound hypotonia, absent suck and Moro reflexes, minimal spontaneous movement, preserved deep tendon reflexes, and left elbow arthrogryposis. Family history included a sibling with TNMG requiring IVIg and cholinesterase inhibitors. Laboratory evaluation revealed elevated AChR antibodies. A neostigmine trial led to clinical improvement, confirming TNMG. Management included respiratory support, pyridostigmine, and IVIg, with serial neurologic assessments and antibody monitoring. Plasmapheresis was considered but not performed due to limited evidence in neonates. Results: The patient gradually improved in tone, alertness, and respiratory function over several weeks. Respiratory support and cholinesterase inhibitors were weaned based on clinical status, with monitoring for side effects. Despite persistent thick secretions and intermittent respiratory setbacks, the patient showed progressive neurologic recovery. Antibody levels remained elevated but are expected to decline over 4–6 months. Conclusions: This case underscores the complexities of diagnosing and managing severe TNMG, especially with significant family history and maternal MG. Early recognition, individualized supportive care, and multidisciplinary collaboration are essential. Cholinesterase inhibitors and IVIg are mainstays of therapy, while the role of plasmapheresis in neonates remains uncertain. Serial antibody monitoring may aid prognosis and management.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：描述一例有显著家族史的晚期早产儿发生严重短暂性新生儿重症肌无力（TNMG）的诊断和管理挑战。背景：TNMG是一种罕见的自限性疾病，影响10–15%的重症肌无力（MG）母亲所生的新生儿，由母体抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体经胎盘转移引起。临床特征包括肌张力低下、呼吸窘迫和喂养困难，常与其他神经肌肉疾病相似。家族史和母体疾病严重程度可能影响新生儿结局。设计/方法：我们报告一名因脐带脱垂行紧急剖宫产分娩的新生儿，其母亲患有MG和严重羊水过多。出生时，婴儿出现肌张力低下、呼吸暂停和发绀，需要正压通气。神经系统检查显示严重肌张力低下、吸吮反射和莫罗反射消失、自主运动极少、深腱反射保留以及左肘关节弯曲。家族史包括一名需要IVIg和胆碱酯酶抑制剂的TNMG同胞。实验室检查显示AChR抗体升高。新斯的明试验导致临床改善，证实了TNMG。管理包括呼吸支持、吡啶斯的明和IVIg，并进行系列神经系统评估和抗体监测。考虑过血浆置换，但由于新生儿中证据有限而未进行。结果：患者在数周内逐渐改善肌张力、警觉性和呼吸功能。根据临床状况逐渐减少呼吸支持和胆碱酯酶抑制剂，并监测副作用。尽管存在持续性浓稠分泌物和间歇性呼吸挫折，患者显示出进行性神经功能恢复。抗体水平仍升高，但预计将在4–6个月内下降。结论：本病例强调了诊断和管理严重TNMG的复杂性，尤其是在有显著家族史和母体MG的情况下。早期识别、个体化支持治疗和多学科协作至关重要。胆碱酯酶抑制剂和IVIg是治疗的主要手段，而血浆置换在新生儿中的作用仍不确定。系列抗体监测可能有助于预后和管理。

abstracts.title: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy in patients with myasthenia gravis, 2023
abstracts.authors: Ahmed, Naba
abstracts.affiliations: Sudan University of science and technology, faculty of medicine, Dongola, Sudan
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To identify the mechanism of how myasthenia gravis can cause takotsubo cardiomyopathy during myasthenic crisis Background: Myasthenia gravis associated with takotsubo cardiomyopathy (broken heart syndrome) is a rare condition but a life threatening. Broken heart syndrome is reversible apical ballooning like dilation of left ventricle related to stress Design/Methods: This is a systematic review of previously reported cases of patients with myasthenia gravis developed takotsubo cardiomyopathy, worldwide 2003-2023, pubmed and google scholar, to analyze and find out the definitive treatment and ways of prevention from it Results: Cases reported previously indicate that takotsubo cardiomyopathy developed in patients with myasthenia gravis during myasthenic crisis in the second day of admission with worsened dyspnea, low ejection fraction, short PR - interval, QT-prolongation and T wave inversion on electrocardiogram; most cases have been occurred in female, and most cases were of age of more than 15 years, especially in presence of thymectomy due to malignant thymoma; some cases have been associated with diabetes mellitus and low frequency smoking history; most cases have been improved with anticholinergic (pyridostigmine) and plasma exchange, NSAIDs (prednisone), and immunoglobulines for myasthenia gravis, dobutamine for takotsubo cardiomyopathy, and ventilator support for respiratory events from myasthenia gravis. Inotropes and vasopressor have been led to poor outcomes; it has been hypothesized that exess catecholamin stimulation cause stress on cardiac muscles presented as takotsubo cardiomyopathy (stress related cardiomyopathy); most cases have been occurred in European and American decent. Conclusions: As physical and emotional stress cause takotsubo cardiomyopathy, they are also a risk factor for developing myasthenia gravis, so avoiding stressful conditions is a prevention, and monitoring cardiac manifestation in myasthenic crisis’s patients with cardiac MRI is very important.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：确定重症肌无力在肌无力危象期间如何导致应激性心肌病的机制。背景：重症肌无力相关的应激性心肌病（心碎综合征）是一种罕见但危及生命的疾病。心碎综合征是一种与压力相关的可逆性左心室心尖部气球样扩张。设计/方法：这是一项对2003–2023年全球范围内已报道的重症肌无力患者发生应激性心肌病病例的系统综述，检索PubMed和Google Scholar，以分析并找出明确的治疗和预防方法。结果：先前报道的病例表明，应激性心肌病在重症肌无力患者肌无力危象期间发生，通常在入院第二天出现呼吸困难加重、射血分数降低、PR间期缩短、QT间期延长和心电图T波倒置；大多数病例发生在女性，且大多数病例年龄超过15岁，尤其是在因恶性胸腺瘤行胸腺切除术的情况下；部分病例伴有糖尿病和低频吸烟史；大多数病例通过抗胆碱能药物（吡啶斯的明）和血浆置换、非甾体抗炎药（泼尼松）和免疫球蛋白治疗重症肌无力，多巴酚丁胺治疗应激性心肌病，以及呼吸机支持治疗重症肌无力的呼吸事件而改善。正性肌力药和血管升压药导致不良结局；假设过量的儿茶酚胺刺激对心肌造成压力，表现为应激性心肌病（压力相关心肌病）；大多数病例发生在欧洲和美洲血统人群中。结论：由于身体和情绪压力会导致应激性心肌病，它们也是发生重症肌无力的危险因素，因此避免压力情况是一种预防措施，并且对肌无力危象患者进行心脏MRI监测心脏表现非常重要。

abstracts.title: Thymoma-associated Dual Autoimmunity: A Case Report of Morvan's Syndrome in a Patient with Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Yandamuri, Sai Pratibha; Guruswamy, Anantha
abstracts.affiliations: Tbilisi State Medical University, Tbilisi, Georgia; NMC Speciality Hospital, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
abstracts.abstract: Objective: To report a rare case of thymoma-associated Morvan’s syndrome developing years after myasthenia gravis, highlighting that overlapping symptoms can delay diagnosis, and emphasizing the importance of comprehensive antibody evaluation and electrophysiologic studies to uncover additional paraneoplastic disorders. Background: Morvan’s syndrome (MoS) is a rare autoimmune disorder, characterized by peripheral nerve hyperexcitability, autonomic dysfunction and neuropsychiatric manifestations such as insomnia and hallucinations. The condition is most frequently associated with antibodies against contactin-associated protein-like 2 (CASPR2), and has a strong paraneoplastic association with thymoma. Thymic tumors can induce a spectrum of autoimmune responses, among which myasthenia gravis (MG) is the most common. The coexistence of MoS and MG reflects the shared thymoma-driven immune dysregulation, but is distinctly uncommon. When MoS develops years after established MG, early manifestations like twitching, fatigue, or insomnia may be misattributed to drug effects or myasthenic symptoms making diagnosis challenging. Design/Methods: A 35-year-old man with thymoma-associated acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive MG diagnosed three years earlier and managed with mycophenolate mofetil, presented with three months of progressively worsening back pain, diffuse pruritus, muscle twitching, severe insomnia, and visual hallucinations. Examination showed diffuse muscle rippling, fasciculations, and weakness without fatigability. Autonomic dysfunction was evident with persistent severe hypertension, hyponatremia and recurrent hyperhidrosis. Electromyography revealed continuous neuromyotonic discharges and paraneoplastic antibody testing was positive for CASPR2 and negative for LGI1. These findings supported the diagnosis of thymoma-associated Morvan’s syndrome. The patient was treated with high dose intravenous methylprednisolone followed by a five-day course of intravenous immunoglobulin, with marked symptomatic improvement. Results: N/A Conclusions: This case demonstrates that thymoma may precipitate multiple autoimmune syndromes beyond myasthenia gravis, reminding clinicians that new neuromuscular or autonomic symptoms warrant reevaluation for paraneoplastic syndromes where early recognition and immunotherapy can significantly improve outcomes and quality of life.

abstracts.abstractZh: 目的：报告一例罕见的胸腺瘤相关莫旺综合征病例，该病例在重症肌无力发病数年后出现，强调重叠症状可能延误诊断，并强调全面抗体评估和电生理检查对于发现其他副肿瘤性疾病的重要性。背景：莫旺综合征（MoS）是一种罕见的自身免疫性疾病，其特征为周围神经过度兴奋、自主神经功能障碍以及失眠和幻觉等神经精神表现。该病最常与抗接触蛋白相关蛋白样2（CASPR2）抗体相关，并与胸腺瘤有强烈的副肿瘤性关联。胸腺肿瘤可诱导一系列自身免疫反应，其中重症肌无力（MG）最为常见。MoS和MG的共存反映了胸腺瘤驱动的共同免疫失调，但非常罕见。当MoS在确诊MG数年后出现时，早期表现如抽搐、疲劳或失眠可能被误认为是药物效应或肌无力症状，使诊断具有挑战性。设计/方法：一名35岁男性，三年前被诊断为胸腺瘤相关乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性MG，并接受霉酚酸酯治疗，出现进行性加重的背痛、弥漫性瘙痒、肌肉抽搐、严重失眠和幻视，持续三个月。检查显示弥漫性肌肉波动、肌束震颤和无力，无疲劳性。自主神经功能障碍表现为持续性严重高血压、低钠血症和反复多汗。肌电图显示持续性神经性肌强直放电，副肿瘤抗体检测显示CASPR2阳性，LGI1阴性。这些发现支持胸腺瘤相关莫旺综合征的诊断。患者接受了大剂量静脉注射甲泼尼龙治疗，随后进行了为期五天的静脉注射免疫球蛋白疗程，症状显著改善。结果：不适用。结论：本病例表明，胸腺瘤可能诱发重症肌无力以外的多种自身免疫综合征，提醒临床医生，新的神经肌肉或自主神经症状需要重新评估副肿瘤综合征，早期识别和免疫治疗可显著改善结局和生活质量。

abstracts.title: A Case of Misdiagnosed Myasthenia Gravis Revealing Myoadenylate Deaminase Deficiency
abstracts.authors: Alagumeena Meyyappan; Bineetha Aluri; Sean Ferris; Christina Chrisman
abstracts.affiliations: Phoenix, AZ; Tempe, AZ; Ann Arbor, MI
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION/BACKGROUND: This case report highlights the importance of investigating the diagnosis of myasthenia gravis (MG) in patients with poor treatment response and the consideration of myoadenylate deaminase deficiency in chronic exertional weakness. CASE REPORT: A 37-year-old female presented with diplopia, dyspnea, and generalized weakness. Serologic testing was positive for acetylcholine receptor modulating antibodies and negative for binding and blocking antibodies. The patient was diagnosed with MG and treatment with pyridostigmine, prednisone, and IVIg provided transient improvement. The patient continued to experience worsening dyspnea and fatigue with several emergency department visits. Seven years after initial diagnosis, she was evaluated by a neuromuscular specialist. Repetitive nerve stimulation revealed inconsistent decrement and needle EMG revealed myotonia in several muscles. Muscle biopsy was performed of the vastus lateralis, which showed myopathic changes. It was notable for lobulated fibers but no signs of inflammatory myopathy. A comprehensive genetic panel for neuromuscular disorders revealed two variants of uncertain significance in the AMPD1 gene. Subsequently, myoadenylate deaminase staining was performed on muscle biopsy and showed near-complete absence of myoadenylate deaminase activity. Immunotherapy was discontinued and the patient was started on D-ribose supplementation with clinical improvement. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Although myoadenylate deaminase deficiency is a rare metabolic myopathy, it should be considered in patients with exertional weakness, myopathic features, and poor response to immunotherapy. Genetic testing for the AMPD1 gene holds uncertain significance, as it is a biochemical phenotype which may or may not result in a clinical condition. However, adjunctive myoadenylate deaminase staining can be performed on muscle biopsy to assess myoadenylate deaminase activity and make a clinical diagnosis. Alagumeena Meyyappan, MD Resident and Fellow Member Award Recipient Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.title: A Case of Myasthenia Gravis Diagnosed by Single-fiber Electromyography
abstracts.authors: Julio Francisco López López; Nicolas Martinez Diaz; Carlos Rangel; Rosa Silva Valencia
abstracts.affiliations: Bogotá, Colombia
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an autoimmune disorder characterized by impaired neuromuscular junction transmission. Its prevalence ranges from 150 to 250 cases per million, with an estimated annual incidence of 8 to 10 cases per million. The most common clinical manifestations include ptosis, diplopia, facial and bulbar weakness, and limb muscle weakness. Single-fiber electromyography (SFEMG) is regarded as the most sensitive electrophysiological technique for detecting endplate dysfunction, with reported sensitivity of up to 97%, exceeding that of repetitive nerve stimulation (RNS). CASE REPORT: We report the case of a 63-year-old woman with a 15-year history of progressive fatigue and muscle weakness associated with left-sided ptosis and diplopia. Physical examination confirmed left eyelid ptosis. A SFEMG study of the left orbicularis oculi muscle demonstrated increased jitter and a blocking rate of 12.3%, findings consistent with impaired neuromuscular transmission. CONCLUSION: This case highlights the diagnostic value of SFEMG in patients presenting with chronic, fluctuating ocular symptoms suggestive of MG. The electrophysiological abnormalities provided objective evidence of endplate dysfunction, supporting the diagnosis after a prolonged clinical course. Given its high sensitivity, SFEMG remains an essential diagnostic tool, particularly in cases with subtle or predominantly ocular involvement, where other electrophysiological studies may be inconclusive. Early and accurate diagnosis is crucial to initiate appropriate therapy and prevent disease progression. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.title: Abnormal Spontaneous Activity in Mild Myasthenia Gravis: An Atypical Electromyographic Presentation
abstracts.authors: Sahaphum Taemeeyapradit
abstracts.affiliations: Bangkok, Thailand
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an autoimmune post-synaptic neuromuscular junction (NMJ) disorder. While repetitive nerve stimulation (RNS) typically shows a decremental response, EMG in NMJ disorders generally lacks abnormal spontaneous activity (ASA). Fibrillation potentials and positive sharp waves (PSWs) are rare in MG and historically have been confined to severe manifestations, such as myasthenic crisis, profound bulbar dysfunction, or respiratory failure. In such cases, chronic autoantibody-mediated blockade is thought to induce functional denervation. CASE REPORT: A 35-year-old female presented with a three-month progression of proximal limb weakness (MRC Grade IV) and jaw fatigue, consistent with Myasthenia Gravis Foundation of America (MGFA) Class IIa. The patient remained ambulatory without respiratory or significant bulbar symptoms. NCS findings were unremarkable; however, RNS confirmed an NMJ defect with a decrement in the trapezius and nasalis. Surprisingly, needle EMG revealed 1+ to 2+ fibrillation potentials and PSWs in multiple muscles. This prominent ASA and small-amplitude polyphasic motor units initially raised concern for an inflammatory myopathy. However, acetylcholine receptor antibody seropositivity and a negative myositis-specific antibody panel confirmed generalized MG. Following treatment with pyridostigmine and prednisolone, the patient achieved full clinical remission, and follow-up EMG demonstrated complete resolution of ASA and normalization of motor units. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: This case highlights that ASA is not exclusive to severe myasthenic crises and can occur in mild MG. The resolution of membrane irritability following standard therapy suggests that functional denervation occurs across a broader clinical spectrum than previously recognized. Clinicians should not exclude an NMJ disorder based on ASA, even in patients with mild symptoms. Sahaphum Taemeeyapradit, MD Resident and Fellow Member Award Recipient ANF International Scholarship Recipient Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）是一种自身免疫性突触后神经肌肉接头（NMJ）疾病。重复神经刺激（RNS）通常显示递减反应，而NMJ疾病的肌电图（EMG）一般缺乏异常自发电位（ASA）。纤颤电位和正锐波（PSWs）在MG中罕见，历史上仅限于严重表现，如肌无力危象、严重延髓功能障碍或呼吸衰竭。在这些情况下，认为慢性自身抗体介导的阻滞诱导了功能性失神经支配。病例报告：一名35岁女性，表现为进行性近端肢体无力（MRC IV级）和下颌疲劳三个月，符合美国重症肌无力基金会（MGFA）IIa级。患者仍可行走，无呼吸或明显延髓症状。神经传导检查（NCS）结果无异常；然而，RNS证实存在NMJ缺陷，斜方肌和鼻肌出现递减。令人意外的是，针极EMG在多个肌肉中显示1+至2+纤颤电位和PSWs。这种显著的ASA和小波幅多相运动单位最初引起对炎性肌病的担忧。然而，乙酰胆碱受体抗体血清阳性及肌炎特异性抗体谱阴性证实为全身型MG。接受吡啶斯的明和泼尼松龙治疗后，患者达到完全临床缓解，随访EMG显示ASA完全消失，运动单位恢复正常。总结/结论：本病例强调ASA并非仅见于严重肌无力危象，也可发生于轻度MG。标准治疗后膜兴奋性恢复提示功能性失神经支配发生的临床谱比既往认识更广。临床医生不应仅凭ASA排除NMJ疾病，即使在症状轻微的患者中也是如此。Sahaphum Taemeeyapradit，医学博士，住院医师及研究员会员奖获得者，ANF国际奖学金获得者，海报会议I和II

abstracts.title: Before the First Dose: A Comprehensive Pre-treatment Screening Framework for Infectious Risk in Autoimmune Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Cynthia Hinderscheid; Amit Sachdev
abstracts.affiliations: East Lansing, MI; Okemos, MI
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Autoimmune generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) requires immunosuppressive and immunomodulatory therapies, increasing the risk of infection. Standard guidelines necessitate patient screening for pre-existing infectious disease before starting all gMG treatment (conventional immunosuppressants and biologics: B-cell depleting agents, FcRn inhibitors, terminal complement inhibitors). However, providers lack a comprehensive screening strategy that prioritizes infection surveillance and an individualized, mechanism-specific and history-driven approach. OBJECTIVE: The purpose of this project is to provide clear recommendations regarding laboratory panels to order for all gMG patients and those with higher risk stratifications, including drug-specific and patient history- related considerations. METHODS: A literature review was conducted to develop layered recommendations for minimum mandatory (universal) and conditional pre-treatment infection screening protocols. Inclusion criteria included articles within the last 15 years across related specialties for immunocompromised populations discussing clinical guidelines and/or overlapping immunosuppressive and biologic treatments. RESULTS: Both universal baseline and conditional screening guidelines do not exist for gMG pharmacotherapy. Globally endemic diseases capable of varied and significant presentations include tuberculosis (TB), viral hepatitis B and C, and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV). Regulatory agency requirements apply to complement inhibitors (Neisseria meningitidis). Additional infections of interest include syphilis, herpesviruses, JC virus, additional Neisseria species, Haemophilus influenzae, Streptococcus pneumoniae, and SARS-CoV-2/post-COVID-19 syndrome. For certain lifestyle and geographic exposure risks, fungal species (Histoplasma capsulatum, Coccidioides) may also be considered. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: While patient care should be individualized, we suggest a minimum mandatory screening protocol for TB, hepatitis B and C, and HIV. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.title: Diagnostic Challenges in Cases of Coexisting Myositis and Myasthenia Gravis: A Systematic Review of Case Reports and Case Series
abstracts.authors: Jaime Moreno Chaparro; Santiago Chacón Becerra; Nathalia María Pérez Becerra; Cristhian Rojas Beltran
abstracts.affiliations: Bogotá, Colombia
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: The co-occurrence of myositis and myasthenia gravis (MG) in the same patient is rare and striking. As treatments for these two conditions differ, accurately identifying and characterizing these patients has become a diagnostic challenge. OBJECTIVE: To identify and synthesize the recent available literature on the diagnostic process related to the coexistence of myositis and MG. METHODS: A systematic review of case reports and case series was conducted. Controlled MeSH terms and advanced searches were used in Medline (PubMed), EMBASE, and Web of Science databases. The 2020–2025 period was considered due to changes in criteria and diagnostic tests. Studies were included if they described at least clinical evaluation and/or laboratory, electrophysiological, or imaging studies. RESULTS: Fifty-seven cases were included. Fifty-four percent were men. The mean age was 69.3 years (SD 12.2). Sixty-eight percent reported a post-treatment relationship with PD-1 inhibitor use. Fifty-seven percent included Triple-M-Overlap Syndrome (with myocarditis). For diagnosis, all reported clinical evaluation as the essential basis. In at least 80% some markers such as acetylcholine receptor antibody (anti-AChR), creatine kinase (CK), or creatine phosphokinase (CPK) were positive. In 15 studies (30 cases) EMG findings were reported, including myopathic changes, spontaneous activity with early recruitment, short and complex motor unit action potentials, and consistent decremental responses. Muscle biopsy was reported in eight studies detecting inflammatory infiltrates or necrosis. MRI was reported in four studies identifying muscle atrophy. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: The coexistence of myositis and MG poses a significant diagnostic challenge due to the overlap in clinical features and the lack of a single definitive test. This requires an integrated approach expanding the use of electrophysiological and biopsy findings. Jaime Moreno Chaparro, MD IFCN International Scholarship Recipient Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.title: Diagnostic Gaps in Seronegative Myasthenia Gravis: A Scoping Review of Diagnostic Criteria
abstracts.authors: Fien Oelbrandt; Carolina Barnett-Tapia; Valentina Ly; Charles Kassardjian; Ari Breiner
abstracts.affiliations: Ottawa, Canada; Toronto, Canada
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In autoimmune myasthenia gravis, approximately 90% of patients have detectable antibodies, whereas roughly 10% remain seronegative. Seronegative myasthenia gravis (SNMG) poses a diagnostic challenge, and diagnostic criteria vary widely. OBJECTIVE: This scoping review aimed to summarize current diagnostic approaches to SNMG and identify existing gaps. METHODS: We conducted a literature search in MEDLINE (Ovid), Embase (Ovid), CINAHL (EBSCOhost), and Scopus from inception to December 10, 2025. Two reviewers independently screened abstracts and full-text articles for eligibility. Data extraction addressed four topics: (1) antibody testing requirements to define seronegativity (acetylcholine receptor [AChR], muscle- specific kinase [MuSK], and low-density lipoprotein receptor-related protein 4 [LRP4] antibodies); (2) diagnostic criteria for SNMG; (3) antibody assays used; and (4) evaluation performed to exclude MG mimics. RESULTS: Of 1,052 studies identified, 100 met inclusion criteria. Since 2011, 20% of studies defined SNMG based on AChR antibody negativity alone, 62% on AChR and MuSK antibody negativity, and 18% on triple negativity. Diagnostic criteria were heterogeneous; however, 42% of studies required EDX abnormalities or clinical response to acetylcholinesterase inhibitors. Radioimmunoprecipitation assay was most common for AChR and MuSK antibodies, while cell-based assays predominated for LRP4 antibodies. Most studies did not report how mimics such as congenital myasthenic syndromes (CMS) were excluded; only one study systematically screened for CMS, and others only considered family history or age of onset. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Diagnostic criteria for SNMG remain heterogeneous. The lack of standardized diagnostic criteria impairs diagnostic accuracy, limits comparisons across studies, and affects the development of novel therapies for this population. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：在自身免疫性重症肌无力中，约90%的患者可检测到抗体，而约10%保持血清阴性。血清阴性重症肌无力（SNMG）构成诊断挑战，且诊断标准差异很大。目的：本范围综述旨在总结当前SNMG的诊断方法并识别现有差距。方法：我们在MEDLINE（Ovid）、Embase（Ovid）、CINAHL（EBSCOhost）和Scopus中进行了从建库至2025年12月10日的文献检索。两名评审员独立筛选摘要和全文文章以确定资格。数据提取涉及四个主题：（1）定义血清阴性所需的抗体检测要求（乙酰胆碱受体[AChR]、肌肉特异性激酶[MuSK]和低密度脂蛋白受体相关蛋白4[LRP4]抗体）；（2）SNMG的诊断标准；（3）使用的抗体检测方法；（4）为排除MG模拟病所进行的评估。结果：在识别的1,052项研究中，100项符合纳入标准。自2011年以来，20%的研究仅基于AChR抗体阴性定义SNMG，62%基于AChR和MuSK抗体阴性，18%基于三重阴性。诊断标准异质；然而，42%的研究要求EDX异常或对乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂的临床反应。放射免疫沉淀法最常用于AChR和MuSK抗体，而基于细胞的检测主要用于LRP4抗体。大多数研究未报告如何排除先天性肌无力综合征（CMS）等模拟病；仅一项研究系统筛查CMS，其他仅考虑家族史或发病年龄。总结/结论：SNMG的诊断标准仍异质。缺乏标准化诊断标准损害诊断准确性，限制研究间比较，并影响该人群新疗法的开发。海报会议I和III

abstracts.title: Electrodiagnostic Assessment Reveals Myasthenia Gravis and Cervical Dystonia in a Case of Dropped Head Syndrome: What is the Best Treatment Approach?
abstracts.authors: Dawling Dionisio Santos; Michael Stanton; Karlo Lizarraga; Alexis Lizarraga
abstracts.affiliations: Rochester, NY
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION/BACKGROUND: Dropped head syndrome is a debilitating condition with varied underlying causes. We present a patient with dropped head syndrome in whom EDX assessment suggested both myasthenia gravis (MG) and cervical dystonia. The patient was treated safely with immunotherapy and botulinum toxin. CASE REPORT: An 82-year-old man presented with head drop, fatigable ptosis, and proximal arm weakness. Antibodies to the acetylcholine receptor, LRP4, and MuSK were negative. Chest CT showed no thymoma. He was treated with plasmapheresis for seronegative MG with marked improvement. He was subsequently lost to follow- up. Years later, he presented with head drop and neck pain. Examination showed anterocollis, antecaput, left laterocollis, and right torticollis, with right more than left hypertrophy of the splenius capitis, levator scapulae, and trapezius. There was moderate neck extensor weakness, ptosis, and mild proximal limb weakness without fatigability. Single-fiber EMG demonstrated markedly increased jitter and blocking, consistent with a generalized neuromuscular junction disorder. Surface EMG showed a lack of relaxation of antagonist muscles and co-contraction of agonist/antagonist muscles during neck movements. Pyridostigmine was ineffective, but prednisone improved neck and limb weakness. Given severe neck pain and abnormal postures, low-dose botulinum toxin injections (10 units each to the right splenius capitis and trapezius) were administered, resulting in significant pain relief while neck strength continued to improve. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: In this patient with dropped head syndrome, EDX assessment confirmed MG and suggested cervical dystonia, supporting the initiation of immunotherapy and concomitant low-dose botulinum toxin therapy. Dawling Dionisio Santos, MD, PhD Resident and Fellow Member Award Recipient Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.title: Immune Check Inhibitor-induced Myasthenia Gravis with Overlapping Myositis and Myocarditis after Pembrolizumab Therapy
abstracts.authors: Naeemuddin Shaikh; Ayisha Khan; Praveen Kowtha; Eun Park; Gabriel Pillar
abstracts.affiliations: Wyomissing, PA; Reading, PA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION/BACKGROUND: Immune checkpoint inhibitors like pembrolizumab, a programmed cell death-1 (PD-1) inhibitor, have significantly improved survival in patients with advanced malignancies by enhancing antitumor immune responses. Despite its benefits, pembrolizumab can trigger immune-related adverse events due to nonspecific activation of the immune system (1). Neurologic toxicities are relatively uncommon but can be severe and potentially life-threatening, accounting for approximately 14 % (2). Complications include myasthenia gravis, myositis, myopathy, polyradiculoneuropathy, and encephalitis (3). Among these, myasthenia gravis is rare but often presents with rapid progression and may overlap with other autoimmune conditions such as myositis and myocarditis. CASE REPORT: We report the case of a 77-year-old female with Stage IV endometrial cancer status post total abdominal hysterectomy who received one cycle of pembrolizumab. Approximately three weeks after initiation of therapy, she developed progressive generalized weakness, right-sided ptosis, binocular diplopia, dysphagia, and difficulty climbing stairs. Laboratory evaluation revealed elevated troponin and a creatine kinase (CK) level of 5720 IU/L. Echocardiography showed reduced ejection fraction. Given the constellation of neuromuscular and cardiac findings, immune checkpoint inhibitor–induced myasthenia gravis with overlapping myositis and myocarditis was suspected. The patient was treated with high-dose corticosteroids and transferred to the medical intensive care unit for plasmapheresis and close monitoring. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: This case emphasizes early recognition of immune-mediated neuromuscular complications after pembrolizumab therapy. Prompt diagnosis and timely immunosuppressive treatment are crucial to reduce morbidity and prevent potentially fatal outcomes. Naeemuddin Shaikh, MD Resident and Fellow Member Award Recipient Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.title: Lipid-lowering Therapy and Neuromuscular Risk in Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Shems Hamdan; Eaman Ahmad; Amit Sachdev
abstracts.affiliations: East Lansing, MI; South Lyon, MI; Okemos, MI
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized autoimmune myasthenia gravis (MG) is an antibody-mediated disorder of the neuromuscular junction (NMJ) that causes fluctuating skeletal muscle weakness. As the MG population ages, dyslipidemia and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease are increasingly common comorbidities. Cholesterol contributes to NMJ stability by supporting lipid microdomains that organize acetylcholine receptor (AChR) clustering and synaptic signaling. Therapies that alter lipid metabolism may therefore influence neuromuscular (NM) function in patients with MG. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the safety and mechanisms of Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-approved lipid- lowering therapies in patients with MG and identify treatment approaches that reduce cardiovascular risk while minimizing NM complications. METHODS: A literature review was conducted following PRISMA guidelines examining experimental studies, pharmacovigilance analyses, systematic reviews, and clinical reports on lipid metabolism, NMJ physiology, and lipid-lowering medications in MG. Drug classes reviewed included statins, bempedoic acid, proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) inhibitors, inclisiran, ezetimibe, fibrates, bile acid sequestrants, niacin, and nutraceutical agents. RESULTS: Statins show the strongest association with MG symptom worsening. Proposed mechanisms include mitochondrial dysfunction, immune modulation, and disruption of cholesterol-dependent NMJ membrane structure. Therapies that do not act directly within skeletal muscle, such as bempedoic acid, PCSK9 inhibitors, and inclisiran, demonstrate lower neuromuscular risk. Bile acid sequestrants appear to have the lowest theoretical risk because they are not systemically absorbed. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Treatment of dyslipidemia in MG requires balancing cardiovascular protection with NM stability. While statins remain effective therapies, some patients may experience worsening symptoms. Newer lipid-lowering agents that avoid direct skeletal muscle metabolism may provide safer alternatives in susceptible individuals. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身性自身免疫性重症肌无力（MG）是一种抗体介导的神经肌肉接头（NMJ）疾病，导致波动性骨骼肌无力。随着MG人群老龄化，血脂异常和动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病日益成为常见合并症。胆固醇通过支持组织乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）聚集和突触信号传导的脂质微结构域，有助于NMJ稳定性。因此，改变脂质代谢的治疗可能影响MG患者的神经肌肉（NM）功能。目的：评估美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准的血脂 lowering 治疗在MG患者中的安全性和机制，并确定在降低心血管风险的同时尽量减少NM并发症的治疗方法。方法：按照PRISMA指南进行文献综述，检查关于脂质代谢、NMJ生理学和MG中降脂药物的实验研究、药物警戒分析、系统综述和临床报告。审查的药物类别包括他汀类、贝派地酸、前蛋白转化酶枯草溶菌素/kexin 9型（PCSK9）抑制剂、inclisiran、依折麦布、贝特类、胆汁酸螯合剂、烟酸和营养补充剂。结果：他汀类与MG症状加重关联最强。提出的机制包括线粒体功能障碍、免疫调节和胆固醇依赖性NMJ膜结构破坏。不直接在骨骼肌内起作用的治疗，如贝派地酸、PCSK9抑制剂和inclisiran，表现出较低的神经肌肉风险。胆汁酸螯合剂似乎具有最低的理论风险，因为它们不被全身吸收。总结/结论：MG中血脂异常的治疗需要平衡心血管保护与NM稳定性。虽然他汀类仍是有效治疗，但部分患者可能出现症状加重。避免直接骨骼肌代谢的新型降脂药物可能为易感个体提供更安全的替代选择。壁报交流 I 与 III。

abstracts.title: Muscle Relaxant Use in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis: Assessing Risk and Safety
abstracts.authors: Sanehdeep Kaur; Amit Sachdev
abstracts.affiliations: Canton, MI; Okemos, MI
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is a chronic autoimmune disorder of the neuromuscular junction (NMJ) in which autoantibodies against acetylcholine receptor (AchR) result in muscle weakness. 5% of United States adults are prescribed muscle relaxants annually for numerous indications. Of considerable concern to both providers and gMG patients is that muscle relaxants may exacerbate the disease. The safe use of muscle relaxants in gMG has not been recently/exhaustively reviewed. OBJECTIVE: To assess the safety of on-label, off-label, prescribed, and supplemental muscle relaxants in patients with gMG. METHODS: An extensive literature review was conducted to evaluate the effects of commonly used medications for muscle spasms including centrally acting muscle relaxants, neuromuscular blocking agents, supplements, and other neuromodulatory drugs on gMG patients. Medications were organized into tiers ranging from high to low risk to provide a framework for assessing relative safety in the management of muscle complaints in gMG. RESULTS: Skeletal muscle relaxants acting directly on the NMJ pose the greatest risk for gMG exacerbation. In contrast, commonly prescribed muscle relaxants such as baclofen, tizanidine, and cyclobenzaprine primarily exert central nervous system effects and lack direct NMJ blockade, posing a lower risk in gMG. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Centrally acting muscle relaxant therapies appear to have lower risk of exacerbating gMG. However, further clinical studies are needed to clarify the safety of these agents for better management of musculoskeletal symptoms in gMG patients. While all available therapies carry some risk, we suggest that cyclobenzaprine be considered initially in gMG patients. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身性重症肌无力（gMG）是一种神经肌肉接头（NMJ）的慢性自身免疫性疾病，其中针对乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）的自身抗体导致肌无力。美国每年有5%的成人因多种适应症被处方肌肉松弛剂。临床医生和gMG患者相当关注的是，肌肉松弛剂可能加重疾病。肌肉松弛剂在gMG中的安全使用尚未近期/全面综述。目的：评估gMG患者中标签内、标签外、处方及补充性肌肉松弛剂的安全性。方法：进行广泛的文献综述，评估常用肌肉痉挛药物对gMG患者的影响，包括中枢性肌肉松弛剂、神经肌肉阻滞剂、补充剂和其他神经调节药物。药物按高风险至低风险分层，为gMG肌肉症状管理中的相对安全性评估提供框架。结果：直接作用于NMJ的骨骼肌松弛剂对gMG加重风险最大。相比之下，常用处方肌肉松弛剂如巴氯芬、替扎尼定和环苯扎林主要发挥中枢神经系统作用，缺乏直接NMJ阻滞，在gMG中风险较低。总结/结论：中枢性肌肉松弛剂治疗似乎加重gMG的风险较低。然而，需要进一步临床研究以明确这些药物的安全性，从而更好地管理gMG患者的肌肉骨骼症状。虽然所有可用治疗均有一定风险，我们建议gMG患者可首先考虑环苯扎林。壁报交流 I 与 II。

abstracts.title: Myopathic Changes on Electromyography in Treatment Naive, Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Patients with High Acetylcholine Receptor Antibody Titers Ricardo A.
abstracts.authors: Vivanco Menoscal; Nakul Katyal
abstracts.affiliations: Lexington, KY
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION/BACKGROUND: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an autoimmune neuromuscular disorder characterized by fluctuating muscle weakness due to impaired neuromuscular transmission. Myopathic changes on EMG have been reported in MG patients with muscle- specific tyrosine kinase (MuSK) antibodies, and less commonly in those with AChR antibodies. CASE SERIES: Three patients (2 females, 1 male; age range: 40–65 years) presented for EMG testing to evaluate severe, fatigable oculobulbar and proximal muscle weakness. The duration of symptoms ranged from 4 to 60 months. All patients had marked ptosis, nasal dysarthria, neck flexion, and proximal upper and lower extremity weakness on examination. All patients demonstrated significant (>10%) abnormal decrement on repetitive nerve stimulation study and myopathic changes on EMG in either cranio-bulbar segment and/or proximal muscles. Patients were suspected of having MG and were treated with IVIG, low-dose oral prednisone, and pyridostigmine, which resulted in significant improvement of symptoms. AChR antibodies drawn before treatment were positive in all patients at very high titers (AChR binding Ab range: 47–96 nmol/L; N: 0–0.04 nmol/L). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Treatment-naive AChR antibody-positive generalized MG patients may have myopathic changes on EMG and high antibody titers. Poster Sessions I & II

abstracts.title: Overlap of Inflammatory Myopathy and Myasthenia Gravis: A Rare Neuromuscular Diagnostic Challenge
abstracts.authors: Nathalia María Pérez Becerra; Cristhian Rojas Beltran; Omar Santiago Chacón Becerra; Juan Sebastián Aguilera Donado
abstracts.affiliations: Bogotá, Colombia
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION/BACKGROUND: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an autoimmune disorder of the neuromuscular junction with a prevalence of 150–200 cases per million, whereas idiopathic inflammatory myopathies (IIM) occur in 5–22 per 100,000 individuals. Their coexistence is extremely rare and has been mostly described in small series, including small patient studies of six and seven patients. CASE REPORT: A 49-year-old woman with clinical features suggestive of inflammatory myopathy was subsequently diagnosed with concomitant MG. Conventional EMG showed signs of active denervation in the deltoid muscle; interference pattern analysis (IPA) revealed low-amplitude motor unit potentials with rapid recruitment, findings consistent with an intrinsic muscle fiber disorder suggestive of IIM. Due to progression with bulbar symptoms, a repetitive stimulation test was performed, showing significant decrements; stimulated single-fiber EMG revealed maximum values of 263 µs and average values of 126 µs, consistent with a postsynaptic neuromuscular junction disorder. Based on these findings, the EDX study was repeated in all four limbs, with normal results. The patient underwent thymectomy and was started on pyridostigmine and prednisolone with minimal improvement; three months ago, she was switched to deflazacort with partial improvement. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: The coexistence of MG and IIM is rare but clinically significant. Electrophysiological studies play a key role in identifying abnormalities in both muscle fiber integrity and neuromuscular transmission, thereby facilitating an accurate diagnosis and appropriate clinical management in patients with overlapping neuromuscular disorders. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.title: Rare Overlap of Myasthenia Gravis and Acute Motor Axonal Neuropathy
abstracts.authors: Praveen Attele; Kourosh Rezania; Farnaz Khalighinejad; Jonathan Grossman; Betty Soliven; Naeva Bratina; Michael Lonigro; Neha Sehgal
abstracts.affiliations: Chicago, IL; Valparaiso, IN
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION/BACKGROUND: The coexistence of myasthenia gravis (MG) and acute motor axonal neuropathy (AMAN) is exceptionally rare, with only one prior case being reported in the literature. CASE REPORT: A 67-year-old woman initially developed progressive ptosis, diplopia, ophthalmoparesis, and mild hand weakness over 1 month. She was diagnosed with acetylcholine receptor antibody–positive MG and treated with prednisone, pyridostigmine, and IVIG, with partial improvement. Six months later, she developed progressive worsening of hand weakness over 2 weeks accompanied by new-onset dyspnea and was hospitalized. Neurologic examination demonstrated bilateral ptosis and ophthalmoparesis, severe distal greater than proximal weakness in the upper extremities, and preserved lower-extremity strength. Upper-extremity reflexes were absent, while patellar reflexes were preserved. Pulmonary function testing revealed a negative inspiratory force of −10 cm H₂O, requiring bilevel positive airway pressure. NCSs showed normal sensory responses with reduced compound motor action potential amplitudes and partial conduction block in the right median and peroneal nerves. Repetitive nerve stimulation demonstrated a significant decremental response with low-frequency (3 Hz) stimulation of the right median, ulnar, and peroneal nerves. Serologic testing revealed markedly elevated GD1b IgG and GM1 IgG antibodies. The patient was treated with plasmapheresis, resulting in substantial improvement in limb strength, although ocular symptoms persisted. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Concurrent MG and AMAN should be considered when patients with MG develop rapidly progressive limb weakness and areflexia. EDX studies are essential for distinguishing overlapping neuromuscular disorders, and ganglioside antibody testing may support the diagnosis. Early recognition allows timely immunomodulatory therapy and improved neurologic outcomes. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.title: Triple m Overlap Syndrome: A Rare Complication Following Dostarlimab Infusion
abstracts.authors: Alex Yu; Moby Mathew; Shan Chen
abstracts.affiliations: New Brunswick, NJ
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION/BACKGROUND: Triple M (3M) syndrome is a rare sequela of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI), characterized by the overlap of myasthenia gravis, myositis, and myocarditis. We present a case of 3M syndrome following PD-1 receptor inhibitor infusion. CASE REPORT: A 70-year-old female with metastatic endometrial cancer presented with 4 days of right-sided ptosis, associated with proximal weakness, neck pain, shortness of breath, and palpitations. One month prior, the patient had received carboplatin and paclitaxel infusions, with the new addition of dostarlimab (PD-1 receptor inhibitor). Examination revealed right-sided ptosis, symmetric fatigable proximal upper extremity weakness (MRC scale 4/5), and mild fatigable dysarthria. Contrast- enhanced brain MRI was unremarkable. Acetylcholine receptor (AchR) blocking, binding, and modulating antibodies were within normal limits. Anti-muscle-specific kinase (MuSK) antibody was not detected. Creatine kinase (CK) was elevated at 5,981 U/L (reference range: 32-182 U/L) with 84% muscle-type CK and 9% myocardial-type CK. Anti-Jo-1 and anti-PL-12 antibodies were negative. Troponins and liver enzymes were elevated. Cardiac MRI was normal. Symptoms improved following high-dose IV methylprednisolone, IVIG, abatacept, and ruxolitinib, with further improvement at 1-month follow-up on a prednisone taper, pyridostigmine, ongoing abatacept and ruxolitinib, and discontinuation of dostarlimab. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: 3M syndrome is a rare and life-threatening immune-related complication of ICI therapy, with an estimated mortality rate approaching 40%. First-line management is high-dose corticosteroids, with IVIG or plasmapheresis for refractory cases. Emerging therapies, such as abatacept and ruxolitinib, may be beneficial for concurrent myositis and myocarditis. Supportive care for myasthenic symptoms includes pyridostigmine, close pulmonary and neurological monitoring, and avoidance of exacerbating medications. Poster Sessions I & III

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言/背景：Triple M（3M）综合征是免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）的罕见后遗症，以重症肌无力、肌炎和心肌炎重叠为特征。我们呈现一例PD-1受体抑制剂输注后发生3M综合征的病例。病例报告：一名70岁女性转移性子宫内膜癌患者，表现为右侧上睑下垂4天，伴近端无力、颈痛、气短和心悸。1个月前，患者接受卡铂和紫杉醇输注，并新加用dostarlimab（PD-1受体抑制剂）。检查显示右侧上睑下垂、对称性易疲劳性近端上肢无力（MRC量表4/5）和轻度易疲劳性构音障碍。增强脑MRI无异常。乙酰胆碱受体（AchR）阻断、结合和调节抗体均在正常范围内。未检测到抗肌肉特异性激酶（MuSK）抗体。肌酸激酶（CK）升高至5,981 U/L（参考范围：32-182 U/L），其中84%为肌肉型CK，9%为心肌型CK。抗Jo-1和抗PL-12抗体阴性。肌钙蛋白和肝酶升高。心脏MRI正常。经大剂量IV甲泼尼龙、IVIG、阿巴西普和芦可替尼治疗后症状改善，1个月随访时进一步改善，当时正在泼尼松减量、吡啶斯的明、继续阿巴西普和芦可替尼，并停用dostarlimab。总结/结论：3M综合征是ICI治疗罕见且危及生命的免疫相关并发症，估计死亡率接近40%。一线管理为大剂量糖皮质激素，难治性病例使用IVIG或血浆置换。新兴疗法如阿巴西普和芦可替尼可能对合并肌炎和心肌炎有益。重症肌无力症状的支持治疗包括吡啶斯的明、密切肺部和神经监测，以及避免加重病情的药物。海报专场I和III

abstracts.title: Clinical and immunological features of thymoma patients with and without myasthenia gravis: A pilot study
abstracts.authors: M. Corbo1; F. Beretta1; R. Taliani1; S. Bongiolatti2; L. Voltolini2; L. Massacesi1; V. Damato1; G. Spagni1
abstracts.affiliations: 1Department of Neurosciences, Psychology, Drug Research and Child Health (NEUROFARBA), University of Florence, Italy; 2Thoracic Surgery Unit, Careggi University Hospital, Florence, Italy
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Thymoma-associated myasthenia gra- vis (TAMG) is nearly invariably associated with acetylcholine receptor antibodies (AChRAb). However, approximately 15% of thymoma patients have AChRAb in the absence of MG and rarely may develop post-thymectomy MG (PTMG). This study evaluates the clinical and immunological features of thymoma TABLE 1 Stride detection results by pathology. Precision is defined as the ratio of well-detected strides among all strides detected by the wDHT. Recall is defined as the ratio of well-detected strides among all existing strides. patients with and without MG to identify predictive biomarkers of PTMG. Methods: Patients with thymoma treated in our Centre be- tween 2011 and 2025 were included in the study. Demographic and clinical data were collected, and available serum samples were evaluated for in vitro complement activation using a flow cytometry live cell-based assay. Results: Fifty thymoma patients were included in the study: 17/50 (34%) TAMG, 27/50 (54%) thymoma patients with no MG and AChRAb negative (AChRAb-MG-), 6/50 (12%) AChRAb positive thymoma patients without MG (AChRAb+MG-), of whom 2/6 (33%) developed PTMG. Types AB/B thymomas pre- dominated across groups (n = 40/50,80%) without statistically significant difference between MG and non-MG patients (with/ without AChRAb). Most had a Masaoka stage I–II (n = 43/50, 86%). The majority of patients had maximum MGFA>II (13/19, 68%). Sixteen serum samples were available for further anal- yses (10 TAMG, 2 PTMG, 4 AChRAb+MG-). Complement ac- tivation was significantly lower in AChRAb+MG- thymoma patients compared to TAMG and PTMG patients (p = 0.0332, Mann-Whitney U test). In one PTMG patient with available se- rial serum samples, level of complement activation increased significantly from thymoma diagnosis to MG onset. Conclusion: In vitro assessment of complement activation could represent a novel biomarker of PTMG. Future studies are warranted to investigate in-depth antibody as well as thymic and B-cells properties in PTMG patients.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景和目的：胸腺瘤相关重症肌无力（TAMG）几乎总是与乙酰胆碱受体抗体（AChRAb）相关。然而，约15%的胸腺瘤患者在没有MG的情况下存在AChRAb，并且很少可能发生胸腺切除术后MG（PTMG）。本研究评估了伴有和不伴有MG的胸腺瘤患者的临床和免疫学特征，以确定PTMG的预测性生物标志物。方法：纳入2011年至2025年间在我中心治疗的胸腺瘤患者。收集人口统计学和临床数据，并使用流式细胞术活细胞检测法评估可用血清样本的体外补体激活情况。结果：共纳入50名胸腺瘤患者：17/50（34%）为TAMG，27/50（54%）为无MG且AChRAb阴性的胸腺瘤患者（AChRAb-MG-），6/50（12%）为无MG的AChRAb阳性胸腺瘤患者（AChRAb+MG-），其中2/6（33%）发展为PTMG。AB/B型胸腺瘤在各组中占主导地位（n=40/50,80%），MG和非MG患者（有/无AChRAb）之间无统计学显著差异。大多数患者为Masaoka I–II期（n=43/50,86%）。大多数患者的最大MGFA分级>II（13/19,68%）。16份血清样本可用于进一步分析（10份TAMG，2份PTMG，4份AChRAb+MG-）。与TAMG和PTMG患者相比，AChRAb+MG-胸腺瘤患者的补体激活显著较低（p=0.0332，Mann-Whitney U检验）。在一名有可用系列血清样本的PTMG患者中，补体激活水平从胸腺瘤诊断到MG发病显著增加。结论：体外评估补体激活可能成为PTMG的一种新型生物标志物。未来有必要深入研究PTMG患者的抗体以及胸腺和B细胞特性。

abstracts.title: Continuing medical education improves competence in implementing new therapies for myasthenia gravis
abstracts.authors: S. Rohani-Montez1; M. Calle1; F. David1; E. Santos2; N. Gilhus3
abstracts.affiliations: 1Medscape Education Global, London, UK; 2Biomedical Sciences School of University of Porto, Santo Antonio University Hospital, Porto, Portugal; 3University of Bergen, Haukeland University Hospital, Bergen, Norway
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Treatments for myasthenia gravis (MG) are evolving, requiring physicians to consider new mech- anisms including FcRN or complement inhibition. We sought to improve knowledge of these new therapies and their application in today's clinical practice. Methods: Physicians participated in a 3-part video-based, online CME activity (available at www.medscape.org/view- article/1002773). The education effects were assessed using a 3-question, repeated pairs, pre-assessment/post-assessment study design. One question assessed confidence. Pre- to post- assessment differences were evaluated using the McNemar's test. p ≤ 05 is the significance level. The activity launched in 08- 2025 and data were collected through 10-2025. Results: 53 neurologists and 80 primary care physicians (PCPs) completed all pre- and post-assessment questions. Overall sig- nificant improvements were seen after participation for neu- rologists (correct pre-assessment response rate of 47% vs 73% at post-assessment; p < 0.001, Cohen's d = 0.9), and PCPs (correct pre-assessment response rate of 31% vs 54% at post-assessment; p < 0.001, Cohen's d = 0.98). Improvements were observed in cli- nicians’ understanding of the rationale for FcRn inhibition in MG, and how best to tailor new therapies in different clinical scenarios (Figure 1). After participating, 38% of neurologists and 26% of PCPs had measurable improved confidence in determin- ing which patients with MG may benefit from a targeted therapy. Post-education, 52% of neurologists and 42% of PCPs said they intend to consider targeted therapies earlier for patients with severe or rapidly progressive MG (other responses in Figure 2). Conclusion: This study demonstrates the success of online, multi-component, video-based education in improving compe- tence in implementing new targeted therapies for MG in practice.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景和目的：重症肌无力（MG）的治疗方法正在演变，要求医生考虑包括FcRn或补体抑制在内的新机制。我们旨在提高对这些新疗法及其在当前临床实践中应用的认识。方法：医生参与了一项由3部分组成的基于视频的在线CME活动（可在www.medscape.org/view-article/1002773获取）。使用3个问题的重复配对评估前/评估后研究设计来评估教育效果。一个问题评估信心。使用McNemar检验评估评估前到评估后的差异。p≤0.05为显著性水平。该活动于2025年8月启动，数据收集至2025年10月。结果：53名神经科医生和80名初级保健医生（PCP）完成了所有评估前和评估后问题。参与后，神经科医生（评估前正确回答率为47%，评估后为73%；p<0.001，Cohen's d=0.9）和PCP（评估前正确回答率为31%，评估后为54%；p<0.001，Cohen's d=0.98）均观察到总体显著改善。临床医生对MG中FcRn抑制原理的理解以及如何在不同临床场景中最佳定制新疗法方面有所改善（图1）。参与后，38%的神经科医生和26%的PCP在确定哪些MG患者可能从靶向治疗中获益方面的信心有可测量的提高。教育后，52%的神经科医生和42%的PCP表示他们打算更早地为严重或快速进展性MG患者考虑靶向治疗（其他回答见图2）。结论：本研究证明了在线、多组件、基于视频的教育在提高实践中实施MG新靶向治疗能力方面的成功。

abstracts.title: Epigenetic profiling of cytokine gene promoters in MuSK myasthenia gravis
abstracts.authors: C. Elmas1; A. Stoccoro2; M. Lari2; V. Iovino3; A. Cepele3; M. Guida3; M. Maestri3; F. Coppede2; I. Koneczny1
abstracts.affiliations: 1Division of Neuropathology and Neurochemistry, Department of Neurology, Medical University of Vienna, Vienna, Austria; 2Department of Translational Research and of New Surgical and Medical Technologies, University of Pisa, Pisa, Italy; 3Neurological Unit, Department of Neuroscience, University Hospital of Pisa, Pisa, Italy
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: Myasthenia gravis associated with antibodies against muscle-specific kinase (MuSK-MG) is a well-characterized IgG4-autoimmune disease. This study in- vestigated whether epigenetic modifications, specifically DNA methylation changes in cytokine gene promoters of interleukins implicated in IgG4 subclass switching, are associated with the IgG4-predominant immune response in MuSK-MG patients. Methods: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells were isolated from MuSK-MG patients (n = 36), acetylcholine receptor myasthe- nia gravis patients as disease controls (n = 7), and age- and sex- matched healthy controls (n = 12). Genomic DNA was extracted and after sodium bisulfite conversion, DNA methylation of the promoter regions of interleukin (IL)-4, IL-10, and IL-13 was as- sessed using methylation-sensitive high-resolution melting (MS- HRM) analysis. Methylation levels were estimated by comparing the melting profiles of subjects' DNA samples with those obtained from DNA standards with known methylation percentages. Results: MuSK-MG patients showed 16% lower DNA methyla- tion levels in the IL-13 promoter compared with healthy controls (mean 14.51% vs 30.40%, p = 0.0038). IL-4 promoter methylation was lower by 185 in MuSK-MG patients compared with healthy controls (73.24% vs 91.18%, p = 0.0001), as well as disease control (98.08%, p < 0.0001). No significant differences were observed for IL-10 promoter. These methylation patterns were indepen- dent of age, sex, and treatment status. Conclusion: Selective hypomethylation of IL-4 and IL-13 pro- moters is observed in MuSK-MG, while IL-10 promoter meth- ylation remains unaltered. This potentially facilitates increased cytokine expression, potentially favoring IgG4 subclass switch- ing, although additional regulatory mechanisms are likely involved.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景和目的：与肌肉特异性激酶抗体相关的重症肌无力（MuSK-MG）是一种特征明确的IgG4自身免疫性疾病。本研究调查了表观遗传修饰，特别是与IgG4亚类转换相关的白细胞介素基因启动子中的DNA甲基化变化，是否与MuSK-MG患者的IgG4主导免疫反应相关。方法：从MuSK-MG患者（n=36）、乙酰胆碱受体重症肌无力患者作为疾病对照（n=7）以及年龄和性别匹配的健康对照（n=12）中分离外周血单核细胞。提取基因组DNA，经亚硫酸氢盐转化后，使用甲基化敏感性高分辨率熔解（MS-HRM）分析评估白细胞介素（IL）-4、IL-10和IL-13启动子区域的DNA甲基化。通过将受试者DNA样本的熔解曲线与已知甲基化百分比的DNA标准品获得的熔解曲线进行比较来估计甲基化水平。结果：与健康对照相比，MuSK-MG患者的IL-13启动子DNA甲基化水平低16%（平均值14.51% vs 30.40%，p=0.0038）。与健康对照（73.24% vs 91.18%，p=0.0001）以及疾病对照（98.08%，p<0.0001）相比，MuSK-MG患者的IL-4启动子甲基化低185。未观察到IL-10启动子的显著差异。这些甲基化模式与年龄、性别和治疗状态无关。结论：在MuSK-MG中观察到IL-4和IL-13启动子的选择性低甲基化，而IL-10启动子甲基化保持不变。这可能促进细胞因子表达增加，可能有利于IgG4亚类转换，尽管可能涉及其他调控机制。

abstracts.title: MG patients facing heat waves. Heat waves exposure differentially worsens MG-ADL Scores in anti– acetylcholine receptor but not MuSK myasthenia gravis
abstracts.authors: E. Lagrange1; S. Sacconi2; J. Reis3
abstracts.affiliations: 1Grenoble University Hospital Department of Neurology, Reference Center of Neuromuscular Disease and ALS consultations, Grenoble University Hospital; Grenoble, France; 2Université Côte d'Azur, Peripheral Nervous System and Muscle Department, Pasteur 2 Hospital, Centre Hospitalier Universitaire de Nice, Nice, France; 3INSERM-UNISTRA UMR 1260, Centre de Recherche en Biomédecine de Strasbourg (CRBS); 1 rue Eugene Boeckel; Strasbourg, France
abstracts.abstract: Background and aims: To assess the impact of heat wave ex- posure on symptom severity, as measured by the Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) scores in patients with autoimmune myasthenia gravis (MG), comparing anti– acetylcholine receptor (anti-AChR) and anti-MuSK subtypes. Methods: We conducted a cross-sectional questionnaire-based study including 206 adult MG patients. Heat-related symptom worsening during heat waves, hot bath sensitivity, cooling strat- egies, and MG-ADL–derived heat-aggravation scores were ana- lyzed according to antibody status. Results: Heat wave exposure was associated with a significant worsening of MG-ADL scores in anti–AChR patients, whereas no significant effect was observed in MuSK patients Anti-AChR patients frequently reported symptom exacerbation during days of heatwaves, after hot showers or baths and commonly required air conditioning. Cold exposure was associated with symptom improvement predominantly in the anti-AChR group. TABLE 2 Linear mixed-effects model estimates for change in physical and psychological MSIS-29 scores with respect to time and intervention. FIGURE 1 Histological and ultrastructural findings of the CM. Conclusion: Heat wave represents a clinically relevant aggra- vating factor in anti-AChR MG, supporting targeted environ- mental management strategies in the perspectives of climate change, in such a vulnerable population.

abstracts.abstractZh: 背景和目的：评估热浪暴露对自身免疫性重症肌无力（MG）患者症状严重程度（通过MG-ADL评分测量）的影响，并比较抗乙酰胆碱受体（抗AChR）和抗MuSK亚型。方法：我们进行了一项基于问卷的横断面研究，纳入206名成年MG患者。根据抗体状态分析了热浪期间热相关症状恶化、热水浴敏感性、降温策略以及MG-ADL衍生的热加重评分。结果：热浪暴露与抗AChR患者的MG-ADL评分显著恶化相关，而在MuSK患者中未观察到显著影响。抗AChR患者经常报告在热浪期间、热水淋浴或沐浴后症状加重，并且通常需要空调。冷暴露主要与抗AChR组的症状改善相关。结论：热浪是抗AChR MG的一个临床相关加重因素，支持在气候变化背景下针对这一脆弱人群采取有针对性的环境管理策略。

abstracts.title: A Hypothetical Immunological Cascade to Myasthenia Gravis: A Novel six-stage Framework Linking Pharyngeal Mucosal Injury to Neuromuscular Autoimmunity and a Novel Retrograde Inference Cascade
abstracts.authors: Jason Gursky
abstracts.affiliations: Carlsbad, CA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is a chronic antibody-mediated autoimmune disease of the neuromuscular junction. Monozygotic twin concordance of ~35% implies that most non-thymoma cases require a non-genetic, environmental explanation, yet the initiating trigger remains unknown. Current etiological approaches study known triggers and idiopathic conditions in isolation, limiting mechanistic integration. OBJECTIVE: To present a six-stage Hypothetical Immunological Cascade (HIC) proposing that chronic pharyngeal mucosal injury initiates, in genetically susceptible individuals, a sequence of barrier disruption, neoantigen formation, molecular mimicry with epitope spreading, systemic neuromuscular junction autoimmunity, immunological entrenchment, and potential tolerance restoration. A companion Retrograde Cascade Inference (RCI) enables backward inference from clinical phenotype to putative trigger. METHODS: Systematic literature synthesis across MG pathogenesis, mucosal immunology, molecular mimicry, environmental triggers, and cross-disease cascade models (1980–2026). No primary experimental data are reported. RESULTS: Stage 1 (barrier disruption) is supported by Mendelian randomization evidence for a causal GERD–MG association in late-onset MG , case-control data linking smoking to early-onset MG, and experimental evidence that the nasal/pharyngeal mucosal route is immunologically competent for AChR-directed immune responses. Stages 4–6 are supported by Tier I evidence. Stages 1–3 rest on mechanistic plausibility and are priority targets for prospective validation. The weakest link is absent demonstration of CHRNA1 protein expression in human pharyngeal epithelium, though nAChR subunit transcripts have been detected in adjacent upper airway tissues. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: The HIC-RCI framework is proposed as a universal Rosetta Stone template for autoimmune diseases with unknown triggers, enabling translation of mechanistic knowledge into structured, testable hypotheses.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）是一种慢性抗体介导的神经肌肉接头自身免疫性疾病。单卵双胞胎同病率约35%，提示大多数非胸腺瘤病例需要非遗传的环境因素解释，但起始触发因素仍未知。当前的病因学研究方法孤立地研究已知触发因素和特发性情况，限制了机制整合。目的：提出一个六阶段假设性免疫级联（HIC），提出在遗传易感个体中，慢性咽部黏膜损伤启动一系列过程：屏障破坏、新抗原形成、分子模拟伴表位扩展、系统性神经肌肉接头自身免疫、免疫固化以及潜在的免疫耐受恢复。配套的逆行级联推断（RCI）可从临床表型反向推断可能的触发因素。方法：对MG发病机制、黏膜免疫学、分子模拟、环境触发因素及跨疾病级联模型（1980–2026）进行系统文献综合。未报告原始实验数据。结果：第1阶段（屏障破坏）得到以下证据支持：孟德尔随机化证据支持GERD与晚发型MG存在因果关联，病例对照数据将吸烟与早发型MG相关联，以及实验证据表明鼻/咽黏膜途径对AChR导向的免疫应答具有免疫学能力。第4–6阶段得到I级证据支持。第1–3阶段基于机制合理性，是前瞻性验证的优先目标。最薄弱环节是尚未证明人咽部上皮中CHRNA1蛋白表达，尽管在邻近上气道组织中已检测到nAChR亚基转录本。总结/结论：HIC-RCI框架被提出作为未知触发因素自身免疫性疾病的通用Rosetta Stone模板，使机制知识能够转化为结构化、可检验的假设。

abstracts.title: Average Volume-assured Pressure Support (Avaps) in Monitoring Respiratory Muscle Weakness in Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Alexander Fay; Elizabeth Madole
abstracts.affiliations: Alameda, CA; Redding, CA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Respiratory failure in myasthenia gravis (MG) may be life-threatening, but there are few objective metrics, other than blood gases, to monitor respiratory weakness. Average Volume-Assured Pressure Support (AVAPS) data collected during sleep provides effort- independent, continuous measurement of respiratory function at home or in the hospital, and we hypothesized that this data might correlate with response to successive cycles of plasma exchange. OBJECTIVE: To describe how AVAPS ventilator data, including peak inspiratory pressure (PIP), can be used to monitor treatment response in a pediatric patient with MG. METHODS: Ventilator data representing nightly averages from Philips Trilogy EVO in S/T-AVAPS mode were collected during clinical exacerbations treated with plasma exchange (PLEX) in one patient. RESULTS: Over several exacerbations in a 12 year-old with generalized, AChR receptor antibody-positive MG, we observed worsening negative inspiratory force (NIF), rising PIP, and a drop in spontaneous triggered breaths to 0% at nadir, coinciding with worsening weakness and increasing MG-ADL scores. The patient underwent PLEX for each exacerbation, with improvement in PIP, NIF and MG-ADL after the fourth cycle, to the point of not requiring BiPap when PIP reached 6 cm H2O. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: AVAPS data show steady improvement in PIP with successive cycles of PLEX, and provide a reproducible, effort-independent method to monitor respiratory weakness and response to treatment. We propose that AVAPS may be used as an objective measure of respiratory weakness in patients with MG, and perhaps other neuromuscular disorders, and may be used to determine the effectiveness of therapeutic interventions and duration of treatment.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）中的呼吸衰竭可能危及生命，但除血气分析外，用于监测呼吸肌无力的客观指标很少。睡眠期间采集的平均容量保证压力支持（AVAPS）数据可在家庭或医院环境中提供不依赖患者努力的、连续的呼吸功能测量，我们假设这些数据可能与连续多轮血浆置换的治疗反应相关。目的：描述AVAPS呼吸机数据（包括吸气峰压，PIP）如何用于监测一名儿童MG患者的治疗反应。方法：在一名接受血浆置换（PLEX）治疗的临床加重期患者中，采集Philips Trilogy EVO在S/T-AVAPS模式下代表每夜平均值的呼吸机数据。结果：在一名12岁、全身型、AChR受体抗体阳性的MG患者中，历经数次加重，我们观察到负吸气力（NIF）恶化、PIP升高，以及自主触发呼吸在最低点降至0%，同时伴有肌无力加重和MG-ADL评分升高。该患者在每次加重时均接受PLEX，第4轮后PIP、NIF和MG-ADL改善，当PIP达到6 cm H2O时不再需要BiPap。总结/结论：AVAPS数据显示，随着连续多轮PLEX，PIP稳步改善，并提供了一种可重复、不依赖患者努力的方法来监测呼吸肌无力及治疗反应。我们提出，AVAPS可作为MG患者（或许还包括其他神经肌肉疾病患者）呼吸肌无力的客观测量指标，并可用于判断治疗干预的有效性和治疗持续时间。

abstracts.title: Beyond Myasthenia Gravis: Apraxia of Lid Opening Following Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting
abstracts.authors: Seyed Khatami; Ruta Vyas; Ali Haq; Jasmine Chopra
abstracts.affiliations: Las Vegas, NV
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is a neuromuscular junction disorder that can progressively worsen if not diagnosed early. Apraxia of lid opening (ALO), defined as the inability to initiate eyelid opening, is often clinically challenging to distinguish from bilateral ptosis in MG. In cases of diagnostic uncertainty, empirical treatment can prevent potential respiratory distress until serology returns. CASE DESCRIPTION: A 72-year-old male with a past medical history of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, coronary artery disease, a post-craniectomy suprasellar tumor, and chronic left vision loss underwent coronary artery bypass graft surgery (CABG), left atrial appendage clipping, and ascending aortic aneurysm repair with graft placement. Postoperatively, he underwent emergent re- intubation the same day due to unresponsiveness. Neurology was consulted to evaluate transient unresponsiveness and ALO versus MG. The patient reported prior intermittent ptosis without formal work up but denied other MG symptoms. Head and neck CT indicated no acute findings. Brain MRI showed a known heterogeneous, enhancing, calcified suprasellar mass with associated chronic bilateral optic chiasm atrophy. An EEG demonstrated mild bihemispheric slowing but no epileptiform discharges. RESULTS: A trial of intravenous immunoglobulin was initiated for suspected MG. However, acetylcholine receptor antibodies and anti-striational antibodies returned negative. The patient was discharged to acute rehabilitation for continued functional recovery and outpatient nerve studies. CONCLUSION: This case illustrates a diagnostically challenging neurological complication after CABG. Physiologic stress and transient global cerebral hypoperfusion may precipitate ALO via cortical-subcortical disconnection. Appropriate physical exams are important to distinguish ALO from potentially seronegative MG while optimizing preoperative hemodynamics and avoiding hypoperfusion episodes.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：重症肌无力（MG）是一种神经肌肉接头疾病，若未早期诊断可进行性加重。睁眼失用（ALO）定义为无法启动眼睑睁开，临床上常难以与MG的双侧上睑下垂相鉴别。在诊断不确定的情况下，经验性治疗可在血清学结果回报前预防潜在的呼吸窘迫。病例描述：一名72岁男性，既往有慢性阻塞性肺疾病、冠状动脉疾病、颅骨切除术后鞍上肿瘤及慢性左眼视力丧失病史，接受了冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）、左心耳夹闭术及升主动脉瘤修复加移植物置入术。术后当日因无反应状态接受紧急再次插管。神经科会诊评估其短暂无反应及ALO与MG的鉴别。患者诉既往有间歇性上睑下垂但未正式检查，否认其他MG症状。头颈部CT未见急性异常。脑MRI显示已知的异质性、强化、钙化鞍上肿块，伴相关慢性双侧视交叉萎缩。脑电图显示轻度双半球慢波，但无癫痫样放电。结果：因怀疑MG开始静脉注射免疫球蛋白试验性治疗。然而，乙酰胆碱受体抗体和抗横纹肌抗体均返回阴性。患者转至急性康复机构继续功能恢复并接受门诊神经电生理检查。结论：本病例展示了CABG术后一种诊断上具有挑战性的神经系统并发症。生理应激和短暂性全脑低灌注可能通过皮质-皮质下失连接诱发ALO。适当的体格检查对于区分ALO与可能血清阴性的MG很重要，同时应优化术前血流动力学并避免低灌注事件。

abstracts.title: Me&mgtm Digital Biomarkers Scores Reflect MGFA Severity Classification
abstracts.authors: Carolina Barnett-Tapia; Sophie Lehnerer; Séverine Bieuvelet; Loïc Carment; Clarissa Gorin; Natacha Pesic-Heuvrard; Kenza Drareni; Noura Sellami; Bhaskar Dutta; Benjamin Yungher; Saad Zinaï; James F. Howard; Jr.
abstracts.affiliations: Toronto, Canada; Berlin, Germany; Paris, France; Boston, MA; Chapel Hill, NC
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Generalized Myasthenia Gravis (gMG) severity is classified into 5 MGFA groups based on muscle weakness, supporting prognosis and treatment decisions. With emerging digital health tools and their digital biomarkers (dBMKs), there is a need to investigate how these novel outcome measures reflect activities of daily living (MG-ADL) and disease severity. ME&MGTM is a software enabling remote self- assessment of ptosis, dysarthria, breathing, and limb muscle weakness through dBMKs. In the decentralized ME&MGopen study (NCT05566964), patients performed digital tests for one year. OBJECTIVE: To describe associations between dBMKS and MGFA groups. METHODS: Adults with gMG reported their clinicians’ evaluations at baseline and completed the MyVoice, MyEyelids, MyBreathing, MyArms and MyLegs digital tests monthly. MyVoice and MyEyelids scores increase with gMG severity while MyBreathing, MyArms and MyLegs scores decrease. Mixed models analyses determined associations between dBMKs and MGFA subclasses. RESULTS: 48 participants stratified into MGFA groups (12 Class II, 26 Class III, 10 Class IV) had mean (SD) age 64.2(15.3)/ 56.8(14.1)/ 45.5(20.5) years and mean (SD) MG-ADL scores 4.2(3.7)/ 7.4(4.4)/ 8.3 (3.4). DBMKs’ scores often associated with disease severity with MyVoice (0.6/1.2/0.9), MyEyelids (3.1/3.1/3.7) scores increasing and MyBreathing (19.8/13.3/13.3), MyArms (101.9/78.3/90.1) and MyLegs (18.6/14.8/12.6) scores decreasing. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: ME&MGTM dBMKs generally mirrored gMG severity supporting their potential clinical relevance and adoption in clinical practice.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：全身型重症肌无力（gMG）的严重程度根据肌无力情况分为5个MGFA组，用于支持预后判断和治疗决策。随着数字健康工具及其数字生物标志物（dBMKs）的出现，有必要研究这些新型结局指标如何反映日常生活活动（MG-ADL）和疾病严重程度。ME&MG™是一款软件，可通过dBMKs实现对上睑下垂、构音障碍、呼吸和肢体肌无力的远程自我评估。在去中心化ME&MGopen研究（NCT05566964）中，患者进行了为期一年的数字测试。目的：描述dBMKs与MGFA分组之间的关联。方法：成年gMG患者在基线报告其临床医生的评估，并每月完成MyVoice、MyEyelids、MyBreathing、MyArms和MyLegs数字测试。MyVoice和MyEyelids评分随gMG严重程度增加而升高，而MyBreathing、MyArms和MyLegs评分则降低。混合模型分析确定dBMKs与MGFA亚组之间的关联。结果：48名参与者按MGFA分组（12例II类、26例III类、10例IV类），平均（SD）年龄分别为64.2（15.3）/56.8（14.1）/45.5（20.5）岁，平均（SD）MG-ADL评分分别为4.2（3.7）/7.4（4.4）/8.3（3.4）。dBMKs评分常与疾病严重程度相关，MyVoice（0.6/1.2/0.9）、MyEyelids（3.1/3.1/3.7）评分升高，而MyBreathing（19.8/13.3/13.3）、MyArms（101.9/78.3/90.1）和MyLegs（18.6/14.8/12.6）评分降低。总结/结论：ME&MG™ dBMKs总体上与gMG严重程度一致，支持其潜在的临床相关性及在临床实践中的应用。

abstracts.title: Myasthenia Gravis: An Autoimmune Disease that Results in a Neurodegenerative Disease: The Hypothetical Immunological Cascade Reveals Shared Immune Architecture Across Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, and ALS
abstracts.authors: Jason Gursky
abstracts.affiliations: Carlsbad, CA
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Neurodegenerative diseases have resisted disease-modifying therapy partly because their immune components are treated as secondary phenomena rather than structured pathogenic cascades. Myasthenia gravis (MG) progresses through a reproducible immunological sequence formalized in the Hypothetical Immunological Cascade (HIC). If this architecture operates in neurodegeneration, the therapeutic implications are transformative. OBJECTIVE: To demonstrate that the six-stage HIC framework derived from MG exposes shared immune architecture across Alzheimer's disease (AD), Parkinson's disease (PD), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), reframing these disorders as stage dependent, therapeutically targetable immune pathologies. METHODS: The HIC and its Retrograde Cascade Inference protocol were applied to AD, PD, and ALS. Stage-specific mechanisms were mapped, evidence graded across four tiers, and each disease positioned on the autoimmune autoinflammatory continuum using MG as benchmark. RESULTS: All three diseases mapped onto all six HIC stages. AD anchored the autoinflammatory pole (complement-mediated synaptic stripping analogous to NMJ destruction in MG). PD showed classical autoimmune features (HLA-DRB1 associations, HLA-restricted alpha- synuclein T cell recognition). ALS demonstrated protective autoimmunity (C9orf72-specific CD4+ T cells producing IL-10, longer survival), demanding rethinking of immunosuppressive strategies. Treg dysfunction emerged as a convergent node, supported by trial evidence: low- dose IL-2 in AD (improved CSF Aβ42, p=0.045), sargramostim in PD (Treg expansion), and low-dose IL-2 in ALS (MIROCALS, HR 0.32, p=0.007). SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: This is not analogy; it is structural homology. Complement-mediated destruction, Treg failure, and epitope spreading operate through conserved mechanisms across the NMJ, synapse, dopaminergic terminal, and motor neuron. These findings position neuromuscular immunology at the center of the neurodegeneration therapeutic landscape.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：神经退行性疾病一直未能实现疾病修饰治疗，部分原因在于其免疫成分被视为次要现象而非结构化的致病级联。重症肌无力（MG）通过一个可重复的免疫学序列进展，该序列在假设性免疫级联（HIC）中被形式化。如果这一架构在神经退行性疾病中同样运作，其治疗意义将是变革性的。目的：证明源自MG的六阶段HIC框架揭示了阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）之间共享的免疫架构，从而将这些疾病重新定义为阶段依赖、可治疗性靶向的免疫病理。方法：将HIC及其逆行级联推断方案应用于AD、PD和ALS。映射阶段特异性机制，按四个证据等级进行分级，并以MG为基准将每种疾病定位在自身免疫-自身炎症连续谱上。结果：所有三种疾病均映射到全部六个HIC阶段。AD锚定自身炎症极（补体介导的突触剥离，类似于MG中的神经肌肉接头破坏）。PD显示经典自身免疫特征（HLA-DRB1关联、HLA限制性α-突触核蛋白T细胞识别）。ALS表现出保护性自身免疫（C9orf72特异性CD4+ T细胞产生IL-10，生存期更长），要求重新思考免疫抑制策略。Treg功能障碍成为一个汇聚节点，得到试验证据支持：AD中低剂量IL-2（改善CSF Aβ42，p=0.045）、PD中sargramostim（Treg扩增）、ALS中低剂量IL-2（MIROCALS，HR 0.32，p=0.007）。总结/结论：这不是类比，而是结构同源性。补体介导的破坏、Treg衰竭和表位扩展通过保守机制在神经肌肉接头、突触、多巴胺能末梢和运动神经元中运作。这些发现将神经肌肉免疫学置于神经退行性疾病治疗格局的中心。

abstracts.title: Preoperative Intravenous Immunoglobulin and Plasma Exchange in Myasthenia Gravis
abstracts.authors: Napasiri Putthanbut; Aditi Chakradeo; Eleni Kebede; Vijaya Lakshmi Valaparla; Chilvana Patel
abstracts.affiliations: Galveston, TX; Texas CIty, TX
abstracts.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Patients with myasthenia gravis (MG) undergoing thymectomy are at increased risk of perioperative myasthenic crisis (POMC). Although intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIg) and plasma exchange (PLEX) are routinely used for acute crisis management, evidence comparing their efficacy for preoperative management is limited. OBJECTIVE: To review the current studies and compare the efficacy of preoperative IVIg and PLEX to reduce perioperative complications in patients with MG undergoing elective surgery. METHODS: We conducted a literature review of studies evaluating the use of preoperative IVIg or PLEX in patients with MG. Studies published within the past twenty years were included if they evaluated adult patients with MG who received preoperative IVIg and/or PLEX before elective surgeries. RESULTS: Preoperative IVIg and PLEX demonstrated comparable effectiveness including reduction of perioperative myasthenic crisis, intubation duration, and the length of stay in patients with moderate-to-severe MG, with variable results among studies. Improvement was most evident among higher-risk patients, particularly those with severe disease, bulbar involvement, or a prior history of myasthenic crisis. SUMMARY/CONCLUSION: Current evidence supports comparable effectiveness of preoperative IVIg and PLEX in high-risk patients with MG but remains inadequate to guide standardized practice. Treatment protocols varied among studies, leading to inconsistent outcomes. Further investigation is warranted to establish standardized preoperative protocols for IVIg and PLEX use to reduce the risk of POMC in patients with MG undergoing thymectomy versus elective surgery.

abstracts.abstractZh: 引言：接受胸腺切除术的重症肌无力（MG）患者围手术期肌无力危象（POMC）风险增加。尽管静脉注射免疫球蛋白（IVIg）和血浆置换（PLEX）常规用于急性危象管理，但比较二者在术前管理中疗效的证据有限。目的：回顾现有研究，比较术前IVIg与PLEX在降低接受择期手术的MG患者围手术期并发症方面的疗效。方法：我们对评估术前IVIg或PLEX用于MG患者的研究进行了文献综述。纳入过去二十年内发表的研究，条件为评估在接受择期手术前接受术前IVIg和/或PLEX的成人MG患者。结果：术前IVIg和PLEX显示出相当的有效性，包括减少中重度MG患者的围手术期肌无力危象、插管持续时间和住院时间，但各研究结果存在差异。改善在高风险患者中最为明显，尤其是重症疾病、延髓受累或既往有肌无力危象史的患者。总结/结论：当前证据支持术前IVIg和PLEX在高风险MG患者中具有相当的有效性，但仍不足以指导标准化实践。各研究治疗方案不同，导致结局不一致。需要进一步研究以建立标准化的术前IVIg和PLEX使用方案，以降低接受胸腺切除术与择期手术的MG患者POMC风险。
